with the huge ad campaigns arby's has been running lately i had high hopes for this very rare visit to one of their "restaurants." what a disappointment. first, let me say that the service here was fast and friendly. i had no issue with the service at all but the food leaves alot to be desired. when you buy a meal from arby's expect to get overpriced lunchmeat. thats all it is. i had their new cheddar bacon beef sandwich with curly fires and the sandwich was small .. nothing like the photo and just not tasty at all. it had no flavor whatsoever. it s was not even as good as a premium roast beef cold cut you could get at any decent supermarket. the curly fries, however, were phenomenal. they were piping hot right out of the fryer. unfortunately, the fries werent enough to earn this place more than a one star review. i think the only thing id ever get from here again would be the fries. 

big thumbs down for arbys as a whole.
They have very rude staff and offers very bad service. In addition to that my last visit included being accused of lying about my order resulting in me being charged wrong.  Fun times.

Solid and affordable Thai style restaurant located in the heart of Chinatown. I did not expect a simple chicken and rice dish to be so deliciously made! I got their Set 1 with a boiled styled chicken dish. It came with a bowl of soup, bottle of water (or soda, you can choose) and a few cucumbers as a side.

As someone who does not like ginger, I was in love with the ginger rice that came with the chicken! The ginger taste is there but it was very light and flavored nicely in the rice. It was not overwhelming at all!! I got the boiled style chicken which is 100% recommended especially if you like super juicy and soft chicken. The two dipping sauces were ginger oil and a lightly spicy sauce that gave that extra OOMPH to the entire dish. Price and portions of the dish only cost 9.99 which is an excellent and very affordable dinner option.

A great spot in U City right on Penn's campus! If you go around 12/1pm while school is in session, be prepared to wait at least 15-20 minutes to order. My go-to is the falafel salad, just as it comes. The falafel is fresh and still warm, and the toppings (especially the beets!) are the perfect match. It is just the right amount of food.

3 stars are for this: I ordered a mint chocolate tehina shake after being told there was no nut contents in it... I drank the shake and was bothered by it a bit. When I went back the next time to verify there was no nut contents, I found out they all have a nut milk base. The first counter attendant did not know this and said there was no nut contents in it at all... Just be aware. I luckily don't have a detrimental nut allergy, but it could have been a bad situation if I did.

Absolutely horrible customer service. They gave me a very small amount of chicken so when I asked for a little more they tried to change me double. Before I finished explaining the toppings I wanted the lady already began wrapping my sandwich and gave ME attitude when I explained that I wasn't finished... so confused. When I thought the situation couldn't get any worse, as I was about to pay I asked for a cup for water and they explained that they were all out of cups. But when I saw there were plenty of cups available they said they couldn't give me those cups and that there would be more tomorrow?!! Then as I sat to eat with my girlfriend the lady continues to just stare at us while speaking whatever language they spoke, it all just felt very demeaning and unprofessional. When I asked for more napkins later as we were finishing the meal the man came over and continued to ask what the situation was and if I needed more napkins in a sarcastic tone. Dude, just please stop talking, and give me my napkins. Absolutely ruined my experience at subway here on campus and will never be returning.

Definitely on my list as top takeout spots in Chinatown - would come back again and again for their fried chicken over rice! Highly recommend.
How they're managing COVID: All servers were in masks and gave very punctual, quick takeout - I called to order in advance, but they have online ways of placing orders too.

Food: They're known for their chicken over rice dish, a common street food in Thailand. Tried both the fried and boiled chicken options - I did like the fried a bit more, but thought both were delicious. The sweet & slightly spicy sauce paired very well with the chicken. My favorite part was definitely rice - a blend of ginger and chicken stock. The chicken portion size was also quite large for only ~$10.

Overall: 5/5 -  Seriously - you have to order this for takeout at least once. I will definitely be back (largely for their rice!)

After seeing reviews of the newly opened Hainanese chicken rice restaurant on Yelp, I was excited to check out Cily Chicken Rice. 

I grew up eating Hainanese chicken rice, so I am going to be biased of course, and had high expectations going in. 

I am used to Hainanese chicken being poached in stock with ginger and scallions, which would make the chicken flavorful. Cily's boiled chicken tasted pretty bland. The sauces that were provided did compliment the chicken nicely though. I also liked that the chicken was served warm, unlike Penang's. 

The fried chicken, on the other hand was delicious. I would recommend this over the boiled chicken.

As for the chicken rice, it wasn't seasoned and could use more chicken fat. Our set for two also came with two bowls of broth, with generous pieces of radish in it, which I enjoyed.

I know that  there is someone begging at the door at times, and I know there are some rather unusual people sitting in the front of the restaurant; but I think the staff is nice and friendly and the food is always hot and fresh. I don't give money to the folks at the door and they're usually respectful and don't get in your face or really bother anyone at all. I do feel guilty about eating there because let's face it, I'm not there for a salad, I'm there for a Big Mac and other versions of their delicious burgers and lots of Diet Coke. I also feel guilty about the unfortunate folks at the door and that I'm eating basically unhealthy food (feeding my processed food addiction) near people who want money to feed their addictions too. There is a sad irony about the human condition that screams in mind when I go there. My processed food addiction, their various addictions, the desperation, OMG if you can overcome all of that, and hang back with the staff near the register, it's not a bad experience :)

So the staff are really nice and patient. For a while they stopped calling it "special sauce" and started calling it "Mac sauce" (I think it was generational because the younger staff didn't know what it was) but today on a commercial I heard the announcer call it "special sauce" again so maybe it's throwback Monday?
We had a really good experience and enjoyed the new turkey sandwich (it was California turkey something). The staff was so kind!
The service here is appalling and totally ignorant service. The food is not worth the risk getting shot in the rodent infested alley where the restaurant is.

Food:
Sandwich ($7.50) was dry and average. Towards the end I just forced myself to finish it because I was hungry, not because I enjoyed it. I would rather walk get a sandwich from High Street which is in the same food court. Or better yet, take a trip to center city for some dizengoff. 
Shake ($5): very heavy. The plain shake has nuts such as almonds and tastes like a peanut butter shake. I split the cup with 3 friends because it was too heavy for us to finish alone. We drank it to wash down the dry sandwich but this combo just left us feeling so heavy and full. 
Shawarma fries ($3): too salty. Similar to Cajun fries 

Overall, overpriced & mediocre food. Honestly, this whole food court is too boujie for my taste. I miss the old food court. But if you have the money to spend and want falafel, this is the only option in university city. I wouldn't come back

The line for this place was less a line and more a mob of people huddled around the counter, so I knew this was the hot spot to grab lunch on campus. Would I come back, though? Probably not. It was good, but not worth the wait or the prices IMHO. 

Got the falafel salad (should have got the sandwich since the pita pocket did look enticing) and a banana tahini shake. I had heard through the grapevine about these tahini shakes and was excited to try one on the 100 degree day I was there. 

I'm glad I got the banana, cause the tahini is DEFF an acquired taste. It was tasty enough, but not nearly as cold and refreshing as I had hoped. Pretty mealy and thick actually.  The little bag of falafel balls and garlic dip for the salad were actually very delicious and perfectly fried, but the salad and dressing itself was bitter and kinda meh. 

The wait was at least 20 minutes and close to $20 in cost. You're better off getting some nice street halal for a fraction of the cost.

Great quick bite type of place. 
The cheesesteak was one of the best vegetarian versions I have ever had in this city. 
The fries were good, but I wasn't really feeling the heavy seaweed taste. 

This is a great step in the Philly vegan scene, but I wish it was a little more affordable.

It had to have been 2012 I came into this restaurant for the first time. In a way, this restaurant is like Steak n Shake (they are popular in the Midwest since I'm from there). I'll admit, I came in here to use the bathroom, I would have ordered but this place gets so packed and crowded. The staff here is usually nice, they have never given me a hard time. I actually went to a Johnny Rockets when Showboat Casino was opened in Atlantic City, NJ and I really loved the food.

Revising my previous review of this particular Burger King for taking greedy advantage of the Papal Visit by over-doubling it's prices (double cheeseburger went from $1.69 to $4 that week), and for not carrying standard promos such as the lack of a Halloween Whopper. This is a much nicer place than it was a year ago, but thats about all I can say about it for now.
Attention!! They food is disgusting no type of effort! No seasoning, weird taste !!! Please listen and don't waste your $$ they need to go OUT OF Business!! What a shame !! Nasty as hell .

I don't think I will be dining at this establishment again. If I set food at this Johnny Rockets location again, I am pretty sure it is going to because my coworkers are going to out vote me; I can guarantee it will not be my choice. 

I have driven past this location hundreds of times between 1994, when I got my license and started going in to Philadelphia without adult supervision, and now. I always said to myself that I need to stop in there as I drove past. I love the opportunity to step inside a Johnny Rockets for an order of fries and one of those tasty milkshakes. So what can be better than going to Johnny Rockets on the iconic South Street in Philadelphia.  

To be fair this location was probably great back in 1994. I would even say It was probably a great place 10 years ago. The experience I had today told me two things. Either this place has gone down hill, or it was never as great as I thought it may have been. 

The minute I walked in the door, I wanted to walk right out. The placed smelled like it was moped with a mixture of dirty water with a cap full of dirty toilet water. For me that is a deal breaker and is going to cost your a few stars. The booths still had remains of food on it. Our initial server was a gentleman my coworker recognized as a person that drank a keg a day at Downey's; everyday. It showed because he was a little loopy. For some reason he was put on a new section and we received the young Romanian waitress who was awesome. Except for the french fries onion rings mix up, she was on her game. The rest of our order was right, she checked on us continually without be overbearing, got us refills at that right time, and even offered to itemized the check. My buddy and I always do a straight split as long as we get close to the same thing, but the gesture was nice. 

The food was ehh and the place was a bit filthy. However between our waitress and the manager the service great. I look forward to restoring Johnny Rockets reputation  when I have it on my cruise in October.  I know how good they are.  The store in Philadelphia does not demonstrate that completely.

It's really vegan!!!!

Being from Chicago n visiting family in Philly a lot we've had our fare share of chz steaks (before going vegan).  I wouldn't necessarily say I'm a super fan of cheese steak, but I actually found that this place serves better Philly cheese steak than other real Philly cheese steaks that I've had. 

N they have cocktails!!!
Apple cider lemonade with 2 shots of bullet whiskey!!!!  
Nuff said!!  

Def gonna have to hit this up again when we go back to philly!!

I had high expectations for this place as I love V Street and Vedge, but I was very underwhelmed by Wiz Kid. Perhaps it's because I'm not a huge sandwich person and surprisingly despite living in Philly for 1.5 years haven't tried a Philly cheesesteak.. so take my review with a grain of salt. I got the Wiz Kid Philly (seitan, mushrooms, fried onion, rutabaga wiz) and the Wiz Fries (their version of cheese fries). At $9.50, the the WK Philly was decently sized but not worth it in my opinion; it was way too salty and greasy for my taste. The fries were pretty decent, and a nice little indulgence! The vegan ice cream was awful though, very icy and hard, not creamy at all. Unfortunately, I feel like I just wasted calories eating at this place! Cool atmosphere and very friendly staff though.

Don't even want to give them 1 star. They don't deserve it. The customer service is TERRIBLE. They don't even ask which type of bread you want for your sandwich, gives you the smallest amount of meat, and doesn't give all the proper toppings/sauces that are supposed to come with the sandwich. NEVER EVER GOING HERE AGAIN. Please do yourself a favor. Don't go here and waste your money.
Absolutely worst! They don't even acknowledge customers standing waiting to order. Place is filthy and this was before COVID. New management and staff are needed here

Trio is a new Breakfast/Lunch spot located in Germantown at the busy intersection of Wayne & Chelten Ave. There are 5 different bus lines congregating at these 2 streets and it's usually very busy here. 
Trio is a small place with seating for about 12 - 15 people, but it has a huge menu. They serve all the usual Breakfast items including Belgian Waffles, Fish & Grits, Breakfast Sandwiches and Omelets. The Lunch menu is even bigger with Cheese steaks and Wraps, Wings, Salads, Teriyaki, Fish Hoagies, and even some Korean dishes like Bulgogi and Kalbi Ribs. 
I went there for breakfast one morning and I strolled up to the counter where a very polite young lady asked me what I would like. I ordered 2 Eggs over medium with Salmon Patties and Grits with butter, Toast and Coffee. It came to $5.45 and she said to take a seat and she will bring it to me. 
An alarm immediately went off in my mind hoping that I wouldn't be siting there eating out of a takeout container. Happily I was served with real china and cutlery. The food was decent and filling and I can't wait to come back and try the Kalbi Ribs. They better have some Kim Chee!

My first visit to Goldie was for a casual lunch-time snack. 

The staff was incredibly friendly, and the choices/menu stands out among the other vendors at Penn's new/renovated Franklin's Table.

The Original Tehina shake was GREAT. I wasn't sure what to expect from it, but it was sweet and nutty and rich - almost giving off some peanut butter flavors. 

The Shwarma-spiced fries were a tasty addition too. They are super flavorful, briny, and fried to perfection. 

From what I saw, the falafel sandwich and salads look incredible, and I can't wait to come back and try those!

This is a hard review to write because I've had so many mix ups here but one top notch experience.

When I'm feeling weak and hungover I sometimes pop in here on my way to work for a #1 with a small oj..more times than I can remember the order gets messed up. The drive through takes forever and by the time you get your bag you're frustrated and late and you drive off without noticing you got a bacon biscuit sandwich instead of your egg McMuffin....devastating lol

Now recently an employee was moving to california to work remotely and as his going away party we catered in McDonald's (kind of a gag party but you should give it a go). I went inside because I knew this wasn't a drive through order..I ordered probably 15 mc doubles half without onions.. 10 4 pc McNuggets.. flurries..several Big Macs..fries..pies..etc..we went all out. The woman at the counter was so nice and I got all that food faster than any drive though experience. What's even better is instead of ringing up everything separately she rang them in as pick twos for $4 or something...I spent way less than expected! 

Lesson learned no drive through for me..but large orders are surprisingly a yes here!

This is the slowest drive thru in America. Just say no, it took over 30 minutes with hardly anybody in line. I will never come here again, you would do better cooking it yourself it quicker and it will be fresh.
This place ruins my diet, lol.  Just too good, love the iced coffee. I like the think they did with the drive through.

I LOVED the tehina Turkish coffee milkshake. It's the perfect size, super delicious, and I've never had anything like it. I would come here again purely to get that milkshake, it also has this delicious cookie and walnut topping. So good. 

Giving 4 stars cuz I got the falafel salad and I didn't love it. The beet to salad ratio was like 3:1. I don't mind beets usually but it's better as a topping rather than the salad base. Falafel was good I'd love to try it in the other forms. 

Bottom line:  get the milkshake here 100% and if you aren't the president of the "I love beet committee" then don't get the falafel salad

If you want delicious authentic Thai food, this is the place to order from! Food always comes hot when delivered, well packaged with more than enough portions.  Just ordered the Pad Thai this evening which was simply delicious.  Prices are very reasonable!

This was my first time eating here and I guarantee I will visit again. The rolls I ordered were very very delicious. I ordered two sweet and two savory rolls to get a taste of each, plus unique drinks.

The savory rolls certainly surprised me with how crispy they were despite having a lot of meat stuffed in. I wouldn't order these expecting your normal Chinese restaurant egg rolls. These are bigger and more filling. The Generals Tso roll was my fave. Mainly because it packed all the flavor of the Chinese dish without the overwhelming sweetness in a lot of American Chinese food. The salmon roll was delicious also, but ultimately nothing spectacular compared to the General Tso's. 

As for the drinks, the blue wave reminds me of blue Hawaiian Punch, nothing more nothing less. Its delicious, but mainly served as a mixer for Tequila. The Tea, while also delicious reminded me of any standard bottled tea mixed with pineapple juice. 

Finally, the dessert rolls...the dessert rolls alone were delicious enough to make me come back. Each bite of the dessert rolls brought a new amazing flavor profile. The Peach Cobbler reminded me of homemade tarts. The cheesecake reminded me of a Tasty Kake but actually edible with flavor. 

All in all, I came in expecting an experience similar to traditional egg rolls and came away quite impressed with this restaraunts ability to use traditional foods in unique ways. I applaud your efforts and will definitely return.
It's ok depending on the time of day and if ur getting it delivered because they just put anything n the bag but overall the food is good lol

Mikey Chen came here so therefore I must come here. He noted particularly the rice being good. He wasn't wrong. 

They specialize in Hainanese chicken and you could get it either boiled style or fried style with crispy skin. I got their set#1 with the boiled style chicken. The chicken tasted like your typical Chinese poached chicken and came with a ginger scallion sauce and a hot sauce to go with it. Their ginger rice though was special. It didn't taste like your typical white rice and had a unique flavor to it. The set also came with a soup and was a nice hearty broth - not too salty not too bland. 

Overall, I would come again if in the area. I gotta try their fried style chicken rice next time.

Been a faithful customers to them until piece of metal was in my juice for takeout, contacted them they said they was busy they would call me back never called me back and blocked my number from the cell phone I sent the pictures too .
There money hungry and don't care about the customers

Dined inside the other day and ordered Set 1, and paid $2 extra to get the combo of boiled and fried chicken. The radish soup and ginger rice were both amazing. Chicken was very juicy and paired perfectly with the variety of sauces. Very clean facility inside. This was my second time eating boiled chicken and it is very different. Tender and juicy meat, but I prefer fried over boiled. I wasn't able to finish my food so got it in a to go box. Unfortunately, they do not have any sauces they can give you to go not even one. Also, it's a credit card minimum of $15. Thankfully they have Venmo and you can pay using the app! 
I plan on returning and trying their other dishes like curry and noodles.

Usually our go to Restaurant, Menu is Decent and Prices aren't bad. We've Never had a Bad experience here, but tonight was Absolutely terrible. We were Sitting for an Hour and a Half, we only Received drinks and Apps. We Only seen our Waiter twice. 
We got Up, offered to Pay for what was brought to us so we could Leave. The Manager was Professional, Kind and Understanding. He Comp'd the whole Meal. 
Unfortunately, we Probably won't return.

the Cashier charged me the wrong amount (the total dollar amount for the car behind me). the  cashier did not verify that it was the correct order but simply swiped my card. It get worse as the same cashier says it is not her mistake but mine because I was supposed to know my order.  She started to argue with me until she back off. she did cause a scene for no reason.
hint: It helps if you comfirm what was ordered.
they did correct the problem and refunded on the spot.
I checked the order when I go home and my order was missing food.  My daughters happy was not a very happy. It was missing the toy and her small fries.  
overall, it was a pretty horrible experience.  I would give zero stars if it was not for the fact that the food I did get was able to feed my daughter and I.

Sorry excuse of an establishment. Can't believe this place has the audacity to consider itself a restaurant. Incredibly long wait times even for orders placed ahead of time, rude staff, dirty interior. Don't do it to yourself, get chipotle next door instead- you'll thank yourself for it and save yourself the frustration.
Staff is hella rude. Inside looks way too dirty for a restaurant and again, the staff is HELLA RUDE. Food was ok, but overall place is terrible.
We ordered the cheddar and the garlic Parmesan fries along with the wings. Not bad. I like the variety in fry flavors. We would definitely stop by here again.

I visited today and I couldn't receive my order because their machine said decline but my bank account showed the money being taken out. I called Chase bank and they said the money has been taken out and nothing is wrong with my card. The rep said it is their machine and they still would not give me my order.

Well wasn't this place a nice surprise! Honestly, I always stay away from newer restaurants like this because sometimes the food is toned down in terms of spice and everything nice, but CCR was a very pleasant surprise. We tried the black cloud fungus (mushrooms), the chicken pad thai because I literally try pad thai everywhere, and the red curry. 

The black cloud fungus aka mushrooms were REALLY good. The texture kinda reminded me of tofu with more cheesier taste. I even threw some on my pad thai towards the end of eating it because I mix my foods like a child sometimes. The pad thai was pretty solid. Not the spiciest, but the portion were fair. I really don't remember the red curry since my wife only gave me a spoonful, but the little I had was ok. lol She's nice sometimes and shares her food. 

Overall will order something different like the chicken fried rice and see what the fuss is about.

Wish I could give NO stars to this location!

I've never had a cold burger from a fast food restaurant until today. Ordered the cheesy combo sandwich. I love fast food, but this location and experience killed that streak. 

The price of the sandwich, according to the drive-thru menu, was $3.99, but when I paid, I got charged $4.49. The employee did not care to correct the mistake when I brought it up, and said that the drive-thru menu is incorrect. He then shut the sliding window in my face. So rude! 

Never ever going back to this location again. Will go to the McDonald's next door!

Pure fucking idiots they have working here... trust me if you want McDonald's go that extra mile and get it from Bristol pike, I can just bet these guys fuck up something anytime we go here ... I've had it I'm gonna go out of my way next time not to come back. BTW were in the wake of a pandemic and all but one person was wearing the mask improperly. Sure hope me or my family don't get sick and I'll pray for anyone else that chooses they're service

In honor of Thanksgiving I may as well get a couple Turkeys out of the way. It's a hard call but Johnny Rockets just might be the worst establishment on South Street. After all while people might find reasons of merit to enjoy the other candidates, we can all agree that minimum wage making waitstaffs who dance on tables and sing out of tune to 50's music is pretty damn nauseating!

The one time that I made the mistake of giving here a try I ended up with what  might just be the worst burger I've ever had. It was seriously all kinds of undercooked and gross. The place was also on par with Beach Boys songs that I would have prefered to have forgotten about. The one sick sad twist is that the Milkshakes were actually pretty damn amazing. But nowhere near worth putting up with the rest of this place and it's inconsistent service. One day I'll liberate that recipe!

If your in absolute dire straits and really need to do a 50's style restaurant, than at least go to somewhere with tolerable food like Ruby's or Nifty Fifty's. but avoid here at all costs. Bleurgh is right!

The chicken and rice here is excellent but don't sleep on the Thai food! I've tried all of the noodle dishes on the menu and was happy with every single one. I would say their noodles are better than many Thai restaurants in the city. The drunken noodles dish is quite spicy so beware if you have a low spice tolerance. Cily has become one of my favorite restaurants in Chinatown because the food is always consistent. I always seem to forget that they're closed from 3pm-4pm, which is oddly when I want to order!

Seriously the best sandwich I have ever had in my life! The staff was so fantastic. They were able to answer any questions and even give suggestions. The falafel is soooo crispy. 10/10 will be coming back again and recommending it to everyone under the sun.

So freaking delish. 10/10 recommend the fried chicken and rice. The reason for only 4 stars is, I always order for delivery. A couple of times I have received my order and it's been wrong. One time I ordered the fried chicken and received the boiled chicken and it took forever to come.. so I was hungry and the order was wrong, so you can see how that's frustrating. Another time I ordered extra sauce and they gave me the wrong sauce. It hasn't deterred me from placing future orders from here, but it does cause me to worry I may not get what I ordered. Also it takes a little longer than it says it does than the delivery time your are given. But it's a must try though.

I stopped here with my son because he was bugging me to get Checkers I said NO at first but he talked me into going- I wish I stuck to my guns on not going because the food was just what I thought it would be gross & and soggy. The cheeseburger looked like something that was plopped together tons of may ketchup and mustard on the bun that it made the rolls soggy. Checkers needs to focus on making better food or I am afraid they will be shut down soon and be just a memory. Do Not go here.
Literally changed everything I knew about Thai food!  Super delicious, cute, and clean. I totally recommend any of the chicken sets and the coconut soup with ginger rice is amazing

Sunday afternoon came in to the store and order takeout 11:55AM,  after paying the lady told us that their kitchen is very busy, need to wait 20-30min... at that time she really didn't give us a choice cuz we have already pay. Went out and bought drinks and came back 25mins later, the same lady told us that it almost ready, they are packing our food. Continue waited 15mins, saw new customers came in after us and order, their food got served.... Went and ask, got a response "I can't control the kitchen" it's now 12:43PM... we are still waiting. This kind of restaurant, I would suggest to stay away! Far away!!! Will never come back again...12:45PM they came out with our food, I walked out and my sister remained me to check the bad, and there!!! they missed up our order!!! This was the worst experience. We are speechless.

Some real attitude in here. Plus, half the staff doesn't wear a mask, they don't even pretend. I had "thought" that businesses on campus were under the same mandate as the students. I guess not? Are they vaccinated?

If you have the  IQ of a stick , here's the place of employment for you... EVERY TIME, I go there, don't know why I do, they  screw up  my order... HOW HARD IS IT TO  PUT STUFF IN A BAG?? Rob me every single time.. Place should be closed down... GOOD  JOB MANAGER!! Morons!!!!!!

I loathe McDonald's and fast food in general, but I did go here once out of sheer desparation, hunger and broke-ass-ed-ness.  I got a $1.00 McChicken Sandwich, no pickles - It came to $1.07 and I just barely had the change scraped together.

What a humbling experience.

I pray it won't happen again.

The service is terrible here -- 4 people working as a cashier but no one is taking orders, just talking to each other. The manager was nearby but didnt seem concerned and also was participating in the talking. I'm not really sure how this McDonalds stays open in the area, especially without a renovation and some new staff.  Lots of better 'fast food' nearby with workers who will actually take your order.

Friendly staff. Typical Subway food. In and out within 5 mins or less!
Oh and they always tell you how many subway points you have!

Lol , this place deserves NO stars ! Every single time I come here , they have an attitude and they get something wrong . How a business can be run with such incompetent people is beyond me. Even the manager can't get anything right but has the nerve to have attitudes .. what a joke . I ordered through Uber Eats and requested 2 happy meals . I received one . I reordered another happy meal and this time they gave me a Big Mac . How in the hell do you go from happy meal to Big Mac . Can none of you read an order screen ? Lol isn't that apart of your daily task ? Tsk tsk . Ridiculous

First time I came here was on 9/28/12. I can't remember if I had bought food. This restaurant does get packed since it's close to the PATCO 8th and Market station. Service is ok but as mentioned it does get crowded. If you decide to eat in the restaurant, they don't have the trays.

No one at this location cares, in fact you are bothering them, tried to send me out with my to go order short 2 cheeseburgers, and no drink, literally half my order. Then they copped an attitude when I asked for the items I paid for, this started a "it's your fault" argument between the employees, the only one even attempting to try was the lone cashier, there was a short Hispanic girl is a red McDonald's uniform that was playing grab ass and yell at the employee that was supposed to be cooking(I think she is sweet on him).
 
When I asked for my drink the first time, the woman that was only oversalting the fries and handing out orders barked at the cashier to give me my drink after asking me what drink I was Spose to have instead of looking at the pull sheet attached to the damn bag she gave me.

I remembered they forgot my nugget sauce last time so while waiting for my drink I looked in the bag, they nailed giving me my sauce and shorted me two cheeseburgers.

Whoever runs this place should fire everyone, close down, clean the place like it's getting ready for a grand opening and hire new staff, I know it's McDonald's but damn y'all just don't care
This is some of the best falafel I've ever had. I come here on my lunch break all the time and the food is consistently amazing

I ordered 25 wings and only received 20. Not a huge deal but when the wings are almost a dollar each it adds up. Plus, I ordered 25 to split 10 and 15 with another person. When I called an employee (female) got on the phone and asked me (in a condescending tone) if I was sure and implied that i was wrong about my count. She stated that the cook said they checked it before it went out so there was no way for her to know for sure. I have an extensive order history with them and have never had an issue before so now to have one and have it implied that I was wrong, when the 20 wings were laying right in front of me, was a little insulting. As if I would call them to try and get 5 free wings from them. So instead of just sending me my wings I was offered a 5 dollar credit for a future order. I will never order from them again. There is a right way to treat a customer and then there is George's way.
This was the worst Subway sandwich I've ever had. It was flimsy, no choices offered! Paid over $20 dollars with all the fees included with Grubhub. I will never order again!
Currently waiting for my order. Its been more than an hour. Horrendous service. My uber driver has bern waiting for more than a while. Utterly ridiculous
It's a good place to get a quick lunch or dinner.  I'd say that 'Fridays' offers a bit better menu, but Applebee's is never a bad place to eat.

The Good first. Cily pushes chicken on you in name and decor, and they're not messing around. I had their fried chicken with rice and it was SCRUMPTIOUS. The outside of the chicken was so crispy. It was like I was crunching glass in my mouth (in a good way), but the meat was still moist and delicate. I was really surprised by the rice. My dining companions and I kept looking at each other and saying, "my god, the rice!" after every bite. Never before have I gone to a restaurant and been wowed by rice, but Cily changed that. My dining companions also ordered chicken and rice dishes and were similarly impressed. Our appetizers we ordered were a smorgasbord of fried delights. Really clogged our arteries on crab rangoons, spring rolls and dumplings. All were pretty solid and everything was extremely friendly to our wallets. Seriously though...That rice...Heavenly.

There aren't many bad things about this place. I suppose the place is  small and I was a little disappointed they didn't have Thai fishcakes in stock. A legitimate criticism I have, and this is nitpicking, is that there were a lack of vegetables with our chicken sets. But Cily does have some vegetable mains that we could've gotten if we really wanted our fix of greens.

TL;DR Nothing silly about Cily Chicken Rice. Chicken is genuinely good. Maybe get some veggie dishes on the side though.

I gave an extra star because the issue was resolved but I ordered breakfast on the app 10:20. The app tells you to then drive to the thru and tell the associate working drive thru that you have a mobile order. What the app does not tell you is that you have to let an associate know immediately which means that if you really want your food you must order and arrive and wait in the astronomically long line all before breakfast ends or your order doesn't get served. So I placed my order at 10:20, arrived at 10:25, waited in the astronomically long line for 20 min and then was told because breakfast ended before I reached an associate there would be no food for me. How absurd! Your order should be honored because you placed it within the time constraint of Breakfast served. I cannot believe they'd even let you wait in that line and then tell you oh we don't have any food for you despite the app telling you to pull up and retrieve your order. Now, after speaking with five different people, they managed to "find" a way to give me my order with some slight substitutions by 11:10. My confusion now lies at how 10:30 arrives and all of a sudden there is no breakfast. I assume they put it away or give it away but how can you say because of the time of day there is just no longer any food? That just doesn't make any sense. I know this is just an issue with the way the establishment works because their lines are super long any time of day. However, this solidified my thinking that orders on the app should be honored so long as the order is placed within the time constraint or the app should not avoid for you to place the order if the time assumed for the line wouldn't allow you to get the food in time.

Had to reorder my meal twice and was wrong once I received the order. The sandwich had a plastic label inside of it. Customer service was awful!!! The staff need customer service training and safety protocol education!

This was the first meal I had after moving to Philadelphia and it was a great introduction! It stays open a bit later than most of the other restaurants in the area, which is much appreciated. The boiled chicken rice is so good and reminds me of hainanese chicken. We got the set for 2 people, which also comes with soup! There was a regular sauce and a spicy sauce and I actually really liked the spicy one. We also got the pad Thai which I thought was just ok, which is why this isn't 5 stars. The chicken rice was def 5 stars though!! The value is also so great - we were 3 people and still had a good amount of leftovers! Definitely 100% recommend stopping by here for the chicken rice :) I'll come back and try the fried chicken instead next time (or do half and half bc the boiled chicken is so good)

Can they sparw the condiments? I asked for extra condiments on all of my sandwiches because I know they are very skimpy with them. All of my sandwiches were very dry and almost inedible. Also none of them were labeled. People don't like you to have to open every sandwich to find out what they are! Skimpy on napkins. Forgot or did not have part of Grubhub order, but still charged for it.
Don't waste your time!

Yea! Potato Corner finally opened today in the Fashion District. There were plenty of people waiting for their orders of fries, tater tots, chicken tenders, and definitely no salads.

I came with my coworker, and she got a combo tots and tenders because the chicken poppers advertised on the menu were not available. It came with a large drink. I went with the "jumbo" (small) tater tots only.

There were a lot of young kid staffers with two or three older men who just have been the managers. Because the staff were just opened an hour or so, it was not a well oiled machine and it looked like bumper cars in the small space for all of them. There also was some confusion as to which direction does the line go for ordering and pickup.

The food itself is made in some industrial stainless fryers which you just pop the product in the hopper and set a time. Then a few minutes later you're good to go. My tots were nice and crisp with no grease taste. The chili BBQ seasoning was fine. Not homemade, but good. The tots from my coworker got the cheddar seasoning and also was just fine. Her chicken tenders were crispy. They weren't great, but also not the worst she's ever had. I saw they were just regular grade tenders in a sealed plastic bag. The ranch dip was good. She was disappointed that the lemonade was just the Coke variety and not a fresh squeeze like we get at the Reading Terminal Market (see my review!). 

So there are some kinks in efficiency to work on, but I'm sure in time that will work out. The food is good when you're in the mood for some comfort food. 

My jumbo tots were just under $5 and the combo meal came to $11. You could probably get a better meal for that amount elsewhere, but this was nice.

Absolutely would come back for the tots.
Found long hair in my fries on 2/7/2021. Some workers not masked. Those with masks did not have their noses covered.
Ordered 4 cheese mac and cheese with chicken fingers to go and it was HORRIBLE. There was sugar in the MAC and cheese and the chicken fingers were more like nuggets

Terrible. Just look at how much fries they skimped out on my order. I guess this is typical Philadelphia fast food when it comes to ordering fries. Same always goes for all the Wendy's. They only fill it up half way. Ridiculous
This place was amazing. We shared a salad, okonomiyaki fries, and vegan cheesesteak. So yummy!! The fries were amazing.

Got takeout here, during my lunch break at work, Set 1 is very worth it for its price of ~$11.00. Comes with this mildly spicy orange chili sauce for the chicken. Will come back here, next time I work a day shift.

I am a huge baby with a weak stomach and am continually poisoning myself with gluten and lactose on my lunch breaks at Penn. 

NO MORE! I am completely obsessed with Goldie. Crispy falafel with a tender interior, a veggie-dense salad free from cross-contamination, and well-made fries with whatever the hell seasoning they offered me. I can't remember what it was called, but get it.

Last, but not least, the tahini shake. Holy shit. How do they do it without dairy? How do they make it so addictive? Just, how. HOW. It solves the problem of halvah's horribly dry mouthfeel, delivering glorious globs of sweet sesame to my palate with every gulp. 

I am considering quitting water, as this is clearly the superior beverage. If I die, don't blame Goldie. Blame my stupid brain that loves candy and hates being hydrated.

We got the set #1 and a fish cake appetizer for takeout. Ginger rice was amazing , chicken was a bit dry, and sauces were on point (just wish there was more). They did forgot to add the soup that came with the set and we didnt notice till we got home. Fish cake was good and as expected!

I'll probably come back for dine in at some point and see if that makes a difference.

I was craving cheesesteak eggrolls and Rock N' Rolls popped up in my search results for cheesesteak eggrolls near me. I was happy to discover a place specializing in eggrolls. I couldn't resist ordering a selection of eggrolls to try.  I started with the cheesesteak eggroll I was craving, then added a chicken cheesesteak eggroll, a veggie eggroll, and an apple pie eggroll for dessert.

This place knows how to cook an eggroll! Each one was perfectly cooked and crispy with just the right amount of filling. The cheesesteak eggroll was delicious and satisfied my craving. My only minor gripe is that it could have used more cheese. Unfortunately, I didn't get the chicken cheesesteak eggroll I ordered. It was replaced with the Buffalo chicken eggroll. While it was tasty, it needed a dipping sauce to cut through the heat of the Buffalo sauce. You can order a dipping sauce with each eggroll, but since I didn't order this I had to drink water to deal with the heat. I did get a refund for the missing item. The veggie eggroll was as good as an eggroll gets without meat. I'm a big fan of apple desserts in general and the apple pie eggroll did not disappoint. A delectable dessert that provided a sweet ending to my meal. 

I do plan to order from Rock N' Rolls again when I want a cheesesteak eggroll. And maybe next time I will actually get the chicken cheesesteak eggroll to go with it.

I came here with my family last week for Fast Food Lunch, and although, it's the best for everyone to be honest. The Spicy Chicken Sandwich, one of my favorite meals at the Chick fil A Restaurant was absolutely fabulous and delicious but the thing I like the Beverages is the Ice, how did they do it?!

I was very excited to try this place especially they specialized in Hainanese chicken which is one of my favorite dishes. 

I got the boneless chicken over ginger rice. It also came with liver, gizzard, and soup. Other dishes I've tried were the pad see eew noodle with beef and the fried style chicken over rice with ginger rice. Overall,  the dishes were good but my favorite was the fried style chicken rice. I found the fried-style chicken more flavorful and the chicken cooked more well done. The ginger rice was ok. It's good but the flavor can be better. The pad see eew dish was delicious. I also enjoyed the soup with radish that came with the meal. 

The service and the wait time for the food are longer than I expected.  But overall, a great place for Hainanese chicken and Thai food in Chinatown.

This place should be permanently closed down. That would actually be a service to everyone. This is absolutely the WORST McD's in NE Philly. I went to the drive thru and ordered a Nugget meal. The idiot who gave me my bag was more interested in talking to her coworkers. I asked for sweet and sour sauce to which she said it's in there (it's f'ing bbq sauce!) To make matters worse, there were no fries in my bag even though I already paid and they come with my meal. I wouldn't wish my worst enemy eat here except for puta who gave me my order in the drive thru.

This used to be a great place with great customer service but those days are gone! They have understandably had to make changes due to the COVID-19 pandemic but they ought to have warning signs everywhere about how long the wait is. This has always been a busy location but now 'busy' is the understatement of the year. If you want to go through the drive thru now they have two lanes set up to reduce traffic. This seems like a great idea but it doesn't stop the line from wrapping all the way around the parking lot of the nearby Buffalo Wild Wings. They should have a sign at the end like the ones at amusement parks saying: "90 minute wait from here." So at this point you might be thinking: "Okay then I'm gonna be smart and order ahead for a curbside pickup!" Well, I have some bad news for you. I had a similar thought on my last craving for Chick-fil-A and did just that. I placed an order at 2:43pm on a Monday afternoon and arrived a little before 3 thinking my food would be just about ready. I learned the hard way that they don't start making your order or even charge your card until you get there, make your way ally the way around the 50 car drive thru line, and park in one their designated spots. This of course completely eliminated the point of ordering ahead but "Okay," I thought, "at least my order should be done soon." Do I even have to tell you how wrong I was? I waited 30 minutes in a hot parking lot while my phone told me my order was being prepared until it finally change to tell me a team member was bringing me my food now. I wait another 15 minutes and finally they bring me my food and drink. Furious and impatient from the wait, I quickly left the parking lot. On my drive home I took a sip from my drink only to find out that they had given me the wrong drink!!! I didn't return to the restaurant because I couldn't stand to wait there another minute but this has been one if my worst experiences at a fast food restaurant ever. If you're looking for chicken, try the Popeyes across the street!

came here at 5am, it says 24 hours on the front of the building and on google. i pull up to the drive through and the guy says "sorry were closed" i saw two employees walk in the side door. 

this is what happens when you hire lazy people who dont care about their job and just want to get paid for doing nothing

I would give this place 0 stars if u could. It's just ratchet in here. Every person that works here is ratchet. They are fighting behind the counter. They have meek mill blasting from a boom box in the back. The manager with the nasty wig is horrible too. The place is RATCHET. Takes forever to get food yet everyone is chillen in the back

I came in at 12:04AM. No one would greet or seat me so I found a seat of my own 5 minutes later at 12:09AM. From there I was basically refused service. If I was sitting in the wrong section I would have been notified but that's not the case...I was there sitting at that table from 12:09AM to 12:50AM without a glass of water or even a menu. Multiple employees walked past my table as if I wasn't even there. I even placed my wallet on the table and held my debit card for everyone to see. I was still ignored. At least 3 to 4 parties who were 3 or more people strong were waited on and served in less than 10 minutes while I am sitting in this establishment like an invalid for an hour. It was nothing less than spite. I had money. I waited patiently. I actually gave you an hour of my time even though I knew this was personal. Everyone else in that restaurant was served in a timely manner except for me and yes, I paid attention. I don't know why the entire staff would be so rude. If you have a right to refuse service, I don't know what I did wrong but I do know that I will never dine here and I will tell every customer that comes to my store on south street how awful this experience was. It wasn't even that busy which is the most ridiculous thing about this. None of the employees seemed new and I believe the Latino man in the purple shirt was management. This whole debacle was inexcusable and you should all either take remedial training courses or be unemployed. This field is not for you and apparently I'm not for this establishment with the way you all treated me.
Employee yelled "CLOSED" as I drove through the drive through. All signs say 24 hours. If you're not open then you need to change them.

When I saw this on my map I for sure wanted to get some. I used to get this in the Philippines when I was younger, it definitely took me to memory lane of how good these fries were. At first, we couldnt find the location because we thought it was its own storefront but it was inside the mall. We got 2 giga fries, garlic parmesan and cheddar cheese. Got the fries super fast and each fry had the powders evenly  distributed.
Lazy staff, don't answer the phone, they forget parts of your orders so watch out ! Just go to a different McDonald's

Ended up here after an impatient friend refused to wait to be seated ANYWHERE in the city.  No one was in here and that should have been a sign...

Super friendly staff.  Really.  Very friendly and that is literally the only thing this place has going for it.  Oh, and the milkshakes.  Maybe.

I don't even want to really get into it because the whole thing was upsetting.  We wanted breakfast but the sign was hidden in the window and it read that breakfast was only available until 930 and it was 10.  It was Saturday, btw.  Even though they offer a fried egg to top a burger, they refused to make eggs after 930. Fine.

There were flies.  We ordered a side of fries and it was enough for maybe a small child who doesn't like fries.  The food was awful. and slightly cold.  Not just mine.  My friend's food as well.  There was something unnatural in his turkey burger.  My Boca burger (which let me just say, I REALLY appreciate them offering) had a film.  

We will not be back here.  Ever, if we can help it.  But there's always the zombie apocalypse scenario so...
This arbys is the worst. The cashier was rude, the milkshake machine is always out of service, and we waited like 30 minutes for 4 meals.

I'm so glad I came across Cily Chicken Rice. I've missed good Hainanese chicken rice, and this place delivers. Both the "boiled" and fried chicken were done so well that I had nothing but good things to say about them. The "oil" rice was also made just rice with great flavor and fragrance. Best of it was the chili sauce, but I wish it was a little spicier.

I just went through their drive-through and it was ridiculous, not only did the girl who took my order not input it AT ALL but also once her supervisor came over and filled my order "SHE GOT IT WRONG". I was right there face to face and she "STILL" managed to get it wrong, I'd made the drive specifically cause this location is normally better than the one that's closer to me but maybe Burger King is just not worth the money if they can't get anything right.

Ordered take out, food are well packaged, still warm when received. Delicious chicken and rice, and I love the sauces. Friendly owner and staff. 
Portion is perfect for me, might be a little small for bigger person. However, since the price is pretty good, you can just order a bigger one or another one. 
Do recommend to try both boiled and fried!

I am embarrassed to say I had walked by this restaurant 100's of times on the way to nearby la Colombe and had no idea a Vegan steak shop was right under my nose until I read an article in Philadelphia magazine about the best Vegan/vegetarian steak sandwiches in Philly. I am so glad I found out about this Vegan shop as they are a couple blocks away from my office. I had to try signature sandwich WK Philly which is sauteed Seitan, fried onions and mushroom and a vegan cheese wiz. They have pickled peppers which are a little too hot for me, so you can request on side or omit the pepper. The Seitan was succulent and moist, with the veggies. Delicious. I also tried the wiz fries which are hand cut and very good. Employees very nice and I didn't have to wait long for my food. I look forward to my next visit. it will be very soon. Thank you!!

SMH I hate to give this updated review but something has to change. This place used to be bomb. I told everyone how good the chicken was. Now it's just down right, Nasty! After doing some social media research it appears their old cook is no longer with them so it explains why the quality has goin down drastically. I got a platter with double mac and they literally sold me the scrap at the bottom and the sides of the pan. Just dry hard noodles and the chicken was just ok. This last final time, I bought 10 wings for myself and a friend. The wings were veryy small, greasy and you could taste fish. I ended up trashing majority. Total waste of money.
Best pizza in Center City. Nice people, always consistently great pizza. Prices are reasonable too!

Keeping in mind this is only a fast food restaurant, I understand that the service will not be aaaammaazzinng. However, I was highly taken aback by how rude the employees were and how slow the service was. I waited in line for 15 minutes and I ordered a number 4 meal. As I was leaving, I noticed that I was missing fries. I turned back into drive through, waiting another 10 minutes, only for the employee to tell me that I was lying about missing fries. They said that we ate the fries and was trying to steal food. As if I would wait in line for 10 minutes to get a free fry; I probably spent more money on gas in the line than the fries were worth. The manager did come and give us fries; however, because of them accusing me of stealing FRIES, I will not be going there again. Food was good, but the employee was extremely rude.

Had the best Hainan chicken rice here. It's hard to find Singaporean style food and I'm so glad to find it here! They even give you the soup with it with the hot sauce. Must try! Just wish they had milk tea here too

Was in a MOOD for some Checkers fries and I was in the area visiting a friend. Fries were highly disappointing. I should have went to the location on Broad and Champlost cuz the fries are always hot & fresh there (at least for me).

I'm a little obsessed with Rich Landau's restaurants so don't be surprised that I'm gushing. Every time I'm in Philly, I find a way to hit up Vedge and V Street, and now I have to find room in my stomach for Wiz Kid. It's just so good!!

I'd been to their (now defunct) stand in Whole Foods so I'm familiar with their phenomenal cheesesteaks, but this restaurant has a larger menu that includes a PIZZA STEAK.

...a little back story, prior to giving up meat when I was 17, pizza steaks were my jam. The little place around the corner made big fat ones that I can still taste. It was one of the hardest things for me to let go, and yet I did, because cows are the best and I love them more than I love pizza steaks. I've tried many a vegan cheesesteak in the years following, but until now, no one offered a pizza steak.

So you can imagine my delight when I saw it on the menu! I ordered it so fast, I gave myself whiplash. That, some wiz fries, and a kombucha from the tap and I was in heaven.

The bread is perfect, the seitan is sliced so thinly, it's like the person who came up with it actually ate a cheesesteak at one point in their lives (unlike soooo many cheesesteaks with chunky seitan, no thank you!). I didn't love that the sauce was just dolloped on top, and the cheese was just layered on the bread. I remember the pizza steaks of my past being saucy and cheesy throughout, and I think it would make for a tastier eating experience.

The fries were amazing. Their rutabaga wiz is one of my favorite things on the planet, and their fries do it justice. Could it use more wiz? Always. I could bathe in that stuff.

Wiz Kid is definitely on my "must eat while in Philly" list with all of Landau's restaurants. I'm just going to have to make longer trips to accommodate all the delicious food I have to eat.

I gave you two stars for now because I personally think McDonald's is better and you forget my sauces. That is besides the point. I will give you 5 stars if you collab with dairy queen. Let's be honest, those mini cinnamon rolls are not good. The benefits of this joint forces idea would be that you get good deserts and it's an iconic duo of the king and queen. It would be legendary and you would get an insane amount of customers. I can almost guarantee a rate of success if you do this.

Went here for a late night meal. I kid you not, when I got home with the food a cockroach crawled out of my burger. So needless to say this place is dirty, the people aren't friendly. There's always some sketchy things happening outside of the building too. Don't go here.

There's an app called Too Good To Go which lets you reserve "surprise bags|meals" from restaurants in the Philly area (which prevents Food Waste). I ordered a surprise bag from this restaurant. I was supposed to pickup the bag between 9:45pm-10:15pm. I arrived at 10pm. No bag left for me to pickup. The person working states, "The store is closed and I'm not making the order."

Why give Too Good To Go a pick up time when your store is closed? Make it make sense. If I had known that, I wouldn't have even reserved the bag.

When in Philly: vegans want cheesesteaks too! Yum and yum! I found this place through Instagram and it did not disappoint. The bread was delicious and perfect to hold the precious contents of the sandwich. I took it back to my hotel to enjoy and after seeing and tasting the "steak" i even went back online to make sure this place was really fully vegan! I know!! This place has lots of other yummy sounding menu items that I will have to try soon. You can dine in or take out.

note: this review was before corona occurred, and based on my experience in the beginning of march 

to start off, I LOVE GOLDIE. I heard so much about it and was like "how can a falafel place be that good? i bet it's overhyped". 

But i do not think it's overhyped. I never had juicier, softer, and more flavorful falafel. 

The falafel salad comes with a wide range of savory vegetables with a good amount of falafel on the side that you can put on your salad or eat on the side. The sauce is tangy with a bit of sweetness. I love the beet cubes that add a freshness to the salad also. 

The falafel sandwich is AMAZZING. the pita is very soft, and the falafel inside is flavorful. The creamy sauce I got in complemented the falafel and vegetables inside very well. It was also not dry in my opinion. 

The Tehina coffee shake is also great. It has a smooth and thick texture, yet has that blended taste of coffee in it without being too overpowering. It's not hard to swallow like some other smoothies I tried. I think the cookie toppings on top also add texture to the smoothie.

One of my favorite places to eat for hearty and delicious food, highly recommend !

This was my first time trying Zio. Online ordering was really easy! The shop called me to confirm my special instructions, which I really appreciated. The pizza was ready on time and SO good!!! I liked the homestyle crust, and the toppings were plentiful. Just a tad greasy but due to the pepperoni- so to be expected!
Employees were polite and professional. I will return!

Their chicken ceasar salad cost me $5.66. Its a side salad with only lettuce, croutons and chicken and there wasn't even parmesan cheese.  Their excuse for why such a small salad at a high price was its a quality salad.  Bullshit for a $1 more I can get a regular size salad with parmesan cheese and eggs from The Works.  Thats what a real Chicken Ceasar Salad is.

Updating my review - apparently Carmen is no longer here. Reportedly, she was a bit abrasive with some customers; which is a shame for the customers and for Carmen. I hope she gets her act together and get back on her feet.

This Arby's is still the only one outside of the far-reaching Philadelphia Mills, and I'm grateful to have an Arby's that is accessible from Center City. 

My recent visits bear out that the food is served right and it's served hot. And from what I can see, the staff works hard at serving up your goods.

The crowd and the environment in this section of the City are a little rough, which apparently is why they have secure door locks on the bathrooms. And sometimes the tables aren't cleaned up as quickly as they should be.

But it's still a 4-star from me; they do pretty good here.

Fantastic!!! The menu of this place will absolutely meet all your craving criteria. From wings to fried chicken, sandwiches, hoagies, burgers and so much more. A variety of fries and styles like curly and wedges etc. Very small establishment mainly because its a take out place. The employees are very professional and sweet. I ordered 20 wings, a buffalo sandwich and 2 drinks and the bill was about $30. I also ordered a cheese steak and it was very good! I am looking forward to trying the pizza steak lol sounds interesting. They also offer platters (full meal) with mac and cheese and other sides that you could choose from. It is an endless menu of yummy, freshly made finger food. I am glad I found this local gem... Football season is here and we all know how much we love to skip the kitchen and order wings. They charge .35 cents or so for debit card usage on top of your bill, but they tell you before they swipe it. If you want to avoid the charge just carry cash. A lot of places are now charging for card usage, cash is making a "comeback" haha. Oh they have personal pizzas and fltabreads too. Definitely recommend this place!

Food:
Sandwich ($7.50) was dry and average. Towards the end I just forced myself to finish it because I was hungry, not because I enjoyed it. I would rather walk get a sandwich from High Street which is in the same food court. Or better yet, take a trip to center city for some dizengoff. 
Shake ($5): very heavy. The plain shake has nuts such as almonds and tastes like a peanut butter shake. I split the cup with 3 friends because it was too heavy for us to finish alone. We drank it to wash down the dry sandwich but this combo just left us feeling so heavy and full. 
Shawarma fries ($3): too salty. Similar to Cajun frie

Overall, overpriced & mediocre food. Honestly, this whole food court is too boujie for my taste. I miss the old food court. But if you have the money to spend and want falafel, this is the only option in university city. I wouldn't come back

I've ordered from here twice via ubereats. The restaurant is very accommodating on request which I very much appreciate. 

First time I ordered their set 3 - half fried and half boiled. Second time I ordered their set 3 - with a request of 2 fried and 1 boiled if it was possible and they gave it to me. I also ordered their tom yum soup and wontons. 

Portions were really good and filling. it. Their chicken was good both times. I prefer the fried chicken over the boiled -- the fried is much flavorful and both times the flavor. Their wonton was good, nothing special but also not bad. Their tom yum soup had good amount of stuff in it but it was too salty. 

I find it there may a bit of inconsistency with seasoning with the soups? The chicken sets comes with radish soup; my first order the taste was perfect but my second order the soups were sooo salty that I couldn't drink it which is also the same order as the salty tom yum soup. 

Overall, I really like this place. I would order again. On the side random note I missed the paper rice wrap for the second order. Something about the paper wrapper brought back nostalgic memories; it was a nice touch.

This is our go to weekday food in a Chinatown - this is a very very solid addition in the area!  The hainanese chicken rice and the fried chicken rice are delicious, though I prefer the fried chicken rice slightly more. Definitely recommend! Prices are good too :)

Love the harissa sandwich and coffee shake. Delicious cheat meal. Eat here all the team. Couldn't recommend it more.

Despite it being amazing for America, I wouldn't mind fresher falafel.

DO NOT EAT HERE. Absolutely TERRIBLE food. How in the world do you have chicken in your name, but FAIL so prominently at providing quality chicken? 

I ordered 10 baked wings with Cajun SAUCE. Pay attention to the mention of sauce. 

What did I get? 10 NAKED wings with a side sauce cup with what I can only believe to be their Cajun seasoning. ARE YOU SERIOUS???? This a supposed CHICKEN SHACK. This is their speciality. How do you mess this up??? 

Sheer laziness and lack of concern for their customers. Extremely lucky that I ordered via DoorDash otherwise I would've been front and center demanding a refund. I will never order from this place again.

We visited Philly for my birthday weekend March 2021 and I was in search of any black owned business I could support. We ordered dinner from this spot and maaaaaannnnn!!! So goood!!! We got a variety of egg rolls and the banana pudding and peach cobbler. ALL were delicious! The drinks were good. You CANNOT go wrong grabbing a bite here!
(Sorry no photos- we were so hungry it just went that fast! )

This salad is the salad to rule all others. Super delicious. I want to eat it for every meal. The falafel is incredible. 

The fries though. They are everything I have ever wanted in a french fry. Crispy on the outside, perfectly spiced, and the ketchup just takes them over the top. The only downside is that they'll leave you with what my husband lovely refers to as "shawarma fingers", but it's worth it.

First I want to let everyone know I do not write negative reviews for any restaurant/company and usually keep to myself. But me and my colleagues have given Trio's multiple chances to see if they would clean up their act and because there isn't to much around our location. 

I will tell you this, each and every single time we ordered something from here our order was wrong or the delivery is missing SOMETHING. The partial of the order that the food is correct is just so/so I'm taste. 

When you call to let the owners know your order is wrong they IMMEDIATELY become hostile and blame it on you. You are the problem. Not a professional buisness that I would ever recommend and I will be sure to let EVERYONE know how ghetto/ nasty these people are and basic/average their food is to act like this to customers. Maybe you shouldn't have a business if you can't run one?

New spot so we give it a try, chicken is very moist in a good way!! 
Ginger rice is 10/10 (must order extra of that)
Used to be my favorite, now they are overpriced tiny wings. As my man Trump would say ..... SAD!

I do love their food, but the customer service is something to be desired. My husband and I pulled up to the drive thru and the employee sounded miserable she straight up said "what do you want?" When she got on the mic. No hello, how are you, just "what do you want?" Seriously???? We've also been sitting in the drive thru line for 15 minutes so far and there aren't a lot of cars. Unacceptable. When you work with the public you are being paid to take care of them. I don't care what kind of mood you're in or if you hate your job. Put on a fake smile and make money. BE PROFESSIONAL. Stop being miserable. It makes me sick that people who do that get away with it so easily. Cheer up, buttercup.

PS I had to put my food in the microwave when I got home. Not cool.
I like their fried chicken, and the dipping sauces. But the steamed chicken was RAW, soup too salty, and the Thai tea was  too sweet...

Horrible. Don't go. The person was talking on the phone the entire time when making the sandwich. At check-out, she asked if I wanted a drink, I said no. I asked her for the receipt and she still charged me for the drink. When I confronted her, she gave me a smirk and handed me a cup. No shame at all. They should close this place down. With this kind of moral standard, I can only imagine what they do with the food.

The food is good at McDonald's but the service in the drive threw always sound so lazy like they don't want to work there! And even the inside is VERY sticky and gross I recommend the drive threw. There best food is the fries the filla o fish is trash I highly DONT recommend that. I don't know who would get fish from a fast food resturant. Highly recommend going to Burger King or something. Burger kings's taco is probably better then filla o fish.

I have tried their food from when they've first opened. They have consistently delivered great quality food for a very affordable price. The portions are enough for the price and the ingredients are fresh. I have tried both boiled and fried chicken rice. I personally like the fried option a tad better than the boiled. It's great that they're adding more options to their menu. I have recently tried their Tom Yum Fried Rice and Pad Thai. Both are really good, but thei Tom Yum Fried Rice is my new favorite. I'll most likely try their other options soon!
Pizza is great.  Service is quick. Service is professional. Whenever I am in town, this is the pizza joint to go to.
Wasn't as good as expected. Milkshakes were pretty good and the food was just barely ok. Kids liked it though.

Clientele= horrible

Busy location

Staff-  nice here

"You don't want no drink?"  

At least they ask& Do their job

Extra star for the presence of tapatío on the premises


Long lines at 1:00 AM

God bless these people

As i stated in another review i stop in here once or twice a year. Nothing has changed here. I use to live in the area and still have friends and family that live here.They always serve COLD FOOD..I came in 3/28/16 burger was cold french fries cold and ordered chili fries for someone else. COLD COLD and dry.. This is the same way this place has been for years. Out of 10 times that you go maybe 2 of them they will serve you warm food. Go to another checkers..The only difference this time they were a bit quicker than most of the other times i have stopped in here.Other Checkers ive been to arent like this..Its just this one for some reason..

How do you run out of French fries at a Chick fil A !? . Lame and completely unprofessional especially after waiting in line for 40 mins. Get your shit together. This is why you don't open awesome southern spots up north. #Hangrykidsandmom

I've never had such delicious grilled chicken from a fast food joint....very tender and juicy. My girlfriend got a greek salad and quesadillas, both of which were delicious. I live in East Falls, but I make it a point to stop by this place if im in the Northeast. The staff is very friendly too. There is huge TV which plays nothing but ESPN/CNN so if you're waiting, you're not really bored. Fried chicken takes a little while to cook, but soooo worth the wait. Make sure you get a platter so you can add mash potatoes, corn and a small salad. Nom Nom Nom!

OK - there's a brand new (about 3 months old)  Wings to Go on the North East corner of 15th & Vine (where the Korean Deli used to be).  They serve Wings, Boneless Wings, Chicken tenders, Fried Shrimp, Quesedillas and Chili along with about 20 different dipping sauces from Mild, Medium & Hot to Suicide and Homicide.  

We tried the tenders and Buffalo Shrimp (so good, so greasy, so what!) along with the Honey Barbecue and Golden Garlic Parmesan sauces.

As junk foods go - I am not a "wing man" (er, wing woman??) but the shrimp were fresh-fried and so tasty.  They are steps from my home so I bet we'll be back.  My 4 year old just loved the shrimp - to the exclusion of the boneless wings that we ordered for her.  She just wanted to eat shrimp.  Next time we'll get 15!!!

Best for take out - but there are a few small booths and tables.

The owner, Angela is a sweetie and very hard working.  I sure hope they make it!

I had the Korean Fried Tempah to go. It has a kimchi radish and sounded spicy and delicious. While I did like it, the portion was quite small. It's not something I am dying to have again either. The vegetarian cheesesteak seems to have raving reviews so I'm gonna try that next time in hopes of getting my mind blown.

They have to buzz you into their bathroom.  You wait by the door and then, if you're lucky, they decide you're good-looking enough to get into their special club.  

After entering the locked door, you walk up a set of secret back stairs to "Club McDonalds"-- the after hours bathroom club, with the hottest music and a huge disco ball.  All of the toilets are studded with swarovski crystals and the bathroom is lit in with a blacklight.  When you flush, it sets off a strobe light and everyone goes crazy dancing.   The floors are lit from below; colored lights flash as you wash your hands-- nodding your head in time with the music.  You walk back downstairs and open the door back to the regular McDonalds; blinded by the fluorescent light.  You shudder as you sit down with your fast food; saddened to be back with the McDonald's "regular people."


That is all a lie, but they do have to buzz you into their upstairs bathroom and it is weird and sometimes it takes a while and you're just standing there like "Im sad can you let me in please"

Awesome egg rolls!

I'm a big eater so I was little worried that these rolls weren't going to fill me up...wrong.  Not to mention you can mix and match from a wide variety.  Oh and did I say they're delicious?!?!?

Compared to other fast food places, chicfila always dominates. This branch is American owned, the workers all speak perfect English and it's always very clean. I would NEVER pick McDonald's/BK over one of these.

When I tell people that my favorite buffalo chicken cheesesteak in the city is located not in the Italian Market, but in the heart of Chinatown, I get a little judged. When I take them to try it, they understand.

I spent my first six or so months in Philadelphia looking for the perfect buffalo chicken cheesesteak (chipped, not chunked or chopped chicken, american cheese, and buffalo sauce - not hot sauce) and was having an oddly hard time doing that! Then I found Zio Pizza Palace (not to be confused with Zio's Brick Oven Pizza) and haven't looked back since.

Their garlic knots and mozzarella sticks are also yummy, pizza is pretty good and cannoli are delicious....but the buffalo chicken cheesesteak is everything.

Ps...if you want bleu cheese (or ranch) on it, you have to ask.

First time here and did takeout. Chicken was still crispy on my 15 minute car ride home. Love the crunchiness, fully cooked and  juicy. Sauces are bomb! Got the Korean hot, sweet chili and bbq. Would definitely go again!
Best cheesesteak I've ever had!!! And I'm speaking as someone who hasn't been vegan my whole life. Better than any other cheesesteak anywhere in Philly! Still dreaming about it...

This place has the best cheesesteak in all the Philadelphia! I absolutely love this place. They also used to have a location in the whole foods, but after Jeff Bezos bought whole Foods WizKid no longer rents there. So now I go to the main location. I highly recommend you check this place out. You will not be disappointed.

I was in the area and wanted some lunch truck foods. It was around lunch time and most of the trucks had a line, plus parking around Market st. was a big hassle. I've seen Chow Bell's Rock and Roll before but it was always empty, usually a red flag during peak lunch hours. 

I was starving and like always, there was no line at Chow Bell so I decided to take a gamble. The egg rolls were expensive, 8 dollars for 2. I couldn't comprehend what kind of egg rolls would cost 4 dollars. I went with it anyways and got one seafood roll and one cheesesteak roll. I wasn't expecting much and I immediately thought I have made a mistake.

Not long after I ordered I realized how wrong I was. I thought the egg rolls were frozen and refried. I was pleasantly surprised to see the chef pulled out wonton wraps and started rolling them fresh in front of me. When everything was done with, he packed them in a big box, they were huge! They were more like mini burritos, definitely worth the money.

My first bite went to the seafood roll. I was completely caught off guard with how good it was. There was lump crab meat in the roll. There was no filler whatsoever. Imagine an entire crab cake filled in your egg roll. It was sweet and delicate. I went in for the cheesesteak roll and was blown away again. It was packed with juicy slices of steaks that had more flavor than any Philly cheesesteaks joints I've visited.

I could not believe myself, this was top notch restaurant quality food! I came back to the truck right away to ask for the chef's name. Steve was very happy to see how satisfied I was with his food. I will never judge a book by its cover again. This was one of the most unique eats I've experienced.

No surprise hands down the slowest most pathetic place on the face of the planet... the morons at work here are lucky if they can count their fingers and toes. Slower than molasses in winter time I really can't think of anything else to comprehend the total inability to have the ability to work. They want $15 an hour you must be joking me ,  I wouldn't pay them $2 for the speed that they're working at.
