They were not friendly at all and there were so many people standing inside waiting on their orders that it made me nervous being around that many people. There were 2 girls preparing the orders, and 1 girl cooking the food. The obviously needed help with these orders. My food pick up time was 2:45pm today and I had to stand in the restaurant for 26 minutes before it was ready to only receive the wrong order. I called the restaurant to complain but no one answered my call.  I WILL NEVER PATRONIZE THIS CHIPOTLE LOCATION EVER AGAIN.

Just ordered two Double Sonic with cheese pickles ketchup mustard lettuce one chicken sandwich with lettuce and mayo ... but instead got one double with only cheese ketchup and mustard two chicken finger sandwiches not a chicken portion sandwich wont be ordering again ...
The food was good along with the service.  The only thing I didn't like, no matter what you get, it's a 15% gratuity  to dine in.

This Chick-fil-a is pretty awful and it needs to be completely revamped. Chick-fil-a has to know that this location is extremely high traffic. Please create a better system to move the customers right along. 

I'm very disappointed to still be in line, curating my review, while taking a lunch break from work because it's taking this long to order and receive my food. 

The employees that are outside taking orders are nice but somewhat unorganized and just seem lost. The employees inside as well. They do not seem equipped with the typical functionalities that other Chick-fil-as have at their other locations.

This location is clearly a very populated area and I've seen Chick-fil-as have multiple drive-thrus, a lot of employees inside/outside taking orders with tablets and payment scanning devices at their fingertips. This location did not have all the bells and whistles. Very sad.

Food was fresh and hot. That's where the 3 stars came from. 

This is the absolute slowest and most unorganized Chick-fil-a I've ever experienced.
Well food is good.    Happy hour is great 9-11p.  Mon and Thursday $.65 wings a lot of TVs  food games.    Good beer selection.

COVID compliant with in dining spacing (nobody was really eating in) and everyone in masks with gloves. Gyros here are the best but their hummus, not so much. I enjoy the Greek salad as the potatoes are just ok. Gyro all the way each time!

I love love Nifty Fifties BUT the South Philly location was "ok". They messed up my order. And the burger was alright, but not really what I'm use to from Nifty Fifties. The cheese fries were excellent. I would definitely go back for them. The establishment is on the corner, so I suggest calling ahead because it's hard to find parking. And, to me, by calling in your order it was less of a waiting time.
It's Greek lady, if you're a local it's not much to say about them. They rarely disappoint and you know what you're getting, fresh quality food.
DELICIOUS! Too crowded though.  I recommend the barbacoa burrito

This is a small location, so it does get uncomfortably crowded by the register with people waiting for food or using the self serve soda machine. At least the service is fast. The Cajun food is an embarrassment that is nothing like what you get in New Orleans. But the chicken and biscuits are great, and that's why this was a welcome addition to the center city food scene when it opened. Don't be tempted by the other food items. Stick with ordering what they do best - fried chicken that is much better and cheaper than federal donuts.

Aramingo's Best is a great pizzeria located on the corner of Aramingo and Cambria in the Port Richmond and Fishtown area of Philadelphia. They have great pizza, as well as many other great options. Just be advised that while their cheesesteaks are decent, they use sirloin in place of the more traditional (and more expensive) shaved ribeye.

Service has always been good and friendly and I honestly can say that I never had a bad meal here.

Their pizzas are more in the Trenton style, where they swirl the tomato sauce on top, so you have multiple different taste profiles, a different one with every bite. Growing up in central New Jersey (Edison, to be exact), I never tried this style before, but I enjoyed it.

All in all, this is a great place to grab a meal. I definitely recommend here.
Waited in drive thru for atleast 20 minutes with only 3 or 4 cars in front of me & when I got to the window they had the wrong order which took at least another 10 minutes

Enormous (seriously- two meals worth!) salads at extremely reasonable prices with fresh ingredients! We've ordered multiple times during covid for delivery because it is always fast and fresh. Great place!

Food quality has changed, not worth price anymore. Gyro chicken was dry and bland, they change the sauce, and french fries. Buffalo chicken cheesesteak also different quality of chicken compare to three months ago, my niece asked if they were under new management idk. Menu has also change no more turkey burgers.

We came this to the reading terminal market and this caught my eye for a split second. There were so many other options to choose from and I wasn't craving a burger at the time. But I did end up seeing Mac and cheese. And not just any regular Mac an cheese, it was with lobster! I have always been skeptical about cheese and seafood but this was really good. I love Mac and cheese by itself but with the added twist of lobster added a sort of salty ness to the dish that was pretty good. 
So my dad and I got our main dishes somewhere else but we ended up sharing the Mac and cheese and we were full. We shared the small portion of it and with our other main dishes, it was just enough and really good. 

The servers were really nice. It looks like it's always busy there but they deal with customers really well. Hardly waited a long time for it. Stayed warm while we got our main dishes. 
Seating can be really hard but you just have to try to find a spot and claim it.

Would I come here again? Yes and also want to try their burgers next time.

Saw the pictures of the food on here and thought, I must give this place a try, can't be as bad as the reviews? Turns out it was.

How a place that sells this kind of food can run out of key ingredients is beyond me 

Not very clean and the staff seemed rather rude too.

Overall it was not a pleasant experience yesterday and I think it will definitely be my last experience in this place.

Don't let the pictures fool you!

Preordered for a work lunch. The order they delivered was an hour late, and it was wrong. I called the restaurant to discuss it (and ask to get the rest of the order) and after being hung up on a couple of times, the staff was incredibly rude. They never sent the missing items. The salads we did get were not good - the vegetables, particularly the tomatoes and peppers, were clearly old. The tomatoes were slimy, and the peppers were soft. i will never order from here or eat here again.

One of the nicer Chipotle's I've been to in Philadelphia. Lots of seating, very clean, and nice ambient lighting.

Went here a little after 6pm. There was no line when I got there but by the time I sat down there was a line almost to the door. Seems like one of the popular restaurants out of all the choices in this plaza.

I got a carnitas bowl. Everything was perfect except the white rice was undercooked. I like brown rice but I avoid ordering brown rice when I go out since it's almost always undercooked because of how long it takes to cook it compared to white rice. But this time even ordering white rice didn't prevent me from getting undercooked rice. :( 


Everything was 5/5 stars otherwise but undercooked rice sucks
Lousy Food...Delivered cold and incorrect to Children's Hospital of Pennsylvania....Poor Customer Service......

Burgers and fries are not bad but nothing to rave about. The atmosphere of the market hall itself is exciting but this place was comparable to any other burger place I've been to. I came with two other friends who also expressed the same opinion. My friend ordered a regular cheeseburger with fries. After gulping it down in three bites, he went off to find himself a bottle of root beer. I ordered the vegetarian burger and for other vegheads out there, I"d recommend saving yourself some calories and ordering a salad instead. Might even taste better than the burger.

I gave the restaurant one star, only because I have to give a rating in order to comment. I've been working at Reading Terminal since October and I was dying to try Hunger Burger... and decided today would be that day. After using my card and the terminal with no issues all day, I get to a cashier and she tells me my card is declined when there is legit money on the card. The way she acted could have been done better and on top of that one of the servers making the burger was also rude to another customer (which was within my earshot). I will find another spot for burgers within the terminal but NEVER AGAIN will I go to this spot---

2 hour and 17 minutes for my BREADSTICKS to get delivered. This place is a joke. Freezing cold when they got here and the order wasn't ever correct. Go somewhere else.... they offered me a free order of breadsticks to say sorry. Any manager reading this please contact me. Horrible service. HORRIBLE. HORRIBLE. HORRIBLE.

I got the Cheesesteak.  The roll was very good.  It had a good amount of chopped meat.  The cheese, fried onions and mushrooms were mixed in with the meat nicely.  The lettuce and tomato were fresh.  Very good portions.  Nice big and clean place.  I will be back for the Gyro.  I wish they had parking.  Big menu.
Good crust, light, crispier on deeper dish, good selection of pies and slices.  Fresh shake cheese in the fridge...

Okay so I waited in line for 30 minutes (no joke) and when I got to finally order they didn't have lettuce. She never offered another solution to the problem or apologized. Why did I wait in line for so long if they didn't have a key ingredient??? How frustrating. THEN - she got my order wrong. I ordered carnitas in one bowl and she gave me carne asada in both (which I can't eat)!! Literally such a terrible experience. 

The picture is what my bowls looked like UNTOUCHED. I hadn't eaten at all and they look pitiful. 

if you're looking for good food or good experience or the confidence that they will have what they should, look elsewhere.

Wow... where do I begin?! Ordered though Uber eats on a Friday night. We Loved EVERYTHING we got. Indian Burger was super juicy and flavorful ( salivating just thinking about it lol ) . Got two poutines, one with saag paneer and the other with chicken Tikka. Hubby and I devoured everything!

They were extremely rude and any time I asked for extra of something she huffed and puffed and gave me a tablespoon size. I asked for a tortilla on the side and never got it. I would tell her what I wanted in my bowl and she just stared at me like she didn't hear me speaking but would respond with okay and not move her body to scoop any food. The utensils were just out on the counter, the counter itself had food on it. Their masks were barely on. When they stuffed our bag FULL of of order and we asked for a second bag they told us it was policy to not give out bags even after we offered to pay. Mind you we came 2 days prior, because we are staying near by, and we were met with the same disrespect from a different set of employees. Management needs to take a look at how they train their employees because they have ZERO customer service skills.
This 24-hour location was closed when I got there Saturday at 3 a.m. What a waste of gas.
edit: do not order anything with syrup!!!! that syrup is fake. it will give you migraines and massive headaches!! i know it because i ate my pancakes with that fake ass syrup!!!

Hostesses are welcoming when you walk through the door and the service was commendable. I ordered some fries, mozzarella sticks, dryrub lemon pepper wings, cajun wings and bbq wings. The fries are crispy yet soft. The mozzarella sticks are different from what I'm used to. It's like they changed the breading and made it look like a baked turd. Despite the weird texture and look, it still tasted okay but the marinara sauce was very watery and ruined the appetizer. The dryrub lemon pepper wings were extremely salty and sour, cajun wings were just great with a hint of spice and the bbq wings were just okay since it was just plain wings with sauce over it and it didn't really stand out much. Overall, the bone-in wings were quite juicy and crispy. Caution : most of the sauces I got were very watered down and it was not enjoyable. (Ranch, Mild, BBQ)

It was fine but there has to be changes and the drive thru line was long. Arguments were happening inside, Restrooms are very clean and the food was great. There should be computers and we will have to begin an inspection with the City of Philadelphia Department of Health and Commonwealth of Pennsylvania Department of Public Health.

You'd think that Philadelphia is over-populated with burgers, yet another Burger joint keep opening every day! 
This one is like no other though, with a portion of each sale will be donated to feed children in need around the world. ( their mission is Buy One, Feed One. )
I went and checked it out this morning and had the breakfast slider- fried egg and American cheese on a potato slider. Was tasty and would love to go and try the Burger soon.
Three and half Yelps!

There we go with this bad customer service again of all places these people are a bunch of Cutthroats and guns that work here that horrible their disposition and their attitudes they take forever to complete in order hey using profanity in curse words in the background you have to grab your child and Usher them out of the way of these people just so they don't hear some of the things that they say in the background on top of that bitch screwing up your orders when you go back to inquire about your order I have a whole lot of nasty attitude and stupid things to say out their mouth where is the management of who's in charge of this place it's like an Animal House in there and someone really needs to step up and take charge of this place because it's really some sort of Rough Riders Den or something that's horrible in there each and every time I show up I think the things changed and just when you think things have changed get a new batch of idiots it's just crazy in there and they really need to make a change if you want your time to be wasted and your order to get screwed up go to that location

Greek lady is definitely my favorite place to go eat on campus. The food is good, cheap, relatively healthy, and there are never any problems with the orders. I especially like the omelettes and french toast for brunch, and the lamb gyro for dinner. I really enjoy the laid-back atmosphere in the restaurant as the service is always very solid and friendly. and the a One guy in particular, George (always wearing a Flyers hat) is particularly nice and is always down to chat about anything, mostly sports. I would recommend anyone to come enjoy a meal here, talk to the staff, and enjoy the food.

Wow this place served me the most disgusting guacamole ever. I am SO disappointed. The chunks of avocado are so hard and brown they are completely inedible. I will never eat at this location again. Don't waste your money!

Zaffron is set in the food court of One Liberty Place (2nd floor) and located beside Chipotle and across from Chick-Fil-A. It's a pretty typical Mediterranean "quick lunch" type of place; I tried the #1 Spicy Chicken Wrap which wasn't too spicy after all. The rest of the also looked average, though I probably would have enjoyed something else more. They do give a solid helping of food which was nice and it definitely filled me up. Overall, if you want something quick that is a little different than your normal routine but won't leave you hungry shortly after, this place is worth a try.

I have been frequenting this place for over a year now. They have undergone new owners and there doesn't really seem to be a change in the quality of the food which is nice. There are more people working behind the counter, but not as nice as the last owners though. 
Food is always good, but it's my recommendation to get it earlier in the day as opposed to eating there for a late lunch. Otherwise, it's one of my go-to places to eat in the City!

Cheap food. Big portions. The chicken plate comes
With a big portion of chicken so this would a great place to eat post gym to get a nice heaving of protein. The guy at the cashier was very nice. Food was slow. Overall nothing bad but nothing impressive
Great pizza.  Always the same.  Never had a bad pie from them.  Must try with the sauce on top.

I really liked the spicy chicken kabob wrap. I think I have found my new lunch place.
Add hummus to it and u have a perfect lunch in your hand and all u got to do is bite into it to enjoy the flavors.
Spicy is American spicy so which is low on thai category. Will definitely try other things on the menu as well

The Imperial Palace Chinese Restaurant has a very large menu; in fact, it is so extensive as to be rather intimidating and difficult to decide off of. 

We ordered several items; I only ate the rice, vegetable fried rice, and vegetable chow mein noodles. The vegetable fried rice was pretty good, but I didn't prefer the chow mein. 

Probably the best thing about this place is that it was quite convenient, and there were enough choices to satisfy a variety of tastes.

A perfect spot for a complete breakfast before taking off into Philly for a day of sight-seeing, beginning with the UPenn campus right across the street. My family decided to pop in two mornings in a row, and we were not disappointed. 

The first morning I ordered an egg and cheese sandwich on a plain bagel (which is unfortunately the only bagel variety the Greek Lady carries). I was pleasantly surprised with the melty cheesy quality of the sandwich, and would certainly order again as a rich morning indulgence. 

The second morning I ordered an breakfast platter, with two eggs overeasy, two thick pieces of wheat toast, and a large pile of diverse cut fruits. The kitchen makes all breakfast items fresh from what I can tell, and it shows in the excellent quality. The eggs were perfectly cooked, and the large helping of fruit was delightful. 

The service was excellent, and the outdoor seating area was comfortable, if a little sparse and not entirely spotless. 

I hope in the future the Greek Lady considers using metal silverware instead of plastic -- but overall a great spot for a hearty and balanced breakfast!

I've gone here twice and have gotten different things each time. Every milkshake I tried was good. The cups are really cool as well! The burgers are okay. My burger bun was sort of dry the last time I got it. Their spicy cheese fries are really good though. The food does take a while so I would call ahead if you can.
A favorite place to eat in University City. You can never go wrong with the sandwiches or platters. The sides are amazing!

I order the Bacon and Ranch wings with a salad and Mac and cheese. I also had the Fries every thing was good the wings were my favorite they were delivered on time. I would definitely recommend this Restaurant when your at the place the people are very nice and friendly.

Best milkshake for the best price in the city! I've tried the Oreo cookies n cream which I loved and would get over and over and over again. I couldn't finish it all myself but it was even good the next day. Also tried the caramel cheesecake with toffee added in. That one was good, but a little too sweet. And the toffee - I was expecting toffee candy bar prices but they were kore like crunchies. Again, couldn't finish it myself, but a couple hours later, the toffee crunchy pieces got soggy and gross so this one definitely isn't good for later. Finally, got a single patty burger with fried onions, tomato, lettuce, pickle and ketchup (those toppings are freebies) and it was solid! Would definitely order again.
I like their food. I used to always get the turkey burger deluxe but unfortunately they no longer carry turkey burgers

I am sitting right here having a very dry tasteless falafel wrap and my partner is having a kabob which she ate only half of . 
I would have loved to support Zaffrons being a new business but am at pains to give it beyond 2 stars. 

The wraps are typical supermarket wraps and falafel is drying with a powdery grrrr taste behind the throat. 

The kabobs flavor ( according to her ) was okayish and it was okay bec of the mix veggies n sauce which I liked.

Will return to try again to be able to give them time to improve.

Price high

came here for lunch today~ got in line and saw people in front of me were mostly ordering salads to go... i was the odd one out and got the beef & lamb gyro on rice~ 

i walked this bad boy down several blocks back to my cube.. food got a tad cold esp with the tomato cucumber salad on top of the hot mess.  BUT!! to my surprise, food tasted fairly good!  i housed it before i could take a picture.  good sign right? 

so to sum it up, it tastes great!  i could tell the produce was fresh (enough).  meat was ok~ strange looking stripes of gyro but tasted fairly good.  portion wise is comparable to a chipotle rice bowl.  you might not feel as satisfied afterwards but i think it's because zaffron's ingredients are less greasy.  it'll leave u just enough room to enjoy a smoothie.  for $8.10 after tax? not too shabby~ decent choice at the food court.
Delicious! Amazing customer service and ambiance. I ordered 12 McChickens and they were great. Will be back again soon!

Went there yesterday 2xs once for breakfast n dinner not only were my hash browns hard as a rock I was able to drop it in my table n here the bang I tryed to call but no one answers I finback at dinner bother my woooers were over cooked fries were stale onion rings oldso good to say yet again they got me for another $26 if imyou want BK I suggest taking a ride to any other but this one I have video I sent to the health department yesterday so they can see this place is ripping my ppl off by serving food made hours ago

Someone made my pickup order wrong so I needed it to be remade correctly and everyone who worked there that interacted with me made me extremely uncomfortable and treated me with absolutely no respect.

This Place is basically chipotle/QDOBA but with Indian food. It's definitely an amazing take and I love the idea. However I still think this place is definitely a bit overpriced. Especially when comparing kids to adults. It's just robbery of prices. Especially with Uber eats/door dash. Which is how I initially tried this location. They could've been better. But I miss my cultures food sometimes and this fills that crave in a good way. You could make these wraps at home. As well as the poutine fries. And probably for less and have more.

I come to this location often last night though I paid for my order got home & it wasn't right. I wrote email to corporate & they right away took action.  I received email stating I would get a coupon in next few weeks which was good. I then got a phone call for me to come in & get a free meal for my inconvenience. Now that is how you run a business. Its not about the free food but the reaching out to handle the issue. If he would have just called that would have been good enough.  The managers name was Anthony & he definitely earned this 5 star rating. He was nice & made sure food was fresh. Of course I'll be back bc this location is convenient for me. If all businesses handled their issues as such the world would be a better place
Local favorite. Tried just about everything from the menu. Great value and always busy. Desserts are great too. Good for college age or families.
Slowest Chipotle I've ever been too. Employees will do anything but make people's food. 10/10 would go againPobnos-4tiqjo-qacfin
Employees did not have on masks . While handling food I think should be a must . Mandatory in Pennsylvania.

First of all, the place was empty/not busy... but all the tables are dirty ! Been going every now and then ever since they opened. Cheers to the disgusting quality of stale old food I ordered through Uber Eats from you just now as well as paying for an extra mashed potatoes that never came nor did my Diet Coke that was supposed to come with the order which the driver went back for and you guys were out of mashed potatoes.  The food was awful and I paid for food I didn't even get.  I heard you were really rude to the driver as well.  Awesome service. My order was 30 min late, and wrong (even though it was an online order). Had to ask several times for a cup and lid. Absolutely no order inside and allowed certain people to stay in the store and others had to leave? No way to notify people if there order was ready. If you can find somewhere else to eat, do it.

La atención de Valeria fue estupenda. Y la comida fue excelente gracias

Valeria's service was great and she paid perfect attention to our order. The food was also wonderful, thank you so much.

This is literally one of the worst chipotle establishments possible. I have already filed numerous complaints on chipotle site from them constantly not fulfilling online orders properly, making online orders who's order didn't come into the system stand in the back of line, having multiple employees stand around doing absolutely nothing. I have never seen slower workers at a chipotle in my life. I live 4 minutes walking from this establishment and I can walk up to the center city location (10min) grab my food and walk back and still get it before this location could even put out 1 order. So wild

Such a disappointing experience. Came here with a friend to grab a late lunch and received bad food and service. My blt consisted of 2 pieces of bacon, no tomato, and wilted/brown lettuce. Our glasses were dirty with dried food on them. I asked the server for new glasses of water, which we never received. Such a waste of money.
middle of a pandemic and the employe had no gloves on. and proceeded to argue with me after i mentioned it. disgusting !!!

Lol this Mcdonald's is atrocious. 

The 1 star is for the fact it's open 24/7. Everything else about this place sucks. The wait for food is abysmally long.. Mcdonald's is supposed to be the fast food of fast food places. I could've gotten a burger from Tap House next door quicker than this place was pumping out fries. The vibes here were also negative, populated by mostly the wrong crowd. Would not have a comfortable meal sitting in.

Hire more workers. Have some kind of rule for not populating your entire restaurant with non-paying customers. Buy febreeze or something.

I'm a man of habit. Each Friday I celebrate the end of the week by getting a lamb gyro, curly fries, and a side caesar salad from the Greek Lady. The food isn't spectacular but its good for a delivery gyro. If you order a salad as an entree, be warned, it is ridiculously large. Many heads of lettuce rolled to bring you your leafy meal. The salads come with warm pita slices which is a welcome addition. I've dabbled in a couple of their other menu items as well. The grape leaves are a tad too oily and the spanikopita is usually a little burnt and terrible. On the dessert side, the baklava is as sweet, nutty and filicious as it should be. The restaurant itself is full of students, so I prefer to order, and generally my order arrives quickly. Decent spot.

Still only 3 stars.  Got a schwarma rice platter for lunch and meat was still dry - albeit fresher than at dinner time.  DO NOT COME HERE AFTER 2 PM.

Female cashier was friendly and kind.
Rice was fresher at lunchtime.

$8.00 and change. (no drink).

The employees are the most miserable group I have seen at an establishment. They can take my complete order from beginning to start without ever saying a word. I get no response when I say hi and all then how they are. No response when I said thanks. They need some customer training lessons at this location. Food was only okay. Go next door to Wendy's

Ordered through Grubhub, employee working seemed irritated when I arrived to pick up my order, despite wearing a mask and tipping 25% on the order. 

Wings were cold and nothing special, will not repeat

No ketchup, no Mayo, no toasted roll & I waited an hour & a half just to be delivered. I spoke with the manager & he told me the chef that he did put both ketchup & Mayo. Well if that were true would I be using my own? Never again text nothing like they use to !

This was a great experience. Our service from the  gentleman behind the counter was exceptional. He walked us through all the options for our meals, prepared them with care and in a timely manner and made good suggestions. On top of that the food tasted amazing! Two thumbs up!!
Overcooked meat/rice/burnt fajita veggies. Witnessed a cook eating and drinking IN THE food prep area.  Friends of the employees distracting the workers. DO NOT EAT AT THIS ONE!!!

This has to be the worse Mc Donald's on the planet today's date is Sept 28, 2019 and the time is 11:38am this is the 3rd time they state they are closed today was due to an alleged power outage but they must of forgot to turn the lights off you can clearly see there's power in the restaurant. The employees were outside playing around cursing and throwing ice at each other. The tine before that the registers were down. Who ever owns this restaurant needs to hire ALL NEW STAFF STARTING WITH MANAGEMENT YOU ARE LOSING MINEY DUE TO POOR STAFF
If you are looking for the best slice of pizza in Philly... This is the place to be! And I must add I really ain't the biggest pizza lover, but I think I grabbed a slice every day this week:)
I order the food by Uber eats,food are still warm and delicious when they arrived. The only problem is Cajun fries and chicken are a bit salty. Good dinner experience.

Party of four Philly natives decided to stop here to try a new place. We had a chicken sandwich, standard burger, caesar salad, french fries and sweet potato fries. Came to 36 and some change. Food was pretty good overall. Fries were crisp but not greasy. Sandwiches were juicy. The reason for the lackluster review is the rude employees and poor customer service. An ask for napkins was met with attitude. Ask for a small bag for our remaining fries - as we didn't get one to begin with - and were met with attitude and a no, you should have gotten a bag. There are so many other great places here, don't bother with this one.

I'm absolutely loving this new neighborhood addition!  My dad and I went here for dinner a few days ago and everything was wonderful. Their menu is HUGE as is their selection of wing sauces, so there's sure to be something for everyone. 
I don't really get down with wings so I got the ECW salad with grilled shrimp. It is one of the best salads I've ever had and definitely the best salad I've ever had in Port Richmond. The shrimp were cooked perfectly and all the ingredients were fresh and delicious. 
My dad ordered chili and quite liked it. For his entree he got a bbq combination with ribs and a grilled chicken breast, and he was very impressed. 
We also shared the ECW version of a blooming onion and it was fabulous. 
Thanks to their nice beer list I was able to wash down all this deliciousness with one of my favorites, Dogfish 60 Minute IPA. 
Everything here is well executed. To the prompt and friendly service, fair price points, and tasty food, it was all great! This is sure to be a new hot spot of mine.

I read so many great reviews on Hunger Burger and I'm quite disappointed. 
Located in the Reading Terminal I thought this place would be great. The service was terrible the cashier seemed aggravated with the lunch rush, which is understandable but come on this is your job. 
I ordered the hunger burger single and lobster mac and cheese. The burger was pretty lackluster and the lobster mac was really oily and had no flavor. I really wanted that lobster mac to be good especially since they are surrounded by seasonings and flavors in the Reading Terminal.
I. LOVE. THESE. GYROS. You can't go wrong here. I've had Greek Lady numerous times and it's great food at a great price. If you think the gyros are heavy, you can get the same thing over salad!

As much as I despise entering the Popeyes at this location, I keep coming back for the fried shrimp and sides.

I personally enjoy the food at Popeyes, but the service and experience is absolutely terrible. The employees are pretty rude and disrespectful almost every time I go. Unfortunately I usually try to keep minimum communication with them as possible even if that means accepting an incorrect order. 

There was one instance when I waited in line for about 15 min(I'm assuming it was for the chicken sandwich) and when I finally reach the cashier, I am told they don't have fried shrimp. There was no sign stating this and I have only ever gone to Popeyes for that.

Customer service really needs to be improved at this location.
They forgot the biscuits I ordered so I essentially overpaid for a box of chicken. Awful place to eat.

I was drawn to this place because the salads looked so fresh and delicious in the case. I ordered the farm house salad and decided to splurge on the lobster mac and cheese. The salad was plain awful, i've got nothing good to say about it. Soggy lettuce and onion rings, zero vegetables (the salad in the case had all kinds of veggies and blue cheese) no cheese at all. the lobster mac was good but not for $10.99! 

disappointed.

This Chipotle is literally so unpredictable. 

Nothing worse than having that feeling of binge hunger and arriving at this particular Chipotle and they don't have steak, cheese, pico, corn AND lettuce all at once. Every now and then, they'll run out of the occasional ingredient and it's quite annoying - but still manageable to order your favorite meal without it. But most recently this past week (way before closing) they were literally out of about 6 ingredients all at once which is pretty unacceptable if you ask me. 

Employees are obviously unhappy to be there - they move painfully slow, with zero sense of urgency and slop together the food so carelessly, it's possible to actually lose your appetite watching the way they make your  meal.

Went with my daughter for lunch. She ordered the California wrap and I had the buffalo chicken wrap. Let's start with the bad, the food wasn't awesome. My daughters didn't have the black beans it was supposed to come with, so it was basically a white rice burrito. My wrap didn't have a hint of buffalo, but was heavy with ranch...which it was supposed to come with. Mine was good, but my kid wasn't overly excited.

The good: The fries are awesome! My daughter cared less about her flop of a wrap because she had a huge portion of great fries. We also asked for a dipping sauce for her wrap to give it some flavor. They brought out an incredibly mild one, but it had good flavor. I asked our server if they sold sauces by the bottle; she wasn't sure and later brought over her supervisor. She said they didn't, but offered to bring us out samples. After we told her to bring us the hottest, she brought us out the three hottest sauces they have. All were incredible! 

The service was fantastic; I wish I remembered our servers name because she was great. Both she and the supervisor were incredibly friendly and attentive seeing as my daughter needed several drink refills. 

So yes, the food had some mistakes, but that is not reflective of the ladies out front and they totally made up for it. I'd rather have decent food with great service than amazing food with bad service. I know we'll be back.

One creative? ingredient is that they put french fries in their gyros too. I would still like my fries on the side, but that's a personal choice. The tzatziki was tasteful because it was more dense than some other food carts. The gyro is huge because the pita is stuffed with all the ingredients. It was only about $6.50 I think. My friend got the lamb gyro platter and it came alone with fries on the side, really good string beans (you should try this) and some kind of soup for about $9. tl;dr Penn's quintessential college fast-casual, offering up reliable food for an affordable price

Let me cut to the chase -- Greek Lady is not a restaurant that you should go out of your way to try out. But its consistency is where it shines: the food is cheap and consistently just-above-average. Greek Lady fills a niche on Penn's campus for Americanized multicultural cuisine. Walking in, you are greeted by faux brick and mini-columns, about as authentic as Greek Lady's cuisine. Two-person tables are scattered around the dining area toward the left of the entrance, while a few four-seater tables are pressed along the wall. Additionally, there are several outside tables that end up being as enjoyable as the weather.

During peak hours, the line can get to around 15 minutes and tables can fill up with students and neighborhood residents alike, but you can call ahead of time for takeout. Moreover, Greek Lady offers delivery anywhere around the University City bubble for a cheap flat rate. If you dine in, then grab a number after your order and scope out a table. Staff members are continually making rounds of the dining area, dropping off platters or bussing tables. Service is always friendly, but wait times for the food can vary substantially from 5 minutes to nearly half an hour.

By far, the best thing to get on the menu is the Chicken Platter -- it comes with a huge serving of chicken (plenty to last over 2 meals), along with pita, two sides (I usually get the Greek salad and curly fries), and a dipping sauce (I opt for the tzatziki), for just under $10. The chicken is cooked well, but it always comes completely unseasoned, so expect to eat it with your dipping sauce or a different condiment. The pita is served warm in tin foil, but rather soggy as if it's just been reheated. The Greek salad is always fresh and comes with a hefty dollop of feta. It can sometimes be overly drenched in the oil and vinegar, so I typically ask for dressing on the side. The fries are almost definitely the same frozen ones that you can buy at any store, but are actually fried and have a nice crisp. Again, if this food appraisal seems pretty lackluster, it's because the food, like the restaurant as a whole, is just barely better than average -- the big portion-size and proximity to Penn's campus are the two real draws.

Super disappointing. Used their online ordering. Food was supposed to be ready at 215PM. 225PM roles along and food still not ready. Asked the cashier who then checked a ticket and said it was, "about to be made," though politely. Iafter 232PM, about 15 customers served and me asking a second time about if my food was being made I finalkt asked for and was provided with a refund.

Moral of the review....do not order online from here. Moreover don't come here if you do not want to wait. Seems like the assembly line of food makinh should be perfected by now but this place always has a line. Two stars given for quality of food and the fact that the cashier apologized. Unfortunately,  I will not be back.

The pick up time for online orders are not accurate. I waited at least 30 extra minutes. The food was good. They got my order right for the most part, one item was left out. 

I feel like the app/online order platform should be re-adjusted to give you accurate pickup times so we don't have to stand outside the store waiting for so long. It was also hard to social distance since so many people were waiting outside.

I have only tried their pizza and it was really good. The service was equally as good. I would have given them a 5 star rating but their $1 discount to pay in cash is really a $1 charge to use your credit card. I understand credit card companies charge businesses fees but these businesses should include these fees in their pricing. Carrying cash in any city is not safe. Cash also spreads germs and there is a current coin shortage. They should give a $1 discount to not use cash. But their pizza is really worth trying. I enjoyed it!!!

Ordered a garden salad and no where in the description does it say that they put bacon on it (as a vegetarian, this is something I look for). When I got my salad they put bacon on it! Not only was that bad, but most of the veggies were wilted and on the verge of going bad. Not happy.

I've worked in the food industry so I get that sometimes it's frustrating and no matter what you do, sometimes ya just drown in busy-ness but the rudeness and attitude I got from the hard ass "security guard" here is ridiculous. Not my fault y'all forgot half my order. I was even OVERLY nice about it. I said thank you and got straight up ignored. Y'all got some fuckin nerve.
The food is amazing. I never thought Indo-Mex could actually be this good considering the flavors are oceans and continents apart.

We ordered delivery of a sampling of dishes because  I really wanted to do a thorough review. Luckily my eating partner in crime likes to share. We ordered, two slices of pizza one standard, one tomato pie type, 1 order of fries, a regular chicken cheese "steak" hoagie, and a slice of chocolate cake. There's quite a bit left, we ordered too much food and it was all quite filling. Both the regular slice and the tomato pie slice are HUGE ( please see photos). 

Service: 5/5
The folks at A&M are all really nice. From Madeline on the phone  (yes like the children's book series) to the delivery man (who was very nice and exactly on time) everyone was sweet as can be.

Food:
1 slice tomato pie with cheese.4/5 (rounding up it's really a 3.5/5 read why...) if you want cheese it's a $1 more which is fine. But like the other reviewers reported, their tomato pie-sauce is very sweet. We both enjoy ALL types of pizza but I'd  probably revise the sauce recipe for the tomato pie with or without cheese. It's far too sweet as-is and not chunky enough. The dough is crispy and a little thicker than their regular pizza 4/5
 
A slice of standard cheese pizza 4/5
This rating is based on a  bite (stolen by me) of a single slice of cheese pizza pie.I usually like reheated pizza better because I prefer thin, crispy crust. I agree with the other reviewers, the crust is nice and thin. It's light on the sauce and an average amount of cheese. It's a bit on the dry side but very edible for sure. Were I the pizza chef, I'd probably under bake the pies slated for single slice sales  and then finish it off during the reheat for the single slice customers. That would probably be the best of both worlds. I think the final product using that method would probably be a better quality product.

Fries 4/5
Though they came luke-warm, delivering hot, crunchy French fries packed to go in plastic or styrofoam container from over a mile away is virtually impossible . But as requested they did not add salt and after reheating for 10 min, they were perfect. 

Chicken cheese steak hoagie 5/5
You have to like tiny sliced/cubed chicken breast meat for this type of chicken cheese "steak" hoagie to work for you. The tomato and lettuce were very fresh, and the hoagie came hot on a scooped roll (as requested). The roll was the soft kind but it was definitely a hoagie/cheesesteak roll. I think the onions were sautéed separately from the chicken. We added our own mayo and sweet peppers. It was tasty, the meat was very lean and wholesome and not the least bit greasy or wet. 5/5

DARK Chocolate cake 3/5
This layered chocolate cake was moist, dark and rich and tasted like it was coated with espresso powder. My dining partner liked it but we both only had a few bites. It's not a huge slice but it's plenty to share and we left more than we ate.
Burgers were delicious, fries were nice and crips and best of all were the chicken nuggets.

Word mash-ups are amongst the things that bring me the most joy, so I HAD to have a burroti from Twisted Indian Wraps. The fusion burrito, filled with chicken tikka, rice, and a variety of vegetable fillings was delightful. It was a joy to experience some of Indian cuisine's greatest hits in a different format. I had some lentil soup as well, and thought it was a great complement to my meal. I can't wait to try the other clever dishes on the menu!

So its papa John's what can we say. 
I always order and pick up when the have the 50% off pizza deals. Never have an issue and always ready when I pick up. My boyfriend ordered and had it delivered one night and it came fast.
Its premade pizzas not fresh cant complain honestly about the food cause we know what were getting.

I ordered 2 burrito bowls for pick up and both of them were made incorrectly and cold. So I had to drive all the way back there for them to correct it. Bad experience 
And the staff (manager included) should be more friendly

Foods was excellent. But they nickel and dime everything- after buying a ton of foods and drinks, I went back to get a refill on a coke. The owner asked for additional $1.80. I couldn't believe it. They put a ton of ice in the first place and didn't get enough coke. Now for a small refill, I have to pay anther full price? Good luck staying in business much longer. Too many good solid halal foods few blocks away

Probably the worst McDonald's I've been to. They make all their stuff at once and don't make your order fresh. The nuggets and fries weren't hot and were stale and the sandwich was soggy. Avoid this heap of trash and save your money.

YIKES! This Mickey D's got a big D- from me. Pretty much a fail! Not passing by any means! This is the worst food I have ever had at a McDonalds!

Granted, I did come in around 2am.. but that should not excuse REALLY bad food and service. I had completely burnt patties on my Big Mac for goodness sake! 

I did experience some attitude as well... But I was ok with that... after all, I was surrounded by drunk customers... anyone dealing with drunk customers for hours on end would become impatient. So this did not effect my rating... 1 star accounts for really bad food!

EDIT: I had given this 3 stars because I love McDonalds food. I really do; I've probably eaten the whole menu so many times over that I've shortened a few years off my life span. But after many experiences I bumped the original review down to 1 star.

With that said, I realized that I should review this establishment in terms of the service and not the food, since it's a chain establishment. With that in mind, this is by far the worst customer-facing establishment I have ever been at in terms of service. I'll mention a caveat that if you come before 10:00pm, I genuinely believe the people on shift here are much nicer, but I've had too many midnight run-ins with really poor service, and without the place being busy! I can understand that late at night people can get cranky but I believe that sometimes I've had endless downright disrespectful encounters.

One that sticks out in my memory is this one night we were at McDonalds. It was around midnight and the place was NOT busy - perhaps 3 people in line. We had ordered through mobile order and came to pick up our food. When we picked it up, we asked for a cup of water with the order. The person glared at us and did not reply. We asked nicely a few times, asking if they weren't allowed to serve water as part of their policy, which we understood if that was the case. Both of the people just glared at us and went back to talking to each other. At that point, there were still only maybe 3 people ordering and they were not doing anything besides standing around. This lasted for 10-20 minutes, which eventually more people came. We ended up asking one of the cashiers, who was nice enough to give us the water. We were paying customers and the service people did not even give us a reply even when we tried to phrase the questions in an understanding manner.

This was probably my worst encounter at McDonalds, but I've had similar encounters that just leave my impression of this place... not so good.

It is conveniently located in the area, right across from Fresh Grocer. They have everything a regular McDonald offers. Love their limited time international menu. Especially Canadian fried chicken sandwich. It is the BEST chicken sandwich I've ever had in McDonald or elsewhere. I was very surprised by the crunchy and favorable chicken patty. I wish they can keep this burger on their menu. 

However, the place itself smells rather bad whenever we come. That is why I am only giving it a 2 stars comparing to other McDonald's.
The manager sent two employees to beat up a Ronald McDonald clown outside the store advocating for $15 wages. I mean my god it's the clown of the company lol
Hidden gem in university city! Salads are huge and the grilled chicken is fanatic. Gyro always hits the spot,   great pita and authentic gyro meat.

Got lunch for a few people here today, I was a little overwhelmed with the orders I had to get. The employee named Darling was FANTASTIC. She was efficient and so sweet. If she is the person who takes your order consider yourself lucky, she is awesome! 100/10. Get her a raise Qdoba!!!!
Have all  you people giving this place 3 stars tried the Greek Lady Salad?  It's ridiculous.  That with their homemade pita, hummus, and tzatziki = heaven.

Sure it's commercialized and americanized, but I love this place.  Healthy choices, tasty food, take-home portions, brown rice, quick service... that's plenty for me.

I don't compare it to other asian food, I compare it to my other relatively quick and cheap food options outside the city.  When my stomach is grumbling on Saturday afternoon I think to myself, "Do I want pizza place, fast food, Couch Tomato AGAIN, Wawa... oh yeah, Pei Wei!"  Not only does it fit my under 45 min, ~$10 for a meal criteria, but has the added bonus of being healthy.  And boy do I like health.

I've had the spicy korean, thai coconut curry, and thai dynamite, and all have been quite good... options for tofu or shrimp, and brown rice, make it even better.  Spicy dishes aren't over the top, but do have some kick.  Wash it down with black current or orange peel brewed iced tea, yum.  Top it all off with a fortune cookie or two... in bed.

I just wanted ice cream . How could it be such a LONG and difficult process? 

There's really no other Sonic in the area, so at around 930PM my friends pulled up into the parking lot & there was a whole party (more like riot) going on. People were actually camped in the parking spots -- with chairs and all. IN THE PARKING LOT. 

No problem ordering. We pressed the button and the worker took our order. We paid with card and thought all was well. 

FAST FORWARD 40 minutes later... WHERE WAS OUR ICE CREAM? We ordered 4 ice creams -- 2 sonic blasts & 2 master blasts.. it's literally ice cream with toppings.. They make these all day long.. So I don't get why it was taking forever? 

The car to our right ordered about 5 minutes before us but they received their order a whole 20 minutes before we did. I get that it is busy and everyone is probably ordering at the same time -- but then you should probably close some of the ordering machines if you can't actually serve each car waiting.

We decided to take a look inside the restaurant and it was a whole MESS. Please hire more people because we just want delicious dessert! ..

SO FINALLY we receive our dessert. Guess what? THEY RAN OUT OF DESSERT SPOONS/STRAWS. They gave us small skinny straws for our ice cream... ?!??? Might as well use my fingers lol. Well this is the first and last time I will be going to this Sonic. Such an unfortunate experience.

By far some of the worst service 
Even by McDonald's standards 

Waited 10 minutes for fries while the staff just sat there. Rude when anyone asked her to do anything besides sit on her ass

What can I say? It's not the worse but it's definitely not the best. I don't know too many places with decent wings but I can say that when I'm tired of contemplating where to go I'll resort to this place. I do prefer places like this over somewhere such as Buffalo Wild Wings, so that's a plus. 

They don't have a great selection of beers sadly. Nothing more than a few craft beers and your common domestic selections. Other than that you can get a varied offering of flavors (bone-in/out) and the generally have some pretty decent deals on wings. For instance, Thursdays are .65 boneless wings and Mondays are .75 bone-in deals. I rarely waste my time trying something else due to skepticism and fear the dish won't be good. Sometimes you just gotta stick to what you know is good.

I didn't expect much; it's airport food. This was quite possibly the worst food I have ever eaten. The lo mein was mushy, the bourbon chicken was as dry as jerky, and the chicken with mushrooms and zucchini was bland and slimy. My suggestion:  go to Wendy's or go hungry.

Ok location. It has the Coke machine serving all those flavors that's a plus- I come here for my biscuit cravings- it's no fine dining. It's Popeyes! 
Ppl are generally nice

Yesterday my friend and me were planning to go some other restaurant in University city area. They said waiting time was at least one hour so we decided to go to different place. 

I went to Greek Lady couple times before and each time everything was more than fine. Good food, very clean restaurant, open kitchen which I always love that. We ordered chicken gyro platter and salmon platter with 2 sides each of them and also we got house salad.

The food was really good. They were busy but it was really fast service. Like usual everything was really nice and very important thing after leaving one table immediately they cleaned up with bleach.

Highly recommended. Stay safe and healthy.

I would rather you not put anything guac instead of putting a whole rotted guacamole.. that's just disrespectful. And the chips are old and stale and the side of guac with that is old too. That's bullshit
Everyone is always super nice at this Burger King like Chic fil la nice!! It's super clean too!

This location on 40th st has to better in regards to how their staff act when there are customers present,  they are extremely loud and do not take into account that not everyone need to hear their conversations...they be too busy interacting with one another than taking care of what needs to be done.  Their tone of voice is not welcoming.
Yummy food! Love their cheesesteaks and milkshakes! The service is phenomenal and quick. Their outdoor dining set up is great- they even have tents. Clean and new restaurant.

Horrible. I love Burger King, but I'll never go to this location again. There was 1 person working the register & bagging up food. The manager was storming around, filling up the ice machine, cursing the entire time, with a bad attitude. The wait was 10 minutes for a sandwich and fries. The drive-thru isn't any better. 
They charge $ for dipping sauces, and are very stingy on the ketchup packets.
Do yourself a favor & go to a suburb location, or not at all.

I've given this location a chance 4 times now, and I never wrote a review until now because I believe post Covid hiccups are a thing in the food industry, and that I needed to have some sympathy. After tonight I won't be returning unless I'm in the mood for one of their S'mores milkshakes and feel like waiting a half hour for it. Seriously, the food isn't worth it at all. Just go for the milkshakes. 

Not only is the clientele extremely obnoxious (every time I've embarked on waiting for over 30min for any size order I've ever placed, I've witnessed some extremely obnoxious patrons just screaming and being insanely rude to the staff). So, it's already a hostile environment, which is obviously uncomfortable. One of the worst parts about visiting this NF location, is that you will not wait for less than 30min for your order regardless if you ordered a single soda, or a full meal. The second (and main) worst part is that all of the food is really terrible. Literally everything I've ordered from them over the past year has been barely edible. Just get the milkshakes if you really need to go here. 

Also, pro tip: if you order a cheeseburger, it is literally a burnt burger patty with a slice of cheese on top. Nothing else. Make sure you ask for something else on it if you don't just want a patty and cheese on a dry bun.  But keep in mind that if you ask for say, lettuce and tomato, after getting your order - you will wait another 10-15min for that side of condiments that should have come on the burger automatically. Such a strange place.

I haven't tried anything but their grilled chicken gyro, and I have to say that it's absolutely amazing and overfilling. I usually wanna take a nap after eating half of it. It's so filling. I love their white sauce. Will definitely come back here again.
Food was so delicious I will tell my friends and family about east coast wings there are awesome thank you very much

This place is literally like a Wild Wings or Hooters except they have more flavors for wings which is very cool. However, I still got the chipotle hbbq because it's my fav! The food was also VERY hot as in temp which I was not mad about because I could eat at a decent pace. 

The host was sweet but the server seemed a little too occupied, not sure if they were under staffed or not. 

What I didn't like is that they charge you for veggies and for dipping sauce like ranch or blue cheese.

We were impressed with some of what we got and underwhelmed by the rest of it for the price.  The naan wrap was a hit. My vegetarian meal was lackluster. The burger we got for our kid was very rare. It wasn't beyond what some people order, but it was significantly rare for having not been asked. Maybe that's what we get for ordering beef from a (non-Indian?) Indian food place.  My biggest complaint is that everything simply wasn't worth the price. It would also be nice if their projected wait times didn't seem so arbitrary.

Would give 1-2 stars but owners hassle you until you take down the post. Downright AWFUL. 
4 stars is Ridiculous! How many bogus posts? How many fear to give 1 star? Don't be fooled!
Worst pizza I've had in decades. Have eaten pizza all around country, places where you shouldn't eat pizza, and no place worse than this. 
3 out of 4 couldn't stomach the food. 2 gave up on 1 slice of pizza. Other gave up on a couple bites of Stromboli. 
So bad that don't want to eat anymore tonight. 1 small slice is not filling, but it puts you off food for the night.

It's a small store in center city and it gets crowded fast. This seems to be a prime delivery spot as the drivers are in and out a lot faster than the people waiting in line or waiting for their orders. Speaking of order, there is none. one line for drivers and in store customers. Most drivers just walk up to the front and shove their phone in the persons face demanding the delivery order. It was crazy as I waited for about 25 minutes for 2 chicken sandwiches and strawberry lemonade that were totally forgotten about. I'll probably go back, but it'll only be out of the convenience of me just being in the area.

As far as fast food joints go this was not that bad. Though there was a pipe sticking out of the building when we went to the drive through which was a bit concerning. 

Also they didn't give us any onions, when we asked for extra onions! But the burger was alright, and the lady who gave us our food was nice.

I really, really want to give them 4 or 5 stars because the concept ROCKS (Think Maoz meets Qdoba) and the guys who run the place are really nice, but - there are a few things that need working out first.

I came to Zaffron for dinner (mistake number 1 on my part - you'll see why) while running a last minute Victoria's Secret coupon redemption run.
I rarely eat in the food court unless I have my 6 year old with me (She likes the California Rolls from Sarku - go figure, and Saladworks, and Chik-fil-A on the rare occaision I'll let her get it.)

So I headed over to Spice (the Indian Joint) and saw this place - brand spankin' new (2months old really).  

I ordered a Schwarma platter and jazzed it up with lots of cucumbers, tomatoes, chick peas and olives.

Everything has potential - but the meat was DRY (It had been precut - likely at lunchtime - the Schwarma Spit was empty by the time I got there) and some of it was crunchy - and not in a good way.  Also the rice had been siting around a little long - great flavor - but tasted like the remnants of lunch.

Again, this is probably "my bad" and I bet at lunch when the turnover is higher, the food is likely fresher and tastier - but meanwhile - I can;t wait to go back (at 11:30 pre-lunch line crowd) and give them another try.

The 2 dudes ahead of me orderes $2.00 side of falafel (3 balls per side) and that seems just about perfect.  

Also I did not try the hummus which looked awesome - and for just $.50 you can add a bunch of mix-ins and toppings, if you care to.

Owners are 3 culinary partners and the one I met tonight was a sweetie.  I intend to try them again and re-yelp - hoefully with more stars.

Keep it FRESH - from first client to last - and you'll have more dinner business.

Also - I noticed they open at 9 AM - I wonder if they'll offer breakfast?  Shakshouka to go?

Price is "Philadelphia Lunch" approriate - $8 - $10 (more if you dare to get a beverage.)

Good Afternoon to my Yelp Family!!! I recently visited this location on Aramingo Avenue. I ordered the grilled chicken nuggets with waffle fries. I ordered a small order. I believe there were about 7 nuggets. I always enjoy the food here. This is probably my favorite of all the fast food places.  There is a lot of parking here and there were a lot of tables in the eatery.  Chloe, the cashier, smiled and was warm and polite. I will definitely visit this location again. See ya! Yelp Family!!

The greek lady was a huge disappointment as soon as I received my plate of food.  However, the food is made relatively quickly and it's cheap, but it lacks in quality and definitely shows in the food.

First of all, the employees seem to all hate their jobs.  It was a highly unpleasant environment to eat in, that  I contemplated packing my food and just eating in the car.  Second of all, the greek food is americanized.   This is hardly greek food, and any semblance of greek food is just that they serve rice and gyro.  The potatoes are horrible and not seasoned well, and so is everything else on the plate/

Maybe I'm a bit picky about Greek food because I have grown up with a great authentic restaurant near my hometown, but The greek lady is definitely not a place I recommend to anyone.

One big,thirst-quenching, fat-kid approved star for the crushed-ice Ocean Water drink (What flavor is it? Ummm... BLUE!) and Diet Dr. Pepper made even more scrumptious by all that crunchy ice. 

Another greasy, glossy star for the tater tots, both plain and smothered in "cheese" and chili. These are clearly frozen and just dunked in oil -- pretty hard to screw up -- but that doesn't make them one whit less appealing. 

Everything else was gross.  Cold, chewy, bland, soggy, salty -- just plain unappetizing and yucky.  I'm not a snob about fast-food, either -- I can get down with McNuggets and go to town on some Wendy's like whoa -- but this did not compare.  Mostly the food was ice-cold, which is so disappointing.  The best thing about junk fast food is the fresh-from-the-fryer texture and heat you just can't produce at home.

The commercials are cute but the food is rude.  Avoid.

Hunger burger donates a portion of the proceeds of each burger sold to non-profit organizations working to end hunger. A noble mission that I would really like to support. But a mediocre burger in a city with plenty of great burgers is something I can't support.

After I ordered my burger I watched how they were being cooked. The cook puts the burgers on the grill and then smashes them! Squeezing out what little juice was in the patty. And since very little juice came out, they must be using lean beef. So you end up being served a thin well cooked burger with very little juice. The only good thing is that it's fresh beef.

They have such a great location and a great mission. What a shame they don't know how to make a great burger.

I work on campus and I have trying ordering  via phone and on the website.  Trying to get through by phone is AN AWFUL EXPERIENCE!  I have waited an hour for a lunch delivery.  Can't get through by phone and the customer service stinks.  I like the food but they need better management on the phones and customer service side.

The food from here is okay - it's like a solid option if you want to try some food that's relatively affordable but not the best of the best. Definitely the best Qdoba in the city that i've had so far

This is the worst Chipotle in Philly. I've had massive issues with every single order I've placed here. Last time, we got it delivered and the rice was crunchy and hard and old and the drink was missing. This time, we placed an order on the app and went to pick it up and they messed up every single item. They left out a PAID side of guac from my quesadilla order. The burrito we got was literally the half the size of a normal chipotle burrito and was missing key ingredients - it must have been 4 inches long. It only had cauliflower rice and guac, veggies and other ingredients were missing. The soda fountain was broken, too. The employee was really nice when I asked for my soda cup, but she neglected to tell me that their soda machine was 100% empty, and she watched me walk over to the soda machine and try every single soda only to discover that there was no soda syrup in the fountain at all. I just left after that. This place is horrible, disappointing, poorly managed, and you should never go there. Only good thing about tonight was that I got a full refund.

Really any star for this place is a plus, the staff are the worst, and none of them seem to want to work. I had to ask them can I be waited on, and then the young lady came over with s attitude. I just asked for coffee at 10am and she told me it would be a wait because they just open, hold up it's 10am and you open up at 9am.  
1600 N Broad 
Between Cecil B Moore and Oxford St. 19122

Overall, pretty mediocre. I found the seasoning to be lacking - I got a chicken burrito bowl that really didn't taste like much even though I had gotten all of the things, as one does (both beans, all the veggies, all the salsa, all the cheese)! Also prep work is lazy as evidenced by 1) the huge chunks of raw onion and tomatoes in the pico de gallo and 2) the thick pieces of bell peppers that are almost raw in the fajitas. 

The only saving grace is that guac and queso don't cost extra with any entree.
Hands down the best Chipotle in Philadelphia. Excellent customer service, fresh food, and speedy service! Another excuse for me to eat Chipotle on a regular basis!

Recently came here with my dad and my daughter.  The service was terrible with the exception of one individual. Long story short but we ordered a shake to share. Were then told (after we paid) that they couldn't do shakes and they couldn't give a refund. Then told yes, they could do the shake. Our food comes...we finish and still no shake. We wait, and wait and wait. Ask a few times about the status....overall we were there about 45 minutes and no shake. Ask to speak to the manager. He comes out about 5 minutes later and has no clue what's going on, gives us no explanation and no apology. We finally get our money back.  Get it together...I can understand if the machine was broken but the experience was ridiculous.

The rating on this McDonalds resturant is completely true and doesn't even deserve a star 

The building is old and very dirty. One entrance is typically blcked by random debris. It is very unorganized and is very underequipped  

I have had many experiences here. It is in a great location and a prime hub where people walk and visit nearby stores. 

If you want to be hastled by 10 homeless people and sit in a poorly cleaned seat definitely stop by. On numerous occasions I have been asked, sometimes offering food and money to the people. 
If you can believe it not even uber eats can change the rating as many times the food is below average. A few times the food was damaged and missing items. 

My worst and very recent experience here was when my food came and not only smelled, but tasted like cigarette smoke. On further inspection it appeared that all of the fried foods had ash or something on tem. I assumed that some genius tossed a cigarette in the fryer. 

The WORST McDonalds around. McDonalds is obviously nothing to write home about, but this one in particular takes the cake. 

If you want fast food. I would reccomend any other place other than this one

I would give this place a third chance for sure, but the first two trips were pretty God awful.  I love food in general and Asian fusion especially, but the meals I have had hear were both pretty bad.

The first time I had the curry, which I would never recommend to anyone.  I don't even remember the second thing I had, but it was equally yuck.  Other people seem to like it though, so I would do some Yelp searching to figure out what to order and go back.

POOR SERVICE/MEDIOCRE FOOD! We waited for our orders for over 30 minutes and we were wondering what happened as this was supposed to be a quick bite to eat kind of a place. After asking for it, the guy behind the counter then started to hurriedly prepare the orders because he was slowly preparing a party tray that throughout our meal was just sitting on the side of the counter- that obviously indicates no one was really rushing to pick it up. So why prioritize a party platter when your customer is right in front of you waiting after having paid. Food is mediocre at best. Over $45 for 3 orders and had to eat it in 15 minutes. This place isn't recommended if you only have an hour to get a quick bite to eat!

I ate a chicken fajita burrito here in 2008, it tasted okay at the time. a few hours later though I was in the grips of food poisoning. 

Im not sure if it was the dubious cleanliness of this location on a winter evening, or something to do with the supply chain - but be prepared to potentially spend the nexts 2-3 days in extreme discomfort, in your bathroom, if you eat here.

Had the worst experience with McDonald over the past 24 years. The staff there are soooo rude and they yielded at us just because we need some sauce. I don't know what to say about the service. I was hurt. Please prepare a strong heart if you want to be a customer here.

Went to breakfast had homefries and fish unfortunately fish was swai nasty fried way to hard needed to change oil home fries were burnt paid 75 cent for peppers and onions no peppers and uncooked onions went there cause I heard it was good sorry was untrue

I would give it 3.5 stars...I have gone to the one in Springfield and had mixed emotions.  PF Changs (see Chris L's. review) at least in the Chadds Ford location, is the slowest service I have ever seen, so the fast food atmosphere and similar menu makes Pei Wei like PF Changs Express. Of course Changs has a very nice assortment of teas and is a great place to take a date, whereas the newly opened Baltimore Pike locale is already just acceptably clean, not spotless, and when I asked if they served coffee the manager very rudely sniggered in my face.  (Why that is funny I don't know.) They do have lovely sauces, like chili oil and so forth and I personally think white rice is disgusting. Out here in the suburban wilderness you can't get brown rice for love or money. The decor is more San Francisco-y than trying to be actually Oriental, I think. The chain is from out that way originally. The food was good, smaller portions than Chang's which is sometimes a good thing. Not too bad an idea but I'd rather go to one in the city than this particular locale.

Food and service are in need of improvement. There is plenty of parking and they do host boxing and UFC events on all TVs with good drink specials. Just wish they put more care into their food and customer satisfaction.

The worst Burger King I've been to in the past several months. My sister and I eat at BK about twice a month after a day of shopping. Most BKs are decently clean. This place is not very clean, i.e., sticky floor, excessive dust atop the inoperable drink machine, dirty floor behind register counter and noticeable food crumbs crammed along the bottom edge of cashier computer screen. Cleanliness is not top priority for sure at this location. Before I noticed just how nasty the place is, there was a mix up with my order. I ordered 2 for $10. Cashier rang up BOGO for $1. (2 for $10 is all my sister I have ordered in the past few months). I questioned the order not having fries and drinks. Manager told me the order did not come with fries and drinks. 2 for $10 doesn't come with drinks and fries, I asked. He said, BOGO does not come with fries and drink. But I ordered 2for10, I replied. Cashier chimes in and says,  "He ordered BOGO." My sister and I in unison, "We ordered 2for10." Manager attempted to correct the mistake. He asked for our drink choices. The cashier went out of view to pour the drinks (remember self-serve machine was out of order). I immediately asked for a refund. The cashier was mistaken about my order and continued to insist that I ordered BOGO. I admitted to them that I should have noticed the price for the meals was not that of the 2for10...accepting my responsibility in the mistake. But when the lying cashier was asked to pour our drinks and she went out of view to do so, that was too much. Then after taking in the full lack of cleanliness of the place, I got my refund and left. I strongly recommend NOT eating at this BK location. Very deserving of their 2 star rating.

I give it 3 1/2 stars.

The kids really loved their burger... actually they ate it so fast I didn't have a chance to see it or take a picture.. lol . They said it was probably the best burger they ever had.    
Glad they enjoyed the burger since the place is named "Hunger Burger".     Next time I visit I will try it since they gave it such huge reviews.

The kids also had fries which they enjoyed and they looked yummy.

I had the lobster mac and cheese ($11).  It was just ok because it did not have a lot of lobster.  It was minimal so I would NOT get that again.  

The salad they had out looked like it was out a long time so I would not order it.  

Will I be back? Yes.  I want to try that burger.

I'm usually not too picky with McD's- you get what you pay for. However, this one somehow always manages to smell like someone peed all over the walls. 

Food is exactly what you would expect. Service was also exactly what you would expect at McD's. I guess if you are considering eating here, a one-star review wouldn't do anything to stop you anyways, so just go on and order your chicken nuggets and get to the self-loathing stage already.
The other locations seem fine, but this one just opened and already the reviews aren't that good. But from my experience with places on Oregon Ave I guess I shouldn't expect different^
