Greek Lady is a go-to lunch spot for me and my coworkers. The chicken gyros are by far my favorite! The best part about the gyro is the French fries that are include INSIDE the gyro, much like those you would get overseas. They are very generous and fill the pita to the brim, so make sure you are hungry when you eat this. Also, try the honey Dijon mustard! It's homemade and probably one of the best I've had..

Tip: I recommend ordering from Doordash, Uber, etc. rather than calling the store for delivery. It takes a while to get, unless you order at least an hour in advance prior to your lunch break.

Me and my girlfriend came here after eating Chick-Fil-A for some milkshakes and the service was fast and great! For the milkshake. They could use better straws. They make it super thick and it makes the straw hard to suck from. They give you a spoon too. But overall. Great and quick!

What a DISASTER!  Really wanted Mexican after drinks with friends, was in a hurry.  Used to go to the Qdoba at 19 & Chestnut until it closed to make way for another Target.  Stopped at this place on way home.  Went in one of two doors, wrong.  Walked into a girl and two cops waiting for their food.  By the time I made it to the front of the line, lost my place.  There was one guy working, who dropped dishes a number of times, and a girl working, who seemed to do nothing but walk in the back and then come back out, oblivious to people waiting on food.  The girl customer was very patient, the cops not so much.  Seemed to be a ton of work to get them chips they were waiting on.  There was now one woman in front of me, I waited for more than 15 mins while they tried to assist her.  It was absolutely absurd, but as I decided to leave, unserved, no one even looked in my direction.  This place needs to close, and make place for a respectable business...

We love salads, my guy and I. In university city, it's hard yo find a place that makes BIG salads for $9 or $10. Many salad joints here make single or small portions of salads and charge the same amount (although I do love me some saladworks! Always a nostalgic place). So we ordered by phone and came to pick up. He had the Mediterranean chick salad which is lettuce, tomato, cucumber, pepper, feta (tons of it), and red onions. I had chicken salad which is the same except for the feta and an addition of hard boiled eggs. We asked for tzaziki sauce, which is amazing! The salads come with pita, but I did not eat it lol. The salads are huge!! We both workout and usually be hungry as hell for dinner, but we couldn't finish our salads and packed the leftovers. They were still good the next morning! I think we will be regulars here from now on.

not my first time here but its been a while. the place is big and usually pretty noisy. i guess theres not much you can do about that. on my visit today there was only one register open initially so i waited and waited till finally a gentleman decided to help out and man the second register. ordering was simple bcuz i knew what i wanted. i ordered a lamb gyro and onion rings. the one thing i never liked about this place is the fact that they put french fries on their gyros. i will never understand why but i don't like it so i made sure to tell the cashier NO FRIES ON MY GYRO. the order was ready after 5 mins or so. food was fine. not the best gyro in philly but it sufficed. id stop in here again.

I love this place, they get my order right every time and when they are out of anything they always call me to let me know. The food is always hot and super fresh, all the sauces are really good and so are the apps. I love the lava petals and the Buffalo chicken tenders too.

Pei Wei is a well run chain restaurant with a energetic, multicultural staff. T he restaurant is comfy and attractive and they have nice plates and utensils and the open air kitchen is a great idea for a fast food spot. i love Asian food and a spot that offers Chinese, Japanese, Thai and Korean dishes caught my attention 
I ordered the Korean BBQ and my friend ordered the Pei Wei spicy chicken. I really liked my dish, even though it wasn't barbecued, the beef was very tasty as were the veggies and the sauce. My friend didn't care for the Pei Wei chicken saying that the coating on the chicken was too overpowering 
I had a Egg Roll that was filled with ground pork and veggies and it came with a nice sauce to dip it in. I don't know if you can call it fast food, because when you think of it most Asian food is fast food. How many times were you amazed when you called a Chinese take out and gave them a list of entrees as long as your arm and the voice on the other end of your call said "Ten minutes"

This place has the best milkshakes I have ever had, and I drive almost an hour just for them. The last time I went was pre- pandemic so I have no information on anything current. The staff is always incredibly polite and get your order out fast. I've never had an order messed up, or a milkshake that tastes bad. I always ask the cashier to surprise me with whatever they like and never get a bad one. Definitely a place I recommend going to, or stopping by when you're in Philadelphia.

Your review helps others learn about great local businesses.

Could I have given this experience more than 5 stars? I would totally do that. Got the butter chicken and chicken tikka bowl. Loved both of them so much. Spice and taste level was top notch. I would definitely recommend trying this place.

My wife and I stopped by this place the other day because we heard it was worth checking out.  The food was amazing!  She ordered a shwarma sandwich and I had spicy chicken kabob on a salad.  The meat is incredibly fresh (not to mention local and organic) and it really sets this place apart.  They obviously care about their product because from the taste of it they are paying a premium for that meat!  The place functions kind of like Chipotle, but with Mediterranean cuisine.  You pick a base, a meat, then various freshly cut toppings and sauces.  The mango chutney should not be missed!  We also got a side of hummus which they must have made fresh because its probably some of the best hummus I have had outside of the Middle East.  Bottomline: its well worth visiting over and over - we actually had lunch there then got dinner to go.
Amazing pizza! We just moved here from the west coast and we always love NY pizza and this is pretty darn close!

Known for being slow, having bad customer service, messing up online orders, and now for the lack of cleanliness. Having been an online customer for the past two years I have let a lot slide. I was appalled this afternoon when I saw the shape of this place in person.  I will absolutely not be coming back to this branch. Shame on the managerial staff for letting it get this far.

*Update: we now also tried the Cherry Hill location. Staff super nice! Food seemed a little less fresh and fewer choices but still good.

Not actually open 24 hours. Came around 4AM after a very long car trip to hopefully get a meal. Employee said as soon as I walked in the door "We're closed" even though the sign on the unlocked front door said 24/7. Pretty disappointed.

I am one of the many converts to the fast casual restaurant craze. I love going inside, being able to order quickly (well, after it takes me fifteen minutes to decide what to order), sit down, and have someone bring me my food in both less time and for less money that at a normal sit-down restaurant. 

Seve' M said it really well - Pei Wei may not make you dance in the street, but it does the job really nicely. I would go a step further and say that it makes me very happy as well! 

I can't comment on speed of service, as the two times I've been have been off-peak with not many customers. And I've only ordered takeout. Both takeout servers were very polite and friendly, and did a great job of double checking the accuracy of my order and offering me any paperware and condiments that I might need. 

The food is pretty yummy. But it will not knock your socks off. But (again), sometimes what you just need is a comforting meal. Sometimes you don't need a fancy meal that tingles new tastebuds and makes you wonder what the secret ingredient is. Sometimes, all you need are delicious Dan Dan noodles. That's my go to, and maybe that's what you should try. A nice bowl of chicken, bean sprouts and cucumbers in a spicy brown sauce begging to be tossed with hot noodles to soak up the sauce. It's really a perfect Asian American comfort food, with fresh veggies to boot.

We ordered a Large cheese pizza with what was supposed to be 10 Buffalo wings. Me and my husband got super sick off this dinner. If your planning on throwing up with your significant other I recommend going to Aldo and Manny.

Food was good, but I'm definitely not returning to this location for Chipotle. Nope.

In our most recent order they didn't include the chips and also gave us a half empty guacamole. 


The only reason we go back is because we were given gift cards, but it's clearly not worth it if this is what happens.

I ordered a takeout lunch... original chicken sandwich- no pickles (said it more than once); small fries and chocolate beignets. Lots of confusion behind the counter. Waited 10 mins for cold fries, a lukewarm oily chicken sandwich with 4 pickles on it, stale bread. The beignets were the only things that were hot. This $11 experience reminded me why I stopped going to fast food joints as an adult. Better price, service and food at a hot dog cart.

This was my first time coming here, and it was dreadful. I ordered spicy mixed chicken with 2 large sides and 7 biscuits to treat my coworkers, and she somehow changed it to mild. I didn't realize this until I looked at the receipt. It said mild on there even though I said spicy. I apologized to her and told her it was actually spicy chicken. She then told me off about making her go all the way to the mild chicken instead of the spicy ones. Alright, I apologized again. It was indeed my fault for not realizing it earlier. I apologized to her yet again when she was bagging up my order because I did feel bad. 

I was trying very hard to not get upset since it was during lunch time and the store was quite crowded. However, one of the large sides was wrong too. My biscuits were also missing. They weren't even there. The box that was supposed to contain biscuits have one piece of chicken in it.   ??? I ran out of excuses to defend this place at this point. It seems like many other reviews also contain bad customer service stories.

Got my to go order last weekend for lunch!
I love that this is an Indian/Latin fusion place. There were many items I was interested in but decided to go with the butter chicken poutine. 
It came with tons of delicious butter chicken over crispy fries. It also came with delicious sauce and fresh veggie topping. I felt like I got a decent amount of food for what I paid for. I also go lt the mango lassi. I thought that was good but alittle too thick for my taste (my first time having it so not sure what to expect?) 

Overall had a good meal and take out experience!
do not but food from here ive i got food poisoning from the pizza i was sick for weeks

Aldo is so nice I think he is the owner of this this establishment. He gave me and my fellow rite aid coworkers free pizza. I'm not going to be bais in my review, the pizza was not super greasy and the dough was light and fluffy; you can tell that the pizza is home made. This is why I like local  food business because the quality of standard is much higher than a dominos or a little Cesar. I would rate this pizza a 8.5/10. You should support local food business in time like these, I'll definitely be stopping buy to get some more food from this place, if you see Aldo tell him Scott sent you.

So my last review wasn't so pleasant. Today I guess I'll keep the ball rolling. I came here YET AGAIN against better judgment. Since this location is always inconsistent, when I drove up I read the signs to make SURE I can order in. The door read in HUGE LETTERS "OPEN FOR DINE IN." I walk in and it was pretty quiet but I stand to order only for the woman to say to me online orders only. I'll be professional and leave profanity out of this but how much BS can one location give? I immediately turned around and walked out without a word because in my hangry state, I'm not a nice person at all. 
    Obviously it's false advertisement to say it's open for dine in and then tell customers you can only order online. I don't know if it's management, I don't know what the hell it is at this point BUT I'm surprised people put up with their crap anymore. Not only will I write here but I won't stop until they change all the way. It's such a disappointment seriously!
Food is good. Staff is friendly, but we're not wearing masks over nose. The gentleman took his mask of entirely who was serving drinks..

Walked in to place an order and a random employee yelled we are only taking online orders. So I then walk out of the line. Walked up to the line again to ask a question and the same random employee yelled at me that they are only taking online orders. Might be a better idea to have the employee by the door informing people that they are only taking online orders instead of waiting for them to step in line and yell across the store.

I will never forget this restaurant ever, ever, ever. A little while ago I was here for a Yelp event and I was one of the psychos that took the"East Coast Wings Challenge". Now I truly love spicy food, so I figured I could easily handle this.
Well the server made me sign a waiver and we had to wear gloves and protective eyewear. It finally hit me-what the hell was I thinking?? They laid out containers of milk and packets of sugar to ease our suffering.
The manager said the sauce was made with the infamous Ghost Chili Pepper. On the Scoville Scale which measures heat levels in peppers, the sauce registered 2 million units -same as the pepper gas used in warfare. In comparison, the jalapeno pepper registers a mere 3 thousand!
I ate it. Other Yelpers were coughing, choking and regurgitating. I kept a cool head and a poker face while calmly walking towards the men's room with a container of milk. Once inside the bathroom, I drank the milk like I was wandering in the desert without water for a week!  I couldn't talk for about 15 minutes, thinking this was one of the stupidest and bravest things I've ever attempted.
Now back to the restaurant. ECW has great food especially the wings, with 75 different sauces to choose from. I'm partial to the Harvest Apple, and I love the fried pickles, the pretzel bread, and the burgers. 
Last week ECW had a special promotion, the first 75 customers got free wings for a year and wings were.35 cents all day!  I couldn't wait all night in line, but I stocked up on lots of tasty wings.

This is the worst pizza I had in a long time. I moved from Italy to the US three years ago, so I am used to American pizza by now. You can actually eat really good American pizza. I ordered a "Margarita" pizza, and it was literally sweet. The crust was sweet, the sauce was sweet, it was basically like having dessert. The mozzarella inside of the mozzarella sticks was hard as a rock. Maybe I was just unlucky because it's Super Bowl night and they're really busy and forgot to use any salt, but I definitely wouldn't want to try it again.

We walked around Reading Terminal Market for a while on our first day trying to decide on the perfect lunch. I saw the lobster mac at Hunger Burger and decided that's what I had to have. My husband ended up choosing it too. I got the 'Bello Burger and we split the mac. It was pretty expensive for fast food. $12 for the mac. I expected it to be the best thing I'd ever tasted, but it was just so-so. We also had to wait forever for the food. I guess it takes them a while to make the 'Bello but no one told us that when we ordered. I enjoyed my good, but next time I will try a different place for lunch.

Delicious! 

The hot chutney was *fire*!
The chicken was well marinated, beans were subtly spiced and other toppings/ sauces were very flavorful. Great new addition to the neighborhood!

Wasn't even finish making my order nor paying and he already make that shit when I said I didn't want that he started to curse and get all rude they got Hella young people working in there with no respect for people that comes in and order stuff they need to do better they already lost me !!

First off, I love small businesses. Greek Lady had that feel; cozy seating, lots of people sitting/lots in line, and friendly family vibes. I got the Chicken Gyro Platter. The gyro was really flavorful! I'm not a fan of the very thick flatbread. But still, it was good and very filling. It came w/two sides; I had green beans and lemony potato slices. They were OKAY. I'd say the sides were average. But the star of the place is the gyro: so 4 yelps

Its alright.  It beats the hell out of similar establishments(I'm looking at you Q'doba) because the food is just hands-down better.  The nachos are a little oversalted but that is forgiveable.  

I recommend the chicken fajita burrito, but have them throw in some rice, beans, and guacamole.  You will not be disappointed.

Service: 4*
Food quality: 3* (I don't do half stars)
Food quantity: 4*
Speed: 4*
I am an adventurous eater. I've ordered about half the menu thus far and have yet to be disappointed.
I've used their delivery service, take out, and dine in and have yet to be disappointed.
While no restaurant is perfect, I've never been there when they've had a bad day.
I'll be back.

Coming to this location made me realize how spoiled other chick-fil-a restaurants have made me.  I wanted to give 2 stars but that would be punishing them because they are popular.  If this were any other fast food location this would be considered fast service (there would be less folks in line) but still knowing the amount of people patronizing this location, they could be doing way better!

Anyway the food is consistently good so no complaints there.  You do have another flow of customers that come up to the collection window so it gets confusing.  There has to be better methods for app ordering if that is what is taking place.  There are panhandlers just beyond the collection window but they respectfully wear masks and usually have a sign with their requests.

In closing, this location could do so much better to service the amount of customers there.   They are probably losing customers that decide not to continue waiting.  They need to invest in making the entire process more efficient!
The food was not good at all I ordered well done burgers and they were not prepared as requested. Very disappointed. The milkshakes were great. Service was fast. Food taste has to improve.

A frustrating experience. This was my first time here, and it was a train wreck! We will not be back. The place upon entering was extremely loud and dirty. There was no organization with staff so ordering and waiting took forever. Our order was wrong so we had to fix it. At least we had a gift certificate. So it's like we never paid. Don't let the outside decor fool you. This place is gross and trashy. 

The food was not good. I looked up the dishes online since we were going to pick it up and eat at home. I am so glad we did not dine-in. I had pad thai and was craving it. It tasted nothing like real or Americanized pad thai. It tasted like a camp fire. The peanut taste was missing completely even though there were weird peanut halves on top. I was really hungry and ate half. Debating on if the leftovers should just be trashed. The crab wontons were really weird. They looked tasty but were not. Avoid these too. 

Overall, I would rather eat at a mall food court Asian place. It might be a slight step above. At least they give you a free sample on a toothpick prior to ordering.

The absolute only thing I eat from here isn't even chicken, it's biscuits and gravy. Because, to me, there's no one...not even your granny's gravy that can compare to theirs. So you can imagine my disappointment when I pulled up to order and was met with egregious attitudes. The young man who works the drive through curses at you because he forgets items in your order...(how do you mess up biscuits and gravy?) Anywho, if you are starving and in the market for good food, drive a few miles to a place that will appreciate your coins because this staff does not.

First and last time I eat here and I haven't even tasted the food. Called ahead to pickup 2 salads and humus. Got to the restaurant 20 minutes later and am still waiting another 25 minutes now as I've watched the lobby fill and clear. Obviously very popular. Incredibly disorganized. I could have bought the ingredients and made my dinner from scratch at this point.

I love this place so much!! I always have an awesome experience here. The food, the service, and the atmosphere is always welcoming. It is priced fairly, the workers are kind, and I am always satisfied when I am leaving here. Definitely stop by because everything is always wonderful.

Typical diner with take-out and dine-in options. I believe that they also offer delivery. The breakfast here is delicious and the owner is such a sweetheart. She was very patient with me when I placed my order (I changed my mind twice). She thanked me for my business and wished me a good day on my way out. I order two bacon egg and cheese sandwiches and an order of chicken and waffles. Sandwiches were good. The fried chicken was nice and flavorful. The waffle was very fluffy and tasted amazing. This place is also inexpensive. The chicken and waffle platter was only 7.00. Will def be back.
I have eaten here several times and it is always the same experience-- the service is slow, the order is inaccurate, and the staff are fairly rude. Go to a different location.

Nothing special.  Came in because me and the BF were starving.  What I really wanted was a sandwich.  What I settled for was chicken tacos.  Normally I can polish off 3 chicken tacos no sweat.  

These tacos are just really bland: 
-soft flour tortilla (I prefer corn, but that option then becomes crispy...yuck), -bland chicken that must be drenched in Chulula
-lettuce
-salsa of your choosing
-cheese
-"lite" sour cream (who cares you're eating cheese.  It's not supposed to be healthy.)

Once again here is where taco bell takes the cake.  I will give them recognition for having my favorite hot sauce Chulula, which makes most any type of "Mexican" food taste a whole lot better.  But good Mexican good doesn't need to be drenched in my favorite hot sauce.  

The BF's taco salad on the other hand, was tastier.  It had a lot of lettuce for substance.  Nice rabbit food.  All in all, he likes the place. 

I was still hungry after my two tacos and all I wanted was a cookie.  That's how you know I really was satisfied.
They will forget items in the order. 2 for 2, including a nice $81 order with tip for the kitchen. It won't make a difference. Just, don't go.
This place is the worst! It just took 30min to get my meal. And they got it wrong  again

Great food and friendly service. Gets busy! They offer walk-up takeout, call ahead and online orders for takeout, and delivery through doordash. 

I love their chili on basically any of their food. Always get their nuggets. 
Never skip the onion rings!
Old of this world milkshakes

The salads are huge! I've gotten the grilled chicken salad every time (with vinegar) and it is so amazing... every time. Literally an entire tomato, huge cucumber slices, fresh red onion, a boiled egg, and I would say 3 breasts' worth of meat. Definitely worth the money. Make sure to call in first if you plan on picking it up.

I thought the gyro was just okay though. Nothing too special with that.

Chelten Avenue is the special child of the Burger King franchises.  You can't get extra onions .  Why?  Because of the neighborhood?  I always get satisfied at Easton Rd.  A smile and extra is satisfied.  Attitude is extra Chelten Ave late night.

I should have checked Yelp before I stopped by this location. I was looking for a quick meal in the area and the Wendy's across the road was closed. I got in the drive-thru line to place my order.

I wanted to try the new spicy crisp chicken sandwich so I opted for the Medium size meal with fries and a Diet Coke (I'm working to reduce my overall sugar intake).

After placing my order I moved up to the first window to pay for my meal and the young lady at the window never greeted me, repeated my order back to me, or repeated my total. She just stuck her hand out the window for my money so I repeated my order and asked her what my total was.

From here, I moved to the next window to pick up my food. My soda apparently had a hole in the cup but the server quickly noticed this and replaced it with another soda. I checked my bag to confirm that I had the right sandwich and fries.

What I failed to do was confirm my fries were hot. I was irritated that I had cold fries to go with my hot sandwich but pressed for time, I let it go.

I did enjoy the spicy chicken sandwich from McDonald's. It had the right amount of sauce on it and a pickle.

Greek Lady is a great place for a late night meal since their kitchen closes at 11pm. I've spent quite a few nights getting takeout from here. The good thing is they're easy to order from and the quality is pretty consistent. Bad thing is you have to be careful to double check that they didn't make a mistake with your order. 

I always get the spinach and bacon omelette platter which is a hefty serving and pretty good. Just make sure you grab ketchup for the potatoes. I've also tried their gyro wraps which are also good. They're quite fun because they come wrapped with French fries. The chicken platter is also decent but definitely require ketchup to make up for the lack of flavor. 

All in all, Greek lady is a good place for a filling, quick meal.

Since they've allowed calling in orders ahead and more take out options, I've finally had the chance to try N50's. While there are plenty of other burger and cheesesteak places in the area, this place has a shiny exterior so you know it's new. 

I was recommended to try the milkshakes here, but my first time, I got a burger, spicy cheese fries and spicy nuggets. Paying and pick up was a little slow as there is only one person allowed in the store at once, but the order was done right as I got there and the food was still hot when I got to eat it. Solid burger, tasty french fries and the nuggets were real breast meat. Overall a tasty little late night meal, but the prices were a little too much for my liking, especially when the place across the street is more original and cheaper. N50's has the milkshakes though, with a huge variety so I will definitely be trying one of those at their new location in Port Richmond, but the food is just A-okay

Service was terriable took over 30 minutes for a order. And finally ask for a refund as  I watched people after who ordered after me. Get offered free appetizers and drinks. Guess customer service isnt a one of the top things with management.

I have been to East Coast Wings on multiple occasions and enjoy the wings and some of the staff.  After my last two visits I have decided I will not return.  This place seems to have a policy of not giving customers all of the change that they are due.  The waiters decide to keep whatever change, meaning coins, that are due to the customer after paying.  For example, on one visit my change that I was suppose to receive was $3.98.  The waiter, a latino male with a pony tail,  brought me back $3 and kept the receipt.  The next time I visited I had a guy named Khris.  Keep in mind this is a completely different waiter.  Again I ordered, ate, and paid.  Upon receiving my change I received $3 even with no receipt.  After waiting to see him again I didn't and flagged down another employee  and asked for the general manager.  Much to my surprise Khris came to my table and said he was the acting manager on duty.  I asked him if I could have a copy and he seemed surprised.  When I looked at the receipt it said that my correct change was $3.38, so I asked him where my 38 cents was.  His response was that he didn't carry change on his person. I politely told him that i would like the 38 cents that I was due. He smirked and retrieved my correct change.  Imagine of every check they kept the cent on each order.  At the end of the day that is a significant amount of money. On the other hand, imagine that they rounded each check up in favor of the customer.  They would be short at the end of each shift and be accused of stealing by the restaurant.  The same is true in regard to the customer.  IT IS THEFT FLAT OUT!  I WILL NOT RETURN!

Giving a two star review because although the staff are polite and I'm sure they're hustling, I've been sitting in the parking lot waiting for a meal I was told would "be out shortly" for a hour ago. I understand that the place is swamped right now, but not sure how it takes a hour+ to fry up some chicken nuggets, or why people who arrived way after me have been able to escape with their food much earlier than I am.

Place has really good food. I've had a few things off the menu from honey wings, Chinese donuts, general tso's shrimp. If you order over the phone prepare to still wait they start to box it up when you get there.

I ordered my usual today from the Chipotle down the street from job. I understand people are stressed out and stuff, but it was ridiculous today. I asked if I could get some red sauce, and was told it's extra. Maybe, but I've been ordering the same thing for months and never was asked to pay for it. 
When I asked, I was told by at least four different employees that I had to pay...that's fine, but everybody acting like they have stick up they butt was ridiculous!!

Don't be fooled this is not a real restaurant but instead one of those ghost restaurants. Just a store front which a kitchen upstairs and everyone is just getting takeout.

The vegetarian wrap needed more flavor from toppings or sauce. It felt like 80% of the wrap was just plain rice without any seasoning. 

The poutine was okay but being named poutine makes me expect fries with a lot of sauce and cheese on top instead we got fries and some toppings thrown on top. Overall tasked fine but the flavor was nothing special just fries with some toppings.

We ordered delivery from Aldo and Manny of a sampling of dishes because  I really wanted to do a thorough review. Luckily my eating partner in crime likes to share. We ordered, two slices of pizza one standard, one tomato pie type, 1 order of fries, a regular chicken cheese "steak" hoagie, and a slice chocolate cake. There's quite a bit left, we ordered too much food and it was all quite filling. Both the regular slice and the tomato pie slice are HUGE ( please see photos). 

Service: 5/5
The folks at A&M are all really nice. From Madeline on the phone  (yes like the children's book series) to the delivery man (who was very nice and exactly on time) everyone was sweet as can be.

Food:
1 slice tomato pie with cheese.4/5 (rounding up it's really a 3.5/5 read why...) if you want cheese it's a $1 more which is fine. But tLike other reviewers have commented, their tomato pie-sauce is very sweet. We both enjoy ALL types of pizza . I'd probably revise the sauce recipe for the tomato pie with or without cheese. It's far too sweet as-is and not chunky enough. The dough is crispy and a little thicker than their regular pizza 4/5
 
A slice of standard cheese pizza 4/5
This rating is based on a  bite (stolen by me) of a single slice of cheese pizza pie.I usually like reheated pizza better because I prefer thin, crispy crust. I agree with the other reviewers, the crust is nice and thin. It's light on the sauce and an average amount of cheese. It's a bit on the dry side but very edible for sure. Were I the pizza chef, I'd probably under bake the pies slated for single slice sales  and then finish it off during the reheat for the single slice customers. That would probably be the best of both worlds. I think the final product using that method would probably be a better quality product.

Fries 5/5
Though they came luke-warm, delivering hot, crunchy French fries packed to go in plastic or styrofoam container from over a mile away is virtually impossible . But as requested they did not add salt and after reheating for 10 min, they were perfect. 

Chicken cheese steak hoagie 5/5
You have to like tiny sliced/cubed chicken breast meat for this type of chicken cheese "steak" hoagie to work for you. The tomato and lettuce were very fresh, and the hoagie came hot on a scooped roll (as requested). The roll was the soft kind but it was definitely a hoagie/cheesesteak roll. I think the onions were sautéed separately from the chicken. We added our own mayo and sweet peppers. It was tasty, the meat was very lean but and wholesome and not the least bit greasy or wet. 

DARK Chocolate cake 4/5
This layered chocolate cake was moist, dark and rich and tasted like it was coated with espresso powder. My dining partner liked it but we both only had a few bites. It's not a huge slice but it's plenty to share and we left more than we ate.

Need to hire more staff!! It's not that busy now and we are sitting here WAITING took a while for the wait staff to take our order. Ran out of mushrooms while we were waiting for the order.... wait staff that was here was just standing around. They seriously seriously need to hire more staff or have better staff!! If you have a lot of time it's not too bad but if your hungry you'll starve before you get your food.

I usually order Greek Lady off of GrubHub, so I have only been to the physical restaurant a few times. It has always been extremely crowded, but the food makes up for the loud hustle and bustle. My favorite is their chicken gyro and chicken Caesar salad!

So far this location has treated me consistently well. The staff seemed to be strictly following safe COVID practices.
 I'm not sure if the honey salad dressing is made in house but I think this location has the best dressing.

Asian Chao is a dependable standby for faux-Chinese at Philadelphia International Airport (PHL). Even if there's a long line (and there seems to be, perversely), it moves quickly.

I usually go for the fried rice or noodles, and the sweet and sour or bourbon chicken. There's no hot oil, but they have hot sauce packets, perfect for coloring a meal crimson. Everything tastes as you'd expect, barely two steps above edible, nothing more.

Prices are usually atrocious - you're in an airport, after all - and if you're unlucky enough to be low on cash, they'll happily swipe major credit cards.

If this place existed outside the airport, they wouldn't survive a year.
Solid burger option in reading terminal for people in conferences nearby. Nite my first choice in the terminal, but a good options when lines are to long elsewhere.

Great burger place. The Mac and cheese is exceptional. I came here a while ago and it was crowded per usual. 

The quality of the Mac and cheese was great. The prices are a little on the high end but then again you're getting quality seafood in the Mac. The burger was cooked hot and cooked to perfection. 

If your a tourist, check this place out!!

If I could give this location 0 stars I would. They get in timed for how fast they get the food out, so instead of letting management know they suck they make you pull to the bottom of the drive to wait for 20 minutes for your food. At my last visit, all the cars ran out of room and we had to park at the repair shop next door. Four of us sat there like idiots waiting for an employee to walk us out our orders. They never get the order right either. Than you have an annoyed employee running back and forth while your food gets cold. Horrible service.

There is nothing Greek about this place.  To be fair, I had some pretty kick-ass Greek foods.  Yes, that includes Gyros.  I would give this place 2 stars, but I got grilled chicken kabob which is essentially impossible to screw up, BUT it could be more flavorful (i.e. marinate it with lemon, oregano, olive oil like real Greeks).

They're green beans was one of the foulest things I've seen.  It looks like cellulose that's been processed and pooped out... all dark and squishy and yuck and etc etc etc.   Lemon potatoes?  Sounded kinda good but NOPE.  Lemon soup aka avgolemono?  Two thumbs down.  Don't get me started on the gyro. 

Just because you have fries-stuffed gyro you can't name your joint anything Greeky.  That's just pure deception.  Only things marginally Greek about this place is their gyros (which were subpar) and spanikopita which they probably bought frozen at Trader Joe's and heated it up.  Gyro - I felt like I was eating a crappy burrito with mushy fries in it.  Not to mention, the staff are morons.  Cheers to idiocy.

A pretty good Chicken Breast Sandwich! I got it spicy and it was pretty fresh and delicious. I also got the sweet potato fries and chipotle ketchup - a great combo! I think that they did a good job keeping up with such a long line and getting food out quickly.

The first time I came to visit Philadelphia, I went to the Reading Terminal and this was the first place I ate. Probably because I wanted to keep it safe with a burger the first time, since there were so many different options that I got a little overwhelmed. 

I was starving by the time I arrived (due to touring all around Philadelphia by foot), so by this time "my eyes were bigger than my stomach" and I ended up ordering a single YO!LK BURGER, a side regular FRENCH FRIES, and a regular hot side of MAC N' CHEESE. 

The YO!LK BURGER (beef burger, American cheese, fried egg, onion ring, and chipotle ketchup) was amazing, a little greasy, but amazing. Probably because it had the gooey yolk running down everywhere adding the savory yolk flavor in every bite. My only complaint was there bun was a bit smushed rather than properly fluffed out as if they came stuffed in a bag. The onion ring was a little too greasy and kept sliding out whenever I took a bite of the burger. There was nothing too special about the FRENCH FRIES. They were shaped and fried perfectly. The MAC N' CHEESE was amazing (anything with a crapload of cheese is amazing). They didn't use American cheddar, but a different type of cheese that had a more delicate cheese flavor that landed well on the tastebuds. In the end, the only thing I was able to finish was the YO!LK BURGER. Like I said, my "eyes were bigger than my stomach."

It wasn't crowded when I came and the ordering process was efficient and fast. The food took a bit of time to get out but not too long.

This location is horrible! Staff rude and very nasty.  The hours of operation listed on the door state 10:30am- 11pm Monday- Friday. The staff did not unlock the doors until 11 am. No apology,  how can I help you, what can we do for you today.  Instead customers were greeted with rude and nasty attitudes. It does not matter where you work, or how much you get paid you should take pride in the service you are providing for people.

If you're ordering delivery from this chipotle, expect them to forget your sides. I've paid for countless queso and chips that never arrived. When I called it was the busy signal. No way to get a refund on the app. Disappointing.

Possibly had the rudest experience of my life and I was only inside of this store for maybe 5 minutes. After the rewards app wasn't working, I walked up to the counter to use the scan feature to get 99cent hot cakes and as this was my first time, I asked how I could order and scan. The woman with short, curly dyed blonde hair (she seemed like a manager) just looked at me dead in the eye and didn't tell me what to do, just said "I don't know what that is" while pointing at my phone. Okay, not much of a problem solver, I could tell. I had to figure it out myself and find the scanner thing hidden to the right of the cash register and I told her that I wanted hot cakes and medium fries. She rolled her eyes and input my order into the register, asking me twice more times which size of fries I wanted. She was like this with every customer in line that I saw, as if speaking words to her was offending her. She must've been having a terrible day because even when she passed me my food and I said thanks and asked if there was syrup inside, she rolled her eyes again and said everything should be in the bag in the meanest possible way. Really wish I asked for her name, but the way she was yelling around the kitchen to her coworkers and the way she was interacting with customers, I knew that would cause major issues. I'm aware that the place gets busy, but talking to the people working there was the most uncomfortable thing I've had to do in a while and there were only bad vibes. As soon as I left, I felt like I had to immediately wash my hands which says a lot. Bathrooms are usually grimey, fries are good though. Why do I even try with McDonalds? Stick to places with drive thru.

So I ordered from Twisted Indian Wraps. The delivery was really quick. I ordered- Butter Chicken Poutine, Chicken Tikka, and Samosa burger. 

The Chicken Tikka was full of flavors and has a good amount of seasonings and chicken worth the price for the portion and the burger was nicely cooked and has a good amount of veggies and sauces filled. 

The packaging was completely leakproof and food was warm when delivered. All items were very delicious. Surely gonna order again.

All I need to say is.... Lobster Mac & Cheese.. Creamy, dreamy, cheesy, savory goodness with generous amounts of lobster. Seasoned just right and baked to light golden. Yes, it's expensive. Yes, it's worth it and Yes, I'm going back on Saturday with my guy to get more.

Nice space, order at the counter and they will bring your meal. Got the Chicken gyro platter and it is a lot of food. Sides, roasted red peppers and lemon roasted potatoes, so delicious!! Chicken gyro and lentil soup just OK. Hummus very dry and absolutely NO flavor. Pass on it.

Their drive thru leaves you waiting at the bottom of the drive while they bring your food OUT to you leaving cars behind you angry that they can't get out. Meanwhile your food is not hot just lukewarm NOT going back!

Customer service and good food service is NOT this locations main priority. I am very unsatisfied with the service I received at this location and I will not be going back. I ordered a $5 meal just a couple of hours ago. The girl who packed the items in my meal was very rude and just said "here" as she dumped the back on the counter for me to get it and then walked away as if she did not care. 
When I went home I discovered that I had not been give a spoon or fork for my meal and that she had given me a small drumstick that did not look like a regular piece it looked like it belonged in a kids meal! 
I called and spoke to the manager Jamal who only excused the girls rude behavior, cut me off and yelled trying to over talk me over the phone. 
The management and some of the staff here needs to be retrained to say the least. They have no concern for the customers experience here and they seem to only be employing good customer service skills when they feel like doing so.

to commerate the 75th aniversery of the landings at normandy, my friends and i decided to eat a meal together to celebrate world war ii.  we trecked long and far to reach this eatery, and when we got inside we were ambushed by inefficiency and lackings of this burger king establishment.  i had ordered a crispy chicken sandwich and a whopper and presented my coupon for another free whopper which the guard violently rejected.  my throat was parched for some water.  however, the king cruely denied my request for quality hydration hours for the agreed price of free, so i was forced to get a fizzy beverage.  the king removed the ice and half the flavors, including orange hi-c my favorite non fizzy beverage.  so i was forced to get a vanilla doctor pepper.  fizzy. and gross.  my sandwiches came with splotchy tomatoes and white lettuce as a clear attempt to poison me, for his begining attempts on my life had failed.  as of the completion of this account of my audience in the court of the king, the poison has not fully taken over.  but the rumbling in my stomach tells me the first round of paratroopers are beginning to drop on my digestive d day.
OK food. Chicken is always burned. Food can be cold. Online order is on time after initial covic period.

Absolutely loved the food. It's authentic Indian street food with a twist. So many flavors in a bite. We tried Samosa burger, meat burger and the butter chicken bowl. Everything was delicious, can't wait to order again. They deliver which is perfect if you want some comfort food.

Wish I could give it no stars.   Will never go back.
Refused to refund my money after they charged me 2 times for the same item.   Wrote to corporate and they just said "contact your bank, we won't help".
Highest priced location in Philly, per clerk.
Filthy.  Tables covered in old food/drink spills.

I saw a feature about Twisted and bookmarked them as a place that sounded really interesting. The concept is Indian fusion mixed with Mexican food and it sounded absolutely delicious. They offer a variety of wraps, burritos, bowls, and even poutine with classic Indian flavors and dishes. 

My partner and I each ordered the super bowl which was such a great deal at only $15 you could choose 3 proteins and a base, and we were completely stuffed.  I got the butter chicken with chickpeas (chana) and saag paneer, topped with yogurt and the medium chutney.  My partner got the chicken tikka masala with beans (rajma) and saag paneer and yogurt as well, but with the hot chutney. The chutneys were nice and spicy and really added a great flavor to our bowls (the medium one was more herby in flavor, the hot was more peppery).  We tried each individually before mixing it all together, and each component was really delicious except for maybe the saag paneer, we weren't too crazy about as the cheese curds were very small. Overall, super pleased though with them! 

Our poutine was alright- ours unfortunately came without the cheese it was supposed to be topped with? We ordered a small kids' size just to try it because we were really intrigued, and we topped it with chorizo tikka, jalapeños, katchumber (cucumber, tomatoes, onions) and pickled onions. The fries were actually really great, nice and crispy and delicious but overall it kind of was nothing special, just fries topped with things. We should have in hindsight ordered a more curry based meat topping to make it closer to poutine. 

I would definitely recommend them as a quick bite / takeout place, I could see this being a great stop for a hearty lunch for anyone and it for sure gets huge bonus points for uniqueness!

Wow very shocked. I thought the place was supposed to be known for their ice cream flavors but their milkshakes were terrible. They just have a very chemical taste to them. We ordered 3 different flavors (one was vanilla even) and none wanted to finish them. I would not recommend getting any milkshakes. I gave them 2 stars bc I remember them having decent food in the past.

I can only speak for the pasta, but frankly I felt ripped off. It was bland and the chicken was dry. So underwhelming. And for 15$... ridiculous. The worst Italian I think I've ever had. The setup of the restaurant was also very confusing and shady. I only went because it was the holidays and every other restaurant was crowded. I haven't tried the pizza but maybe they should stick with that instead.  Yikes

Dayum!  I wish I had read my old reviews.  I got the schwarma - again pre-cut meat (at lunch - 11:50 AM) and bone-dry and COLD.  So I had a salad with cold, dry meat on top and threw away most of the meat.  Just icky.

I added some sauces and toppings but was told hummus is $.79 extra.  What???  And the have no baba ghannoush.

There are so many fast-casual Med spots (CaVa, Naya, Naf Naf) that I will not be returning to Zaffron.

Just skip this place and eat elsewhere in the Liberty Place Food Court.
There is a reason their line is shorter than the others.

Not happy.
Not happy at all.

0 STAR NASTY PIZZA NASTY FOOD YALL WILL GET SICK
Anywhere else should be better 
Worst food 
Stay healthy every one and read the other review

My office ordered from this Qdoba through Grub Hub. Not only were our orders wrong and not tasty, but all but one of us got very ill from this meal. It was the only thing we'd all eaten in common. The only person who didn't get ill, didn't eat guacamole, so that was likely the culprit. 

First of all, their page on grub hub doesn't match the menu on the Qdoba page. Therefore it was a pain placing the orders. The food did arrive within the confines of the 35-45 minute estimate, which is about the only good thing about this whole experience. I guess the credit for that mostly goes to the Grub Hub driver though. 

The food was tasteless and everyone's order was missing salsa or salsas that we had some specified on the order. Other various toppings were missing as well. Then three of us later had the worst stomach cramps I've ever experienced and some serious intestinal distress. It caused me and another staff member to have to take sick time to deal with it and recover.  

Moral of the story is read Yelp reviews of the specific chain location before ordering delivery. Other Yelpers have reported this store as unclean and posted photos of it; I also saw another report of food poisoning. It's too late for me now, but it isn't for you. Obviously, I won't be eating at any Qdoba's in the near future and am never going to this location again.

Ordered from this place on a whim because my girlfriend had a $25 uberEats gift card. Safe to say it was the best decision we could have made. This place is a hidden gem and I can't believe people have not heard about it yet. 

The food is delicious and so flavorful. I love the combination of Indian and Latin flavors as it is so unique. We ordered a mango lassi, aloo tikki burger, masala fries, and a naan wrap. I recommend trying all of them. We got all of that food for $25.

Walked past this place a bunch of times so I was excited to finally order a pie. I tried a large vegetarian pizza which included toppings of mushroom, onion, broccoli and peppers. The pizza was loaded with toppings and the crust was crunchy on the outside, soft on the inside. Overall good pizza, could do a little better on customer service.

This Chipotle has been super frustrating since the pandemic started. At the beginning of the pandemic, the portion sizes shrunk like they were trying to ration the food, the meat especially. That situation has gotten better, but one thing that has continued to remain spectacularly bad is the online ordering logistics. Every time I go, my food is ready at least 20 minutes after the app told me it would be ready. This usually means that it's taking 40+ minutes for them to prepare my order. Not sure why it would take this long given how quickly they prepare food during non-pandemic times.

The worst part is the chaotic pick up process they have going on. The entrance to the restaurant is usually closed until a worker comes out and mumbles the name of whoever's order is ready. Because it's so hard to hear with the City Ave traffic in the back and because everyone is hoping their overdue order is ready, the end result is a large group of people huddling around the entrance trying to figure out if their order is ready. I wouldn't be surprised if this Chipotle is the next scene of a covid outbreak due to the large gathering of hungry and frustrated customers outside of the restaurant everyday. City Ave Chipotle, please get your act together!

I absolutely hate this location. The customer service is trash and they never have anything. I waited in line tonight for 30 mins only to be told they were out of rice. How do you run out of rice at 8:30 but you don't close until 10? To add insult to injury one of the little smart asses serving food told me if I want rice I need to go to another location and made a sound when I walked away. I see why y'all have security. I bet these bitches would do their fukkin job without shit to say if he wasn't sitting there.

You have to order online but can sit inside and eat? How stupid is that. People that work here are super rude. Watched about 10 people leave because they were told they have to order online. Center city doesn't even make you do this

I have gone to this Pei Wei at least weekly since it opened, partially because I used to live near it on City Avenue but ultimately because I just love the food, the mandarin orange green tea, and it's a beautiful getaway from the City. I believe that Pei Wei makes the best Kung Pao (chicken/steak/shrimp/whatever) dish that I've ever had; I'm an addict of it and their unique teas. Now that I'm not living near it, I'm still returning for my weekly fix. It's a gorgeous, modern Asian interior, and it's fun to watch the fire spew up from the woks as they cook (oddly enough, I don't see that happen as much anymore for whatever reason).

That being said, the other reviews are right in that this location has seen better days in the past. They have had a few really endearing managers, hostesses, and food prep staff. But this location has had challenges in keeping quality staff, things stocked at the drink bar, or keeping up with the tables. This often happens to many City businesses, due to the more transient staff. Sometimes everything is perfect for a while, and it softens up occasionally. Hopefully more attentive management can keep it more reliable. And City Ave is inherently a rough place for a nice business such as this to survive.

But yes, I am a Pei Wei fan and I am always looking forward to my next visit! For a meat-eater like me, Pei Wei always gives a healthy portion of it; unlike other local competitors. Making the trek out here is worthwhile, as one cannot get as decent of value for the dollar at Center City places. 

[2017 Edit: Closed. It's a cryin' shame for City Ave to have lost one of its best restaurants. I'm at a loss without this place.]

I have to admit, Hunger Burger was actually cool. Such a wonderful addition to the area. Such an awesome menu, it was quite hard to choose, but I am really happy that I had Bello Burger. Team are very charming and service is really quick. Hunger Burger is pretty solid.

This chipotle is atrocious. Cant get a single online order correct ever.
Not only that, the fountain drinks have been empty for months - reminds me of the classic McDonalds "ice cream machine is broken"

Constantly botching online orders.
For example, bought the Big Mac bundle box today only to be missing both sets of large fries, watered down drinks, unfresh chicken nuggets, plain hamburgers instead of cheeseburgers, BBQ sauce instead of honey mustard and overcooked meat crumbs on the outside of the bun of one burger.
They do this all the time regardless of what the service is (UberEATS, DoorDash, etc). How hard is it to read an order from a screen and place said items out for delivery. They are the absolute worst. Do not order online from here at all

Well I liked east cost wings the first time my wife and I had drinks and ate. So today we decided to go back. They shorted us both on  our wings, we ordered 6 they gave us each 5. When I questioned the bar tender she said they can't count never discounted or even offered to take anything off the bill. Well this is the last time my wife and me will eat there again. People count your wings.

I only ate here once, and only got the Stromboli so I have no idea what their other food is like. The ends were good but the middle was really greasy, dripping grease and soggy. Great drunk food probably

THE BEST WINGS EVAA!! If you want amazing food and amazing service, dine here. The environment is inviting, the employees are fantastic, and the food is to die for. East Coast doesn't compare to other restaurants like Apple Bee's, Olive Garden, or Friday's. They win hands down!!

I love this place. I had the pleasure of getting the grand tour while my brother was working on their computer system.  The food is great and the place is extremely clean.
The sesame seed topping sounds weird for a pizza but you will never order it without after you try it. The chicken fingers are the best I have ever had.

What the F in the world?? If i could give 0star, that would be great because I ordered chips and Guacamole and since we can not dine in, I brought it to eat it at hotel and when I open the bag of chips and there's lethally about ten chips inside. How can i tell? Take a look at the picture. I never thought i would write review to franchise's restaurant but wow. This is way too shocking how I received about ten chips of bag for full prize when I can just go buy bag of chips for $5 at any store. Very disappointed. Just wow.

Miss almost every ingredient in both my burrito and my fiancé's tacos. The guacamole was brown. And the chip bag had maybe 20 pieces of chips. If you're low on item don't take orders. This was the last straw in a series of bad orders from Chipotle. And then they give us attitude because we have the audacity to make a complaint. I used to work at chipotle and this is beyond sub par. I paid way too much money to get a few pieces of chicken. I even paid for extra chicken knowing that they give small portions. We demand better service.

Beware! Unclean workers with dirt and grime under their fingernails! I have gotten the "subway shits" from this location twice. I've contacted corporate who were very apologetic and got me in touch with the local business owners who were rude and blamed me for getting. They said I "allegedly" got sick at their location and if I cant prove it I shouldnt be complaining to corporate about them. I contacted corporate again, and the local owners called me and harassed me on the phone. Is this how you run a business? Stay away!

Really good and really cheap! Imperial Palace is a neighborhood spot on Broad street that makes good food really fast and oh so cheap. 
When I order from here,  I order food that you order in the neighborhood,  not like you order in Chinatown.  
For instance, I order egg foo young here, never in Chinatown.  I  also order the spare ribs and rib tips, the Yat Me in, the fried chicken wings which are available in many flavors like buffalo and General Tos style.
There's nothing fancy here, just call in your order and get out,  and don't be thrown off if the guy answers the phone saying "Hello" , you got the right place.

This Burger King has got to be the worst. The WORST customer service. The WORST in the world in order correctness. The WORST!! Stay away. McDonalds ,Wendy's and Taco Bell are all up the street. Just spend the extra 5 mins to go there instead. Thank me later.

I came all the way from New York because it's been two years since I ate here. Honestly I'm so mad It was horrible I got chicken gyro  the chicken was rock hard on my first bite. So i started digging in it with a fork and it was just the most disgusting  dried out old chicken. I threw that straight in the garbage. That place lost is luster and taste buds. It's so unfortunately because I was really wanting this for awhile,

Training on basic customer service skills are and cleanliness are needed at this location.  The attitudes were absolutely horrible!! I asked to speak with the manager a blond female said she was the manager I explained the issue with my order and the behaviors.. She literally could care less based in her respond and no effort to rectify or address the issue.  I will never, ever visit this location.  I also plan to call the corporate offices!!! Horrible

My first time eating here, and I was completely disappointed! I was excited to see all the options for vegetarians while looking at the menu online, but when I picked up my order for takeout at home, the food didn't look as great as it did online. The taste of the food was very very bland, and each meal that we tried was extremely dry, with almost no sauce to mix in with the rice. The tofu in my meal was dry and tasteless, which was pretty disappointing to me. This will definitely be my first AND last time eating from this restaurant!!

I have been coming to this burger king for over 10 years and it sad to say the food quality has gone down drastically . The chicken taste different now I am not sure if the cook is cooking it correctly because the last 2 times going there my chicken has been chewy to the point it disgusting when eating it. I spent over 40.00 both times and disappointed both times I think the management needs to get on top of the food preparation and make sure the food is fresh and cooked correctly. I will not be back because the first time I was excusing it but I went back again and had the same issues . So I do not recommend this burger king

I haven't been in a while but I went last night to get a chicken cheesesteak for me and cheesesteak for my daughter. She loved it. She ate majority of the entire cheesesteak and I was impressed because she's so little lol and it was a nice size steak. I on the other hand ate half of my food and saved the other half for later. But it was good.

Wanted to try a Philly cheesesteak, and was also headed to the airport, when Yelp took me to Nifty's. Their service was friendly, the cheesesteak was good and their shake was AWESOME!! Definitely will have to go back if I go to the east coast again. Gave it 4 stars though because onion rings were not breaded and crispy enough.

The Greek Lady came recommended to me by a friend that went to Penn for undergrad. Walking in, it definitely felt like a place I would go to if I were in college. Cheap, fast, and relatively delicious food in large portions--what more could you want? We ordered our food at the counter, grabbed a number holder, and sat outside, where the waitress brought our food. 

I ordered the lamb gyro and my friend ordered the lentil soup and the 9 oz. steak sandwich with fried onions, tomatoes, and hot peppers. The menu had said "Lamb gyro and fries," so I had assumed that the lamb gyro would come with fries. Imagine my surprise when I found out that the fries were INSIDE the lamb gyro. It was an unexpected, but not altogether undelicious twist. The gyro had a generous amount of lamb meat, which was very flavorful. The pita, itself, was soft and warm. My friend enjoyed his sandwich, was at least a foot if not more in length, but didn't touch the soup. For a lentil soup, it was a bit lean on the lentils, and had a funny flavor to it. My friend said it tasted like mint, but I disagreed; we never did figure the flavor out.

All in all, I would come to Greek Lady again for a cheap and delicious meal. Next time though, I'll specify fries on the side!

I am giving this five stars but I think the service is slow. I've had to wait a while for some of my dishes and the whole pick up system seems a bit hectic.

I used to come here for their gyros only, and I thought the food was alright. Maybe 3 stars. I think the biggest problem is that it's large and the meat gets a bit dry, but that might just be what gyros are like.

However, the reason I'm giving this 5 stars is because the chicken tenders are amazing, but the fries are even better. The chicken tenders are really crispy and go perfectly with their honey mustard, which is kind of sweet and less tangy. The fries are very deep fried, and are super crispy. They remind me of really good cafeteria fries. They go soggy after a while like all fries do, so eat them fast. There is a lot of food too, and their chicken tender platter is actually pretty cheap.

Ordered a salad via Postmates. I called to check on the status of my order b/c it was taking a long time. Whoever answered the phone, put me on hold for two minutes and said that my order was on my way to me. This was a blatant lie just to get me off of the phone. My order was cancelled about 30 minutes later which probably was postmates fault and not the restaurant's. However, whoever answered the phone could have been honest and told me there was a problem with the delivery instead of lying to make me feel better. Now it's two hours after I ordered my food and I'm still hungry. Please be honest with your customers. Thanks.

I won't go here again. As just one example of my visit, the guy making my quesadilla burnt it and then decided he'd just flip it inside out so I wouldn't notice.  So I get an 'inside out' burnt quesadilla mess in my to-go container.  It's so dumb, it's funny i guess...

My girlfriend is a McDonald's addict, so I find myself here at 2:30 AM on a Sunday morning after last call way more often than I normally would.

And, you know what? Over the years, they've made steady improvements.

First, the place is cleaner than it used to be. Probably hard to believe, but they work hard to do it. It's rarely sticky in there anymore, even after last call when the worst ie drunkest clientele (myself included) of the night has come for their fix.

Second, the food is fresh. I can't remember once in the last two dozen visits that I didn't get fresh fries or where something came out cold. That used to be a chronic problem. No more issues. Great.

Third, and I can't believe I'm saying this, but nothing destroys the ghost of hangover future like a bundle meal. Two cheeseburgers, two medium fries, two Big Macs, and a ten piece nuggets for twelve bucks. That's so insane it shouldn't exist, like a seven sided cube or whatever Pinhead from the Hellraiser movies was.

Fourth, the staff is hella nice. I would not be as nice as they are at 2:30 in the morning serving my goofy, stumbling ass. The graveyard shift at the 40th and Walnut Mickey D's is a harsh mistress, but these kids are getting through it with a smile.

Kudos, guys. You've turned a new leaf.

Very few fast food places can produce quality service and food! This place does that times 10! Great service, great food, great people! You get your food as you order and the shakes are amazing! Highly highly recommended!

The food is ok whenever you get it of course. I have ordered from them three times over the past few months. The first time I ordered a salad, my salad was never delivered. The second time i ordered a salad they forgot to put my salad dressing in the bag. I called and they were very apologetic over the phone and promised to send the driver back right away with my dressing and never did. Again today I placed an order for deliver at 9:59 am to be exact and the driver called me at 12:26 pm letting me know he was here with my order (although when I placed my order, I was told my order would arrive by 11:15 /11:30) 2 1/2 hours for a local delivery of a salad is unacceptable. I called several times to speak to the manager and was left on hold for over 5 minutes but no manager ever came to the phone. I will NEVER order from Greek Lady ever again. Very disappointed!!!

This is a horrible place stay away.  Last night I went to here and I ordered a steak gumbo.  I returned home  and in a few hours felt pain in my stomach. Following this I threw up 5 times and had severe diarrhea. I do not feel like eating even today. It was horrible. I never want to eat at a Qdoba again
Employees were rude, inattentive, and were not wearing masks. Everyone refused to give me my order for carry out that I was already charged for.

Wow, it's a travesty that I have to leave a review like this. But understand this is only about this particular location and not Chick-fil-A as a company. I've been to Chick-fil-A's all across the world, coast to coast. 

If Chick-fil-A wanted to create an educational video on how a franchised store should not operate, this location would be the example.

Absolutely horrendous store. Offer online order only and love giving you brown guac. Constant issues at this store.   Its not the employees who works theirs fault. Its the manager and the Donkeys up top.

I would probably give Greek Lady four stars, if not for the slow service and inconsistent food.

I used to stop by Greek Lady decently often, but I stopped coming back after a few mediocre gyros--especially one time when I brought my visiting parents here. I recently tried it again, and the food seemed much better than before. The salads are humongous and consistent, but I'm not really a salad person, so I usually go for the chicken gyros. Sometimes the chicken is hot and succulent, and sometimes the chicken is cold and dry. The fries and vegetables stuffed inside the gyro make it pretty delicious (and this is coming from a picky person!). Furthermore, I've had nice lemon roasted potatoes and then overly salty ones. Overall, the portions are pretty large, and the prices are decent.

Beyond that, my biggest complaint is with the snail-paced service at Greek Lady. The cashier lines are generally reasonable. But when it comes to food preparation, I often wait at least 10-15 minutes for takeout here, and even longer when I eat in. They usually have a lot of customers (it's much nicer when they have outdoor seating, but otherwise it's pretty packed), but they also have a lot of kitchen help, so I don't understand why it takes so long... especially when the food sometimes comes out cold! Definitely set aside more time than you would expect when eating here. It'll be a hit or miss experience, but when it's good--it's great!

I came to Greek Lady for the first time about 7 years ago on a random summer weekend with my cousins, and I was blown away by how delicious my veggie gyro was - probably because they are one of the only places that puts fries in their gyros. 

Fast forward to present day, I came here a few days ago on a Sunday. I forgot that school was still in session, and came to realize it real quick when this place was flooded with college students eating breakfast at 12 PM. One group of college students were celebrating someone's 20th birthday here, so I got an age check thanks to them. Anyways, I ordered a vegetarian gyro and my BF got a lamb gyro. While the vegetarian gyro had most of the ingredients I wanted - lettuce, onion, tzatiki, fries, and feta - it didn't live up to my expectations. The pita was overstuffed to the point I had to take mini bites instead of wholesome bites. There were no tomatoes and no kalamata olives (!!!). A greek gyro without greek olives? How dare they?! My BF enjoyed his gyro, but neither of us finished our gyros so did he really like it? No one will ever know...

All in all, I've had so much better elsewhere and will not be returning to Greek Lady in the future.

Yet again I gontheu the drive thru the girl workin has ear pods in n is very ignorant when I'm taking to her she can't hear me bc I guess she's busy listen to her music‍ they r out of onion rings n certain sandwiches stop being lazy n drop the food they have a delivery truck man standing over the sandwiches with a tank top on n arm pit hair  that I can see when my husband asks why he's there she shook her head it's a Friday night at 10pm if we see her again working we will not come back she's ignorant n a bitch sorry but it's been multiple times or mayb she just dont like white people I wish I could give this location0 star

I would give zero stars if I could. Not only is the staff rude, it's just so disgusting and unsanitary. We decided to get takeout and we got there on time, however they were running extremely behind so we had to wait an extra 20 minutes. Once they gave us the order, it was literally so cold. Not to mention that it was watery and unedible. They refused to help us or make a new one. Look at the picture and see for yourself, this place is disgusting. I would seriously be worried about health violations, I'm going to gag. Get it together.

I couldn't even tell if the toast we would get here had whip cream or just sweet butter on it. Wait until we get to talking about our DC restaurant choices to notice the crazy influence you have had on my taste buds.

We ended a wild situation here once and I appreciate that six years later you've slowly but surely turned me into a better person. 

Huntsman Bridge Cafe: https://www.yelp.com/biz/jon-m-huntsman-hall-philadelphia?hrid=FMlTU--dMHhjcPzwpy4anQ&utm_campaign=www_review_share_popup&utm_medium=copy_link&utm_source=(direct)

That's right, brace yourself. You no longer have to drive far beyond the reaches of Philadelphia to get your Sonic Fix, they opened one up right in Port Richmond. 

I know, Port Richmond, but you don't have to drive to Bensalem anymore, HOORAY! It's right in the huge lot where they built a lowes on the corner of Butler and Aramingo. 

Shakes, Chicken-y things, Fries, FRITO PIES?@1?! Sonic makes every other fast food place it's bitch. I am going there as soon as this review is over, and you better believe I'm going to stuff my face. 

I leave you with this haiku:

When I am empty
You fill my heart with lime-aid.
Sonic you are great.

We dine at ECW at least once a month and we're never disappointed. The wings are consistently delicious and high quality. Large in size and full of flavor. 

This particular time we tried their burgers which were also pleasing-fresh off the grill and piled high. 

East Coast is especially great for watching the game as there are big screens mounted throughout the dining area and bar and no matter where you're sitting, you'll have a clear view of no less than two distinct games.

Waited 20 min for 2 cheeseburgers and 1 small order of fries. The cheeseburger was literally just the burger, cheese and bun. No lettuce, no tomato, no onion, nothing else. What a rip off. I'd rather go to shi*+y McDonalds and order from their Dollar menu.

My fave spot in Liberty! 

Prior to the pandemic, I used to eat here just about every day, Monday through Friday. Now whenever I'm in center city or have to go into my office, I make sure to stop and get lunch. So glad to see they're still open! 

My usual is either the spicy chicken on a wrap or the  lemon chicken on a salad. I believe their dressing is made in-house and it's the absolute best. I recommend their hummus as well, as long as you're a fan of garlic - so delish! 

Overall, Zaffron is a great spot for a quick and delicious bite. They're reasonably priced, especially for center city and the staff is so pleasant and efficient.

Horrible service, have no sense of time or urgency. They just let me order sit there for 10min and didn't do shit. It's actually a joke. I've waited 20min for the order and another 10min just to see my food sit there.

Greek Lady's Gyros are good and their baklava will blow away your expectations.

These are the only two things you need to know about Greek Lady.  

On the action-movie-parallel-satisfaction-scale, this restaurant is The Fifth Element.
It took over an hour for our order.  I understand you might be understaffed but then your facility should be honest and let the customers know the time delay.

I don't know if they hired 2nd graders to work here or what but these people apparently cannot read. They mess up my mobile order every.single.time. I've worked at a chipotle before I know it's not that hard to not put sour cream on a bowl that doesn't ask for sour cream. I thought this was common sense but apparently not to these people. Ridiculous!!!!

I wish I can give negative reviews. Every since this location has reopened it has been horrible. They mess up my order EVERYTIME!! You pay for one thing and they give you whatever they feel like giving you. The food is cold and lines are Always long. I hate this location & refuse to go back. Philadelphia mills location always gets the orders correct

I asked for just a cup of tap water for three times and the owner lady still gave  me a cup of Sprite. She knew that I was asking for water because she gave me a bottled water at first. She could have sold me a bottled water by just saying that she does not have tap water on the beverage fountain. At least she should know that people have reasons to ask for water when they don't want sweetened drinks. She probably never thought someone may post their unpleasant experience online because all passengers are busy catching their flights. But, this truly is not a good trick. I would like to remind people passing by this place.

I love Nifty Fifty's. A classic, traditional burger with all the fixings you want! They have the best french fries. I can count on the taste and quality to be consistent. This location is take-out only but they're not a fast food joint (I don't think they claim to be). I can agree with others as I've waited 20 minutes. I suggest ordering online ahead of time.

Lamb gyros and french fries, french fries inside of your gyro! Sandwiches, platters, lemon potatoes! What's not to love?!

I've eaten in, ordered delivery as well as catering for a work event. I've never been disappointed by the delicious food and service from Greek Lady.

You can't go wrong with the ol' gyro full of meat, veggies, french fries and an equally satisfying amount of tzatziki sauce. They have everything under the Mediterranean sun and then some (hoagies, cheesesteaks, etc) so you've got plenty of choices. I love potatoes so while my gyro already comes with fries, I also like to order a side of lemon potatoes as well. 

Get your Greek fix here!

I ordered a meal platter from this ghost restaurant; chicken tikka masala, channa, saag peneer. Let's talk about it...

First of all, this is supposed to be a MEAT platter. Where is it ? These few pieces of chicken with all that damn rice was all I got.

Now, I was told by the very courteous Uber Eats driver that they didn't have any saag paneer and to sub it with an other side. I requested just saag (spinach) if not, curry potatoes. Ummm, these green specks on top is spinach right? Mmm hmm, moving on...

The channa was horrible. Just flavorless like they took chickpeas right out the can, undrained, and sprinkled some garam masala in it. I've eaten channa plenty of times at Indian restaurants and it doesn't taste like that.

The curry potatoes made up for the tasteless channa somewhat. The gravy was flavorful but the potatoes were just like that chicken tikka... barely there.

This was not a pleasant experience at all. But on a good note, the 2 stars are for the naan and chutney, the best part of the whole platter.

Food cold and need to change their fryer grease as their tots tasted old.  4 of us eating and they gave us 3 napkins and 4 ketchup packets.  And if you're a customer and need to use the bathroom they will tell you that BOTH bathrooms are broken. When asked what they do for bathrooms they say they don't use them.  GROSS.  So either too lazy or nasty.  So be sure not to drink too much of their watered down soft drinks or you'll find yourself having to drive yourself somewhere else.  Not too family friendly when your kids can't the bathroom.

A+ wings.
Skip the other stuff.  It's fine and all, typical applebees-esque fare, but you're honestly coming here for wings.  They're too good.

Staff, please provide more milk to people doing the #10 insanity wing challenge, please.
I would have appreciated not having to wait for you to retrieve more milk from the back as I was slowly dying from 2 million heat units.
Better yet--ice cream.

I just had the worst experience at this Chipotle. I've been here several times and never experienced anything like I did today.
