I get there and I order a chicken and steak burrito bowl, they are out of fajitas and shredded lettuce. I also ask for a quesadilla and was told I had to order it on the App which makes absolutely no sense. I ask for a salad bowl, I'm told they don't have any vinegarette and ask if that's ok.. ughhh no it's not OK! I ask for tortilla chips ..they don't have any. I go to pay for my bowl I'm told they only taking cards no cash. Thank goodness I have plenty cards. I get back in line as I still don't have anything for myself. I ordered the chicken tacos, I asked for brown rice, chicken, tomato's , lettuce .. the young lady says umm let me check if we have more rice she goes in the back then over to the take out side and comes back and says we don't have anymore brown rice.. I said just give me the meat lettuce Tom as she's making it a young man comes out with a fresh tub of brown rice. I said there goes the rice right there.. she says you want me to put it on the side ? I say no JUST CANCELLED THE WHOLE THING .. like what the heck is going on at this location? It's dirty and unorganized, and not supervised.. worst experience I've ever had at chipotle!
not because the pizza didnt taste good but because this place is ghetto, loud and most importantly didnt even slice the damn pizza.

I stopped over at Cafe Spice to fill a craving I had for Indian food while at work.  I usually order from Tiffin in KOP, but was quite pleased with my order.  It was definitely "A-OK."  

The line moved quickly, which is a huge plus when you're on a fast lunch break.  All meals came with a large portion of rice plus your choice of 2, 3, or I think 4 was an option "sides" or meats.  I ordered the Chicken Tikka Masala and Paneer.  

The order also came with fresh Naan.  Their Naan compared to others I have had was a little flat and a bit crunch.  I really like to be able to "bend and scoop" with my Naan and this was just past that.  

All in all, the price is great (I think 8.95 for HUGE portions - I didn't even finish mine), the flavors were pretty good, and the service was fast.  There actually aren't a lot of take out Indian places near my office (That I'm aware of...) so this is a great filler when I want that warm, filling feeling from my favorite Chicken Tikka Masala.  I still prefer Tiffin, but if it's not here, this will do.

My absolute favorite pizza store in port Richmond.  The French fries are amazing.  The pizza always gets great reviews but I don't really like pizza so I'm not good to judge this.  But if you want good French fries at least, go here!
Called ahead for my order, and still waited an hour and half! Then I didn't even receive the correct items. Food is average.

Eat here!!! I was in the area and saw a sign for this place so I decided to try it. It is worth the drive to this area. 

They have 75 different types of wing sauces so the menu is a little overwhelming. The good part is they have lots of other items such as salads and burgers.

I was just in time for a GREAT LUNCH SPECIAL. It runs from 11:30 to 3:30 pm(roughly). It was $7.99 for 6 wings, a side salad and a soda. Keep in mind, they do charge you $.99 for the sauce. I think thats ridiculous but whatevs. I had the Kamikaze which was ABSOLUTELY AWESOME, MAYBE THE BEST WING SAUCE I HAVE HAD. (Other than silk city wings of course). It was sweet, complex and spicy on the backend.

The salad was really good with bacon, cheese and all types of crunchy stuff. 

My server was awesome and the food came out fast. I also liked that there were other servers who walked by and helped out as well (without asking) when I needed a refill.

Ah yes, the well-known campus establishment known as Greek Lady. My first encounters with them were positive, but it's been all downhill from there.

I am constantly amazed to find Greek Lady's seats filled for lunch or dinner. While they do present a different kind of fare from a Chipotle or Qdoba, the quality is only decent and the service is inconsistent. Each of the last three times I have been there, I have had to wait upwards of 20 minutes for my food. With a place that offers takeout as an option, that is just inexcusable for the in-house patrons. The location is the greatest boon to this restaurant, but I'd much rather walk a few doors down to HipCityVeg or to any of the excellent food trucks right across the street.

I just went in for an online order and the 3 people who work there were being hounded with waaaayyyy too many orders. So, yes the wait was long, like 30 minutes late for online orders. I blame something about the ordering system for this because the people working there were clearly working so hard, while also somehow managing to be so patient, so kind, and I just wanted to say thank you - especially to the gentleman with short dreads working the register  - I biked home just meditating on how kind and patient you were with the woman standing at the front berating you about how to use the chipotle website to cancel her order and you telling her without stress or any harshness whatsoever, in such a nice way, "I really wish I could help you but I simply can't right now." I was deeply touched by that. Made me want to apply to work here to be blessed with some kind and patient coworker relationships. Thank you!

Manager was very rude and argumentive.   
 I asked for 2.woppers on Wopper Wed @ $2.00.  Charged me full price for one and took off $2.00 one the other one..  why  ????   Poor customer service

I was just there bought 4pcs chicken for $7.55 she just gave me 4 tiny wings 
The popeye at Girard is away better

Go to MCDONALDS INSTEAD!!! 
I live 1 block from this BK and I would rather drive 30 minutes to a different one. DO NOT GO through the drive thru!! Only MORONS work here and I GUARANTEE they will totally F*CK your order up. In fact, it won't even RESEMBLE what you ordered.  I think the manager gives bonuses for the worker who messes up the most orders. Seriously, the last 3 times I went here my order was screwed up all 3 times. I don't understand how one fast food restaurant can have this many idiots working under one roof. There's even a screen that tells them what I ordered. I guess none of these people can read? It's ASTOUNDING. But Kudos to the Manager!! You did GREAT with hiring top notch workers!  TOP NOTCH!!  
If I could give negative stars, I absolutely would. MORONS.

Brendan and Becca: 

Made a quick stop here on the way to the Cinemark on Walnut to see Black Panther. We both got Chicken Gyros. They're delicious and the portion is pretty large, all for a fairly reasonable price. We would prefer that the fries not come directly on the sandwich, but that's not a huge deal. 

One of the drawbacks about Greek Lady is that their soda machine is the type where you choose from a huge menu of sodas all on a touch screen and then it mixes it on demand. These seem great because there are so many options, but then you taste the soda and realize that the cost of having so many choices is that none of the sodas really taste right. Even basic Coke doesn't come out right.

Otherwise, Greek Lady can be pretty loud, but it's not huge deal. 

Overall, a great quick dinner . Would recommend it if you're in University City and in the market for a dependable dinner joint.
best pizza i've ever had in my life. seriously so good and the staff here are so nice. they really care about their community too.

This Chipotle location wasn't getting much love in its early days, but my experience for lunch on Monday was solid. I arrived around 12:45 and the line was short. I noticed all the tables in the restaurant looked like they had been recently cleaned. 

The first employee I encountered was the woman who made my bowl. The construction of said bowl was a little bit sloppy but I did notice she was careful to drain salsas which is crucial in avoiding a liquidy mess. The next employees were the cashiers, who were friendly. 

My bowl was spot on for what I typically expect from Chipotle. The condiments area was also well stocked, clean and organized.

We ate at the Greek Lady before but we ordered for delivery for the first time. The order of Gyro, hummus samples and Chicken fingers came quick, and easy transaction. All of them were fresh and delicious. I can tell they made them on premise, no frozen stuff. I also recommend their cheese cake, so creamy!!

This place is ATROCIOUS. I had a group order for people placed 8 hours before the pickup time. I was told that the location was closed as they finished making our food, and that there were zero chips or guac or queso left for us even though the order was placed FAR in advance. What's worse, almost none of the orders were correct! Chicken was replaced with barbacoa, an entire burrito was JUST rice, and countless other errors occurred. A terrible Chipotle, one that should not be trusted for anything but the most simple orders. Will be looking for a refund and will not ever go back  again.
Portions were terrible and all the food is old. Refused to let me wait for fresh rice and meat. Especially since they increased the prices. Will not be back to this location.

I went here per my friends recommendation to check out the fresh new location. I got the $5 dollar big box which was a steal. You can either get two pieces of chicken (upcharge for breast) or three tenders, two sides, and a biscuit. For 5 dollars. You can also add a drink for an extra dollar. Chicken was fresh and sides were good. Service was also really friendly, and the only negative was the slowly service (they were pretty backed up during the lunch hour)

Worth checking out if you love that Louisiana fried chicken. Definitely try the spicy since it has a nice kick. 

Enjoy!

I ain't no Greek, but I've been several times to Greek lady. And what's better than cooking great greek food? Eating great greek food.

Greek Lady at-a-glance:
- Generous portions.
- Quick-service.
- Reasonable prices.
- Greek Appetizer Sampler. Tasty and enough for two.
- Delicious grilled salmon.
- Flavorful chicken gyro, on homemade fresh, warm pita from the oven, with tsatziki sauce, lettuce tomatoes, onions, and french fries. French fries? Think weird? it's not always so!

Last word:
Me: .... , and one sweet Greek coffee, please?
Cashier: We don't have Greek coffee! 
Me: You don't have Greek coffee in your Greek restaurant?!!
Cashier: Sorry miss. All we have is Nescafé.
ME: Say whattttttttt.

Four solid Yelps.

Hunger is located in the Reading Terminal Market. The market itself is very busy with tons of shops and stores. Hunger Burger had a nice variety of burgers. We ordered our food and it was ready in less than 10 minutes. We were able to get a table right in front of the restaurant. We would definitely eat here again.

Don't. Just... don't.

I know it's 2 am. I know you're drunk. I know you want chicken nuggets and a shake so you can throw up later and wonder why the hell you would "ever have a milk shake after 15 beers but it seemed like a good idea at the time."

But, do yourself, and the overwhelmed staff of the Mickey D's at 40th and Walnut a favor, and just don't.

You'll wait in line for way longer than it takes to microwave the leftover burgers they're going to serve you, mostly because some jerk in front decided to order some item that no one goes to McDonald's for - items that I like to call "McOrder something else, asshole." 

Also, late at night, the dollar menu - drunk food ambrosia - is off limits after whatever hour when it happens to matter the most. 

Also, there's Crown Fried Chicken like, 2 blocks away, and they're AWESOME after last call.

Why did I not review anything about this place during the daytime? Because if you're here (sober) during the day, you need to re-evaluate your life choices. 

You've been warned.

Upside: if all you want is some fries, they are up to snuff.

The food is extremely average, they have a decent variety, which is nice, but it's convenient.

The service is embarrassing. It takes ages for the food, and the staff act like they're in summer camp. They just fool around while not attending to the food, and when they FINALLY get you the food, they act  like they're doing you a huge service. It shouldn't take them 40 minutes to put together simple meals. I still go often for the convenience, but time and time again am waiting 35+ minutes, when it's not particularly busy, and the "chefs" are playing paddy-cake in the kitchen before they get to my food.

If you look closely, it says "The original Hunger Burger est. 2015." Not so original, I'd say. In fact, it's a painfully obvious rip off of Shake Shack, except it's not at all as tasty.

The best part was the chocolate malt shake and even with that, I couldn't taste the malt. I got the philbert burger, cheese fries, and regular mac and cheese (only because the lobster mac and cheese was $5 extra, making it a whopping $10 for a SMALL).

Philbert is just a burger with bacon, tomato, lettuce, and cheese. Nothing special and the bacon wasn't physically edible; way too tough. The first thing I noticed was that my tomato was freezing cold and the burger was warm - it didn't sit right with my senses. The "cheese fries" weren't great either; the cheese was runny (it actually spilled all over my sweater) and tasted like some kind of extreme salty salad dressing? Very off-putting. Last but not least, the mac and cheese was dry and not as creamy and delicious as I would think most macaroni is. Just seemed obvious that it was sitting out for a while, but I'm sure glad I didn't get the lobster mac. Without the malt, everything came to nearly $19 and it was not worth it. For $10 more dollars, I could go to fogo de chao and have a feast until my stomach hits the floor. Never again.
I had a pizza delivered on Wednesday night and it was hot and on time. Pretty good too; not the best but it's good. I would order from them again.

A lot of people ask me how I'm going to give this Mickey D's four stars. Bear with me.

Sure, the first impression isn't so great. Once you push your way through the panhandlers to the front door, you're assaulted by a wee bit of a funky smell. That is the smell of grease, so toughen up, snowflake. That's what you came here to put in your body, so I don't want to hear any complaining.

Sure, the second impression isn't so great either. It's a wee bit messy, sometimes fights break out, and on occasion it's packed with inebriated white people and those two guys playing chess in the best booth. But you're not here for the ambiance, buster. And don't pretend like you were, because if that were the case you you wouldn't be reading Yelp reviews of a McDonald's franchise.

The third impression, however, will catch you so off guard that had this been D Day, you would have let the Allies take over the whole damned beach before you even realized what was going on! The staff are unbelievably friendly. I'm talking smiles, I'm talking accommodating weird orders, I'm talking making recommendations when you're overwhelmed by the menu. This is pure conjecture, but I'll bet you a four piece McNug that if you had a flat on the side of the highway, these are the suckers that pull over and make sure you're okay.

Here's the kicker. The food may not taste that great, no. But the calorie to dollar ratio is simply unbeatable. Download the app, and if you pick the right deal, you could be looking at 1200cal of protein and fat for less than five dollars. Try getting that kind of deal at Chipotle next door and they'll laugh in your face while you're being gurneyed out on account of norovirus. None of that at McDonald's, their meat is fortified with the best antibiotics money can buy.

At this point you're probably asking, well Jesus what does it take for this guy to give out five stars? Good question. I'll grace you with an answer. The ice cream machine is always broken.

I keep hearing about Aramingo's Best.  I'm a Franco's guy.  My wife and I got some killer bud the other night and I was high as hell and it dawned on me....let's try Aramingo's Best.

We got the upside down pie, well done.  Dude!!  This was better than Franco's.  It was crispy, the sauce was excellent and it was actually well done.   We also got some wings and they were tasty too.  The food came very fast.  

I was really stoned, so when I got up the next day, I had some cold pizza for breakfast.  I was thinking to myself, "was i just super high and that's why this pizza was so good"?   No...it was just as delicious.  I will be trying this place again, for sure!

As always food is delicious and served quickly. HOWEVER, WHERE IS THE REST OF MY MEAL??? I did not pay 7 dollars for a bowl that was not even a quarter full. When ordering online, I am frequently underwhelmed as I often receive my bowl without all of the ingredients and requested and paid for. Is it so much to ask for the food I paid for and a decent serving? I think not.

Came here a while ago for a quick bite before getting on the road and I'd say it was definitely a longer wait than fast food, but well worth it. Ordered at the pickup window.

Overwhelming variety of soda flavors - like, I panicked and picked basic ass cherry vanilla because there were just that many choices - but if you research ahead of time you'll be good. 

Hotdogs were fantastic. They had that crunchy bite on the skin, and a really good bun. Fries were BOMB. I can't explain the seasoning, but they were heaven. I devoured the whole large cup in a matter of minutes in my car. 

Prices are decent. Would definitely return.

Greek food meets American diner food at Greek Lady, a bustling restaurant that's become a staple of University City. Their best dish is undoubtedly the Gyro Sandwich, and I still remember being so surprised to find French fries IN the sandwich the first time I had it! There were three selection of gyro meats, each carved from a rotating spit: lamb, chicken, and the House Gyro, made with marinated layered pork. A chewy pita bread was spread with a layer of thick, creamy tzatziki, which provided the perfect contrast to the crispy gyro meat and the hearty fries, and the fresh veggies (lettuce, tomato, onion) topping it off provided a refreshing bite. The gyro sandwich platter also came with two sides (I had the roasted red pepper and the green beans stewed with tomatoes), as well as a Greek salad made of lettuce, cucumbers, tomatoes, green bell peppers, red onions, and oregano. I also got their appetizer sampler plate, which came with a selection of dips including a dry, grainy hummus, more tzatziki, four dolmas (stuffed grape leaves), and my favorite, the Feisty Feta Dip, made of briney feta mixed with herbs and beaten into a spreadable paste.

The employees suck
The service sucks
The food sucks
The store is dirty

Ordered a spicy chicken sandwich and a chicken sandwich combo. Gave me a sandwich made with 2 chicken tenders instead of a spicy chicken filet.  The regular chicken sandwich was made properly with a chicken filet. The fries were underdone and soggy. Went online to share my feedback and they never gave me my validation code. 

Skip this location and go to the one on S Broad st

Ordered takeout from Greek Lady for dinner after passing by on a walk. It met expectations in that the value for the price was quite good and it had some highs and lows - though many of the lows could be improved. We ordered a lamb gyro platter, a chicken gyro platter and a salmon platter. The lamb gyro was fairly typical, the meat was really nice and shawarma-like and there was a generous amount of it. The pita was a little disappointing but that may be a result of takeout rather than eating in. The salmon was a little dry and would have benefitted from some seasoning. The broccoli was BEAUTIFUL and well cooked, but also would have benefited from some seasoning - even just garlic salt. Mash potatoes were great. All in all, very good value for hungry people on a Saturday night in a pandemic.

Once again, I'm amazed that I managed to not review a place that I go to at least once every other week.

What can be said about Greek Lady that you don't already know? Probably not a whole lot, but whatever. 

In my experiences with various delis, flat top shops, and street meat purveyors, Greek lady really does do a gyro right. They fill up a warm pita with more meat than you likely thought you could, top it with fresh lettuce, tomato, red onion, fries, and tzatziki that's on the creamier (ie more delicious) side. I either go for the lamb or the house special, which I believe is pork. It's not as juicy as the lamb but makes up for it with spices galore. You can also ask for a mix of the two. 

That's not all though - try their sides! I tend to go with broccoli and lemon roasted potatoes, but pretty much everything is good. If I'm feeling heart-attacky, I'll order up some cheese fries. They're quite bacony.

All-in-all, delicious.

Pro-tip: Everything here is HUGE. Be prepared to have to take out your left-overs. Sharing is not frowned upon.

king george iii of england was a kinder king to the american colonies than this burger king was to us.  twice now, the king has shut his endless supply of food off to his royal subjects.  we must end this monarchical system of power abuse before more victims are starved, listening to the unapologetic robotic voice at the drive through telling you they are "closed.".  revolution is in the air

Pizza was promised to be delivered in 30 minutes.  It took approximately over an hour.  Of course, pizza was cold.  Additionally, when I called the establishment to see the status of the delivery, the employee responded "I don't manage deliveries."  Very unprofessional and customer service was poor.

Additionally and more importantly, the quality of the pizza is subpar.  Crust seems pre-bought or pre-made.  Much better pizza places around the area.  Will not order again.

Best mom and pop Chinese food in the city! Everything is flavorful but the fried chicken wings are amazing just plain but you can customize to your liking with salt, pepper, ketchup etc. The shrimp and broccoli, wonton soup and fried rice are all also really good. Perfect after a late night . Easy street parking on broad but they also have a small driveway type parking lot on the right side of the store. Closed on Sundays since the pandemic started.

This location is horrible! Garbage everywhere, staff barely speaks to you, food is inedible! Stay away from
This one unless you want get salmonella poisoning. You are seriously taking a risk by eating here. We threw ours out!

All the previous 1 and 2 star ratings are appropriate. This location, tucked into an awkward corner under a Target parking structure, is hit or miss as far as food and service. 

I've been several times as I've never had any real issues with the quality of my meal. During my first visit I asked for a burrito bowl - with a little lettuce. The woman taking my order retorted "a salad." I said, "No I just want a little lettuce, not much." She continued (in a very sassy way) "If you want lettuce, its a salad." Given my nature I could have gone back forth forever holding up the line and arguing the point that there is only the difference of semantics here, no change in price, ingredients or add-ons. I did not. I let a Chipotle worker have her day and continued on down the aisle. 

During my next visit I noticed that the delivery orders are being fulfilled from the same station as the walk-ins. This means that the employees squinting to reading orders from receipts are obstructing the movement of the employees taking orders from the customers standing in line in store. This is quite awkward. The beautiful part about Chipotle is the ease of ordering. Point, Shoot, Pay, Fill water cup with Soda lol. When the person fulfilling my order cant scoop my guac because someone else is using the guac spoon (even though its my turn and ive been waiting in this long @$$ Chiptole line), its bothersome. The many other locations I've been to have a separate station for online/delivery orders. As they should. 

On another visit I wisened up! Ordered online for pick up, parked, noticed a shockingly long line and semi full seating area overwrought with children. I saw the Panera style online order shelf and swooped in to grab my meal. My cup was in the bag so I swung around to the drink counter and filled with Mr.Pibb. I was out the door in under 4 minutes with a line of people staring longingly at me. A champion. The Lance Armstrong of Chipotle. 

Again, I've never had any issues with the quality of food like some other reviewers indicated and this may have something to do with the times in which I visit this location. But my advice to anyone reading this. Order online for pickup. They dont deliver fountain drinks and the bottled drinks are robbery.

This place is worth your hard-earned cash with portions that more than adequately meet the affordable prices. Yup, the gyros have fries in them and pretty much always taste the same. They are not the best gyros ever, but they have fries in them. The buffalo cheesesteak is the best! Nothing here is very healthy, but it's worth the bigness of the food item.

I've recently discovered Qdoba and, for fast and relatively cheap fast food Mexican, I'm a fan. You can get a salad in one of those delicious crunchy tortilla bowls (just tack on 465 calories for one of those bad boys) or nix the bowl for a healthy meal. 

There are several options for protein and two different types of veggies (grilled and fajita style). There are many types of salsa. I love options. I love Mexican. I'm loving Qdoba.

Here's hoping I can resist that delicious queso.

I will start by saying I am a true Chipotle customer. I will find a restaurant anywhere I am. This location however, seriously needs new management or something. It's unbelievable how they lack professionalism, sense of urgency or anything for that matter especially now during this COVID time. 
     I frequent this location because it's near my job and home. It's gotten to the point where I'm willing to drive further to go to another Chipotle just because this one sucks. Examples of how they need new management...one, seems like they pick and choose when they let you order inside or online only. Two, the whole purpose of ordering online is to have it waiting for you upon arrival, NEVER is. Today, I was one of the MANY people anxiously waiting on employees who not only took their time but carried on with their personal conversations while the store was almost filled of people waiting. A line formed for people to order inside while an employee was setting that side up at 12:30pm. Mind you store opens at 10:45AM! Someone saw the line form and yelled with an attitude "ONLINE ONLY" while he was preparing food in the back. 
      Before I came I ordered my food online at 12:00p and got there at my promised time 12:30p. I waited in there until 12:50 for food. Not only did they make it super late but they didn't call out orders made or put them in the spot people are supposed to pick up so it sat and sat. Finally I walked over to check the bags along with about 10 other people hovering over bags trying to leave. I honestly don't know how this store is ran under these conditions with it seems like no concern for customer service. 
     Overall, I'm done with this location and toxic relationship we seem to have. I'm not the only person who experienced this kind of behavior let alone pay for this service. Hopefully this review reaches who it needs to so these issues can be addressed.

I should be able to give zero stars on here! And I usually Yelp before I order but it's McDonald's right? Again I was wrong for not following my instincts! Like you guys have one job! That's it! And I get it it's hard sometimes but when someone orders a damn burger and asked for no ketchup?!?! What's the hard part of this especially when I just ordered that and nuggets and I didn't even get a damn bbq sauce! I threw my food in the trash because not only did it have ketchup it was ice cold! And not only did I say no ketchup but it was all over the box! My gears have been grind and I'm over it but next time no ketchup please.........

I am highly upset. The manager here is rude. My order was wrong, I called and he offered to remake but I had to pick it up. I don't drive so I had it delivered, told me they couldn't redeliver. Then over talked me and said they'd issue a refund, then hung up on me. I am not ordering from this location ever again. Not only was my order wrong, they didn't send the extra dipping sauces I paid for. I have contacted corporate as well. No paying customer deserves to be hung up on.

This is hands down the WORST location of Chipotle I have EVER BEEN TOO. Not only do they have horrendous customer service, and hang up on you when you call with a question about an order but they DO NOT EVER GET THE ORDER CORRECT. All but 1 of the times I have ordered through the app, and even when ordering in person I waited 90 minutes for a cheese quesidilla. In NO RIGHT WORLD SHOULD ANYONE WAIT THAT LONG FOR A QUESADILLA. This part needs to be mentioned aswell because it is literally a DAY CARE. The one time I walked into the chipotle to pick up an order there were kids running around, and lounging at the tables with their feet up while their parents were screaming at them from the other side of the counter while they were preparing an order. SHAME ON THE MANAGERS FOR ALLOWING THIS AND SHAME ON CHIPOTLE CORPORATE FOR NOT GETTING THEIR ACT TOGETHER AND RESOLVING THIS SITUATION. I WILL NO LONGER GIVE MY MONEY TO A COMPANY WHO DOES NOT CARE ABOUT THEIR CUSTOMERS IN ANY WAY SHAPE OR FORM.

Pei Wei is basically a sort of diner that serves contemporary Asian food. You place your order and pay at the front counter, then take your number and sit down. It's nicely decorated and the music playing overhead is nice lounge music while you eat. It's also pricier than other food court type of places, with entrees starting at 7 dollars or so. 

I actually got alot of my screenwriting ideas while sitting in Pei Wei because of the cool atmosphere and music. 

The food ranges from alright to great. best. One bonus about this place: they offer brown rice for health freaks for free. But when I want to substitute noodles instead of rice, there is an extra charge.
The manager is very nice, the counter girls are a little rude but I guess this can be expected since they are not working for tips.
T
he place is bright, clean, with an open kitchen and they bring the food to you quickly.  It's a quick and cheap alternative to take out, if you actually want to sit.

This is the single worst McDonalds and restaurant I've ever been to. The employees are super rude and the wait time will always be 30+ minutes regardless of how full the restaurant is. I cannot stress how terrible of an experience getting food at this MCDonalds is. This is one of my rare Yelp reviews purely because of how awful the service is. Please change management.
This is unacceptable. I choked on plastic this morning, and then I looked to see if there was anything else wrong with my sandwich, I noticed there as plastic all around the egg.

Came here for the first time with my boyfriend on sunday service was great our server chris was very nice came back and checked on us frequently.i ended up ordering the bangbang sweet chili wings they were crispy and delicious. i also ordered the mac n cheese burger so good! My boyfriend got the cowboy burger and honey bbq wings everything was great from the service to the food i will be back here for sure!

Glad a new spot has opened up in Schmidts. It's a small airy industrial feeling space.
Similar to many other bowl concepts you pick your base, protein, and you get a deep friend mandoo with your order.
I got the japchae (clear noodles) as my base. The beef bulgogi was good but the spicy chicken was more awesome. He put our food in these deep paper containers--the size is great for the price but then all the sauces start sinking to the bottom and not mixing very well... so my noodles and bulgogi got very garlicky and salty by the end. (Also for some reason the chicken bulgogi bowl was filled much more than my beef one?!) 

I do like the grab and go beer option as well as the awesome pastry selection. I wish it were more Asian style (see: my love for Paris baguette by hmart) but I had the red velvet cupcake in a jar it was was swell. It wasn't too sweet--which is really how I like my cupcakes.

Love the concept but the execution is going to need some time to smooth over.

I went to this spot to get a two piece chicken. Have been going here for a few years. Chicken was always good. Chicken was boxed by manager Got home chicken was old and dark and extremely small. Called back manager had left employee informed come back next day would replace. Went in and spoke to manager who became extremely rude, indignant and insensitive to what had happened and we are talking two piece. It was horrific and terrible  it was unbelievable. I asked for my money back. Do not go to this Popeyes. You do not know what you will get and in this case the customer was not right and from his attitude never will be. Disgrace for a manager. 
327 Spring Garden Street. Please remember this address.
Worst chipotle I've ever been to.  Employees are awful.  Literally nothing positive to say.  If there were one closer to me, I'd choose Taco Bell over this location every time, and that's just sad.
That was the best customer service I had on the phone in a long time. Let's see how the food is when I head over to pick it up.
Just ordered an 8 piece and got 5 wings in the box.  Also the 2 girls behind the counter severely lack communication skills.

I like stopping by Greek Lady for their affordable breakfast menu, under $10. A breakfast platter with three scrambled eggs, toast, and your choice of either mixed fruit or home fries will cost you just under $8. They also do solid pancakes and French toast. This food you could cook at home, but you'll come with a friend on a day you don't want to do dishes, and sit comfortably in one of their large booths.

P.S. Their French fries are pretty delicious too

I am not one to post negative reviews and am very understanding that COVID has changed so much for restaurants, but this Chipotle is laughably bad. Like many others, I love Chipotle but this location is actively trying to ruin it. I've been blessed to work from home during this pandemic, so I often order lunch in from local places. I'd say 5 out of 6 times Chipotle gets my order wrong. I think after today I'm finally done. The bowl I got was no where near what I ordered that I checked to make sure it had my name on it. Sure enough it did, they just completely disregarded what the order was. And don't even get me started on trying to go in person - an utter waste of time (almost 1.5 hours last time) and still wrong, with rude workers on top of it. 
As much as I love Chipotle, they've lost me until they completely change this location.

This is most definitely the most disappointing Chipotle that I've been to. The order frequently gets messed up when I order through the app - I don't get double meat, or the vegetables are missing in a VEGETABLE bowl (i.e. NO MEAT/Sofritas!). The vegetables here are typically chopped into really thick strips that end up not being cooked fully. Last time I came here, I was given a meager amount of vegetables in my VEGETABLE bowl and barely half a scoop of guac in that bowl. The guac I've gotten has also been brown a few times.. I've given this location MANY chances, because it's the closest one in the area, so know that this review is a cumulative review over the two years of living near this area and ordering from this Chipotle. Truly disappointing.

Fucking sucks. Sucking sucks. Got charged twice one and Uber eats delivery meal had so much food missing (beans, STEAK, onions) Disappointing, my first review ever and this location deserves it. Staff sucks ass they need to see who the fuck is managing this place.

I don't believe I have ever left a negative review for a company before.. but this particular Chick-fil-A is the absolute worst Chick-fil-A I I have ever been to. And I eat Chick-Fil-A a LOT. It took this place over 20 minutes to get our food to us. None of the employees were helpful. At the window when we finally got our food, the employee just looked at us with a blank expression and didn't say a single word. I will absolutely never return to this Chick-Fil-A again. There are several in the vicinity, so if you're reading this then I highly recommend you go to another one. It'll save you time and your food will be warmer.

Please do not go here under any circumstances.  

This specific location contains the most incompetent people on the face of the planet, even by Philadelphia fast food standards. I ordered food for delivery, they deliver the wrong order.  I then call to get a refund and reorder my food, and they literally delivered the food wrong again.  All I ordered was a quesadilla and chips, not some ridiculous hidden menu item, but an item with THREE ingredients.  ITS ASSEMBLING A QUESADILLA. ITS NOT BRAIN SURGERY.  A LITERAL 4 YEAR OLD COULD PRODUCE THIS ORDER.  Its not even just incompetence from employees its just straight up not giving a F about people at all And @jacob you can comment that youre so sorry about my experience and blah blah blah, but at this point theres clearly a pattern of just awful service so I can only assume you're as incompetent as your employees.  DO BETTER.  #QDOBAFO
make sure u check your food b4 u leave my chicken leg was burnt I had to beg to get another 1 and most tables r dirty I wouldn't eat inside

This is the worst place I have ever chosen to order from. I have ordered from many different Chipotle locations and they have been quite enjoyable, not this one. When I ordered a rice bowl with chicken and a side of tortillas and a drink, I was expecting to receive my order within 25-40 minutes, it took chipotle over 2 hours and 45 minutes to just prepare the order. Past times I have ordered from here, they have forgotten multiple items on my order and have just given me a free chips and guacamole voucher which doesn't even work. I only received my correct order this time because I messaged my DoorDasher to make sure they included everything because I knew if I didn't, I would not receive my complete order and once again be very angry and hungry. I will never order from this place again because they don't know how to treat their dissatisfied customers, they run their place like a freaking daycare, and have no regard to how long an order has taken even if it is just a plain and simple one. I WILL NEVER RECOMMEND THIS LOCATION UNTIL THEY CHANGE THEIR WAYS!

Every time I come here I just get more and more disappointed. I've tried to give it several chances because it's the closest one to me but it really sucks. Always looks a mess, they barley want to give you any ingredients in your burrito, staff is friendly but they don't all seem to know what they're doing. Overall I just always leave very disappointed and regret coming here in the first place. With that being said I don't think I'll come back again I've learn my lesson the hard way. You'll be better off going somewhere else TRUST ME !!

Favorite place to eat in University City. Portions are big enough to feed 2 people. I am surprised that Greek Lady doesn't have at least 4 stars, if not more! Quick service, plenty of seating, inside and out and clean. Chicken plate is my go-to, it comes with two sides. The gyros are also above average. All of the food I have seen come out from the kitchen looks great. They have a dessert case with cakes and cheesecake that look mouth watering. I'm telling you--go here!
I used to work here back in 2012, and compared to then this place has fallen off. No sense of urgency and I see employees waiting around instead of taking initiative and doing what needs to be done.

This location isn't it! They need to pull it together and soon! Service is so so. Milkshakes are ok. Food is F'n horrible. I'd rather ride up to grant ave when I'm really in the mood for this place. From here on out I'll only go when I'm in the mood for milkshakes, nothin else unless they really revamp some things!

Inconsistent. 

To my dismay this place has severely let me down. I think we have been here maybe 8 times so far and been satisfied 2 of those times. They are EXTREMELY hit or miss in every way. The customer service is either great or absolutely terrible. Some employees treat me like I am asking for the whole world when I order. I can FEEL them rolling their eyes internally as they shuffle me through the line, giving me meager portions of everything but their attitude. 

I mean it's Chipotle, go here if you need to, but just know that you'll have to spin the Roulette wheel and hope that you get lucky with whoever is going to make your food.

GOOD LUCK

I do NOT like the customer service here. I did a online pick up and on my receipt I was told to walk straight to the cashier. One of the workers looked at me like I was crazy and didn't even ask if I was a pick up order. I'm not sure what's her name because she's not wearing a tag but she is highly unprofessional. She whispered under her breathe she was ready to get the f*ck out of here. Ma'am if you don't like your occupation don't work there. She made me wait for pick up to work on someone else order but I already paid for pick up, you can simply just hand me my order.

Not my favorite scarf!! I literally just retched on the train and on my favorite scarf. Here I am trying to make the best of missing my free percussion class by heading to reading terminal for some feel good eats only to leave empty. Nothing was tickling my fancy as I mowed my way through the herd of feasters until I started reading the business names and slogans. "...feed a child with every burger sold." I get to fill my belly and do a good deed all at once?...sign me up, right? Wrong. I ordered the chicken breast sandwich, seasoned cheese fries and a cookies and cream shake. But when she told me the total I almost had to re-evaluate my life. Cause y'all know I'm Frugal Francine when it comes to my coins.  $20.14?!! I'm hungry so ok. The wait was minimal considering it's reading terminal... but the first sign of run was the pricing. The menu may say one price but be sure to check your receipt. My seasoned cheese fries were listed as $4.50 but I was charged $4.75. It's only a quarter but if I didn't have it, would I still be able to get my fries? When I inquired, the cashier said the menus were PROBABLY just old. Sure. Then there was the issue of the term "cheese fries." When you read cheese fries you think potato goodness under melty cheese goodness...Noap! 2 ounce cup of gritty goo for the overflowing heap of lukewarm fries in a bucket. It was soupy and grainy. Cheese should NOT swish. Fries were good. Might've been great hot though. So yeah moving on to my shake. The ice cream scooper probably added a little more flavor to my shake since they weren't wearing gloves. It was more like milk with cookie crumbs. My sandwich...well I never got to try it. I head to the train and I was about the 3rd or 4th goo dipped fry in when I went to wash them down with my cookie milk. Key card swipe...One sip...two sip...sweat...what in the  it decided to go back the way it came. Grateful I had the bucket-o-fries because it made for a great vomit pail. Although, I lost my lunch all over my favorite scarf...on the train...in front of everyone, I am willing to try them again solely based on my daughter devoured the sandwich. "Mom, sorry you threw up but you have to try the chicken sandwich." I however needed a recovery nap.

Not sure what all of the bad reviews are about, but we've ordered twice from the Papa Johns app and had great experiences both times. Once we did devilery and they were right on time. The second time we did pickup and the staff in the store were so nice and friendly!! Also, if you use the app, it has all of the specials on there and we had no issues using them. We will definitely continue ordering from here!
Not sure why both maps and Yelp says they have a drive thru. They don't. Just wasted my time coming here.

Food aside (although it was very good),  this is a great to place to go on a stressful day when hungry.  The two woman behind the counter are amazingly pleasant, and nice.  They were busing, taking orders, and keeping the place clean while
seeing that patrons were taken care of.  It is so nice to see a well run place, where service seems to be first.

i use to come here all the time..my bill was 34 dollars and some change..i tipped 5 dollars..my total came to 39 dollars and some change, i clearly remember what i sign as i keep track of everything i purchase and how much i spend..about a week later i get a email that stated "we noticed you gave a generous tip for 15.00 which gave a total of 49 dollars and some change".. i could not believe what i was reading..i called the manager and he had me come in the next day to verify my signature..when i looked at the receipt neither the digits or signature was my handwriting!!! clearly it was a duplicate receipt that the bartender reprinted and forge my signature on!!!! never do i stop half way down my signature and continue where the pen was lifted!!! The manager gave me the 15 dollars back, needless to say as soon as the same bartender that committed fraud against me saw me he looked away!!!! i called a couple time to see what actions were taken besides giving me 15 dollars back hopefully firing the bartender and nothing!!! i was a regular, not anymore..That same night that same bartender was taking drinks to the cooks in the back like what type of business is that??! i advice anyone that goes to eastcoast wings keep the receipts and have both yourself and whoever is taking care of you to initial the receipt copy and keep it as reference!!

I will continue to say this about this specific establishment over and over - this is the most incompetent chipotle facility I have ever in my life gone to. Constantly running out of food, have workers left and right playing with their thumbs not knowing wtf to do and now saying no to customers who want a quesadilla because "it's too inconvenient and only offered online" - a bunch of clowns work here
This place has good pizza. Customer service is okay if your white...ouch I know right.

Wings here are so so but the honey garlic sauce is awesome. The waitress was really nice and made suggestions of what beers to try . I would say the service is great but the food so so. Of your looking to have drinks and so so food I would recommend going there but if your looking for excellent food keep on going.

The service is pretty spotty even before Covid (regularly would miss items that I ordered), but it's completely gone downhill now. Per mobile app, we ordered ~5 min ahead of time, but waited over an hour for the order. When we got the order, they were missing the biscuits and we waited another 20 minutes. No apologies at all. I love their chicken and fries, but the customer service is not worth it.
The inbreds working at this establishment cant follow a simple set of instructions. Wouldn't recommend. The Kosmo grille down the street is a much better option

Organic chicken?  I had to try some when I made a rare (thankfully) visit to the Liberty Place food court.  I got the chicken in the form of a kebab in a wrap.  Many toppings were available and I got mine with some spicy tomato sauce, cucumbers, rice, peppers, roasted garlic, and maybe a couple other items whose particulars I forget.  The chicken, fillings, and wrap were all okay, but lacked any particular zing.  The chicken could have been a little crunchy on the outside, a little warmer, and generally more flavorful.  The sauces also could have had more oomph.  The wrap itself was okay, but it could have been warmed it up a little.  Seriously, it's a restaurant, it's supposed to have -- and use! -- restaurant equipment that I wouldn't have at home or -- especially -- at the office.  Have it!  Use it!  Make the trip worth it.  Otherwise, I'll just remember more often to make and bring my lukewarm sandwich/wrap/whatever from home, which is going to kick your wrap's only-okay ass every time.

They are rude and very unprofessional. I stopped by tonight at 9:50pm and the worker behind the counter said they were closed when the sign on the door says it's open until 11pm. She laughed and said "we're closed" three times as I looked at my watch. I will never go back to this establishment when the employees are rude to customers without explanation on why it was closing earlier. The woman needs to be fired and there were 3 other customers inside the Popeyes that were getting their food.

Solid, dependable, consistent.. this place offers fresh salads, gyros and sandwiches. My favorite item: Greek supreme salad! The spanikoppita is very affordable and HUGE! It's a great appetizer. Their delivery is prompt and customer service is dependable.

This place is disappointing. We love Nifty Fifty's and have been eating there for years at their other locations. The food was always consistently good but the south Philly takeout place is not. I have gotten cheesesteaks and the bread was stale. Another time they forgot the cheese. We started ordering our fries without cheese and putting our own wiz on because their cheese fries would be soggy like they were sitting around for hours. Last time I ordered a single cheeseburger that was so burned I just threw it away. I give up.

i ordered online because of covid and both my and my moms order were missing about half our stuff, it's understandable because of covid that some things would be missing but all the vegetables on mine were missing (it was my protein) along with more, my moms was missing ingridents and had beans all though she asked for it without them. the resturant seemed somewhat unclean from the bathroom to where the people were working. Generally i've had bad experiences at this place over the past three years, this is not somewhere you go because the food is good and you want to go... this is where you end up because you are starving and hangry

Grub hub ripped my money off!!
Had to change my card, they took my money and the restaurant never provided the delivery!!!

I came here recently in a trip to Reading Terminal Market for lunch. To me it looked promising because of the line and it also looked like an new addition to the market. 

The menu was easy to navigate and I found myself ordering a chicken sandwich and a small lobster Mac and cheese. The Mac and cheese options sit right in the window and all look very inviting. 

The sandwich was good. I'm not sure what the breading is but it is not your typical flour breading and seemed more like crumbs or some kind of meal. All in all the chicken of the sandwich was slightly crispy with good flavor. There was a sauce on the sandwich that made it kind of drippy but also gave it great flavor as well. As for the lobster mac and cheese it was just okay. Nothing special. It also was not that creamy and had started to separate a bit.

The real shocker was that I thought 18 bucks was kind of expensive but I appreciate their mission so I was not that bummed.

We got the poutine with saag paneer, and it was definitely interesting. The fries itself were well cooked and I liked the vegetables, drizzles, and mixins, but I'm not sure if I'd get the dish again. I thought the saag paneer was good and I would happily eaten it with rice, but in this case, I'm not sure if the saag added much to the dish other than making the fries soggy. I'm interested in trying their other fusion dishes next time I come though.

two very hungover chicago girls made a trip out from the city for this place.  hurrah hurrah, it's here!
nothing beats the barbacoa soft tacos. it was like a little happy dance in my mouth.
i'm so excited that it's in philly...now all they have to do is put one in the city...and i'll be a very content girl.

As Someone else mentioned, I love Chipotle but this location is not good. They are not efficient in getting people through the line compared to other locations I've been too. 

They always seem rushed and unorganized. A prime example of them having terrible service is today! A dozen or so of us walk in, stand in line, we wait for a few minutes as the employees look at us. Then finally one person yells to tell us that you can only order online like we're supposed to just know. The last time I walked in it was normal.  

No signs outside.
No signs inside. 
No one greeting you at the door to let you know the new process. 

For some reason allowing people to walk in and stand in line confused then yelling the new rules to them is the process they went with.

Annd... They got my order wrong today.

Hard to get to... if you're coming from a certain direction the roads around there are so screwed up you'll end up making all kinds  of wrong turns. But that's the city. Everything else went ok with my breakfast order.

IF I COULD CHOOSE NO STARS I WOULD!! I bought chicken tenders for my 1 year old and get back to the hotel and this is what the chicken looks like!! RAW CHICKEN!!! 
So disappointed and sick to my stomach!

If only I could rate this location with no stars. I have never seen a staff so unprofessional and unwilling to carry out their basic duties of scooping Mexican food ingredients into a cardboard serving container. It seems like this shouldn't take a rocket scientist to figure out yet there we stood for over ten minutes waiting to complete our order but rather than service customers in store they focused their collected efforts on web orders. When we saw all the guacamole was brown that was our cue to exit. 

Chipotle you can do better, anyone could do better.
Tons of a selection on wings dry rub is fantastic definitely recomend. Also highly recommend the cajun wings and the honey habanero

This one is much better than the one in university city. If you live out this way I guess your options are pretty limited!

My friend and I treked out here on a sunday due to el fuego being closed. 

Pretty solid burritos!
Ya get ya moneys woyt...ordered Uber eats,large portions,tastes great. Got the Buffalo blue fries and a cherry chocolate shake...
I can't stand their casual food process - especially ordering online. They're always late!!!!!!! I hate chipotle.

So I was at the KFC on Stenton here in Philly. DO NOT EAT HERE. I ordered and Single Breast Meal.  However I got more than a Breast Meal. After calling corporate to report a fried mouse or rat tail. I was simply offered a refund and apology for inconvenience.  Not happy. #INeedMoore #KFC #DirtyDining

I don't blame the staff working in this establishment, they were hustling. They were only taking mobile orders which makes sense , since there is only 3 people . One cooking , one making the orders the 3rd person is loading . There needs to be max # of orders that should come through the sight during peak hrs. This will allow the food to be made properly, and delivered promptly. The staff gets 5 stars from me but the brand gets 1.
I love them, I'm from California so they remind me of In&Out buuut way better  hands down every time I'm in Philly I stop by  Just reminded myself I need to go back
LOVE LOVE LOVE their lobster Mac n' Cheese! Also their burger and fries hit the spot! So many good places to eat here you can't go wrong with a burger. Friendly service as well

Really delicious food here. I had a chicken gyro and thought it was so good. Everything was really flavorful, and I loved how they put French fries on the gyro. The tzatziki sauce was amazing and they put a lot on it. The chicken was also tasty, and the pita was thick and soft. The service was a reasonable speed and the staff was friendly. I also loved the restaurant itself - we sat outside and it was really cute. If you're around the UPenn campus this is a solid place to get a quick meal at a reasonable price.
The food is actually good but not delivery accurately assessed. 2 blocks away?  1 hour later still waiting ‍‍

This place should be shut down after today. I got a bowl to go, and once i got home i opened it and there was a nice piece of wrapping plastic mixed into my food. And when i went back to get my money back they offered me another one? What do y'all think i just enjoy eating plastic? My total refund was $9.72 and instead of just giving me a $10 bill like i did the first time i payed, so i could get the hell out the weirdo actually counted out 72 cents and took 10 years to do it. Place is constantly dirty, trash is always overflowing. I'm calling corporate as well because this place needs a more proactive staff and management.
It is quite possible that this is thee WORST Chik-Fil-A that I have ever had the displeasure of eating at. AVOID AT ALL COSTS

I'd rather get local takeout Chinese. Pei Wei is awful, even for Americanized Chinese.

They serve up pan-Asian style dishes, most which are reasonably-priced. Their menu even features handy-dandy labels to indicate what can be vegetized, and what can be made hot. Sadly their cooking was a pale imitation of reality: my so-called spicy "Thai" blazing noodles had MSG'd beef, and were coated in a chili sauce that tasted salty sweet - then again, I have deadened taste buds. My more normal friend found her dish too spicy.

On the positive side, portions were good, and they sold beer. (I had hot tea, the next best thing.) Service wasn't in our face either - we sat ourselves after ordering up front - so be proactive if you want any. The interior was attractive enough, sporting P.F. Chang's branding. Oh, and parking is a snap!

Pei Wei didn't remind me of any diner, save for their open kitchen. If you sit at the counter, you can watch staff wok and toss.

Thanks to my friend for paying!

Greek lady used to be the only place nearby to get a solid gyro, so I went here a few times to try out the menu for dinner and brunch. The pancakes here aren't too great, maybe overly sweet, and the side orders are all pretty oily. The gyro never comes out just as you'd want it. The dessert section here is pretty large, but other than that, I don't think Greek Lady has a place in ny future. They're owned by the same people as Allegros down the block, which makes sense, as their appetizers are pretty much the same.

So I go to school near this chipotle and I decided to go eat there. But I should've just went to the one I lived near. Not to be fat but my Burrito was smaller and less packed then normal. I got a chicken burrito with brown rice, sour cream, cheese, and lettuce. My usual, and I take my first bite and the chicken was burnt. Df. On top of that I found a tomato or something in it. I hate tomatoes and to find one on a burrito I customized disgusted me. Also while I was in line I saw how they were making the other food and I was ashamed. Go there at ur own risk.

This was a nice, clean Popeyes restaurant, which isn't as common as it should be for this chain. The food was fresh & delicious and I got great service by the manager. I hope the manager molds his staff by his example; if so, this should continue to be one of Philly's best Popeyes.

This is literally the worst chipotle. I've eaten here so many times out of convenience with the same poor service but this time was really the last. I promise you will be just as disappointed when you visit here. They delivered me an empty cup when I ordered a bottled drink (not the drivers fault since they can't open the sealed bag to check the order) and the employees including the manager clearly don't care to do their jobs with dignity. Sad to say the owners clearly don't care because they'll continue to make money since they're next to a target. But from now on it won't be mine.

Very filthy environment. The food bar is dirty and workers don't even care. Employees are very rude and assertive. Facility requires masks but half the employees are not even masked properly. Save yourself the trip and don't go in here.

PISSED. line long as heck. only one person working outside. GET ALL THE WAY HOME WHICH IS NOT NEARBY, and there is no damn chicken on any of the breakfast sandwiches I ordered! I am beyond annoyed. I called and the manager asked me the same damn questions. Said she would call me back and never did. *shocking*

I love chipotle but this location has turned me off to it! 

Every single time I order, it's an unpleasant experience. When I order through the app for delivery, my order either never arrives or arrives with missing items. So I decide for next time to order for pickup, however that's always terrible as well. I end up having to wait almost a half hour past the "promised" pick up time to get my food only to find out my order is either completely wrong or missing items! You can never win at this place.

Last night I placed my order 30 minutes before for a 6:00 pm pick up. Now I know it's prime dinner time so they're going to be busy. I showed up at 6:15 expecting my order to be ready but it wasn't. I was waiting with 10 other people inside the store while only three workers work in a small section trying to fulfill all the orders in a rush. I don't understand why they can't work  in the assembly line they have in front of the store? If it's for COVID safety reasons it makes no sense because everyone is instead crammed in the store not social distancing for long periods of time while waiting for their food. Service would be faster if we were allowed to order in person and it would ensure order accuracy. Anyways, 25 minutes later I finally got my order but when I got home discovered it was completely wrong. I ordered a chicken bowl with veggies, lettuce, brown rice and black beans. What I got was a half filled bowl with sofritas, white rice, and pinto beans. Totally innacurate! I submitted a complain and have yet to hear back but I won't be coming back to this location until I can order in person, maybe.

MMM..i love gyros & fast service!

I came here when I visited my friend in Philadelphia! Not amazing or "anything special" gyros, but it will do! A pretty basic gyro and yummy yogurt sauce! The atmosphere was very upbeat and I knew It was a place that all the college kids went because it was inexpensive and good quality food! 

Definitely a place I recommend visiting if you are in the area!

This restaurant has people for some reason getting food from the window for you instead of just letting someone handed out the window and none of them have their nose covered. People cooking food inside don't have masks on. Come on you guys got to do better.
Ordered delivery through door dash. Arrived quickly, hot and looked great. Huge portion. Everything tasted fresh and what I expected. Order was correct. Would order again for sure.
This place is trash, has 8 people standing outside in the rain waiting for their food and some of them have been waiting 30+ minutes. Don't waste your time or money

A major mix up with discount codes, I decided to support nonetheless. I give a 4 because the samosas are great, the poutine was a little dry. You definitely need the sauce and it is delicious. The tacos weren't amazing but ok. Would I go back? Maybe. They are open late and the poutine when I covered in sauce was good! I added the chicken from the poutine to the tacos the next day and it was a good leftover. The fries were fried perfectly and they were quick with prep. It is a ghost restaurant and if you are looking for tacos here, hit Rustika. But get some poutine from them, samosas if you are far from Uni but don't break your neck to go
Went here for lunch during the week. It was packed and busy! I ordered the shrimp noodles and found it pretty bland. I didn't enjoy it too much. I wouldn't mind giving it another try though.

I went over to Jake's one day during my lunch break from work, as I had been eager to try that place out for over a year now!  Before I entered, I scanned the menu posted outside the shop, and decided to go try myself a cheesesteak.  I ordered the Steak and Egg; cheesesteak with American cheese and ketchup topped with an egg sunny-side up.  While the sandwich was listed as having sriracha ketchup on it, I'm not a fan of the hot and spicy side of things, so when I asked if I could substitute regular ketchup for the sriracha, the counter girl gladly obliged.  I also ordered a small side of fries to accompany my cheesesteak.  While I waited for my order to be ready, I noticed that at each table in the shop, there is a roll of paper towels--and I can totally understand why.....so delicious yet so messy!! I also notice that they have what they call a "5 Pound Challenge"--in which participants are challenged to polish off 5 pounds of food (a 2-foot long cheesesteak, 4 Philly soft pretzels, a box of Tastykakes, 24 Peanut Chews, and a Cherry soda), and if they have done so in 45 minutes or less, it's ALL free!  I could never eat that all on my own, but would love to split that with a few people!  Definitely a great idea for friends!  Can't wait to try more of their menu items including their milkshakes AND the chocolate covered bacon!

Service: although there were younger people preparing the poké bowls for me they were very kind and patient. 

I ordered a vegetarian poké bowl that i built on my own (I suggest building your own bowl). This place allows you to get a larger portion of poké bowl than the other places that I have been to. They allow you to choose 2 servings of protein (you can choose two different ones or the same ones). There are also unlimited amount of toppings. I loved it. There are several vegetarian options. I would highly recommend this. I'm sure there is something everyone can find here if you like brown or white rice based food. You can make your bowl sweet, salty, and/or spicy. There are a few seats where you can sit and eat, but taking this food on the go is very doable.
I had the steak and egg, really good. Excited to go back and try the Village Turkey and the Barnyard.

Watched "Undercover Boss" last night and it made me hungry for a soft pretzel! Some of the malls here in Houston sell a terrible pretzel wanna be. So very sad. Please open a franchise in Houston! Texas needs pretzels!!!!!

This place is pretty good, I come here once a week but the reason three stars rather than 4 is for two things that are a little annoying: first of all they only sell diet half iced tea/lemonade. I really don't get why they have four rows in the drink refrigerator for diet half and half and not one lousy non-diet half and half. Does that make any sense at all? Is diet half and half in such demand that it warrants for rows to the exclusion of regular? And I've talked to people about this. To no avail. My other gripe is how everybody kind of communicates via corporate-speak. It's the same schpeil every day about the sandwich, "Hi sir" and "Is Swiss cheese okay?" (every time)  etc etc it's kind of bothersome. People shouldn't be drones

I really like the Schmeer.  I mean, really really like it.  It's just a delicious combination of tender turkey breast, provolone, spinach, sliced RED onions, roasted peppers, and a garlicky mayo on a soft, fresh yet crusty roll.  A whole sandwich will easily be enough for 2 meals.  I brought half for lunch and it was still delicious after spending a day and a half in the refrigerator, although I would recommend eating it fresh.  Dad's pick is the midtown chicken (he's trying to be healthier), which still tastes pretty darn good and indulgent with sliced, grilled chicken, avocado spread, peppers, onions, and a mix of cheddar and mozzarella, in a salad bowl.  While I'm a bread-loving gal, the salad and bowl options are nice if you want something flavorful yet low carb.  Apparently you can also get a sandwich over fries instead of a roll if you really are looking for a heart attack.  One of these days I will work up the gusto to try that.  In the meantime, I am very much content with the sandwich options here and even more grateful to my wonderful, foodie father who actually drives down to the city just to grab a few for lunch and dinner (and bring some extras for my lunch the next day).  Definitely worth a visit if you're in Philly and want a quick, satisfying, flavorful, and affordable bite.

Absolutely delicious. Fresh healthy ingredients,, healthy, zesty flavors, prices reasonable, super fast,....so good. I had a bowl with salmon, mango, cucumber, cilantro, avocado, with a sweet and sour sauce, topped with tempura crunch and sesame seeds. So good. It's like a combinations of sushi and salad--but because it's a bowl, you can mix a lot more ingredients and textures than you can with sushi, so there is a lot more variety.

Quality of sushi-grade salmon was fantastic. Love everything about this place.

I had my order delivered since I was staying in a nearby hotel.  The food was hot when it arrived and the portions were more than adequate and very tasty.  The driver was very pleasant.  I would definitely order from here again the next time I'm in Philly

This is my new go-to pizza place! I love their stuffed pizzas which are unique on their menu. They also have some unique sandwiches that I haven't got to try yet. Everything that we've ordered from here so far has been great! Wings, cheesesteaks, fries and pizza are very good! The people are also very nice. Our order is always correct and ready on time. They always give us a 2-liter soda every time we pick up. They are also always early or right on time for delivery!

pure awesome till the last grain of rice!!

+great music

yummy, went for the 1st time yesterday, the wings are tasty and you can get them rather quickly, which has not been my experience  at other spots.  the sauces were delicious, the wings were extra crispy w/ coating, not like Soho so they were slightly different in taste, but overall a nice treat when in CC.  nice and clean establishment w/ pleasant staff.

I I'm in town from Arizona and my wife saw this place on tv and told me I had to go. Absolutely worth it. Ordered the garlic bomb off their "secret" menu and it did not disappoint. Well worth the trip and the service was great. They were helpful, friendly, attentive and expedient.

Thank you Jake's for bringing something different to the table. The Market East options in the sandwich department tend to mirror each other so it is great to have some variety in a menu. 

These sandwiches are true sandwich lover sandwiches. Great bread with fresh ingredients. I have eaten lunch in twice and the workers are very friendly and make it a casual environment. They probably eat for free all day back there so I would be a happy camper too. I have tried the Barnyard, Mensch and the Italian all of which make a great and filling lunch. All the sandwiches are $7 or $8 which isn't too bad with the quality of the products. 

My only true complaint is the fries. They are pretty boring on their own and not crispy enough. I will be back soon to continue my quest to try every sandwich on the menu, minus the leaner ones section, no time for that.
I am sad to report I have not been nearly as happy as I had been in the past. Things were not put together with care, and the meat has been dry my past couple trips. Still good, but down a peg.

I love the garlic bomb and the pulled pork sandwich. When I lived in the Market East neighborhood, I used to visit Jake's at least once a week. The $5 pork sandwich special on Monday was very good for my grad student wallet---and very good for my tummy. Fries with special sauce on the side is a must. And the meal completes with a cup of birch beer that cools me down before another wild bite of sandwich.

I must like this place because I keep going back.  It's the only food joint in this eatery at Penn that I can go to routinely.  The husband and wife team that own and manage the place are really friendly and definitely remember the regulars.

As far as a Quizno's goes, it's the the same as any other, so you either like their stuff or you don't.  I happen to like it.
I had the Cowboy. Very tender shredded pork with grilled onions.  Amazing!  Good quality; good value.  It is also a good vibe.  I met the owner, and you can tell he's passionate about his concept.
I stopped here on my way home. I was happy the pretzel were hot and fresh. A1 customer service.

Hi this Popeyes is the worst and nasty they have the worst people in their nasty as attitude and if your looking to work there don't work at that Popeyes becuase they don't pay when say they are going to pay fuck everybody that work their don't waste your time working there like I did it's not worth it the pay is very low like $7.25 that's fucking shitty

This place is GREAT! The pretzel's are cheap but delicious. Who though you could get 10 pretzels for $10. Traveled to philly from dc and happened to drive by this place. It has a convenient location and plenty of parking. Also I am a big sauce person and they like 10 different sauces to try! 

The staff was also very friendly! Big home town fans and fun to talk to. Would def recommend to anyone traveling to philly! I wish they had one around DC cause I would buy platters for work all the time.

Well it's a nice place but of course it had to be something "south street" about it. Of all the Poke places I've been to this past year (we are on a Poke kick) they have a system where you can write the order down. Rather than take the order as you tell them. I'm just guessing but it's probably for accuracy, but here is the kicker...
They can charge for whatever they want! Especially when you have to "modify" the meal to your liking. The more boxes you check the higher the price. Most places aren't like that but hey the food was really good. 
I'm giving them 3 stars for a few reasons:
1.the portion size was tiny in comparison to say Pokeono in Ardmore
2. The staff has no idea what is going on if that lady at the courter doesn't tell them, and it holds up the line
3. They charge for everything and that 10% discount was bunk! 

I'll go back but I will surely be in that area instead of going out of my way for such a bizarre dining experience. Better luck next time guys!

The pig sandwich is awesome and very reasonably priced, I try to stop here at least once a week for my pork fix. Prior to trying Jake's pig, I felt that no pork sanwich in the city could live up to the GOAT of pork from the little shack on Synder Ave.  Well, I still feel that no pork sandwich is better but Jake's is pretty close, and its not always easy to go to the little shack on Snyder but Jakes is right on the corner of where I work.  Go get the pig on a Monday and experience reverse sticker shock, they have a monday special on the pig that makes me feel like I am robbing from them.

I don't know what all the fuss is about, but then I am not a burger and fries fan.  In fact, I can't remember the last time I ate a burger with fries.  So why the review - my husband is a burger and fries fan and likes this place.  He does not go often as even he realizes that any place whose food has the grease from the overfilled fries bleeding through the paper takeout bag with in moments of being packed is best eaten in moderation.   He reports that both the burgers and fries are tasty and well sate his craving for such when it arises.  I love that do not charge extra for toppings, with or without them the cost is the same.  We always finds the service friendly and fairly quick, which is good as I am usually waiting in the car for him.

Your choice poke bowl composed of menu or customizable options. Bowls are filled generously and composed of grains, proteins, sauces, crisps, and veggies. I've visited often since their opening and have had the salmon, tuna, shrimp, yellowtail, crab, and eel options.. I prefer the tuna, salmon, and eel, but all options were palate pleasers. Order online or inside for convenience, cash and credit accepted. Consistently fresh and filling for a reasonable $10-15 each.

I always get the large meatball sandwich, which is probably one of the most caloric sandwiches to get there.  I request extra sauce and get just Italian seasoning.  The pickled hot peppers also go well too.  I wish they had some parm to top the sandwich.

The lines get long during lunch so make sure you come by early to avoid the rush.

Really nice addition to the 'hood.

Sandwiches are served on Carangi rolls, seeded, unseeded or multigrain.

The Midtown Chicken was great, red onions, cheddar and a red pepper spread went down fast.  The Village Turkey was not as good - the meat was good but the roll kind of overwhelmed the sandwich.

Fries were hot, crispy and above average.  Sodas are "micro-brewed".  I'll definitely come back - all the ingredients were fresh and good, and it's the next best thing to a Paesano's without the real thing.
Ordered delivery. Was right on time. We ordered midtown turkey, 50/50, and farm fries. I'd say the fries were the best!
this place is pretty good  I liked how the Chili Ponzu Salmon came with onion crisps! Can't go wrong with oriental toppings ‍

Jake's was my first meal stop during my visit to Philadelphia, and it was an awesome way to start several days of enthusiastic eating.  The 50-50 sandwich is super decadent, flavorful, and messy in the best possible way.  The roll holds up well to the mounds of meat filling.  The sandwich was finished off with a creative, spicy Sriracha mayo. The fried pickles were only $2, so I had to give them a try.  They were much tastier than they sound, although I didn't want to eat more than 4 pieces.  The cherry soda from the fountain is absolutely awesome, and the sweetness perfectly balanced out the saltiness of the rest of my meal.  I sadly did not even come close to having enough room left for dessert.  But if I did, I might have tried the chocolate covered bacon.  

The place is really clean with a lot of tables.  Their jelly bean presidential poll is cute (looks like most of their customers are Obama supporters). 

For people obsessed with going to places that have been featured on the Food Network Shows, Jake's has a wall devoted to those who have tried and succeeded or failed at their 5 lb Philly Challenge which includes a 2 foot sandwich, 4 soft pretzels, 24 mini peanut chews, 1 box of Tasty Cakes, and 1 cherry soda to be eaten in 45 minutes.

Go hungry and be prepared for a filling, satisfying meal!
Had the most delicious sandwich ever!!  Sharp provolone, broccoli rabe, & pork..  The rolls were phenomenal, too.  The pork melted in your mouth!!  The milkshakes were fantastic,  too!!

University City Chipotle, you deserve more than a paltry 3ish stars!
You would think with all the college students, this place would be packed, but I never have to wait more than a good 10 minutes to leave through the exit doors with my burrito in tow (I wouldn't sit down to eat here, as the atmosphere leaves a little to be desired and plus, I can just walk 10 minutes and I'm home again, free to put on my drawstring PJ pants and plop down on the couch like a good American!)

Their veggie burrito is far tastier than Qdoba. At least, their guac is better...the general ingredients seem fresher to me...and I never have a stomach ache by the end like I do with Qdoba. Sorry, Qdoba. I'm not sure what that's all about.

To the reviewer who said look at the calories online and skip the tortilla, are you crazy? Life is too short not to eat burritos.
