I live in Center City and used to order soft pretzels at the Rittenhouse location (Samson St).  I work in Baltimore/DC and my clients love Philly Pretzels.  I ordered large amounts that need to be ready at the buttcrack of dawn so I can drive the pretzels to my clients.  The Rittenhouse location messed up so many of my orders from not delivering them in a timely manner to giving me the wrong amount of pretzels...I had to find a Philly Pretzel that didn't suck and that's what brought me to the Passyunk Location.  My orders are always ready when I pick up at 6am and my orders are always correct.  They also have bags of hard pretzels which I like in case I run out of soft pretzels to give to clients.  They can also make initials or other things (hearts/Christmas trees) out of pretzels which are always a hit at Birthday Parties or Holidays.  I highly recommend this location!

I saw some rave reviews on Yelp and had high expectations.  After a good streak of strong Yelp referrals, this time I was let down.

I was excited to try the "Charlie Brown" - a peanut butter, bacon, and brisket sandwich.  First, it is incredibly skimpy and sparse on meat for a $10 sandwich.  Then, it was dry and almost flavorless.  I still felt very hungry after finishing it.

My friend got the BBQ Sandwich and also said his was dry and dull. 

I am probably the least picky and one of the most generous reviewers on Yelp.  But I just cant think of anything good to say about this place.  They do have some good concepts and food creations there, I guess.  Maybe I just went on a bad day?   For that I will bump from a 2 to 3 stars.

Im a big fan of CHIPOTLE and every time i travel to different states my first stop is always CHIPOTLE.
In my burrito i always ask for extra GUACAMOLE obviously FRESH guacamole and today these people are trying to tell me that the guacamole from the picture is fresh. REALLY???? Come on people REALLY??? Im not american, im Hispanic and im coming from the place people make real FRESH GUACAMOLE this is ridiculous..!!!

This is my first bad review I ever wrote. First of all the food is delicious! I service is horrible!!!  I place and order for a beef sandwich, the server said it was $10. I repley I thought all sandwishes were $5 on Monday. He asked how do I know that. I said "I was here on a Monday and she said all sandwiches were $5 all day". He then asked who it was, I said a white woman, he grilled me further " what was her name?". I told him I don't know. (It is not like there were name tags or how or why would I would remember.) He said only the pork is $5. I said ok I'll oder a pork sandwich. He went back to make my sandwich while talking to the other gentlemen about me making up a story about someone telling him about all sandwichs  $5 loudly so I can hear him ridiculing me. I saw him cutting 2 rolls. I questioned him and he said you order the beef sandwich first and I can not change my mind after I order you will have to buy both sandwiches. I told him I only wanted one. He said refunds. I filped out and demanded my money back. I was fuming how I was treated as regular customer.
This place is good, would recommend if sick of eating Subway all the time.

Walking in the restaurant is SUPER clean. The server was very patient (thank you so much ) but there's so many options, I couldn't make up my mind. After much deliberation I finally decided I would get the ST Burrito (with no masago) I honestly was not expecting the burrito to be gigantic, i could barely eat half. The burrito was tasty (super messy to eat, but that could totally be my fault) I will visit again , I look forward to trying a poke bowl.
They give you attitude and such a small amount of food. Rice won't even fill the base. AWFUL PLACE!!!

I ordered chicken fingers with Fries to go. The fries were yummy, a bit soggy from the condensation of the plastic container but the chicken fingers were huge! So it made it worth the $9 I paid. The chicken fingers weren't my favorite but I would go back and try their wings or bonesless wings next time

Ordered online for pickup at 7:30PM an hour in advance. Got there and 30 minutes later, everyone who arrived there after I did got served while I was still waiting. Saw my fucking burrito laying there as everyone else's food was served. I don't think they check their online orders. Don't come here if you value your time.

Went in at 8pm. Workers were telling each other stories about their school experience, cursing and calling each other names. Asked for a courtesy cup of water. 
"We don't do courtesy cups no more." 

"That doesn't sound right. Is there someone I can speak to about this?" I ask them.

"Yo. Can you tell him?" The teen call to her friend, who she was telling the story to. "You heard her. We don't do give out cups anymore."

Solid as always!

I've been to the Center City location and was on this side of town so it's access on the second floor of Whole Foods was clutch. The menu is basically the same as the original location - simple and completely vegan. 

It was a busy afternoon so there was a bit of a line before I could place my order. The process is fairly simple, and once order is in place, you wait for the attendants to call your name for pick up or eat in. 

I ordered the combo - Turkish shake, falafel salad, and shawarma fries - all for $15 - not a bad deal! 

I found the salad fresh and fulfilling. The lemon dressing adds the right amount of acid to the greens and falafel. The Turkish shake, as always, was solid - so good (even if not exactly good for you haha), and the fries were fresh from the fryer seasoned just right with the shawarma spice! 

Overall - great experience and glad I was able to make it to this location and to learn it keeps to the reputation of the original location. Will definitely be back!
Food was fast and hot. The burritos are nuts, especially late night. Highly recommend giving these guys a try!

Chix & Wings is great! I've gotten the plain white meat a few times before and it kept me coming back, but today I tried the buttermilk white meat and it is delicious! The chicken comes in nice large pieces and it was dusted with some tasty powder(Im not sure if it was some kind of buttermilk powder or some seasoning blend but it was amazing!) I was confused about why there was an option for both plain and buttermilk since I thought they would be basically the same, but they are definitely different and I can't wait for the next time I pick up a 5 piece of Chix & Wings buttermilk white meat!
The fries are nice and crispy and come in a little paper bag. There's not a lot included, but enough that I was full after 3 pieces of chicken and almost all of the fries. 
The to-go bag had a bunch of ketchup packets, some napkins and some plastic forks. There is also a self serve counter to grab all of these things, so I had more than enough after I grabbed everything without realizing it was already in the bag. 
There are signs on the window with covid guidelines, but while waiting for my food, someone else sat down pretty close to me in the waiting area and the employees didn't seem to care. The employees did have gloves, masks, and a plastic wall between them and the customers though, so they are taking some precautions. 
My mouth started watering just writing this review, so I'm going to go heat up my left overs now!
Quick service for takeout and delivery. I like the stripe style. They have the best special: 2 slices and a soda for $3.50. Great deal for lunch or on the go.

Hmm so what to start with. Do it my first time in a long time that I tried McDonald's. Veggie were fresh, chicken had chicken meat, bread was good. 3  cuz something was missing. Sandwich was good for price, but that all. The main thing is pick up was confusing, not enough space, both ordering like and pick up is combined. You can't see the screen if ur order is ready or not. Some orders are being called some not. Mine was taken outside, even tho I requested pick up. If I didn't mentioned my number they wouldn't call me probably.

Waiting for an hour for BOGO on grand opening. Definitely worth it. The place is not big with some seatings, it's hot because of so many people waiting in line out to the side walk. 

Worth the wait for unlimited toppings. It's the only poke that has zucchini noodles. There are so many topping choices that when you put it all together you'll get very flavorful poke. I recommend adding the snow crab worth additional cost. Don't forget the seaweed. The bonito flakes is another topping that you usually find on takoyaki. It definitely adds umami flavor to poke. I recommend adding this,

This is the east coast's older, more experienced burger compared to the west coast's In-and-Out. Indeed this franchise has been taking the fight to In and Out with several locations now in San Diego.

Don't get me wrong, I love them both! But Five guys does some things a lot better.. A larger assortment of toppings and a greasier burger. Yes. I'm a fan and once you start doing some animal style fries in and out will be on the ropes.

Yum!! It's hard for me to pass up Mediterranean/Israeli food, so when walking through the food court section at Whole Foods, I immediately knew this was going to be my lunch.  

My husband and I both ended up ordering the same thing - the Falafel sandwich. He put regular tahini dressing on his, and I opted for the Harissa sauce - this hit of spice was the perfect accompaniment to this beautiful sandwich.  Super cheap at $8, it's falafel in a warm delicious pita pocket, with tehina, Israeli Salad, and Cabbage.  Simple, delicious, fresh, and flavorful!  I'd order this again and again!

Goldie is part of the CookNsolo Restaurant Family, which includes one of my all-time favorites, Zahav! Other restaurants in this family are Abe Fisher, Federal Donuts, Dizengoff, and The Rooster.

I'm still a fan, but definitely some problems at this location in the last 1/2 year. 

Seems like they are not able to retain staff. 

I come in twice a week and I now very rarely see the same people working. Every time I walk in it seems like they are interviewing. 

Because the staff frequently changes the service is often painfully slow.Quality of the food is inconsistent.

Why can't they keep people? Economy recovering and they are not paying enough? Poor management? 

Do something to fix this problem.....

You would think that if a restaurant was named Chix & Wings, then their wings got to be good, right? Wrong.

I pass this place literally everyday on my way to work, today I decided to give it a try, and there is not much to say other than cheap. 
Cheap service, cheap attitude, cheap food quality. Oh yeah cheap as in cost as well! 
I got the FAMOUS double fried wing served with a side i.e: Sweet Chilly " crispy "wings and a Cole Slaw side.
Wings:  6 pieces of tiny, badly sauced and not tasty or crispy inFAMOUS wings.
Cole Slaw: dry and flavorless.
Price:  $6.95
Would I go back and give it a second try? Hell to the no! There are plenty of fish in the sea.

Two Yelps!

Subway isn't my favorite restaurant to begin with but this is probably my least favorite location. The location is super small. Probably only 3 or 4 tables. The staff there isn't the friendliest. This place is convenient for me so I've gone here a few times but only out of connivence.

Opt for another store if you can, at least as far as drive thru is concerned.

The attendant was incredibly rude and failed to communicate with us clearly. Had conversations during the order process and couldn't inform us they were out of mill shakes, leading us to ask about it many times.

We tried another store before and they had no milk shakes either. We questioned her about whether this would be the same for all other stores, she aggressively said she didn't know and the reason this store couldn't sell them is  because they were cleaning the machine, at 4pm.

This happened today, May 22nd at 3:50pm.

I adore 5 guys, always fresh. Made to order. Friendly staff that is very accommodating and welcoming.  Fries done reg or Cajun style and always fresh. Huge portion even the kids love it and always ask to go there
To expensive 2 burgers 1 fry and 2 sodas 38 dollars that's crazy for take out food and it was just ok nothing special I watched the guy smash all juice out of my burger it was dry dry dry
If I could give 0 stars I would. Worst Stromboli ever. It looked good upon arrival but once cut open it became a messy ball of doughy mush. Never again.

My wife makes fun of me, but sandwiches are my favorite salty food / main dish. Which of course leads to some accusations of being a lazy cook, since she wants a main dish, vegetable, and carb. Whereas I'm quite happy with my entire meal between 2 slices of bread (or just 1 roll!). But I digress...

I normally don't post reviews, but I was jonesing for a good sandwich, and decided to search and see if Jake's has franchised yet. Alas, it seems there are fewer than when I was last in Philly. I thought they were a chain in the area. Again, digressing; I do that when I'm hungry. 

I live in the South, and while you can find good BBQ places, all the sandwich places have cold cuts (barf!). The only exceptions tend to be Northern-deli-places that still mostly only have gross (IMHO) Italian subs, and which sometimes have Philly cheese steaks. But of all the sandwiches I had in Phillip, the eponymous cheese steak was not my favorite. 

This is, or was, my favorite sandwich place ever. We tried a bunch of sandwich places on our first visit to Philly (full disclosure: this was in August of 2014). I had Pat's and Genos's on the same day (also full disclosure: this was when I was fat). I still dream of the pork sandwich I had with real meat. I'm making Homer noises as I type this. The loaded gravy fries were pretty great too. Service was good. The only negative was the price being a little high for a sandwich. But seeing my alternatives now, I'd pay even more. The closest I've been since then was outskirts of D.C., close to Baltimore. We had considered taking the train just for this sandwich and the tiramisu French toast at Green Eggs Cafe. But we only had 2 days to visit friends...

Farewell, Jake's. I hardly knew ye. If you're now down to just 2 stores, I might not be likely to see you again.

Would have given 5 stars bc I am a regular I order 3 to 4 times a week but ever since they hired that rude girl Jade I belive her name is... 
me n n husband are done tonight Saturday the March 7th will be the last yet again this girl try's time tell me she can't do this with a order which is funny snice they do it for me at least once a week but then again when I got there to pick my food up another man was complaining about her saying she's on her cell phone putting customers on hold they have 3 girls there and only 1 of them working the man said he called 20 min. Before to place a order and the girl rushes him off the phone which she does to me to maybe if she wasn't in a rush orders could be taking correctly lucky big bens uncle Charlie's uncle joes and apple pizza all have this same menu so we will now just drive to one of those locations it's been a good 2yrs with this place before they started hiring these young people that really don't wanna work and know it all

You can DIY or order from one of the menu options. 

The small is more than enough food for me.

I've had better food made at other locations. The tacos were soaked and sloppy. The meat wasn't drained properly and everything was just thrown together...literally. I don't recommend going y to o this location at all.
We've been ordering a lot of takeaway from Red Poke since the pandemic and the food is always fresh and flavorful. Poke bowls are always delicious and the Crazy Burrito is amazing!

Drougie's is one of me and my family's favorite pizzeria.  We usually prefer take-outs because our food is hot and fresh. Delivery is inconsistent, sometimes we get our food super fast, and sometimes extremely late even though we are literally five minutes from the restaurant. 

Upside-down pizza is one of our MUST HAVE. Whenever we crave for upside-down pizza, we have to order from Drougie's. If Drougie's is not available for any reason, we just won't order from anywhere else lol. Another fav of mine is sweet potato fries, I love that it doesn't have salt, u can call me boring, but I like my fries plain. Recently me and hub been ordering ravioli and stuffed shrimp from Drougie's. I love the Spinach Ravioli and hubby love the Cheese Ravioli and Stuffed Shrimps with Crabmeat. As for dessert, Tiramisu is one of our favorites from Drougie's pizza.

We didn't try everything on the menu yet. Here is what I find out, AVOID Charboiled Fresh Scallops, it got a weird stench and tastes extremely sour.
Great food. Quick service and greeeeen! Menu is interesting, affordably prices and well cooked. Healthy.

Great quick lunch spot for poke bowls and burritos. The build your own is a great deal and was HUGE. I chose three proteins for $13 and the toppings were very generous. I thought the rice was a bit over seasoned/salty. Depending on the toppings I felt the salt in the rice was a little much. But overall, I loved this spot! 

PS it's a beautiful walk around this area. If you are staying at a hotel nearby this was such a nice area to take a lunch time stroll.
Wings were EXTRA SMALL AND the jerk seasoning was poured on instead of mixed. Not appetizing at all. Wasted my money

Wow! Drougies is absolutely unbelievable. The food is excellent. The menu is huge which is great cause anybody can find something they like even vegetarians. They also have very healty items such as salads and wraps which are delicious.  Delivery was incredibly fast and so was pickup. Serice was great. Will def.. be my new favorite place.

If I could give a zero stars I could. Let me preface by saying chipotle was and has been my go to since I first  delighted on it in college one day, and I've never turned back since. until today. 

I ordered my new usual- 3 soft shell tacos without rice. Pretty filling but not itis inducing like a bowl.

Honestly, I dunno why I'm even bothering to describe the food when I should say: please see images attached. 

I was so nauseous when I saw it moving that I didn't bother to take a video ( probably would have made me vomit). But I took this picture bc I knew it would be hard to believe otherwise.

I stuck by you through all the E.Coli scares, and probably more telling , I stuck by you every single time there was a price hike. But alas, no. I cannot and will not allow myself to return to a place that has big ass bugs in its food. 

Just no.

Maybe I'll eat at another location. Maybe one day. If the chain stays in business and ( more importantly) if the rewards card stays.

I still feel creepy crawlies down my throat.

I would like the help from the Jefferson Hospital community to help me with an issue. Last week money was spent at one of my favorite eating spots at 138 South 11th st. Now, the food is good but one day last week Friday to be exact May 3,2019 one of my coworkers placed an order and the food was not good this day. My coworker reached out to Chix & Wings to let them know of the unsatisfying meal. They were told to just bring the receipt and there money would be reimbursed. They also mentioned that they lived over the bridge and would not be able to hold on to the meal until they returned back into town on Monday 6,2019. Chix & Wings said okay. Now when the money is to be reimbursed with the receipt to show for proof they are now saying NO. This is not fair to the customer at all. Yes it maybe in their policy to have both food and receipt. But if you don't live close by why isn't the receipt enough. Especially when you already said it would be fine. This place is not being reasonable with there discretion. Asking Chix &Wings to refund for the unsatisfying food. If not then can the Jefferson community take a week off from buying any food from them. If it were you wouldn't you want them to be fair to you?
Food was awful, dry. That was my first and last time. I don't see why people go crazy for that stupid chicken sandwich. The service was also terrible.

Perfect spot to get a great, quick meal. We had a busy couple days in Philly and I can't believe I actually ate here 3 times. The people who run this business are the nicest, and the ingredients are incredibly fresh and delicious. Can't say enough good things. There is also something for everyone here. Vegan, vegetarian, etc. So good.

They're sloppy with your food and give small portions. My beans were just threw in my bowl without an attempt to even drain them. I asked for lettuce and got 3 shreds and then an attitude when I asked for more. Good times!

So happy this is in the neighborhood. Fresh fish, good portions! Been needing this here. So far had the Rainbow Bowl and all the different types of fish were delicious. Lots of side ingredients too including the avocado and pineapple. All good quality.

Red Poke Express will always delight your tastebuds. Everything is always fresh and unparalleled service. This place is we're you need to be if you like poke. I suggest you make your own but all the premise bowls are delicious as well.

We stumbled across this listing on a random Monday night when my husband and I had no interest in cooking and made this game time
Decision to order. It was everything you would expect it to be; gluttonous, cheesy and all around instagrammable. I'm not sure we'll ever stoop this low again but it was fun for a one time thing

I am delighted to write this review for the Philly Pretzel Factory at Broad Street and Passyunk Avenue.  Due to social distancing and living in another state, we were unable to see my sister and my dad on their birthday.  Wanting to send something delicious to celebrate their birthdays, I reached out to two other Pretzel Factories first that were a bit more convenient to their location - they refused to deliver.  I then remembered there was a location near St. Agnes Hospital.  Before the words were fully out of my mouth in talking with the manager, Josh. . . he was perfectly agreeable to providing delivery and was eager to share options and pricing with me.  He then told me about a special that was just being offered in the last few days.  Let's do it!  Josh was engaged, accomodating, and ensuring that all would go right.  Today, the tray was delivered to my family and they were thrilled.  Fresh and hot and delicious.  Thank you, Josh, for helping me celebrate their birthdays from a distance!  You are fabulous.

Service at this place is horrible, terrible, no good, very bad!!!! I love chipotle but the employees at this place are the absolute worse none of them even like their job and make this location in the middle of UCity look like some ghetto shit like just throw the whole crew in the trash!!!

Considerably better than the one on Columbus Blvd. The only thing I don't like is the set-up for the drive thru window. Oddly, there is a split lane and you can use both lanes to order, but then the lanes merge back together before you get to the window to pay. It's not smart. It needs to be two lanes all the way through the process, or just one.

Fries are always hot and fresh with the right amount of salt. No complaints!

Used to order from this place all the time, was alway good. Last few times I've had them the quality has significantly diminished. Pizza was floppy, lacked taste. The pasta was just sitting at the bottom with sauce thrown on top, wasn't mixed at all. Overall the food is ok, nothing like it used to be
It's like you order something only to find out when you come home it's not what you ordered and when it happens more than a few times it's unacceptable. Sincerely, unhappy customer

Have gotten takeout from this place probably 5 or 6 times by now and each time I leave with a delicious bowl filled to the absolute top with rice fish and toppings. You order by checking off items from a slip of paper and there are plenty of options in each category. By the end of the slip you could have chosen 17 items to pile into your bowl. Fish is usually fresh and being able to switch things up for just $10 is amazing.

Ordered a calzone, fries and mozzarella sticks and it was pretty disappointing. The food was not terrible but also not that good. But why really made it a bad experience was that there was a huge hair in the middle of the calzone that confirmed that we will not order from here again. The only good part was that the Cajun fries had great seasoning, but that's it.
Came for the roast beef sandwich. Awesome! Good people work here. Stop if you're in town for a game like I was. It's really close to all the venues.

Every time I go through the drive-threw I wait at least 15 mins Or more it doesn't matter if I'm the only car in the drive threw  And my order is never bake it's always a sandwich and fries that's it and all I see them doing is messing around in there

I have been trying a lot of poke places around Philly and Red Poke Express is one I would recommend to others. I came here and got two poke bowls to go, one was the South Street bowl and the other was create my own. I felt that they gave me a good amount of rice and toppings. Everything tasted good in our bowls; no complaints. You can ask for extra sauces on the side. 
The boss lady was very nice.

Large, filling, poke bowls with fresh fish. The greens are fresh and crisp, and the amount of food for the price of healthy food makes you feel that much better!

Enjoy!

I'm done with this place ... Been here a half dozen times and it's always been OK (some times better than other times), but our last visit (2/1/17, 7ish) left me feeling ripped off.   
Employees were nice, but the sandwich (garlic bomb) and side (onion strips) we ordered were so small, I though it was from a children's menu. I'm not exaggerating, it was TINY! They may as well have used a hotdog roll. I'm mad at myself for accepting it considering it cost me $15 and change. 
Aaaand, the food really did lack flavor ... Seems like once these sandwich joints start to expand, they go to hell. 
Never again.

I get that this is one of the only fast food places open after midnight. But sweet holy Christ, 15 minutes to order your food and another 20 just to get it is ridiculous. They just need to have more staff on hand at nighttime. Yikes.

I'm usually not a falafel fan but this place has converted me. All of the falafels I've ever had were always so dry but Goldie's falafels have a perfectly crispy outer shell and a soft, never dry filling. I've tried the salad and the harrisa sandwich here and both were excellent. But let's be real, the true star is the TEHINI SHAKE. It's life changing and worth the trip to Goldie alone. It's like a milkshake but better because of the oh so creamy, nutty and incredibly addictive flavors of the tehini. If you love the black sesame shake/soft serve from Matcha Love then this will be right up your alley. The tehini shake is definitely a sweet treat and too many may possibly give you diabetes but yolo!

I order the so called famous double fried wings and was not very happy totally disappointed with them. They were fried too hard and were very dry, which they try to hide with that abundance of sauce. It was not a good choice, not sure if I will be going back for another visit

2nd time this wk we order 4 Big Mac NO Lettuce and made sure to say it multiple times bc I know they are to busy playing with their friends in the store always so $30 later we drive all the way home to a xtra lettuce in everything

I just love this place it's one of the best kept secrets that Cafe Chicco top of the list best place for Roast Beef Sandwiches up there with Nick's etc!  Known about it a few years but I'd get here now and then but keep buggin thru facebook asking when will there be delivery, and more recent u can get it thank u!! ..also it was cash only way back another bit inconvenience I'd walk past but not having cash on-hand i'd do an oh well.. NOW pretty sure they take credit!!!  The Roast Beef is to die for..piled high..the gravy like grandma use to make and their other sandwiches ie Meatball or salads or any specials are also delicious!  Let it be known though that its a small cafe only maybe 4 tables so it's not a sit down bring a crowd place..and also for some reason from the outside its easy to miss.. but then again i did say it's a best south philly secret.. i was first told about this place from those in the health field considering nearby Methodist Hosptial and Doctors offices on broad.   I so recommend this Caffe.. i've ordered delivery and it went very well.. very clean and good friendly people.

The PokeSpot is one of my favorites to treat myself to on a weekend night. 

I've never stepped foot inside, and have only had it delivered (or picked up by a friend), so I can only comment on the food. 

PokeSpot has lots of pre-made bowl combinations available, but I love creating my own from all of the ingredients they have to choose from. Pick a base, add two or three fishes, a sauce, and all the toppings to your heart's content. 

My favorite is the cauliflower base, which isn't too crunchy or soft, and serves as a great substitute for rice. I like getting spicy tuna and salmon, and the fish is always fresh and the bowl is full of it. The bowls never skimp on your favorite fishies and toppings, and it's a very filling meal. I will continue to order PokeSpot, and hopefully will stop in soon!
Ordered Chicken Marsala takeout was not what I expected as a Marsala, different . Within 3 hours I became sick. Coincidence, I don't think so.

I'd leave 0 stars if I could. My coworkers and I ordered Spicy Chicken sandwiches for lunch because we wanted to see what all of the hype was about. No big deal, right? WRONG. 

Our order arrived later than it was supposed to (we didn't mind that, we could wait). We get back to our office, open our bags, and there are 0 Spicy Chicken sandwiches. There were 7 original chicken sandwiches. We also all ordered fries. GUESS HOW MANY ORDERS OF FRIES WE GOT?! NONE. Cool, GrubHub will settle this. Called GrubHub, got my money back, placed another order because my guy, I really want to try this sandwich. 

Second order is slated to arrive at 1:00 PM. 1:00 PM passes, 1:10 PM passes, 1:20 PM passes. Food arrives at 1:30 PM. GUESS HOW MANY SPICY CHICKEN SANDWICHES AND ORDERS OF FRIES WE GOT?! ZERO. Chick-Fil-A and Wendy's would never do this to me.

Worst place on the planet. 99.9% of the time this place gets your food wrong. They never care they take forever and have the worst customer service I've ever seen. Avoid at all costs. Whoever owns this McDonald's should be ashamed.

I go to this Macdonald because it is the closest but I do not go anymore!  Every time I go, the treatment is horrible, they are rude, ill-mannered, they have no education, they throw food at you, they give you what is not, they give you incomplete orders, like they give courses to all employees, how to treat customers badly, there is one in particular  who has all his face covered I do not know what country he is from but he is super rude.  don't ever go shopping there

The food that I had order had a weird smell coming from it and it looked freezer burn. Called them as soon I received my order. They asked me what I wanted to do about it, I told them I just would like another order made that didn't have that smell and freezer burn on my food. Received my food after the place had closed it was well over a hour for me to receive a replacement order. When my replacement order arrived. The exact same smell with the exact freezer burn on the food. I would never order from this place again. Ticket number 201. NEVER ORDER FROM HERE!!!
Amazing food and amazing service! The portions are huge so you won't go hungry, would recommend to anyone looking for Poke.

So disappointed... used to be my go to for neighborhood delivery. Now that this virus hit , supporting neighborhood small business was my intent as well as feed the fam. I ordered online, convenient. After an hour I called, the nice girl who answered rudely dismissed my concern to a rushed " sorry, it will be there shortly" and hung up. Another hour goes by.... nothing. I call... no answer. Literally called 6 times, no answer, it rang until the Verizon message came on. Sadly I sent the delivery guy away with the food, 2 hours and 11 minutes later. Canceled my 52$ card payment, and lost a yummy Stromboli spot for good. I wash my hands...

Just ordered off GrubHub however the driver couldn't find the location. I really wanted to give this place a shot so I went out myself and found it easily, so any food delivery driver's reading this you have no excuses. Anyways, I'm really glad I did go out and pick this up myself. Food is incredible! Anything less than 4 stars is unreasonable. The two gentlemen working the kitchen were personable and professional. This will likely be one of my new "go to" spots.

The third time will NOT be a charm, because I'm going to Qdoba. Do you like your chicken tacos with a side of sanitized COVID? How about your beef barbacoa brushed with brow sweat? Well with the way they use the same gloves to open cabinets and packages while they roll your burrito up, it must add flavoring. I watched my server walk around the store opening cabinets; touching counters, walls, people and everything else with his serving gloves on trying to find a plastic ramekin lid. After he found them, while opening the packaging; he leaned over to another sever, asked did he need him to fold the other customer's burrito, did so, then finished opening the plastic sleeve of ramekin lids from the marvelously dusty shelf/cabinet. It was awesome how he only noticed when the burrito goo smeared across the packaging. Then and only then did he notice and change his gloves. I saw visibly how they spread germs and in this pandemic I'm not interested in those ingredients. They have a row of chairs in front of the counter but the "burrito lady" moved them and was allowed to rest her entire body up against the glass with her mask at chin strap level. Although they have social distancing stickers on the floor, nothing is really enforced. Upon entering there should be 2 lines; one for ordering and the other for online orders. Everyone just stands around...in close proximity. There's no sanitizer visible for after interactions. I order 3 tacos, (1 order) but they came out the the price of 2 orders. They didn't toast the tortilla so i had to replace them with my Aldi one's when I got home. The carne asada was fatty and chewy. But the queso was great. After doctoring up my food, I gave my to my daughter. It's safe to say I won't be returning. I'll take my health habits up the road.

Ordered from Grubhub, food was pretty much on time, only being delivered 10 minutes past the scheduled delivery time. I got the Caribbean pizza, which sounded awesome on the menu, but I was not a big fan of it overall. The flavor of the pizza itself is nothing special compared to some other pizza places I've tried in the NE. It is also a little too thick for my liking, but some other people may enjoy that. Mozzarella fries were decent, and I would recommend those if you are into cheesy fries. My fiance enjoyed his Meat Lovers stromboli a lot, but did not care for the flavor of the pizza sauce on the side. I don't think I'll be going out of my way anytime soon to eat here, when there are better options in the area.

Chipotle was nearly 20 minutes late on delivering my order.  I called to cancel and they told me to call back after I received the order for compensation.  Well I called back and they wouldn't do anything since the order was delivered.  Talk about a BAIT and SWITCH and lying associate.  

My food was ice cold.  Don't order food from this chipotle unless you want to wait forever and end up with cold food.  And of course they won't refund you.  I'm half ready to file a complaint on BBB for straight up lying to me.

We've been ordering from this place from the Original owners when the food was good cooked right and on time! But after tonight we will no longer order from this place  They always get orders wrong etc and what was a shocker tonight is they wanted our food back to replace it for the right stuff  soooo when the delivery guy came with our right order we had to hand him the other food  Yes it's true I recorded it!! 
The young kid who is probably no more than 14 yrs old that answers the phone there is rude and Incompetent they are always clueless to when it comes to ordering from their app!! 
It's against health code to take food back that has already left the business!!!

3 for Taste, 4 for cleanliness and portion size, 4 for price, 3 for time it took for the order

I came with two friends for take-out. There is only one current table available for indoor seating. The cash register has plexiglass separating the cashier and the customer.

We ordered rice bowls with different formulations of the chicken. I got a chicken katsu bowl and was happy to have it come with a healthy portion of stir fried vegetables and a large serving of rice and chicken. I think we ended up waiting a total 15 minutes for our orders, which granted, on a Friday lunch time, is not long, it felt a bit delayed. I think the veges tasted as expected and the chicken was crispy with a nice soy garlic side sauce. I think for a meal under $10, you can definitely get full from this. 

I do commend the restaurant for cleanliness, but the space is small itself for social distancing.

Tips/Takeaways: 
Decent food for a good price and large portion size with the rice bowls. Nothing too fancy, but not disappointing. Would recommend return!

I stick with the salads here, although a coworker gets the stir fry and likes it.  The Cobb Salad (I make a few changes to it using the touch screen ordering sustem) is a bit steep ($12 when I get through with it.) but the portion is immense and I can eat some at 3 or 4 PM if I get hungry again that day.  It will not keep well the next day.

The staff is underpaid and disinterested which I fear will cause long term service issues.  The 2 guys at the wok - working very hard - were clearly ticked off about something.  Then, the oven started to smoke.

Crispy-drama at lunch.
Great quick lunch spot for poke bowls and burritos. The build your own is a great deal and was HUGE. I chose three proteins for $13 and the toppings were very generous. Loved this spot!

I used to eat at this location and the Rittenhouse location often.....well......until......I saw an employee do something very unsanitary. It wasn't the first time. There were many times I've witnessed employees handle food with bare hands and contaminate other food items. Each time I spoke up and told them they were violating Philadelphia food safety standards and that they had to wear gloves. Each time they would be indignant. Once I witnessed an employee handle raw chicken wings with bare hands and then cooked food items with those same unwashed hands. I said something again then. The last time I visited this location a food prep employee was picking her nose. I was done. I visited the Rittenhouse location after that but because of the cleanliness issues I asked a few questions about how the food was prepared. The cashier was indignant and essentially told me he would not sell to me and told me to leave while he cursed at me. I asked why and he told me he would call the police. He did. Police have been used as a tool against black people when non black people decide that they just don't want to deal with us. The event that happened at the Rittenhouse location stayed with me for a while. That cashier knew what he was doing when he called the police. He knew the potential risk to my life, but he simply didn't care. I was a black person asking questions that he didn't want to answer so it was simpler for him to just put my life in danger. So based on all of these events I would advise not to patronize either of these establishments.....not if you don't want contaminated food or to patronize racists.
I don't know what they did to the food but it turned out super duper salty. I literally had to throw out the whole thing. Def would not come back again.

So we ordered. Waited 15 minutes and showed up. This is new as this Covid distancing. The girl comes out takes my credit card and I ask her to add some vinegar to our order for our fries. She has a sweatshirt that says "Wake and Bake " on it. Yes I can relate but she is at work. She goes to another car and gets there credit card as well, goes in and runs both cc and gets our food ( which was ready and take our food outside. I ask again for the vinegar. She says ohhhhh ok.  Goes back inside, around to the inside of the kitchen and has a conversation with another girl. After a couple minutes I just left. Sadly enough I even tipped her. 
So a eye roll when I ask for something you always serve. 
And your wearing a t shirt about drugs ( while at work)
So I wouldn't have cared about the sweatshirt if I had actually gotten my order.

This is my favorite pizza in the Northeast. Always fresh and cheap. The crust, cheese, and sauce is the best. The slices are large. I usually get 2 slices and a can for $3.50. What what...you can't beat that.  They even have a 28" inch pizza if you feel like sharing. Such good hangover food!

Although their food is good I'd be very leery about ordering from them. I will NOT order from them again. I placed an order for pick up, they delivered it, It was the wrong order. Before I got home my son called to tell me it was wrong so I turned around and went back. They wanted the food BACK?!?! I said I would dispose of it, they said they HAD to. I asked if they were going to redeliver the food once it left my house. they stated they wouldn't do such a thing. So, to be safe I contacted the correct customer. They stated they were waiting for over 2 hours for their food. I told them they were sending their driver back to my house to pick up the food supposedly for disposal. I would not give it to them. The correct customer called me back a few minutes later telling me Drougie's called to tell them their driver was in an accident and that their food wouldn't be able to be delivered. I feel it is deplorable that they would have such practices. Beware. God only knows what happens to your food once it leaves that place.

I'm a big fan of poke bowls and was happy to find out PokéSpot is only a few blocks from me. They have a good space with a good amount of tables and it wasn't crowded when I stopped by after work around 5:30. I made my own bowl with brown rice (didn't expect it to be hot!), salmon (delicious), spicy salmon (delicious - goes great with salmon), avocado (always delicious), edamame (delicious), kani salad (delicious - might be my new favorite thing), masago (delicious) topped with srirachi aioli. Mix it all around and...you guessed it - delicious! Overall, I'd say the whole experience was pretty great.
Watched a roach crawl across the counter while awaiting my order. Next time, hold the appetizer!

Cheese steak was so good I forgot to take a pic of it before I devoured it! It's more of a brisket style cheesesteak. The meat was so juicy and the fries were fresh! Would definitely pop in again next time I'm in Philly.

The employees were terrible and rude and were very skimpy for no reason. I asked for rice and she gave me half a spoonful no joke and then I asked for extra and she rolled her eyes and gave me the other half. Then I asked for extra chicken and she did the same thing. She also gave my boyfriend completely brown guacamole. And the chicken was completely burnt. I'd avoid this place at all costs!

There's now a fricking Goldie here! 
I'm actually kind of angry that if I stayed in the neighborhood, I would be less than a minute away from a tehina shake. 
I think there has to be a Cook and Solomonov food combination equivalent to a Philly Taco? But less disgusting?

I thought I'd give this poke spot a shot, but the place didn't feel all too clean. Also, the smell of fish starting to turn bad was obvious. I was so turned off that I literally couldn't get past a couple bites and had to throw out my meal :( not happy about it

This place is fast, affordable, and tasty. It's in a convenient location where you are surrounded my many other restaurants, coffee shops, and dessert places.

The Mensch was of decent size, beef brisket was not too fatty, and the bread portion was perfect. The horseradish was just clunked on where the bread folds (at the bottom), and I had to eat my sammich while avoiding that area. It was too much in  too little of an area.

Jake's is good for fast sammiches, but nothing to write home about. I bet if Jake's was in another city, it would do awesome. Sadly, there's too much competition in this area in Philly.

Chix and Wings, I had such high hopes for you because you are so close to my home and I love love love wings. Alas, while the double fried had good texture the sauce was only okay, and the regular wings fell flat both on texture and taste.
I had the bacon cheeseburger all the way and small fries.  Both excellent.  The place was very clean and staff was friendly.  So fast I didn't even get to enjoy the peanuts!

This has been my go-to poke place for the past few months. Online orders have been quick and easy, which is a big help during COVID. Their portions have always been generous and ingredients have tasted consistently fresh and delicious. Definitely check this place out for poke in the Queen Village area!

I'm not a big fan of soft pretzels but with the other things they have I must say it is incredible, between the cheesesteak pretzels, pizza pretzels, and sausages. An awesome variety which includes water ice! Every time I walk in there with my daughter and they always remember us and they are so very very kind to her and she absolutely loves them watching the pretzels being made through the window. LOL
Ingredients are always fresh. I drive past like 3 different poke places to come to this one because it's so good!

Great spot! Love that they have premarinade options, I haven't seen that before. I got the chili ponzu salmon and the spicy tuna. They have a good variety of toppings and sauces. I thought the prices were pretty reasonable compared to other places. For around $12.50 I got a huge amount of food! I wish they had a 1 protein option or something smaller, because I definitely don't need all that food. It was really tasty though, and I'm glad it's in the area. I'll definitely be back!

My favorite Philly Pretzel Factory! Open during COVID-19. You can order from their takeout window or call ahead to pickup. They always have unsalted or if you call in advance, they'll make fresh ones for you. They always provide fast and very pleasant service.

Food is great. I like that they offer little burger options since I have a tendency to feel full quickly. Staff is friendly and quick.
I wouldn't suggest coming here if you have a peanut allergy though since they have peanuts all over the place that you can grab for free.
I was expecting "fast decent reasonably healthy desk lunch" - in a similar vein as a Chopt, Pret, or Chipotle. It IS that but really a league above any of those places.

I guess they e gotten some new phone and front girls working. I did not want to come back here but it's my boyfriends favorite pizza spot in the area. I have to say they're good is always pretty good. They have a great selection. Only thing is they have listen that pick up plain pizzas are 8.99 but the last two times I got charged 9.99. Only a dollar and not worth going back for but they shouldn't list a price if they can't use it.

This USED to be my Go to place. But I will NEVER AGAIN order from them again!! I ordered from their online website that's printed on their menu.. They accepted my order, took my money. An HOUR later we call to check since it's taking so long and they say they never got my order!!! ARE YOU kidding me.. mind you this is the SECOND time they have done this to me. But that's not the worst part.. after waiting almost an hour and a half my husband went to get our money back and they are saying they won't refund our money.. REALLY?!!! You took my money, didn't make my food but now you won't give me my money?!!!!! We had to threaten them with the police in order to get a refund!!!! If you can't handle having an online ordering website then take it the hell down!!! Like I said this is the SECOND time they did this to me.. I gave them another chance after the first time, but NEVER again!! My whole family orders from here but they won't anymore after I tell them about it, and anyone else I know!!! I wish I can give them negative stars!!

Popeyes is the best fast food fried chicken . For the quickness , it was perfect. The biscuit was not as warm as I expected. The chicken was delicious. I love fried chicken so if you're craving in the middle of the night for some , this is it.

When you advertise as a 24 hour McDonald's, and you are closed after midnight on two consecutive nights, that just shows that you have a staff who doesn't give a shit or a store manager who doesn't care either
Closest McDonald's to my house and for some reason their McRibs outdo other locations. No complaints whatsoever.
Red Poke Express is Poke. The Poke bowls here are amazing, the wife & daughter are awesome too. The wife makes your bowls with love . You will not be disappointed.

Full disclosure, this review is ONLY for their single slices. I've been on a bit of a quest lately to find the best slice in Philly; well, the NorthEast part of it anyway, and I've come across WAY more pretenders than contenders. But, Droughies is far and away leading the pack at the time of this writing. (By the by; how the hell do you pronounce the name of this place? "Druggies?" If so, thats unfortunate.) Anywho, I stopped in here to grab the 2 slice and a soda, $3.50 special (whoo hoo!). The slices came out quick and are even jazzed up with this circular sauce pattern on the pizza. The dough was "toothsome" (I love that word), which is a big checkmark for me. I hate dough that is either flaccid or crunchy. If I wanted a wet tortilla or a cracker, I would've ordered that, but Droughies gets the crust perfect. The sauce is the, "delicious with just a hint of sweetness" kind, and the cheese tastes like actual cheese. AND, no orange grease dripping off the slice! 

I can't give 5 stars for the entire establishment because I've only had the slices, but if their other offerings are as good as their pies, you could probably do a lot worse. Highly recommended.

They are very slow, so slow your food cools down on the assembly line.  

BUTTTTT a burrito bowl is only 4.91 (as of this post) for only rice, chicken and beans. mindblown.

Great little wing spot. The place is a bit small, so it's probably better for takeout. Decent price, it was like $12 for 10 wings + fries. Would totally recommend the wings from here, they have mostly Asian fusion type wings here.
Been here multiple times and it does not disappoint. Very generous with all the toppings you choose. I always get a create you own poke bowl. Quick and filling meal.

Failure on all levels. I visited Crisp for lunch and while I try to say something nice about all restaurants, I'm at a complete loss of positive things to say about Crisp. From the lack of friendliness of the staff to the low quality food and poor preparation, Crisp underperformed even the most basic expectations. There are far too many options in Center City, so don't waste your time with Crisp. When you're craving stir fry, check out nearby Honeygrow.

Had the Rainbow Bowl and I was pleasantly surprised by how fresh the fish tasted. At first, I underestimated the size of the bowl, but I was full afterwards.

The pineapple though, gave it an interesting taste. Seemed out of place so next time, would order that on the side, if possible.

Used Doordash as the delivery method, and it was an disorganized experience that caused an hour and a half of a delay.

As a student going to school near here, I go here very frequently. Although I've seen my fair share of bad service, I've always been able to handle it because its Chipotle; you go there for cheap food, not for the manners of its employees.

This was another issue though. Today, I dropped by around 3:30pm for a lunch since I've been studying all day. I asked for a bowl with rice and black beans, which was dutifully fulfilled, but when I asked for carnitas, the worker put chicken in the bowl instead. No biggie.

I tell her I actually asked for Carnitas.
She doesn't say anything to acknowledge me, doesn't even look up at me.
I tell her again. 
She ignores me again. This time, she starts talking to her co-worker behind her about something else, while she starts working on a new bowl. At this point, she has not acknowledged that I've said anything at all. 
I tell her once again.
She looks straight back and yells straight in my face, "I KNOW!"

I've dealt with the other problems here, including messed up orders, the saltiness/blandness of the food, little pieces of plastic in my burrito, the "can't-be-fucked" attitude of the workers, but today was a first. 

 Never have I ever been yelled at in a restaurant for a mistake that the worker made. At no point did she seem the least interesting in dealing with me until she literally yelled at me, and there was no follow-up either. I don't even use Yelp, but I literally created an account because I'm just fed up with this.

My son and daughter in law ordered Chipotle for my grandson and I.  3 Steak soft shell taco with Extra Steak, Cheese, tomatoes and 3 Chicken soft shell tacos with Extra Chicken, rice, tomatoes, cheese and sour cream.  They came bunched up in 1 piece of foil for 3 chicken  & 1 piece for 3 Steak, San the Extra meat which we paid for & Squashed up & VERY SLOPPILY THROWN TOGETHER!!! I don't want to gross anyone out, but it look like leftover trash from someone's meal!  I wouldn't have fed this to my dog!!!!!!!   I called the store and talked with the new manager who was VERY APOLOGETIC & tried to tell me how to get my refund back from Doordash but I explained that my children had gotten it for us and they were not going to go through the trouble!  So my grandson and I ordered from Southside pizza and threw the trash from Chipotle away!!!!! I am SOOOOOO DISAPPOINTED IN THIS LOCATION WHICH IS NEAR ME but EVERYTIME I ORDER FROM THIS ONE LOCATION, IT ALWAYS LOOKS LIKE THEY DON'T CARE WHAT THEY SERVE YOU!!!!!!!!!!   Hopefully, the new manager will turn things around-HE sounds like he has the PASSION, THIS LOCATION WAS LACKING!!!!!!l

OMG, Caffe Chicco was certainly outstanding. Very friendly service with a great atmosphere. These guys have a fantastic menu too. Service was awesome and everyone working here was very nice and helpful. Caffe Chicco = Awesome.
Had the Phoenix bowl and it was delicious. Good size portion. I was able to walk in and order- will definitely be back for more!

Got lunch from here for the first time in a while.

Tell me why I asked for "no cheese" in my salad about 5 times and there is cheese in my salad. The lettuce is old and is more pink than green. For $8 there are plenty of better places to go for lunch. Not coming back.

The preparation at this location is mediocre at best. They seem to always be overwhelmed with mobile pickup orders or Ubereats types of orders. 

I've ordered for pickup and went home to find my order completely wrong! I ordered chicken and they gave me steak or vice versa. 

Additionally, the staff can be so overwhelmed that they forget to pack items entirely! If I did not pick it up, I wouldn't have been able to remind the cashier for both my drink and my side! 

I walked in and saw 2 employees rapidly packing orders from a screen and they were scrambling! Meanwhile, a small crowd of waiting customers were forming. It looked disastrous 

The staff could definitely use better training or more employees to handle the volume of orders. Especially to improve their quality of service and food preparation.

I ordered $89.00 in food through Grubhub and my driver delivered my food to someone else's house cause we never got it . However I called five guys and they made it right he fixed my whole order over and I picked it up. That's alright , good business I will eat at five guys from this point forward it was suggested by my daughter and for that I am forever a loyal customer.The food was good so take it from me leave Grubhub and door dash alone they are trash and hire thieves to deliver their food . Everyone has GPS no use to getting lost and houses are numbered so no need to deliver to the wrong spot apparently their employees can't read. But five guys are great and I appreciate their kindness .

We got the cheesesteak on garlic bread.  It was very good garlic bread.  It had a good amount of finely chopped meat. The cheese added flavor to the Cheesesteak but it needed a more thorough melt. $8.10 after tax, take out only and home to the 28' Pizza.  It was a good Cheesesteak experience.
They haven't really been doing so good when it comes to social distancing. I have been there when there wasn't a pandemic and I enjoyed them much more
Awesome place for Poke. I'll grab a bowl and take it to a park nearby. "It's like sushi deconstructed" - Jared

Very fresh poke. I had build my own bowl with greens but don't expect much of it. I asked my miso dressing to be put on the side for my to go. I couldn't find it after I left  the store. Either they forgot or it's mixed in. 

When you build your own, you check mark the ingredients that you want. You can double or triple it to meet your limits. The staff is really helpful in explaining the ingredient that you aren't familiar.

Don't skip the seaweed. It's fresh and really good. Perfect complement to my poke.
There are some seats available for dine in

Missing Hawaii and was craving poke, so we decided to get some from Red Poke Express, since the reviews look promising.

This was our first time ordering from Red Poke Express, and our expectations were adjusted, because mainland poke just isn't going to be as good.

When we first saw the takeout container it looked small, but once we started digging in, we realized how big the portions actually were.

Overall, Red Poke Express exceeded expectations. The raw fish was fresh and cut up in nice medium chunks. For the price, quality and portions, this was pretty great. This will be our choice spot for poke for now. The sauces were okay, but so is the sauce everywhere else.

Ordered delivery last night - won't be jumping to order from here ever again... 
To start, the man who took our order was rude...
My younger brother is obsessed with cheese fries (he gets them from everywhere) the fries were SOGGY & he said the side of cheese was gross... I was shocked, I've never heard him say this about any other place we've ordered from before. My boyfriend got the chicken basket platter, he said the fried chicken was good BUT his fries as well were SOGGY. I got the chicken parm platter, they pre-cut my chicken for me which isn't terrible but all my breading had fallen off - I am a girl who enjoys extra cheese (I did not request extra cheese) but the amount they piled on top was TOO much - the sauce was very watery, the pasta underneath was just not good. 3 items (1 being only an order of cheese fries) at almost $40 for this experience was definitely not worth it.

The falafel salad was way too salty! I felt like they dropped a whole damn salt shaker inside. The only redeeming quality was the sweet beets that counteracted the salt. The dressing was pretty creamy and tasty but alas the salt content ruined the dish.

I am excited to have tried Red Poke since I moved nearby! There aren't many poke options in Philly and this one exceeded expectations. I got a brown rice bowl with salmon and they had great toppings including mango and pineapple. For $12 it was a lot of food and very reasonable price for poke. My only complaint was that they didn't mix the sauce with the protein and toppings as most poke places do. I'll definitely be back soon!

I picked up my chipotle meal from 3925 Walnut Street in Philadelphia after ordering online. First, I noticed that the bowl was extremely light so I opened it and noticed that it was missing almost everything I asked for. I told the cashier and they didn't say sorry and just gave me an annoyed look and took my bowl back. After getting it back, I thought everything was fine. Then noticed that there was no meat (I got carne asada) AND the rice was hard and undercooked. I am currently recooking the rice in my rice cooker as I type this

The food from the other location on 20th has been decent, but the service at this particular location is terrible. The young lady at the register was completely rude to customers: Refusing to answer questions about the menu and pointing. Turning her back on one who had a question about his order.

I wanted something different than our usual (Indian or Mexican) and this place is pretty close to us. My husband is all about volume of food, and on first glance he thought that this wasn't going to be enough food. He was surprised to find how full he got. We've ordered several times since. We often get the fire bowl - love the salmon, little bit of heat, sweet of the fruit and the crunch bits. It's such a satisfying meal!

BEST MENU EVER!  They have my favorite fries..Steak cut fries.  I think they have over 20 combination of just french fries alone.  If you are craving it, they probably have it.  I like their pizza too.  I usually pick up single slice pizza, though. It is super thin, nice and crispy.  Good choice for take-out.

I visited the opening day yesterday around 7pm and have been debating since then how many stars to give. I'll start with the one positive, this location is ideal for those who work west of City Hall. I'm not sure whether to cut this place slack or feel they should have done better but when we arrived they only had 4 (meat/fish) options. The line was long and overall it took us about an hour to get our food. The place was HOT! Like I'm standing in one spot sweating gross hot. I'm not sure if the AC was broken, couldn't go higher, too many people? It was just super uncomfortable. The employees looked tired and irritated which is understandable but still we're the customer and that left a bad taste in my mouth. Speaking of bad taste, the food...pretty gross honestly. I was forced to get chicken (that in itself is a crime, chicken on a poke bowl, yuck) which I paired with shrimp, white rice, mango, corn, cucumber, pickled ginger and for sauce the Sesame Ginger. The chicken and sauce were both bland in my opinion. My friend and I did the BOGO free and out total almost came to $15 and neither of us had anything extra so compared to other places this is def on the pricey side. Will I return, ehhh maybe in a few months when they sort out the kinks.

Absolutely disgusting you might as well eat at freaking McDonald's unbelievable. And here I thought McDonald's was the worst place on planet earth. I guess I was wrong I guess it's every place in Philly so far I have eaten is disgusting

Burger is disgusting! Figures of course Philly has the most disgusting five guys on planet earth!

 I can tell you they would be rolling over in their graves at the five guys down south

You know McDonald's they never melt cheese who the he**wants to eat a burger with not melted cheese

Burger so well done I might as well eat a hockey puck holy crap if I could use cursewords on here I would I'm tired of paying for garbage food

DISGUSTING I WANT TO THROW UP...

Let's not forget the five guys is known for their fries right not this one horrible

OK I am going to throw up this is so disgusting. I promise you if you go to Wilson's Torresdale grill During the week daytime hours and only you will never eat at this place ever again I promise you

I suggest every employee go try their burger they will not eat at five guys I promise you I bet $1000 on this five guys most disgusting one I've ever been to I want my money back I'm going to throw up

Goldie offers Mediterranean food at reasonable prices.  They are located in the downtown Philadelphia Whole Foods Market.  I get the falafel sandwich and a sour cherry iced tea.  All for about $10.  It's a must stop if your hungry while shopping at Whole Foods.  Also try their tehina shakes.  They are fantastic!!!
This place said it was open 24 hours on Friday and Saturday and it's closed. Tried calling and no one answered.

I always order takeout on caviar from pokespot because it is convenient and has more options of sides compared to other poke spots.
Their quality and quantity is very inconsistent tho. Sometimes I get a good blend of tuna with similar sizes. One time I had several huge chunks of tuna that were not cut into smaller dices as should.
Previously I also always had some addon items missing. Recently they seem to quit doing that and instead chose to pour half a bowl of sauces in to my pokebowls.
I find it funny that they keep making different and new mistake. Im not sure if they do it only to takeouts. 
I probably will still order from them  because of their overall variety.
And I hope one day they can grow to a business with consistent qualities and portions.

Theres only 2-3 Poke (pronounced Po-kay) spots in this area so options are limited but I definitely think poke bowls are a great healthy filling meal. The bowls are really fresh and served with your base of choice.  (zucchini noodles, califlower rice, white or brown rice among other options). Plus there's so many toppings to choose from! I got the chili ponzu salmon (poke bowls are made with raw fish). It came with scallions, cilantro, sesame seeds, edamame, mango, onion crisps and fish eggs (masago). So many flavors but they all worked perfectly together.  If I'm looking for a fresh meal, I'll definitely head here. 

Average price is $9-$12. So set your expectations!

Have been ordering here for about 15 years. It has always been mediocre at best. Tonight has made it simply bad. 

We ordered a margherita pizza (sauce, fresh mozzarella, tomato, basil), but we didn't get that. Instead they sent a white pizza with sliced tomatoes on it. Spent 15 minutes on the phone with them trying to straighten out the order. They ended up sending us a text showing the menu ingredients saying we got what we ordered. Also ordered mozzarella sticks. There were only four in the container (even though the menu says you get 6) for $7.50. 

They lost a customer.

Heart shaped pretzels were the perfect ending "favor" for our daughter's wedding.  This location came up with the idea of bagging two heart pretzels together with mustard. They were displayed and ready for our guests to take home at the end of the evening.  They were fresh, delicious, and the perfect ending to our Philly wedding with many out of towners.  When our guests realized the pretzels were in the shape of hearts, it was that much more special!  Thank you to the GM/Owner for making the pretzels so unique and special for our daughter's wedding!

Really wanted to get a feel for what a true Philly cheesesteak sandwich would taste like so my bf and I decided to try the jake sandwich (steak and provolone cheese) ($8.50) with an order of fried pickles ($2) and small fries ($1.50).

We found that the sandwich was ok - it was a little dry and could do with more grilled onions and needed sauce. The fried pickles were yummy and went well with the dipping sauce. The fries were very crispy.

Although we weren't that impress with the sandwich we still want to come back to try the other ones - maybe the classic was just too plain.

I want to give this restaurant kudos but Slan Grubhub one last chance and all of my order was not delivered when I called the driver back to inquire and text him no response. Grub hub you need to stop hiring hungry people  ........ however the manager at this restaurant was honest enough to fulfill our order once more and for that I thank her and will always patronize this McDonald's. Of course now I will call in and pick up people pat too many fees through DoorDash and Grubhub to be ripped off . Thanks McDonald's

Visited Philly for a week and came here twice for their vegan tahini milkshakes. So unbelievably tasty - get this to treat yourself or just because! 

I tried the Turkish coffee and mint chocolate chip flavors and definitely preferred the former because it was not as sweet.

I've never written a yelp review in my life but I had too about this dumpster of a so called Mexican restaurant. The lady at the register tried to charge me for hot sauce, It was for my tacos. The employees making the food don't wear gloves and look like they're on work release. I don't think I've never finished 3 tacos in my life but this was a first. The chicken looked like shavings from Mrs Doubtfire's legs. I think the nacho chips were from the dollar store or something. You, 100%, could make better tacos out of a kit from a store.

I came in on Saturday around 11:44 and saw a sign stating that they were out of chicken and shrimp. Thankfully I didn't order anything with it. 

I ordered signature spicy salmon and at the end the guy who helped me with my order had to go to the basement to get the sauce. I saw only him at the store.

It's completely a different scene than the last time I was there. It seems like the store is not prepared for business.

It's a shame to see because it's my favorite poke place.
Small, pop-in location. Staff was friendly and service was quick. Was there midday on the weekend and not too busy.

Chix is OK. I originally wanted a 4 piece chicken tender meal. I was told that they were out of chicken tenders. Kinda surprising given that this place has chicken in its name. I order some wings instead. 10 minutes later, I'm told they suddenly have tenders again. I now have to wait again for the tenders. 

The batter is really similar to Korean style fried chicken. Not really a fan. Fries seemed to be the generic thick cut fries that probably come out of the freezer.

The menu is really weird. There's everything from Bahn Mi, to teriyaki bowls, to rotisserie-style chicken.

Five guys is a step above "fast food" burgers like McDonalds, Wendy's, etc. However, it's not much better tasting for the price. They are much bigger burgers with more toppings. It's pretty plain tasting for the amount of toppings though. 

I do want to comment that the service at this location is very good. They made our order wrong and when we brought it up to them they made us a new burger.

I ordered chicken and biscuits from this KFC via Grubhub; 1 drum, 3 wings, 2 biscuits. So how it they did not put the other wings in the box baffles me? And the biscuits were dry and crumbly, like it was from yesterday's old batch. This order was total trash. It only takes once for me.
Smaller store. Very clean. Staff usually friendly. Seems a bit confusing there the way counter is set up

Definitely understand why Qdoba is more popular around these parts. 

Back home, Chipotle was always my go-to, but I don't think I'll be going back to this store anytime soon. I ordered through the mobile app and waited over thirty minutes for my order. Good thing they didn't even make it! Even when I asked the cashier if my order was ready, she nodded her head and looked away- completely ignoring me. 

They have loads of bagged mobile orders on their counters and maybe call it out every 15 minutes or so. it's a mini competition to see who can get the attention of the cashier to individually check for their order completion. There was over 10 people standing to get their pick up orders beside me, and a guy was even there before me... waiting more than 30 minutes for fast food is insane to me. A woman who was frustrated even asked to be refunded for her order and the cashier was no help at all. Meanwhile, the mobile orders are super inconsistent and a group walked in and out to pick up within two minutes while a huge crowd had to wait. 

I got my refund through the mobile app after waiting around 35 minutes since the store was so chaotic and I just knew I'd be there for hours- I wonder if they have bad transference from the app to this store specifically? 

The one time my order worked last week, the food was not good at all, apparent that they don't follow Chipotle protocol. The white rice had no flavor- no saltiness/lime, the beans were wet and flavorless too, etc. The only enjoyable thing was the chicken. I hope Chipotle HQ checks up on this store's food prep, management, and ordering issues.

We were looking for a quick lunch following a funeral nearby. This place had some great reviews so we gave it a whirl. The staff was friendly, fortunately it wasn't crowded. We ordered their specialty- roast beef sandwiches, sat down and a few minutes later our order came out. I rarely order roast beef but this was on point. Everything that makes a classic sandwich- beef was juicy and tender, just the right amount of "au jus", sharp provolone, crusty roll, dollop
of horseradish- I topped mine off with a roasted long hot pepper. Totally forgot to take a photo. But there's a reason people are saying they are better than Nick's.  The menu isn't extensive, but it doesn't need to be. Definitely recommend giving this spot a shot. 

I will caution that there are only a few tables, so I'm guessing they do a lot of take out business.

Just my third 1 Star Review on Yelp and this Popeyes location deserves it 100%. To start this place is filthy from the customer section to the sloppiness behind the counter. 

The sweet heat sauce at this location is almost always out of stock BUT they magically will give you some portioned in their own disposable cup. Hmmm weird, gross , and no thx!!

We were pumped to try the new chicken sandwich but knew this location will probably disappoint us. We risked it and went on a Friday night and arrived at 7:45 pm. There were only 3 people ahead of us and about 5 behind us when we went to order. 

I wanted one original and one spicy but plain. No mayo/sauce/pickles. I was turned away Bc they said they had pre made the rest of the sandwiches until close. Hmmm ok?! Then he followed up with this location only serves them how they come.. ok enjoy it I will take my business else where. 

I see no management responds to this location... wonder why.. wonder how this dirty location is still in business.

I've never had an issue with my food here. Always fresh and fast! There no drive through, but I think its worth parking and going in to get a tasy juicy burger that never disappoints. A bit pricy but Treat Yo Self!

Absolutely amazing. Not only is the food delicious and fresh and healthy, but the customer service is fantastic. My family and I have ordered catering from Goldie's twice for family events. My sister and I were taken care of by Sara the second time we picked up catering and she was so genuinely kind and helpful!!

This random listing came up on my Uber eats with a buy 1 get 1 burrito deal.  Not knowing what this was I wanted to dig in and try this deal. So ordered the fries burrito with chicken and one with beef.  

Searching for this spot I had no idea where/what this was until I had to call Uber eats and they told me check behind the library.  I thought it might have been a ghost kitchen inside the Acme but not so. 

Politely surprised at the massive size of the burritos.  They were also tasty better than Chipotle which I think are bland and flavorless and these come with a side of cheese sauce if you ask.  Overall awesome bogo deal.  It was originally listed at $14 but now comes in at $16.  I would never buy one at that price but with the deal makes it worth it.

Ahhh good old poke bowl places. This place is pretty good. Like the bowl was filled and there was no small or large just good fish, unlimited toppings... and a nice place to grab lunch. 

Only thing was the salmon had a slightly fishy taste. Like very slightly but nonetheless it was there and wanted to point it out.

Every single time I have been here, they screw up my order. Every. Single. Time.

If you use their drive through, make sure you check that you have everything you ordered before you pull away, because I guarantee they didn't give you everything. Otherwise you will have to go inside and stand there and wait while the staff ignores you until you have to try to get their attention. In which case, they'll act like they're the inconvenienced party.

I'm done going to this location because their baseline is incompetence.

I order from here a few times per week.  Pizza is tasty just make sure you ask for it well done or it comes a little soggy.  Their wraps are delicious and full of meat.  I like that they have a kids menu as well.  They do sometimes forget something but when I call are quick to replace it.

I went in having seen several Facebook postings from friends and some good looking pictures of sandwiches.  I specifically went for the decadence of the 50/50 - "l/2 pork, l/2 smoky grilled bacon with house sriracha spread and sharp provolone."  The sandwich had a couple of slices of bacon, but it definitely wasn't 50/50.   I'm happy to pay for a good sandwich, but this one wasn't as stuffed as I would expect for the price - more bread than meat.  BTW - the menu prices on Facebook aren't the same as in the restaurant.

We managed to check out Red Poke on its opening day.  Spoiler: the food was great and the service friendly.  Obviously, my expectations weren't at max given the short runway they faced, so I'll point out some gaps but believe they are all just a matter of time.

We built our own bowl with 2 proteins.  We also ordered a miso soup.  First, it was pleasant to see yellow tail as an option for one of the proteins, as it is usually just standard tuna (which I like and ordered as well).  We pilled on the extras like mix-ins, toppings, and crunch.  Again, it was great to see some non-standard toppings (at least for the poke places I've explored).  The bowl came filled to the top but was lightly on the sauce (which was immediately corrected with a small side provided by the staff).  

Billed at $9.75 the price was more than fair for the portion.  The miso soup was good as well.  However, the bowl was kind of small for $2.50. The Ginger Wasabi Shoyu sauce really took the bowl from good to great.  Therefore, I clearly recommend you go with it!

Service was on point in greeting us, explaining the menu, and making sure we had a seat.  Making the bowl was a bit slow, especially considering the limited number of folks waiting at the time,however, I blame that on being new / opening day jiggers.

Overall, I'm a fan.  I should be back (when I make it to that part of town).  I'll also encourage others to give them a taste!

Somewhere in the back pages of whatever newsletter the secret cabal of fast foot chains subscribe to, I imagine a simple three word ad beckoned.  Jefferson Needs Lunch!   Certainly on entering this new Five Guys location, I got the impression it's goal was to meet the lunchtime demands of Jefferson University Hospital.  Everyone inside appeared to be either college age, or wearing scrubs.  Seeing a gaunt thoracic surgeon gave me a morbid chuckle, clearly he must be scouting his future patients.  It seems like this location was opened in a hurry, it is more spartan than most other location I've been to, and everything feels very temporary.
