The staff generally isn't the most friendly, most of them seem miserable and as if they hate their jobs. Some of them seem lost and just standing around. They don't seem very efficient either- the wait time is pretty long for a fast food restaurant. The dining room is usually messy- overflowing trash cans, tables that clearly haven't been wiped all shift, trash on the floor-which could be blamed by messy customers- however the employees should keep up on it. Soda machine selection seems to be slim some days- a lot of stuff tends to be out. The "fresh" lemonade tends to look pitiful- practically emptied. 
Overall this place has turned into such a dump, such a shame because it was close and convenient for "quick" meals.

I work in Old City, have eaten at almost every establishment. This by far is the worst of the worst. Definitely not AUTHENTIC...I don't know where  some of you may have eaten who has cooked for you, but this is definitely not good food. I feel sorry for the people who actually came back.

I'm not rabbit to eat lettuce!
I was there and I order to go to try this restaurant when I got home and start eating sandwiches mostly lettuce not falafel and shawarma.

If I could give them ZERO stars I so would. They do not give a fuck what goes in your bag if it's hot nothing. I called the number to make a complaint heard nothing back. If you want some good Wendy's take the time to go to 69 or Broomall. Boycott this Wendy's.

I came to Mamoun's because I went to another place up the street and they don't take credit cards. I am so glad that they forced me to find somewhere else because Mamoun's is friggn awesome!  I got a falafel plate which has a good amount of food on it and comes with pita. It was so good. I mean really good. The falafels were cooked to a very nice crisp which I got with the rice, and the pickled turnip and actual pickles were perfect with it. The person who took my order was nice and friendly and I felt welcome and knew that I definitely would come back. Also, the bathroom was really clean. It was a good experience. I wish I had taken pics.

if i could rate this mcdonald's lower than 1 star, i would. this mcdonald's was the grossest place i've ever been to. not to mention, the employees were rude and fisty. so it was a nice sunday afternoon and my uncle was picking up some food for the family. when he got home, my grandpa took a bite into his burger and you best believe there was a whole ass wood chip in there. the size was 3/4 of a patty. i am very surprised he didn't chip a tooth lol!! so my mom drove herself back to mcdonald's to complain for my grandpa and they first went to the back to talk about her, they then got 4 employees to come out at yell at her and accuse her of lying. i promise you, the employees were one of the rudest group of employees i've ever met. first of all, WHO HAS THE TIME AND ENERGY TO WASTE GAS TO GO AND MAKE UP A LIE TO GET $5 BACK. anyway, long story short, don't go to this mcdonald's unless you're looking to get sick or choke on something :) have a good day!!!

We ordered via grubhub and were fans overall. They forgot my avocado which I paid extra for, and they also forgot my wasabi. The poke bowl 'build your own' was very good, but the sushi my fiance ordered was just ok. pretty bland. I did really like that you could choose your sugar content for the milk teas; I usually don't get them because they're too sweet but I enjoyed the one I got this time around. Would get the bowl and tea again but not the sushi.
Order a chicken combo meal at daughter request. She complained the chicken died thirsty. Moisture came from temperatures of the sandwich.

I was trying to place an order and ALL of the workers were cursing and messing around doing everything but work taking orders. They were even cursing while finally taking  my order, the most ridiculous thing I ever experienced

They make their fries fresh everytime and I applaud them for that but COME ON! Why is it ALWAYS so slow?! And why do the people working there seem to just not give one shit about their jobs. It's very disheartening.

Anthony W. was the shift leader during our visit! He was attentive to our orders and continued great customer service even after our pizza's we finished!  I have many food allergies and I know every time I come my pizza is safe from any contamination. It is prepared quickly and with care each time! Great food, great staff, 10/10 recommend!!

This is a great spot for falafels.  I usually order the same thing every time I come here.  The lamb falafel sandwich and a mango juice drink.  The sandwich is quite the site when you see it.  It is a large pouch of pita bread that is packed with lettuce and lamb meat.  It is quite large and so I find this to be a good value.  The mango juice itself is also very good and tastes natural.  

Service is quick and there is also a large individual bathroom for use.  Great spot for a quick, cheap, and satisfying meal.

This place is amazing. I bought my kids with me to get  lunch and they loved it. It's very clean and the staff are amazing and super nice. Especially Shaniece!!!!! She had a conversation with my child and was extremely helpful with helping us get our order together. We will be coming back to this establishment.

If you never been to any Shake Shack, go back in the womb and restart your life. The best chicken and shroom burgers everrrr! May look plain but there is FLAVOR (I don't really eat beef but everyone says their burgers are good) Omg I always mention how picky I am in my reviews right? Very important. I don't even KNOW what's in the shack sauce and I could eat a bucket of it, ok that's gross but you get the point. I used to live in NY so when they finally came to Philly I was likeee hallelujah!!! Where else can you get a bomb sandwich, quick, with a glass of wine or a beer? I'll wait.

I was pretty disappointed in my visit at Tea Bowl Shop. I specifically came for the bubble tea so I cannot speak for the quality of the poké bowls, but the bubble tea was lackluster.

Originally, I wanted to order the various fruity drinks I saw through Yelp pictures from this establishment. I showed a couple to the cashier and he told me that those were not on the menu so I couldn't order them. Although that was a damper, I decided to go for a passion fruit green tea.

The taste was off -- tasted like the fruit syrup they used was either sitting out all day or unclean. I couldn't really get past this. It was not worth the $4. 

Service was average considering there was only one person serving as cashier and barista at the same time. He was quite impolite, but not going to hold that against him since I'm only there for the bubble tea. 

I'm a huge bubble tea fan and this place just doesn't live up to my bare minimum of expectations.

Everyone is trashing this place, but one, it's McDonald's. Let's be real. These guys do a fine job getting food to you fast. Sometimes it's a little backed up, especially around dinner time, but they are well-meaning and hardworking.  Check your order if you use the drive-thru, but you should be doing that anyway. Staff is nice and quick most of the time.

I saw that this place had opened and I wanted to stop by for a late lunch, so today I got the fried chicken biscuit, and my expectations were very high. But when I got my biscuit, it seemed a bit dry and broke apart on me. The chicken seemed to be fried at least 2 hours ago because it was dry and chewy. The price was a bit high for the portion, but I'll come back to try the yam fries, the deep fryer was broken when I stopped by. :( 

-NEW UPDATE-
I came back for the yam fries today. I was really excited to try them, so I ordered it to go to share with my family. But when I opened the box, they were all burnt! I waited about 15 minutes for them too, very upsetting and won't be coming back. I want my $8 back!

We had a cooking mishap last night with dinner and hubby saved us by ordering Shake Shack so we could quickly eat something delicious. He ordered the new KFC sandwich and I ordered the Shack Stack with the Shroom burger and a regular burger patty (comfort food vibes). We also picked up a small side of fries with the new Gochujang sauce. The Shack Stack was cheesy, delicious, and consistent with what I expected. 

The new Korean inspired items were less impressive. The chicken sandwich was good, but KFC is typically very crunchy chicken and this sandwich was not. We've ordered KFC to-go from other places in the pandemic and it held up its crunch so I don't think the takeout aspect was the culprit here. The Gochujang sauce was a good sauce but it tasted like any other burger sauce or spicy mayo. That could just be my unfamiliarity with what Gochujang sauce is or should taste like. It was still a good sauce and the fries were consistent with what I expect from Shake Shack.

Great job with the consistency of the normal menu items and with social distancing, etc. at the store. "Meh" to the Korean inspired items from me.

This location just opened and it's so nice! You can't order from an actual person anymore but instead order at a kiosk, submit your number, and then they text you when it's ready. So much nicer than having to use those dirty vibrating discs that other locations have. The only thing is that if you want something extra (like extra pickles), you can't tell them when you are ordering but have to go up to the people making food and then let them know. The employees are super super helpful. She offered to get the extra pickles for me and also brought our food out to us and cleaned our trash up. Service kinda reminded me of chick fil a, but better! They also constantly went around wiping down tables. The burgers were fresh as always and I tried a vanilla milkshake for the first time. The milkshake was solidly good, but it had some icy bits in it which weren't great, I would prob get a milkshake from them again though. Overall really great experience!

So this place is really a joke yeah three workers one sitting down and the other two standing around and soon as I walk in he tells me all you have to go to the computer in order I can't take your order at the register why would I ever come here ever again

I ordered a sandwich and fries using a coupon on the mobile app thinking id have an easy weeknight free dinner. Well i was there over 45 minutes and left empty handed. I went thru the drive thru to ask what was up and the girl was so rude to me and said i needed to come inside. Dont waste your time with mobile ordering or with the shit staff.
I was very excited to try this place but was disappointed with their chicken kebob sandwich which later gave me a severe stomachache. The only good thing about my experience was the mint lemonade.

My husband and I ordered take out from Shake Shack the other day. We live about 4 blocks away and our food was ready by the time we got there, which we appreciated! They had a covid bouncer, enforcing a strict one person/group in, one out. So we were especially glad we had ordered beforehand because the line to order was somewhat long.

We got home and unpacked our food. We both ordered the regular shack burger and I ordered hot spicy fries. The burgers are amazing! Like so amazing you wonder how the hell did they make a fast food burger so delicious?!  It was juicy, flavorful and cheesey! 

The hot and spicy fries were so spicy, I was running to my fridge, grabbing the milk and drinking directly from the jug! I honestly thought spicy meant like Cajun seasoning, where it had a little kick to it. I was so very wrong! My husband tried them and he was also shocked by how hot they were. He couldn't eat them either.

Overall, food is great! Watch out for the spicy fries, though! If you order them, you might consider asking for the spicy seasoning on the side. We will definitely order from here again!

I went on January 3rd at night and spent $38.19.
My daughter happy meal didn't bring her apple slices and she got nuggets and it didn't bring any dipping sauce. I bought (3) 6 piece nuggets didn't give me any dipping sauce. I order a large chocolate frosty-ccino it tasted horrible!, I tried putting sugar at home to try to drink it but it was still super bitter. I paid $7.39 for a taco salad they didn't give me the chili, salsa, sour cream, chips or the extra shredded cheese I paid for - so I paid 7.39 just for a bowl of plain lettuce and few pieces of tomatoes. A huge order and didn't even get 1 napkin or a fork for my expensive salad SMH...

I live a block away so I come here several times a month. Service is quick, however the workers are rude and occasionally mess up your order. The building hasn't been updated in awhile, so expect to go to a 80's-90's era McDonald's. I ordered a McFlurry and they "didn't have ice cream", so I had to order something else. Dissapointing.

This is a fast-casual spot that serves up good falafel sandwiches, shwarma or kebab near the Independence Mall/Old City area. It's a good place to stop by if you work in the area or are walking through shopping or browsing the historic sites. I like the East Village falafel sandwich and the mint lemonade. Eat in, take out or get it delivered using Yelp.

I did have to wait about 2 minutes for the young lady to get some salad dressing, but it's not the end of the world. They've gotten a lot better since opening. I'll be back.

This place never disappoints!!! Every time I come here the staff is very polite and my order is always done right. Blake is great and he helps clear the line and get customers in and out in a hurry. I hope Blaze is around for a long time because they make my pizza life complete

Great hummus, baba ganoush, and tabouleh. I ordered the platter with those three items plus chicken. Great flavor, perfect creaminess of the hummus. The baba is light and perfect flavorings. The chicken is grilled and not dry but it's not a big size.

The desserts are delicious and fresh too. You don't want to skip it.

The pita is fresh and moist. Perfect for dipping the hummus.

Great service and very helpful in fixing my order due to some misunderstanding.

Believe it or not...not all shake shack's are the same.  Some are larger, some are more convenient, and some could be less crowded.  This location happens to be all 3 of these reasons.  

This is a newer location that opened up in the past two years.  Now there is a Shake Shack on both sides of Broad St.  While I like the other location, it's can be a wait for your order.  Not so with this branch.  lo and behold, there are order kiosks to be used for NFC and charge card payments.  I can't tell you how much easier this makes ordering.  No need to wait in line while someone ahead figures their order out when they get to the register.  There are several kiosks here that allow you to choose dine-in or take out before proceeding to the actual food items.  When you are finally finished you can pay with Apple or Google Pay or a credit/debit/gift card.  Super easy order process.  Those paying with cash or just want to talk to someone can order from the persons at the register.   I like the option of ordering from the kiosk when their are lines.  This enabled you to avoid them.  

You have the option to enter your cell phone number for a notification when your order is ready.  I did this, but I was greeted, with a nice surprise.  An employee brought more order to me after calling my name out.  I did not even have to go back to the register area for pickup!

The location is also notable for having a lot of space.  There is a lot of seating space available.  I have also noted that this location is also a bit less busy than the location at 20th and Sansom.  Also makes for more seating space.  

I have not noticed any difference with the food here.  It is the same price and quality.

I am not mad about this create your own pizza with unlimited topic for under $10 trend going on in Philly right now. We have Snap ($8) and more recently &pizza ($9.50). Blaze opened yesterday by Drexel University offering pizza, a few salads (skip them), and agua frescas (do not skip). Like the others, Blaze has an assembly line set up and they also promise a 2 minute cook time. The casual space has two stories with plenty of tables. 


I ordered the "red vine" pie with ovalini mozz, cherry tomatoes, with red sauce to which i added goat cheese, roasted garlic, and salami.  To offer a full comparison to Snap:  topping selection is similar but Snap offers truffle oil. Snaps pies are slightly larger and they  offers great salads, but Blaze's crust is better. Blaze has a convenient cardboard top and bottom that separate for easy eating on the go.

A very nice location and likely the best in Philly. This Shake Shack is one of the first to introduce a self order and payment system. It is very efficient and makes it easy to order without having to wait in a long line. The service is fast and the workers are extremely nice and talkative. The staff will go above and beyond to make your experience great here. 

This establishment is very clean and has very nice decor and a good amount of searing and televisions. I would also like to complement the great music choice. 

The food here is very good. A new item on the menu is the chicken bites, which come in a variety of sizes. These bites are brand new and extremely tasty. They have a soft juicy consistency on the and are very crispy on the outside. They are probably the best I've ever eaten at a fast food joint. Well seasoned and definitely a great addition to the menu. 

I also recommend any of the burgers and shakes on the menu. They are always good and have a great taste. They have excellent lemonade and will give you refills if you ask. 

This is definitely the best location of Shake Shack that I have ever been to. Staff are nicer than most joints and the self order as well as the cashier order are both options here. It is very convenient and they give you very good service. I strongly recommend this location

We made mobile orders at this shake shack. They were always ready by the time stated it will be ready on the app. The employees were courteous and quick. The food was still hot. However the second time which was the next day, it was past rush-hour and the food got a bit cold. The mushroom burger wasn't as good since the cheese kinda solidified and wasn't melted like the first time I ordered there. I would still go back for another burger.

Let me also note, it was 7pm. Literally dinner time for most establishments.

Pizza was good it had a nice Zesty sauce like i like, it Could've been cooked longer but it was good. They have good Cheese Fries like back in the old days.  Customer service was good. I would try this Spot again.

Even before Covid, this place is a pretty bad Wendy's. I've literally never gone up to the drive through windows without having to wait to give my order, repeat it, and wait a long time to get it. Overall I think the fastest I've ever gotten out of the drive through was still 10 minutes, and I place my
orders in advance on the app... 

The inside is also super gross, and the workers are always rude. I know fast food service is an awful job, but dang you don't need to scowl at me when I say thank you. Yeesh.

after waiting half an hour standing outside they gave me the hamburger without bread tube to wait 35 more minutes for them to put bread is a total waste of time

4/15/17: Service was unfriendly, yet efficient, the cherry Coke tasted 'off,' the onion rings were pretty lousy and the "new, crispy chicken sandwich," (which is why I went in the first place - it looked so good in the commercials) it wasn't ... it wasn't good.
It'll probably be years before I again eat Burger King ... but I definitely will not eat at this location again, it's been nasty for a long time.

I know blaze pizza is a chain, so this review is more about their business model rather than this specific location. This location itself is fine and a great spot for temple students. I came during a slow period, so I didn't have to wait too long to order or get my pizza. 

Blaze, as opposed to other DIY/pick your own pizzas, has a more limited menu and options. There are the suggested pizzas with the sauce and toppings already picked out for you, or you can pick your own pizza with 1 or 2 toppings. There were a decent amount of toppings to chose from, but limiting it to two was slightly disappointing. 

When it cooks, you can request any of the finishing sauces. Overall, the pizza I ordered was pretty good and it did not take too long to wait for it.
Really delicious pizza ! I love how you can add so many toppings all included in one price.
I visited with friends in Aug. outdoor seating was available. Even though I don't like coleslaw! This was delicious!!! The waitress was cool! The adult drinks where ok

Wow place is simply the worst stood there for a good five minutes and the staff were  dancing, swearing  without regard and basically doing anything but work really need to shut this place down and all the employees or at least fire everyone and hire a manager who can manage this place. Really gives Macdonald's an awful name. Never set foot in that place ever again rather go to Dunkin Donuts where they at least acknowledge your existence.

Few things you need you know about Wok Street:
- There's one Wok Street thing that you need to know for sure: it's owned by the same successful Hai Street Kitchen folks.
- Limited-service and fast-casual Southeast Asian with a twist. (Chipotle-like concept.)
- Serves bowls, Banh Mi, summer roll side and Tofu cheesecake, in addition to couple house-made drinks.
- Thai iced tea ($2.49): Little-bit-too-sweet, and kinda bitter.
- Bangkok beef signature bowl ( regular:$9.19, large:$11.18). Tried once, NEVER AGAIN.

As I'll remain regular at Hai Street Kitchen, Still, Two Yelps is more than enough for Wok Street.

At 5:10pm yesterday I visited this location with a buy 1 get 1 free coupon for Dave's Singles with Cheese.  The order taker claimed that the manager had to approve all coupons (never mind the fact I just tore it out of the ad).  I don't recall ever encountering that problem before @ a Wendy's or any other fast food location for that matter.  She said that she was in her office (mind you when I first came in the restaurant there were zero customers out there) and had to approve the coupon before even attempting to ring up my order!  Meanwhile, another customer came in the restaurant and she immediately rang up that person's order.  I had to wait 7 to 10 minutes before someone in authority got up to the counter to approve the coupon (no apologies given), let alone have said order rung up.  In the meantime, you had @ least 5 associates just standing around talking and doing zip.  Probably because of this, it took another 3 minutes after my order was done for one of them to rudely shove my order in a bag!  Also, I was feeling a little light headed while waiting with my head down - and I would have thought someone would offer me a complimentary beverage (even in Philly) or a drink of water as common courtesy for my wait - no such luck!  In the interim, NO other customers came in after the person I mentioned who came in and unlike myself was immediately rung up.  I also suspect a racially discriminatory element was in play at this location since I happen to be of a different racial group than that of the associates and the other customer.  IMO if their late founder Dave Thomas was aware of an incident such as this he would be spinning in his grave!  Today I used - with no issues whatever - a similar coupon at the Wendy's on Huntingdon Pike near the Giant - and service was stellar there.  Am guessing I'd best stay on the 24 bus an extra 20 minutes or so to get to the Huntingdon Pike location or drive an extra 10 minutes to the Huntingdon Pike location to get proper service going forward.  Other advantages the Huntingdon Pike location offers are 2 percent lower sales tax AND no extortionate beverage tax (thanks a lot, Mayor Kenney & City Council?!)
Now I've been a fan of Wendy's when I want a quick bite but this breakfast sandwich was very good. I also love that it is shaped in a square like their burgers. Good Job Wendy

HORRIBLE! I'm not one to complain. (I understand people make mistakes sometimes.) Excellent Burger's, I've never had a bad meal for this place.  I dare say,  possibly the greatest burger's I've ever had. Keep doing what you do Shake Shack.

Save your money!!! The service was horrible the food was so dry I felt like I AC eating sand. They gave me a hand full of fries that looked like they were cook this morning! I got a large soda with. Literally 5 ice cubes on a warm day. WTF!!!

A girl came to the window and tried to open it , it was locked so she just went back to mopping and completely ignored my presence less than three feet away from her. I came here after an ice-skating session because I was starving. It is located at Penn's Landing so it is super convenient for a snack. I wanted the crab fries because I heard they were good. Tonight I chose to order the bundle box. This was a big mistake. Inside my box, I received two Big Mac's with stale ass buns, dry black burgers, slapped together with no care. Eh... this place is really going downhill. First few times were okay. 
Third time was horrible- they completely burnt my falafel. It was hard to bite, and the sauce had a bitter taste to it as well. No tomato either. Only a pocket full of lettuce with the burnt falafel. I complained, and got an email from a rep giving me a free sandwich. 
So I go to redeem it the next trip, and the guy tries to charge me TWICE full price for a platter. What?? I was getting a free sandwich! Rude too.
Don't waste your time. You'll get much better from a food truck or Mamas Vegetarian.

Got the 30 sugar taro with bubbles. The bubbles are smaller than most other shops, but are cooked all the way through. They could be sweeter, but overall acceptable. 

The taro flavor itself is actually pretty good- it is a bit more pronounced than taro at other shops which I am a fan of. 30 sugar is similar to what you would expect. 

Overall, it's nice to have another bubble tea store in West Philly for some variety.

Just happened to stumble across this place. It has a warehouse vibe to it. Staff was all very friendly. So I asked the young lady working behind the counter what she suggested. She was more than happy to whip up her favorite combo plate for me which consisted of brussel sprouts, rice, a mix of spicy chicken & pork, sweet red onions, edamame, charred corn & topped it with fresh cilantro. Let me just say that this dish did NOT disappoint. The cold glass ginger lemonade was very tasty & refreshing. Smiling friendly faces, fresh ingredients & clean atmosphere can't be beat for the price.

My mom got me and my sister a cheeseburger with pickles, fries and an Oreo milkshake which were delicious. Me and my sister instantly like shake shack and my mom starts ordering a lot there so I can definitely say that I like shake shack.

All in all I can say that shake shack is four stars with its delicious burgers and ordering and delivering service

Do not get delivery from here. Multiple people have ordered delivery at my work and the food doesn't show up. 

Then today we watch the driver put the food snap a photo and then leave with the food. 

I know that they use outside services to deliver the food but this has happened twice this week alone.

This place is a sad excuse for a Mcdonald's. None of the employees care about anything. You will wait forever for your food and it will still taste terrible. It's also one of the Mcdonald's that never has a working ice cream machine. My friend ordered an m&m mcflurry and she was handed a cup of ice cream with m&ms sprinkled on top, not even mixed in??? I would rather go to the other Mcdonald's down Broad st.

30 minute wait in a nearly empty restaurant and still have no food. 2 people standing at the counter waiting before I arrived are still there. I Pointed out that someone had left a woman's wallet and the staff person was absolutely rude. Staff are loud. Going from sweeping the floor to handling food without a change in gloves. Very disappointed. But I have other options.

Sister lunch outside Mamoun's today. Delicious. I had the Manhattan - a pita with falafel and tons of veggies. I especially liked the pickles in a bite of lots of other richer or crunchier things. Had a hard time at the very end eating 4/5 bites of baba ha push and olives, but I'd eat it again in a second.  The fries were on point- crispy, hot, creamy on the inside.  Fast takeout, and they have tables outside to eat at. Yes!!

This location is consistent... in terrible service, that is. This location operates its drive thru only. The employees will literally watch as you knock for 10 minutes. It's surprising that such a horrendous location continues to thrive. Even a McDonald's in the middle of busy Philly can do better. If I could give less than one star, I would. Save your sanity and go somewhere else, don't be like me, and be foolish enough to mobile order with these people. Or you'll end up like me; wasting time on a review, when you could be doing better things with your time.
this place is amazing! the pizza is amazing and the service is great especially the shift leader, Anthony!! he was very welcoming and friendly!! i highly recommend this place

Idk if I have much to say cuz I got leftovers that were gonna be thrown out since someone didn't pickup their order at my friends job.

And these chicken tenders were tasty and lasted half of this week .. but as they got older they were less exciting to eat tbh.

also chicken is probably pretty bad for you depending on where the chickens come from so im tryna be more vegan etc.

I've given Scratch a try twice now. I really wanted to like it because they're right next to my office, and in theory biscuits from scratch sound delicious!  The first time I went I got the biscuit with butter and jam to go with soup I brought from home.  The biscuit itself was very dry, and the jam was just alright. They forgot to include the special butter.  

The second time I went for an egg sandwich and ordered up the Johnny Paycheck.  It was quite honestly.... terrible. The biscuit was again dry and fell apart on my first bite.  The egg was a hunk of pre-made casserole egg, not "I will fry it up when you order it egg".  For an $8 egg sandwich, I would expect fresh. The bacon was undercooked and the cheese was a white American cheese slice. Perhaps the brisket is worth one more try, but it won't be anytime soon for me. On the upside, the staff seemed very friendly.

As an avid consumer of pizza, I had been looking forward to the opening of Blaze Pizza for months! So obviously I could not miss out on their grand opening last night. As a grand opening special, the restaurant offered free pizzas. As if that wasn't enough to win me over, the offer also came with free drinks and s'mores cookies (yum!). 

Because of the special offer, the place was packed. However, service was not compromised by any means despite how hectic it was. All members of the staff were friendly and helpful. A customer was even given a second free pizza because there had been a mistake on the original pizza that he had ordered. 

Food-wise, Blaze Pizza offers signature pizzas, 1 top pizzas, simple pies, or you can build your own pizza with a large variety of toppings. For the Build Your Own Pizza, you can request an unlimited amount of toppings for the one price of $7.95. The pizza dough also comes in original or gluten-free. For my pizza, I decided to build my own, and found the ingredients to be fresh. The pizza crust was thin, yet still chewy and crispy at the same time. In regards to size, a hungry person could easily finish their whole pie in one sitting (or perhaps that's just me). Regardless, I think the prices here are fair for the amount of food you get. 

Overall, I loved the service, food, and ambiance. This newly built establishment is spacious, modern, but maintains a warm feel. I look forward to frequenting this spot during the rest of my time on campus.

I'm surprised there aren't more reviews about this place, it seemed quite busy when I got here! It's located inside the Penn Medical Center so it's definitely targeted towards the employees and patients there. As a Penn student it is a bit far away from campus and a random location, but I wouldn't coming once in a while. This place serves pretty healthy food like salads, wraps, smoothies, and even Asian soups! I wish it were closer to Penn campus though.

FOOD: I ordered a custom wrap with kale, spinach, corn, tomatoes, apples, carrots, broccoli, and tofu. The tofu was just meh, had to pay extra for that and the kale. Overall price was only 8 ish dollars which is pretty reasonable. Definitely a good place to grab a quick healthy lunch if you're in the area, but nothing that blows your mind. I think the smoothies look really good though!
Like all the other Shake Shack locations I've been to, this one is no different. Food was great and the wait time wasn't bad.

Came here for lunch because I walked past on my way back from Staples. 

The store had a couple of tables set up, but mostly was empty space due to COVID. You ordered via one of two active touchscreen monitors, and then put your phone number in so they can text you when it's ready. 

The fried chicken sandwich upgraded with bacon and avocado really hit the spot. It also had mayo and pickles. The crinkle cut fries survived the walk back to work and were still crispy. It was just enough for an order to fill you up. They also threw in some ketchup packets.

The very friendly staff was following all COVID-19 protocol with masks. Masks required when waiting for your food to be made. Almost wished I got the shake too!

$12.45 for the fried chicken sandwich and fries. Decent!

C'mon man....its Popeyes....what do you want out of this review. We've all eaten there, and it tastes the same as when you go to any other Popeyes.

THAT SAID, I will say that this particular Popeyes is a little more "hood" than the rest of them. There are always some interesting clientele in there, and although nothing has ever FULLY popped off while I was there, there have been a few sketchy occurrences. (loud arguments, customers cussing at the staff, people selling bootleg DVD's while you try to eat, etc).

The employees are always still nice to me, considering, so I've never had an issue.
Ordered takeout and the portions were HUGE which I love. The flavors were all spot on too. I got falafel platter and grape leaves. Would go back again in a heartbeat.

Terrible customer service. Placed an order for pick up at 9pm was "promised" by 930pm and 945 they haven't even started making the order when asked about it. They have one person cooking with several cleaning and counting inventory instead of focusing on customers orders. There seems to be no manager in sight, just a bunch of teenagers walking around and slacking off. There's other customers who ordered around 8pm promised for 845pm and they're still here waiting at 945pm for an order. They also messed up both burritos on my order and didn't have the glass coca colas that i order in stock so they gave me two cups for the fountain machine. I go to use the fountain machine and they took all the nozzles off for cleaning and didn't block off the machine so i then got covered in soda. This point i was fed up with their service and requested a refund and was told they couldn't do it because we ordered online. THEY'RE ONLY DOING ONLINE ORDERS. 10/10 would not recommend eating/ordering from here and i will never come back.

This was my first time here and it was a seamless experience! You can place your order at the kiosks when you walk in the door or you can order at the counter. No sooner had I submitted my order and I got a text message saying my order was ready for pick-up at the counter. The next minute, my name was being called and picked up my shake and left. 

The inside of the building was clean and organized. The employees were working really hard and were getting orders ready quickly. I noticed an attention to detail of theirs - there was an employee stationed in the midst of the people waiting for their orders. She was asking people if they had ordered already or not and was directing people appropriately. She asked me if I had ordered and since I did, I moved over to the order pick-up line. I appreciated the intention to create an as straightforward ordering experience as possible for customers. I will definitely be back!

I used to frequent another Tea Do location years ago when I had an office near one. I hadn't been in a TeaDo in a couple years until I stepped into this location last night. I was excited to see my old favorites on the menu and see some new ones as well. Service was friendly, but I was disappointed with the drinks.

I got my usual, the sesame milk bubble tea. I decreased the sugar to 30%. The sweetness level was perfect, and the flavor was just okay. However, there were many undercooked bubbles and the overall flavor had a fake sweetener taste. The bubbles were also smaller than most shops, but not the mini ones. 

My husband had the Thai tea which used to be my backup drink. They asked him if he wanted to adjust the sweetness level of this drink, which surprised me. At the other location I used to visit, they could not adjust the Thai tea since it was not a powder and the base was brewed in advance. When he received the drink, I tasted it, and it didn't have the same flavor as the one TeaDo used to brew. It was rather bland. Maybe they're using a powder now? I'm not sure, but it was very disappointing. It's a shame because they used to have the best Thai tea out of all the bubble tea chains. 

Due to the quality of the bubbles, I wouldn't go out of my way to visit this location again. University City has other bubble tea options with properly prepared bubbles.

Every time I order from here through Uber and door dash they mess up my order. Something from my order is always messing. Tonight was the last straw when they forgot my drink and my nuggets. Won't be ordering from here again.

Hands down the worst McDonalds I have ever been to. From closing 30 min early to randomly closing for 30 minutes in the middle of a lunch rush, this McDonalds is sure to waste your time. I have never seen a place on Yelp more deserving of a 1-Star rating. Avoid this location if possible.

My roomie and I were desperate for some fried food at 12:30 AM on a Saturday and decided to take a chance on this place even though they didn't have any reviews. We ordered a single stack cheeseburger, French friends, fried Mac and cheese bites and jalapeño poppers. EVERYTHING WAS AMAZING. Food arrived before scheduled and was piping hot. The French fry portion was massive and came with a tasty dipping sauce. After our first bite we immediately put the card that came with the delivery on our fridge so we could order again. Do yourself a favor and order from here.

I love teado! So happy one opened in university city. I've been here a few times with friends since they opened last week. I've tried a few of the milk teas and normal green tea drinks. Their boba isn't super sweet which is nice and everything is well flavored. There's also a bunch of games so you can spend time with friends or outlets so you can study. Wifi's good too

I went to this spot twice so far and the food is great and the staff is very nice and provides great customer service. The prices are very good for the amount of food that you get, they give you a lot which is great. One thing I would be aware of is the hot sauce. The hot sauce is very very good but super hot (I love it). It is definitely worth a try if you like spicyness!

I can't justify going to any other burger place around University City anymore. Spencer's is worth the walk up the hill.

Why would you ever go to Shake Shack or something even pricier when Spencer's is:
a. better
b. cheaper
c. more filling
d. much less crowded? 

It's not fancy, it's just very reasonably priced yet creatively designed burgers with delicious sweet potato fries. I'm a fan of the Dr I burger (huervos rancheros-style toppings) and the one with the fried cornmeal tomato. The burgers are decently sized (though not unhealthily ginormous). I usually sub in a turkey patty (tastes just as good for $.75 more) and I'm out with a filling meal for less than $8. 

Service has always been friendly and fairly fast. It's a bit tricky to find if you're not sure of where you're going (go into Sabrina's, but turn right once you get inside instead of left) and you'll see the registers.

Better than in and out and five guys (which are both top notch burgers) Better than everywhere and everything. We got pick up and it was prompt and accurate. I love this place more than anywhere. My favorite burger on the planet. Nothing beats it. Come here.

This review is way overdue and I will make sure I DONT continue to fund a location that isn't worth of the wait, money or energy!

My first Shake Shack visit was here last week. As a long time CA resident and afficionado I understand that this in a high-class homage to a famous west coast burger chain (starts with In and ends with Out!). I will say quite different but a very enjoyable experience. 

Burger: very fluffy & soft yellow potato bun but with a slightly sweet flavor. Burgers are smashed and crispy, and you can tell the meat is a good quality grind. Cheese is expectable melty, bacon was pretty good and a nice smoke level (can't say that it was outstanding, but enjoyable). 

I think the Parmesan truffle fries were the champ: the truffle sauce is decadently rich, and the Parmesan was, at best, hiding like a barely glistening early season snowfall that quickly disappears...slightly pathetic. But the wavy fries are crispy and dynamite with that super thick truffle sauce. 

Yes I would eat here again if I want to splurge on a high-quality fast food burger. But I'd just as soon pay ~2x less and get the OG west-coast deal that makes up in style and  value, compared to what Shake Shack does with quality and class.

They aren't wearing face masks, and are probably giving people coronavirus.  Definitely not coming here again- the entire staff at 10pm on Tuesday needs to be fired for risking other people's lives with their laziness.

Love Mamoun's! I'm a West Philly person, so my loyalty should sway towards Saad's, but Mamoun's food (from falafel, rice, chicken, shwarma, etc) tastes fresher, not greasy, and great spices surpasses Saad's and other casual Middle Eastern restaurants. The price point is good, portion size is good, freshness is good, and omg, their spicy sauce is my favourite! For today, we got Manhattan sandwich (this sandwich was packed! It had falafel, and everything else you can think of). Chicken kebob plate was good! Their chicken was flavoured and cooked just right, the rice was so aromatic with spices I wanted to keep eating. Their lamb shwarma was not greasy, but also not dry, with good balance of flavour! Their grape leaves are pretty awesome too! 

I do wish Mamoun's will come to West Philly or closer to West Philly. I can only hope for that, but until then my family and I will be loyal customers.

The first thing you should ask yourself is why is the falafel sandwich so cheap? Is it super small for $4.75? Why is there a $6 special in which you get a falafel sandwich and a juice of your choice? As my dad would say, what's the gimmick? What's the catch? Is the sandwich better than Goldie's? Or Mama's Vegetarian?

The sandwich is small, like a half-size Mama's Vegetarian and about the same size as a Goldie sandwich. It tastes closer to a Mama's Vegetarian sandwich than a Goldie sandwich. It's a little cheaper than a Mama's Vegetarian sandwich ($5.50) and the style is different from all three. From what I see, Mamoun's mashes their falafel balls to a pulp and presses it against one side of the pita bread like a layer or spread. The rest of the pita pocket is filled with lettuce, pieces of tomato, and a generous helping of tehina sauce. I don't think there was any cucumber in it. Each bite of my Mamoun's sandwich was loaded with flavor. Pure and simple ingredients. It just made me smile. 

I tried the hot sauce that was on the table, the one that warned "Caution: Extremely hot. One drop at a time." Spicy friends, this sauce does have a good kick to it. I did four drops.
 
Compared to a Mama's Vegetarian sandwich, Mama's falafel are a little crisper, not mashed up in the sandwich, so Mama's sandwich is a little tougher to eat, especially if you want to get falafel in every bite. Since Mama's falafel is a bit crisper, it might be difficult to mash the falafel up into a spread. Mama's gives you cucumber as well as lettuce and tomato. Compared to Goldie's, well, hmmm.... Goldie's has better tasting falafel. Goldie's falafel are softer to the bite. It's almost like biting into lightly crisped raw foods protein balls (remember those?). Goldie's gives you more falafel than Mamoun's or Mama's half-size $5.50 sandwich, but... Goldie's falafel are tiny, so it's about the same amount of falafel. Goldie's sandwich tastes good, perhaps even great, but it's overpriced at $8.

[Side note: What the hell was Goldie thinking making a falafel sandwich $8? This is supposed to be street food! Not street food for trust fund babies! Oh, wait... this is a falafoodie sandwich!]

Back to the comparisons, Mama's has the best bread, especially when you get it warm out of the oven. Jesus, it's good! (Oops! there's my church influence!) Goldie's bread is good, too, but not pillowy soft like Mama's. Mamoun's bread is okay. It's more like store bought than homemade. Of the three, for overall value, I think Mamoun's is the best. It edges past Mama's a little. You can't go wrong with either one, especially if you live on one end of town or the other. Goldie's is about five blocks away from Mama's. If you have extra money that you don't want to put into your new Mercedes, try a Goldie's sandwich, otherwise go for a Mama's sandwich if you're west of Broad and Mamoun's if you're east. For pure, unadulterated bite-after-bite falafel, go with Mamoun's.

Oh, yeah, and the juice is good, too.

I also added chicken to mine for some protein. The salad was quite a big portion! I was very hungry and didn't even finish the entire thing. Brought the rest of it home with me and it made for a portion of my dinner that evening. :)

Staff is friendly and the establishment is kept very clean! Prices are reasonable considering the portion size. 

I will surely be stopping here again and again! Who needs coffee when you can get a Banana Nut Crunch Smoothie for an energy boost?!

The countless other one-star reviews for this location are accurate. Do not waste your time at this McDonald's. If you do end up here, make sure to check your order multiple times before leaving. The drive-thru line is usually long and moves slow, which might make you want to rush out of there. However, if you do, you will most likely end up getting the wrong order.

Nastyyyyyyy. Worst customer service ever. Anytime you go it's bad. Rude on speaker. Can't count on register. Never gives a receipt with order. Today was the last time going ever. Hair in food ! Never have hair nets. This place needs to be shut down ASAP

I used to smirk when I would see 1 star ratings for McDonald's because...c'mon, it's McDonald's, what do you expect? But yes, this place is on a whole other level of bad! Tried to order from the drive thru at around 2 in the morning after a night out. There was clearly a McDonald's employee inside working, but she refused to answer after I repeatedly called out "hello" in the speaker, trying to place my order. After a while, multiple cars started piling up in the drive thru as we sat there confused on why this 24 hour McDonald's wasn't providing drive thru service. We drove around a couple times, calling out "hello" into the speaker for placing orders in case the worker hadn't heard us the first time. Eventually, an Uber drive who was in line for the drive thru banged on the order pick-up window until the worker opened the window. The Uber driver was there to pick up her orders and this worker did not care! Instead, she proceeded to yell really aggressively about how they were closed because they were switching from dinner to breakfast (at 2 in the morning? Yeah, ok). I tried to ask her why they're closed when it's a 24 hour McDonald's only to get more aggressive yelling as a response. Aborted mission and went home. Whoever ordered Uber Eats from McDonald's that night definitely didn't get their food. Super rude service.

I recently ordered here via DoorDash (amidst the pandemic).

Shake Shack burgers are usually among my favorites. I ordered from here to try their limited time Korean-inspired menu items, and I was disappointed with what I received. I had the Korean-Style Fried Chick'n and the Korean Gochujang Chik'n Bites.

To start off, the chicken in the sandwich did not really have a good texture to it as it was not crispy and mostly lathered with too much sauce. The kimchi was a good touch but not flavorful enough to really complement the sandwich as a whole.

The chicken bites were $7.79 (same price as the sandwich), but I received like eight very small pieces. It was not worth it at all. The sauce that came with it was also very underwhelming.

Overall, I find that Shake Shack is usually very consistent and a great place to grab burgers. Unfortunately, these limited time Korean-inspired items were a good idea but poorly executed.
Avoid this location if possible. Didn't receive a receive for my order but one of the biscuit sandwiches came with a terribly stale bun instead.

It was really good. I've been to Shake Shack before and they never disappoint. This location had about 4 kiosks for customers to use to order their food if paying with a card and one register if paying with cash. The kiosk allow you to input if you have a food allergy and will show you which menu items contain each allergen, which is helpful. I ordered the strawberry mint lemonade, which seemed to be brewed warm and then poured over ice which didn't really help to cool the drink down. The chicken sandwich was amazing as always and the fries were cooked fresh.
This is the worst Mcdonalds to go to. They don't care about manners or following protocol.

This McDonalds is one of the most incompetent fast food drive thru I have ever experienced. I have had multiple orders (mobile/drive thru/ in person) missing items or having wrong items. 

it is also one of the SLOWEST McDonalds I have ever experienced. I have spent 20 minutes in the drive thru REGULARLY. Just sitting waiting for them to get my order wrong.  then when i get my wrong order the food is the poorest quality fast food 

Why do i keep going back? answer : it is in a very convenient location right off City Ave. HOWEVER, at this point i have had so many infuriating experiences at this mcdonalds that I now travel 15 minutes out of my way to stop by a different mcdonalds to get my food without the annoyance. 

Recommend to everyone to not waste their time waiting to get food from this location until management is changed to be more efficient.

I love this cute little tea shop. My partner and I come here almost once a week to grab a QUICK boba. There's usually easy parking nearby and no more than four other people inside when we visit. Please try several of their drinks!! You can't go wrong with a single one. They have so many different options for drinks, toppings, ice level, sweetness, etc., including non dairy milk options! AND the staff in there is amazing!!
Wait time always ridiculous tacos are raunchy attitude to Ranchi but I'm too damn lazy to go anywhere else lol

Tea Do is located in the Hamilton Court apartments on the corner of 39th and Sansom Street. They're currently open for takeout, however there are plenty of ways to order online for delivery and you can also order via Snackpass. There are plenty of drinks to choose from and the store also has a selection of Asian snacks such as Pocky and Yan-Yan for sale. Note that there aren't many lactose-free options.

I got the regular sized Jasmine Milk Tea ($3.50) with less ice and 30% sugar. You can adjust the ice and sugar level to your liking. The bubbles were soft and it wasn't that sweet, but I wish the tea were stronger though and my drink tasted a bit watery. 

TLDR: An average bubble tea chain store.

It's 812 pm and I'm still  waiting for my 730 pm order. There's about 20 people waiting in here and only about 3 preparers working. Need more staffing management. Or perhaps start cleaning duties after peak hours. Or after closing. It's an everyday issue after 7 pm.

Please don't eat here! Me, my wife and my son got food poisoning after eating here on Friday December 3rd, 2021.
Just wanted to treat my family to special on a Friday night and we ended being sick all weekend. Dehydrated, running to the bathroom, no energy. My wife swore we had covid, all rapid tests came back negative and the only thing different was the Wendy's we had.
PLEASE DON'T EAT HERE!!!!

I tried all the proteins in the menu - chicken, the lamb in shawarma and falafel. Everything tasted overcooked and burnt. Even the hummus had a burnt after taste. 
Small place with about 4-5 tables and it was empty on Sunday evening.  
Not the best of experience but I might give them another try. Very reasonably priced.

On a weekend, this place gets pretty crowded with people stopping by to grab a drink, a bite (takoyaki/etc), or to sit down and chat with friends/study. The place does stay consistently loud, but if you have earphones, it's okay. They also have a few games to play with friends. 

As for the drinks, they were just okay. I got the Brown Sugar Milk Tea - definitely didn't see any brown sugar or tasted any brown sugar (maybe I got the wrong drink?), and the boba is on the firmer side, but a good size (lots of bobas I've been having here are a little too small and soft, almost over cooked). Taste was just okay. My friend got one of their fruity signature drinks, and tasted like a flavored syrupy drink - would've hoped for more.

Terrible customer service. Placed an order for pick up at 9pm was "promised" by 930pm and 945 they haven't even started making the order when asked about it. They have one person cooking with several cleaning and counting inventory instead of focusing on customers orders. There seems to be no manager in sight, just a bunch of teenagers walking around and slacking off. There's other customers who ordered around 8pm promised for 845pm and they're still here waiting at 945pm for an order. When i first walked in they workers were dancing by the grill and high fiving eachother. 10/10 would not recommend eating/ordering from here and i will never come back.

My burger could have been assembled with a little more care (the bun was pretty squished when I got it - see photo) but otherwise I have no complaints about this spacious Shake Shack where the service was timely and pleasant.
This is a perfect example as to why these workers do not deserve $15 hourly rate.  Corporate needs to shut this location down!  Horribly ran store!

If I could give place a zero star, I would! Stopped by to get a chicken sandwich and much my surprise when I got home was a crappy cheeseburger, took it back, " Oh we're sorry we have your sandwich here". Got in my car in the passing lane in the drive thru, checked my sandwich it another cheeseburger. Oh, the staff thought it was funny. The Manager comes to window with her hair all over the place and said "Oh the orders got mixed up", I said oh, you think, twice? Again, her staff thought it was funny! I will be calling corporate! Everyone should be fired!!!! I'm gonna let corporate know I won't be patronizing that store until some changes are made. Do yourself a favor, dont go there after 9, unless your high!

3 stars is not a bad thing! Wok Street is a pretty good "upscale fast food" restaurant but it's catered to the American palette. 

The layout is setup Qdoba style and the seating is limited. There are 4 options of rice bow and one sandwich style and about 3-4 beverage options.
The limited menu works with helping ppl make quicker decisions. 

I tried the pickled peanut pork bowl. 
There's ALOT of rice and its very filling. It could have used a bit more seasoning and sauce flavor but I kept in mind the American palette. The Brussel Sprouts in the bowl did confuse me slightly. They kind of overwhelmed the pork. I would've preferred broccoli but that's just me. Overall I like my experience and the price was commensurate to center city prices. 

I will surely be back and trying another bowl

Are you looking for a sweets fix?  Baklava Cafe has got it all.  They just opened but you wouldn't know it based on their selection.  They've got boat loads of flaky pastries some with walnuts others with pistachios and more without. Then they've got trays full of apple crisp pies and meringue cookies and it's pretty much heaven.
I stick to the honey drenched concoctions, so I went in knowing I'd like a pistachio baklava.  I got a square pastry which had sides folded up to meet in the middle, it was topped with pistachio crumble and, to my delight, was filled with crushed walnuts.  The best of both worlds; this cost $2 and was completely worth it.  My friend thought the roll reminiscent of a Papadopoulos Greek Caprice Wafer looked good.  It looked like a Caprice, but it was open in the middle and much lighter, almost delicate.  It only cost $1.50  Both pastries were lightly honey soaked.  They weren't saturated, but rather the flavor of the (probably) homemade dough, nuts, and honey complimented each other perfectly.  I've made baklava before and it's never tasted this good.  The guys at Baklava Cafe really know what they're doing.
The restaurant isn't in full swing yet so it's not clear whether they'll be offering coffee, tea, etc., but I can't imagine a Mediterranean cafe not serving some sort of delicious beverage.

This McDonald's and the other one nearby on City Ave are now regularly closing to people and only serving DoorDash and UberEats. Don't waste your time driving here just to be told that they won't serve you. You can read more about their new deal in this article: https://restaurantbusinessonline.com/financing/mcdonalds-announces-new-deals-doordash-uber-eats

THE WORST McDonald's you'll ever come across. Employees barely doing their job , manager had a funky attitude. Food is just slapped in the wrap into the bag. They never fill the drinks up. It's just over all a mess. 0/10 recommend. Don't waste your time folks . ‍
They claim to be open 24/7 but denied my friend and i in the drive through. Claimed they were getting ready for breakfast. Very rude.

Everyone is yelling at each other behind the counter. Long wait for food. Chocolate frosty's was pretty watery, when the vanilla ones looked quite thick. Safee, the guy taking my order, was super nice though.

I am very dissatisfied with the service I received today manager didn't even acknowledge us as valued customers are very understaffed the workers seemed overworked they were also itching their backs to get out of the store and decided not to take any more orders even though it's claims on the website that they're open until 11 and it's only 8 PM. they did get my order correct though!!

They made me wait for my food then tell me i need to cancel my order because they're not working. We waited for over 1 hour before they said ANYTHING. DISGUSTING. Its March 21'st. 12:30 am & the site says they close at 2am. He was walking around with a bad leg, drinking SODA with a drive through full of over 22 cars. They never even informed others that they were no longer serving. I'll be taking this up to corporate.

The ghetto. It's like they put ads out for the most ignorant people looking to get on somebodies nerves. Have you calling on the Lord. Lol Simple questions and you would think you insulted them. Miss fix the attitude, if you don't want to work.....quit. Wendy's need to provide E.I training to their employees because you're employees are lacking.

Woohoo!  I was introduced to Mamoun's in NYC, then made some visits to the Princeton location, and now they've made their landing in Philly!  Had the falafel plate, which was tasty as ever.  I added a side of hummus to help break up the flavors and textures with the rice.  The interior is not as large as the Princeton location but there is still seating to be found (can't say the same for the NYC spot).  I appreciate how their sides menu indicates whether items are gluten free or not.  I did not see likewise for the main entrees - not sure if it was an afterthought or if the mains are free of gluten as well.  I can't find definitive answers searching online so hopefully they address that.

Had the bubble taro milk tea with almond milk. It is delicious  . Service was great and quick. Also must try the lazo coffee (im spelling it wrong) or just say Colombian coffee it is so delicious as well.

food is consistently great here. my favorite is the fat gorbies, but the mozzarella sticks are fire and the chicken tenders are supreme here. i've gotten the cheesesteaks a few times and, as a philly native, even i rate these pretty high. i live close by, but have gotten it delivered to other parts of the city, and seeing a large delivery range is always key for me to be able to share good places with friends!

The popping bubble tea was something new to try. The flavour was decent and refreshing. The Thai milk tea was refreshing as well however the consistency of boba were different which I didn't like a lot. 
Due to the pandemic, the we ordered through phone and went to get them after 10 minutes. 
Decent products but improvement needed.

Unless you like watching a disorganized circus show, and poorly prepared food, I'd avoid this place. The woman who prepared my wrap couldn't have cared any less about customer service. She threw my wrap together carelessly, then practically screamed across the room asking if I wanted it toasted- all while she argued with coworkers about how they were doing their job wrong. The only thing I can say about the wrap was that it was terrible- primarily because they slop on way too much dressing. Only come here if you're desperate for food or you find amusement in fast food employees arguing with each other.

Went in for some fries & the manager came over to help me order on the kiosk so I wouldn't have to wait for the person to finish in front of me. She was very nice, stayed with me & showed me how to use it. It was a cool experience. The employees seemed to all get along & everyone was working together. Oh yeah... the fries were on point!!!

By far the worst fast food restaurant I have ever been to. Extremely rude employees, made me wait for 5 min in the drive thru before they even said a single word. Been here 3 times and each time it's the same. Employees act like your bothering them when u walk in because they r busy talking and horsing around with one another all  while the drive thru has cars wrapped around the building. I say thank u at least 2 times (once after ordering and once after I receive my food and never did I get a "your welcome" out of anybody each time I been here. I could write for hours on how terrible this place is. I will rather starve before stopping to eat at this Wendy's ever again for as long as I live. By the way, I never once took the time to write a review before, so that alone should say enough about th

I wish I could give this zero stars. Awful place. I just don't understand. I said NO MAYO seven times at the window. Before my order. During my order AND RECEIVING MY ORDER.. There was a long line so I didn't double check. Smfh. If I could curse on these without being rude I would. I'll never go back. Just because you work for $10 an hour doesn't mean you have to have a $2 stale attitude!! People in China work for 4 cents. Get over it or GET EDUCATED. Worst experience at a fast food place ever. Atleast be nice about your accident!
very rude and uncommunicative employees. train your employees mcdonald's. employees were hugging and making out just behind the counter while i waited to pick up an order

I would have said 3 stars but the description for 2 stars is "Meh, I've experienced better", which is exactly how I feel about this place. The decor was really cute, but the biscuits weren't so good. They were definitely ok, but you would think a place with biscuit in the name would have really good biscuits. Maybe I'm biased because I'm from the south and I've had quite a few biscuits in my day, but they don't stand up to even the mediocre restaurants back home. That being said, everyone was quite friendly, again the decor was really nice, and the toppings on the biscuits were fresh and delish. It wasn't a bad experience, but I doubt I'll go again. I might walk by so I can look at the decor, though.

It was poor service. The employees had a major attitude wasn't paying attention and was trying to make me get back in line for some fries that I asked for with my order. I get home and my burger as well as my daughter burger was raw. Then I called to give the manager the complaint and she refused to get on the phone
This is the worse McDonald's around the smoothie machine NEVER works - a long wait in the drive-thru at least 30 minutes. I will never go back there!!
The worst McDonald's ever ! This are all kidS working here never give the correct order!!! Hair

Here visiting from Atlanta and there are no public bathrooms. This manager claims it's because of COVID but the employees encountering customers all day are walking in and out 711 across the street says they don't have restrooms at all which has to be illegal and a lie

I really wanted to like this place - but the quality of the food ruined that. I walked in around dinner time to grab a biscuit to go. I love biscuits and fried chicken so my obvious choice was to go with the "Fried Chicken Picnic Basket" which came with buttermilk fried chicken, cabbage slaw, and corn relish and cayenne ranch. The price of $9 was very steep for the quality and quantity of food I got. The biscuit was pretty small and tasted a little dry. The chicken came in two small pieces, one was good and juicy but the other piece was super stale and over cooked - I could barely chew it, so I threw most of it out. Overall I was a little disappointed! They have other types of biscuits there and you can even BYOB - build your own biscuit, which I thought was quite clever!

Horrible!!! Don't give this Wendy's ur money! Manger made our breakfast meals that took 15 minutes with no one in the drive thru.. received all three orders and drinks was water not soda which I order? an  food wasn't hot an nasty as crap!! $22:00 down the drain !!  Depending on the drive thru cause COVID-19 very pissed Don't waste ur money.. Don't due it !!

I used to go to the original location in NYC all the time prior to moving so I was excited to see a Mamoun's open up in Philadelphia! The falafel here is good but not the same as I remember it to be. The prices are also slightly higher. The tabbouleh was alright, definitely needed less oil and more salt. I would come back if I was in the area. The restaurant is clean with plenty of seating so it's great for groups.

Firstly, I hate McDonald's but I was driving by and really craved chicken nuggets. I opted for the drive through thinking that it would be quicker than going inside for such a small order. However, I was incredibly wrong! I arrived at 11:30, placed my order at 11:39PM and received my food at 12:04AM. 

The food: the ten piece nugget that I received was incredibly mushy and I'm convinced way undercooked. I couldn't eat it. Also, i ordered sauce and even paid the additional $.25 per sauce and there was no sauce to be found in my bag. 

The young lady taking my order was incredibly rude and rolled her eyes when I asked if they were having a busy night after waiting for nearly 30 mins. 



 NEVER GO HERE!!

I will rate the food when and if I ever get it!  Ordered 12:50 for a 1:30 delivery, they emailed me that it would be delivered around 2:00.  I called and was told the driver was out with our food (salad, sandwich, soup), it is now almost 2:45 and I think 2 hours is beyond excessive delivery time.  Just a tip, maybe they take their $4 delivery charge and hire more drivers as they must have a flood of lunch orders.  It's less than 2 miles away and I think choosing deliver over pick up (to dodge the rain) was a mistake.  So again, I explain this review is fully based on delivery & service which will taint my view of the food.

Aside from the fact that me and my family love Popeyes chicken I had the best experience with one of their cashiers at this location. She was extremely pleasant and even made my daughter her own special meal which was really sweet.  It's really rare that fast food workers show so much patience and great customer service so I really appreciated her. Great job server #2001 !!!
I love this place. Cute decor, lots of options, food, and fun games to play with a friend.

Ordered from here today through uber eats. I haven't ever been to this location but have been in the china town location in the past. I got a salmon onigiri which was super small to what I remember getting from the one in China town. Very stingy with the amount on the actual food and sauce was maybe a teaspoon full. Sauce tasted like was made differently as I am a fan of hot things but the taste was off putting as if whoever made it didn't do it right and was very hot. Thank god I like hot. Also my drink a red guava aloe Vera tea was very watered down and my takoyaki was smushes all together because of their uncaring about they are handing open bags of food to drivers coking into the shop for pick ups. Very disappointing. 3 disappointing items for $20. Won't be revisiting unfortunately.

I do not like the concept of ordering online and picking up in the store JUST to have to wait in line anyway.

I ordered for an 8:10pm pick up and didn't get my food until 8:50pm. And it wasn't due to lack of staff because it was at least 6 employees in the store. 

I think I'm more upset because you have to pay for your food when you place the order so you almost have no choice.

PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE Be careful and check your chicken when you go to this Popeye's Chicken. I bought the Chicken Wings they are advertising for the SuperBowl and the chicken was BAD. The chicken was bruised and reddish brown on the inside. It seems like the chicken was going bad and they froze it and continued to sell the chicken. I called when I got home to inform the of the problem and I spoke with a girl named Juanita who stated she was the manager. She asked me if I could bring the chicken back that night but I was home and it was a drive to get back and I had taken off my clothes. So I told her no I could come in the next day after class. She told me to just come in bring my receipt and she would inform the managerial staff the next day. When I went in the next day (2-2-2017) the Shift Manager Khan asked me where was the chicken I said in the trash because (Juanita) told me just to throw the chicken in the trash. So I did. I told Khan, Juanita, the manager who was on yesterday (2-1-1970) told me to throw it in the trash and he asked me how do I know you are not trying to get free chicken. I was angry because I feel like he was categorizing me due to the demographics he sells chicken. I also feel like he is selling that bad chicken because of the demographic and the neighborhood he has his business in. I am contacting the Health Dept. in reference to this Bad Chicken he is selling.

This place is a rip off! After sitting in the drive through line for over thirty minutes my order was incorrect and the fries were cold. I tried to go and retrieve the items that I paid for that were missing from my bag but the manager slammed the window in my face demanding that I get back in line and wait another 30 minutes for a mistake that was made on their end. The workers here are rude, and honestly I feel like they come to collect their pay and go home, no REAL hospitable service is being provided here and I will NEVER spend money here again

I want to start by saying I've NEVER taken the time to write a negative review before. But after being turned away by the drive thru for the 3 billionth time, I feel it's necessary. I typically hit the drive thru anywhere from 5-6:30 am. Time and time again I am told the system is updating and it will take 15-20 minutes, or today at 5:45 I was told they were transitioning and weren't quite ready yet. But the best is when they don't reply at all. I once actually (and foolishly) came back a 1/2 hour later once only to be told the system was updating. So it's pretty clear the people inside just have no interest in working. Wonder how interested the owner would be to know how much money he's given away to the Wawa on Rock Hill Rd. thanks to his employees ineptness. Because I've literally seen lines of cars turned away.
Once again we have painfully slow service. And all of the staff appear to think that a mask is a chin guard. Not over the mouth or the nose. Pretty fascinating.

I'm trying but I just don't get it. Half filled, frozen tasting crinkle cut fries and a underwhelming burger, that honestly isn't much better then what you get at Wendy's. Add a small drink and you're paying over 12 bucks.. End result, still hungry..

Other then the service being pleasant, I'm done with this place.. There are way better, fast casual spots in this city..

I was in the area running errands and stopped by Shake Shack for a quick lunch. Ordered the Avocado Bacon Burger + Chicken, which was available for limited time. The sliced avocado was fresh and applewood-smoked bacon was delicious. Loved this new menu item and totally would order again!

One of these days I'm a really learn my lesson from eating out of fast food places in the hood. I know better to not eat at these sort of establishments but I was being hella lazy and said give it a try. So boom I did - and hated it!!!!

My fries were hot! The were hot full of grease and they were soggy as all hell. After trying to eat it because I was hungry I just couldn't. I decided to just throw them away and try the spicy chicken sandwich. Man that darn chicken was still clucking. I couldn't even bite into it bc it wasn't all the way done. All I could taste was the darn mayonnaise. I don't know what human being would put so much mayonnaise on a darn sandwich. The Mayo was oozing from the sides of the sandwiches. 

Needless to say I spit out the bite that I did take and just drank the Tropical Berry Lemonade. No complaints there their lemonades are usually always hella bomb. Its like Jesus himself made that lemonade. I sat there during my lunch break with tears in my eyes from hunger drinking my damn lemonade wishing I had edible food.

The hot sauce is no joke! But the lamb could use some more meat.

Must get: regular falafel sandwich, hummus, 
Meh: shwarma sandwich, OJ
Missed: none

I think Mamoun's, in my opinion is an overrated falafel joint that managed to make its way into CC. My wife loves it, but in my humblest opinion, it's got some stiff competition with mama's falafel, hummusology, before it can get 4-5 stars. The biggest disappointment was the shwarma, which were basically few strands of meat on top of a well crafted pita falafel sandwich. The hummus platter sounds nice, but when presented, it looks just a little bit sad and poorly executed with splotches of hummus, baba ganoush and garnishes. The mango juice (previously thought to be OJ), or whatever small percent of fruit that existed in the sugary drink, was way too sweet for me. Overall, we spent about $40 with a little bit of leftovers, but I was just not highly impressed.

Food: 3 stars
Service: 4 stars
Ambience: 3 stars
Price: 3 stars

I'm not really sure who this place is aimed at: 

People who love biscuits but don't care that the biscuit they get is tough, not flakey, and dried out?

People who like the idea of down home cooking but don't mind if off flavors and badly-paired new ingredients are added to the classics? 

People who like fast food but want to pay more for it?

I've been here a few times because it's near my work and I want it to be good. It is always terribly disappointing. Bad sauces, bad pickles, bad biscuits, served lukewarm. Just skip it.

Occasionally I get a craving for some McD's fries and McFlurry.  Guilty pleasure. 

Was on my way home tonight at 10:20p. 
I saw only two cars in the drive through so thought I would give it a go. 

Bad call.  

They took my order quickly enough and I pulled around. 

Two cars still in front.  Ok. This should be quick though, right?

WRONG 

I waited for about 15 mins.  
Cars behind me were driving away.  

I got out oF mY car and tapped on the first window to ask the guy if the car in front had a custom order or something and if they could ask him to pull to the side. 

Dude said it was a SHIFT CHANGE.  
Fair enough. 

I said alright and went back to my car. 
But 5 more mins passed...
Cars not moving.   

 Finally someone opened the window in front.   
Yes!   Here we go!! 

NOPE! Just asking questions.  

Meanwhile another couple cars drove off. 

I finally gave up and drove away.  

I want that 30mins of my life back.  
(Shame on me for waiting so long)

This Wendy's is generally very slow, and seems unorganized. Last night we went through the drive thru around 7:40 PM. There was only three cars ahead of us which is very few compared to normal rush hours, we waited for almost 20 minutes before getting to the speaker to order. When we got our food luckily we checked our bag because we were missing a fry. I ordered a grilled chicken sandwich and it was burnt and completely dry. I'm usually not one to complain but I couldn't eat it. I used to work at Wendy's and I know they make the grilled chicken ahead of time so I wasn't expecting a fresh off the grill piece but this shouldn't have been served.

So this was my first time ever going to this restaurant. I want you to understand this place for the work they do is phenomenal! This pizza was A1. I'm from NY so the pizza to me there is always ON POINT but this place.

This wendys is up the block from me that's why I come here . I don't want to have to drive out of my way to another Wendy's so I stick to the one close to my house. It seems like the staff here is unfriendly and miserable which makes my trip here very unsatisfied. Also, when I order from here they seem to forget to add part of my order and I sometimes need to make a U-turn and go back for missing items. This to me should have been checked before the bags get handed over to the customers. Well I think I will have to start going to another Wendy's because maybe if I go to another Wendy's the order will be correct and not be missing items.

All I want is to be able to pull up get my order and it all be in the bag but not only that I want my food to taste good. I hate when they put wilted lettuce on my sandwich and I really hate when the French fries are cold when they should be hot I just ordered the food it should never be cold. I think management needs to keep a better eye on how things are running so they know exactly what is going on.
