I enjoyed a delicious wok and a side of brussel sprouts. Much better experience this time! The wok was spicy and full of flavor - and the sprouts were right on point - with just the right amount of salt.

I ordered a rice noodle wok with beef, broccoli, mushrooms and snow peas - topped with tropicalia sauce & garlic. YUM! I savored each bite, and have the leftovers for another tasty meal today! I will definitely come back again soon, and truly appreciate when a business owner displays accountability and extends a genuine offer for redemption. Not only is it great customer service, but it says a lot about the type of establishment they run - with care and consideration for customers. Thanks again!

Good joint with good food. I loved the concept of choosing my own sauce. They gave me samplers as well to help me decide. Tasted a few and they were all  equally good. You should definitely visit if you're around center city and looking for some Asian food !

This has got to be the worst place to order food in the entire tri-state area.  I would seriously rather chew myself across the front lawn then have to even ORDER anything from this place ever again.  The mere fact that I have to give this place at least one star has me close to tossing my computer off my desk.  My experiences have always been dreadful at this particular ABP.   Empty coffee containers, grinds in my coffee, registers completely abandoned by employees, etc.  However, my experience this past Friday was notably horrendous.

Since I work in the building I am sometimes in a fix to grab something fast and convenient.  ABP is neither of those two things.  I came in Friday at 3:30 pm (they close at 5) and ordered the Newport Turkey.  Description: white bread, turkey, avocado, cheddar, honey mustard. Sounds good right? The girl behind the counter takes my order and tells me they don't have white bread.  No white bread at a bakery??  Awesome, we're off to a great start.   I opt for wheat, no problem.  She starts my order and there's not one person in the store. With plastic spoons- (yes upside down plastic spoons for the spreads) she starts my order.   

10 minutes later, and a turkey avocado sandwich presented to me sans avocado- I am told they are out of avocado and asked if I still wanted it.  I said I was not interested in an $8.00 turkey and cheese sandwich.  The employee looked completely confused and asked what else I'd like.  I asked if they had arugula (a main ingredient for the next order I was going to place and a majority of their menu) and she said no.  "We haven't had arugula in weeks."  Neat.   She suggests other things on the menu that have avocado- to which I respond "you said you didn't have avocado..."  She says "We might have one in the back." And looks at me blankly as if I should give her marching orders to do her job and obtain ingredients.  Commence staring contest. I guess I lost because she then takes another person's order.  I've now been here 15 minutes.  She comes back to me, THROWS OUT the sandwich she started and repeats "you know, we might have one in the back" but then says "but... it'll be a waste.  No one will use the rest of the avocado since I only use  1/2 for your sandwich.  It'll be wasted."  (My head is literally about to spin off of my neck).  Staring contest round two.  I win this one.  She goes to look for avocado.  

Ta-Da‼‼! It exists! Miraculously they DO HAVE the ingredient for my sandwich that is now hanging out in the trashcan.  Wonderful! She says "what would  you like INSTEAD?"  You've got to be kidding me.  I said "I'd like the sandwich that I initially ordered since you have all the ingredients."  She said "but I just threw it away....and now all that turkey is wasted."  (Crickets) (I close my eyes and start to pray) 

After a small huff from the employee and three Hail Mary's from me- we were able to get back to reality and the order is started again.  Again with plasticware.  She asks if I'd like the entire avocado on my sandwich to avoid waste. I said, sure why not.  She says "It'll be extra... another $1.00".  No thanks.  She says "well, I sorta used 2/3 of it so..." I said "I'm not asking for extra anything...." Her response "well don't tell them you got extra then." Wow.  I am now here for 25 minutes.  Sandwich still incomplete.  3 people have asked where the cash register attendant is.  Screams throughout the store "Yo, go get _____. Where she at?" I am now having heart palpitations and I am wondering how I am still alive. Finally my order is about to be complete and tossed in the oven.  I had to ask that she put the avocado on last so I wasn't eating microwaved mush and the response was "what do it matter?"  Before I leapt over the counter to make it myself, another patron interrupted to request new tea water because the water was room temp.  That person may have looked like Jesus in that moment.  

Order complete 32 minutes later with only one other order prepared.  No joke. Complete nightmare. Oh...and the sandwich sucks. Never again.

I just happened to stumble into wokworks yesterday, and it ended up being exactly what I was craving. This is my new go-to spot. The ingredients are fresh and tasty, and the options make it really interesting. I ordered brown rice with broccoli shrimp and the peanut sauce. It was healthy and satisfying. All in all I was really impressed by the whole idea! Thanks wokworks!

Just an average Wendy's. Food seemed a little over priced but I assume it's because it's at the airport. The staff were friendly and it did not take long to get my food. I got a double cheeseburger and it was good, but nothing special. 
Would eat again.

Yuck.  I don't really like fast food anyway - and Wendy's is barely tolerable, but this location (a busy one due to location for sure) is pretty awful.

Not a good choice.

Not the greatest choice for food- but my daughter wanted chicken nuggets before we went food shopping and didn't pick out unnecessary items we didn't need just cause we were hungry- she seems to enjoy the kids meal- but everything else on the menu is hit or miss. 

Came today and she got her kids meal as I waited an additional 20 mins in the reserved drive thru parking spot for my pancake breakfast meal- that for some odd reason takes forever to make- when about ten other cars drove through the line already behind me. 

So I guess it's a special order item or something- I have no fucking idea- but it must be made by the slowest person ever! So apparently it takes super long to heat up pancakes and a biscuit with eggs- smh- saw a worker came out and went to another car waiting for their food so I got his attention and said I'm still waiting for my meal- he mumbled something and walked away. 

 By this point I'm still waiting and even more irritated because I don't think the employee I saw gave 2 shits about me sitting and waiting for my food- and I doubt he mentioned it to anyone inside the restaurant. So by this point I'm in bitch mode over the fact I'm still waiting and by this point I have to unbuckle and drag my 5 year old into the restaurant to bitch and complain- which I did- when looking in the back I see an old man about 90 preparing what I think is my meal. Then the drive they guy who initially helped me in the drive thru grabbed the meal and looked confused like wtf is my meal still here and not given to me. 

I talk to him and say I've been waiting to long for my meal- and was pissed. He apologizes and I again say you shouldn't have someone waiting in the reserve spot if you forget about them. I grabbed the meal and walked out! The meal was surprisingly fresh but the whole ordeal waiting wasn't worth it- how is it fast food? This is my last straw with this fast food chain and location

I like Au Bon Pain, and when I worked in Commerce Square used to frequent this store a lot.  However, my experience today was downright shameful.

I went in, noticed they had a new sandwich - Turkey and Chedder on a Cranberry Ciabatta - and ordered it.  I was told they were out of Cranberry Ciabatta, but they could make it with the last plain ciabatta. I said sure.  

I waited around for a while and then was informed that the bread cutter was broken, so they couldn't make it on the plain ciabatta.  Did I want it on a baguette.  I said sure.

While I waited for the sandwich, I wandered around the bakery area looking at the cookies and muffins.  I came back to the counter to see if my sandwich was done and the two young ladies that were manning the sandwich counter were gone.  The only person behind the counter was an older lady making salads.  I stand around for a while, she finishes making a salad, and then loudly comments about a sandwich being left in the oven, and asks if it's mine.  I said it might be.  She pulls the tray/sandwich out of the office, it looked VERY well done.  Finally, the two young ladies returned, finish my sandwich and hand it to me.  This entire ordeal probably took 20 to 25 minutes - for one sandwich, with NO other customers.

When I got back to the office and ate the sandwich, I noticed it was missing a key ingredient, and one that probably justified it's $7.19 price - avocado!.  So, I paid $7.19 plus tax, waited about 25 minutes for a turkey and cheese sandwich on a baguette.

ONE NOTE - the young ladies were very nice, not rude, just a little airheaded, clueless and forgetful...which can be just as aggravating as rudeness - especially when in a hurry.

This truck is fantastic! I had the B.R.A.T Mac, which was mac n cheese with bacon, ranch and tomato. It was the best mac n cheese I've ever had. The mac n cheese itself was delicious, but it also had just the right amount of toppings on it as well. I HIGHLY recommend the B.R.A.T mac. However, when I go back, which will be soon, it will be highly tempting to try one of the other items that sound just as delicious on that menu. People may think it's over priced, but you're paying for quality, which is what you're definitely getting!

My husband and I take turns stopping in on the weekends for their egg flatbreads. They guy who works in the morning on the weekend is great -- friendly, efficient, and remembered us and our orders after a couple visits.

You're kidding right?  This Au Bon Pain should probably get 1 star due to the vermin infestation.  But anyway - the over priced, high calorie sandwiches & soups are a godsend when it is raining and I am too lazy to leave my office building, but other than that?

I am so over au bon pain.

I love this idea and the variety of toppings. At the end of the day, it is still Mac and Cheese. No matter how good it gets, Mac and Cheese can only get so good, which is why I give it 4/5.
I tried the spinach, the bacon, and the crab. The crab was definitely my favorite.

My husband and I made an order through drive through. My husband had to continue to repeat the order as "Sameerah" appeared to be occupied while taking the order. My husband decided to make ONE change once Sameerah finally got his order correct and she then proceeded to say in a very loud time while her headset was on "Can you please come and erase this entire order and start over again because he keeps changing his order". I then decided to go into the store and speak with the Manager about what happened and Sameerah decides to come from the back and argue with me. When her Manager told her to go to the back she CONTINUED to make smart comments. I requested that the Manager speak with his staff because none of them treated me professional from that point.  It's obvious that Sameerah has no home training, but the lack of professionalism is sub par at best and needs to be addressed. There are a bunch of young girls working in there and very unprofessional... Additionally the Manager there has no control of them... He passively handles the situation... Sameerah needs to be terminated immediately....  Poor conduct; poor judgement and VERy unprofessional.

I'll take an order of mac n cheese "animal style".  If you ever been to in and out burger the Mac Attack is very reminiscent of it.  It's mac n cheese topped with bacon, pram, bread crumbs and fried onions.  Delicious concoction!  Bacon was crispy, not fatty, onion gave it a sweet taste, the mac was over the top creamy.  The whole dish just jelled together.

Big E is the zoom that makes this place go. Food is regular chick fila fare. the lines are always too long, but it does move relatively quickly. im not sure why they have one long winding line though. but seriously, they need to give Big E a raise since he's more than half the reason we keep going back.

The story behind Plant Pure is pretty interesting....Nelson Campbell, the man from the documentary entitled 'Plant Pure Nation' which tells the story of his journey to obtain state government endorsement of a plant-based diet teamed up with local chef Fernando Peralta who owned Vge, a former vegan joint (I actually wasn't very fond of) in Bryn Mawr to open this flagship location of Plant Pure Cafe, a new, healthy fast food franchise. 

Fernando was inspired to go vegetarian after watching his father suffer through a quadruple bi-pass and seeing his health wasn't up to par either. Fernando then gained interest in Buddhism and educated himself in the truth behind animal cruelty. It was then he went full vegan. Love these types of stories! 

Plant Pure is super simple... sammies, a couple rotating soups of the day, a salad bar, side dishes and make your bowls which seem to be a fan favorite and what I choose when I dine here. You don't have to be a veg-head to enjoy a meal here. In fact, I highly recommend it if you're not! It's so tasty you won't miss the meat.... 

You simply pick your protein (soy strips, black beans, baked tofu, seitan) a base (either brown rice and quinoa or potatoes), and then your oil free delicious sauce (red coconut curry, jerk peanut, creamy mushroom, teriyaki). Kale, broccoli, sweet potatoes, onions, roasted peppers, corn and mushrooms automatically come with every bowl. You may ask for substitutes or to eliminate as you wish. I personally keep forgetting ask to eliminate corn. I would also recommend NOT choosing the potatoes as a base because it come with yams as a topping. For me it was a bit too many, taters and I really love spuds. 

On both visits I opted for the seitan as my protein. It came highly recommended by the employees every time. It's pretty delicious, sliced thin and perfect texture. I alternate between the jerk peanut sauce and red coconut curry as they are the spicy (but not really) options. I can't choose a favorite. Both very delicious!! Sauce comes on the side so drizzle as you wish although the bowls are all under 500 calories so go for it! In fact everything on the menu is under 500 calories! It's hard to believe that actually. 

We have tasted the black bean soup which is perfectly spiced and the coconut mushroom wth chunks of meaty 'shrooms. It is TO. DIE. FOR! I would go out of my way for this soup alone!! It's creamy consistency and so flavorful!

They have a few kids' options in addition to the regular menu as well as vegan soft serve! Say what?! Kids loved it!

They also have what some may be familiar with and that's a "Groothie". If you're a vegan in the city you have heard this term for a green spinach based smoothie at other veg friendly spots. Curious, I asked an employee and she explained that a Philadelphia woman trademarked the term and sells it to many local plant based eateries. Neat!

Everything on the menu is whole foods-plant based, made with whole grains, nothing fried, no animal products, no added oils and limited sugars - mostly from natural sources. It's straight forward food. 

100% VEGAN. 

ZERO CHOLESTEROL. 

NO ADDED OILS. 

UNDER 500 CALORIES

PREPARED FRESH ON-SITE

BALANCED NUTRITION

Love the message and the purpose behind this business plus the food is delicious! I wish them much success! 

Plant based or not, give it a go! It's so incredibly delicious  and at a reasonable price point for a feel-good, quick meal!

Heard awesome things about this place and my expectations were exceeded. Was semi busy when I walked in, cashier took my order within 2 minutes and had my food within 5. Perfect as a fast casual. Portion size was large enough, ingredients were fresh, and I received exactly what I ordered. Gonna have to make this a regular thing.

I went here for lunch today based on a recommendation from one of my co-workers. I'm a big fan of stir fry and, based on their menu and website, figured this place to have fresh ingredients and bold flavors. 

I was right about the fresh ingredients part when it came to the vegetables, which is why I gave it more than one star. However, the crispy tofu I got was completely misnamed as it was soft and overly chewy in texture. And the bigger issue was with the complete lack of flavor, even though I ordered from the spicier end of the menu (General Tso's). Even though my meal was completely drenched in sauce, it tasted like it had only been covered in a bunch of cooked oil. Talk about the worst of both worlds - greasy, sodium filled sauce covering a dish that doesn't even remotely provide the flavor to justify eating something so unhealthy. The final kicker, they are very stingy with the vegetables, especially considering the price. 

Needless to say, I will not be visiting again.

The portion sizes are unbelievable! Be prepared to leave full. Sandwiches were very fresh and very tasty. We waited no more than 5  minutes for our order. This meal was inexpensive considering we are in the heart of a city eating "specialty" food. Kudos to the staff. We will be back!

Ordered a sandwich for pickup via a living social "deal" that was $4 for a footlong combo.  Sandwich was ready timely upon pickup.  I order a turkey sub with 4 free toppings and avocado.  As I open the sandwich in my office, one topping and the avocado (which I paid extra for) was missing.   Awful service.  Can't get a printed order correct.
What can I say? Even though the staff often looks like they could give a damn if you want a #1 or not, they're fast and consistent. And, yes, I do want a #1.

I've had the black bean bowl and the salad bar here. You can't get a better deal on a salad bar!! A size small salad is ~$6 and they don't make you weigh it before you pay (i.e. I can add all the heavy cherry tomatoes I want without worrying about a price increase!). The cilantro lime dressing was delicious but a little thick. I ended up bringing the salad back to my office and diluted the thicker dressing with some red wine vinegar that I have. My only suggestion is that they add oil and vinegar to the salad bar (or maybe it is already there and I missed it). Great place for a quick healthy lunch!!

I have been to a lot of McDonald's in my time, all over the country and this is, without doubt, the absolutely worst McDonald's I ever have been to, may be the worst fast food eatery ever. No coffee, no ice, bathroom was busted, no chicken, no ice tea, everything was broken. It was run down and awful,  but to add, the staff was horrific, especially the extremely rude girl who took my order. Fire the staff and tear it down. I didn't think McDonald's even let their restaurants get this bad.  STAY AWAY!!!

So good. I never tried the food trucks until now and wish I had sooner. The banana chocolate chip cookie is amazing and the Bella Donna was delicious and inexpensive. Highly recommend. The line is long, but come with a friend and the time will pass quickly :)

Went there today and the place was totally disorganized. Only two cashiers at lunch time and one was brand new. They have no order to the line. You are supposed to figure out who is next and who is waiting for their order. I let 3 people go ahead and order and then went to the unfriendly slub who sits at the first register. I go there at least once a week for a salad and she causes me of not waiting my turn. One person left to order besides me and I was there first. I told her to keep her salad and promised to never go back. The Manager was nearby and never said a word. Terrible customer service. I wish I had read the other reviews here before I started going there.  Don't patronize this establishment.

I am a fan of this place. I like my stir-frys with lots of veggies, and this place does not disappoint on that front. I ordered the SmallWok bowl, and that is more than enough. It carries me through lunch and leftovers.

I'm vegetarian, so I order tofu as the protein and usually get brussel sprouts or broccoli as the veg. First of all, the tofu is actually good here. I have been to so many places that just cube it and toss it with the noodles (not good). WokWorks' tofu is cubed with a nice char on it, served hot. That doesn't seem like a big thing, but it can be when you've been served crap tofu before. They also do an excellent job on the brussels sprouts; again, a veggie that can be horrible done wrong, but here they are well done, slightly charred, and have a citrusy flavor that is really nice. Their broccoli is tender.

I usually get the smoke sauce, only because its sorta like BBQ sauce, which I still love. I will certainly return to try more options. If I could have any critiques at all, the only suggestion I could make would be to label which sauces are veg. I picked Smoke because BBQ-like sauces are usually a safe bet, but I admit to not knowing 100% for sure, and Asian sauces often have a tendency to have sneaky animal ingredients in them at times, so a little designation might help. But that really is it.

The service is very fast, very nice and they do not rush you at the counter. They are very patient and will actually help you assemble the bowl piece by piece.

As one who was a Vegan for four years in the early aughts, then Vegetarian for the next few, and now a meat eater again, I found this place recently as I have an interest in simple healthy eating as I am now in my 40s. 
This place is amazing. My favorite item are the tacos. Chock full of so many veggies, you don't know you are not eating meat. For real. Another reviewer commented that they skimped on the avocado. Maybe with theirs, but not with mine. Yes, it looked exactly like the picture the owner took. 
There are only a few tables, and it is definitely a cafe and not a restaurant. Just letting you know. Hence the name. Place is clean, service is friendly. Looking for a healthy lunch in Center City, check this place out. You'll love it.

This is THE Worst Mcdonalds I've ever been in! That's saying something considering every city McDonalds is horrendous. 

It's like eating in a homeless shelter in this particular store. 
There's literally homeless people in front of the door begging. Stinking to hell. And just ruining your experience of Center City. You're waiting in line and hungry souls looking like the cast of the walking dead is staring your food down. 
Is it possible they perfected begging telepathically?

When you step inside I swear to God it's so Dirty you realize why Homeless people feel at home there. It smells like a few homeless people died there and no one has found their body. 

I ordered a Steak Egg bagel which was so old I swear it was made yesterday morning. 
How could it possibly be this stale if I'm here 7am in the morning????? 

I'm never going to mcdonalds again. 
They should be ashamed. 
Dirty work stations. Dusty looking employees looking like they couldn't care less if they tried. One was even tucking her shirt in. Try to be a little more professional Sharkiesha. 

If I could give a negative starred review I would. DO NOT GO HERE.

Yelp you've failed me again. Maybe I just didn't get the right combination for my stir fry but, it was super lackluster. The sauce was almost non-existent and the taste was really bland. I also had the sweet and spicy wings which were... meh. I may try it again as they might've just had an off day.

Very disappointing!  I went there for lunch today and got the bam bam steak bowl. The whole thing tasted BURNT!  They need to teach their cooks how to actually cook. I had such high hopes for this place.... :-(

They brought the food truck into the store?  Or maybe the store was first and then there was the food truck.  Regardless, after a Yelp event, we wanted to grab some food and found this store close by.  We were excited and the four of us all purchased separate items.  I ordered the heart attack, with bacon, caramelized onions, and potato chip crust.  My wife ordered the crab meat mac and cheese.  Both were a great way to fill us up and we still took some home for later.  

The food was prepared fast and given to us in plastic containers that are reusable.  Great location and I like the variety of mac styles.

Stopped in here to try it out as it is still a fairly new spot in Center City. The decor inside is really cute! Everything in the restaurant is vegan which I think makes it kinda unique! I ended up going for an order of the tacos. I feel like they could have used a little more seasoning throughout. I could help but feel like they stuck to their name a little too much at times I felt like I was eating the plant. A little hot sauce and the palate changed completely. Fair price $9 for three taco. And I like how all their prices are the same. It doesn't cost more for one thing vs the other! They even featured a salad bar.

This was our first time going to Plantpure Cafe, l may say we were quite pleased.  Lauren was Awesome in her recommendation from the menu, we were able to use our Groupon which was an added treat.  We will be visiting again.   The vegan ice cream was a very tasty too.  We didn't get the young man's name who brought the yummy vegan burger to our table, but he has a wonderful demeanor.  Kudo to you for a nice meal.

A groupon got me there, and now I just want to crawl into their basement hoping to go unnoticed and live the rest of my life from PlantPure scraps. 

Seriously, it's that good.  And I'm not even a vegan.  I went with two friends, also non-vegans, and they loved it as well.  

Healthy.  Delicious.  Earth-friendly.  Affordable.  What more can one ask for?

Spicy is an understatement for the spicy chicken here but I LOVE it. Overall the chicken is good here. Somehow they always manage to give me a thigh when I ask for a wing, but I'm not complaining. Have never tried anything other than the spicy chicken, lol even tho its piping I'm scared of mild.

.....10 minutes later. I had to come back and review the mild chicken, it's perfect. Just tried a piece from a breast that my friend had. Extra crispy and tastes as if seasoned with salt and pepper.

Got the Cobb Salad w burger, service was super slow.  Front staff seemed to care more about talking to each other rather than serving customers.  Food was good though, although  would not go back to this location because of service.

I don't frequent Wendy's in general, and this was my only second time at this location.  I was lured in by their advertisement for "fresh" fries with sea salt, along with the fact that I pass it twice a day and it's always crowded, so it must be good, right?  

When I went in, there were 2 lines and I belatedly realized I was in the wrong one.  My line had one register, while the other had 2...what kind of set up is that?  After waiting more than 10 minutes (should've trusted my instincts and left at that point) I switched lines and still finished sooner.

I got a #1 and was hoping the wait was worth it - NOT!  The fries were tastless and rubbery.  The burger was also tasteless with the exception of the half of a raw onion that was on it.  I took off almost all of the onion - I swear that taste stayed on me for the next day - and it was still awful.  The roll tasted stale and the rest didn't taste like much at all.

Ah, memories.  This was the Burger King that my friends and I, and just about all of the other kids in my class, went to on the first Friday of every month when our grade school would let us out early.  I'm sure the staff appreciated the invasion of Catholic school brats.  Anyway, memories aside, this Burger King is pretty standard.  It's pretty clean, the staff is relatively friendly, and the food tastes just like Burger King food tends to taste.  It's terrible for you, but it's cheap.  And I like it better than McDonald's.
Horrible customer service , people working at drive through have zero idea what she is doing . Rude , unprofessional and clueless .

The worst service from a Wendys I've ever had. The associate wouldn't let me tell her my order, she kept cutting me off. I get my food, and drive off. I get 5 min down the road and they forgot my cheese fries. I go back in and the manager acted as if I inconvenienced her and had an attitude. I submitted and online complaint and no action was taken. I submitted another complaint and was contacted by cooperate and she stated I would receive a call from the general manager. I never got a call from the general manager. Wendys will never get another dollar from me. Ever.

Food was very mediocre. I came in wanting to LOVE this place, but it simply did not deliver. I think the concept has so much  potential, but I did not feel the ingredients were good. Also it did not help my review when three of the veggies I wanted in my stir fry were not available.

I went here for the first time to pick up some lunch. I got white rice, beef, broccoli, pineapple and dark smoke (sauce). It was SO bland. I don't know if they forgot to add the sauce, or if the sauce is that bland, but it was not good. There were 2 HUGE pieces of beef. Why not chop it up into bite size pieces? Also - it looked more like roast beef than a stir fry type of beef. Why? Yuck.There wasn't much broccoli in there.  There was A LOT of other crap in there that I didn't order (onion things? they were long. celery. carrots, etc). I'm pretty bummed that I wasted $10 on this lunch that wasn't even edible.

The wait is horrible.  I ordered Pork Buns and their typical Wok meal with the noodles.  Wow.  This place is so bad.  The noodles were way over cooked and the buns were just ok.  Not going back.  Don't waste your time here.  It looks like a good idea that they couldn't execute on.

I admit it, I have recently become addicted to the wok. I ordered my first last Friday, seemed so harmless, so simple. No base for me, I am not into the starchy stuff and hides the truth of all those lovely vegetables.
Sunday night rolls around and I start thinking about pacing lunch for Monday and I ordered another wok. Split it across two days. Here it is Wednesday and now I am thinking, crap, really am I going a week solid on this for lunch? Yep! It's cold out, the wok, it's good and is a great vehicle for Sambal Olek. 
Oh yeah, the crispy dumplings are crispy, really crispy. Unlike any other place I have been so far.
If only they were wheelchair accessible, that one step in front is my downfall so I am destined for delivery.

This place gets better and better every time I go. At first the pricing was weird and the food was decent. Recently however the taste has extremely improved and the pricing is more reasonable and makes it easier to order. My meal is always fresh, hot, and filling. I personally prefer wokworks over honeygrow.

Slow service and terrible food. Wendy's has long been my favority fast-food joint, but this place and some of the other local establishments have really gone downhill lately. I ordered the new Portabella Mushroom Melt, and my burger was overcooked and dry. Considering that I go to Wendy's to get AWAY from overcooked dry burgers, you can imagine how disappointed I was. The fries, lukewarm and limp were almost as disappointing as the burger. My chili was fine, but I guess it's hard to mess something up when all you have to do is slice open a package of precooked food and pour it into a warmer. 

Also, it took well over 10 minutes just to get my lousy food at the counter. It's not fast, and it's barely food. I'm so not going back there again.

Enjoyed the portioning and meal itself. Got the bam bam steak: thin stir fry noodle, seared steak, baby bok choy, broccoli, garlic, bacon, crunchies, and spicy oyster sauce. Aside from the bacon and crunchies, didn't really seem too fusion-y. $11. Honestly tasted like something I would get at an Americanized Chinese food restaurant, but fresh. Quality of the ingredients was spot on, and all the staff were very friendly. Nothing that really set this place apart though.

Restaurant was pretty dead, and didn't really understand the fascination with plastic plants hanging on the walls. Everyone I saw that came in seemed to pick up food.

Overall, good experience, and probably something that I would grab on a regular basis.

I live going to wokworks whenever i need my noodle fix. I have tried the beef and the shrimp with assorted vegetables and they were both great! I recommend anyone who has never tried this place to give it a try. Its really lowkey and i didnt get nervous whenever i go inside to order (someplaces give me the uneasy vibe). The line was fast and the food came out faster than i expected. Really enjoyed.

Burrito was prepared cold and I wasn't expecting that, so the packaged cheese shreds were not melted, medium rare steak was cold, and everything was mushed together in a wrap. It was okay, but I can definitely find better. I was excited because it looked delicious, but I wasn't impressed. Probably won't order that burrito or come back any time soon... Especially after seeing other terrible reviews from this place. Staff was not friendly either! A woman that works there stood behind me for about a minute with a tray of trash and I didn't see her, so the woman behind the counter called to me to move but I couldn't hear her (meanwhile she is getting annoyed), so the woman behind me continued to stand there when she could have easily walked around me. Strange, and avoidable. I'm not coming back.

Drive thru service here is decent. ESP if you've never been inside. Idk if it's been updated inside recently but I had to stop going inside because it just smelled like some severe swampass. 

The employees who work the window are generally smiley and friendly. The drive thru usually has a line. Lucky if it doesn't. The parking lot can get messy so if you decide to go in don't park up against the building, difficult to impossible to get out during a rush. 

My experience has always been decently hot food. This Wendy's is pretty good at getting your order correct the first time thank God.
Great stir fry just wish there was more sauce added to it. The edamame dumplings are awesome!

Came here to grab some dinner quick. The place definitely could use some cleaning and revamping, looked like the whole shop was starting to fall apart. I got the 4 for 4 deal with the free Dave's Single promotion this month for downloading the app. The chicken nuggets were only a little warm, and not exactly tender. The fries weren't too fresh. The sandwiches were pretty okay, though I was given a drink instead of a frosty I ordered originally. Yeah ..this place could really use a little better management and help.

The most delicious Mac and cheese ever! I got the bold buffalo, but I could tell even without the buffalo, the basic Mac and cheese was really well made. I tried this place during a food truck event and it was honestly the longest line at the whole event. At one point it wrapped around the street. The portions were also huge and one serving was enough for me and my boyfriend!

I ordered delivery via GrubHub -- their page denotes no minimum and no delivery fee. I ordered a sandwich and a two liter soda. I can understand that maybe that isn't worth the delivery for a small establishment...but I don't think that the resolution for their predicament is to call me up and beg me to order something more, then move into more harassing me into buying something more, and then when I said that I am really not interested in a pound of french fries to myself, I was told that my business wasn't worth it. I haven't eaten in more than a day, and was sitting around waiting for the sandwich that was supposed to arrive in ten minutes. Great. 
Basically, I can't review their food because they deemed me unworthy, but from the looks of the other reviews, I'm not missing out on much.
I just get upset when people think it's ok to blame others for their own mistakes (IE no delivery minimum or fee)...because now I've had to have a confrontation with someone today that I really would have preferred to avoid.
Sadly, there are probably enough obese people in South Philly to keep them afloat.

The worst Wendy's I've ever been to. Very poorly operated. You'll need a TB test after eating here. STAY AWAY. Roach motel. I literally tossed my food in the trash and gave my daughter a bath after going there.

The good: Yes it's a chain, but I will say that their food tastes better than other Chipotle locations in Philly. So that's a plus. The location is also convenient. 

The bad: service is pretty awful here. Usually only one person working the line an several others in the back walking around or chatting with coworkers. They run out of ingredients fairly often. The app is a waste if you're in a rush: orders are never ready when they say it will be. In fact, on more than one occasion they never even got my order. When they did, they only started making it after my arrival. Everything is really slow here.

The ugly: finding hair in my food? Done!

WOW! Just simply, wow! One of my close friends held a wedding this past Labor Day weekend and Mac Mart Truck was one of two culinary options, which I thought was awesome. I consider myself a Mac'N'Cheese enthusiast and this is as good as it gets. I had the Cowboy Cup which had bacon, corn bread, and jalapeños and it was the best damn mac and cheese I've ever had. Not only was the staff super friendly, the food was so so good!

Stumbled across this place while looking for a new lunch spot and was delighted to hear that this was in the same place as Maoz. Based on my meal there, it's a more than worthy replacement for our fallen falafel place. I'm not a vegan by any strict standard, but eat plenty of vegan meals without trying.

I got a plant bowl, with rice/quinoa, seitan, and the coconut mushroom sauce. Seriously. So, so good. Everything was cooked to perfection in the bowl, which included kale, sweet potatoes, onions, peppers, and corn. My dad joined me and got the same thing except with red curry sauce (which I tried and was happy to taste that it wasn't too reliant on salt for flavor, which is a huge plus for me).

I wish it hadn't been cold so I could've treated myself to the vegan self serve. Plus the sandwiches that were being brought out to other customers looked delicious!

The staff is also incredibly friendly! I was greeted upon walking in the door and once again as I left. Some places can't be bothered with the former, let alone the latter.

I'm very much looking forward to the next time I spend my lunch break there.

Went on Sunday no line, no waiting so I assume my order was correct.  Overall I just didn't really enjoy it.  I ordered rice noodles with veggies, the tropicalia sauce, and crispy garlic.  Maybe my order didn't get the right sauce because I didn't taste anything sweet or spicy. It tasted like generic savory stir fry sauce.  I liked the consistency of the noodles.  I like the variety of veggies. I did not taste the crispy garlic  so I would not waste the extra money on this.  Lastly, I did not realize eggs come on everything.  I'll take responsibility here as it is mentioned on the menu (in very small lettering).  I hate eggs.  I even got some egg shells.  I'll be sticking with Honeygrow

Pros:
Good Variety of Vegetables
Noodles
Fast

Cons:
Expensive
Blah tropicalia sauce
Eggs come with everything
Egg shell

This place has gotten S L O W and they regularly run out of staple items like chicken, fajitas or rice. I guess they want stuff to be fresh (?) but this is a foreseeable and preventable issue that after being open for over a year should have been ironed out. Further, some employees are great and fast, while others move like snails and randomly walk away from their positions for inordinate amounts of time, bringing the line to a grinding halt. 

Who ever manages this place needs to step up because it's about to fall out of my rotation to one of the hundred other lunch options.

Ordered from here Friday night for the first time.

Came in less than an hour. My garlic fries were great as were my sister's ocean fries. Star off because they messed up part of our order (put hot peppers & pickles on my sisters' and mom's sandwiches and not on the side.)

Good place to grab a quick lunch or dinner to go. My boyfriend and I both enjoyed our food. I ordered a custom bowl with brown rice, vegetables, and Dan Dan sauce on the side; my boyfriend ordered the teriyaki stir fry with brown rice and thought it was delicious. Some of the reviews I read mentioned the food being too oily; you can actually choose your oil level when you order!

We came here around 6:30 on a Friday night and there was no line. The staff was young and friendly. We got our food in about 5 minutes and took it to go. Both of our orders cost around $20. I'd come back.
Very busy counter with ample staff to meet the needs of hungry customers foday. Ordered a single. Nothing special. It was served without delay.

I went here for lunch the past two days because I work in the building next door. For the food that you get, it's extremely overpriced. I got a chicken cobb salad and a chicken avocado sandwich. 

Chicken cobb salad- didn't have any chicken on it, and I paid extra for that. Really upsetting. It wasn't that large of a salad for $8.50. 

Chicken avo- I thought this was really good and I enjoyed the flavor of the chicken and I liked the bread. I would probably get this again. 

There are definitely better places in the area that taste better and are less expensive.

Don't mistake this fast casual chain for fast food. Everything is cooked to order, which is great! And the food is tasty, and fairly quick.

The problem when I was here was the woman taking orders. She didn't know how to move on between customers, which was adding tons of unnecessary wait time

I love this place! True vegan values, and food. So delicious, I love the Reuben in a wrap, but the bread is also amazing. Definitely something for everyone, you don't have to be a vegan to enjoy this awesome food. To the very young to the very old there is something yummy and delicious waiting for you here. The extra bonus is you can count on it being very nutritious as well. Plus the people who own and work here are awesome human beings, I will follow you from Bryn Mawr to Philly, because it is totally worth the trip. I have taken hard core meat eaters here and they hated to admit it but they loved the "steak"sandwichs!

Not bad for the first time. Boneless were a little crispy but the  fries were not bad. Employees were out cleaning the lobby and tables. Will try again. Employees are just getting adjusted to the daily routine.

There's no Chick-Fil-A in SF so when I was walking around exploring Philly in March of last year and saw them in the Penn Center, I was so excited. I grew up eating Chick-Fil-A in TX so it's a nostalgic thing. I always get an order of their chicken nuggets and a deluxe chicken sandwich with Polynesian sauce. That sauce, so addicting! The line here is fast but my gripe is the actual wait for the food. Takes forever and a day, especially when you're hungry. =/ It's in the food court upstairs so there's plenty of seating.
Ordered chicken but got burnt general tso's chicken. Friendly staff and nice atmosphere. Too bad i work around the corner, thought i found a sweet spot to eat for lunch but nvm.
East Coast hamburgers rock hard over west coast Cali-Pussy-Sodium-free-burgers!   This Wendy's is no exception.  Good food in a fast-food burger.

In all my 34 wise years of life I have never been to a Popeye's Fried Chicken. That is until my wife came home tonight and wanted to go. We don't really eat fast food, especially fried chicken, but fast food tastes good and I love marketing. 

This place is very easy to find. It's on the corner of City Line Ave / Haverford Ave and it is super bright and inviting. It was empty other then a family of 4 sitting down. I was surprised by how small it was inside. Only a few tables. I really never saw a fast food spot with such a small seating area. 

The people behind the counter were nice. We ordered the 8 piece with a side of mac/cheese and 4 biscuits. We were out in under 3 minutes. Scary...god damn scary to order, pay and leave with food in 3 minutes. 

This stuff is good...almost a little too good. I am not a fried chicken person. I haven't tried all different kinds but I enjoyed the batter/breading, whatever you want to call it. I could not stop eating it. I honestly felt like a robot. Total lose of control and by the time it was done I felt pretty horrible. Amazing stuff but I felt depressed, sleepy and mildly angry when I was done. 

I don't think I will be going back to Popeye's not because the food was bad, or the service was bad but because I'm scared of what might happen afterward.

Ordered the chicken Cesar salad and there were huge chunks of chicken and barely any dressing. Want to charge me for extra when they could see that the leaves were dry. The romaine was also wilted and brown in some spots. Have had better from here before but have also had instances where there was way to much dressing. Can't win

Okay so I don't know what happened in the last two years since I wrote that review but CHick-Fil-A has really stepped it up!  The employees are very nice, courteous, and service is fast and organized.

Been to Wokworks twice and have been very pleased both times.  Staff was extremely friendly, helpful and patient  as it took me some time to make my choices.  All of the options looked great so it was hard to decide.  Service was fast.  Loved the lo mein noodles with chicken, snow peas and peanut sauce.  I think the pork dumplings were the highlight - probably more from the sauce than the base ingredients.  Citrus tea slush was great, too (last summer, not this winter).  Thought the plant life on the wall was very cool.   Looking forward to trying the sides and more combinations of the wok dishes.  Will have to wait until next time I'm in town.
This McDonald's has a great location and the food is okay.  It gets quite busy at times but it's a good value.

Went to wokworks for their second day of lunch.  Line of people waiting to pick up food should have tipped me off that something was amiss, but I ordered anyway.  

Liked the options and the interesting ingredients, but this place really has to work out its operations (an assembly line concept would seem more efficient) as my food took over 25 minutes to be ready.

With respect to the food-

First impression - not great presentation.  Wish "to stay" orders came in actual dishes and not cardboard takeout containers.

Taste-wise my quinoa, chicken, brussle sprout, mushroom dish with the green curry sauce was good but too salty and WAY too much sauce, it was like a soup. 

Friends I was with thought their dishes were pretty good.  Prob should have ordered rice or noodles as they seemed to absorb the sauce much better.

Here's to hoping the kinks will be worked out as there is potential here.

I'm always hesitant to wait in a long line for food but this truck was a must. My roommate and I went to the annual food truck festival and got two of the original mac and cheesed. They were yummy if a bit on the cold side. I think the cold was just do to the weather however so not their fault. The best part was definitely the crunchy topping. If I go again I want to try the buffalo mac and cheese because it looks amazing.

Horrible is the word!  The staff is plain rude and not to mention the discord!
I went here last week to order my sandwich when my sandwich is announced and I come to pick it up (clearly as there is NO line for pick up and there is NO order number concept). As soon as i pick it after my payment was done. This staff lady comes and snatches the bag from my hand saying "Not so fast". Her tone implied that I might be stealing?? After i have paid in full? You know you can say the same thing politely.
Anyways I asked them to keep my sandwich as i was so pissed. I'm a traveling consultant and often eat outside. This place is certainly OFF MY LIST.

I sent my feedback to feedback@aubonpain.com but never got a response back from anyone.
Clearly customer service is not a priority here. Unfortunately i can't give a 0 star so

Im giving a fast food chain in Philadelphia four stars bc of the performance of staff dealing with drunks

The manager I think was fast getting orders out, asked if customers wanted ketchup, gave napkins... Excellent on his behalf. 

Food came out correct and tasted as it should have, so no complaints.

Second place I've tried straight off this month's Philadelphia magazine restaurant recommendation section for 'best bowls' or something along those lines and I have to say YES. Wokworks really has the MOST delicious bowls that I've had here in Philly so far. Both my boyfriend and I built our own wok bowls and had them delivered to home (thanks Postmates!) and each was different as we were able to choose from a wide variety of grains, protein, veggies, and more.

I was very impressed with the friendly staff and the eccentric collection of sauces. The ingredients were top notch and I was very pleased with my meal; the portion sizes were more than adequate! I highly recommend the pepper sauce, but can't wait to return to try some other combos.

Imagine taking your daughter for nacho fries because that is all she wants after a hard day of test taking at school, and you are greeted by the manager accusing you of lying and scamming for free food.

If I can score lower than 1, I would. My daughter went in because the drive through was long. She comes out and looks in the bag to see they forgot the fries. She runs back in and was greeted by an employee who stated "I didnt forget nothing" and left her standing there. 

After 5 minites, I walk in and was promptly ignored until I asked for the manger. He yelled from the back and asked "what do you want". I tried explaining they forgot the fries and he interupted by stating "No, the fries were in there and if you wanted free food, you will have to wait for it". Shocked I asked if he just called me a liar at which point he turned his back and ranted to the other employees about people walking around scamming free food and he can't stand people like us. There was verbal sparring but it is hard to spar with someone with such Intelligence.

Now, it would seem that if I was scamming, nacho fries are not the highest ticket item Taco Bell has to offer. I would also think that the customer service industry would not go around calling thier customers liars.

BTW, the managers name is Damion.

The first time I tried this place I got some combination of noodles & veggies & sauce.  It was pretty good, which is why I came back.

The 2nd time I got string beans, brussel sprouts & edamame dumplings.  Probably wouldn't have gotten the dumplings had I known they were fried, but it wasn't on the menu and I didn't ask.  Everything was good except the string beans.  They were so salty I couldn't eat them.  

Another time I tried their smoothie (Mango black tea something or other) and it just tasted like lemonade.  I hate lemonade.

Most recently I got the orange chicken salad and asked for it without chicken.  The guy made a big deal about pulling the chicken off of the pre-made salad.  I guess I could have done it but I asked when I ordered it, before it was given to me and he acted like it was some big inconvenience.  Also, there were a ton of orange seeds in it that I had to keep spitting out. There has never been a single other person in there when I go and they always act like they're doing you a favor by making your overpriced over salted food.

The service was only friendly the first time, gets worse every time I go back.  I probably won't go back again.  Jane G's is right across the street and for the price, much better in my opinion.

This place offers a really good burger! It's juicy, fresh and flavorful. The French fries are thin and served pulping hot. I have tried the original and the rosemary version. I couldn't really tell the difference in flavor. Thankfully the service is fairly quick since it is located in the Philadelphia airport food court.

This place is awesome! Stopped by on a Wednesday and they seriously offer FREE BEER! It sounded too good to be true, but the super nice server Stacy brought us up and actually poured us free beer! They had some great specials too, Brussels sprouts for $3, pop corn chickens $4 and more!

this location is always fast!!!  they even have a lady who will walk around to the tables and re-fill your drinks if you want! 

the food tastes standard to all chick fil a's i have been to.  i have absolutely no complaints about this place. 

and there is someone who dresses up like a cow, but he stands down on the street, not in the gallery.  :)

Wokworks is a very attractive and clean place with friendly staff. Love the herbal wall garden. GO for wok noodles and teriyaki sauce with any protein. Also delicious pickles and green beans. Kelvin slushie is a hit.

Great lunch spot! I got the fat and happy mac and cheese bowl, and I've got to say I was feeling fat and happy by the time I was done. 

Definitely not the best eat in place. It seems like most of their business is through online ordering services. Although they do have some seating if you're looking for a quick lunch.

Stumbled upon this place while trying to find something to eat on my lunch break. Service was super, everyone was so nice and helpful! The food was decent. It's not the best I've had but it satisfied my craving. I got the general tso's chicken bowl and I gotta say, their sauce was REAL good. A little overpriced for the amount of food you get, but it's philly so what can ya do?

I am not obsessed with chick fil a and the long lines make it annoying to come to this location. Be aware that if you have a lunch hour you should try to come early to beat the line that wraps around the corner. 

DO NOT ORDER A PARFAIT: I know that I probably am the only person to order a parfait, but I was not expecting the fruit in it to have mold on it. They claim the parfaits are made daily in the morning but clearly that is not true. When I showed them the parfait they did refund my whole order (which was nice), but I will obviously never order a parfait again.

Came here recently when I was craving stir fry, and wanted to avoid the long lines  over at Honeygrow. Although there was not a long line, the wait time was just as long as it would've been at their competitor. Not sure why, maybe they don't have as many fry stations, or they receive alot of call-in takeout orders, but it was about a 20 min wait for my food. No Bueno.

I ordered a tall, pork, broccoli, sweet peppers & bok choy, with peanut sauce, topped w/ fresh cilantro & fried shallots. It was good, and the sauce was flavorful, although not too much peanut flavor. Portion size was generous. I also ordered a spring roll, and I guess I should've asked what kind (fried or cold) because it was the type wrapped in rice paper & served cold. I was not a fan, and would not order it again. I'm willing to give them another try again, as I'd like to try out some of their other sauces as well as their dumplings.

Let's just hope their wait time improves.

The food is good.  I'm not sure why there are gnats flying around though which is a turn off from wanting to eat there.  Last time I went there were 5 employees and not one picked up a rag to wipe the dirty tables.  I wiped my own table.
So twice in one week I've been. Yes it's an airport. Yes it's a Wendy's. But really?  No OJ. No cinnamon roll. Etc. It took less time to tell me what they had. Attitude was like oh well.
Guys, this place is good! Its not gourmet or anything but as far as panda express goes this place is bomb! Sweetfire chicken was delish

Super good, very fresh and friendly staff. I suggest the crispy tofu, it was excellent. Great first experience and I was glad to see Grubhub delivery driver picking up a few orders while I was inside eating. 

I would definitely come again. A bit pricey but heathy food isn't cheap in this city (or anywhere). Good size for the price and excellent service.

Why so stingy with avocado? Unlike the pictures posted by owner on yelp, out of my three tacos, one had a single piece of avocado and the other two had two pieces each. Taste isn't great but itself, but is ok after adding the sauce. If you're charging 8 bucks for three vegetarian tacos, I expect more ingredients of nutritional value. Some standardization of product assembly would be good.

I'm all for hiring students and giving them a working experience but they must be taught professionalism.  I'm wondering if common courteous was taught at the training sessions. If so, James must have been asleep during the class. He definitely missed the session on "how to print out a receipt!"  To make matters worse, when I arrived home and opened my meal (2 grilled chicken wraps), it appeared to have been made and packaged by a 2 year old! Both wraps were sloppily made. Going back wasn't an option for me because I live too far.  Lesson learned on my part!

It's a great place for a vegetarian dish. I got their bella donna - which was basically several vegetarian meatballs served on a bed of brown rice and accompanied by a pita bread and cheese. It was warm, filling, and great on a cold winter day. The flavor wasn't particularly stunning, but it definitely got the job done. It's a great make-you-feel-good place, even if it is for a small lunch break. It is also always packed with a line around noon, so be careful to time it right!

WOW!

This mac and cheese will rock your taste buds and you will never look at mac-n-cheese the same ever again! I finally found the truck during the callow hill night market, the line was super but well worth the wait. I ordered the Heart Attack Mac - which was mac n cheese topped with caramelized onions, bacon and parmesan panko crunch. The cheese and toping combination was just perfect - It was happiness in food form. They offer so many other different varieties of mac n cheeses, so I will definitely be going back for more. The price is pretty reasonable for a gourmet mac n cheese bowl and service is pretty quick (yes even if you are standing in a long line during a night market) They don't have a set location where they do business therefore make sure to check them out online to see where they camp out. Go get your mac-n-cheese everyone!!
Every time I go to this specific chipotle the food is cold.  I've never really had a great experience here.  Also the rice usually has no flavor

I don't know if it's just the location or what but tonight the service was terrible and the food didn't taste right. Doesn't taste like how I had it when I first moved to Philly . 

So as the drive thru person was taking our order he'll pause in between our order and you can hear him laughing through the speaker like what was so funny? Professionalism? I think not. 

My boyfriend ordered the chili dog and it was so sloppy . I had ordered the #7 which was the spicy chicken sandwich meal . The spicy chicken tasted so sour I don't know what happened there . Was the mayo that was on the sandwich overdue or something? Who knows. My fries were very mushy and tasted like it's been drenched in oil that has been sitting there for months. The Sprite fountain drink tasted so gross . It tasted like I was sipping water from a molded filtered sink . Never ever coming back here again. The food and drink was just trash. Excuse my language ! Go to McDonald that's nearby it'll probably be better.

I'm not vegetarian, but lately this has been my first choice whenever I'm in the mood to buy lunch from the nearby row of food trucks on Spruce. The chocolate bomb cookies are seriously amazing. I'm not a huge fan of cookies, but I can't get enough of these..so much dark, rich taste and a steal for the price. 

I also like that the food itself is really inexpensive, and I usually enjoy their specials more than their regular line of items. A lot of the specials I've ordered were very flavorful and delicious, despite not having meat in them.

DO NOT GO HERE. It is absolutely terrible, it's ridiculous. I ordered a butterfly shrimp combo which came with fries, a biscuit and a soda. So starting off with ordering. the girl seemed so impatient and rude, which annoyed me. And then they didn't have my sauce as I was ordering, but I'm not a person to complain about something like that. It happens. Once I pulled up to the window, she repeated my order to me but it was something completely different. When she got it right, she practically shoved my food in my face. 

For the meal, oh my goodness. The fries were soggy and all I could taste was oil, and I opened my box as soon as I drove off. The butterfly shrimp wasn't hot or crunchy. When it comes to popeyes, I love the flavor and crunchiness of both the wings & fries but for this place, it was neither. I was on the way home from a long day of work, so I ate a little bit anyway. But when I went to drink my soda, TASTELESS! An unappetizing meal with an unappetizing soda, how annoying. NEVER AGAIN.

Mac Mart catered our wedding at the 23rd Street Armory and did a fantastic job!  Guests are still raving about the Mac. And Marti was sooo easy to work through the entire process. Great luck in your new storefront!

This McDonald's location is the pits and has been going down hill for years. The staff changes all the time. The building and equipment is falling apart. There is usually a long wait inside or in the drive thru. The poor employees in the summer work without air conditioning. Not my first choice of places to eat but at times it is convenient. Today Hubby picked up breakfast the food smelled horribly, was overly greasy and mushy. This place needs to close . I'll drive the extra 10 minutes to the street rd Feasterville location.

Marti Lieberman's Mac Mart Truck has had a meteoric rise over the past year. Marketed as Philly's first and only mac n cheese food truck, it's an ingenious concept, brought forth by the focused marketing plan of Ms. Lieberman. From the name to the bright pink design, it's clear that this Drexel alum was made for this.

She's a mainstay at the 33rd street food truck scene, but with the press nipping at her designer heels, it's no surprise that she's a continuous presence at a variety of special events. Whether it's catering for the Starr Restaurants' executive team or a media event for Outward Bound Philadelphia, there's a reason everyone's clamoring for the Mac Mart Truck and it starts with the mac. 

While the local media came out to cover Outward Bound Philadelphia rappelling off of the Four Seasons Hotel a few months back, I came to indulge in a bevy of mac n cheese.

I could not choose just one from all of the options available to me, so I went with all of the options that day. The mac comes with great packaging, but fair warning - these are not microwaveable, an important point that was clarified for each and every customer. 

But enough babble - let's get on with the mac! 

Mac's Mart [$8]
Original Mac, buttered Parmesan Panko bread crumbs, ketchup (optional)

The original mac maintained an al dente texture with the creaminess of the cheese interspersed throughout. The Ruffle-style chips added a nice salty kick though overtook the Parmesan Panko bread crumbs in terms of texture and taste. Still, this had all the elements of a good mac n cheese - creamy cheese, al dente macaroni, and texture on top.

Cowboy Cup [$8]
Original Mac, crispy bacon, cornbread crumble, jalapeno ranch drizzle 

The cowboy cup offered a jalapeno ranch drizzle that was subtly sweet, with hints of spice on the finish. Even the cornbread crumble had an innate sweetness that was countered by the salty bacon. Though I typically prefer crispy bacon, I actually enjoyed the meatiness of the bacon here considering there was plenty of texture from the cornbread crumble. 

Pesto Bowl [$8]
Original Mac, basil-pecorino-walnut pesto, Parmesan Panko crunch

As expected, the pesto bowl ventured into herbaceous territory. In fact, as soon as the lid was lifted, the delicious smell of garlic and basil wafted out from within. The Parmesan Panko crunch was more apparent here and offered great texture. With the undertone of pesto, be prepared for a salty, yet creamy bite! 

Spinach & Artichoke Mac [$8]
Original Mac, garlic sauteed spinach, soft artichoke hearts, cheddar cheese shreds, homemade pita chip crisps

The spinach and artichoke was a great interpretation, with each bite emanating the oft-enjoyed dip. The garlic sauteed spinach and tender artichoke hearts were apparent, though the homemade pita seemed to be overtaken, or even replaced, by the Ruffle chips. Regardless, if you like spinach artichoke dip, this is the mac for you!

Heart Attack Mac [$8]
Caramelized onions, crispy bacon, Parmesan Panko topping

But truly, my favorite Mac Mart Truck mac is the Heart Attack Mac. That shouldn't be much of a surprise considering my gluttonous tendencies. I was able to indulge in this at the 2013 Chinatown Night Market and it was simply incredible - creamy mac n cheese topped with thick-cut bacon, sweet caramelized onions, and a Parmesan Panko crust on top? You can't go wrong with that. The added sprinkle of Frank's Red Hot only added additional flavor and heat to a great mac.

So if you're ever craving Mac n Cheese, don't hesitate to check out Mac Mart Truck's Facebook page or Twitter handle for the latest on all things mac in Philly. You won't be disappointed. Mac Mart Truck recently celebrated their one year anniversary so congrats on that milestone, but here's to decades more mac for Philly's devoted.

Today, I have had it with this chipotle. I'm convinced that the workers at chipotle r sexist because every time I go in there they give my male friends more portions. Today I order a chicken burrito paid about 9 bucks and it was smaller than the water cup they give you. The burrito barely had any meat or rice and the majority of the burrito was made up of sour cream. I would greatly appreciate if the management fixed the issue with the amount of portions they give. I'm not asking for double meat I am asking for the usually amount.
This place have bad services. I ordered to go, yet they added wrong stuff to my bowls. In addition, they just put the caps in the wrong bowls.

Cashier by the Ashley was very unprofessional . Would not answer when question was asked . Walked to the floor just to push chairs in. The floor and tables were dirty and she ignored it, I noticed while taking others peoples orders she was on her phone .

I LOVE THIS FOOD TRUCK. It has a massive variety of vegan/vegetarian foods. There's usually a long line which is understandable considering the caliber of the food.

Bella Donna - tofu meatballs on rice with veggies & cheese. This was incredible. The tofu meatballs were so flavorful, spicy, warm, aromatic and it really melted in your mouth. I loved the herbs and spices as well. It was served with rice and vegetables which gave nice balance and texture and worked so well with the meatballs if you mix it in. Came with pita bread which was great.

Note: will be coming back to attempt to try every thing on the menu!

Not feeling the Chik Filove. The staff here was pretty rude. I live in Atlanta and employees take great care of you there. We asked for fries instead of tots with out biscuits at 10:25am. They told us we couldn't do that and we would have to pay full price for fries and soda. So our regular order of $14 ended up costing us $18. Then we waited over 20 minutes to get our food. Absolutely ridiculous.

The competition for best food truck on Spruce street in UCity is fierce, but I have to give it to Magic Carpet. The insanely long line between the hours of 11:40-1:30 every day is proof enough, but I still feel like I should give them some much-deserved love on yelp anyways. 

The people who work here are friendly, and they do a great job of remembering the preferences and tastes of their (many) regulars. They also provide solid recommendations for newcomers, so definitely ask. Everything is vegetarian, and most (if not all) items can be made vegan.

I hate myself for not venturing out from my regular order more often, but I get such powerful cravings for my reliable favorites that I find it hard to deviate from my winning formula. I usually get the magic meatball, the falafel sandwich, or the pita knish, but honestly, you can't go wrong in my experience. It's often messy, and a fork is pretty much necessary, but man, the flavor combinations are on point! Can't say enough kind things about this cart.

Customer service at this location was horrific. The cashier was rude and disrespectful. I politely asked for a coca cola and was told that "We ain't got no more". I've eaten at this location multiple times and have not experienced this level of unsatisfactory customer service. It's not my fault that I didn't have the psychic abilities to know that Coke wasn't available. Corporate, please address this issue by adjusting your training practices.
We was greeted with and attitude and disrespect and not to mention she was on the phone texting while customers was at the counter placing their orders

Creative and complex flavors and surprisingly good value! I was a bit taken aback by the 8$ cost of the jalapeno popper mac and cheese bowl at first, but after I realized it was enough for 2 meals, the price no longer seemed so bad. I just wish the mac n cheese wasn't cold by the time I got it back to my desk. It was a cold day to venture out of the office for my lunch break, so I was really looking forward to hot, gooey cheese to warm me up. Because of the temperature issue, the jalapeno popper cream on the top did not properly melt or mix into the mac n cheese. When I reheated my leftovers later, however, and mixed it all together, the flavors were more even. The crunchy topping added awesome texture! I'm definitely going to try it again, since I feel like the cold mac was just a one-off. I also love the pink truck and pink bags- adorable aesthetic!

I've Been eating at this panda express for almost a year now and I never get tired of it !! It's always fresh always satisfying always very clean even their bathrooms is spotless I don't eat Chinese food ever but I love Panda Express !! They greet you the moment you walk in they have very good manners very polite people . When they run out of something the cooks are there to provide the food quickly! I recommend this spot any day , it's quick kind and clean and it's very hard to find a fast food place like this around.

This place is always crowded. But that is because of the location.
I will say that the staff here has always been nice to me. They do their best to get orders out quickly, but the popularity of this place makes that almost impossible.
4 for 4 is the best deal. And download the app...a lot of deal available also.

The employees were very cordial in the drive thru...however, they messed up our order.  Ordered two six piece chicken nuggets...one had 4.  Instead of honey mustard...they give us pure honey.  No ketchup as requested.  The only thing I did catch was the drink order they messed up.

Lotta hate for this particular location.  All I know is that Chipotle is one of the very few national chain fast food places that I can actually eat at.  
Seriously, when you eat healthy, crap like McDs and even ChixFillAy is indigestible. But Chipotle I can eat.

Gave this place two tries and both times my order was wrong. These wings are really small, not fresh tasting and their sauce is too salty. The wait times are too long for the quality of food that you'll get. They're far more better places for wings than these.

I have been to this location a few times. They are not friendly. Twice they have shorten the pieces of chicken in m bucket. I do not recommend this location. They need to be trained on how to treat there customer.

Everyone here left low reviews, but the last time I visited it was good. and I was even surprised that they chicken tasted good, because I thought that they will be at McDonald's level.     But chicken nuggets still got no to a little chicken meat in it.  But they better than Mcdonald's. But I think that their refill machine pour both water and soda in the cup. I might be wrong but I hope other customers can back me up. 
Update: went there again because they have a lot coupons. I was surprised that lettuce in their salad and burgers was fresh
Update: we went there again with my friend and they put sm fries instead of large.  So many bad reviews but I guess no one cares.

Getting off of the shitty New Century bus, starving and grossed out,  we headed over to this McDonald's to use the bathroom and grab a snack. 

This turned out to be the perfect Philly welcome. 

I was able to enter the bathroom right away, but my boyfriend had to wait for them to BREAK INTO THE BATHROOM with a putty knife....as a HUGE fight consisting of female McDonald's employees broke out in the street. It was insane. Screaming, clawing...we couldn't wait to get out of there (okay, who am i kidding, i ran out of the bathroom without drying my hands to see this spectacle..). 

FInally the employees were able to pry the men's bathroom door open and we were able to make a swift exit. 

Only in Philly?

OMG! My first time trying a Smashburger and I was beyond pleased. Single cashier was very pleasant and efficient. Classic bacon burger was made to my exact requests (no cheese, onions or pickles, extra mustard and ketchup). It was bagged (with napkins) and in my hands in under 5 minutes. Hot, juicy and flavorful!
No tomatoes, a half a piece of bacon and a half of a lettuce leaf, WOW! Service suck on top of that. If I had dined in,  I would of threw it back at them in their face and walked out. Don't GO HERE!
Friendly staff, excellent food. Given the high quality of the ingredients, prices are quite reasonable.

This Subway is bad, bad, bad.

For starters, they only had two people working during the lunch rush. One on the register, and one making sandwiches. I waited no less than 10 minutes for the three people in line ahead of me to get their sandwiches. 

Second, the guy who was making my sandwich didn't have a clue what he was doing. I actually had to remind him to take my meat out of the microwave and put it on my sandwich.

Third, my sandwich sucked. I had several bites that were just bread and nothing else. Blah.

Finally, after consuming my food, I got out of my chair and the person I was with started freaking out. Why, you ask? Well, because there was a big old roach making its way across the tile floor.

GROSS.

I won't be returning here.

I was really sad that Maoz closed, but I was really excited when Plant Pure opened up, because I'm always a fan of more vegan eats. I like that they write the calorie counts on the menu, and that everything they have is under 500 calories. The staff is very friendly.

I ordered the vegan Banh Mi and a side of roasted potatoes. I will say that I'm a bit disappointed this place doesn't offer fries of some sort (even sweet potato!). Also, my food looked nothing like the beautiful, brightly-colored photos I saw on Yelp before I came. Here goes:
-Potatoes: Maybe I just got a bad batch, but their roasted potatoes were REALLY DRY, stale, and hard to chew. They're also quite bland - could barely taste any salt/herbs. I ended up digging through it to find as many not-terrible potatoes I could, before giving up and tossing it. Really wish I had not ordered them, very unappetizing.
-Banh Mi: I must say that they have HUGE PORTIONS. I'm a fan of getting the most bang for my buck, and this place delivers on that end. I swear, the sub was larger than subways!! However, the bread wasn't toasted and REALLY SOGGY from the cucumbers/sauce. Yikes. Also, I wasn't really expecting the small, diced-up pieces of tofu in the sandwich (the menu says strips), but they weren't bad. Just a little bland.
-With the Banh Mi, they offer you your choice of sauce, and I opted for the peanut Jerk sauce. I guess I was expecting something spicier (because, well, "Jerk" hints at spicy, no?), but overall the sauce was a great complement to my soggy, bland sandwich and added some much-needed flavor.

Overall, my high hopes for this place fell flat. They delivered in that their food is affordable, light and healthy, but they've sacrificed flavor. However, I'm hoping my review is based on an off-day - I'm definitely open to giving it another chance. I didn't get a chance to try their vegan soft serve, so at the very least I'll be returning for some ice cream!

My past few experiences haven't been to great, but tonight my mind was changed! I believe it was Rocky, Camille, and Summer behind the line. They were really friendly and I didn't feel rushed like usual.  I got to talk to them while waiting for steak, which they made fresh because I've had recent bad experiences. Best bowl I've had in weeks :) thanks

HORRIBLE! This location deserves 0 stars. The restaurant wasn't crowded, so I'm not sure why the young girl behind the counter was moving like it was rush hour....I watched her slap rice and beans like she was training for the Chipotle Olympics (let me know if there is such a thing!)

Back to the Burrito Nazi: she stares at you, asks you if you want steak, rice...then proceeds to slap it on your burrito sloppily. The kicker: all the mess from the rice, beans, lettuce, etc ends up on the dirty counter and she wipes it with her hands to the trash and proceeds to use those same dirty hands to roll numerous burritos! 

Maybe she was pissed off because 4 of her co-workers were chillin in the restaurant eating burritos and tacos...I dunno, but damn....
Will NEVER come back again....I'll take the drive to University City and grab Qdoba instead.

I think I caught the staff on an off day. I was pretty excited to try Wokworks because of the glowing reviews. It seemed like the two cooks were imparted in some way. They were behaving very strangely, made every single order incorrectly, and my food tasted terrible. The only reason this experience is getting two stars is because there was one employee, a young woman with blonde hair, who was doing everything she could to keep the customers happy. She apologized profusely for each of the incorrect orders, but it was very clear that she was not at fault. I felt really bad for her, so I doused my noodles in sirracha and ate it anyway. If she weren't there, I would have asked for my money back after having to send my dish back twice! The first time, the cook had neglected to cook anything in the bowl. I put a fork full of cold noodles and toppings into my mouth. The second time, the toppings were completely omitted. When I finally received my dish, it tasted disgusting.

This place was busy and seemed very trendy with the amount of people going in and out. I can't say I enjoyed the chicken teriyaki signature dish. It tasted slightly off, but I wouldn't take this place off my list just yet. The staff was courteous and friendly. I will give this place another try.
