The employees here rushed me through my order! I ended up getting the Kung Pao & honey sesame chicken with fried rice & veggies. Their prices are high compared to your local Chinese store, however  they offer indoor and outdoor seating and a clean environment.

Horrible customer crevice! Drive thru was so rude
Don't think I'll be coming here again

Since it opening. I have been going to this location. I never have any problem until just last week. I order half chicken and half steak bowl with guacamole. Came home and eat my bowl, as I use my fork to grab some guacamole, I find a big shell of avocado. I was not happy.

This is the best Popeye's I've found that is within a reasonable distance.  I love their spicy chicken and their biscuits are amazing.  If I want my basic meal, they have that, but they rarely have special seasonal items.  I've asked for the ghost wings plenty of times during that promotion, but they never have it. 

The parking lot is extremely small and moves in one direction.  A few times I have been there around 12:30 and there is a delivery truck blocking their exit, delivering supplies.  Cars are backed up trying to leave through the drive-thru lane.  I would imagine that they would ask their supplier to come after the lunch rush.

Just opened and sucks already! Ordered a burrito, salad and chip with queso. Lettuce was barely visible so I asked for more. Salad lettuce was welted. Girl making salad was sweating like crazy and I was praying it wouldn't drip on my food. Asked for a tray to carry the burrito, salad, chips and queso, side of mild salsa and 2 drinks. Girl gave me tray with puddles of water on it (how does that happen) takes salad out my hand and places on the soaking wet tray. Needless to say my salad bowl was wet and water got on my burrito (because it wasn't fully wrapped). Finally open the chips and was disappointed again. Ok so sometimes you get a  chip that's "undercooked" but an entire bag of chips that can be folded and never break lol this place is a joke and I will never return

I'm very excited that PlantPure Café took over the spot that used to be Maoz. PlantPure Café has a ton of vegan street cred. It's a collaboration of Fernando Peralta from Vgë and Nelson Campbell of the documentary PlantPure Nation.

It has an all vegan menu that still includes the falafel and pita you're used to getting at this address. But they've added many more options too. For my first trip there, I went with a bowl that had brown rice & quinoa as its base, seitan for protein and red coconut curry as the sauce. It was as delicious as it was healthy.

They also have the Groothie, a green smoothie by Get Real Get Raw that has organic kale, spinach, and apples. An added bonus is they have vegan soft serve ice cream too!

They got my order wrong and were missing an item.  These guys aren't careful with ensuring that the orders are correct so always double check your order in front of them.  They are essentially stealing from customers by short changing them for items that they paid for.

Order 2 large fries for 1$ each and two jr cheese burgers.
Fries came burnt but the manager replaced them with fresh fries no problem. 
Both burgers where under done however once again manager stepped in and gave me two fresh chicken sandwiches that where perfect. 
Free refills on soda is always a plus 
Huge tv on ESPN was the highlight of my visit will be back just not for burgers. Not the cleanest Wendy's (they are extremely busy) clean enough that I ate in the restaurant. Great for children and quick meals

I came into Wok Works a little nervous as I am not the typical Asian fusion eater. However, I have heard good things about the restaurant and the young owner so I gave it a try. My expectations were exceeded long and far. I ordered the BBQ pork belly with various fresh veggies, along with a sweet and sour sauce that was just the right blend of both. Meat was tender and flavorful. Overall good decor, with a young, vibrant atmosphere. I would give my recommendation without a doubt.
The impossible burger was great, best idea and marketing Burger King could have ever made. Much healthier and something on the menu for the people.

The manager here knows how to run a proper fast-food establishment.

The counter girls are well trained and polite. 
The food comes out hot/fast.

The line can get pretty long during lunch hours, especially on Fridays but it's never taken me longer then 10 minutes from start to finish.

Chick-Fil-A is the best, and this is the best outpost I've visited in the Philadelphia area.

Closed on Sundays but thats not their fault.

Deb is a bright light to anyone's day. She made me a special falafel sandwich with honey Dijon, balsamic and another good sauce. Her grandson was working with her that day. They are quick and efficient in their process to get the orders out for the lunch rush.

I've been to this location several times since it opened a short time ago,  always had a great experience with the order takers and the overall service HOWEVER I'll  never come back to this location after the lack of consideration the server showed me. As soon as she greeted me she started to Ramble On in a low fast pace tone that I could not understand, she ran off words, not sentences repeatedly.
I motioned twice that I could not hear what she was saying but she refused to slow down,  I asked her several times to speak up SHE REFUSED!! In the end I purchased food I did not want because she wouldn't listen.
Worst Experience.!!!!

Just went to this Wendy's and got a 10 pc nugget meal and was supposed to get a baconator meal too. They asked what size and drink and everything. They took my whole order and I pulled up to the window to pay and they say the total is $7.  Clearly they messed something up. I asked if that was for both my nugget and baconator meal and he says yea. And of course I pull up to get my food and they say they didn't hear the second half of my order after asking me what size and drink I wanted. Every time I go here they can never actually get anything right. Wendy's CEO would be very disappointed with the service at this location.
I'm always satisfied but I'm Not Happy this location doesn't have Mac and Cheese on the menu yet

This Wendy's needs to change their hours. There are sketchy exchanges constantly happening during the early evening outside of the restaurant especially on weekends. Not to mention the shooting that occurred there last night at 8:40PM!!!!!!! It is dirty inside, and people choose to use the street as their trash can who eat there.

I'll keep this short and sweet. The place is a tiny bit pricey but it's an airport so of course. The service was meh and the wait time was pretty long. The burger was very good though. I would totally recommend.
I was boycotting subway. The new chipotle steak made me come back. It was surprisingly delicious.  Thumbs up.

Location seems to be under new management, showed up on my way home from work since i had some coupons. Manager on staff was actually directing people calling out orders on an old-school kick. Looked like they're training new staff as well, as the manager was required to show how to process multiple coupons in a single order.

Food was prepared pretty slow but, turned out piping hot, so hot it left half the car's window steamed on the way home. I grabbed 2 Dave's singles sans tomato and pickle, a 10 piece nugget, and a 4 piece order of their new chicken fingers, two large fries, and two large drinks- My daily meal.

Drinks are served by a modern Coke freestyle machine (SIlver colored not that it matters), latest firmware, featuring promotional soda in the form of Dave's Orange-Cream. (Basically the Hi-C Vanilla i highly recommend anyone to try at their next Freestyle visit) Unlimited refills, despite philly beverage tax. (Row Row fight the power.)

Chicken Tenders, a new addition to wend's menu felt lacking. Maybe its just because Wendy's does nuggets so well but the quality of the meat felt comparable if not worse, breading was lacking compared to the nuggets as well. Their new concoction for promoting the tenders is S'awsome sauce, and it's alright, reminds me of Sanchez Sauce from Hoagie Haven, cept with a little less kick. 

My 10-Piece Nuggets were on point, slightly crisp golden brown breading and the same quality white meat chicken that Wendys has been using for awhile now- supplier here is good, the only way to mess them up is employee negligence, of which there was none here.

My Dave's singles came out alright, you can taste the difference, and everything's better fresh off the grill. I cant remember he last time i got food from a Mcdonalds or BK that was actually steaming without it being like 20 degrees out.

Fries were average, still hot but not nearly enough salt and a little on the floppier side than i'd like (Wendys fries usually are i don't know why.), but that was easily corrected with a little additional  salt.

All in all a really solid night for this Wendy's i don't pop in enough to know if this is standard or i lucked out but it seems like they've got something good going on here.  4/5 for a wendy's for sure but, in the grand scene of things?

Flavor & Presentation 3.25/5   |   Speed & Service  2.75/5   |   Pricing & Portions  2.66/5

Overall  3/5

Their wings and fries are really good. It's a shame that their orders take so long and also that I was faced with obvious discrimination.  It was extremely embarrassing and humiliating! I have walked into that establishment three times now, and three times the same exact thing has happened. It's a shame that people have to experience this behavior in this day and age. The employees were more focused on goofing off with each other than they were helping customers!

This is the worst Popeyes location ever. They don't even answer the phone when you call for questions or complaints . They got my order COMPLETELY WRONG  and did nothing to rectify the situation . Not only was the order wrong it was cold and we got a bunch of sauces we did not ask for. i wont be returning.

First and foremost, there was a curly black hair in my sausage McMuffin with egg. I'm pregnant and hormonal, so this led me to tears after everything else that had gone wrong with this order. Our other issues were that we did not receive the kids drink with the happy meal. The said sausage McMuffin that ended up having a hair in it wasn't even originally rung up. After ordering the kids meal and quarter pounder meal, we asked ordered a sausage McMuffin with egg, a cheeseburger, and a large fries. The employee even restated/asked if we wanted both the cheeseburger and the McMuffin (which I don't even know why he would think we were replacing the McMuffin with the cheeseburger, we never said we didn't want the McMuffin, we were just adding one more item to the order. The employee also "tried" to confirm the size of fries we ordered and twice my husband said large, so we again clarified large. However, he rung up a medium. After receiving our order we saw that the McMuffin was missing, and he was like "o you still wanted that?" Uhhh, yea, we never said we didn't! So then he asked us to pull off to the side and wait for it, after almost 5 minutes, someone brought it out. It wasn't until we got home and opened the bag that we saw the medium fries instead of large fries and realized we didn't get the kids meal drink. THEN, finally opening my McMuffin, super frustrated at this point, they put the wrong type of egg on the McMuffin. Honestly I order the egg McMuffin because I like the white egg, not the yellow folded egg. After proceeding to eat it, I found a curled black hair in the sandwich. At that point I cracked. I am in complete disgust at the lack of hygiene (the drive-through worker literally lifted his shirt to rub his belly while we were waiting for our food at the window) and the most incompetence and lack of ability to follow simple order instructions I've witnessed in my life. I'm sick to my stomach right now.

This Chik-Fil-A is just OK.  Not as good or well run as the stand-alone shops in the suburbs - but the service is quick - and my little one loves the Chik-Fil-A nuggets kids meal.

Chik-Fil-A is just about the only fast food I ever let her eat.  We are not proponents of it.

I enjoy the side salad (minus the cheese) and it comes with (fattening) tasty croutons and honey roasted sunflower seeds.  If you ate all the condiments and dressing Chik-Fil-A offers with the side salad - you can easily pack away 500 calories.  Sheesh.

So be careful out there folks - it's a nutritional mine field - but it's decent fast poultry.  And your kids will eat it. (Not sure how great of a thing that really is.)

This is the second time I called this place and both times there were issues with delivery.  The first time the said it would be late, and yes it was thirty minutes lates.  

This time the deliverer said he was at the wrong address and again he was thirty minutes late.  He asked me to come to him.  I called the store Texas Chicken & Burgers sharing I would be canceling the order.   They had no idea of identifying my order or who they deliver through.  I won't be going back here.

I do not believe they understand lies can cause illness and poor community relations.  The manager was unruly.  He asked me, "Whose the deliverer?"  How am I to know?  He also said after I said, "How am I to know?  "Do whatever you want to do."  The he hung up.  This Sunday, September 22nd 2019 6:28PM.

I'm a huge fan of the hazelnut coffee and the oatmeal.  For one thing, who doesn't enjoy putting their own toppings on their oatmeal?  Sure, I may go overboard with the brown sugar but no one is stopping me from piling it (and the chocolate chips) on!

I've also had some of the breakfast sandwiches and they are pretty tasty as are the salads.  The place lends itself to working professionals who pop in for breakfast and lunch, so while I would never consider it a place where I could power up my laptop and get work completed, it is an okay spot for grab-and-go food and drinks.
The service was awful. Food was cold when delivered. Burger was soggy. Bathroom was filthy.

Why do they keep removing my review?

I called and put in a delivery order for about $50.00.  About 30 minutes later I received a call from the driver and he said, "I'm not sure if I have the correct address?"  I asked, "Where are you?"  He shared an unfamiliar address.  I told him my  address and he asked, "How do you get there?"  I told him, "Cancel the order.?

I called the manager of the store and he said, "Who's the driver?" "How am I to know?" I said.  He then said, "Do what you have to do."

I tried to contact my bank to reverse the charges, but the driver came a knocking.  Reluctantly I took the meal.  The driver apologized, but I was not done.
GrubHub sent me a text and I shared with them what happened.  I even put the same review on Yelp and they always delete the review.  I want to mention as well they should use Rhode Island not Texas.  Texas is known for their portion size.  Plus you can smell the bad oil on the chicken.

One of my go-to food trucks on campus if I want something healthier.

Recs: 
- Bella Donna (tofu meatballs) -- add spicy sauce! 
- For portions, even their smaller size will be fine if you're not super hungry
- My favorite thing of theirs is the banana chocolate chip oatmeal cookies - to die for! Many times I'll stop by the truck just to pick up a couple of cookies for my friends and I. You can taste the banana in the batter. Wouldn't recommend the other cookie options over this one though - banana chocolate chip is unanimously the best,

Didn't give a truck a full 5/5 though because I still end up preferring food trucks with meat options at the end of the day, but this is a great vegetarian choice!

I went to Love Park during lunch and decided to check out this food truck. It's bright pink and cute!

I got the crabby mac ($10)- Generous portions and super filling!!!! The mac and cheese is delicious and they top it off with pieces of crab. I want to try the bacon mac next time. 

Massive food coma upon finishing the last bite....I should have just ate half in retrospect. If you love mac and cheese and want authentic mac and cheese (not kraft)- come here! #donoteatallofit #greedtookoveragain

Work lunch go-to. Easy to order via grub hub and its ready to go when I get there. Food is delicious. I go with the chow fun noodles with tropicalia sauce. I rotate choices on the meat and veggies but it is all good. The level of spice on the sauce seems to vary slightly depending on the day, I prefer it on the slightly spicier side :) Kelvin slush is pricey but quite refreshing on a hot summer day. Side options are great to share if you each get a wok.

False advertising!!!!
The latest advertising that WS has is 15 whole wings with your choice of sauce that is 19 dollars and some change with tax .   All I'm going to say is don't be fooled.   Just take a look at my photos.   Need I say more ‼‼‼‼ the wings were SMALLer then the actual wing-dings and were burnt with no meat on the inside.   Please do not be bamboozled by this advertising

Worst service ever. Unfriendly, downright mean. It almost seemed as if we were on a show, waiting for us to react about the poor service. Bathroom was locked. When asked if there was a key, the woman said to use the ladies room. The ladies room was also locked. The food was subpar. There were a lot of people sitting around eating food they brought from home. I will never go back to this place.

It was a really long line, which can seem especially bad because I went on probably the hottest afternoon of the summer. They do offer so many options, which are great for vegetarians and non-vegetarians alike. I forgot what the entree is called, but it was vegetarian chili on rice and a salad. The combo platter was so large, I could probably only finish a fourth of it though. I probably wouldn't come back here for awhile just because I'm not sure if it's really worth the wait, but I can't complain!

Great burger as always but the flavor was slightly off. I got the regular cheese burger. They also didn't have jalapenos, which was pretty trash. Still my favorite burger spot though. Service was good and wait time was relatively low. My friend enjoyed his turkey burger as well.

This location can get very crowded, since it is in the Liberty Place food court, but they move out very quickly, and always take your order while you're waiting in line. The food is also nice and hot when you get it; and the employees are always very kind and willing to help you with whatever you want.

Terrible services. It is clear that the people who work here have never had any customer service training. Seems as though there is no leadership  or direction. No napkins and dirty tables. I will not visit a chipotle again.

This place is horrible. The server didn't say anything when I placed my order, just looked at me, like I was bothering them. I checked my food when I got home, the burger was smashed, there was something on the pickles, and the fries were cold. I didn't bother to eat it. Do not waste your money.

I come here every so often for lunch because it's convenient from where I work. There's nothing spectacular about it but it's not the worst fast food place I have ever been to. 

The customer service could be better. I understand that the employees are ALWAYS busy but putting a smile on your face is the #1 rule in customer service. 

The food is just okay. There's nothing to rave about and there's nothing to complain about either. Sometimes, the food could be a little too crispy of burnt but I would rather have too crispy than undercooked.

The line is long 95% of the time but everyone tries to keep it moving at a steady pace. However, it seems as though no matter how simple your order is, it will take a few minutes to get it. 

Lastly, if you want sauce, ask for extra. Sometimes, they forget to add the sauce in the bag or they do not add enough.

So I'm assuming this is actually called Wise Fricks since there's no name on the building and a bunch of people were wearing shirts with this name on it. It used to be Ariana's.

So, lets just say that ANYONE'S mother could cook a better burger. I waited 20 minutes for my blue cheese burger and another 5 for the, what was supposed to be onion rings. I walked home (literally one block away) and the burger was cold, and had no blue cheese. The meat was charred on the outside and dry inside. The onion rings were thrown in a brown lunch bag and ALL the breading fell off of the onions. I had a cold burger (that wasn't what I ordered), a pile of onions and a pile of breading. I was also the only one in the place.

I really wanted to love this place because its a block away and I love burgers but this place sucks. I'd be VERY surprised if it was around a year from now. When I'm the only customer in the store and you STILL cant get the order right - thats not a recipe for success during the current food boom.

Bottom line. Save yourself the hassle, go to Gooie Louies.

This location has got to be the worst I've ever experienced.  Staff is slow and has not once in the dozen or so times i have have been there gotten my order correct.  Not a hard one to get right either. 1/4 lb single with ketchup and pickles only. How pray tell do you screw that up?!? I can understand when busy maybe they just gave me wrong burger but every time I dont think so. Once I brought my burger back in and told them it had cheese on it and the manager snottily replied you have to tell them no cheese, I rebuted I did I said ketchup and pickle only so to me that would
 mean NO CHEESE. If you go through drive thru do not leave window before checking your order. Thats if you can stand the 20 min wait on line. Insude wait times are even worse.  This franchise owner needs to get his license revoked he is giving the Wendy's brand a bad reputation. 
P.S. If an employee goes on break and is getting a  meal there they jump the line regardless how long is which I think says more than anything the staff doeant give a damn about the customers.

Omgeeeeee!! Love this place! Stopped here last night before going for drinks. I got the chicken with green beans, sprouts, lo mein and a spicy sweet sauce. Servers were nice. Food taste good cold and I never eat cold food. Enjoy!

The hype is NOT real people! This place was legit in my college days ~10 years ago now.... but it must be fabulous when you're a broke college kid. Revisited my old haunt today on a whim while at a conference in the area... it is definitely NOT as good as I remember. The lines are even longer and the food (although it was the height of the lunch rush) was barely heated through. I think the only thing that made my meal of rice, veggies, and falafel even slightly warm was the hot sauce! There's a serious lack of flavor in all items, MEH!

Due to the two most recent experiences I have had here, I had to give Chick 2 stars. 

My meal when I order here is always the chicken nugget meal. The past few times, some of the nuggets in my 8 piece were undercooked. I had to spit out at least one nugget. Guys, it is not difficult to make nuggets! Please get it together!

On my most recent trip, the cashier handed me my ketchup. The ketchup had goo all over the outside of the packet! My hand was so sticky, as well as my purse when I stuck the ketchup in my bag. I spent at least 5-10 minutes washing my hands and cleaning the outside and inside of my purse before sitting down and eating. I ended up throwing out half of the ketchup packets that were given to me. Disgusting!

Had this amazing chicken burrito with my own choice of sauce, veggie and rice. The dressing was flavoursome and the presentation was amazing. My burrito was neatly packed and didn't have loose ends. Taste was so good that I got one for take away as well. If you are a student then they do buy one get one free on Saturdays of every week. The staff was amazing and it was pretty intense to see how quickly they were delivering orders to their customers. I was very impressed with their service. This will be my next stop for mexican food.

I have never been more petrified as I was in this McDonald's.  (you can see my last mcdonald's review was scary... but this place SERIOUSLY made the worst Boston McDonald's look like Burlington, VT  Applebee's)
Why was breakfast served until 11am on a weekday?

I was one of maybe 20 people in the place... I would estimate that 4 weren't homeless meth addict hookers.   no joke, it was scary.  i put my hoodie on and started my little twitchy-fake-crazy routine so that people didn't suspect me of having an actual wallet.

Just don't go there... unless you are a meth addict who wants a 10am breakfast.

I work very close to this food truck and I head over quite frequently for lunch. I went today and had the falafel salad, and felt like I should finally finish this review. 

I normally get the falafel sandwich or the salad, but I tried the spinach pie and was blown away. It was quite rich, but amazing. Today's salad was great, although there wasn't as much "salad" as normal and it was mostly the falafel. There were five balls on top of my greens, and they were, as always, perfect. I got hot sauce and it wasn't overpowering at all.  There was a line, and I waited about five minutes - I was behind four people. The line grew and grew behind me so I must have had good timing. It was about 1:20pm on a Thursday when I got there.

 The only reason I didn't give it a five-star rating is that the pita bread is like cardboard. It only serves as a decent vessel for amazing food. Maybe it's better when it's not cold outside and the pita has a shot at not being so dry. Don't worry, little pita, I'll come back and keep trying.  

I recommend it- enjoy!
Went here for the beer menu and had some really delicious edamame dumplings and brussel sprouts! Stacey was really great and the free yeungling was definitely worth the trip!

This place is fantastic. Many vegan restaurants serve food that is oily and not particularly healthy. That's why it was such a joy to find PlantPure where the food is light and healthy in addition to being very tasty, filling and vegan. 

My girlfriend and I stopped in for lunch today and had a tofu bahn mi and a bowl with roasted potatoes, black beans and veggies. Both were delicious.

In addition to the excellent food, the layout is modern and comfortable and is located conveniently in Center City. I didn't get the name of the young man who took our orders but he was very friendly and helpful in answering our questions. The restaurant is spotless. I look forward to dining hear again on future visits to Philly.

Wendy's get more expensive each time I go... But, I must say their food selections are delicious. My new fav the Portabello Mushroom cheesey met burger! Sooo delicious and flavored. The fries were hot.

I had to use the restroom and it had a door code on it. That was weird to me. They seemed a barely staffed but, they were responsive and polite.

We drove from Maryland to visit Temple University for a football camp on a Sunday. This Chipotle was open. Great customer service. The staff greeted us we entered, were polite and spoke as we left.    Kinda rare at chipotle so they get 5 stars from us.

When I was there yesterday it was pretty much dead. The line was not too long, but the service could use improvement. Overall the area is clean and I haven't yet gone down to the basement seating area. I didn't eat the food, my bf did. So can't say much about that.

The service was great. The staff is very friendly and welcoming but the food was ok. I built my own bowl and got the SOBA noodles and the garlic sesame sauce. I think I the general tso or a soy based sauce would have been a better option. I would give it another chance.

I don't typically review chains but this Chipotle can be frustrating. On more than 5 occasions, they have not had fajita veggies, which are a staple in my bowl. I have never run into the problem at any other Chipotle location. But I still get it because its on campus. Other than that, its just a Chipotle. Nothing different than any other that you would find.

Poor service, lousy food! And the coffee is so hot when it escaped the cup through a crack in the lid...it burned me through a shirt and sweater. Lovely thing to happen just before getting on a plane! My lawyer will be calling after we get back in town!  

I have pictures of the giant blister but cant seem to figure out how to post it here.

This place is horrible.  It's always a mess, there's never any cream for the coffee and often the coffee urns are empty.  If they are filled, there's extra grinds to give you that full crunchy coffee experience.

I don't know who they are hiring, but they clearly don't care.  Empty registers (and trying to check out is painful), no one behind the sandwich counter and when asked for help, told they'll get to you in a few minutes.

I only go here as a last resort because I work in the attached building.  It's a shame, because I love their asiago cheese bagels, but not enough to brave the pain that is dealing with their employees (with management no better).
They take so long to give the food !!!! I'm never coming here again. They make my whole Wendy's experience bad.

I'd give zero if I could! They wanted to charge me 27cents for hot sauce for my cold old fries! But the guy before me asked for two and paid nothing! I walked away and said good luck! It's not about the money. I have frequented McDonalds and never paid for condiments!
The employees seemed tired and miserable and serving cold old food. Period!

i am probably the last person who would be a vegetarian, but i love the bella donna meal special at magic carpet! it's so filling and flavorful... no need for meat at all. this food truck is super popular during the lunch rush as well, so expect to wait in line for these beloved tofu "meatballs."

I had very low expectations and somehow this McDonald's didn't even live up to them.

All I wanted were fries- hot, salty, fresh french fries.  But I knew that fries alone wouldn't fill me so I got a grilled chicken ranch salad in addition to my order of fries.  I had to wait for a while for my food because the woman in front of me requested no salt fries so the entire kitchen staff (I'm not kidding) was busy trying to deal with this special request.  I finally got my food and left.  When I got back to work and sat down to eat, I realized after my first bite that they had given me the no salt fries as well.  Huge bummer.  I tried to salt them myself, but even though the fries were a "fresh" batch, they were soggy and undercooked and even with the salt, were still nothing like what I wanted.  

So I moved on to my salad, which was just ehh.  I should know better than to get a salad from McDonald's, but I was trying to be 'healthy' so I could eat my fries and not feel bad.  The lettuce was crisp and fresh and the other veggies were crunchy, however the chicken they put on top was dry and stringy and not at all appetizing.  

On top of the sub-par food (even for McDonald's standards), the store itself feels very disgusting.  I tried not to touch anything, even the doors on the way out, and yet I still felt like I needed a shower after leaving.

I came here for lunch on a quiet Tuesday afternoon. The menu is a simple, "Chipotle- esque" style, where you choose your starch, meat, vegetable, sauce, and topping. I had noodles with chicken, brussel sprouts, teriyaki sauce, and crunchy garlic. The bowl was good and filling. I also ordered two orders of pork belly buns, one of which I dropped off for my fiance with his afternoon coffee. We both thought they were good, but of the order of two, which each had one bun with overly charred pork belly. The pineapple salsa was an awesome compliment to the buns. My biggest complaint is that this entire meal took half an hour to prepare! I thought it would be ten minutes in and out. No one has half an hour to waste for take- out on their lunch break. It appeared as though they were training someone new, which took their attention away from the pork belly, allowing it to burn.

I may be back to check out their happy hour, but cannot afford to wait that long for a noodle bowl for lunch.

This is the worst Popeyes I've ever been to! Horrible customer service, not 1 of the employees had gloves on and the he/she with the blonde Mohawk looks at u funny when you ask for sauce or utensils like your asking for something unordinary, food was cold and the chicken was dry! They need to do some overhauling! Also they never have any of the stuff you see in commercials. If you go there are 7:30 you always have to wait 25 minutes for spicy chicken, and this is suppose to be fast food I don't think so! I will never go here again and I don't recommend anyone else to either!

One word: BREAKFAST 

Granted it is a Wendy's and their burgers are a slight step above hockey pucks, they do however make a solid breakfast sandwich. This has become my go breakfast option when flying out of PHL early in the morning.  It is not too pricy and and they will cook the egg on the runny side if I ask.  I will often make the trek from terminal E on the opposite side of the airport to grab one of their breakfast sandwiches.

The big pink truck w the "I love Genie" blonde caught my attention so I had to stroll over and order.  I got the large mac and cheese with crab.  It was filling...wish there was more Old Bay on it and more crab.  Loved the idea of the potatoe chips on the top of it...

This place is awesome! Stopped by on a Wednesday and they seriously offer FREE BEER! It sounded too good to be true, but the super nice server Stacy brought us up and actually poured us free beer! They had some great specials too, Brussels sprouts for $3, pop corn chickens $4 and more!
Worst salad i ate in my entire life! Chicken was rubbery greens were rotten and cold. Stay away from this one  unless you like to go often to the toilet

Everytine I order from Uber Eats the food is fresher then when I acrually go to the location. Very strange that it would be better organized and all my food is actuakly hot abd fresh. 

Ordered a bundle box and all the items were hot and fresh. So delish. I also ordered a box of cookies and they came in a cute box. The cookies smelled so good and were still warm. 

Everything u ordered was tasty and freshly made. I am so satisfied with my meal and my purchase. I think for now on ill just order in rather than go out to the location where I have to deal with bad service, miserable staff and terrible food.

Fantastic heart healthy lunch! The falafel wrap and side salad really hit the spot. Great flavor and no added oil. The portions are big and because they don't add oil, the calories for main dishes are reasonable (500 kcal or less). If I lived in Philadelphia, this would be my go-to spot. I'm really hoping they franchise and grow.

Wok works has quick, affordable food for both lunch and dinner. The large-portioned combinations blend well together and the sauces are really unique! The wok bowls are evenly distributed with all of your personally chosen ingredients and each individual component is cooked nicely before being combined. Definitely check this place out if you are in the area. The employees were really friendly too! Seems like they have worked out the "kinks" that people have commented on previously.

I think I'm going to get a lot of hate for thinking Magic Carpet is average. Sending my sorries in advance! Don't get me wrong. The food here is enjoyable. But do I consistently crave it? Never! Maybe it's the "meat-lover's bias."

I think picking the right food truck for lunch is an art at Penn. It's a delicate balance among all the factors that are influencing your decision, and any factors that are extreme may just be the tipping point. 

For me, the line is outrageously long around lunch time. So if you are a die-hard fan (and I'm sure you've figured it out by now), whatever you do, do not come here at exactly noon! Want to meet a friend here for lunch? Come at 11:45, come at 12:45. Don't come on the spot, it's a nightmare waiting to happen. 

The next disappointing part for me is the portions. For (if I remember correctly) $6, you get what they consider a large serving. Boy...now I know how vegetarians can stay in shape. What I consider "large" is probably double the size of its container! Maybe I'm just fat and gluttonous, but I always end up feeling hungry by 4:30 :(

Taste-wise, it's flavorful. The Bella Donna is delicious. And even though the lines are always long, the owners seem genuinely nice and patient. Thank you!

If you're looking for customer service you certainly won't find it here.  Employees were rude and somewhat abrasive.  Food was standard McDonald's fare (B) however customer service (F). It's a only if you have to spot
Super friendly and efficient service.  Great food.  Really nice vibe on a rainy afternoon. Portion size is perfect and the food is fresh.  I'll be back!!

I have eaten at Wokworks a bunch of times... its consistently delicious and they have a great menu. I prefer this place over Honeygrow any day!!! My favorites are there Edamame dumplings with the peanut sauce and their wings. Of course the noodles cant be beat either. If you are wasting your time at Honeygrow ordering noodles... please for all our sakes.... go to Wokworks.

UPDATE: This restaurant is now closed at this location. A note on the door states that they are looking to re-open at a new location. I sure hope they do!  They definitely would benefit from a bigger space. 

Had bowl and lentil burger.  Both were awesome. Healthy. No added oil. And affordable. I hope they add the carrot dog that Vge Cafe used to offer. It's outstanding. Really good coffee here too. Whole foods, all plants, and yummy!  Way better than Maoz. No greasy, oily food!!

I cannot understand the attraction to their food. Sure I can appreciate fast food once in a while, McD's fries or an In-N-Out burger, but I really just don't like the taste of Chick-Fil-A food. It is incredibly overrated - maybe CFA's fans got hooked during childhood or just want some cheap calories?

And lately with CFA's hiring practices coming to light (including religious, racial, and marital questions) as well as CFA's donation of sandwiches to a group opposing gay marriage, I would avoid CFA even if I did like the food.

Decided to try again this week and it was a success. All of our orders came out to perfection, including my Bleu Burger. It's rare to find a place that actually uses it and not salad dressing. The garlic fries seemed even better this time around. 

If you're a fan of spicy, I also highly recommend the Fire Burger on the behalf of my mother.

this place is ghetto unfabulous but when driving from north philly and you want chicken at 12 am, don't make the same mistake i did. the drive thru line takes forever speaking to its location only. i placed my chicken order and got taco bell in a kfc bag. probably someone in front of me got fed up with the wait and bolted throwing the line off, otherwise there are some lazy *** people working hear who cant follow a simple list system. I HUNGRY!!! awful tacos, if the person whose order i got at least ordered what i like from taco bell i would nt be so hungr but i wasted 15 minutes and 10$ here, these mashup KFC/TACOBELL/BASKIN ROBBINS...or whatver places at least need to stick to the proper wrappers...i wouldve known off the bat something was wring if they gave me a taco bell bag when i ordered KFC. The mad max, bullet resistant glass box makes it tough to communicate with the person who gave you food, especially if they are the one taking orders at the speaker station too.

please shut this place down and install a proper chicken joint who is staffed by people who are not smoking hat everyone else is on a friday night, at least until they get off work.  I think theres a checkers nearby, please (owners of checkers) stay open later than these people so you can provide proper service to the night owls in the mood for late night eats.

any other time of day and I would throw my money at popeyes, a half assed popeyes meal is worth more than the whole kfc ass. hell, ill even take churchs.  so disapointing to be dring home for 45 minutes and open the bag to find soft tacos and bean burrittos, i might as well have shoved them up my butt then pushed them out again so i could just cut out the middle man.

Extremely poor customer service. Reported to manager how disrespectful the female at the drive through was. She repeated an order that was wrong and I told her she had it wrong. She told me to "calm down".  

I don't care what industry your I'm regardless of wage, don't be rude!
They are skimpy on sandwich toppings.  I had to ask numerous times and then the sandwich maker would put a small pinch on.  If you want a sandwich made how you like it dont go here.

5 stars

Wokworks is truly an afternoon delight. I was in rittenhouse square following the snowstorm and was in need of something warm me up. I ordered a thin fry noodle with steak bowl and it was absolutely on point. Filling but without that sickening bloated feeling you have after Chinese food. Nasty.  
Wokworks is definitely getting a return visit!

Wokworks is amazing! The perfect lunch, healthy and filling, I had a tall wok with chicken and veggies but could have easily had a short wok and still have leftovers. The pork dumplings are also delicious. I can't wait to go back to try the other sauces and the slushies

My boyfriend and I recently stopped by wokwoks on a Sunday afternoon after being told it was similar to one of our favorite NYC spots, Wok to Walk. If I was going to compare the two, I would say the noodles at Wokworks are a half step below Wok to Walk but they were still delicious. You could tell all the ingredients were fresh. They were just missing that addictive quality. I think the noodles needed more sauce. 

However, we also ordered pork dumplings and pork belly buns because who could resist? And they were phenomenal! The dumplings were made to order and crispy just the way I like them. They came with spicy mayo which is not typical but I enjoyed it. And the flavor combinations in the pork belly buns were great. 

Since I was there on a Sunday afternoon we didn't have to wait long at all but all the food seemed to be cooked to order so I imagine if there is a crowd it could take some time. The staff was very friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. I would definitely go back to this place again!

I don't think I was prepared enough yesterday, when I came into Terminal C of Philadelphia International Airport and spotted this Wendy's location. I just adore Wendy's and if given a choice between Wendy's and a Subway shop (also in this little food court in Terminal C), I ended up picking Wendy's. It convenient and easy to eat and doesn't upset my stomach. 

When I first got there, I noticed their cooler displaying several bottles of water along with a few different soda's. I was thirsty and new I'd had a long walk and still had more to walk if I wanted to get back to where I needed to go easily. However, knowing how hungry I was getting having not had much as a snack or lunch on the first plane (of 45 minutes between Albany and Philadelphia), I ended up getting a 1/4 lb single burger(#1), but that's all I was budgeting for.

I knew I'd be facing an elevated total between the two (they are mostly a convenience here) compared to my local non-airport locations where I live, but when I heard just how little I spent, I was thrilled. (7.05 for the total of the two - without a 5cent deposit fee that applied to that jug in that state). I was expecting it to be a whole lot more.

Pick up of my order was a little more thrilling. I waited patiently, but it felt like it was taking longer than a few minutes for the burgers to be made and prepared onsite but had the one employee out front calling the order number (found at the top of your receipt). She ended up calling "7138", "7139", "7140" and etc. until she called my order of "7143" which I thought was interesting because I was the only one left at the time though their boards of transactions they needed to present proved differently. 

Food was okay...A little cooler than your normal Wendy's locations' burger but still the warmth from the wrapped burger inside a paper bag. It looked presentable.

Stumbled out of Hope Chest after bra shopping and saw the Free Beer sign, hot & hungry decided to pop in.  Large cup of cold Kirin Beer on tap was offered as soon as I stepped up to the register and showed my ID...chose the Happy Hour Wings and shrimp bun sliders. The place was very busy and everyone was quite chatty and friendly so the wait for my food passed quickly. WOW!! The Tropicalia wings were some of the best I've ever had..REALLY spicy.  The bun was delicious too.
Yummy food, FREE beer, fun atmosphere (TV had soccer game which seemed to be a quite popular)!
I will be back for lunch and will definitely bring friends for Wed. Beer nite!

Mac and cheese is something that has been done time and time again. Everywhere you go you will undoubtedly find someone who claims that their mac and cheese is THE mac and cheese. Well forget all of them because this is it. 

The Mac Mart blew my mind to put it simply. I wasn't expecting anything out of the ordinary really but I was blown away. The BBQ mac and cheese is incredible and the fudge truffles are no slouch either. If you like mac and cheese go to this truck. If you don't like mac and cheese, go to the mac mart and your life will change for the better.

Received cold food, messed up our burgers, and order took forever in drive through with not many cars in line. Sent complaint about the experience 2 months ago... Wendy's has yet to acknowledge it. Glad I wasn't holding my breathe. Poor customer service and food was cold and wrong.
Tried their sesame organge chicken salad. Fresh, well seasoned and portion was good enough to subsitute proper lunch. Fast service. Would love to come back to try their noodles

Frickin' delicious!

This trip was my first time trying it, and I can't wait to go back for more. Seitan steak sandwich: mmmm. Perfect blend of savory, sesame, spicy and crunchy (thanks to the fresh veggies). The pita was robust and held up to the gravy and sauce quite well, but I appreciated the server's tip to eat it with a fork. Ideal comfort food, and quite filling for $5.

Service was friendly and helpful. I wish I could try the Bella Donna, but alas it's vegetarian-not-vegan. Still, I am coming back for seconds soon.

When my stomach starts to gurgle and yelp around 11am, there is no place I think about more when anticipating lunch than Magic Carpet. For those who work (or study) in the hospital research building area: while hospital and research building cafeterias are a cheaper option to Au Bon Pain, the best option when you're looking for the best bang for your buck is the food carts conveniently right on Spruce between 36th and 38th streets. Of these, Magic Carpet stands out among the rest. Beware though, popularity comes at a price... Lines can get long, mostly populated by hospital employees and undergrads, so be prepared to wait around 10 minutes before you can order. 

My favorites include the Bella Donna, Magic Meatball, and veggie chili. All the food is vegetarian, but as a meat lover I can still say it's pretty delicious. The meal deals tend to be more filling than the pita sandwiches, and the topping options of sandwiches vs meal deals are essentially the same. I like that the guy who's always here at this cart reminds me to take a fork. It's like he cares! That, and the warm delicious tofu meatball of the Bella Donna, are enough to keep me feeling warm and toasty all afternoon. I guess that's why I keep coming back.

Straight up rough.  It's like a fucking block party in there!  
The staff needs to understand that they are working in a professional environment -- that goes with their hygiene and their speech.  Me thinks I won't be going back there anytime soon - I rather starve on my break than to go there.

The hefty black girl on the counter is VERY Rude! She just picked her nose and flicked the booger towards the condiments. Are you serious? That is striaght a violation. I will be posting this photos I have to the Health Department.

how the hell are you going to serve me sour creams and chives potatoes to go with no god damn sour effing cream.. now im eatting a dry ass potatoe. worst service eveeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeer. fire your dam staff and hire new people please. this wasn't even once, this has happened almost every time i get food here. always messing up orders.

Let me start off by saying I'm a girl who LOVES her stir-fry.  It's the perfect combo of veggies, carbs and protein and I could eat it every single day. That's why I was super excited when I heard this place was opening in my neighborhood.

It's similar to HoneyGrow, but less pretentious and on the smaller side.  There is only one persont to place an order with, however, so I could see this creating a bottleneck problem when getting crowded at busy lunch hours.

The base of the stir-fry comes with carrots, cabbage, sprouts, onions and egg which is nice, but adding in extra veggies and proteins can start to get a bit pricey--I ended up paying a little over $10 which is okay, but I'd rather be spending $8. (Yes that $2 difference makes me feel slightly less guilty about buying lunch out every day when I really intend to bring my own from home, but never do, obvi).

They jam-pack your take-out box with food, so don't be fooled because it's actually a pretty generous amount of food.  I have to deduct one star, however, because I was really excited to try to the 'Pearlmaker' Oyster Sauce (garlic, sesame, scallion, almond joy), but was really taken aback by the almond joy-candy-almost-mint-tasting-flavor the sauce left me with.  It sort of ruined the whole dish for me, but I will definitely try a differenct sauce next time. Highly recommend this stir-fry heaven!

Tempted.  Three hour layover in PHL, and I was tempted to taxi out for some real cheesesteak.   (I even checked car rentals.)  But I resisted.  The nice airline counter folks in PHL (an oxymoron, right?) recommended Eat at Joe's (Terminal B - near Gate B10) because the cheesesteaks aren't too greasy.

Joe (I called him Joe because he was da boss) and his staff were great; they hollered to the customers to confirm the order rather than just mindlessly reading the receipts.

The $12 Cheesesteak (combo with fries) was soft and tender with plenty of flavor in the meat.  Available with grilled onions or peppers.  Not greasy at all, the soft hoagie roll remained dry and not soggy.  No Whiz, which was slightly disappointing, but there was a little bit of cheese (EDIT: Thanks, Yelp buddies).  Thick-cut fries were crispy and freshly fried, as they were fairly busy.

Was it as good as one of the originals on the corner of 9th & Passyunk?   Nope.  But youse bet it sure beat the ubiquitous fast food joints in the airport.

Probably one of the slowest airport McDonalds locations I have been to.

It was nearly 4pm on a Friday and pretty dead, but there were tons of people just waiting for their food and no line to order. I could hear the constant BEEP BEEP BEEP of the machines in the back, and having worked at McDonalds before I know what that means. It means stuff is ready to go but that the staff manning the grill (was there only one person back there?) is not keeping up.

My fries were hot and crispy (the most important thing with McDonalds) but my cheeseburger was lukewarm.

Went back again today and was not satisfied. They did not fill the bowl with romaine so the salad bowl was maybe half full. It was also 12:40 and most of the bread was gone. Just keep getting disappointed every time I come back.

Chick-fil-A is a great spot to grab a meal to go or to eat here. In the middle of the food court in the mall, it's one of many options, yet every time I come it's always packed. That is one thing about this location, the line is always long. Overall though, the service is good, and the food is always great! I've never had any issues with getting my food other than waiting some time, and it always comes out fresh. Nothing really hits your chicken cravings quite like Chick-fil-A. My latest run: 8 pc Chick-fil-A nuggets with Chick-fil-A sauce. A centerpiece in the chicken diet.

This place has gotten S L O W and they regularly run out of staple items like chicken, fajitas or rice. I guess they want stuff to be fresh (?) but this is a foreseeable and preventable issue that after being open for over a year should have been ironed out. Further, some employees are great and fast, while others move like snails and randomly walk away from their positions for inordinate amounts of time, bringing the line to a grinding halt. 

Who ever manages this place needs to step up because it's about to fall out of my rotation to one of the hundred other lunch options. 

Update: this place has gotten even worse somehow. 3 of the last 5 times I've been here they have been out of chicken. Are you raising and slaughtering them in the back?! What the actual hell is going on in this pka

In case anyone with influence is reading this... you have a great location for lunches ...and are killing your own profit. Things to address...
At 12.30pm all soups should be filled, not empty
Get stock of breads
Staff who seem they want to help and know what you sell
The fundamentals.

P.s. we came here cos au bon pain is usually great

Once again, I'm in agreement with Caitlin---the only bad thing is the service. But when you're at a train station, fast service is possibly the most important issue.

Last time I was there (to see a friend off), I ordered two bagels with a cream cheese, some lettuce and tomato. We were the only people in the restaurant. It seemed to be taking forever and my friend was trying to get to his train, so I told the barista/sandwich-maker she could just forgo the rest of the toasting process and throw the veggies on top. She did that, but she seemed to take her time with the rest of the process, annoyingly so. 

My friend missed his train, and perhaps I'm looking for a scapegoat, but come on---how long does it take to drop a slice of tomato and some lettuce on a bagel?

On the flip slide, the service is very good at the University of Pennsylvania Au Bon Pain, on Locust Walk. Which is surprising because every other Penn-run food establishment is serviced by people who, as Caitlin C. so astutely wrote, "seem to not like their jobs/lives/pay/uniform."

For a fast food burger place in the airport, these folks did a very nice job. The staff was pleasant, the food came out fast, and they beautifully accommodated my wheat allergy with a delicious gluten-free burger without a bun. I would love to see them off gluten-free buns in the future!
Incompetent very slow counter service.   Left the tomato on sandwich when I told them twice.  Sandwich was tasty.

A few months back, the GF and I were in the mood for Asian noodles, but not exactly itching for the prototypical mushy noodles that accompany an order of Americanized Chinese takeout. Hearing good things about Wokworks, we decided to hop on DiningIn and see what all the fuss was about.

Spicy Asian Pickles [$1.95]
Pickles, chili 

We started off with the spicy pickles. While a pittance of a portion, they were crisp and sweet, with spice that came through on the finish.

Jalapeno Brussels Sprouts [$4]
Brussels sprouts, gluten-free soy, jalapeno

I'm a brussels sprouts fiend so naturally, we had to order these. While I missed the touted heat from the jalapenos, the sprouts had nice bite and were well seasoned. Thankfully, they weren't overly salty from the soy.

Crispy Edamame Dumplings [$4.95]
Peanut sauce

The edamame dumplings were nice - incredibly crispy with a creamy essence within. They were topped with some green onions and sweet black sesame seeds.

BBQ Pork Belly Sliders [$5.95]
Steamed buns, pork belly, pineapple salsa, cilantro

Regular readers know that the pork belly buns were a must order for me. The gluttonous pork was well-braised and had a lightly sweet glaze. The dish itself could have used more texture, with the soft, pliant buns rendering each bite soft on soft. I could have used more pork as well - perhaps double pork a la Momofuku? Still, the accompanying pineapple salsa and cilantro brought some bright balance to the heft of the pork.

Build Your Own Tall Wok [$10.95]
Lo mein, chicken, snow peas, mushrooms, bok choy, crispy shallots, roasted almonds, Blackgold teriyaki sauce 

But what is Wokworks really known for? Their stir-fried noodles! We elected to build our own, with chicken, lo mein noodles, and a melange of various veggies.
These noodles weren't mushy at all and thankfully had life to each bite. They were well-coated with the requested Blackgold teriyaki sauce and the multitude of accompanying additions helped to create a hearty dish.

Overall, Wokworks delivered an experience that was well above the standard Chinese takeout you might order on a random night. Do try their stir-fried noodles. I also wouldn't hesitate to order the pork belly buns again!

Went through drive thru.. staff was nice.. food is 2 out of 5 stars.. maybe if that.. the orange juice is watered down.. couldn't even drink it.. was going to return the juice but already on my way to work.. the staff should've known it was right.. u could see right through it smh..didn't receive any napkins for the greasy hash brown... I'm over McDonalds.. it's  alwayssomething with them

Not quite sure what to say here, I mean it's Chick-Fil-A chicken Tendies.. So of course they're going to get the 5 stars. Love ordering here when trying to get great platters for the office. Great service when stopping here in person.

Yeah,
I should have looked at the ratings before I tried this Wendy's. Don't waste your time or your money. The food is the worst I have ever had at a Wendy's. It didn't even taste like a Wendy's. The tomato on my spicy chicken sandwich was almost brown. The lettuce was wilted and only covered half the sandwich. The chicken was rubbery... I threw it away because I was afraid it was going to make me sick. The bread was stale and tasteless. The fries were cold and had no flavor. I ordered 3 sides of cheese sauce and asked them to fill it to the top instead of half way since I had to pay for each one. They refused. Then they gave me cheese sauce with no lids so they had to put the tiny half-way filled black container in a bigger container which had a lid and all the cheese sauce spilled everywhere and I couldn't use it.  The manager (a barely articulate woman who said her name was Qua-isha) gave me an attitude and told me if I didn't like the portion amount I should take it up with corporate headquarters.  She was the one in charge! So it was obvious why the crap hole of a Wendy's was in such a state.  When I tried to scrape the cheese sauce off of the edges of the bigger container that Qua-isha supplied (and defeated the purpose), it was lumpy and cold!!!  I was so disgusted with this Wendy's, that I will never go back. It's the worst Wendy's I've ever tried and I have lived in multiple states on both coasts of this country.  So I've been to a lot of them.

Don't go here! I give it negative 5 stars!!!
Yuck! Chipotle is just next door and at least the food is edible there.

Gave it a second try and it was just as bad as the first time. I made my own wok the first time and picked from the speciality wok list the second time. My food was heavy like it had a coating of oil on everything. and it had a lot of oil at the bottom. My friend ordered an already built wok and hers was very watery at the bottom and so so bland, the broccoli and noodles tasted exactly the same - no flavor distinction. I hate to say this but both our dishes literally had a wok taste throughout, like the pans used were overly used before they decided to rinse/switch it out. 3rd time will not be a charm, cause I won't bother. Maybe the non wok items are great but it's a bit pricy for me personally to test try after two bad dinners there.
This checkers is dirty I found black hair in the food. I won't be eating from here ever again.

The kids that work there need to learn more MANNERS and CUSTOMER SERVICE. You're there to work PROFESSIONALY. ACT like you know how to treat the customers with respect. You'll never get anywhere with that nasty attitude. I let it slide with the cashier who gave me a whole stare up and down and laughing with her female coworker. But don't give out that nasty attitude. TEACH your employees something before you hire them. Honestly, I would've gotten those two fires if I were a member working there. I should've snapped some pics so I can expose who I'm talking about.

I'm going to give this place three stars since I'm taking location into consideration. It's on my way to and back from temple campus, and en route to the gym - both IBC and TUF. Perfect location.

The food isn't bad - standard subway fare. Sometimes I see a gnat or two behind the glass sneeze guard, but meh.

The service, like all the other reviewers have said, is sub par. Besides the occasional nice part timer, the main people behind the counter are somewhat rude, unenthusiastic, and a little stressful to interact with. Also, although Subway offers the 4/5$ meal special (6 inch, drink and chips) for lunch, they have tried every time to charge me full price. I always have to remind them that I want the lunch price.

Other than the unhappy service, this place ain't bad.

This is my favorite Taco Bell in the area!! They always give me and my family excellent service, our food is always awesome!! They make the best Beef Nachos Grandes, Crunch wrap supremes, etc. I always look forward to eating from here!! Thank you Taco Bell staff for always serving your customers well!! 5 stars and then some!!
Missing items from my order and barley got anything in my taco. Spent 13 dollars. This is ridiculous

Ah, damn...I was so excited to try this truck! I kept missing them by minutes during the first week or two they were on Drexel's campus, but finally made it there. And I was very disappointed.

I went with a grilled cheese that also had mac and cheese on it, and added bacon (which cost an extra dollar on top of the $4 dollar sandwich). The thought of paying 5 bucks for a grilled cheese sandwich bothered me but I needed to try it!

I opened up the sandwich to find that the bacon was forgotten, so that was a waste of a dollar. It's a mistake, I didn't really care. That was the least of the problem, however. The mac and cheese from a box of Kraft or even an Easy Mac cup would have been better than what came on the sandwich. 

The items on the menu sound delicious so hopefully things improve, but I will wait a while before I come back to find out.

I couldn't be more disappointed in Wok Works. 

My first trip there was OK, I got quinoa and shrimp with the smoke sauce. The shrimp was a good size, there were about 8 pieces. The cabbage was crunchy and a nice addition and there was a TON of quinoa, probably enough for 4 servings but it was drenched in the sauce. There was so much sauce I felt like I was eating a too-sweet quinoa soup. 

I decided to give it another go and NIGHTMARE. I ordered chow fun, beef, broccoli, with the green curry sauce.
I got back to my office and opened the box and it looked like a box of grey mush. I dug around for the meat and instead i found grey tasteless shoe leather. It had obviously had the life steamed out of it and was poor quality to begin with. There was no nice sear from the wok or flavor to speak of. There were a whopping 2 (!!!) pieces of broccoli among the sea of gelatinous chow fun noodles. The noodles were mush and entirely inedible. I'm floored at the poor quality and execution. You can see how depressing it looks...let alone tastes from the pictures.

I really wanted to bring my food back because in this situation a manager needed to see it, but it was raining and cold and I'm a wimp. 

Not one to waste, I tried to pass my food off to self-proclaimed "office garbage disposal." He took one bite said "oh this is awful",  covered it in sriracha, took another bite and followed up with "nope still can't do it." 

The "cheap Chinese" cart at 18th and Market actually puts Wok Works to shame and that's just good for a quick greasy fix.

The BK on Frankford n linden is hands down the best. The Impossible whopper is ALWAYS on point. The workers are always super friendly. I'm always going late at night and it's never an issue. Love the late hours they are open. I never review fast food places bc ... well it's fast food... but this one deserves some credit!

Subpar.....
Although the workers were friendly, my pinto beans were undercooked and for some reason every time I come here I get way less food than I get at any other Chipotle for the same price? I usually eat about half of my bowls but I just ate this entire bowl and I'm still hungry.
The shrimp is amazing and the fries are so good!! Prices are reasonable for the amount of food you get. The guys serving are polite as well. A+ halal fast good joint.

Hope you aren't planning on having a chicken sandwich from this location. I was very disappointed after coming here today and ordering four sandwiches and none of them were as advertised. The biggest issue...no pickles! It was chicken and bread. I tried calling to speak with a manger and no one answered, went to a full voicemail box and told me to hang up. I will never come back here again.

Had to wait and subsequently made my friends wait for 30+ minutes.

And they didn't give me the fucking fries which I paid for!

Many things I can overlook, but horrible customer service is not one of them. Managers need to better train their staff on proper service etiquette. Cause this ain't the way business is handled. If i don't throw my money at you, then don't throw my bag of food on the counter.

Quick lunch is the reason places like wok works exsist. I was over Thanksgiving Day leftovers and decided i needed something i could grab quick and in a hurry.
Wok Works is less than a 5 min walk from my office so i ran out the door a few min after 12 hoping to beat the crowds. To my suprise i was the only patron here. I decided on the wok noodle bowl with shrimp and the tropicalia sauce. I was a little annoyed that what i have come to know as the standard veggies used in asian cusines are optional and come with a price tag . I kept my bowl with the traditional carrots cabbage bean sprout and egg. 
Less than 5 min passed and i was out the door on the way back to my cubicle to devour my lunch. The tropicalia sauce has a nice BITE and the spice level is spot on ( at a level 2 on the menu). I will say i thought i got gypped on the shrimp tip but i had to dig all the way down to the bottom of the container to find the protein i paid an extra 3.00 for. The sauce noodles and shrimp all seemed fresh and the portion size was legit. I could have easily made a second meal out of leftovers but decided to eat the rest throughtout the day. The finish sauces all sound great im very intruiged by the green curry sauce so perhaps i will try that next time. 
I think ill have to add wok works to my rotation.

I occasionally stop by here before doing some grocery shopping at Trader Joe's (since it's only a block away). I found the service to be efficient and didn't have to wait too long to put in my salad order.

The size of the to-go bowl is pretty generous compared to some other cafes. However, the two stars are because it was mostly just lettuce and dressing. In my opinion, it lacked proportionate amounts of toppings.

no ..nope ..ok. just no...
dirty tables,disgusting bathroom to start
the dining area ,first floor is a place for people apparently to hang out ,without making purchases and take over that area ..asking for change ,being super loud and way too much .
Go to the liberty place court ,next block

I REALLY like this place. Farm-to-fork what's not to love? This build your own wok place is suitable for all types of noodle/rice palettes with the variety of combinations to find your perfect match. I typically love the signature noodles with chicken and the spicy Szechuan sauce. Yum yum yum! I also recommend the crispy garlic topping for the added crunch and flavor. The best part about this food is you get to satisfy a noodle craving and you get to choose the sauce for your dish as opposed to the oh so typical soy sauce. This meal not only leaves you feeling full, but the freshness of the veggies, meat, etc make you feel like you just ate a really healthy meal as opposed to getting chinese takeout.

The short wok is pretty big so order accordingly! Don't forget the discounted yelp check-in! I completely forgot to use it the first time I went.

Oh and added bonus, wokworks delivers using postmates. Yay!

My friend and I shared the Boston Bean Steam Pot. It consisted of 2 lobsters, clams, shrimp, corn and potatoes. The lobsters were the smallest I've even seen and should have been thrown back into the ocean. They were so puny and tasteless, not worth the effort it took to crack them open. The clams were also small, less than the size of a dime. The shrimp were OK but also on the small size. The best part of the meal was the bi color corn, sweet as could be.

This place is fantastic.

Let me just first say - I don't care about the "plant pure" part of what they do at all. Legitimately, I don't care. So I have no real comment on it. I went in looking for delicious food at a good price. I'm not vegan or vegetarian, but I know what I like.

I went in with a friend. He ordered the "reuben", which is seitan or pure soy strips, cole slaw, thousand Island. He did remark that he was surprised about the cole slaw being a substitute for sauerkraut. I'm not sure if this wasn't reflected on the in-store wall menu or if he just didn't read it, but he said it was tasty either way.

I ordered the Baked Falafel - baked falafel, cucumber, tomato, onion, peppers,
kale, hummus in a whole wheat wrap or pita. They didn't have pita available, which is kind of surprising since it seems like, you know, it's a very pita kind of place. I opted to have a hoagie roll rather than a wrap. My sandwich was legit delicious. The falafel was a bit on the overcooked side, but the ingredients came together like magic. I chose to not have kale in favor of extra tomato and onion.

I also had an unsweetened iced tea, and my friend ordered some of their soft serve which honestly was nothing special.

I would have liked the sandwiches to be a few bucks less to be honest, but I'll definitely come back here. The staff, by the way, is exceptional. Like truly top notch.
This place is amazing. The man is so polite and patient. One of the best subways I've been at.

One star is for the delicious spicy shrimp Bao buns and the crispy noodles with duck sauce. 

The main attraction which is supposed to be the wok noodles was a complete fail. The entire dish tasted burnt and smokey...somebody needs to teach these Cooks to either reduce the heat or add more oil. The entire bowl was so bitter that no sauce could rescue it. What a shame !!!!

I came here recently after shopping at the Gallery at market East. I went to the food court but decided to walk further and get food from a less crowded place. I would order from Popeye's again. For it being lunchtime, service was fairly quick and they got my order correct the first time. I would come back and try to order two piece White meat, which i didn't see on menu but heard a customer order. They have Coca-cola products, in case you were wondering....

This Chick-fil-A will have a super long line but will get you out of the line within 5 minutes with the correct order and then some.
