This is he fast food concept of the future. 

Went back to this place a couple of weeks ago. Was better than the first time.

Although Pat's and Geno's are the most popular cheesesteaks, I don't think they are the best. Tourists and locals alike swarm the intersection of 12th and Passyunk, day and night, and the service and line move quick at machine like efficiency. However, the cheesesteaks are just not that good. If I had to pick, I would say the bun at Pat's is better and they chop their steaks instead of sliced. (In my opinion, chopped has more flavor because it has more surface area.) Overall, I feel like this is mostly a tourist trap, but come for the experience and check out the mayhem at least once. If you want to try the most famous cheesesteaks, get Pat and Geno. Check out my other reviews for better cheesesteaks.
Do NOT use this Taco Bell with GrubHub. They will completely screw up your order and neither party will fix it.

The drive-thru service there is horrible someone really needs to step up and make these people move a lot quicker and more efficient and not let them play around at the registers in Windows this is the second day of the week and I'm so pissed off this is the second time I'm going through the drive-thru and not only did they screw up my order but they take forever I spent 20 minutes in the Drive-Thru 845 and it's not even that many people in the Drive-Thru it's like three people and this is every single time I come through the drive-thru at this location nothing ever changes this is horrible this is not the way you're supposed to do business here I won't be returning I advise anybody that's headed in that direction at that location to avoid it and go elsewhere seriously

My Kids and I never agree on food Choices. We went to Philly Mills to do the Fast food dance One kid wanted KFC the Other Taco bell...I picked up both their Demands..and Noticed HNT( formally Pizza hut) I have to Try ANYTHING NEW. I went ordered chicken & Sweet potato fries  and a Veg & Friends bowl( crispy tofu with veg and grains) The Chicken was crispy hot juicy...the S potato fries could be more crispy but they they were yummy..My kids wanted to "Sample" my HNT meal...I drove home. Asked for my Food It was gone..at least they left me the Veg bowl which was surprisingly good. I'm glad I got to taste a piece of the Chicken&Fries before it disappeared... It's still a New place they did forget my sauces( it was the 3rd day they were opened)All I can say We no longer go to that "Other Chicken" place

I don't know what happen to this Popeye's. Service went downhill this year. Especially one of manager, I'm not sure if she is the manager but if you can yell at your fellow employees without them yelling back, you must be "somebody" right??

We were told at the door that they were close if we want sandwich and we told her we are not here for that sandwich. Ever since that incident, when I craved for Popeye's, even though i was driving past this location, it gives me a bad feeling that I drove 20 minutes to another Popeye's. You don't want my business, I will take it elsewhere. NEVER AGAIN!!

i was very nicely greeted, i asked for a margherita on a cauliflower crust and the girl recommended a Red Vine, the guy at the pizza oven was Extremely pleasant he clearly  liked his job and it showed by his attitude when i got home i was so happy that she recommended this pie because it was really tasty, so good i ate the whole pizza   i will be back! thanks for good food and great service
HORRIBLE. We waited 30 min to be told sorry credit card machine is down.... Then said sorry can't help that.

Not sure where the bad reviews are coming from?

Cheesesteak is super tasty, and greasy (perfect for this time of night). Delivered in 35 minutes. Food was warm. Got my soda. Everything I ordered was in my order.

Don't listen to the bad reviews. These guys are good!

Disgusting service! asked for a Philly cheese steak with no onions, was given one with plenty of onions. Requested that I have one with no onions and the worker proceeded to open up my steak with his hands and pin point that there are "two onions" and gives it back to me (sanitary issue). In disbelief I go back to try and eat it unfortunately there are at least 10 onions in the steak which completely changed the flavor. I take my half back as I made a trip all of the way from New York to enjoy this steak and this was ruining my entire experience. An older man proceeds to yell at me, grabs my sandwich throws it on the floor and throws my money back while cursing at me. Extremely disgusted and in disbelief, how does an establishment stay open with such vulgar people working here. Please make sure you look into your customer service.

Drove down from nyc just to see what pat's was all about..
There's a different window to order steaks another window to order fries & soda.

This place only serves beef, no chicken which we wanted originally however I got a steak cheese with onions & provolone cheese.
We added a few condiments they didn't have jalapeños but they did have other peppers & let me tell you this made me entire experience so much better! 
I loved it! 

Definitely would come back!!!

If you are looking for great fried chicken... don't go here. I stopped one evening on my way from work and  ordered meals for 4 family members. The chicken was overcooked and tasted like it had been brined and then, coated with salt. I couldn't taste any flavor except salt. Absolutely horrible and not recommended for anyone with high blood pressure.

A few weeks ago I decided to go through the drive through to get some yummy fried chicken and it didn't disappoint!  Got home and the order was perfect and the chicken was WONDERFUL!  I like the extra crispy-yum!! Oh and the woman who waited on me was very nice and friendly!

Pat's hasn't been good since the early 90's and I know this cause being born and raised in this city I know a lot of people are getting their heads overly piped up about when you come to Philly try Pats and their not even competition too across the street Geno's. The last time I even bothered to have their sandwich was around '07 and nope it was bad. Just throw steak mmm frozen meat on a hoagie roll and there's your Pat's steak. No flavor because it's not even seasoned like a traditional cheesesteak.

  Pat's need to be dropped to NOT top any cheesesteaks in Philly right with them other supposed to be king of cheesesteaks across the street, them days has been long gone. Ask any person born and raised from Philly would they ever eat from here or Geno's and they'd be like "They don't even cross my mind and their the 2 top tourist spots of the whole city that's all, NO!" To the people who do actually enjoy Pat's maybe you just enjoy no tasting, unseasoned steak but don't go back to yall hometowns or where ever your from telling people Pat's and Geno's are the best cheesesteaks in this city, your giving false information.

I got the Philly bowl. The tuna and toppings were pretty good, but the rice was so dry. It had the consistency of rice I left in the fridge for a few days. I tried to salvage it by picking out the toppings to microwave the rice to give it a bit more moisture, but it basically ruined the whole bowl.

Came here on a friend's friend's recommendation. Their cash-only policy was a bit annoying but luckily there was an ATM across the street. For $11 I got a simple foot-long sub with just steak & American cheese (nothing else). My order was completed as soon as I told the staff what I wanted and it was phenomenal; from the tender cuts of juicy steak smothered in all-American liquid gold to the quality bread that enveloped it all. Before I knew it, my sandwich was gone and my stomach full. Was not disappointed to say the least.

Amazing breakfast ! Its not pretty. As a matter of fact the look may put you off. The menu is gigantic. I had 3 eggs , homemade tater tots, Taylor pork roll and rye toast. $6.50. It was really perfect. Good ice coffee . My buddy had the same with ham. The ham was amazing. Food came out hot. The service was solid. It's only been around since 1980.... how did I miss this?

I came here for happy hour with friends. We were kind of restaurant hopping that day- things were either a hit or miss. With this particular place drinks were a hit and food ... a miss. We didnt ordered anything. Nothing stood out for food. I was tired of chips n dips. But I like the outside space. The decor inside isn't bad either. Service was good.

Pat's Steak 

I tried this spot 7 years ago and I thought why not give it another try since it's right next to Geno's. There was a line but it was quick. Got the same thing cheesesteak wiz price was $11 same as Geno's. The steak tasted dried. Didn't seem like they added flavor. I thought for 3,000 reviews they would bump it up a notch but this will be out of my list if you have this place mark down for Philly.

CASH ONLY/ FREE STREET PARKING

Oh man, I loved Pat's! Okay, I'll be honest, I was nervous placing my order because of how long the line was when we came, how freezing cold it was and with Pat's being outdoors only there was no escape from the outdoor elements (well there's a roof) and the style orders needed to be placed in 'wit' or 'witout' (onions that is) and the barrage of pigeons watching my every move!

Luckily, the hubby and I were successful in getting our cheesesteak wiz wit and an order of cheese fries without a scratch. It was so cool to see the exact place where Sly Stallone stood while filming Rocky and looking up and all over at the celebrity love from famous patrons of the past and present. 

So, the service at Pat's was like this: Finger snap! The worker in the window would say "next" and the customer who had been rehearsing the order would provide it, also while handing out the exact total due for the food. Then the worker would yell out the short hand to the crew workinging the flat tops and then the customer would blink and then BAM! The sandwich would be there... Amazing, right? 

I guess the service at Pat's isn't too much more than this, but really, what more is needed? It seemed like diners would clean off their tables (or maybe the pigeons would help in that matter) and the napkins, peppers, utensils dispensers were full.

Okay, Pat's was the cheesiest, and I loved every bite of my piping hot cheese steak. The meat was succulent and flavorful. The onions were not at all overpowering (which would have upset me, but did not) and the crusty and chewy bread did a great job of holding it all together. There is a seperate line for fries and drinks, which I found to be helpful. The cheese fries were awesome! They were crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. The cheese sauce was fantastic, as expected and we devoured the fires so quickly that they were not at all soggy. Thanks Pat's!

PS There is a church a block or so away in case you need to use the restroom: Emmanuel Chapel :) Just be sure to donate, if you can!

Popeyes is my second choice after Kfc, for original fast food chicken -waayy second. For chicken that is flavorless like a desert oasi. I dont like the spicy chicken options either. I didnt know what people saw in it, until my mom says she wanted chicken with less oil. Churches and popeyes are sorta similar, in that, they both share a recipe with a good base of ingredients, but nothing too out-there that you couldnt find any fastfood chicken joint to be fair.
Their biscuits are rock hard after 3 minutes.

I've ordered from here via Uber eats a couple of times. Each time, the portions seem to get smaller and the prices higher. At least this particular store doesn't Jack up the prices for UberEats.
I just ordered their limited time offered Cajun Fish Sandwich, and, as I should have expected, it was all bun, and breading, with a thin (about 1/8th inch) sliver of fish. They were also very stingy on the condiments. Not worth the money. Also not worth it is the chicken, at close to $2 per piece for rather small pieces.

Going on record to say that I prefer Pats cheesesteaks over Genos. Give me whiz wit! Pats has a nice meat to bread ratio with excess gravy and lots of whiz. I did prefer Genos fries over Pats. Please know the terminology before you order. Cash only. Order your steak at one window, fries and drink at the other. 

There's a bar of toppings like hot peppers, ketchup, mustard, mayo you can dress your steak with. Seating is all outdoor. It's not the most glamorous place to dine but when in Philly, this is a right of passage.

If I could give this place 0 stars I would. Lazy establishment, don't answer calls. Hours aren't what they say they are. Do not recommend going to this subway unless you're looking for a waste of your time.
Refused to give us our receipt & our sauces saying we didn't pay for them. Then proceeded to curse at us while the other coworker laughed. Disgusting.

Good, super fast service. Clean tables and pretty spacious for dining inside. Chicken tastes as it should - super delicious and moist, with a slight sweetness. Had many chicken sandwiches ready in wake of the hype. Would recommend using some type of sauce for the second half of the chicken sandwich. One big negative about all Popeyes food is the insane amount of sodium - watch out for that and hopefully the chain will recreate their recipes appropriately.
Im so infuriated. I was so hungry, and got absolutely nothing. Your food isn't even good but i work late and was so hungry. Didn't come. WORST. I don't even want to give one star

The young man helping me was not well trained.    I asked for extra queso and he tried to charge me twice for it.  He said since he put 2 scoops on he had to charge for both.  I asked if one scoop came with the bowl and he said yes.  I tried to explain to him them I should not be charged for 2, as one is an included item.  He did not understand, he said since he put 2 scoops on he HAD to charge for 2.  Is this just poor training, or a way to rip customers off? 
I am so ready to give up on Chipolte!   Could we pleas get a Moes in Philly????

It's good when ur drunk, and if ur not use to a good steak, other then that I really wouldn't go here to eat a steak....take it from someone that has eaten from this place for 30+ yrs, it was good maybe back n the early 90s, horrible now. Like really bad, U actually can't get a good steak n Philadelphia which claims to be the home of the cheesesteak , there r maybe .....maybe 2/3 places that offer a good steak, they r Johns Roast Pork, Jims, Steves n a pinch and Tony Luke's

Went through drive thru today for dinner,  and it went quickly which made me happy! They didn't have mild chicken, but I didn't mind since I love their crispy, spicy chicken! I got some mild tenders for anyone who didn't want spicy! They didn't have fries because they are waiting for a shipment. No biggie, but I am bummed they stopped the cajun rice - my Mama love that. But, everyone was happy with the red beans and rice and the mac and cheese. Biscuits were tasty as always! Drive thru worker was friendly and pleasant, too :0)

Really loved the build your own part! There are only a few pizza places on Drexel's campus and I was bored of the same veggie toppings on the pizza. Well, they were not customizable so I had no choice. 

At Blaze, you could add unlimited toppings on your pizza and the people behind the counter are super friendly! The crust was thin and then fire roasting gave it a unique test. So when you are at the counter, you begin by choosing your base sauce, add cheese, add all the toppings you want and the pizza goes to the fire grill and it is ready in minutes. Give a finishing touch to your pizza with a dressing of your liking. 

They have a decent selection of brownies and smores cookies. And also soda and other seasonal beverages. 

So if you are in University City and craving for pizza, Blaze is definitely the place to go!
Too Greasy - poor quality meat.  Tony Luke's much, much better.

What a disappointment. Literally just probably had my worst experience ever at a chipotle. I finally ordered the app to save time picking up orders. What a mess! Wasn't close to being ready when I walked in and there were no customers. A bunch of staff just staring at each other having their own conversations. Then as I'm watching a girl work on someone's order, literally watching in horror at the concoction she was making, I realized that was my order. I couldn't believe it. I just got back to work to try and salvage the bowl but it's a complete soupy mess. A complete waste.

If I could give this popeyes location no star I would. There is no professionalism there. Ive been going here for so long but never again. I was in the drive thru waiting for 20min or more and when I get to pay my food, they tell me I only order 2 box instead of 3 box. I repeated my order 3x when I was making my order and at the end the lady said ok so i assume she got it right. And now they are saying my order is only 2 and that i need to go back at the end of the line to make my third order. I explained to them how long I waited and was polite and respectful the whole time. Multiple workers spoke to me and the same respond "I cannot add another order theres nothing I can do". I ask to speak to a manager and they refuse to let me speak to one until one guy came to the window saying he is the manager and his name is "Jonathan Lewis". He too could not do anything. One of the worker even slammed the drive thru window after speaking to me. As simple as another chicken they could not add even when it is thier fault. They even said either pay for the one they have now or leave. Then they said they will call the cops. I could even hear the workers inside laughing and making jokes. I only left at the end because I felt bad for the people behind me in line. But I was super disappointed on how things was handled and how they were incompetent on how to handle a simple mistake that they made. I have worked in fast food industry and even was a waitress for years before becoming a nurse. I understand customers can be rude, disrespectful and down right wrong but this situation is different. They made the mistake and was unprofessional when handling the situation. My family will not go to this location again or even popeyes in general. I ended up going to KFC at 9020 franford Avenue and the gentleman theres was respectful and welcoming, this KFC worker made my day

I wish I could give negative stars. This is, by far, the worst McDonald's location. They routinely mess up orders and leave items out. One time, a burger wasn't even wrapped. Another time, I went through the Drive Thru and was told to pull ahead and wait. The employee that came out to hand me my food actually asked for a tip. I've frequented this place because of convenience but no longer. Avoid.

The way these people work Im started to think we should lower the minimum wage. Alot of people doing absolutely nothing here but playing on their phones. 

3 cars in the drive-thru... expect to wait about 30 mins, always check your order with these geniuses.

F's across the board

Can't come to Philly and not have a steak sandwich. We decided to try out the two rivals that are literally right across the street from each other. 

People were very nice, good came out quick, steak was good but it was so hard to get past all the cheese. It had sooooo much cheese the taste of the meat for lost. I had to get a piece at the bottom to try it. 

Bucket list

Visiting Philly and had to do the tourist thing, especially after all the food and travel channels making a big deal of it.  It is fun the way they are across from each other and lots of good energy.  After checking both out, ended at Pat's for no better reason than my wife's name is Pat.  Service is fast and unfriendly, which I guess is their thing.  You order cheesesteak and pay for it at first window and fries and drink at second, where you pay a second time.  After Yelp reviews, was not expecting much and was sadly not wrong.  Disappointing.  Roll was too chewy for me.  Beef was bland and dry.  Provolone cheese was not melted.  Fries were actually very good, as were the peppers from the condiment bar.  It was fun but would not go back.

First off to the haters: if you order food here and it's not ready in 5min get on their ass. Who the fuck waits 45min, fools!
Second, to the fools who order fast food for delivered: you get what your lazy asses deserve.
Third, food was great, as expected. Tacos unbroken and. Tip, get the box it's a good deal.

I heard about this place from a feature on Channel 3. Stumbled across it the other day and decided to check it out. It's a small storefront with two showcases on opposite sides. The first person you encounter in any establishment should be oozing some personality. Not here, the salesperson was as friendly as the city's potholes I encountered getting to the bakery. After making an attempt to engage Ms. Charisma, I ordered a pretzel, she went in the back and came back with a bag and placed it on the counter and said $.65. I gave her the money and asked for mustard, which was kept in a case with sodas and other mustard you can purchase.  I left, got in my car and pulled out my warm pretzel. It was so darn good I wish I had purchased more.  I give this bakery 4 stars instead of 5 because the first person I encountered when I walked in seriously lacked any type of customer service skills.  I will definitely go back and purchase more pretzels and cookies.
So good it's worth sitting out in the cold to eat.  The meat is so tender and the Cheez Wiz poured over it is actually better than the regular cheese most places use.
Clearly if you are going here you know the deal! Pats? Genos? So cant go wrong with either in my opinion.
It's good but not as good as genos bought two from each place. This place just had less flavor but definitely wasn't bad.

Ordered 2 subs and fries, ordered one with cheese whiz and one with white cheese with mushrooms. Subs were ok, they were a lot better than Genos. It was not dried. Fries were really crispy and delicious. 

Definitely a must try when in Philly! This is considered one of the OG's place to get subs, so it's a good benchmark to judge other subs.

I have to say I was a little disappointed in Pats King of Steaks if they really created the cheesesteak.  The steak part was great - nice and hot, and a little greasy. And I do love provolone cheese.  But the cheese was taken straight from the frig and wasn't even melted.  It definitely beat cheesesteaks in Georgia, and I do love their signage.  No real gluten free options here either - had to eat the layer that didn't touch the bread.

I'm from San Diego, ca... I was visiting fam in VA... went on a road trip to try this sandwhich... cheesesteak with grilled onions...  o m g... this angel is in food coma heaven.... it was a yummy freak of beautiful creamy meaty goodness that had me licking my mittens just so I wouldnt waste the bounty ... yes sir, this was worth the stop... wait till I come back with my buddies
Pats is da bom! The line goes on forever and parking....what parking?!?! Worth the wait for one of the best sandwiches in Philly!

I've never demanded my money back from any fast food joint...until tonight.

Oh yes, Girly Girl and I decided to stop at the drive-thru at this McDonald's after making a stop at the nearby Target.  First thing out of her mouth was, "What if it's creepy?" after I suggested we eat inside.  I told her it wouldn't be, but decided to just go ahead and take it home rather than eat there.  

So we order some food...it came to about fifteen bucks, though the drive-thru cashier insisted it was actually five dollars and change even after I told her twice that it wasn't.  When it finally did sink in, she again quoted the wrong total and laughed herself silly after realizing what a complete moron she actually was.  Ah well, time to wait for the food.

I noticed the car in front of me had actually turned its engine off while waiting.  I've done the same thing before, but little did I know how long we'd be waiting when it was finally our turn.  Once we got up to the window, the guy who looked like the manager handed me a diet Coke, which the stupid moron running the drive-thru was told to correct when she read off my order.  After this, we had to listen to Mr. Manager complain to his workers, as well as discuss someone being on her period that week.  Great.

After about 15 or 20 minutes of this horseshit and being told our food was going to be "right up," I screamed "ALL RIGHT, ALREADY" at the two dunces behind the window that was cracked open just a bit.  Manager finally shut up long enough to open the window and I started demanding my money back.  He tried the song and dance that they only had ONE FREAKIN' COOK in the back that night, but I insisted.  His bitchy coworker tried to change my mind as well, but I said "Look, this is FAST FOOD, not 'wait twenty minutes food'!"  So they finally handed me my money back and we drove off.

What I don't get is why Mr. Manager person just didn't shut his mouth that was running 100 mph and get the hell back in the kitchen and help out.  But noooooooo, he'd rather be spreading trashy gossip and not caring.  Not even after he looked out the window at one point and saw cars wrapping around the building.  

Suffice it to say this is the shittiest McDonald's I've ever visited.  If you really need some of this crapola, then please, please, please find another one in the area.  This locale deserves no one's business at all.
Best in town, never disappoints always get excited eating their food keep up the great work !

We went around 8;30am on Father's Day for the 1st time and was excited to try both Pat's & Geno's famous cheesesteak subs.  There was a couple outside eating and nobody in line.  Was checking out the menu & the guy yelled something out the window & slammed it shut.  I asked him what did he say & he re-opened the window & said he's cleaning the grill.  Then, he shut the window & went back to watching the tv.  I asked him if they were closed & he opens the window & yelled he's cleaning the grill.  Funny, because he was watching tv.  Guess he didn't feel like cooking for Asian Americans that day.  Racist mofo was too busy watching tv.  Next time, we'll eat where the locals recommend.

"Do your pizzas justice, the world loves you!" 
Blaze does exactly the same and the service is quick! You can choose your own toppings or select from their menu.
One of the unique things about their pizza is that they add cheese at the base and sauce on top, that way the base always remains crisp!
A favorite place to hang out for Penn students.
They forgot one of my order. - - and overcharged me for the drink.........feel like they don't want to welcome me.

It's Chi-Chis for hipsters.  That's fine in my book.  Mexican food with a "gastro" twist, a good jukebox, fine beer list, and fair prices.  

Food has been off on some nights, but when it's good, it's very good.  I highly recommend the wings; they are large, juicy, and GRILLED.  The char flavor is amazing.  In general, ordering off the specials board is the way to go.  Brunch is also very good here, and there is no wait most of the time.

A bit dark and loud, but I like it anyway.  A fun place to go with friends.

How are you guys gonna charge $12 for "Freshly squeezed orange juice with cups." and then send me a bottle of Tropicana that you got from Costco for $3?

That is just 100% fraudulence.
So good! The original and the best. Seating outside was easy as was takeaway. Highly recommend!
I save the fifth star for Steve's. Still, this is the best South Philly steak. The best, Jerry.

Pat's is one-half of the draw to Passyunk Square.  Tourists want to experience the infamous cheesesteak rivalry between Pat's and their counterpart across the street.  Personally, I don't believe either are the best in town.  However, it was a fun experience that I'd recommend for those visiting the city.  While in the area, check out the historic brownstones and vintage shops.  Don't be deterred by the line, it moves quickly.  Know what you want, order it correctly.  It's cash only and outdoor seating. Between the two, Pat's is my preference.  The meat is seasoned more and there was more of it.

I had to choose at least one star, but in actuality it's minus 0 stars. I am not surprised there are more than 30 negative reviews. Well I am done, I reported this location to corporate, and I will continue my crusade until this location is brought up to code and standard according to the "McDonald's" culture and tradition. You can not rent a slum property in Chestnut Hill, but you can slum on your fast food choice. It's absolutely unacceptable!!!

Whoa buddy...

There are a million reasons to hate this place, but darn that BONAFIDE chicken... *sigh*

There's the chick w/the false Tammy Faye eyelashes that I am always terrified might land in my coleslaw... "EEEEEEK! There's a tarantula in my food!!!"

As one of my co-workers always says, "I can't stand those stanky girls that work over there. Every one of 'em has a bad attitude."

There's the fact that you can NOT, like it's physically impossible to, get in and out of this store in less than 15 minutes... I get a sucky 30 minutes for lunch, so after the 3 minute drive each way, I have 24 minutes to get my ish and clock back in. I come THISCLOSE if not go over every time. They don't pre-cook much of anything because they are apparently more fearful of it going to waste than of losing customers. My regular lunch date always gets mild chicken fingers and french fries... I usually opt for the chicken sandwich. None of the above are ever ready when we get there.

But then you finally get to taste it, and all is well. lol

The famous Pat's and Gino's, across from each other..1st cheese steak in Philly, rib eye meat,cheese wiz, same recipe from 1940 and for me in my personal quest to figure out who has the better Philly Cheese Steak in Philly is now finally over. I gotta give it to Pat's! Although Gino's was delicious too pat's was just more to my liking. It was fun to go to both spots and buy one of each cheese steaks and take pictures there and experience the whole Philly vibe thing while at the same time grubbing down on some good Philly cheese steaks. I can't wait to go back and try other Philly Cheese Steak spots, maybe there's a place that's better than Pat's but for now Pat's is the King.

I tried ordering Uber eats from this location today and they accepted the order but then cancelled it when the driver tried to pick it up. Last time I ordered for delivery they forgot items. I don't recommend trying to order from this location.

Pat's over Geno's. 

'nuff said!

I give them 5 stars for customer service. After a really long day, I ordered food around 2am from here. I fell asleep and missed their delivery call. When I called back 30 minutes later in a frenzy I was thinking 9 out of 10 that this would be a refund. But they send out the delivery guy again and he was so polite. Lol. So yay! :) 

I'm visiting Philly but I wish something like this existed in my city too for those late night hunger pangs. 

PS: Whatever you get, don't forget to add the Mozzarella sticks too. They are yum!
Service wasn't terrible but when I opened my bag. My tacos were half opened, wrapped terribly and the bag had fell apart. I couldn't even enjoy my food because it was so messy. Never again.

Went here last summer with my family. The place was pretty slow surprisingly. Drive all the way from N.Y to try the famous Pat's steak. I gotta say there's nothing famous about this place. Some old guy behind the counter wearing his 12k Rolex rushed us without letting us choose our toppings or anything. Threw our sandwiches together on dry hero bread with little to no meat at all and some cheap yellow cheese. The sandwich's alone cost me about $10 each! That's without fries and a drink. I couldn't believe I took this drive for a sandwich I seen on t.v and read about in the paper and heard about through family and friends just to be this disappointed. I'll never come back to Pat's.I went over to Geno's down the block and felt much better.  Better atmosphere, better hospitality, better pricing and better food.

What is the definition of a Philly Cheese Steak. Ask Will Smith, ask Rocky Balboa. They'll both tell ya. It's Pat's. Geno's crap steak thinks they can attract people with brighter neon signs - it's because they sell an inferior sandwich. I'm a Midwesterner - from Chicago/Detroit and had been waiting to have Philly's real cheesesteaks. I stomached one from Pat's and Geno's both the same night to be the judge. Bought a sandwich from each place and took a few bites of each first so as to judge without being full.


Pat's is the way to go. 

At Pat's the bread is warm and soft. The steak pieces are perfectly sliced and grilled with a nice blend of onions in it too. The Cheez Whiz is the best and classic cheese with it and it has the texture of real cheese whiz.

At Geno's the bread is hard, the steak seems to be some soy blend that reminds me of White Castle patties, and the "cheese whiz" was watery like it was blended with water and kept sitting out for the whole day. Terrible.

If you want authentic cheesesteak heaven and speak 5 words, here's the order you want to make:

"Whiz Whit and Cheese Fries"

When you are in Philly how can you pass up getting cheese steaks. When we tried Pat's on a Sunday night the line was small and moved quickly which made us go here first. We ordered almost every sandwich possible and my favorite was the pork with all the fixings. Wouldn't really do it again but I'm glad we tried it.

This spot was everything I expected it to be. The food was a tad bit pricey (or at least pricier than before with the cheesesteak being $12), but it was definitely worth it. The bread was soft, the steak was perfectly cooked, and they did not skimp on the cheese and onions. The staff were super friendly and we got our food within seconds. (Tip: if you want the roast pork sandwich and the cheese steak, eat the roast pork first or else it will taste bland compared to the cheese steak)
P.S. I also went to their "competition" Geno's and Pat's is so much better. If you only have the stomach for one, go here.

Maybe I was starving after my 2 hour flight.. Or maybe I was hungover from the night before.. Or maybe because this is the first time I've ever had Chick Fil A, it was freakin' awesome. I had waffle fries and chicken tenders and omg the chicken was pipin' hot and so juicy! They even gave us a refill on the soda cause I was super dehydrated from the flight!
Yummm wish there was one close to where I live!

I've only been to a few so don't consider me and expert. 
The staff was having trouble getting the bulletproof glass open so they could hand me my meal. 

It's what you'd expect from a fast food burger joint.

Five Guys is the best place to go if you don't mind stuffing your face in delicious calories. That may seem like a back handed slap to the face, but I do not mean to come off as one. I love Five Guys. I love how all the toppings are free and how it is not categorized as a fast food joint (because it really isn't). The burgers are delicious and I have never had a problem with it being under cooked or over cooked. Five Guys is not meant to be a classy place, ie paper bags covered in grease, peanuts at the table, gallons of malt vinegar. But it is worth going to it. Beware of the homeless guy who always stands out there though, he likes to steal your cups or demanding money as he opens the door for you.
Eat here and you might get murdered. All this area is is a hot zone for drunks. I would not recommend taking your child here anywhere past 7 PM
Fun and a Philly must do experience. Really not amazing food and the place is gritty and over priced, but it is worth it. Do it.  Eat one at Genos and Pats both within 30 min, THE GUT CHALLENGE!!!

I know many people have given this place top rating but I disagree with such. 
 
For a Mexican restaurant or Mexican fusion the food was very blended and not even the hot sauce added taste to it .  The rice tasted like it was frozen and microwave.  I grew up in a country were rice is eaten almost in every meal and a 5 year old could prob cook a better rice.  Very disappointed.

The $9 margaritas were to my opinion the worst margarita I have ever had, I could even taste a bit of tequila.  The salt on the rim of the glass was just plain old table salt.  Jose cuervo bottle margarita mix is better than Los Caballitos margaritas.  

When I saw the name Los Caballitos I thought that I would see at least a Mexican server but was amazed that our server couldn't even pronounce what was on the menu.  I was attempting to have a conversation with my girlfriend but I could not even hear myself talk due to the outrageously loud music.  

I'm sure that this place has a following and will not agree with this review but I truly will not and would never recommended this place to anyone as I think that close to authentic or authentic fusion Mexican.  

VERY DISAPPOINTED!

I'm a vegetarian 99% of the time, but I make an exception for Pat's every once in a while (usually when out-of-town friends come to visit). Pat's is simply the best. Anyone who says go to Geno's is wrong.

I was surprised to read all of the negative reviews of this place as that was not my experience at all. I mean, in my view this place has several things going for it:

1) They're open until 4 am and will deliver to just about anywhere. How many times are you wanting to get delivery from a place but since you're not in their 6 block radius you're SOL or it's 30 minutes before closing and they don't even answer their phone? The delivery time could be improved but it's not THAT much longer than your average delivery time.

2) Food is good and more inventive than your typical pizza/sub/wing place. "Build your own onion rings"? Come on- that's awesome (and they're great)

3) Food is well packaged for delivery. It comes hot and they make sure they put it in the right container- fried foods stay crispy and softer foods stay warm and soft (not soggy)

I can't help but guess a lot of folks are drunk/high/cranky when they order and therefore probably dole out a lot of crap to these people. We all have that drunken friend who likes to fight with everyone and anyone and rarely is it justified. If you treat someone poorly, they'll probably do the same in return. I think they deserve a medal for putting up with our bulls%*t!

Wanted chicken for the 1pm football game, jumped in the car from Bensalem... signs show dining room is understandably closed and posted hours show 10:30 AM opening. Got there at 11:50 am via the drive through and (1 1/2 hours AFTER posted hours) - after waiting through line of cars to place my order and with zero explanation - advised they would be opening in 10 minutes and to please exit the drive through into the lot. Waited and went back & sat through the drive-in line of cars again at 12:05 and was again told another 10 minutes and again asked to pull over in the parking lot.... my 3rd attempt at 12:30? You guessed it.... another "10 minutes... please exit the line and park... ".... This is now a FULL 2 hours after posted hours? 
   I would not want to be the franchise owner if my team is losing this many customers as I was not the only one who rolled out of the parking lot after the first attempt let alone a third! 

   POOREST service I have seen in a long time!
  
   PS- did get my chicken- called Nifty Fifty's in their parking lot....was ready in the 10 minutes it took to drive to Grant Ave and it was Hot N Tender!

Ask any Philadelphian and they will tell you there are much better cheesesteaks to be had in the city and that both Pat's and Geno's are just tourist stops.  While this may or may not be true, I have eaten a lot of cheesesteaks and have done a back-to-back taste test with Geno's in the past and I like Pat's the best, hands down.  It's meat, cheese, and onions on a good sub roll, and I enjoy it for its simplicity.  I've been here about 5 or 6 times now and always try to stop here when I'm nearby.  Definitely better than 3 stars but stop and decide for yourself whether they earn their King of Steaks reputation.

Rudest staff-truly do not understand how this restaurant could have staff who seem so annoyed with their customer... for giving them business! I'm surprised I wasn't asked to cook the food myself.
I have a pound of American cheese at home that I'd rather go home to then be treated like a plebe or bother to be at the restaurant. Just close- prime location for someone way better. Stop hiring hipsters who don't want to work.

Ordered here a couple of times, food is ok. Much improvement  on the speed. But every time I'm here I continuously witness tons of Order so they must be doing better, more driver is great.NOT. What a rude unprofessional place.

Ahh pats is definitely the king of the game. A little messy but it's juicy and full of flavor. The establishment has been open forever and is a legendary staple to Philly so It's no wonder it's a fan favorite. I opted for provolone but there was so little I forgot I even ordered it w provolone ): will definitely try the cheese whiz if I'm ever back in the area. 
Mushroom provolone steak 7.5/10

The spam of the spam musubi was overcooked and there was a ton of rice per spam musubi. The ratio is a bit uneven, wishing there was a thicker piece of spam for the amount of rice.

Ordered the unagi bowl because I love eel, but the number of eel pieces was underwhelming. The standard sauce that was used tasted good though!

cautition. uber eats and doorsash customers...don't waste your money. you will only be "credited" for your inconvenience and have to wait longer to order from somewhre elser.i ordered 3 times from 2 different delivery services within an hour. first 2 orders were wrong, and they couldn't complete the third order so i had no food. this is not the first time i had issues with order from here, but it is the last. clearly mcdonald's has zero standards, as well as doordash and ubereats.
This place is all hype, Lots of tourists and sandwiches were not that great. I was disappointed.  It was extremely hard to find parking as well.

No No No .... 

I ordered an egg salad sandwich from here once and the toast was burnt. Not a little overcooked but black and burnt, and they still made the sandwich using the burnt toast and delivered it to me. I will say when I called to tell them about the sandwich they sent another sandwich immediately but why why why would you make a sandwich using obviously burnt bread. 

My husband , ever the optimist , ordered a breakfast sandwich on a long roll not long after my egg salad experience, the bread was stale. I think because they toasted the bread thinking my husband wouldn't realize the bread was stale but .... 

There are so many breakfast places to choose from, I can't see myself supporting this business after those two experiences

I know, I know...tourist trap, yada yada yada...

But here's the deal - I've been coming to Philly for years now and when we do we always try to stop for a cheesesteak somewhere-Pat's, Geno's, or Jim's have been the standards, and I've been to Pat's more than any other.  I like Pat's...I really do.  For all the whining about cleanliness and rudeness-please, reach out and grab a clue.  It's a cheesesteak place in South Philly, in an area that just isn't conducive to being 100% clean 100% of the time-get over it or just don't eat at one of these places.

My wife and I always get the same when we come to Philly - regardless of the place - Whiz, wit onions and mushrooms.  The kids get American without...is American cheese even really cheese?  I mean I KNOW Cheez Whiz isn't, but I'm not looking for a filet with gorgonzola here!  Anyway, even though Pat's may not be the go-to place for Philly folks, it's probably going to remain our go-to place for the forseeable future.  We've tried Geno's on multiple occasions and the HAVEN'T perfected the cheesesteak that Pat's introduced on this corner in 1930.  

In a nutshell, for Pat's 2728th review I will say Pat's beats Geno's.  Prices are the same, seating is the same, service is the same, cheesesteaks are better.  There, I said it...

The owner is a dick, he even gets upset if you leave a review he does not like. He'll call you a liar or call you a competitor, he can't take criticism and lashes his insecurities out on people. Don't ever order from here, new ownership is needed.

A must stop if you are in Philly. The service at both Pat's and Geno's is pretty much  nonexistent.... But that's part of the Philly Charm!  Speak English of go home!  Order correctly or go to the end of the line!  

At this point there are already well over 2000 reviews but here is my take on the Pat"s vs. Geno's battle.  

Pat's fries are way better than Geno's,  but Geno's wins the Cheesesteak battle by a nose.   Geno's just seem to be juicier.  

The real truth is that I have had better cheesesteaks at other locations, but you are a true foodie, you have got come to the hallow spot at least one in your life!

Blaze is the best fast casual place on campus. I appreciate how they balance the standardization of the preparing the pizzas with the artistry of putting the pizzas in a brick oven. The pizzas always come out fresh and crispy.

This is my first review with no picture. I will explain later. I was in Phili and was told my multiple people to have a phili cheese steak. I'm from NY so i took the locals advice. I remembered seeing something on TV about Pat's and Geno's being across the street from each other and it is TRUE. you can be at Pat's and be looking at Geno's. The biggest difference between Pat's and Geno's. pat uses a Melted cheese wiz with chopped up meat and Geno's uses slices of cheese and does not chop there meat. I was told by a bunch of different people Pat's was better but they said it is personal prefrence. I went with pats! 

Parking was a B****. I had to park 6 blocks away in a grocery store parking lot. Due to all one way narrow streets. I'm not street parking my Vehicle in a area im unfamiliar with the crime situation it is too attractive to a criminal. being a non- Local im not taking a chance. It looked like a lot of people were walking to this location.

I went at lunch time on a saturday, which was a huge mistake. The line was about 1.5- 2 blocks long i'm not joking ether.The history of this place was cool there was a bunch of pictures of all of the famous people who have eaten at Pat's. I noticed a lot of people standing and eating. There was red picnic tables but everyone was filled. It smelled so good waiting on the line.

Once i got to the window there is a ordering routine at this place. i skrewed it up. I just wanted meat and cheese and i said cheese wit. i asked itf that was was just meat and cheese and the guy was like GET IT RIGHT! and then yelled to the rest of the line MAKE SURE YOU KNOW WHAT YOU ARE GETTING BEFORE THE WINDOW. I handed him my debit card and he said read the sign cash only. This is a CASH ONLY! business  smart by pat's for tax purp and swipe fees.

 I handed the guy a $100 bill said they cant take the $100. he starts taking other peoples cash that ordered already. I wanted to leave The turn over rate for this place was amazing. i gave him a $50 and he took it. I said i'm sorry i'm from NY you guys do it different around here. He said You should be able to read signs. I got super pissed i told him to keep the change i only ordered 2 cheese steaks. The signs he was talking about were right above the cash register. the line wrapped around the building. I coulden't see the menu until i was at the window.  I just felt annoyed. It was cool that i could see the staff making my food.

I ran into some people i knew eating there sandwiches. They told me there cheese steaks were good. I brought mine back to my Hotel and ate it there. The cheese steak was really good. everything was moist and juicy. If i went back to ether Pat's or Geno's again. I would send someone else to get my food for me and pay them $50 just so i woulden't have to deal with the crazyness again. I dont know if it led up to all of the Hype.

PROS:

- The history
-Watch them make your food

CONS
