Good spot in center city for burger and fries. Love their Cajun fries over the regular and not too spicy.

Pats is a great greasy spot for classic chopped cheesesteaks. I got the cheesesteak with American cheese and onions. They are generous with their steak and the bread is excellent. It's also super fast- I hadn't even told them my order and my sandwiches were already ready. My only criticism is that they were skimpy with the cheese for a cheesesteak-- you have to order extra cheese. They were a bit dry too but overall super delicious.
I'm not givin any stars because I didn't get the food I ordered n it took too long to get here. I love Popeyes but this was just horrible. If I order something I want what I order smh.

Through out my life Cheese Steaks have always been my one of, if not, my favorite food. So I had to come to Philly to finally taste the real thing.  And you know the first stops were. Pat's and Geno's.

So I can finally put the debate over. Pats is the better steak by a slim margine. It just felt like the quality of the meat was slightly better, or at least the taste. But it was very close. I understand that most Philadelphians say that both aren't that good compared to the other places around. But it was plenty tasty to me. Pat's takes the it vs Geno's.

I don't know why people lose their nuts over Pat's and Gino's. You pay a shit ton of money (cash only, which really grinds my gears) to someone who truly acts like an ASSHOLE behind the register just so you can get some junky, greasy "steak" slapped onto a white doughy mess of bread. My biggest peeve about Pats is the attitude and impatient eye rolling that comes from the employees while you place your order.

More than year has passed since my negative review and I have been back enough times to make a new opinion- I thought it was time that I updated my review! In the past few months I have been here quite a few times and mostly for nachos and margaritas but one day we came here for brunch. Since that day it has become a staple every few weeks to stop here on a Sunday and grab brunch. They offer options like eggs benedict on cornbread with chipotle hollandaise. They also have eggs with rice and beans and even have vegetarian sausage! My husband always gets the eggs benedict with vegetarian sausage instead of bacon and I enjoy the (l)UNCH portion and get nachos or tacos. Their vegan beef tacos are my favorite. The tacos only come with cilantro  and onions so you need to add-for an additional cost- any sour cream, guac, cheese or pico. The service isn't great and drinks are pretty costly but they are delicious. 

Complimentary chips and salsa are given and the salsa verde is delicious! Parking can be a little bit rough due to the location but just be prepared to possibly be parking a few blocks away. Passyunk Avenue has tons of shops and restaurants so the walk is appeasing!
Good fresh sushi. I really enjoy the spicy crab roll. I decided to take a leap and order the shrimp tempura but the shrimp were a little mushy. I hope they open back up soon.
The best steak sandwich I have ever had by far in Philly and beyond. It's the original for a reason!

Holy Hell!!! Bring a book! How, after all this store has been through (YouTube the video where the employees assault a customer), is the service STILL THIS BAD!!! No matter what day of the week or time of day, prepare to wait for an hour+ to get even the simplest order. And don't think you can skip the wait with GrubHub or a mobile order... it's still just as slow, perhaps even worse. Food order is never right, and the place is filthy. Every employee is disorganized, confused, slow, and disinterested. They are unapologetically terrible at everything. I mean, I honestly don't know how you can fail so miserably, so often, and still stay open. How has corporate not shut down this franchise yet? It's so laughably awful!!

Pat's won the cheesesteak challenge agains Geno's by a hair. The meat was very overcooked but at least it wasn't greasy and the sandwich was not all bread.

We had:

Cheesesteak with whiz and onions - good but not great

Cheesesteak with whiz - my kids thought it was okay at best

Cheese fries - swimming in whiz

If given a choice, I would not go back to either establishment. Jim's beats both by miles!!!

Pretty bad. We were the only people in the drive through but it took forever. The cashier gave us a brownie to make up for the wait which was nice. The tenders were cold, bland, and dry. The three sauces it came with were not tasty. Definitely won't be going back.
Bland. Worst Philly cheesesteak I have ever tasted. Spent $50 door dashing 2 steaks & fries, neither of us could even finish the horrible sandwich. Go to Jim's!

I'd say the philly steak is better than genos of course they have that but the customer service needs some work. Idk what's up with people but a smile will get u a long way with people if you just showed some teeth but all in all the philly was good it's diffidently holding its name as king of steaks but the customer service needs some improvement.

I would also like to add they would of got a 4th star from me if the customer service was better both genos and pats have really bad customer service so if ur going there expecting someone to say hi welcome to pats how may I take ur order they won't they don't care about your day they just want your money and it's messed up cause I'm a very nice guy and customer service goes along way with me I like feeling welcomed when it comes to a place I've never been too and want to try so all and all I hope they improve there customer service if not I won't be returning.

hats off to the chef. he fried that shit good.




mm mm good 


got the mozz, the cheese logs , the cheesy fries , the cheesy steak , and the mac&cheese bites

This used to be my favorite place for cheesesteaks when visiting Philly. This time, I was so disappointed. The steak was dry and lacking seasoning, and the bread was a little stale. I've eaten here before and they were great but things have changed for sure.
Worst service I ever had. The staff is miserable and so rude. After you order your food you wait forever in line to get it.

One staff member, Tanya, was extremely rude. There was a mix up on our order (which is understandable! I used to work in customer service!) and upon inquiring about our order, Tanya approached me very confrontationally and used explicit language. Very disappointed not only in her but also in the response of the staff. When I informed another staff member about the situation she had to be reminded twice to alert the manager. The manager listened to our concerns (which I appreciate) but I am not clear what came of it.

So I know this place is a religion for natives. So given that, we took  two busses, a train and walked about a mile to get to,  supposedly, the two most raved about cheesesteak establishments. 
I really wanted to experience the chez whiz but my daughter felt that was just nasty. So we got provolone. Honestly, there was nothing spectacular about this place. It is all hype.

I was able to order online through Door Dash and pick it up (which made ordering convenient). 

I walked into the restaurant and saw my order sitting on top of equipment in the back, ready to be picked up, but I had a hard time getting an employee's attention to tell them I was picking up the order. I was also the only order sitting there, which makes me wonder if people typically order at the restaurant rather than online pick up. 

I ordered a bacon cheeseburger with lite grilled onions and extra barbecue sauce wrapped in lettuce. The burger itself was absolutely delicious. It was nice having the burger wrapped in the lettuce for 75% of the experience. However, towards the end, the lettuce was curled up funny on the sides, making it hard to eat it with the burger (instead you're just eating chunks of lettuce), so I left the remaining lettuce behind once I finished my burger. It was also VERY VERY greasy. The grease wet the bottom of the bag (and the burger was wrapped in HEAVY foil!)... I had to go through about 3-4 napkins or more while I was eating it. Definitely not a dainty meal to eat at your desk during Lunch (but I did it anyways hahaha).

Esquina mítica de Philadelphia si es que las hay, onda que el cheesesteak es sinónimo de esta ciudad y este es uno de los más famosos.

Pero vamos al sandwich en sí: obvio que es rico, no lo voy a negar, pero la verdad qué hay otros mucho mejores en la ciudad.

La esquina y el lugar en sí son súper pintorescos. Se pide y se come en las mesitas de afuera. La mala es que solo aceptan cash.

This is the worst chikfila I've ever been to. Because they're a brand I usually trust, I thought it'd be a solid bet for an airport meal. I ordered the chicken egg and cheese biscuit. The biscuit, egg, and cheese were fine. But the chicken, which should be the star of the show, was tough and overcooked. Blatantly unacceptable. Avoid this chikfila.
Always amazing when I go here, we drive all the way from NY to have these cheesesteaks & they never disappoint! Will be coming back soon!

Went to Pat's King of Steaks with my wife, sis, and brother-in-law, and had his famous Philly cheesesteak with mushroom, onions, and cheesewiz, which was delicious! And did you know it is kosher, with the cheesewiz put on the bread, invented by Frank, the owner. I was stoked to meet Frank, the owner, and his wife. Both very friendly and humorous. It's rare you get to meet the owners of a famous establishment. What an experience! Will definitely come back. May God continue to bless you.

Don't bother ordering from the Popeye's on North Broad Street. I ordered the Buffalo Chicken Tenders MEAL, which is supposed to come with a Small Drink. When the meal was delivered there was NO DRINK.
I realize that this is a small thing, but if they're doing this to people in a city the size of Philadelphia, then adds up to big bucks.
I tried to call the Restaurant, which is supposed to be open until 10:30 pm, and they REFUSED to pick up the phone.
I tried to use their customer support app, but it wouldn't even allow me to enter the restaurant's address. Nevermind, report the problem.
I guess that I will have to wait until the Chelten Avenue Restaurant reopens, because I don't appreciate getting ripped off.

Always good food, Always good service, Always good Margarita's
My husband and love this place! its our Saturday night getaway.  Its young, fun and loud.   Although I'm not young I have a blast everytime!

Clean, friendly, fast. Attentive supervisor on the floor. The marks of good management.

Best assembled lettuce wrap I've had in a long time. Generous portion of mushrooms on burger. 

This location exceeded expectations -- thank you!

I eat here about three times a week. Always consistent. The pizza is awesome, the staff is excellent, and it is always a good value. Most importantly, my son thinks it's the best. One of the guys that works there Oz, always makes him feel cool. As a restaurant manager myself, I appreciate that. Keep up the good work guys!

I live in Philadelphia and therefore, I have tasted a real cheesesteak. Several, I have even lazily made one at home it's a simple formula a fresh amoroso long roll, cheese of your choice I prefer provolone as the cheese steak gods intended, as "whiz" is not a real food and therefore is not going to be acknowledged as cheese moving forward in this conversation. You then add meat, specifically thin sliced juicy ribeye. Some people like onions and peppers I like fried onions on top. The rest is up to you.

Pats and Genos share this review. Look at the formula! A hot dog roll?! Dry meat?! Your cook can't fry onions PATS!! your kidding me?! My bodega on 4th and Jefferson makes better cheesesteaks than you and that's on the Birds . I gave you your five stars to keep tourists out of the North but I couldn't let it be left unsaid.

Terrible customer service. They are too cool for school hahaha ! They currently have ToGo drinks options, so my friend and I were riding bikes and decided to stop by why not ! We were super excited. Got there and called to order since it's COVID and all. As I'm waiting outside the window for someone to answer, the girl inside yelled, "Kill me!" Like ok ... then she answered and hung up. Came out the window and honestly was super unhelpful. Long story short  ... we left. It was so unpleasant that we went to Stateside and had drinks I hand in less that 6 min! I've been here for food before, nothing special. Save your money and go to an ACTUAL LOCAL MEXICAN joint. You'll thank me

The owner is a dick, he even gets upset if you leave a review he does not like. He'll call you a liar or call you a competitor, he can't take criticism and lashes his insecurities out on people. Don't ever order from here, new ownership is needed.



Once again the owner tries to discredit a review by saying that I didn't complain about the service and asking did I recently get fired by them. Service sucks and I have not and would never work for you, is that good enough for you? Oh wait your going to ban me from ordering from your restaurant, good job lol.

Been sitting in the drive thru line for over 30 min and still not moving ... the order machine doesn't work so all the cars are basically pulling up to the window and doing the orders one at a time ... fucking disgrace.. I get it the job sucks but honestly don't come to work if u not really about getting your job done this is a fucking joke of a place . And honestly this community is just going to accept this type of service because it all they know . I bet if I was in the suburbs it wouldn't be taking long .. oh let me guess it won't because that community actually gives a crap about the service they get but not here
I was weak. I was hungry. Mistake. Shake wasn't chocolate. Fries were cold. Cheeseburger was smashed and slid off the bun. Never again.
The meat was dry and flavorless. Genos is much better...

From Hawaii and always wanted to try a Philly cheesesteak and where better than at Pat's.  
We were disappointed. Overpriced, rude workers, greesy and tasteless. Charlie's sub  sandwiches here at home is way better. Again, just the hype. Never going back and I would never  recommended to my family and friends.
HORRIBLE!!!! over priced and dry no seasoning just meat and cheese. For small fries and drink which was mostly ice it will run you $9 I couldn't believe it. Welp, I learned my lesson.

After all of my visits to Philly, I can now FINALLY say that I've had an authentic Philly cheesesteak! When driving down the block, Geno's is definitely more eye-catching, but I've never been one to judge a restaurant by the number of flashing lights it has -- almost over-compensating, with how much the lights blind you. 

I will be honest and say that I don't have any basis of comparison as this was my first ever cheesesteak, but I really enjoyed my meal here, and the experience as a whole. The line moves scarily fast, leaving you almost no time to prepare yourself to say "Whiz wit" (with onions) or "Whiz wit-out" (without onions) and to get your money ready (CASH ONLY). You get your sandwich within 5 seconds, and then you're on your way to pick up napkins, hot peppers, utensils, etc. 

As for the cheesesteak itself, the meat was a liiiittle on the dry side, but the slathering of warm gooey CheezWhiz makes up for it. I wasn't feeling adventurous enough to try the hot peppers, but my friends swear by them. I really liked the texture of the bread and the fact that it wasn't soggy, but actually still had a slight crisp to it. The cheesesteak is also just the right size -- enough to make me plenty full, but not to the point of bursting at my seams. 

I'd like to come back and try Geno's out JUST so I can compare the two, but Pat's has definitely made an awesome impression in my books.
The food was low quality. Not really any authentic Mexican food. The service was good though.

Not much of a cheese steak place. Food is bland and service is slow. That shouldn't surprise anyone though since they are flamboyant liberals. 
Go across the street to Geno's- better food, better service and better atmosphere. Lower prices too.

Walk up tell them what you want and the make it super quick I got my steak in less than a minute. I got the cheesesteak with onions and wiz, The bun was fresh they give a generous amount of meat and cheese. Parking is scarce, it's cash only they have a bar across the street that has a ATM, and last thing don't get intimidated by the line it goes quick.

WORST Breakfast Biscuit sandwich EVER!  I love my fast food breakfast, but this was not actually edible.  I took two bites and was grossed out by the taste and texture.  Staff was very pleasant, and their chicken nuggets are great, but their breakfast is awful!!
Great customer service I come here from a bit swat not only for food but the staff is great and courteous
I won't bore you with some long winded review about this place, it has 1,400 others if you care for the details. Pat's wins, Gino's is good but, my homemade cheese steak is better than both.

I came here because of such high ratings on yelp and i needed to try this while i'm in philly. Geno's cheesesteak was right next to this one. Waited around 10 minutes and was up for order. 

You have to choose wit or without onions and the kind of cheese you want, either American, Provolone or Wiz. The order came out fast, you then slide your steak to the next window where you order your drink. The cheesesteak was around 9+ and the soda was 2.25. You will be lucky if you can find a seat here. It was in the 90s when I came here so i do not prefer the outside seating. 

The meat was really dried and rough. There wasn't enough cheese mixed in there. The soda doesn't have any gas, tasted like water. This place is overrated, I've had better.

what's a trip to philly without a stop at pat's (and then at geno's) for a cheesesteak eat-off. but for me, a philly cheesesteak is really more of a bucket list type of activity since ultimately, they really aren't that great (fully expect to get some blow back from the city of brotherly love).

but for the cheesesteak itself, i'm all about the whiz. i LOVE whiz. it moistens up the bread, complements the 'spiciness' (not much here since the added peppers didn't really add too much heat), and clogs arteries. what's not to love?

ultimately, bucket list checked. as for the competition, i'd have to give a slight edge to pat's if for no other reason than it seemed a bit more whizzy.
The best cheesesteaks by far in the country. They invented it, they perfected it, they are the reason Philadelphia has a cheesesteak. The best I've ever had! Delicious!!!!!!

Pros: If Geno's busy and line is long then you can come here. You can also compare philly cheesesteak sandwiches with Geno's. 

Cons: lots of flies by the seating area. Cost a $1 more for philly cheesesteak sandwich than Geno's. Not flavorful.

First time in my life I have received a text from a restaurant the next day regarding a negative review of a spot, based on their bad food.  

Ordered from this spot via Grubhub.  A cheesesteak with mushrooms, asked for it to be toasted.  No mushrooms, not toasted.  I got a notification from Grubhub to leave a review, so I did. 

In the pictures you will find a screenshot of the text I received.

Also, they don't have to worry about me ordering again, as the cheesesteak was better fit for a wild dog.




He knows it's real as he texted me.  A lot of similar reviews speaks volumes.  Sure second chances are great and all, you don't always get one though, and if the order is wrong the first time, the customer has a right to leave a bad review.  The restaurant can then learn and move on, or address it as a sincere apology to the customer asking for a second chance, but borderline harassing text messages are 100% inappropriate always.  And at 3am when ordering a cheesesteak, and it shows up an hour later, on time but still an hour later, I'm not going to send it back and give you a second chance to fix it.  Unbelievable and unacceptable.  This guy is a fraud.  Hopefully anyone considering this place will take notice to these very real reviews.

I'd be more skeptical of the 5 star reviews on here, as those probably are fake.  Good day all.

Absolute waste of money. Not only was the staff rude, but he couldn't even bother to put the top on the blender to properly blend the smoothie. Threw it away after 2 sips of kale chunks and artificial flavoring. 

Attached are photos of the strawberry banana kale smoothie... disgusting

I couldn't go to Philadelphia and not have a cheesesteak. With that said we made our way over to Pat's. With a long line that moved quickly and a decent amount of outdoor seating, we decided to eat. There is a special method to ordering your sandwich. I had mine with cheese and grilled onions. I'm not entirely sure on the quality of meat they use but overall my sandwich was good. Between my cheesesteak, side of fries, and an ice tea, I was straight for the rest of the night!!! Pat's may not be the best cheesesteak but I would certainly eat here again.

Awesome Cheese Steak Sandwich and Fries.....! 

I ordered a cheese steak sandwich and fries having no expectations of quality.  I was just hungry and looked them up on Yelp.  They were close to were I lived, 1.6 miles. 

I have only been here once and will return again.  If you have ever been to Philly.  You know that the two most popular tourist locations to visit for a cheese steak is either Pat's or Genos.  Ironically, they are located directly across the street from one another. I have been to both and this place made me a cheese steak that was the closest to either one of these Philly establishments.  However, to all of you that do not know.  There is a way to order a cheese steak sandwich (not a steak and cheese).  Please see the attached photo from Pat's Famous Cheese Steaks!  Thank you!

And they're much cheaper that Pat's too.

What else would I get while in Philly? 

I am in town visiting and the only thing I wanted in Philly was a Philly Cheesesteak. I've heard great things about Pat's and decided this was a must-do on the trip. 

The Philly cheesesteak was delicious, I got it topped with provolone cheese and a side of fries. It definitely hit the spot. 

However, parking was very hard to find, the line was long, and once I got to the window I felt very rushed and overwhelmed as I have never been before. It is also cash only so be prepared!

This is my first trip to Philadelphia and I went over to Pat's to find out what all the hoopla was about with the cheesesteaks. Now initially I intended to try them and the other guys across the street. But after what my Uber driver told me, I decided to take a break and also make a post on FB hands down everyone agreed Pats is better. I was very happy with my cheesesteak wit onions and provolone though I know I'm supposed to get cheese wiz. The service was fast and the sandwich was great. Maybe next time. Check it out if you are in the area. If you have a group maybe do both spots, see what you think.
Nice location with ample parking. The employees can be more preoccupied with gossip on occasion but that may be to steam the monotony of the job.
Wow!! What an experience! Pat's never fails to deliver the goods with the yummy goodness. Haven't been here in months. That will definitely change. The cheesesteaks and fries are still to die for.

Went for happy hour which unfortunately ended earlier that we thought, 4-6pm. It's hard to get any happy hour info on their website. Drink specials sucked. Drinks bought on regular menu were horrible. A michelada was one of the worst I ever had. Their margaritas tasted good, but when I wanted to use don julio or patron instead of the house vodka, they wanted $18 for a glass, which is robbery. If a saving grace was the food, could have given more stars, but I was simply not impressed. Everything was just ok. Only thing I really liked was the plantains. The 2 stars for location, nice outdoor area and nice servers.

It takes 30-45 minutes for an order of a burrito, a taco, and a chalupa. Wtf. This is not for delivery. I could only imagine what delivery times are like. 


I go to Taco Bell enough to know a bad one when I see one. The food is bad for you. I never feel sick after eating at any other Taco Bell. But whenever I eat at this one I always feel sick. Either they're letting the meat sit out too long or just not cooking it properly, whatever it is I would avoid this place. 

Hands down the worst Taco Bell I've been to.
This place has the best hot wings. Especially after you just got done clubbing and need some quick food to satisfy your tummy.

I love how the workers here are super friendly! Also love the concept of being able to build your own - you can get really creative! You can get as many toppings as you want and the workers are really accommodating even if you aren't sure exactly what to order!

Very, very solid Fried Chicken sandwich store located at the base of an apartment building right next to a Panera. Price is super decent; taste is pretty amazing with a good home-feel touch to it. I'll probably definitely come back at one point to try their other sandwiches and rice dishes. Plenty of parking around, and you can order ahead. It is also a mixed mini-convenience store (w/ an Asian emphasis) as well, so that's pretty awesome. I guess the only bad thing I can say about it is that the front door/area is entirely infested with Lanternflies; it's definitely not their fault right now since the species basically took over the city, but it was almost impossible to walk through the entrance without being scared for your life.

What's not to love? A historic walk up cheesesteak joint in a residential Italian neighborhood, open 24 hours and cheap. These steamy meat sandwiches are fantastic, soft hoagie rolls and deli wrapped so well. You gotta decide, Witwiz or Witout. There's a pickled peppers bar and outdoor seating.
Put this place on your list.

Taste ****
Quality/Freshness *****
Presentation/Uniqueness ****
Service *****
Atmosphere *****
Bar
Cleanliness ****
Price $$

The service and quality of drinks/food here have gone steadily downhill.  The last 3 times I've brought friends for food and drink, the experience has been poor to miserable.  The last time, this past July, my friend and I sat at a table without any utensils or water or greetings from staff. When I asked a passing waiter for service, he seemed annoyed and sent a waitress, who gave us utensils and said she be "right back with those waters." We were kept waiting again, so finally we left. (The patio was not at all crowded.) Another time 3 of us got our chips, salsa and water, but after putting in our order waited a long time. When I finally told the hostess, our waitress told us she forgot to put our order in.  No apology, and when the food came it was lukewarm. The 3rd time the service was ok, but the pitcher of margaritas was so water-down that we wondered if there was tequila in it. Anyway, the patio look great and it keeps growing, but because of the poor service and mediocre food I won't be returning or offering it up to friends as a great place for Mexican, especially with so many other, better choices for Mexican or Spanish cuisine.   I think it is revealing the it is very difficult (impossible even?) to get any contact info for managers or owners.

There's a reason why Pat's calls themselves the King.  
This was our final stop of our Cheesesteak tour before going to the game at Citizens Bank Park.   

Parking is a pure nightmare.  It's wedged in a triangle with Geno's, a huge park and then houses and apartments.  I circled four times before we finally got lucky. 

REHEARSE TO YOURSELF WHAT YOU WANT. There's a big board telling you how to order and where to order.  Steaks at the first window and fries and drinks at the next window.  They have zero tolerance for us tourists.  Hahahahaha.

I got a wiz wit for my wife and I to share and a wiz witout for the kids.  Only gripe is they didn't cut it in half.  I had to rip it in half like a caveman in the car.  Did I had to ask for it to be cut? I honestly don't know...

It's part of the Philly atmosphere that we all love. 

Now the sandwich.  By far the cheesiest, which I love.  The steak quality was great and the way it was chopped was actually perfect.  Just enough... not super fine like some places.  Onions complimented this sandwich perfectly and as I already stated,  the cheese wiz was flowing. 

Make sure you eat your sandwich around back where Gazzo gave Rocky the money to train.  Great history with a great sandwich.
Tourists are the only people who think this place is good.  So many outsiders who have no clue about what a great cheesesteak tastes like.

Sometimes they serve adequate McDonalds food. Other times they forget to blend your mcflurry and forget that French fries are supposed to have salt dumped on them. Then when you ask the lady working the window for some salt for the fries she stares at you like she's high as a kite and you just asked her for the recipe for world peace.

The food here is great but customer service is not. It was a really hot day and we asked to be sat in the shade, where there were ample empty tables (around 3:30pm... not even a rush) and were instead put on the sidewalk in direct sunlight. When we asked, we were told that area "is shaded." It was not. Our table was separated from the main dining patio by a gate, so our server rarely came to check on us. Fair warning - the food was yummy but the cost was high. It was around $40 for an app, entree and a drink. We would have stayed longer if we weren't sweating so much!

I would go to this place for drinks or happy hour. I usually get a burrito and make it wet, because I can't help myself, always satisfying.  Obviously that doesn't usually translate to great delivery. There are often specials and I usually try them and am not disappointed last time I went I had a consommé that was delicious and a tasteful gazpacho. Can get a little more pricey than what I would want to pay for a burrito when there are cheaper more authentic places close by at the Italian Market. Before Covid, I often just drank here and had chips and dips.

Food was great in taste and size. Cashier who was skinny, with beard was extremely rude. He had no manners in regards to how he spoke to me and what he said. I am out of town and I was having  a bit of a hard time ordering and I told him this and he told me that he didn't care if I was out of town or not and that I should know what I am getting. So food was good and service was bad. On the other hand the cook at Pat's was real nice and helped me out with my order.
My son ordered a Mc chicken sandwich yesterday through DoorDash and this is what he got. Someone definitely needs to be fired. Never again will we order from here.

Iconic yes. Great cheesesteaks no! Don't even bother. Better than Geno's across the street though. 
We did a road trip from DC to Philly for a cheesesteak tour and Pat's was suggested. Maybe at some point before they got so popular they may have been good...well they lost their touch.
Their fries were good though!
Oh and it's cash only...

The snake casserole is a tasty treat. Barely has that snake bite after taste that you get with most snake. The cow muscle is especially good with cheese wiz. We had the udder milk with cheese wiz and it was the highlight of our trip to philadelphia.

The third Wendy's review:

This Wendy's so far is my favorite out of the ones I frequent. While I may be influenced by the fact it is a short 2 minutes away from school and a great escape from the zoo that is Germantown Friends, I still believe this is a premiere Wendy's location. (Imagine that, in Germantown!)

While this Wendy's is clean, quiet, safe, I don't ever have to deal with my blood pressure going up as it usually does with a fast food restaurant. The service is also amazing for a Wendy's. The cashier is able to communicate in English with no accent, they are quick to receive the order and press the buttons, and nothing ever goes wrong.

Finally, a Wendy's that doesn't make me want to leave the USA because of the horridness of what America has become.
This Wendy's is safe, and good in my book.

I knew what to expect when came here and I got exactly that. A greasy ass cheesesteak (this one covered in provolone). I came for the experience. I did not like it and was assured that there are actually really good cheesesteak places nearby, but I just couldn't eat anything else. Come here for the history and be prepared to get covered in grease. Glad I went, but I have no intention of returning when back in PA.
I expect great things here but prefer Geno's accross the street. PS: check out The Garage Bar next to Geno's! It's B.Y.O. Cheesesteak!!!

I enjoyed my cheesesteak with wiz $11. Super fast and made to order. Only outside seating but there was a bunch of tables. Parking was sooo annoying though, if you drive around long enough you'll find something, hopefully. We parked about half a mile away and walked. Not in the best area. We did feel like the pats cheesesteak was the best, the meat tasted good and the cheese wiz was nice and hot. Good ratio of meat to wiz. Cash only!

Went there at 11am on a Sunday.  Thought the place was abandoned, no signs of life.  Happy that the door opened, I went in and ordered.  The woman who took my order stared blankly at me when I told her someone forgot to turn on the open signs.  She called someone (I thought) to turn the signs on, but she needed that other person to sign into the register.  I told her again that the open sign was not on, and she barely acknowledged that I said anything.  She didn't give me a cup to fill my soda, had to wait for my order.  I thanked her, she did not thank me back, I think it was a grunt if anything.  Rude.  Every table had a film of some sort on it, and was dirty.  Two managers were talking in the corner, I did not feel comfortable telling them how dirty and disgusting their store was.  Carpet needs replacing.  I will never go there again, nasty.

This McDonald's is so funny it's like a comedy routine. Seriously, go here if you have all the time in the world and aren't really hungry. First of all, their drive-thru speakers are broken--and have been for a long time--so you have to roll up to the window to give your order. Not the first window, the second window--no one is manning the first window apparently. If there are two cars in front of you, this will take at least 15 to 20 minutes. If you go inside, you'll be greeted by an almost-unmanned counter with one person appearing occasionally to take an order. The manager (I assume) occasionally floats in and out of the scene. He looks like  a real peach to work for.

I haven't tried using the bathroom here. I guess that'll be my adventure for next time.
They will never get your order right. I don't even know why I come to this location anymore because I regret it every time

PLEASE!!! there is a reason this place only has 2 stars!!!  Placed an order over an hour ago that never arrived. Cleared up the confusion about the address about 30 minutes after the diver called to say he was outside. 36minutes after receiving the correct address food still did not arrive. When I called the store to ask about the order I was basically told that it was my fault my order hadn't arrived and that I was now the last order. He was very rude and made sure to push all blame on me even though a good 40minutes had passed at this point with the diver having the correct address. When I asked to speak to someone over him he responded by saying there is no one above him other than god he then continued to fuss at which point I was over it. Please do not give this place your business.
Worst customer service I've ever encountered. I have went there multiple times because it's in my area and every time it gets worse and worse
Great prices, good food, chill vibes. Service was great. Recommend the mushroom empanadas and chorizo tacos

Brazilian style boneless fried chicken

Clean, fast, friendly service. 

Food was really good. 

The only thing that I can complain about is that the food was not super fresh but I suspect that this is part of the growing pains of being a brand new business less then a week old. 

They are opening a location closer to my house and I suspect if they are half as good as this location I will be there a lot.

This has to the worst Burger King in the city with the dumbest employees who don't follow not a damn instruction ... don't eat here it's the worst ... Easton Rd Burger King is way better .... This place need to shit down ASAP

Well my Chick-fil-A sandwich was good and standard quality BUT service was lacking... Down South you are always greeted with a smile and positive attitude... it's one of the best (besides chicken sandwich) qualities that I about Chick-fil-A... Not even a please, thank you, have a good day, have a safe flight... nothing... if I was dealing with a robot I would even expect better mannerisms... Highly disappointed in the way this establishment is being ran. They are not even using the systems that are in place at other stores.

Always good. Easy to order for pickup. Consistently delish!!! 

I get mine with American cheese, peppers and onions !
Stay away. Slow   Lethargic. Rude people. I had plenty of time to get my flight   Until I came here

Came around 10pmish. My boyfriend and I flew in from California and wanted to try this place. The line was quick and the service was fast. We got our Philly cheesesteak and it was the moment of truth. My boyfriend wanted to come to this place for his birthday from CA to try the famous Philly cheesesteak. Let me tell you--this place did not disappoint. The bread was nice and toasty, the cheese was warm, the meat was tasty, and the overall experience a memorable one. Highly recommend!
Horrible!!! Worst cheesesteak place ever!!!!!!!!!!! I what is it supposed to be King of because it's definitely not the cheesesteaks.  ABSOLUTELY gross!

Solid cheese steak! You order at a window (and you must order quick) and it's cash only. I got regular cheese steak wit wiz and onions. Tasted really good. I wanted to order with provolone but the guy at the cashier was speaking so fast I couldn't change it. (Hence the: please know your order and say it quick). They literally give it to you in seconds which I thought was absurd (but must be nice granted the volume of customers they get). 

Bread was really nice. Cheese complimented the steak nice and the cut of steak & marination was good too! Lots of seating which was a plus. Overall, for my first in Philly cheese steak, I was satisfied!

Rudest service I've ever encountered even before I could order. Just walked out of there cuz they weren't worth my time. I ate chipotle instead and I don't even like chipotle. 0/10 

If blaze reads this you should highly consider firing Nat

this mcdonalds is rlly rlly bad. I ordered nuggets and fries.... the fries were like cold leather and the nuggets were also very cold. I waited in a long drive thru line so usually when u wait a long time it's because they are cooking fresh food???? so i waited because i was like i KNOW these fries are gonna be good since it's so busy. I worked at mcdonald's or a long time and when it was busy we were back there cooking fresh food so it was hot for all the waiting customers. nope not today and not at this mcdonalds. honestly save yourself the money and drive an extra mile to a different mcdonalds because this isn't worth ur $7. oh and i got the wrong sauce

Umm, I've had better cheesesteaks in California. It was greasy and expensive. The cashier was rude and frustrated by customers. Too expensive. Best thing about it was bread. I do not understand why this is "famous".

Ordered from these guys last night via Seamless. As a NYC transplant, not having access to late night munchies is heartbreaking. Enter Night Owls Fast Food. Delivery was shockingly fast, the chicken tenders I ordered were perfectly crispy and juicy, and the french fries remained crispy (which is hard to do with delivery). Prices were very reasonable. Will definitely be ordering from them again for any late night munching needs.

Amazing spot! I love coming here! Staff is great, food is amazing, margaritas are delicious--I've got nothing bad to say about this place.  
I come to this spot regularly and am never disappointed. 
I love it for brunch, drinks, casual dinner, and outdoor sitting in summer.
P.S. Folks who leave poor reviews, stop making up stuff; this place is great and you know it!

They were super nice BUT my provolone wasn't even melted and the steak was cold... fries were good but that's it. We drove from NY to try a Philly cheesesteak and with Geno's across the street  we choose wrong

I visited today, since Pat's is literally right across from Geno's. We wanted to try a variety. Pat's is a CASH only establishment and all prices include the tax already. We ordered a philly cheese steak no onions, but with whiz cheese. The cost of our sandwich was $11. We also order a small cup of french fries which was $5 dollars. I forgot to take a picture, but the appearance was not too kosher. I liked the fact that the bag where it was packaged was in a wax paper like bag and you couldn't see the grease seep through.  We took our sandwich back to the hotel to make the comparisons. We cut the sandwich in three  equal pieces and split the fries. My first bite was from Pat's. Pat's philly sandwich, the thin slices of meat were seasoned and very tender, bread soft and chewy in texture, cheese gooey making the sandwich a perfect combination. Let's talk about the fries, the fries were not very crunchy, somewhat soggy. I really didn't eat them only had 3 pieces. 
At the end, my kids and I made a unanimous vote and the clear winner was Pat's. I believe that the wiz cheese  was the winner ingredient and the glue to the sandwich. If you come to Philly no doubt visit Pat's. (I want another sandwich!!) Lol

I'm so grateful that I have Jason's Toridasu in my building and is open during these difficult times. 
I get chicken burger mostly and sometimes the chicken rice bowl. They taste incredible and the portions are massive that each burger serves as two meals for me. I love this place so much that I end up getting food at least 2-3 times a week from here. You can really taste the good quality of ingredients they use and the sauces...oh my goodness...no words can describe how good they are!!! 
If you like asian snacks and drinks, then you are in luck, they have a wide collection. 
They are so friendly and it's always a pleasure to talk to them.

Their margarita with mezcal was fantastic! In contrast, the fish tacos and mushroom fajita were extremely underwhelming. The mushroom fajita was made with rubbery canned mushrooms. However, it honestly wasn't the food that made me give 2 stars, but rather how dirty the bathroom was. It was pre-Covid dive-bar dirty; urine all over the toilet seat and paper towels overflowing all over the floor. It just had the appearance that it was in no way being maintained or periodically cleaned, which during COVID made me very uncomfortable.

This place is disgusting

He then called up and they advised him that he can get a free replacement. My father did not have time to go back that night or the next day due to working/busy schedule. 

I went with my father today on 1/18/20 

We dealt with Walter a cashier, who was extremely disrespectful, rude and irate and should not be in customer service , he called my father a liar. Walter questioned my father on why he waited so long and demanded a name of the person he spoke to on the phone. 

We finally got a manager after 5 minutes who was unapologetic, insincere and looked like he just woke up from nap and offered us the free meal but we declined due to Walters poor attitude

1. What kind of business prides themselves on such  customer service where they are allowed to hire people that disrespect their customers -it's disgusting. 
2. Second I really don't think I wanted to drive in 3 inches of snow for free chicken that I declined in the end due to horrible customer service. 

Thanks but no thanks

I was so looking forward to trying the salmon cakes. 

Have you've ever had a craving for something only to place an order and receive an incorrect item? Well that's what happened with me. I must say I'm not disappointed.

The delivery service erroneously placed an order for a salmon dinner rather than salmon cakes. I called the restaurant and the person in charge was very nice and advised I should keep the dinner as the wait may take a while and offered to send the correct order. I opted for a credit. I'm not a fan of anyone's salmon but my own. The salmon was so delicious! I also ordered fish bites which were plentiful and delicious as well. 

I look forward to trying more from the menu. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone. Aside from the excellent food, they have good customer service as well which sadly enough, is hard to find these days. I still can't get over how good the salmon is!!! Nice and flavorful and the fish bites.... On point in every way. The picture was taken after some were eaten. Words can't describe how good the food is. No joke!
Visiting Philly for the first time and decided to try out some cheesesteaks. Pat's hands down beats out Geno's. Flavor is on point.

I must have gotten lucky judging by all the naysayers' reviews of this Mickey D's on Cottman Avenue at Roosevelt Blvd., in N.E. Philly. But, rather than being disappointed by its performance, we were actually pleasantly surprised by how good their food and service were. 

We were in a rush to return home after a large shopping excursion to the Asian supermarket nearby, and opted for rapid food from the only drive through in sight. We ordered a quarter pounder w cheese, chicken nuggets, fries and drink, took possession within minutes, and continued our drive home to Bucks County. 

We immediately noticed the heat coming off the fries In the open top paper sack. First sampling was of perfectly done Frenchies - hot, crisp and addicting. The burger was also just off the steel and settling nicely onto the bun. It reached my mouth in optimal condition, with even the onions soft and translucent and the pickle stuck to the cheese so it couldn't fall out. It was like the dream burger from the adverts, except this baby was for real. 

Once in a lifetime! 

Naturally, it wasn't all ideal, as the nuggets had a processed food texture. I knew I was awake. Still, this was as close to amazing as McDonalds ever gets, and the moment required recognition. 

Now that we know it can be done, why should anyone settle for any less?

Okay this place takes FOREVER.. the food is okay- it's McDonalds. Haven't had any problems w the food but make sure you pack a lunch, plenty of water, and full tank of gas for the Drive-thru line. It's ridiculous most times I'm there.  LONG wait. I don't know if they're short staffed.. maybe they're slaughtering the animals on the premises.. No idea.  What I do know is the wait here, is longer than most McDs.. and consistently longer. If you have some time.. wait. If not, head down Ridge pike.

I've been here several times and Pat's always takes the prize as far as I'm concerned. 


Pat's! Pat's! Pat's!

Blaze Pizza really knocked my socks off - it hits all the markers of a great pizza shop: delicious food, plentiful drinks, reasonable prices, gorgeous interior, and super-friendly staff. 

Blaze is located in the beautiful new University City building, and has the vibrant pulse of the Drexel college community around it. As soon as you walk in, you see the colored window panes that accentuate this modern restaurant.

As soon as I walked in, I heard a cry out of welcome; there was about 5 people ahead of me in line, and the counter lady apologized to me for the wait (which wasn't a very long wait at all). She greeted me like I'd been here a hundred times before, and was more than happy to help me customize the pizza along every inch of the way. 

You start off by identifying whether you would like to start with one of Blaze's pre-ordained signature pies or to start from scratch. Regardless of which you choose, you can customize a pie with every single thing that you'd like (as many toppings as you'd like are included in the price). 

Blaze bakes the pie in a great wood-fired oven for 5 minutes, as you proceed to pay for your order and wait. When your name is called, the person asks if you'd like any particular drizzles to top off your pizza, and you either get it to go or chow down at any of the tables in Blaze's two-level restaurant.

I started off with the Red Vine signature pie, and proceeded to add all the things that would make the perfect meal for me. The crispy crust is very thin, and has such a delightful char from the wood-fired oven, which is great for those that prefer it and for us carb-concious folks!

And it must be said: the pies really are as delicious as they look - and don't they just look like they came right out of a professional food publication?!! 

There is a drink station there with a great mix of sodas, teas, and uniquely flavored options (such as matcha, pineapple, etc. which vary), and you can refill as many times to the content of your belly!

You can't really expect parking around here, being in the congested heart of the universities, but there are only two Blaze Pizza restaurants around - and I highly recommend that you find a way to get to experience one of them, when you are in the mood for pizza.

Greatest cheesteak ever . I love stopping here on my way to the Jersey shore. I live in central PA and have taken a few trips to Philly just for pats. Cool staff always . Best cheesesteak and fries by far !
Yo this food is disgusting !!!! Pleassseee don't ever come here! I bought a burger from here and I swear it wasn't real meat. Worst fast food place I've ever been to in my life

Yesterday I had a half of each a Geno's & a Pat's cheese steak, and split it with my brother.

We ordered a Wiz without at both places. Now I have been a loyal Geno's guy for years but my loyalty is wavering.

Pat's was chopped up and I could taste the flavor! The rolls and the whiz were both a wash, both tasting just as good. Pat's Wiz without cost $9.50, I  guess the 50 cents was worth the flavor, when in the area the next time I am gonna go to Pat's King of Steak's to try a whole Wiz with and then I will make my final decision.

Geno's is not chopped and had more fat on it. It was also not as meaty! It was also kind of blah!  Price of a Geno's Wiz Without $9.00, for me I would rather spend the 50 cents and be satisfied.  

Both have outside seating, so make sure to dress according to the weather. Also at both places you order your steak at the first window and your drinks and fries at the second window.  Also make sure you have cash because both places do not accept plastic.

I must add that John's Roast Pork makes a far superior cheese steak, and that you should try theirs instead. Both Pat's & Geno's are riding on their reputation and is really just a big tourist trap.

I will give Pat's 4 Stars & Geno's 3!
This place is so hit or miss. I have ordered the same items multiple times. When it's good, it's really good and when it's not, it's completely inedible. Wish it were more consistent.

After reading horror stories about irate Italians driving people away for placing a cheesesteak order incorrectly (I kept thinking of Seinfeld's soup-Nazi), I was mildly apprehensive. As I was nearing the end of the 30 minute line, my pulse quickened as I tried to remember whether I was supposed to proclaim my cheese preference before or after stating that onions should be included. But apparently it was extremely overblown, because all of the self-proclaimed cheesesteak experts (and there are a lot of these idiots out there on the world wide interwebs) made a bigger deal out of ordering a cheesesteak than was necessary. I yelled "1 WHIZ WIT, AND 1 PROVOLONE WIT!" at a higher octave than planned in my head, handed over $20, got my change, and within 10 seconds, was left holding two sandwiches while looking around stupidly for my friend to pull up with his car. 

But I digress from what really matters: the cheesesteak. I always thought that if Chester the Cheetah had diarrhea, it would look like cheese whiz, so I'd always take the safe (albeit delicious) route of Provolone. But I figured, "what the hell, let's see what the big deal is." I was pleasantly surprised. The whiz worked nicely with the sandwich, oozing in all its neon glory into the meat, and adding the right amount of cheesiness without overpowering it. The meat was hot, flavorful, but somewhat tough when compared to other cheesesteak establishments that I've been to. The bread; honestly, I don't remember anything about it. Overall, my impressions were that the sandwich was filling, warm, and delicious, although the chewy meat, long wait time, and somewhat steep price for what is effectively a medium sized sandwich geared toward tourists from New Jersey (everyone in front of me had the accent) keeps it from being perfect. I know there's better out there, but I left Pat's feeling satisfied and if that doesn't deserve some stars I'm not sure what does.

I didn't do a side by side comparison with Geno's, as recommended by so many people. I refuse to try Geno's because: (1) Geno's looks incredibly garish (like the worst of what Vegas has to offer), (2) Yelpers (Yelpees? Yelps? What are they called?) on average think it's crap compared to Pat's, and (3) the incredible ignorance of the establishment refusing to serve anyone who doesn't speak in English annoys me.

Giving 4 stars for the the whole experience not the sandwich alone.  Got the rude "hurry up and order" service I was expecting being a tourist.  Ordered the steak wit Whiz and onions.  Sandwich was a 3/5.  A little dry and bread was kind of tough.  I've made better myself (thanks YouTube!) Definitely more of a tourist destination.  Want a better Philly then head over to South St.

This location has recently undergone renovation and it looks great. Unfortunately, the same unruly children are still working behind the counter. The girl says, "Can I help you?" I give my order, but she can't listen to it AND scream at her coworker at the same time. She finishes her shrieking and turns back to me and again asks, "Can I help you?" I give her my order a second time. Another young woman accidentally knocks a small, empty cup onto the floor, then picks it up and PUTS IT BACK for the next person who orders a small drink. I hope you like botulism with your Sprite. The manager needs to go back to Hamburger University or some shit, because their staff is a disgrace.
Fantastic vibe all around and wonderful food and drinks! They have the best mojitos and margaritas and are great for large parties.

Pat's isn't great. But it is DEFINITELY better than Geno's. The steak has more flavor and it isn't dry, unlike its competitor. I ordered the cheese whiz wit, and it was fine. However, for a place that's supposedly known for its cheesesteaks, they need to step up their game. Maybe it's the bread - it's pretty chewy. That could also be due to the fact that we visited at midnight and maybe the bread was stale by then. But if you're going to be a 24 hour establishment, you better make sure to find away to keep that bread fresh. The quality should be consistent. I wouldn't go out of my way to come here, but if I was in the area, I wouldn't mind grabbing a sammie from here.

*Tip - cash only

I wish I loved this place more but to me it's nothing too special.

The pizza is a nice thin crust pizza made in house. It's a great set up where you can go down the line and have a variety of sauces, cheese, meat and vegetable toppings which are all unlimited.

As for the taste, you make it what is it! So if you have a preference of what you like or what you're feeling it's a great place to go. For me, there is nothing wrong with it but not my first choice when choosing to eat Pizza.

Oh my goodness what a cool little old school neighborhood greasy spoon complete with owner (I think it was the owner) telling corny jokes. Apparently this is the home base of the 'Jeet' food truck. I was in South Philly so I got the cheese steak Italian, seeded roll, broccoli rabe and sharp provolone. According to my daughter, Karly I'm the only person in the world that didn't know sharp provolone had such a distinctive taste. I am still not sure if I'm a broccoli rabe fan but this broccoli rabe had a lot of flavor. Sorry but I could only give this cheesesteak a score of 89. It was full of flavor and I now completely understand how people can be happy sitting around eating a seeded roll and provolone cheese but it was $11 and it just needs to be bigger and the meat has to improve. Does broccoli rabe always have the more stalk than leafing parts? Very good overall experience and I wouldn't hesitate to go back for breakfast.
Over Rated. There are some much better cheesesteaks around Philly (Steve's Prince of steaks, Jim's, Wit or Wit-Out).

20 bucks gets you 2 lukewarm steak sandwiches with flavorless dry meat. I guess I fell for the tourist trap. I've had way better steak sandwiches in Los Angeles for less money. The place is open 24/7, cash only, street parking.
Absolutely best cheese steak, fast service, you see a line but don't be worried moves super fast!  This place has master the science of pleasing there customers.. oh and don't be afraid of the wiz

I came to terms that poke in the US is not comparable to what you're going to find in Hawaii. Given this adjustment, I went into philly poke with an open mind. The price is comparable to what you will find in city - basically unjustifiable unless you're really craving raw fish with rice. 

I found the freshness or quality of the fish unremarkable. It's not very fresh but good enough. I wish they took out the sinew (the white fibrous lining) in the fish. The best way to distinguish a good poke establish from the not so good is by the color and quality of the fish. Good poke should melt in your mouth and doesn't need much dressing to enhance the taste. 

With all the poke establishments in the area, I don't know how to pick on over the other especially since the quality is relatively the same. I'll probably go to the one with the friendly/more attentive service.

Cantina is kind of a mainstay at this point, for non-authentic Mexican.
I never have a problem getting a table for food, a table comes with free chips and salsa, and they offer vegan versions of all dairy things (although it's an upcharge of $3 PER dairy free thing, be careful how accepting you are of the enthusiastic staff's offer to veganize things). 
I do hate parking around here. It's awful, and competitive, and more than once not being able to take transit instead has kept me from suggesting going here for dinner. If you're driving, plan to leave padding for hunting and then walking from a parking space accordingly.

We have been coming here for quite some time, and for good reason! The place is very nice inside and has a good happy hour. 

We ordered the Mexican corn, seitan wings (BBQ and Buffalo Habanero), seitan salad, and the rice and bean burrito. 

The corn was very good. It's corn on the cob sprinkled with spices and seasonings. The wings were delicious. My wife enjoys the salad a lot and usually gets it. I had the burrito and it was good. It was a little busy in here for dinner during the week, but I wish they were a little quicker on their service. Drink refills, or anything else we needed took a bit to get a server. 

All in all this is a place we would come back to!

We live in bucks county, but when we are in town we make a point of coming here. Today it was raining and they were on a wait. The hostess Sheridan, was the highlight of our visit. She was welcoming, friendly and polite. Food and drinks are amazing as always! Thanks again! We will be back

Keeping it Simple...
Steak with onion and whiz- 2.5 stars.  I've had much better, even in South Florida
Service- 0.000 stars.  When the hot sauce dispenser got clogged and then shot out over my wife's shirt (was not a pretty site).  My wife asked for a cup of water or ice to help with the staining and some punk a__  kid behind the counter refused her and wanted to charge her $4.  Way to go on the service side!!!  I'm a foodie, take my word for this -There are better Philly subs around town and in other states, and for service this place gets a BIG FAT ZERO.   Look out for my article in the paper soon.

Can't remember the last time this location got my order correct. The last two times I've been missing half my food and all my sauces. Your staff is rude and doesn't care. Your uber eats orders are never right. If this is a franchise, the owner should be ashamed.

This spot is real close to my apartment and never fails to satisfy the pizza craving. LeBron James really did good investing in Blaze and business planning because he knows what I want! Great ingredients and freedom to adorn my pizza however I desire for a deal! Look forward to their reopening. The team that works here are mostly up for a chat and are fun. As a Yelp rule, please don't expect every service worker to be "friendly" to you. They're just doing their jobs. (I've seen some crazy Yelp reviews from the Karens out in the world going after workers who they perceive as unfriendly or "mean" and calling corporate on them. Calm down.) Also, don't be that Karen or Ken that demands every topping be on that thin dough base. But if you're that obnoxious human being, tip the staff generously!!
No social distancing practiced during the pandemic. Clerk at counter said store had no limit and to fill it up when there was no room to stay 6' apart. He was very rude about it too the end.

This place was such a horrible experience coming into. I was in line ordering my food when i over heard the manager on duty using profanity and using Derogatory language on the floor to his employees around 6:38pm on 11/18/19 and i was offended because he was using the word "faggot" towards his employees and I'm a member of the LGBT community and this type of behavior is totally unacceptable and professional.

It was ok... Me and a coworker/friend went to the Green Hills for a business trip and decided to stop here after our flight landed before we went to our hotel about an hour out for the night. The guy at the airport recommended Pat's and said it's the best in Philly. Not too sure about that.

The line was pretty long which was too be expected, Geno's was as well. The Eagles Cowboys game had just finished and of course the Eagles lost... so the fans were on edge while waiting in line. I would say we got to the order window in about 25 to 30 minutes. They have a pretty strict policy about knowing how to order and knowing what you want when you get to the front.. obviously.. they want the line to stay moving. I get it. 

The particular time we went they were out of nacho cheese which was a disappointment. The cheesesteak tasted just average. It looked average. To wait 30 minutes a cold, long line, it just didn't really live up to the hype for me. Maybe nacho cheese and something else on it would have gotten me to a 4 star but just wasn't to be. And if you're looking for seating then forget about it, you'll be eating it standing up. Or in our case, the parking lot of a CVS on the back of our rental car. Idk if Geno's would have been any different but next time it would be my stop for sure.
The meat is better than Genos. The cheese is less thicker than Genos. The bread was beyond mediocre. I've had a whole lot better. Don't believe the hype. Jersey mikes FTW.

The original but not the best. I got the mushroom cheesesteak wiz wit. I'm neither a big fan of cheese wiz nor onions, but apparently this is the only way to do it in Philly. Pat's hoagie was big, but the beef was skimping and the mushrooms were from the can. I also had a couple bites of inedible tendon. Maybe they saw I was a tourist and wanted to punk me silly. Not worth the $20 round trip cab ride from downtown.

Bland, plain, overpriced, overhyped. Don't waste your time. You can do better in your kitchen. 
There are better, FAR better places to go.

I enjoyed it. 

1) Apparently, this is the spot that came up with the Philly cheese-steak.  
2) I enjoyed the fact they are open 24/7. 
3) Parking is not difficult if you come early.

Horrible, every time gets order wrong or misses part of the order. Sandwich wrapping horrible since it's always partially wrapped and exposed in the brown bag. Ecosure/DOH needs to inspect them again for proper training.
Slow rude service especially with ChikFila right next door. No comparision to there service
These pancakes actually do taste homemade, cooked light and buttery, definitely don't taste like diner cakes. Bravo
I only go here if I'm drunk and desperate. The food is average at best and the price is higher than most other places. Genos is just as bad, both (as Pats would say) a MISTEAK!
Amazing!!! The fish bites are the bomb! The service amazing and welcoming! Desserts are good too. Love y'all!

Oh God, even by McDonald's standards this place is pitiful. From the appearance to the employees and the service right up to the food there is nothing positive that could possibly be said. 

I might have a desire for a nice McDonald's fry once or twice a year, so I'm not a regular by any stretch, but have been here multiple times. Not once, not even close has my experience been gratifying.

Quite frankly it's a crime that this particular establishment is even permitted to stay open for business.

Came here with my girlfriend during quarantine and it was worth the ride 
Although the menu was limited, the philly was great and packed with flavor 
What a great trip up here !

Terribly disappointing. I already had tempered expectations for Pat's and knew there was going to be a big potential for letdown based on what I've heard from my foodie friends, but being in Philly for the first time, I had to try either Pat's or Geno's solely based on how long they've been around and how much I see them on food specials.

I came on a Friday around 2pm, and luckily street parking wasn't too hard to find within a block of Pat's. There was also no line, which took a lot of the pressure off from ordering. Being my first time here, I made it a point to read all the instructions BEFORE ordering. But even then, the guy at the counter was rushing me to get my order. First of all, I'm reading the directions as it says to do so I don't mess up. Secondly, and more importantly, THERE'S NOBODY BEHIND ME. Chill out. There's no need to be rude as I'm not holding up the line. I am the only person in line! Ended up ordering a mushroom cheesesteak with provolone (I'm not a fan of wiz) and a side of fries.

The fries were actually pretty good, but the cheesesteak was rather disappointing. I don't understand why it costs $10. The bun is soggy. The mushrooms were sliced canned mushrooms that were rubbery and flavorless. The steak wasn't generously portioned, and it was overcooked to the point where it was chewy and there wasn't much flavor.

Sometimes even when you feel like you're making a mistake, it's a mistake you have to make for yourself to learn. That was me before coming here. Don't let it be you! Just goes to show you that just because they've been around since 1930 and claim to be one of the first cheesesteaks doesn't mean they're the best. Pat's is nothing more than a foodie tourist trap.

The eternal battle between who has the best Philly Cheesesteak rages on.  Pat's vs. Geno's.  The only 2 contenders.  The rest is just a fake copy.  I personally like Pat's better but like I said it's a personal opinion. Both places have a loyal following that would fight to the death to prove one is better than the other.  Just note, best fast in ordering, extensive lines in the summer and CASH ONLY.

I am still processing how bad my food experience was. I ordered through Doordash, got delivered.

I know the delivery itself can impact the quality of the food, but let me tell you the issue here had nothing to do with delivery. I ordered their guac, their nachos, and a carnitas burrito. Everything was so bad.
  The guac had a very thick dark layer (it probably oxidized) and was kind of runny. I tried it (can't believe I did, knowing it looked like puke) and the taste was the same as a really low grade store bought guac. They must have left their guac out for too long, disgusting.
  The nachos were the most boring nachos, the jalapenos were't even fresh and the taste was giving me no life.
  Finally, the most disappointing was the carnitas burrito. When I tell you they stuffed that baby but forgot how to fold it... I mean for a minute there I thought I might have ordered a taco. The worst part about it was how greasy it was. Ahh, Pat's King of Steaks--the originator and birthplace of the Philly cheesesteak. I actually kickstarted my Philly trip by stopping by Geno's first, but there was no way I was driving home without eating here. My review compares Pat's to Geno's, so read my review of the latter if you'd like a better idea.

LINE/ORDERING:
Pat's system is the same as Geno's (...or is Geno's the same as Pat's?)--line up at the first window to order your cheesesteak, then walk a few feet to your left for drinks and fries. Sandwiches fly out the window within seconds, so don't leave the line until you get your order.

The classic cheesesteak (Cheese Whiz and onions) is called a "Cheese Wit," which is what Tommy (the manager/cashier) relays to the staff. You could also say "Whiz Wit." 

FOOD:
x3 Cheese Wit/Whiz Wit ($10/ea): The sandwiches here are the same size and price, while the ratio of meat-cheese-onions is on point (and perhaps better than Geno's). The main differences, however, are as follows: The bread here is softer, the steak is chopped, you get more steak in your sandwich, the cheese whiz is (for some reason) not as salty, and the sandwich isn't greasy. Taste wise, both places are similar, but I taste more of the (unseasoned) rib-eye here.

We also ordered x2 drinks and an order of fries for $12. The fries here, compared to Geno's, are thicker, larger, and crispier. Good, but again, nothing special about them.

SERVICE: 
Tommy was the one who took my order. He's one of the famous faces at Pat's, and chances are you've seen him on Travel Channel or Food Network episodes featuring this place. He's a cool dude, but don't hold up the line. Learn how to order or at least know what you want by the time you get to the window.

THE BIG QUESTION:
Is Pat's truly the King of Steaks or did Geno's usurp the throne? As much as I'd like to say one is better than the other, I can't. Pat's is famous for many reasons, and Geno's is great in its own right and holds its weight. The sandwiches have their differences with one another, but both are good. All I can say is that the media has done an amazing job building up this fabled cheesesteak rivalry in South Philly. It's done wonders for both Pat's and Geno's and, most importantly, for the popularity of the cheesesteak itself.
Everybody in there was great customer service on point shout out to Darreion doing it for his community oh my guys motherfucker so fuck you follow me

I have gotten great Sushi here in the past. However, tonight I got the Crispy Chicken Burger. I am not exaggerating when I say it was the best sandwich I have ever had.
