They then took a while to make me a double quarter pounder and when I got the bag back I see the box and decide to just drive off and head home. When I got home I open the double quarter pounder and seen that it's missing a patty and it looks like someone had already eaten it. I then unload the entire bag and the double cheeseburgers were still inside and the other box was not nuggets but a buttermilk crispy chicken sandwich.

To be honest majority of the people should not be working there as they look to be under the influence of some type of drugs. The lady looked completely high and cannot remember if she gave me a drink or not. Then a guy who works out back came to the window to call a crackhead over who looks like he was trying to get some drugs decided to squeeze between my car and the drive-thru window rubbing up against my fender and door which I start to feel uncomfortable and not safe. What the mcdonalds worker do not realize is the I have a dashcam that captured the audio and also video of the crackhead walking up beside my car. I would never recommend anyone go to this establishment as you will either get food poisoned or something else bad might happen.

We got this as our monthly item from Goldbelly and we were super happy with how tasty it was. The only catch is in the directions you have to put the whole thing in the oven except the meat doesn't get hit. For our second two weeks just baked the delicious bread and then cooked the meat with some water and oil and onions and peppers. The cheese whiz was kind of weird but we didn't get to pick the type of cheese. It was pretty tasty and we were happy to get some authentic Philly food here in Houston.

Awesome smoothie on the go, staff was helpful and balanced all the ingredients well. A little pricy but everything is fresh and you watch them make it, which is awesome. I get one every time I come to the 30th street station.

okay - bad reviews all around and i understand why. but am giving night owl the benefit of the doubt. 

i ordered food a few weeks ago and it was horribly late, then items were missing -  but, the missing items were brought shortly after the original delivery - with extra "please forgive us" items. 

all of the food was actually really good !! 5am salad that was actually fresh and good ?? yeah - that redeemed the lateness. 

chicken fingers and chicken parm hoagie were very good too. and i was told the cheese cake was great. 

the owner emailed us the next day to apologize and tell us they had staffing issues. hopefully they get this foxed

I'm a born and raised New Yorker, so I can't say I've trekked to all reaches of Philadelphia for a cheesesteak. But from the ones I've tried, Pat's is my favorite, hands down. It might be a little tourist-y to come down to Pat's, but if you've never been, it's worth a try (and in my opinion a re-visit whenever you're in Philadelphia). I was there in Philly yesterday, taking my girlfriend to a few important food spots and started here. An iconic location, at Pat's there's a sign exclaiming its part in the history of the city. Beyond that, walk up and order your cheesesteak, but do it the right way (follow the rules, even though you'll probably survive if you don't). I always get a cheesesteak wit whiz (which means with onions and cheese wiz). I found yesterday's meal just as good as it has been in the past if not better. The steak was tender, the bread soft, and the cheese and onions were hot and juicy creating an overall tasty experience. There are tons of cheesesteak choices in Philadelphia, but I advise you try Pat's at least once because you won't be disappointed.

The first few reviews I saw for this place were positive so I ordered. I wish I had done a little more research. The negative reviews are definitely warranted. The positives are almost surely fake or purchased. 

And so help me if I get a text from this establishment about my review they will wish they hadn't. 

Laughable that I would tip for this place. $10 delivery charge is more tip than is deserved. My food arrived an hour late (with an hour wait time) and cold. 2 whole hours from the time that I ordered! No phone call at any point. Not when they were running late and not when it arrived. Not even worth ordering to prevent a hangover as suggested by one reviewer. You'll end up passing out before the food even gets there.

They posted their hours from 5am-12am currently whic means you would think they'd have people there 4:30 to open prep get things started nope I pull up employees are in the parking lot walking in or smoking cigarettes

given that there are a few other cheesesteaks in the area that are better, i can't rightly give this place anything more than 2 stars. there's nothing about pat's steaks that stand out to me. the meat, cheese, and bread were all subpar compared to their competitors. the only thing i like about this place is that they have the option of a mushroom cheesesteak. +1 for having a mushroom option, but -1 for not tasting better even with the shrooms.

Here's the thing, I have had better cheese steaks, I have had better fries, I have had better everything that Pat's offers on their menu, but the place has been there forever, it is said that they invented the steak sandwich--on a long roll with grilled steak inside. So go there and share a steak sandwich with a friend. Don't get stuffed there, there are so many better places for later.

Pat's is super cool looking, it is a place where you order outside, there is no inside seating. There is outside seating but not a lot, there is no bathroom and parking is a bear. But you can walk to Citizen's Bank Park for a baseball game from there if you want. The building is all silver metal, like a silver lined trailer, sort of. The menu is on the outside and they don't take credit cards so have cash ready. The service is very nice.

Some people order their steak with Cheese Wiz. Now, that is some junk that comes from a can and is put on your sandwich. If you have never had it, I would not even bother to try it. I find it just gross. I don't want cheese out of a spray can. I don't even know if it is real cheese. So, just don't. Yuk. Also, their American cheese is not great. Play it safe and get your steak with Provolone Cheese. That is real.

The meat is cooked well done, which I find boring and it is not great, but it is fine. So, I guess I just told you this place is not very good. It is fine. It is fun. For what it is, and for the adventure of it all, you should go there. It is good and you will be able to say been there done that, moving on. Have fun. It is a cool area.

Pat's is pretty good.  There is no denying that.  You can be around for as long as they have been without being good.  Despite this, I don't think I will be back.

It is expensive.  For a sandwich, drink, and fries it cost me $18.50.  The sandwich was good but nothing special.  The fries were terrible and the drink was just a fountain drink.  Not a value play here at all.

Also, make sure you know your order.  They move very quickly and if your order is not ready they will send you to the back of the line.  

Overall, go once for the experience.  It is something you can you did.  There is no reason to go again.

Not certain as to why all the hateration on this place... Oh well you can't please everyone.

Anyway... Ordered from here for the first time via GrubHub... Had the fierce late night cravings and nothing in my fridge. Recieved my order later that the time given (hence the 4 stars) but the overall experience was just great! Food arrived hot, was packaged nicely and most importantly was tasty! Hello, they're open until 4am! They're on to something here! Will def be ordering from them again!

When in Philadelphia...getting a cheesesteak is a MUST!  But then its the all-time debate of who has the best cheesesteaks...and my pick is always Pat's!  

Upon arrival, there was one barely a line which was great!  There are 2 windows to order from.  One window is to order the cheesesteaks and then the other window to order fries and drinks.  I've been here many times before and already knew my order--whiz wit!  My usual is cheez whiz with grilled onions.  Btw it is cash only so have cash on hand if you plan on grabbing a cheesesteak here.  My cheesesteaks were made in minutes and then moved to the next line to order drinks and cheese fries.  

The cheesesteak tasted great.  The meat was cooked perfectly and was very juicy and that cheez whiz was covered throughout the entire sandwich.  With each bite you can taste the meat, cheese, and grilled onions.  Delicious!  And the cheese fries were covered in cheese....yassss! It was not just a few fries covered in cheese but all of them has cheese!  And you know that never happens at any other restaurant.  

They do have some outdoor seating so you can enjoy eating outdoors.  There is only street parking so just be on the lookout for parking as you approach Pat's.

I loved the steaks from Pats! I am usually a stickler for tradition but the pizza steaks were amazing! They only take cash, so beware when you go - but if you don't have cash on you there is an atm nearby.

First time here after driving by several times. Not sure what all the good ratings are about. I'm a Philly lifer and the pretzels at this place are not good, compared to a true, authentic Phila. soft pretzel from Center City Soft Pretzel or the old Federal Baking Pretzel Co. These were airy, light and had no real taste. Not impressed. 

Also, the miserable middle age woman yesterday at the counter didn't help to make my first impression any better. And there was no mustard out to put on the pretzel. Come on this is Philadelphia! You've gotta have spicy, golden (not yellow) mustard out. So I asked her if they had mustard - without saying a word, she turns around goes to the back and brings the mustard to me with that same nasty, miserable look like I'm crazy for asking for mustard. The only saving grace was the mustard wasn't French's yellow.
Ordered food through Uber Eats at 9:30, driver went to pick food, order was cancelled without reason at 10:20.

I don't know why it's so much negative bullshit on here, but I love this place. Where I live in the city, you guys are the only place I can order from at night since I work late and honestly y'all have the best "fast food" late night in my opinion. Like I agree with that one other guy, build your own curly fries and onion rings like who has that? Cmon y'all gotta cut them a break for dealing with y'all assholes, I always get a call before they arrive and when they get to my house, it's awesome customer service and awesome food. You can't blame someone for defending their business and livelihood.

Probably the worst Popeyes I've ever been to purely because of the customer service. The lady behind the register (darker girl with a flower tattoo on her arm) was so rude and rolled her eyes when we asked for mustard and ranch. Then when we asked for a water cup she refused to give us one because "this location doesn't do that" which I'm 99% sure is illegal to refuse water to paying customers like that. We also heard her raise her voice at the customer behind us too. Never coming to this location again. Would rather drive the extra couple miles.

This was probably the most disappointing food I have ever eaten.  Pats came highly recommended as the place with the best cheesesteaks.  I got there and was so excited to taste them and I felt so let down.  The meat tasted like it was boiled in water without adding any spices or seasoning.  What a waste of time and money.

Delicious little hole in the wall. Service was very pleasant!! We came from Dover Delaware to pick up my sister from the airport and decided to stop for a philly cheese steak and definitely well worth the stop! :)

Popped in here for the first time in my life after a night of drinking to see what the craze was about and I left neither satisfied or unsatisfied. This is truly the definition of a tourist spot known for its cULtuRE and quite frankly, it's not a fun one. It is Philly, after all.

Onto the food itself, the cheesesteak is a soggy, messy bundle of fatty, steak-filled (but not exactly steak-flavored) goodness that'll hit you the right way after a solid night out. Looking back and reflecting on that memory made me realize there is really nothing special about this place's cheesesteaks, and as I venture across Philly in search of the perfect one, I'll add it to the bottom echelon of my list.
CASH ONLY!! Average cheesesteak- kind of dry and the bun is tough. Nice that it's 24/7 though.

Came to Philly doe the day and couldn't leave without seeking this place out.  It's located in a neighborhood.  Parking is a bit difficult but so long as you don't show up at exactly 12 noon, you'll be fine.  Large red metal pick mic tables outside. You order your sub at one window and the rest of tour items at another. Pay them separately.  Cash only.  There is an ATM on the premises. We got a standard steak sub with provolone and onions.  The bun was the best part.  The sub was delicious.  French fries and soda were ordered as well.  There are lots of places in town but we hit this one because it's iconic and oh so good.
Used grubhub to deliver three blocks away to my busy bar. Not only did it take over two hours to make the food, but half of it was missing and the other half was wrong.  Do better

We were in Philly for the weekend.  Stopped by Pats for a Cheesesteak.  Believe me when I tell you, "Any New Jersey diner can make a better Cheesesteak Sandwich than Pats".  Nothing to write home about.  Cheese Wiz, what the hell are they thinking ?????
Love these guys for everything, almost fast on time and amazing folks. Especially Jon the man! He always take care of the kids when I'm in town
This place is one of my favorite spots to eat in chinatown. It always fulfills my cravings because everything is fresh. The service is also beyond outstanding.

Stopped by Checkers on Broad & Champlost. Ordered 1 choc and 1 strawberry shake. Sat in line with to cars in front of us for almost 20 minutes! We wanted to leave after 10 minutes but were blocked in by cars behind us. Finally got to window, asked if the shakes were melting and was told no. Of course they were,  they were prepared 20 min ago! On top of everything they gave us a strawberry and chocolate mixed shake with the strawberry shake! No sorry for the wait, nothing! Just rude! Oh, yeah, no receipt, which we asked for!   Why is this checkers still open? Maybe more staff is needed and better staff training. No more Checkers for us!

Pat's sells a good steak. Went down for the first time in two years w my aunt to do a little comparison between the two staple cheesesteak spots. I think that's probably the best way to enjoy coming down to Pat's and Geno's.

Pat's is by no means the best steak in Philly, but it slides into my top 10 for now. The roll was excellent and the seasoning of the chopped ribeye enhanced the flavors nicely.

A knock against the steak that I would say is that is got colder more quickly than Geno's. I like when a steak stays thoroughly warm, and the sandwiches heat only lasted so long.

For all the hate both of these spots get, neither are as bad as you hear. Pats reminds me of a how a good Philly cheesesteak should taste: lots of meat, good presentation, strong flavors. For future reference, I'd recommend Pat's over Geno's, but it's really closer than I thought.
Good late night grinds after dranks. Know what you want before you order. Good with provolone or cheese wiz.

DO NOT GO HERE!! If there was any way to actually give zero stars I would. They always get your order wrong and the food is always cold. I don't know why this McDonald's is even still open. Someone needs to come and do a health check as well as see if employees are even working. This location should shut down. For some reason it's listed on Uber Eats, but they didn't include a drink or fries with a meal, no sauce with the nuggets, and completely missed one cheeseburger in a two cheeseburger order. The people that work there clearly don't care about customer service, the wait time is terrible, and really this establishment needs to be shut down.  It is 100% guaranteed you will be unhappy with your order.

Worst McDonalds in the history of man kind. The food is always horrible tasting like the people there just threw it together. Last time I went I had a whole slab of a  mayonnaise jar on my mc chicken literally. My bun was hard the ice cream machine never works and the workers are ghetto and very rude and nasty to guest! Very unpreofessional. I wouldn't even give 1 star to be honest! Never go there! Ever!

Five Guys serves a nice double-patty burger that is probably the best you can hope for from fast food. The burgers are made fresh, never frozen, and you get your choice of free toppings. You can also serve yourself a bag of free peanuts as well. I'm not a fan of their fries and one pet peeve is that the cheese is never fully melted. This location tends to get very crowded at lunch, but they do their best to get you out of there as fast as possible.

A Five Guys burger does hit the spot in a pinch, and would be my choice over any other fast food restaurant, but it's no match for the burgers served in bars and restaurants elsewhere in the city.

Ordered the cheese steak & fries via Uber Eats. The order was fast being prepared and leaving the store. However, my order was not correct. They left off the mushrooms. This may not seem like a big deal. But, they cost extra.  The sandwich wasn't bad, but  unremarkable. Kind of dry. There was evidence of cheese on part of the sandwich, but a lot of it had no cheese. The bread was very good!  Fries were cold. BUT I expected this due to it being delivery. Not everything can be helped and I honestly got what I expected with the fries.

A recent trip to Pat's has reinforced my long time impression of the place as a tourist trap.  Growing up in Philly, we usually avoided Pat's but was in town recently on a trip with friends and they had never been to this establishment. Unfortunately, while eating (with children) we encountered a drunk man selling chocolates and harassing the patrons.  After spending $20 for a cheesesteak and a drink, you should be able to sit down and enjoy it without being berated.  If Pat's doesn't care about the safety of its patron's then they don't serve your money.  Hit up Jim's, Tony Luke's or another establishment.  The food is better, less expensive and much safer environment.
The classic cheesesteak with onions, hot peppers, and wiz cheese was delicious, and I highly recommend it. The line flies and there's plenty of outdoor seating as well.

I waited on the bus line like everyone else (7/12). This is my second visit to this Popeyes. I remember the last time I ordered this, they forgot to give me fries and this time they completely forgot me  I had to drive back to the two burgers (paid), and they had no idea of ​​apology at all, and unreasonably asked me if I wanted any benefits. After I asked them to say "sorry", they still chose to ignore me  And closed the window, I was very angry, God knows I told the truth

This place is terrible. I waited 15 minutes in the drive thru just to make my order. They inform me that they can take coupons because the machine is "down." I want the food so I go for it anyway. After this fiasco they tried to over charge me for things on the dollar menu. I don't care if people were too lazy to change the sign they should at least honor the prices. It's not my fault you messed up. The night crew is terrible. Morning are slow but better.....slightly.

I came here to pick up a cheese steak sandwich before I had to trek back NYC. So I got one with cheese whiz and onions. It was good but with the cheese whiz it is way better. The bread is super fresh and soft. The prices were reasonable about $9.50 for my sandwich. They take cash only. The service is fast. I was lucky I caught at a time there was no line. I definitely want try other cheese steak spots on my next visit to Philly.

Pats was my favorite sandwich this trip. I had Jimmy's and Genos. Genos was actually the worst of them all I definitely won't be back. Pats had a lot of wiz and put it on top rather than inside which I apparently prefer. The staff is also nicer as well and the fastest by far. I am definitely coming here next time. Pats is my place!

This is probably the cheesiest, juiciest, delicious cheesesteak I've ever had. I ordered the cheesesteak wiz wit and boy was it delicious. The beef was so tender it reminded me of an Italian beef sandwich. The cheese was ooey, gooey, messy, and tasty. The bread was soft and had the right amount of chew. I have no complaints, my sandwich was cooked to perfection. Do keep in mind Pats is cash only. Furthermore, you order your cheesesteaks from one window and any drinks and fries from the other window. I highly recommend this place if in the South Philly area. My vote goes to Pats in the war of Pat's vs Geno's!

Lived right outside of Philly my whole life but just had my first cheesesteak EVER and it did not disappoint!!! I was super intimidated going up to order but luckily I had someone to tell me the "proper way" to order. It was definitely a major tourist trap and I'm not sure how long I'd be willing to wait for it when I'm sure there's better spots in the city, but it was still delicious!

This Popeyes used to have the $10 10 piece dark manager special and I used to come here every week for it! The manager always looks like he having a hard day and just wants a day to go by. The staff members are typically always a new face and aren't as bad as other places but they're definitely there to get in and out. 

Food is good as any other Popeyes but this specific one will always be home.

Alright, alright. I finally had a famous Philly Cheesesteak, much to my resistance. Apparently this place was on some Food Network show and is famous? Not why I came - came because this is my boyfriend's favorite cheesesteak place. There's another place across the street that looks more lively, Geno's, but I was told this one is better. I was going to give this a 2 star, but I'll be nice and give it a 3.

It's a 'Dick's Drive-In' kind of vibe (for those familiar with that Seattle staple). 

Basically, you walk up to the window stand, order your cheesesteak ('wit' or 'witout' meaning with or without onions), grab and pay, then you go to the second window if you want to order fries (again, 'wit wiz'... this cheese wiz stuff everyone's obsessed with out here). There's a place to grab condiments, napkins and straws behind, and there's tons of outdoor seating.

CON: if you come here late at night, during winter, like I did, be prepared to freeze and eat fast!!!! 

I'll say this. I'm not a huge cheesesteak person in general. They're good, but I never really crave them. I ate them a lot in high school when my boyfriend at the time worked at a East Coast Sub place. I was persecuted at the window (not by the people who work there) when I 'horrifically' ordered the cheesesteak with peppers, mushrooms and onions and 'WITOUT' the cheese wiz. MISTAKE. As much as I'm not a fan of this cheese wiz stuff, I get why people order it. The meat is SO damn dry you NEED the cheese wiz to moisten it up a bit!

I also (eating with people from Philly) was persecuted for wanting to put ketchup on my cheesesteak, again, because it was so dry! I guess there's a right way to eat them and I wasn't playing into it. The fries were good. Nothing special.

Philly people, don't kill me. I'm sure there are plenty of other phenomenal cheesesteak places in this town. But this one isn't one of them.

5 stars for someplace open really late. I've ordered the chicken tenders and fries with mango habanero sauce on the side 3 times now. I can't speak on the other food, but these were actual chicken tenders. After a night out its nice to be able to grubhub from somewhere that doesn't taste like a microwave dinner or is doused in grease. That mango habanero sauce is SO good. I don't know what these other reviewers are talking about, but I am so glad I found this hidden gem on grubhub after a year of having limited options that were disgusting.
It was the worst food I have ever tasted. I got really suck from it I went into complain and to my surpise doggy style on the counter 5 star they are diffently an employee trying to save there jobs

I have a sister who attends a boarding school in Philadelphia suburbs, so I visit her occasionally. However, I never ate at Pat's or Geno's. So over the summer, my boyfriend, my sister, and I decided to do "The Ultimate Philly Cheese steak Challenge."

At the time we went, there were a lot more people, waiting in line to get their cheese steak at Pat's, which gave me the notion that people might like Pat's a little, tiny bit more. Also, the place looked a little bit more.. antique, or simply older than Geno's. So I thought, 'Hm, this place might be the original Philly cheese steak place!'

After waiting in the line for 5 minutes or so (Yes, it was a very looong line), we got our cheese steak - with Whiz and onions - and fries.  I must say, I didn't like Pat's cheese steak too much.  Personally, I thought the steak was a bit dry. I enjoy onion in my sandwiches, but I could hardly taste the onion. And I absolutely hate the ordering system there! Granted, it's quite hilarious, but totally unnecessary. (Talk about waiting in line for 5 more minutes when I'm starving!) I actually got so freaked out, that I begged my sister to order for me.

We've ordered from Jason's several times over the past few months and it's become a favorite. 

We love their crispy chicken - either on waffles or in a sandwich. It's perfectly fried. The shrimp burger is amazing as well. Tater tots and fries are perfectly made.!

The first time I had Chipotle was when I was in Chicago for a conference. I thought it was really good at the time. Somewhere along the line, I guess I saw Chipotle for what I think it truly is...Qdoba with a different name. I won't do the whole Chipotle v. Qdoba battle, but I find it interesting that this particular Chipotle is located a few feet away from Qdoba on Walnut Street.

I ordered a chicken burrito the last time I ate here and it wasn't bad, but I truly do not see the difference in taste between a burrito from Chipotle and one from Qdoba. I'm convinced they're under the same ownership.
Take it from this loyal barfly, Cantina is IT. Sweetest staff and the best beards, burritos, and booze in town.

If I could rate lower I would but this my 2nd time going to this McDonald's 
1st. Experience was like 5 years ago I ordered from this location on Uber eats and ordered a shamrock shake not knowing it wasn't in season plus I ordered 2 milkshakes with my meals and when my food came I was missing a milkshake and the shamrock shake I called and they said that the shamrock was not in season and I said what about the other milkshake I asked if they could just refund me for the shamrock and send another driver for my milkshake and he said I'm sorry and hung up

2nd experience was yesterday me my daughter and wife went through the drive through and ordered a crispy chicken sandwich and some other items, when it was time to pay for the food the person ask me did I order the crispy chicken sandwich and I said yes and they end up charging me for the wrong order so I had to wait until the manager came to refund me instead they kept trying to charge my card took more money then they should have and she gave me my card and said it kept declining but when I checked my statements it took $30 total and I had to drive off with no food plus the manager was very rude I overheard her yelling that she had to refund me will never eat here again

Pat's is the famous cheesesteak place in Philly, across the street from Geno's. I usually grab one from each place then share with a friend. One has better meat, one has better cheese. I always forgot which! However, it's not about the cheese, it's the experience. The service is awesome & like one of those old TV shows where the whole gang gets in on the act. Love the old photos & memorabilia lining the storefront!

This place had such a potential to be good. The line was always long when they opened a couple months ago. Menu selection is prime, but both times I went my order came out cold. Mac and cheese was hot on the top but the rest of it inside the cup wasn't only not warm, but cold. The chicken sandwich was not warm at all. Same exact result on two separated occasions. The one and only person who was working in there the second time told me she would only accept my order if it was exact change.

Naturally, I went to Philly and had to check out the OG Philly cheesesteak join and I was not disappointed! They made the cheesesteak crazy quick. I got a mushroom wit and it was amazinggggg. I would come back 100 times. Next time I would also like to try the cheese fries! I like the original feel to his place. Nothing crazy and high tech. Really good vibe.

I've been to both Cantina locations a bunch, so I'm surprised this is my first time reviewing Los Caballitos. My husband and I popped in last night for an early dinner and a couple drinks. Our server was Emily F and she was really sweet and fantastic. 

I was dying for a margarita but didn't want something really sweet or high in calories. They have their own version of a skinny margarita, which is made with Espolon reposado, lime and agave. The first round was quite tart but I assumed that was because they were going light on the agave. The second round was much more well-balanced. I hate inconsistency with drinks and I feel like it happens all the time with margaritas for some reason. Bartenders: please measure!  

Of course, the chips and fresh salsas (verde and roja) are delicious, but I was trying to eat light so I only had a couple chips. Luckily, our food arrived relatively quickly so I wasn't too tempted. I ordered the chicken fajitas, no beans. Our server asked if I wanted to sub anything else, so I opted for more veggies. The plate arrived loaded with peppers, onions, mushrooms and chicken, plus some white rice, and a separate plate with pico, guac and tortillas. I ate about half and brought the rest home for a second meal. My husband had the chorizo tacos, which looked great. 

Cantina is an old standby where you can go all out and eat heavy, cheesy Mexican, or choose from plenty of options when you just want to keep it light. I probably wouldn't go at a time when there's likely to be a wait but it's great during less busy hours.

Stopped by for a smoothie before catching a train home to NY. I was hoping to pick up something to eat because it was around lunch time, but most of the food court was closed (I imagine as a result of COVID). Nevertheless, this was a great option and I was really happy with my smoothie! I think it was banana, kale, and strawberry with a soy milk base but tbh I can't entirely remember. I got the largest size which was probably excessive (24 oz) but it held me over until dinner, so I guess that's good!

Worst McDonalds Ever, You never get what you order, it took 13 times so I could finally get a grilled club, every time I order one I got crispy, I ordered a grill the counter girl put in for a crispy in the receipt and a got a grill, they are backwards. No pickles no onions meas extra to them, I ask for an apple pie I got a cherry pie, I don't get it, why are they so dumb? all they do its yell at each other and talk about other people they are not professional at all and if it wasn't because there is nothing else to eat around on my lunch time I would never go there, actually if I didn't have an hour lunch I wouldn't be able to go there it takes them about 20 to 30 min to give you your food, but they sure take it off the screen on time so they look good If you can avoided go to any other mcdonalds if I was the owner of this place I would start from scratch the managers got no control of anyone of their employees

I'm sure everyone has their opinion on which Cheese steak they prefer the best in Philadelphia. Mine happens to be Pats. 

I would say their meat is better than everyone else's. Their onions and bread are decent, but I'm here for the meat which is what matters. I would say Genos has the best onions and Tony Luke's has the best bread.

I've been coming here for the last 4 years and it's great that it's 24 hours. As a result, I've been able to make a trip here at all times of the day. Service has always been quick and good to me. There one window to order your steak and another to order frieds and drink. Also keep in mind that this place is Cash Only. 

Come here to get a true Philadelphia staple: The Cheese steak

Ordered from here a few times when I've had the munchies, each time I've ordered I've hoped either the food or the service would get better, sadly neither one has improved. I always give most places three tries before I make my final decision on them and after the other day I must say that I don't think I've ever been treated so rudely before in my life. I felt like I was In a Jerry Seinfeld episode asking for bread with my soup. My order was wrong I called and told them about it and asked could they apply the difference to my next order and they were very rude and dismissive of me. That's not how you run a business customers can go anywhere and folks don't like to pay for food with a side of abuse. If I wanted abuse I would've stayed with my ex boyfriend. I asked for an apology and got laughter like really? My very last order from this place

Old Dirty Bastard got arrested here in November of 2000.
