This place is tiny, so probably most people stop in for take-out. But even though it was lunch hour on a weekday, we were able to sit at the counter in the window. Additional seating in the building lobby next door, seemed a little unappealing to me, but it would work if necessary.

Maybe it's been too long since I had a sandwich lunch in CC, but I thought the pricing - burger at $11 and steak sandwich at $10 was no bargain. And if you want some spice on that steak sandwich, you can "Buffalo It" for another dollar. It's not like you can just get some hot sauce with it on the side for no additional charge.

Finally, the guy taking the order didn't ask, and we didn't specify that we'd be eating there. So the order came wrapped and in a paper bag with handles, as though we'd be taking it somewhere. It's all recycled content paper (happily, no plastic!), and they have labelled food and paper recycling bins, etc., nevertheless it seemed like a waste to do that packaging.

I've been to the other location - and it's very hit or miss for me. The crispy chick'n sandwich is definitely the best thing on the regular. Not impressed by many of the other items. 

However, this new location on Broad street SERVES BREAKFAST and it's THE BEST!

I got the HipCity Breakfast Sandwich (Tofu egg, organic soy mayo, & tempeh -- except I subbed for a sausage patty) on an everything bagel. I have to say it's the best vegan breakfast I've ever had.

A little pricey at $7 for a breakfast sandwich, but on a morning when you're struggling it's definitely worth it. Well worth 5 stars based on sheer amazingness.

Very long line but short wait with work bestie for two California chicken cheesesteak with fried onions and sweet peppers for me, no peppers for her. Mine was scooped and served on their whole grain option with lettuce and tomato. Bestie goes for classic style. 

For a chain restaurant, JM makes a great product and it's a generous portion of chicken so it was mighty filling and mighty good. California chicken cheesesteak hoagies with sweet peppers 5/5

Jersey Mikes has seating inside the restaurant which is also shared by Wendy's. The manager is a great guy and manages both franchises; evidently this location Is the only Wendy's /Jersey Mikes in the country. 

Bestie and I also shared a bag of chips 5/5

One issue though, be prepared to be thirsty, very thirsty after you eat there.
Always amazing subs - the bread does it for me each time. I love the avocado spread and it's super fresh. For less than $8 I'm satisfied and not bloated.

I had high hopes walking in....they seem to have more sandwiches than bakery items dispite the name. They did not grill my grilled panini, make two after I ordered two, did not heat up my pastry or deliver the food with out even a look nevermind a smile...I would skip this place to give you money to a more deserving local.

Ordered for the first time last week and it was so good that I was craving gyro again tonight. Non Stop Gyro was more than accommodating when they missed one of the items in our order. This is definitely our new go-to for Greek food in UCity!

This place is kind of a crapshoot. The employees are young kids who are fairly incompetent and I'm a bit nervous about trusting my food safety to them. Some nights they have the A team working and other nights it's like some kind of strange performance art behind the line. Buuut, it's right next to the bus stop and is the quickest reasonably healthy meal I can grab after the gym that isn't Eat a Pita.

I must commend Taco Bell on hiring people who can't read not understand English. 3 times asked for No Tomatoes. Guess what, have $15 worth of food I can't eat because the idiots put everything I asked to be taken off put on and everything on put off!!

I love burgers. I think I'm a consider for the chain burgers, with my favorite being steak n shake. When I saw hake shack was opening in Philly, I instantly thought this was the new place to go. 

The shack burger was amazing! It has become an instant burger favorite an will go back for them. 

However, the shake was lacking. We had both the 'special' coffee and donuts shake, and the liberty shell concrete. Both were good, but were lacking in that wow effect making you want to go back. 

Try out the burgers, but you can hold the shakes. Definitely go for the burgers!

Sorry shake shack but you have slipped. The burger beef wasn't the same, it looked formed in a cup and not hand pattied.  

The beloved crinkle cut fries I used to tell people about, no more.  

The shack-meister beer even tasted a bit off. 

I'm confused; It might be a while until i'm willing pay $13 for a mediocre burger and fries I can get at a pizzeria.

I've been meaning to try the Smokehouse Burger for a few weeks now...and I finally did! I'm already a Beyond Meat fan, but the onions, smoked gouda and bbq sauce really made this. It was filling, delicious and really tasted like a legit burger!

Kind of bummer. Got a shack double burger with sliced onion and house sauce...it was extremely greasy. Wasn't able to control the sandwich, everything kept sliding out. And it made the bread soggy. The roll is also too small for the large patties. Taste was good, middle was a bit too pink.
Average expensive burger...nothin special....layout terrible...will not return...no thanks anything higher and one star is a lie
Hands down one of the best burgers I've had in a long time. It's pretty much the only burger in Chinatown. Highly recommend

It's Chipotle, the food and atmosphere is the same as every one I've ever been to. It's clean like most Chipotles. I only come here when I have a random craving for Chipotle, or when my friends convince me we should all get together here because it's cheap. There's nothing great or bad about it. As per usual, I just love the chips from here for some reason. It's just a Chipotle. Guac is still extra.
Not as clean as the red lion bustleton location

Brand new place right in Chinatown bringing attention to Taiwanese fried foods. 

Right off the bat, this place is so CHEAP. Quick snack, cheap eats, fast food prep, and cute theme. 

Reading through the past reviews does disappoint me that yelpers had such bad experiences here but there isn't much for me to complain about. The popcorn chicken was quite delicious, a perfect crisp combined with the perfect moist. I got the honey mustard and BBQ sauce to go with the chicken (although it's weird, they charge you extra for sauce and they put it in a big container with only a little tiny dab of sauce). Both sauces were delicious, I personally liked the honey mustard better. 

I got both the waffle fries and sweet potato fries, the waffle fries didn't have much actual potato in it. The sweet potatoes fries were delightful and much better tasting. 

Overall, it was good food! And I also love their sticky note wall, super cute.

If I could give it a zero I would. Very ignorant staff that can't get an order right even after I tell them my order before paying. Food is always cold staff don't know how to admit when their wrong let alone apologize to the customer. Drive thru lines are always long. They don't even try to please the paying customers.
Second time I have been here. Waited in drive thru line about 15 minutes then and waited today for about 10 minutes with only one person in front of me. Food is average McDonald's food.

Shake Shack is my go-to, even over otherwise lovely and quaint restaurants nearby. 

Although the ambiance is fast-food based, the quality of the food transcends the atmosphere. The Shack burger is next-level eats; they've seemingly demystified the absolute perfect burger. 

In short: Order a Shack burger. Skip the fries for a float. Add a classic hot dog and one Chicago dog. Have the best casual and quick eating experience.

This place was amazing! I love their shack sauce and the cashier was so friendly! Also the place has a great atmosphere for anyone who wants a burger. I also am in love with their crinkle cut fries! I am coming back soon :)

This location is a joke.  It took over two hours for delivery.  When I called to check on the order the woman on the telephone told me there was a new delivery person who didn't speak English, was on foot and didn't know the city.  Why would they hire them?  When I asked if she had any idea when he would be here she was very rude to me and told me it was what it was.  When I called back a second time and asked her if she had any idea when it would be delivered she hung up on me.  She should be fired as well as the delivery boy.  Do not order from this location.  They are pathetic.

suuuuper awesome spot if you're looking for a late night meal or if youre too lazy to go look for the $5 chicken+rice carts. The chicken and lamb combo here is delicious and is so filling. I dont think I've ever been able to finish a whole platter by myself. The best part is ordering it to-go because then you have two meals!! ( unless you have a boyfriend who eats your leftovers :(  ).  I particularly liked this place because the white sauce and the red sauce is self-served. Its already included in the food but if you want more, its available! I always end up getting at least 3 more tiny containers of white sauce (2 extra for my food and 1 for dipping the pita bread), and 1 container of hot sauce. However, when it comes to the red sauce, BEWARE!! It doesnt taste spicy but it really does cause my stomach to be irritated. 

Overall, i completely love the chicken and lamb combo platter and will definitely miss this place when I'm back in LA.

First of all this place was very nicely decorated but the food wasn't worth all the hype. I ordered the popcorn chicken and it wasn't something amazingly good. It was kinda pricey for such a small amount and there was more fried flour than actual fried popcorn chicken. I guess this place is pretty good for the ascetic looks but other than that the food was not good and the customer service is worse. The cashier girl took a very long time to take my order and she only had one customer and she was giving me an attitude the whole time while I was trying to order. I don't think this place is the best for the food or customer service, but this place is good for Instagram photos.

I can't explain this place's popularity. Are Americans just too in love with restaurants with alliterative names? Do people love overpaying for a burger that's the quality of a quarter pounder with cheese so they can pretend they're a New Yorker for a few minutes? These things I cannot explain, like the first time I went and they had run out of fries. Yes, at a burger joint.
Here's one more mystery. For a place that is making money hand over fist why do it's employees all seem so miserable? Almost all my interactions were rushed or apathetic as if they didn't seem to want to be there. This just doesn't happen at an In N' Out or other high end fast casual burger place where they treat their employees better. Maybe if they had gotten stock options as part of their employment...

Shake Shack in my book is basically the the "In N Out" burger of the east.  I've never been, but I've heard and seen nothing but good things about it from friends, family, and celebrities alike.  I also went with my friend's in Philly who have also never been here before.

The first thing we noticed is that everything here was kind of pricey.  I paid about $15 for a cheeseburger, cheese fries, and a caramel milkshake.  Don't get me wrong, because it was good; however, my friends and I don't feel like the food was worth what we paid for.  And there are plenty of other restaurants in the area to get better quality food from.  I recommenced the shake shack if you're looking for a quick bite to eat, but if you want a meal that will really impress you, go elsewhere.

... This place is unique in the fact that it sells dog treats, and allows dogs to sit outside.  Maybe if I was a dog person I'd like this place more.

Shake Shack: really smart PR people.

I was trying to attend the Moonlit Movie (I say 'trying' because the very well prepared and creative people throwing the event had a projector that over-heated about five times, delaying the movie by a half hour plus) with a group of frans, but D and I sidetracked to the free Shake Shack custard in the PHS pop-up garden first.

It was raspberry, so I sulkily ate a dry cone while D and her SO raved about the custard.

(I hate fruit.)

(Ironic, I know.)

Anyhow, when the projector went bonkers, we all packed up and scurried over in the drizzle to the Shake Shack because MILKSHAKES.

I ordered a chocolate milkshake for 5$.  A little bit pricey, and it comes in a squat cup which does not look so impressive.  HOWEVER!

This milkshake was exceedingly creamy.  Oh my goodness was it creamy and smooth and rich and filling.  I enjoyed it very much.

In the end, a milkshake is kind of a milkshake, and a 5$ milkshake only holds charm when you're in the area and NEED a milkshake.  If I ever get back and try a burger, you might be hearing a different song.

(Also, I really recommend sitting outside if possible.  The inside is incredibly, incredibly loud.)

The Taiwanese popcorn chicken is pretty good. I'm not Taiwanese, but I know what it's supposed to taste like, and they do a fairly good job. The bento boxes (other than the chicken) was somewhat lacking. The meager quantity of veggies and rice is pretty sad. Like let's be serious..  white rice is like the cheapest thing on earth, you can afford to give me more than a spoonful.

leaving hungry is never ok.

Shake Shack, you're amazing.  Poor Village Whiskey.

The concrete blends are awesome. The burger was wonderful, if a little more...rare than I would have enjoyed. And I love rare meat. I'm hoping that was just an opening day mistake.

Also, I hate crinkle cut french fries. Because they are reminiscent of cafeteria lunches.  However, they are PERFECT here. And the wiz-american cheese combo is genius.
The only vegetarian food option is this disgusting fried liquid cheese concoction called a "shroom burger." I've eaten here twice now. More depressing than eating a dead animal.
Ordered 2 apple pies. Said to pull off so they can take other orders. Waited 20 minutes and still nothing. horrible.

Love this location normally but should close altogether during COVID. Burger and fries cold and inedible. Ordered in advance and was sitting ready but young man busy chatting up co-workers and it sat longer. Wait till reopen. I know it's hard and I appreciate everyone needs a paycheck but then do it right.
Love their hot dogs. I wish they would fry their onions. The employees are very helpful. Great  place to watch a sporting event.

when shake shack was coming i was excited after waiting a month  i always wait
for a month after any place opens up,well it was good but what was all the hype
bobby burger place in university city blows the shake shack burger away,it was good but not great bobbys burgers still rule

What's all the fuss about? It's an alright burger in a super cute space. That averages it out to about 3 stars.

I got the single ShackBurger and though it looks to be on the small side, it's very filling...perhaps this is related to it tasting like it's lathered in butter. 

Thumbs up for free filtered water.

Don't get the cheese fries. The cheese coagulates in about 3 minutes and looks yuck.

If you want 6 meals for $15 use my discount code: AWHI-JR9. Or you can use it to get $15 off of one meal. Please note the code doesn't work in store. You can order on the app then get it from the store to take advantage of the savings. Or you can use their free delivery system. 

Now about the shrimp & cauliflower grits. They are yummy I get them every week. The cauliflower is so good and so sweet that you almost forget your eating cauliflower.  I'm not a huge kale fan but I like how they braze it so it's bearable!

If you like In & Out Burger and/or Five Guys, you will love Shake Shack. Solid and fast, but not "fast food." They also serve beer, and my personal favorite: Dr. Pepper. Craving a burger? This is what the doctor orders.

it tastes great, even more when I'm high. Love the portobello burger with the beef patty, the portobello has cheese that gushes out when you hit in and its delicious. Beef is amazingly tender. Fried are crispy. Liberty Bell custard was okay, not outstanding, kind of boring, but okay.
Delicious burgers and fries. The milkshakes are below average. After moving to Philly from NYC last year it was nice to see an New York favorite of mine follow me to Philly.

The Worst ever cold food
Dirty in side and Don't go there
After 5pm.went there tonight. To
Many kids work there, what MC Donald's
Don't have what's on the menu, all the time.

Shake Shack is fast food with a nicer exterior than most. I'm a local to the neighborhood and their food is certainly overpriced for what you're getting, however it fits the role of a meal that just needs to be eaten when I'm too busy for something I'd actually prefer. An exception to this would be their ice cream. I go out of my way to grab some of their concretes.

Overall Shake Shack is a decent establishment to grab a casual bite. They have long operating hours, outdoor seating, TVs that are usually playing sports, and beer. All of these serve as nice touches!

If you don't want to come here for a casual bite try Revolution Taco or Rione. Both are just one or two blocks away.

The place is located inside the new China Town Square. There is no sign outside and the address on yelp doesn't either so it was frustrating finding this restaurant.

Second...Soggy tacos!...couldn't even hold up the last one to take a bite without it breaking. Tried the bulgogi, al pastor and carnitas. Bulgogi is the most popular one but tasted the worst out of those 3. I'm an Indian girl with Korean tastebuds so trust me when I say don't get the bulgogi. 

I wouldn't come here again. 

Also, they have a $9 minimum for CC.

Oh! and the Yelp 10% off when you check in doesn't work anymore!!! Lame. Take it down then.

Sorry I get mean when my food doesn't hit the spot.

Honestly, there's not much else I can say about Shake Shack. I've been to the King of Prussia location and now the Rittenhouse location. Of course, Rittenhouse is much smaller and does not offer as much seating, but you're still getting the same great burger. For the first time, I tried the fries and loved it. It was a great compliment to my burger. I didn't order a shake, but I did try the lemonade, which was refreshing on a very warm day in Philly. Service was cool and so was the AC. Overall, if I'm in the area and in the mood for a Shack burger, I know where to go.

Just a note, if you want to drive to this location, parking is murder. I ended up parking on 19th and Market Street, and walking a few blocks. If you're somehow lucky enough to grab one of the two parking spots in front on Shake Shack, well, kudos to you.

I got 6 meals for $15 because I used a code to get $45 off of a meal plan. My coupon / discount code is AWHI-JR9, if you want $15 off of a meal and $45 off of a meal plan when you order on the app. Please note the code doesn't work in store. You can order on the app then get it from the store to take advantage of the savings. 

Now about the romesco chicken.

The chicken and sauce are divine. And the mushrooms paired with it is delicious. I wouldve given it 5 stars, but I hate kale. So I wish they'd make it with collards or something ‍ Other than that it's delicious

I ordered a shroom burger at shake shack an got a small patty on the ghetto potato bread you can buy at shoprite 12 for 3.19. The burger itself was alright but man, this place is too expensive to be this bad

Do they purposely try to mess up your order? Every single time I've gone here they messed something up. Every. Single. Time. I only go back because it's a block away from home but the convenience isn't even worth the hassle.

Stopped here for a meeting and decided to try their black cold brew. Surprisingly the cold brew was better than my expectations. It was not bitter at all and it was pretty smooth. The cold brew itself was a 4/5 I would say. My friend who was also ordering wanted an iced coffee with almond milk but they didn't have iced coffee that day and they don't serve almond milk. They have a lot of seating however some of the chairs are ripped but there is a good amount of seating at this location.
The quality has gone down a lot (LOT) from about 2 years ago. Used to frequent this place but have had terrible rice plates the past few times. Switching over to the masala place instead of here.
Took wife and my daughter, we had a great meal. The manager (?) stopped by our table to see how all was and welcomed us to the restaurant.  Very nice wait staff

Don't get me wrong Jimmy Johns have decent sandwiches, but I will never shop there again. A few months back I order a Turkey tom. All was well until I started to feel a hard object in my mouth that I swear to you looked like someone's fingernail. Nope, I'm done with them. Subways it is.
There's not a single staff member that spends any time cleaning the tables. They are always dirty.

I tried Shake Shack tonite for 1st time.  The staff consists of university students and they were all pleasant and fun.  

The food:  overall disappointing.  

I ordered the regular fries, and Shake Stack Burger.  The fries are crinkle cut, boring and bland - not much better than Oreda fries in the freezer at the supermarket. The only choice is plain or with "cheese sauce".  The fries could be enhanced if their was seasoning option (like Cajun) or dipping sauces (like spiced ketchup, ranch, horseradish).  Very disappointing except they were fresh cooked.

The burger was the beef burger stacked with the portobello mushroom.  The burger was slightly thicker than a pancake.  The mushroom was a disproportionate size to the burger, bun - it was the size of a medium sliced tomato but thicker - it made the sandwich awkward and sloppy.

The place was not busy when I arrived so there was no reason my burger should have been so sloppily put together.

Lastly, I requested the burger to be cut in 1/2, but apparently the staff is not allowed to handle knives. The knife police were on duty.  So unless Shake Shack orders precut produce (which would explain the high prices), someone in the kitchen is handling a knife.  So if the knife wasn't allowed to be touched, take the spatula that burgers are flipped with and use that!  That was one of the silliest things I ever heard.  

Not impressed at all.  All the hype was for nothing.  Not a bad tasting beef burger, bad fries, tiny portobellos however do not make for a good overall meal.  

I didn't try any of the shakes or custards.  Maybe I would return to try those and the hot dogs, but that would be about it.

If youre dying to try unseasoned fries, a milkshake that has the value thats worth $3 at best for $5, and a hot dog that looks just as fake as my grandmothers lip injections, i implore you to go here.

This is not your father's fast food! I've tried quite a few selections and they're all great (except not crazy about the vegan fetuccini alfredo ... I like wheat noodles much better, but the other flavors were great). Salmon dishes, naked beef, snap peas, and egg sausage taco were favorites. Didn't give 5 stars because they're a bit pricy and you need to get medium size if you want to feel satisfied. But I suppose if you want fresh, tasty and healthy, you're gonna pay a bit more.

if give less than 1 start if i could! after placing an order on grubhud over and hour and a half later we ca the number grubhub gives us and the lady of the phone name starts with a d is rude, unhelpful and senseless... she tried to cut a deal for a dollar more saying there was two orders placed under the same name and the grubhub guy cant be called back to the taco bell location. more like taco hell location. then said we could come pick it up! as if we trust the location now lol called grubhub directly for a refund... calling bullshit on the whole establishment and hope karma handles lady d

I have been craving a decent burger and my middle of the range go to is usually five guys. (So you cab gauge my range) I've had shake shack in NYC and have passed by the Rittenhouse location on occasion so I decided to check it out today... But not without investigating yelp first. 

I was very confused because there were a lot of 5 star but just as many 2 star reviews... I was famished and torn and even thought about taking one of the reviewers recommendation and going to Wendy's for a frosty and McD's for a cheese burger.....  BUTTTTTT I wanted something a little better. So I hopped in the cab, landed on 20th&Sansom and decided to give it a go. 

I really hate to say it but this was probably the worst burger I have ever attempted to consume in my life. I got the smoke shack without the ranch (cause I heard the burgers were greasy and wanted the least amount of moisture) and cheese fries with the cheese on the side. I had to use about 9 napkins to blot out the constant dripping of fluid. You could tell that the oil in the fryer was super old cause my fries came out as dark as Wesley Snipes. (Sorry Wesss) And after 30 seconds of exposure to natural light, my cheese began to congeal 

I gave this place one star for the girl working up front who didn't outwardly seem irritated by all my modifications or harass me to order a drink with my meal.  I WAS going to order a shake at the end of my meal.. But yeah, I think I'm over it. Okay, maybe I could give it two for the constant busboy cleaning the tables... But it was weird because late afternoon on a Friday, there were more employees sitting inside/outside than customers. Maybe they're bringing the siesta to the States? Didnt get that memo. 

I recommend everyone to at least give Shake Shack a try for yourself because it could very well be your cup of tea..... Perhaps if I ordered the special Labor Day corn dog, my experience could've been much better.
Horrible employees that treat you very disrespectful! Avoid at all cost! Everything is So distrusting inside

I had the shake burger which comes with lettice & tomato & their special sauce I added (for $1 more) fried onions which were fried shallots. Cheese fries (their cheese sauce is very good its not cheese wiz) that burger had so much flavor in every bite I wanted to get in line & order another. The only downside is parking other than that these burgers are to die for.

By far the worst burrito bowl I've ever gotten from a chipotle. Skimped on everything rice, beans and meat. The service is horrible too everyone gives you horrible attitudes and looks. I don't recommend going here especially since there is another mexican place thats fast, good service, and good food a block away. Not worth it.

I've been going to this taco bell for the last couple years. I'd pick up breakfast burritos from time to time before heading to school but more recently during covid it's been my go-to for quick lunches. I've never had an issue with this place, the workers have always been nice to me and they always get the job done. It's a fast food joint so obviously you get what you pay for. You can't expect michelin star service but the service I think at this place has always been great. There were several times where our order would take too long to make during rush hours (when I would order a lot of food for kickbacks) but they did throw in an extra taco or two or a free drink. Overall, the food is as good as it gets for a taco bell, the service is as good as it gets, and they're quick. This taco bell 100% will always be my go to place for quick eating.

I got 6 meals for $15 because I used my friends code to get $45 off of a meal plan. My coupon code/ discount code is AWHI-JR9, if you want $15 off of a meal and $45 off of a meal plan when you order on the app. Please note the code doesn't work in store. 

Now about my meal... 

The Shrimp Scampi is AMAZINGLY DELICIOUS! It is ridiculously flavorful and fresh. It came with 9 shrimp, tons of veggies and noodles. This will definitely be a staple in my weekly meal plan

Had lunch at another JJs yesterday and it was so good I decided to go to another JJs today for lunch. BIG MISTAKE. Yesterday the bread was soft and fresh - today hard and stale. If I wanted a hoagie with stale bread I'd just stop at a random pizza joint. Very disappointed in this location. Bread can make or break a sandwich and in this case it completely ruined it. If I was eating in I would've demanded a refund. 1 star rating in hopes that someone who works there will see this and make sure it never happens again.

Not sure why there's so many bad reviews but the service is super friendly and the burgers are freshly made and amazing! The only thing that could hamper the ratings would be the time to make one burger ( around 8 minutes). But still a great place to eat if you avoid the rush hours (12-2 pm& 5-630 pm).

I don't leave many reviews but all I have to say is ouch. Listen, I get staffing issues and cooking issues and all that, but the negative attitude towards the customers is what killed this place for me. I have come here a lot over the past year and had good service but recently it has gone super downhill. Stopped in today with about 6 people ahead of me, 20 minutes later I was finally able to order and felt like I was bothering the workers with just saying "burrito bowl". None of the line was stocked very well and paying $2 extra for a really small spoon of guacamole was the bummer cherry on top. Sorry to say it but this chipotle is not worth it, walk the extra few blocks and go to other one on 15th.

Prices have gone up. More locations now. Same great menu and same great staff. ... I needed a restroom while waiting and my temperature was taken, then I was allowed to proceed. 
My son and I both got the "crispy chicken with ranch" sandwich I've gotten there many times before and recall it being much crispier and smothered with more ranch. So I think they changed some things up. My son doesn't like ranch and was able to substitute for a different sauce off the menu. 
Our order came to $23 for just the two chicken ranch sandwiches. I think the hike in prices on everything makes me less likely to go there next time I'm in Center City (Philly) or DC as there are more vegan options at better prices elsewhere. But it was a nice treat today.

If you were to walk a mile in my shoes, you would wind up at Shake Shack. If I'm going to walk a mile, you bet your sweet toosh it's going to be to Shake Shack for a delicious double cheeseburger with some okay fries. And they even give you free water! Free water at a restaurant? Now I've seen it all!

I was v disappointed with this spot.  Located in the Chinatown mall, I came here with two friends after donating blood platelets.  This may be TMI, but I am setting the scene to let you know how hungry and ravenous I was, so you can feel my disappointment firsthand.

It was taco Tuesday and all tacos were $2.  Thinking back to it, why did I go to taco spot in Chinatown?  Well, because there was an Asian-Mexican fusion place I used to frequent in LA and was excited because I thought this would be like that spot.  I was sorely mistaken.  This was not well done at all.

I got the double fried chicken, moist chicken, and carnitas.  The carnitas was decent.  I didn't hate that one.  But, I take a bite into the shredded rotisserie chicken taco and literally bite into a bone.  To say I was peeved is an understatement...there was no turning back from that.  The double fried chicken was ALL breading.  The tacos were overstuffed and impossible to eat.  They overdid the cilantro.  So many complaints, I do not recommend.

Decided to have lunch here today and have to say the experience was just average. Only reason I gave this location 3 Stars instead of 2 Stars was for the friendliness of the staff & portion size. Otherwise, nothing to entice me back to this location. Restaurant was neat and there is ample parking being in the same shopping center as Walmart, but flavor of food was bland. If you're hungry and in the area, I say go somewhere else like Domino's, which is right next door & offers in store meals at this location. I'm sure you will have better luck there.

the platters are great, but i don't suggest it for an actual meal. this is more of a 'lets go here because we're drunk and hungover' spot.... Because thats exactly the type of crowd that goes there haha why you think they're open until 3am? :P
Delicious ranch chicken sandwich, and ziggy burger!! Didn't love the cheesesteak as much. So nice to have vegan fast food options though.

After a long walk through old city, I made my way to Chinatown Sqaure for the first time with the intention of trying Coreanos. I passed by other delicious options, but I stayed true to the game plan. I looked over the menu and there was so much that I wanted to try. I asked the chef if I was able to get three different tacos and he replied that is only something that they do on Tuesdays, but since it was not very busy (it was really early on a Saturday) he would do it. I was immediately excited and looking forward to the meal. My box of food glowed with lots of colors and fresh ingredients. I got one bulgogi, fried chicken and pork taco. These are not your ordinary tacos. They are inventive and unique with every bite. The bulgogi was my favorite. There so soooo much meat on my tacos!! With barely a crowd in the Square, I got the seat of my choice and sat down to enjoy my meal while listening to 90s boy band music playing over the speaker system. At 11 bucks for 3 tacos it is very reasonable pricing. They have lots of other options such as salads and rice bowls, as well as a rotisserie chicken.

After my meal I asked about gluten free. They use corn tortillas and a number of their meats (pork, chicken) are in the clear. Some of the meats have soy sauce in them so those would be off limits.

The burgers are OK. The size is OK, the price is OK for something touting itself as semi-gourmet, and the fact that there isn't much to choose from on the menu is OK--if they're gonna do it right. I've had the Shack Burger pretty much any time I've gone there, and the sauce is pretty good. I like that they give you the option of having it rare. Overall, though, the burger remains forgettable.

Also, it's incomprehensible to me that anyone would actually like Shake Shack's frozen-foods-section-style french fries. I mean, even comparing it to actual non-gourmet-esque fast food, their fries are terrible. When it comes to fries, I would have preferred even a McDonald's to open there. I live right around the corner, so I was really looking forward to the option of having amazing fries whenever the craving arose. But instead, all I get are thick cut fries without any amount of crispiness and lacking the proper amount of salt. The cheese fries are not any better. The cheese would probably be great on crispy thin fries, but on the mushy stuff presented, it only adds to the dry and overly heavy effect.

The servers and waitstaff are extremely nice, which I respect deeply considering how busy this place is. They get your food to you quickly. One star is for these guys. Keep up the good work!

Prices are beyond ridiculous esp for the size of the burger, but I gotta say that you can definitely taste the freshness of it. Order the shack stack... prob the only burger that will fill u up since it's their shroom burger and cheeseburger combined. Absolutely delicious too. I also ordered a creamsicle float. My husband drank it all so I assumed it was good..  lol. I will be back

I consider this a cut above Five Guys in the burger department.  In the french fry department, they didn't really do it for me.

As other reviewers have pointed out and going on the reporting from uwishunu, the patties themselves are supposedly a custom blend from La Frieda.  The taste to me was like a really good burger from a backyard cookout.  It had a decent fat content because while my burger was cooked through, it retained very good flavor and texture.  I liked the bun and I was able to hold this burger easily and fit it in my mouth without unhinging my jaw.  I went with the single shack burger with the sauce on the side.  I tasted the sauce and it really did nothing for me so I skipped it.

The fries were crinkle cut and while they were pretty salty (never really a bad thing) they kind of lacked any other flavor or texture.  They looked pretty processed and I didn't see evidence of potato skin anywhere.  I think it's a personal preference to me for a more rustic, natural cut fry.  I will say they were cooked properly so overall it wasn't a bad experience, just not my preference.

The line wasn't awful and I'm happy that I finally got in.  Seems like a perfectly good spot to grab a burger and a coke when you're feeling like eating the american signature meal.  Of course, if you're feeling fancy, you can get a nice bottle of Shiraz there for 49 bucks.

Tried the chickn shack. Pretty good. Breading was falling off some. Mayo was tasty. Roll was enjoyable. Still would rather get a smoke shack burger but this was enjoyable. Louisiana hot sauce added minor kick. Best fries around. $13

New spot in town. Pretty good. I don't know how authentic it is, but it's still very good. Decent prices, huge servings. I would give 10 stars for this Mango Lycee (sp?) drink that they serve. Definitely worth making your own opinion on.

Summary: not enough vegetables, vegetables are not fresh, food overall is too salty, too dry, our group of four threw out quite a bit of the food.  It's cheap, but I can make better Indian food (at least to my tastes) at home.  The #1 reason I didn't enjoy the meal here was the vegetables--don't go here if you want a well-balanced meal with a lot of fresh vegetables.

I really don't get all the favorable reviews.  Is this place getting their friends to post fake reviews, or do people just have different tastes from me and my friends?    Did we get this place on an off day, or do people really not care about fresh vegetables?  Actually, I think the real reason for all the stellar reviews is that people probably go here really late at night when they're really drunk.  That doesn't help me because our group was totally sober and it was normal dinner time.  Still, if I were drunk and in this vicinity late at night, I'd probably prefer Tower Style Pizza around the corner.

Anyway...I ordered a Kati filled with chicken and I finished mine.  The bread was pleasantly moist, but the contents of it were dry and too salty.  I liked the mint chutney on the wrap; that was probably the best part of my meal, but it wasn't the freshest or best mint chutney I've had.

The other people ordered platters.  There were very few vegetables in the platters.  One came with a crappy tomato (it's the heart of tomato season, why are they getting the disgusting low-quality tomatos that are provided by food service and fast food places?  in winter this is excusable but not this time of year) and there was a little bit of iceberg lettuce (ugh, why is anyone still using this?) in most of them.

The biryani came with some overcooked broccoli and a few peas and carrots.  The biryani, like most of the food here, was too dry, and a bit too salty for me, although not as much as my wrap.

I also am not a huge fan of the ambiance.  It is very clean, and there was a/c which was nice because it was hot and humid outside, but overall it wasn't the most pleasant place.  The music was a bit loud and sort of jarring, the sort of music I'd prefer dancing to, rather than eating a meal to.  Maybe I just wasn't in the mood for it, but it sort of seemed to fit with the food--a bit in your face but not nuanced or balanced.

Two stars, not one, because I finished my food, and even though I didn't exactly feel great after eating the food here, I did not get sick.  And at least it was cheap.

If I want Indian fast food, I would much prefer places like Desi Chaat house in West Philly...it's cheap, faster than this place, and the meal comes with fresh fruits and vegetables and I find it leaves me feeling better.

Seriously though: vegetables vegetables vegetables.  It's part of a healthy diet, it makes the food taste better, and it's a necessary requirement to get me to come back after eating at a restaurant.

This visit was good! Service was friendly and fast.  I asked for an entree that they didn't have enough of so they made me some in about 5 minutes and bought the food over to our table when it was done.  

There was plenty of seating, the area was very clean as well as the bathrooms.
A & J at the window on 5/10/19 at 10:31pm were wonderful. Polite, efficient, and friendly. Would 10/10 recommend going to this location because they are the best thing about it.

Who isn't a fan of shake shack? I guess vegans, vegetarians, and those that can't eat red meat in excess. Still, I think there could be an option for a few of those guys here! Shake shack is like the cadillac of fast food restaurants - it's quick and carry to your table style, but the food isn't greasy or waiting for you when you walk in the door. Don't get me wrong, this meal is heavy and calorie-filled but it's worth it. I am a fan of the fries - nothing wrong with the crinkle cut - the shack burger and the shroom burger. All great options. I've never had one of the custards or milkshakes because they're too heavy from the looks of it, but they look phenomenal! Love this place!

Cool facade, looks great from the street and they say a sidewalk cafe is coming soon. Place is reasonably clean. 

Let me preface this by saying that I won't stand in line for anything. We went around 3:30 and were waited on immediately. We were told, "we make everything to order so this will take a little while." OK, we get it. We sat down with our beeper and waited. Half an hour goes by. WTF? "Oh," the manager tells us, "We threw that away when no one claimed it. We sent someone around to ask." I see. So they remade the order and refunded us our money. The food was OK. I think 5 Guys burgers are just as good and I don't smell like grease when I leave. Fries were fair. Root beer float tasted just like milk and pepsi. I saw someone eating one of their "concretes", like a DQ blizzard and thought it looked like someone had already eaten it. Ewww.

On this particular warm July day, I received a cold burger (i still love crispy bacon even cold, luckily) with some cold nuggets and soggy cold fries.   I don't understand how Wendy's repeatedly fails me on food temperature.  I will return, but only to be given a hot baked potato.

After this, I think it will be hard to stay a customer.

This place hires fucking idiots bc none of them can read or build a taco, ive asked for soft taco SUPREMES  everytime i go and i ALWAYS get regular tacos with no sour cream or tomatoes, this places sucks!!!

1/27/2016 Update: The quality of the food has improved quite a bit since my first visit. I've returned several times since but didn't want to post an update until I've tried several times to ensure the good food wasn't a one time thing. So the dishes I've tried is at the quality level of what I'd expect at Panda Express. I'm so happy I have a go to take out Chinese place near work.
Went here for the first time after a hot yoga class... so I already felt refreshed. And feasted on a shake and chikin sandwich. Perfection.

So JJ's has this really cool marketing initiative, where they give hoagie samples to local offices to pass around to their employees.  Today, we received a box of mini hoagie samples - and I was really impressed!

As a pregnant lady, who has been advised by doctors not to eat cold cuts, I thought I was X'ed out of the hoagie scene.  Not so much - as JJ's offered a delicious veggie option w/ provalone, cucumbers, tomato, lettuce & guac.  Totally surpassed my expectations & they've just won over a new customer!  Who said there was no such thing as a free lunch?!?

It was moving day for me and I decided to treat my friends (movers) to breakfast before we started packing and loading. I figured Corner Bakery would be a good choice since I hear my friends rave about their lunches quite often. Corner Bakery offers 5 different types of breakfast sandwiches with a choice of fruit or potatoes at an additional cost. After waiting in a comfy chair for a few minutes, my to-go bag was ready. 

The entire meal was packaged neatly with all utensils included. That, however, was the only part I liked about our breakfast. All of the sandwiches tasted the same, even though I ordered 5 different ones. Each sandwich was some form of bacon, egg, and cheese. By the time we ate, all of the bread was soggy and had the same consistency. I will not be paying close to $50 for 5 breakfasts and waters from this place in the near future.

This was absolutely the worst Popeyes chicken I have ever eaten it or from I would not recommend this particular restaurant on 52nd and Woodland ave . Biscuits were overcooked the chicken taste as though it had been cooked in old oil I'll never spend another dime in this particular restaurant and I wouldn't advise anyone else to either

If I could give this less stars I would. It was so nasty and flavorless that I literally couldn't eat a bite. I had the spice end platter and it was DISGUSTING. My fiancé had the chicken over rice and the only way she could eat it is by adding A LOT of seasoning. Weirdly we also tried a wrap and it was delicious (Chicken Tikka Roll) which makes me think they PURPOSELY didn't season these AT ALL. 

Seriously...I've been a delivery driver for the past few years here in the city (ubereats, caviar, postmates and doordash) but I can CONFIDENTLY say this is top 5 worst restaurant I ever tasted (and I like to eat)

OK, this is the first time I ever write a review on Yelp, since I generally prefer to leave a company to their own business. But this morning was an absolute disaster.
Order - 1 * Bacon and Cheese Panini (To go)... After 15 minutes of waiting, I asked about my order #63, and the girl behind the counter stares at me blankly, then walks over to an - already - ice cold panini in a plate, she confirms that this is my order and confirms that I ordered to go, then proceeds to wrap it up, hand it over to me, and casually informs me that the kitchen did not remove the egg. I ordered NO EGGS on this. 
I definitely do NOT care for all the haters of Yelp and how it ruins your business, perhaps if you cared more to train your staff to provide alternatives for customers, you will only receive positive feedback!

I ordered the shack burger and was a bit disappointed. The burger looks so sloppily made and there is no shack sauce on it.. I would like to give them another try,but maybe for the chicken and a shake. You guys can do better...

I wanted to try this place. Unfortunately the chestnut street location had stairs leading to the entrance. I think they should indicate if the particular location is wheelchair accessible or not. That way an informed decision can be made.
Love this fast food burger place...just don't look at the calories information right beside each food item on the panel LOL.

Good for what it is.  If you are looking for over the top... that's not really what this place is but it is for sure better than Cosi.  While I wish there was a panera in center city, this place is probably about as close as you can get.  It's clean, in a good location for commuters, or just a nice place to have a cup of coffee if you want to avoid the starbucks crowd.

My husband asks me to come in with him for a quick coffee and a bagel to take to work- sure, I'll try it. Never been there before. When the cashier says "next", we both step up- my husband orders first. Without even looking at me (who is standing right next to my husband), the cashier gives my husband his total. Um...hi? I'd like to order too. Cashier apologies, I ask for a toasted everything bagel with cream cheese. He repeats back to me "toasted everything bagel with cream cheese". I pay for "toasted everything with cream cheese". I get to my office, open the bag...there's a whole lot of napkins, a fork/knife/salt/pepper sachet, and my bagel...with no cream cheese. None in the bag either. 

So, thanks for the knife to spread my non-existant cream cheese. This may seem like a little hiccup, but with so many other places to grab a cup of coffee and a bagel, forgetting 1/2 of the bagel is enough to make me not go back there. If they can screw up a bagel when there's only a handful of people in the place, I don't have high hopes for anything else they do.

Best fast food burgers ever. This is one of those "good food fast" places and they pay attention to the quality of their ingredients. All locations are consistent around the country and this is right on par. Friendly and HAPPY staff which is why places like Shake Shack and In n Out succeed.

I will confidently say this burger blows in n out - out of the water!  It's a bit expensive, but you're paying for quality. The Smoke Shack is amazing. Cherry Peppers on a burger - freaking genius!  I don't even like peppers, but I CRAVE this burger. So glad one is coming to Buckhead. 

Also fries are very good. I like when there's still some skin. Next time you're headed to 5 guys, google to see if there is a shake shack near by, and go there instead. 

The best!
Amazing place! The fish bento is so good and the place is nicely decorated. I just like this restaurant. The milk tea is good. Popcorn chicken is good.

I'm glad to finally have a Chipotle close to work.  The burrito bowl with barbacoa is usually my go to order, and it's hit the spot every time I've ordered it.  Their hot sauce is spot on, and their guacamole is pretty delicious too.

The place can be a zoo during lunch hours, but you do have the option to pre-order online or with the Chipotle ap.

Location is great, and the fact that the place is basically one big window, there's lots of people watching there for the taking.  

Enjoy.

My first visit to a Shake Shack and I must say it was pretty good! I ordered the Chicago dog, fries, and salted caramel shake. Total was around $14. I walked from the Shack to my hotel which was approximately 3 or 4 blocks, and my food was still nice and hot when I got to my room. The fries were really well seasoned. I asked the worker for ketchup but ended up not needing it at all. The hot dog was very tasty. Messy, but tasty. And the shake was yummy too. All 3 employees who I interacted with at the Shack were all nice and friendly as well.

Enjoyed my first experience here. Real
Simple and good food. I picked out my salad, microwaved my grilled
Chicken and got my ice tea. Combined everything and was ready to eat in my car or outside. Very reasonable for what you get. Good value.

Eh. I can't say I'm impressed. I've been here twice.  

What I am pleased by is the "C-Line", reserved specifically for those ordering dessert (and looking to get in and out quickly, of course). 

On their second night of business, I got a Philadelphia Pretzel concrete. It was OK; but only that--OK. The custard was pretty good, but it was not wait 2 hours in line down 20th street good. (Mind you, I didn't wait that long. Again: the C-Line!). The pretzel bits were terrible! Is it actually pretzel? Whatever it was tasted stale and bland.

I'm also pleased at the availability of Draught Root Beer. I purchased this on a later visit. As a non-drinker, I'm always happy when a bar/restaurant puts a root beer on tap which could easily be taken up by another beer. However, they charge $2.65 for a "Regular" which equates to about 12 ounces. It's a bit steep, if you ask me. Especially if you add ice. 

One thing that my girlfriend noticed was the odd pricing for concretes:
If you order a "half" (which is plenty big for one person) a pre-made one is $4.25. Keep in mind their pre-made super-gourmet ones have 3 or 4 "add-ins". If you do a "design your own", which starts at $3.25 for a half, mix-ins are $0.55 each. When you add only two, you're spending more than the 4 mix-in predetermined concretes. If you want 4, you're spending $5.45 vs. $4.25. Okay, sure it's only $1.20 - cry me a river, right? I'd say it's a bit discouraging for those that want to be adventurous and create their own! 

Overall, I'd agree with the Yelp suggestion for 2 stars: "Meh. I've experienced better."

Skip the regular Shackburger and go for the Smokestack burger with applewood smoked bacon and cherry peppers. Makes all the difference! If you're feeling gluttonous, go for the Shack Stack with a burger patty and fried portobello mushroom filled with cheese. I always get the cheese crinkle-fries, though they are rolling out fresh-cut fries soon. The Brooklyn Brewery exclusive beer is also pretty tasty. 

If you have room, opt for the local Concrete blends. I've only had the Liberty Shell, but I'm hooked and haven't tried a different one. It has strawberry puree swirled into vanilla custard and the best part is Termini Bros cannoli pieces. 

One of these days I want to try a hot dog because I also love 'em. But the burgers are so dang good. A whole meal (esp. if alcohol is involved) can be pricey but wooooooorth it.

OK - I am upgrading corner bakery cafe for their excellent work with catering.
No, the food isn't all that wonderful - but it's better than lots of others we've had.  The cavatappi pasta salad (side) is great and the breads for the sandwiches are fresh and not sogged-out.

Nice presentation and better yet - they arrive on time and don't cost alot.  (Hot pasta meal for 8-10 is $90.)

Went there for lunch on the advice of my daughter. Ordered the Bistro Bella without onions and it was delicious. The place is small but there's a counter to sit and eat. The staff is young and friendly. I'll definitely go back again, probably tomorrow to try the kale lemonade I've heard good things about.

The business district of Center City tends to be a ghost-town on the weekends. So when the GF's folks were in town, we were surprised to see that the Corner Bakery was open on a Saturday morning. Needing some simple fuel for the typical tourist walk, we stopped in.

There's plenty of seasoning here - clearly capable of taking in the business crowd during the work week. 

Mac n Cheese & Caesar Salad Combo [$8.69]

The GF decided to go with the mac n cheese & salad combo. The macaroni was nicely al dente, with a sharp cheddar sauce coating the noodles - a bit wet for my taste, but certainly to the GF's liking. It came topped with bread crumbs and grilled bread on the side.

A side of caesar salad was decent - lettuce, shreds of Parmesan, and bread crumbs - hard to go wrong here. 

Anaheim Scrambler [$7.89]
Scrambled eggs, smoked bacon, tomatoes, green onions, cheddar, avocado

I was in the mood for a breakfast sandwich so went with one of their scrambler sandwiches. A melange of creamy avocado and scrambled eggs was accented nicely by the bite of green onion and the crispy bits of bacon. The cheddar brought it all together within the house-made bread, grilled on a panini. I was hoping for a side of home fries, but they were out shortly before noon.

So if you're looking for some simple fare with some house-made bread, check out Corner Bakery! There's no Panera on the west-side of City Hall, so this will definitely do!

Yum yum spice end is my favorite place to stop for food on a night out.. I rarely go otherwise all though there have been times when a kati roll is just calling my name. Through trial and error I have come to learn that my favorite roll is the aloo roll. If I'm feeling adventurous, I'll get the aloo paneer roll. Other rolls that I've liked after trying are, the chicken tikka roll and the paneer roll. Both great options. I've gotten a platter before, which was OK. Probably not worth the spike in price. OK, last tip before I sign off. USE THE WHITE SAUCE. It's there for a reason. The food isn't outrageously spicey - it's just the right amount for a spice vet like me. BUT the white sauce is like the Indian version of ranch. It's creamy, not too dill-y, and complements the kati rolls so well. High-five to spice end!

This is one of my favorite Philly lunch spots- Achari paneer roll is the way to go. 
The white sauce is pure angel jizz.

Not sure if they are just struggling through being a new place but very lackluster food experience: 

-Bulgogi Salad with Gochujang and guacamole $13; sadly this was virtually inedible after a couple of bites. It was so salty and bulgogi was cold. Not sure where the saltiness came from but was overall very very salty. Also the sauce and kimchi has A LOT of liquid so it got soggy really fast. I can't imagine actually getting it for takeout. Flavors were nothing to crave for. 

-1/2 rotisserie chicken with Spanish rice $12; not actually rotisserie chicken? The skin tastes great, but is fried and crispy. The chicken was rather dry as well. 

2 stars because service was great and food came out very quickly but honestly I think the general taste of the food needs to be improved.
Visiting from LA. Looking for some good Burgers. This place BLOWS away any burger I've ever had. Smokehouse burger is on point. Insanely tasty. Looking forward to this place franchising!!
Awesome food, great service. Love this place. We come every time we're in town. Try the gluten free muffins. Or the breakfast sandwiches

Have been here several times due to proximity. However, it has some of the most terrible services and unprofessional staff.

Also, do not ever place mobile orders with them. The staff here do not know how to access those mobile orders and will say "talk to corporate office, we don't have your order" to you, and let you leave.

I have placed several orders that went missing here, in which cases I basically paid for nothing and have to contact my banks to get the money back (because the corporate doesn't really have customer support). I have written to the corporate several times and they never seemed to engage with the problem in this location.

After trying another Taiwanese fried chicken place in town, I have to say this is the better one that actually has the right flavor with the five spice powder and everything, reminding me of street food in Taiwan. :) 

I gotta say though, the discount they offer for a 5-star rating on Yelp makes me shake my head. Nobody Elite is gonna do that if they don't deserve it haha. I'm also docking a star because when I asked for water, one member of staff was willing to give it to me for free while the other staff member awkwardly tried to dissuade her from doing it right in front of me..I see you...

Why haven't I had this yet? There wasn't much of a line during prime lunch time and I moved through quickly- order, pay, get buzzed, pick up food, enjoy. I think I got lucky, because I've walked by before, and, with a line wrapped down the block, I've wondered if they were giving something away. I had the ShackBurger, fries, and a b&w milkshake because it's fryday and you can't go to Shake Shack and forgo the shake. For a quick food (is that a thing?) place, the burger was great. It was tender and the veggies were fresh and crisp. The shacksauce on the burger was amazing and was that a potato roll? I like it. The crinkle cut fries were perfectly salty and the shake was heaven. My coworker mentioned she thinks they make them with custard, I think they make them with crack. Whatever they do, it's the perfect creamy dreamy treat. The burger and fries were actually cheaper than I expected- $5 something and $2 something. I thought $5 for the shake was a little pricey since that's what I was paying for the burger, but I'd probably do it again. Can we get a combo or something? Thanks.

THE WORST!!!! They always forget something in the drive through and they never put sour cream in my chalupa!! Once my husband and I were in the drive through and they rushed us to get our order, then when we paid we waited longer just to get our change.. doesn't make sense why rush us when their register doesn't even have enough change?! WORST CUSTOMER SERVICE. Wish I could give NO STARS. Not even one.
Good food, friendly service, and they have a recycling bin in house.
Love love love Hipcity Veg.. their breakfast was really good and filling. Satisfied customers :-)

This place has it all. Indian street food on point with spicy, flavorful satisfaction all around! Arnav was super friendly and helped us make the best choices for what we were craving. The vada pav and pav bhaji were our favorites but can't wait to try more!

I was so excited when I first found out a Shake Shack opened in my neighborhood, especially after my great experience when trying it for the first time in New York!

I have to admit I was a little disappointed with the food that I got from this location. I ordered the smokeshack burger with regular fries and shared a vanilla milkshake with my friend. The flavoring of the burger was great, I loved the surprise spiciness of the cherry peppers mixed with the smokey bacon taste but felt very gross after consuming the burger because it was sooooooo greasy. Both me and my friend felt gross and lost our appetites for the rest of the day. The vanilla milkshake was refreshing and creamy, it's definitely a 5/5. The fries were mehh, I've had better...wasn't anything special I haven't had before.

The service was fast. The cleaning crew was fast at taking away our trays and garbage.

I don't know if I will come back to this location just because it reminds me of how much it upset my stomach the last time I was there. Definitely room for improvement at this location!

This place is horrible.  I go from time to time out of convenience when I'm in a pinch, but each and every time, there has been an issue.  They are always out of things, including rolls during one visit!  The customer service is poor, and I'm fairly certain I was helped by an owner a couple times.  Corporate should really work more closely with their franchises to maintain the brand.  The only reason I'm giving two stars is because the sandwiches (when available) are decent.

Always great customer service here. You stare,  you order, you take a buzzer, you wait.
It usually takes about 10-15 mins to get food depending on the crowd volume. I went on a Tuesday evening around 6pm. 
Once the buzzer went off, it's a mad dash to the counter, anticipation overriding my mind. Condiments, water, napkins and utensils are laid out for you to grab on your own.
Got the smoke shack burger which was delicious. The peppers added a zesty pickled kick, which was a new experience for my taste buds.
I picked at my friends fries which were decent but I prefer my fries more crispy.
Their frozen custard was so creamy and smooth !
I come here every few months when someone needs to fill their SS fix. I personally think their are better burger joints in the city but when you don't want to go fast food but can't afford bougie joints, this is the place to go.
Tip: SS tastes amazing after a 5 mile run :)

Location: Spring Garden 
They are very friendly and the foot is amazing. So far I have tried the dry steak and the general tsos chicken. Both amazing.

3 Stars

I've been here several times. Still uncertain as to what all the hype is about. I think it a cool place, the staff is pleasant and the place is clean. I think the food there is meh, 10+ gets you a single, cheese fries and a drink which is pretty much par for the course at any burger place. The burger was a little more on the smaller side, the fries were seasoned well and not greasy. I am usually not a fan of krinkle cut fries but for some reason they are a hit. My friend lives and breathes the milkshakes, I saw the milkshake menu and wasn't particularly blown away at the variety and toppings. The time it takes for them to prepare the food is good too. In my opinion if you haven't heard of Shake Shack you aren't missing out and if you have heard of Shake Shack and you do try it, it won't meet expectations.

I was one of the first to try the shake shack in Philly even before opening day and I must say it was one of the best burger joints I have ever been to. You've gotta get a smoked shack or even just a shack burger. It will change your life.

Mmmm great cheese fries and good organic meat on their burgers - the place is spacious but beware it has a lot of fans and it can get quite crowded during lunch hours - a bit pricey for a burger but worth the occasional splurge!

I love snap kitchen! The prices are reasonable, the food is great and the portion size is perfect. At first I though the portions looked small but after eating their stuff a handfull of times for lunch and or dinner I realized it's perfect. 

You also can get $10 credit by downloading their app! (Code: CMCA-WT2)

Their sweet potatoes are amazing and I loveee their chicken enchiladas. I need to try more of their food, but it's hard to resist both of those because they do a great job with them.

I will definitely be eating here a lot. I plan to try their breakfast food next!

Just checked out this place today, I'm sorry I didn't find it until now. The sign is super colorful, and I found that the rolls pack just as much of a puch. Lots of flavor! I got the lamb roll and my boyfriend got the chicken and egg roll. It was cheap, fast, friendly service. In and out in less than the 1/2 lunch break I get. I'll definitely be going back.

Yes, it's just a burger,fries, and shake place. I like the food, I enjoy coming here on my cheat day to enjoy eating the fries. Love the crinkle cut. But what makes this place stand out is the customer service. The employees seems to have fun at work which shows greatly. They are pleasant, attentive, and helpful. That is what makes a place successful. Yes, you need good food too but having great customer service is key also. It's nice to see employees who really enjoy the job atmosphere. Hope management does my change that.

It is what it is: Get yo chicken and leave. 

~ The service ranges from Shit to God-aweful.  So what, it's Popeyes! 

~A bum may belch over your food while begging for change. So what, it's Popeyes! 

~A fat-chick in stretch-shirt and Uggs may pay with cash from her sweaty bra. So what, it's Popeyes! 

It's fast. It's crispy. It's good. I don't care how stereotypical it is. Popeye's at Broad and Snyder has good chicken and has some of the best people watching in town.

Chicken and Rice platter is delicious especially with the white sauce. Place is small but for what they serve its perfect for a quick bite to eat. Food comes out fast and is delicious and well priced.

I never got my food...
Called grubhub that couldn't locate the driver...?
Poor experience...

Second time trying HipCity Veg and nothing really stood out for me other than the cost.

I had a veggie burger that was almost $12.

I get that it's vegan food which is costly, but just a burger for $12.00 is a bit much. 

Not sure when I will be back.

This place has the worst hours! Came here at 6:36pm on a weekday night hoping for a pick-me-up after a long day, and it was CLOSED. Why have such bad hours, especially when it's so close to Jefferson Station? Seriously missing out on a business opportunity with the deluge of commuters. This place also doesn't have Mac n Cheese, so don't get your hopes up. I did manage to eat here once though (long queue, be forewarned), and it's standard good Chick-fil-A fare.

While this place a bit over priced for an order and sit jaunt, the food is amazing. Their burgers are a bit small, so you can justify getting a double. I however chose to save room from fries and a root beer float. Their root beer is brewed by Abita, so you won't get any of that fountain soda nonsense. I highly recommend. 

Awesome life decision on a Friday after a thirsty Thursday. The price and bit of a long wait were the only pitfalls.
So yummy! Food came out quickly. Everything tastes fresh and it was made to order! Also, free refills on coffee is a plus!

Last time I came to HipCityVeg, I loved it, but when I ordered through postmates, I was dissatisfied. They didn't give any of the special sauce that they  usually give, it was so dried. I tried to contact postmates about it and they was like, "we're going to contact the owners, but we're unable to do anything about your order." I won't be ever ordering through postmates,, because they always mess your order and you're unable to  do anything about it. Make sure you check your sandwich before you leave.

After years of seeing Shake Shack appear on my FB news feed and reading about the throes of people who brave long lines for this establishment, it was time for me to see what all the hype was about. Luckily, the Philly location was line-less and there was no wait at all. Good thing, because I would have been annoyed about having to wait for an overly hyped burger and an overly sweet vanilla shake.

The cheeseburger was just OK. What was unique about it was its bun - a potato roll toasted in butter. This stood out versus other buns I've had. I thought the meat patty was on the thinner side, especially given the price. All other ingredients (lettuce, tomato, pickle, onion) were fresh but that's a given in the specialty burger joint world these days. The burger's topped with a thousand island sauce that's thicker than In n Out's version.

If given the choice, I'd take In n Out over Shake Shack any day...better burgers (better shakes too, not as sweet) and better value.

Arrived at five minutes till 11 AM and tried to order lunch. A ignorant young girl behind the counter said we don't serve until 11. Came back five minutes later, she said we don't start serving lunch to 11:30 AM. I decided not to eat here.And then on my way out I saw a mouse run across my feet. Probably the best thing that happened after seeing the individuals that work in the store...
Good food, but they don't accept gift cards! And the company when I emailed them was just like "sorry about that."

After a lot of soul searching and chewing, Shake Shack had finally grown on me. They've nailed their execution here in town and have become a great casual dining establishment in our beloved city with multiple locations.

In hindsight, this service suffered from a rush opening, crowded lines, and hurried expediting. All of that has been remedied and I'm pleased to announce that I now visit once a month (at least).

With the addition of the a Chicken Shack, they've become a favored location here in town.

Oh my! I'm a little embarrassed to say I had only been to HCV for "Groothies" (their trademark Green Smoothies). Not sure what kept me from an entire meal here, but that will certainly change!! 

I must start by saying I had no idea the mastermind, a fellow Philly native behind this cool urban 100% plant based, casual fast(er) food joint is also responsible for Charlie Was A Sinner, the uber hip, sexy vegan lounge and fine(r) dining joint, also in Philly. It all makes sense now. 

Stopped by on a weeknight for a to-go pickup from this, the newest (and my new favorite) of three locations in Philly. The place wasn't too crowded despite it being tiny. Our order was ready promptly and exactly how we asked for it. 

For the littles, we went with the lil nugget meals which include chick'n pieces and sweet potato fries. I just HAD to have a taste some of their "kiddie meals". Verdict? Yummo! I noticed the nuggets had an oat breading! Love that! My one daughter commented they were a tad dry to which I handed her the black bean sauce an aioli which came complimentary. She enjoyed dipping and favored the black bean sauce. She had no further issues. I actually had to call to make sure these sauces were vegan as they were both so creamy and sinful tasting! Fries were good and thick. Mamas, this is a great, easy, healthier food option!

We all split a chocolate milkshake with reminded me of a melted "frostee". Again, it was hard to believe this too was vegan. Perfect chocolate notes and smooth consistency! 

What really blew me away however was the jerk chick'n Caesar salad. Wow! It comes with plantain chips,  jicama, & creamy island spiced dressing. We opted to add avocado for $1 up-charge. First of all, I sat and dissected the chick'n. It looked so real I had a difficult time believing it wasn't. This meal is one for the meat eaters. What they achieve with this chick'n is unreal! It was perfectly blackened and almost had a pulled consistency. It was full of a smoky flavor. The kind that hits you in the back of the throat...in a good way. The creamy tangy dressing was given generously and again, was so sinful tasting. The smoothness of the avocado balanced with the crisp chips and juicy jicama cubes...just so perfect! The salad was an outstanding blend of so many flavors and textures. One of my new favorite salads in the entire city! Hubs doesn't know it yet, but will certainly be picking this up for me on the regular on his way home from work. 

These treats were all so delish it made me wonder just how calorie heavy they were. Come to find out...not too much. The highest thing on the menu which was the Philly steak came in at 550! Win!

Many items can be made GF upon request. 

I can't wait to come back and try "lox" on a bagel for breakfast! This is the only location that offers am goods and they serve La Colombe. We will always keep our eyes peeled for the shake of the month. 

I love this spot. I love supporting local. I love supporting female entrepreneurs. And I love their philosophy so much...."Embracing healthy bodies, a healthy planet, and compassion for all living things." 

Fan for life!!

This place is pretty busy around lunch time - prob from all the Jefferson students/doctors/patients nearby.  I usually get the tuna club on wheat.  If you're hungry, it will still fill you up.  The bread is thickly sliced and surrounds a large portion of tuna salad, cheese, lettuce, sprouts (optional), tomato, and onion (I always get this added).  

Can't say I'm mad this is here.  Wish they would deliver north of Chinatown, though - for when I'm feeling too lazy or busy to cook or get out to get something to eat.

Excellent food truck. Definitely a nice change from the ubiquitous bacon egg and cheese trucks and halal carts. The food is fresh, reasonably priced, and cooked to order. Big portions too. I've tried the orange peel chicken and the chili garlic chicken, both over jasmine rice. Both are delicious and highly recommended.

This was one of my first experiences trying Indian food, and I was impressed. You need to try the rolls. I recommend the Beef Tikka Roll! They are also opening a new location on South Street, which I am excited about. I look forward to coming back! Thanks!

Grabbed lunch with a great client.

Heard it was good but wow! Smoke shack burger rocked.

Obviously if you have eaten at subway before the food is the same at every location the difference is the staff.  This subway is HORRIBLE for service.  They have two girls that work there that are friendly and polite.  Every other girl they have working there is just down right rude.  One girl even tries to put less meat on your sandwich if she thinks you are not looking.  They act like it is an inconvenience if you have to ask them what kind of soup they have but you always have to ask because they never update the board that tells you.  I, unfortunatly, am stuck going to this location if I want subway for lunch because I only have a short lunch break and this is the only location that I am able to make it to in my time frame.  If you are able to avoid this subway I would definatly reccomend finding a different location.

Doh! I didn't know you could order that delicious culinary magic known as white sauce here. Don't make my mistake, friends. I will come try the rolls with sauce and report back. In the mean time, here is my review for now:

I got a aloo (potato) kati roll and sadly, I was underwhelmed. There may be better options on the menu, but the paratha which forms the base of every roll was a little uninspired. Maybe the rolls I'm used to are just insanely buttery (actually that would explain a lot...), but I'm used to the paratha being way more flaky and rich.

I've been waiting and waiting for Shake Shack to open, of course it finally did right before my sister's wedding, so I decided I would have to wait a few more weeks.  I finally stopped in after work around 5:20, no line to speak of = time to try it.  I got the shack burger and fries and took them home.  The fries were cold and not very good by the time I got home, so unless you live/work very close, I would advise against take out.  My burger was juicy, and definitely has that Pat LaFrieda taste you get at Pub and Kitchen, but I thought it was super salty, and I thought the cheese was weird.  Next time, I'm going to try a plain hamburger.  And I definitely want to try the sweet treats.  I was worried this would be the downfall of my healthy eating because it's so close to my office, but I don't think it will be a problem.  I think it's better than 5 guys, but not 500 degrees, and In n' Out is still my favorite quick burger place.

This one is horrible. I would NEVER EVER go there again. The food is dried up. The speaker girl is rude,impatient and not familiar with the menu at all. There aren't many customers in the restaurant. Go figure. It was such a horrible experience in a short time! With that attitude no wonder their business is bad!

I usually don't do reviews for chain restaurants - most people know either from experience or word of mouth whether a place like this is good or not.

However, I'd like to review this particular location because of how kind, friendly, and accommodating their staff are. I use this Jimmy John's not only for frequent on campus dinners when I'm at Jefferson's library, but also to walk through here on cold/rainy days when I'm leaving class as it is attached to one of the campus buildings.

Each and every one of the workers here is so nice and this alone draws me back to the place when I'm debating between a few spots to grab a bite. 

A little kindness can go a long way and this location drums up a lot of business this way, at least from me!

I've been to Shake Shack many many times and I'll always go back! 

Service | There was a line when I went but it went by quick. The cashier was friendly, attentive and efficient. I was given the buzzer and it didn't take long till it vibrated to let me know my food is ready. 

Food | I got the Shack-a-dog this time and it was good. The only thing I can complain about it was the bread was soggy when I got it so the hotdog slipped out on first bite. I also ordered the strawberry milkshake and fries and finished it all! Everything in their menu I've tried but I'm either loving the hotdog or the Smoke Shack. The fries are fried and seasoned to perfection, not too salty. The shake was creamy and not too sweet. 

Overall | Fun place to grab a quick bite with your friends and even pooches! Friendly staff and yummy food (for your dogs too).

Oh man, all I can say is WOW! This is literally the closest you can find to the original platters in NYC. The platter was DELICIOUS and the hot sauce was actually hot... Usually most hot sauces aren't even hot so it was refreshing to see someone doing it right. I got the mixed platter along with a lamb kati roll. The platter was amazing but the lamb kati roll was okay nothing special. The lamb in the kati roll was just okay so it wasnt as great as I had expected but maybe im just being picky.
