A new custard on the menu daily, as a desert or even a shake. Kids have had the purple cow float many times but I discourage it because they gobbled it up and don't eat their dinner.
Great for take out or eat in, tables in the back and two TVs with streaming sports. 
Go and get your burger fix!

Can't go wrong with the chicken plate or chicken and lamb plate. Self-serve red and white sauces. The presentation is really similar to Halal Guys, with finely diced meat over rice and a small bit of salad on the side. It's not chicken and rice off the street or doesn't compare to New York gyro in anyway. However, it hits the spot and is a lot of food for the money. Mint lemonade is a great way to compliment any meal.

This has honestly have to be the most shittiest chipotle I've ever been to. I'm a vegetarian so I need all the proteins I can get, but when a worker can't even make a damn burrito then that's not something I take lightly. Literally 25% of the burrito was trashed every time the worker had tried to fold the burrito.. I end up paying 10 bucks for half the shit that the worker originally put all because she didn't know how to make it Two times and decided not to transfer all the contents every time she tried. I don't know if this worker being lazy, the worker not knowing how to make a damn burrito, or the worker being tired which I don't care for because she is paid for this, but as a vegetarian, losing protein like that for shitty service is not acceptable. Never coming back just to waste money.

It took me a long time to come back to Shake Shack because of my severe allergy to the crowds at this Center City location, but now I've been back twice in only a few months. The lines have largely disappeared since my last experience, and it is fairly easy to find a table now. Ordering food/drink is quick and easy with the efficient staff--before you know it, you will be holding a buzzer and waiting for your food.

I was tired of the burgers because I've always felt the regular size is just a little too small for the price, so I went for the chicken this time. I am in love. A large piece of fried chicken with just the right amount of crunch to the batter is plainly dressed with some lettuce and pickles, making the $6 price feel worth it. I also had a chocolate shake (nice and thick, but not so much so that you can't use a straw), and some of my friend's cheese fries. The cheese was in sauce form instead of shredded and melted, so it got a bit congealed after a while.

Shake Shack is a great option if you are looking for a quick and tasty meal that won't make you feel completely bloated afterwards (although I can't speak for you if you order alcohol).
Everything tasted SO burnt and gross. Only thing that was edible was the cinnamon bites and the soda. Everything else was garbage

So so if that.  I had a mushroom burger and fries.  Fries were less than good, tasted like they were once frozen. Mush burger was so so  - not a lot of taste.  Just something fried w cheese in the middle. No reason to go back really.

I decided to drop by because of the enticing fried squid on the window display and the yelp reviews were positive. 

Shame on those of you who rated this place 5 stars for 5% off your tab (they have a sign that offers 5% off if you rate them 5 stars on yelp). Shame on you!

This is a review for just the fried squid and bubble tea. The batter itself didn't taste bad but the oil tasted like it hasn't been changed in a while. The squid also wasn't entirely covered with batter in fact the batter fell off quite easily which was disappointing because you end up eating the batter and squid separately. For 8 dollars, I was expecting more. We got the oolong bubble tea and it was prettt good but given the 73728 bubble tea shops in Chinatown, it's not worth stopping by. 

The restaurant was empty when I visited on a weekday afternoon. The music was next to the cash register and the cashier spoke so softly that you had to guess what he was saying.

Paneer tikka kathi rolls was awesome!! It reminded me of my Delhi - days!! The roti was so soft and paneer was moist juicy and flavorful!!! Loved it!! Though I thought chicken tikka roll was average. The chicken was dry and had no flavors!! Go for paneer tikka roll!! The service is quick since options are limited.chicken biryani was good but had no salt in it!!!

Shake Shack is just one of those places. I remember seeing the line WRAPPED around the block when it opened and thinking "eh it's a burger, I'll wait". 

Now I find myself frequenting this location when I'm in need of something quick, delicious and bad for my health. 

The 'Shroom Burger stuff with melted cheese and then deep fried is everything you want on a cheat day. The cheddar cheese sauce for the fries is delightful. The milkshakes are overly decadent. 

They also have a few beers on tap. Everything is super fresh and delicious.

Alright guys, I had to check out the HYPE of Snap Kitchen and boy, am I glad I did! This place is GENIUS. For those of you who are trying to eat healthy, control calories/carbs, but make excuses that you don't have time to meal prep and can't eat properly because of a hectic schedule...Snap Kitchen is your answer! I highly recommend picking up some meals for the week - especially if you seem to catch yourself wasting a lot of groceries and throwing away fruits and veggies because your lunch/dinner plans are always up-in-the-air. Not only is it the perfect amount of quality food, everything ACTUALLY TASTES SO DELICIOUS. Yes, it may seem a little pricey but I typically end up paying the same amount when purchasing groceries for the week.

Came to this location a few days ago. We were looking to grab a Quick bite before we had to be somewhere. We walked in the door and had about 45 minutes to spare. Figuring this would be enough time we decided to order our food to stay. There was maybe one or two people in front of us when we placed our order and about 4 people after us.
Then we waited. And waited. And waited.
During all of the wait time, there were two employees on the other side of the counter who were wearing the same gloves the whole time. This means they were handling cash and credit cards, answering the phone, as well as touching customer's food without washing their hands or at least changing the gloves in between tasks. 
Usually waiting for food means that you get hungrier and hungrier. In this case we continually lost our appetites watching the germs being spread throughout the establishment.
Meanwhile, we were still waiting. Our food took well over a half hour and i had to ask them to wrap it to-go. Not only that, but the people who ordered after us were getting their orders before us. I understand this can happen based on specific items taking more or less time than others, but I have never experienced this length of wait time even while frequenting the full service restaurants owned by the same company. Plus, there were two more employees that seemed to be coming in for their shift just standing there chatting with the employees, slowing things further instead of helping out. 
I really wish someone had acknowledged our wait and at least apologized, or maybe just washed their hands.

WHAT IS WRONG WITH THIS PLACE AND THE MANAGEMENT. You guys are okay with having 10 kids in the bathroom not buying anything and yet make racist comments at us because we are Asian. The worker clearly saw what they were doing to my husband and yet they didn't do anything why?! The workers here are rude when we didn't do anything to them but be polite. I understand it's a fast food restaurant but at the end of the day, McDonald is a FRANCHISE and they need to be consistent across the country. We won't be returning for sure. The bathroom is so DISGUSTING. NO TOILET PAPER in the women's bathroom and in the men's bathroom, bunch of kids will hangout and harass you. This place needs to improve in so many different aspects.
Been there with my colleagues for a weekday lunch. Service was fast. The lamb kebab roll was awesome. The sauces were too good. I would highly recommend the place.

Located in the same spot if the short-lived ramen/noodle shop. Possibly same owner. 

Tried chicken teriyaki bowl. Friend got tofu bowl. Both were really tasty. Good amount of rice provided. Only complaint or request is that the bowls would be so much better with veg like broccoli in it. 

Meal was much more filling than expected. Quick and friendly service. Would go again for weekday lunch. 

Only negative: No air conditioning on day I went which was a little uncomfortable.

I usually don't like to leave reviews for chain restaurants, especially Chipotle that seems to have no standards, each restaurant just adds whatever portion they feel like...but this Chipotle became my favorite ever !! I've been here a couple of times since I moved to Philly and they are very consistent. Besides, the staff is always super nice!!! I've also placed some orders online and they are ready right on time.

My husband and I used to eat at Popeyes a lot growing up but haven't in the last few years...until the chicken sandwich. My husbands a huge chik-fil-a chicken sandwich fan but I'm 100% Popeyes! We get the spicy chicken sandwich with extra spicy sauce - so. good. Crispy, big piece of chicken, saucy and spicy. Chik fil a is too bland to me. Obviously not the highest quality meat but it's fast food, what did you expect? It's great for what it is in my opinion! This location seems cleaner and better service than the on broad, closest to Washington.

I was really happy with my delivery order early this week that I'm ordering from them again! Their a
Philly steak sandwich is AMAZING! quick delivery and the food was hot!

I almost never take the time to review places, especially chains-let alone  "fast food" -but i need to point out that this particular location has unbelievable service. I have celiacs. The first time i visited i was unsure of how much safety i could expect from a place that exclusively makes sandwiches. 
As soon as i asked about the gluten free options, they asked me if it was an allergy and said that hey would be super careful. They changed their gloves, took APART and cleaned the slicer, wiped down the surfaces, got new knives and spreaders and told me allcth omg was fuentes that i should avoid. While all of this is slectacular, it's not as impressive and extraordinary as the attitude they had while doing all of this. 
After many years in service industry, i know how common it is for p pole to insist ten times over that they have a serious allergy and then "sneek" a peice of someone's breaded this or that or order a straight up wheat beer, etc.. I tend to be skeptical too, for that reason. Not only did they take me seriously but they didn't treat it like annoyance or a burden at ALL- even though that had to do about 3 times the work than a regular order. My first visit, he asked me questions about what kind of gluten free things i like, how long it's been since i've had really good pizza and joked with me while he made my sandwich. 
I travel through 30th street station regularly and because of how consistently kind and accommodating the straff is, i've made Jersey Mike's my go-to for lunch. I keep expecting to one of these days have a lethargic, sub-par experience, but it never happens! Every single time, they are just as helpful and thorough and that is pretty rare. So, thank you!

This unassuming location is a delight for starving vegans  in need of a quick bite. We were at a hotel near city hall and were within walking distance. I have tried this franchise before but it has been some time and I was happy to see how much they have grown. This location--much like the others is small, but it does have dine-in space in a beautiful spill off room. Granted, there's only about 6 tables in there soo grab one after placing your order and the staff will bring your order right out to you. 
While we're there give the Crispy HipCity ranch a try, note that you can have it prepared as a sandwich or a wrap. You will need to be specific or it defaults to a sandwich. Also give the nuggets a try, if you prefer your food crisp I would ask them to fry em a little longer.

Really slow service for take out. Chicken has absolutely zero sauce. It does have flavor but its dry, I had to put about 6 things of sauce on to make it taste right. Overall, go to the food trucks for half the price and a better product (with a free drink too.)

Snap Kitchen is like stepping into a sterile galley on a spaceship.  The fluorescent lighting and meticulous shelves of boxed food containers just seemed very strange and cold.  Speaking of cold, the food is that and expensive.  Two small banana pancakes were $5.99--and you have to pay an extra 99 cents for a thimble of maple syrup.  Many of the entrees are extremely pricey, which is not conducive to the promotion of wholesome and healthy eating.  Also, I've learned that nuking food in a microwave is an unhealthy, if not dangerous, practice because zapping your food actually destroys many of the beneficial nutrients.  It's always disappointing when eating well doesn't align with a reasonable budget.

Plenty of options with varying portion sizes. Everything I've tried here is flavorful. Key lime pie made with Greek yogurt and crush pecans is a tasty & healthy dessert option. Another bonus - the staff are always friendly.

I'm really nice, and that's why this place is getting a 4 instead of a 3. They're also looking out for the dogs and people that love beer. Way to look out for man's best friend! The alcohol is really the reason for the 4. The shack burger looks incredibly clean and picturesque. Because of that, I wanted to up the ante by getting the SmokeShack burger, which you can get with everything that comes with the regular ShackBurger. Pretty good stuff! I felt like it was mildly greasy without feeling too guilty. Overall, the burgers are a little small for my liking. I know that they've ditched the crinkle-cut fries and brought them back, but I can't get down with them or the cheese on it. The fries just do not have that fresh feel to me, because they are frozen and twice fried. The cheese has this strange artificial taste that I can't get past.

At my most recent visit, the cashier I had may not be the brightest individual. I said the name for the order twice, and spelled it, and he still managed to get incredibly wrong. :( Customer service is generally good aside from that. I've heard great things about their concretes. I have not tried them, so I cannot speak on them or the dog treats, since humans don't eat dog food, obviously.

I have passed the Corner Bakery for years and went in for the first time last week. The commuter crossiant is soooo good. Eggs, tomato, cheese and bacon good. The meatball and pasta is great as well and comes with garlic bread and a side. It is filling as a dinner. My boyfriend loved the mac and bacon. Also you can get made to order breakfast sandwiches. The staff is so friendly. It isn't the quickest service but it is worth the wait.

5 people in the front working and I'm standing here waiting to order while the cashier is lining up French fries containers on the counter slowly. Workers here must be mildly retarded. Been here 20 mins and no food yet. Fast food? Not here. Funny thing is I was first in line. -5 stars if I could. Is there even a manager in this place? Nobody acts like one in there. Bathroom has a strong odor of urine like a homeless man that pissed in his pants two months ago.

The milkshakes here are sooooo yummy! I loved the salted caramel one and the black and white was pretty perfect too. The service is quick and when you're having a fat kid Friday, they have all deliciously bad things you could want. I had the cheeseburger and cheese fries and P had the cheeseburger and hot dog. All were good, but I think I'd rather skip the food and just come back for the milkshakes, which are exceptional.

I was at 30th Street waiting to take a train to Washington DC for the AIPAC Policy Conference. I had some time to spare so I decided to pick up a Jersey Mike's sub for the train. 

I had never been to a Jersey Mike's Subs before today, but I have been to Subway, which I like. 

First, Jersey Mike's has all the meats and cheeses in a refrigerator in front of you in a fridge. I even saw them cutting the meats and cheeses up right there. 

I decided to go with cold roast beef sandwich on a seeded roll. It also came out nice and fast. 

I eventually, had the sub about half-way through the train ride and it was pretty good. The roast beef was tender and full of flavor and the provolone cheese went perfect with it. I also loved the seeded roll, which tasted fresh and was nice and tasty. 

Altogether, this Jersey Mike's located in 30th Street Station serves some great, tasty subs.

This was the worst experience of my life. I came here only for the sandwich, and was told that they stop making sandwiches after 10:00. When I came in at 10:05! I'm pretty sure the cashier doesn't speak English, and an innocent child slipped and fell on the extremely damp floor! Never coming back here again!

Oh my gosh, I absolutely hated my food here.  I got the vegetarian Dan Dan noodles, and they had zero flavor aside from a completely overpowering smoky charcoal flavor.  Inedible.  For the same price you can walk a block or two to Su Xing, relax in a nice quiet restaurant, and get the lunch special, with entree, side, soup, and tea.  Which is, in fact, exactly what I did!

I ate here a few times while I was visiting Philly, mainly because they were close to the conference I was attending.  But, I was not disappointed with my options and food.  It was pretty delicious and filling.  The menu is diverse, has a lot of good protein options, and is very fresh - sometimes you just want a fresh salad that isn't too light, but just right?  This is the place.

I would say they are a little pricey - I wasn't paying, so I didn't pay too much attention, but there are cheaper vegetarian and vegan eats in the city.  Still, for center city prices, this is a great buy.

Such a delight to have a "healthier" option for Chinese. I got the General Chicken over rice.  The food is not bad I just wish they added more sauce to give it more flavor.  It is pricier than your usual Chinese food truck but what "healthy food" isn't more costly.  I'm going to give them another shot and try a dish with noodles and ask for extra sauce.  Like extra extra sauce.

Ignorant ass staff. Drive thru is the worst in the city . As if you are bothering them when you are ordering. After you  place an item to order you hear "mhmm" or "that all" . I've banned this from visiting anymore. #CessPool

Shake Shack in Philly yes :) Might not have the NYC feeling but food is identical and you get the actual Philadelphia feeling which I like more than NY. Same service as every Shake Shack but has shorter lines

We just walked in and out of this place for the second time - sandwiches are always good but the music is always comically loud! It's doesn't exactly fit the atmosphere and the employees can't even hear the customers order. Very weird.
A shitshow of crackheads, dealers, and stupid people who've never seen a drive thru before and take 10 minutes to make an order. Staff is nice though, so the star is for them. I don't envy that job.

You are famous for your burgers and shakes? Ughh
Burger is so less than average and shake which I just got is making me sick. 
Dont waste your money and pick other burger place!!!!!
I always wonder "WHY?!" when a friend wants to eat here (twice now in the past 6 months).  There are so many other options here that blow this chain away.
So the health department closed this dump down, job well done. Never have I ever experienced such rude service and to top it off my food was cold and the store was dirty.

I came here one day on my walk back to the train, I was shocked to find out that they only had one type of cheese to offer(provolone). WHAT KIND OF SANDWICH PLACE DOESNT HAVE MORE THAN ONE TYPE OF CHEESE?! Also, the staff was very rude and insisted that I try the provolone and that I would like it... I'm 31 years old, I'm pretty sure I know what kind of cheese I want on my sandwich by now... And that would be American, Swiss, or Cooper sharp. Never going back. They need to get it together over there.

Staff needs to learn about sanitation and disinfection.  The girl making my sandwich was holding and swiping through her phone before and during making my sandwich.  She was wearing plastic gloves, however after she touched her filthy phone she didn't change gloves.  She then proceeded to put her germ infested phone on the supposedly sterile countertops where they make the sandwiches.

I love Shake Shack, but this is definitely thee best location!! (20th and Sansom) Mike and his staff are professional and courteous to their guests. It is always clean and the food is always cooked to perfection.

Went to Shake Shack on Sansom Street with co-workers.  One of my co-workers had insisted that the chicken sandwich there was the best ever and that we had to try it.  The burgers there are awesome, so we assumed the chicken sandwich would be awesome as well.  The location is great, the place is cute, and the service was friendly.  Unfortunately, my chicken "SAND"wich was very disappointing.  There was what felt like gritty sand in my sandwich.  Assuming it came from the lettuce.  All three of us had the same issue with our chicken sandwiches.  Two of us had already eaten most of our sandwiches when the third person finally said something, and he went to complain - only to suggest that they not use the lettuce anymore for future customers.  He was given a replacement sandwich, and the employee who handled the complaint was very gracious, and even brought out fresh hot fries.  BUT his second sandwich had the gritty sand in it as well.  This was a disappointment.  I have been to the original Shake Shack location in Manhattan numerous times over a decade ago, and have been a great fan of the burgers since then, often enjoying burgers and fries and shakes at the various locations in the Philly area since moving back home.  But having sand in a chicken sandwich makes me not want to go back.  =(

Shake Shacks not in Madison Square Park have always been a little overrated to me.  i know hoards of people are now out to kill me for saying that...  But, really, if you go across the street from this one in Philly, you can get the best burger in the city at Village Whisky.  If you go up the block, Starr's Dandelion Pub also has a wonderful burger.  That being said, Shake Shack is fairly fast and low key, and it is a little cheaper than the others mentioned.

This review is not about the food, but the bad and slow service, and sometimes on top of that; you might get some attitude. The food itself is ok, and boy I love Chipotle.  Since I live nearby, I go ( and will still keep going) there whenever I'm lazy and starving, or if I'm simply craving some Chipotle burrito bowl. If it wasn't for the Bowl, I wouldn't cope with the crappy service, which it, to be honest, a hit or miss. One other thing won't be easily missed: The ridiculously long lunchtime line. 

Three Yelps.

Amazing service and great fresh food . Haven't seen anywhere else where an employee would come to the table and offer soda refills ... 
Good job keep it up guys .

This review deserves a 0 star!! I ordered choose 2 Mac & cheese and cheddar broccoli soup. When my order came out, It included the Mac & cheese, but not the soup. Instead, I was given a meatball panini. I was not given a receipt to confirm with the waiter, but luckily the waiter had a receipt and confirmed I was supposed to get the soup instead. He had told me to keep the sandwich and he would be right back with the soup. A couple minutes later, the waiter comes back with an empty plate and proceeded to ask me to grab a napkin and place the sandwich that I already had touched back on the plate. 

WHAT THE HECK??? I already touched the sandwich and now you are taking It back?! That's disgusting. They're probably taking back the sandwich to give It to someone else. That's absolutely disgusting.
Who ever the chef was who made the quarter pounders on the night may 17 is the fucking best chef in the world. I got my burger done medium with pickles evenly distributed and cheese perfectly placed.
Amazing food,fast service, and Covid regulations followed. Will definitely go back when in town!

Worst Chick fil A I have ever been to. I hope my review helps bring attention to the issues here. 

Scene: 11:30 am on a Saturday

No lemonade. As in the dispensers were totally empty. How is this possible at a Chick fil A?!

Got a sweet tea instead. It tasted like water so I had to return for a Diet Coke. As I was doing this another woman was returning her Sprite which she said didn't taste like a Sprite, and another woman was returning a sweet tea too.

Food is fine but below average for a Chick fil A.

They don't accept the app.

Limited menu choices. 

Indifferent employees.

Omg we loved Chipoltle! And I'm so glad they got their issues figured out. 
    Today while roaming around we ran across this store. And what a perfect day for it! Cold outside and warm inside. I love the Carnitas burrito and Bf loves the bowl. Our food was quite fabulous tonite. It been quite awhile. 
    We sat looking at the line workers and two asian guys were staring looking at the menu trying to figure it out. So I swallowed and told them how it works. They both got bowls and sat down to eat!  Everybody happy happy happy!! Sorry no pix... ate it all

Foods themselves are nice.  But they fuck up my orders twice in a row.

I ordered 2 tacos online and I got only 2 - I noticed pretty quickly on my way home and went back to the store.  They fixed it right away.

I ordered many items on the side online, they forgot them all - I noticed after I got home and did not want to go back to get.


Seems like some cooks are lazy, not paying attention, or not care at all.  

I never had that kind of experience at Chipotle at another locations (in another states).  So, this location is a quite disappointment.

Great location but that's about it.  Waited 25 minutes (not even busy) for a $14 " salad" that was 99% soggy shredded lettuce, poor customer service, and an a attitude when i asked for an update on my order.  Won't be back

I just don't know WHY so many people in opur office love this place?  They rave about the ham on pretzel bread (MEH).  They rave about the salads (MEH).

They even rave about the Cinnamon cream cake - and while it does taste awesome - a "serving" is over 1100 calories.

No thanks.

I'll walk across the Street to the snob-cast center instead for some local (NOT!) goodies from La Scala.

It's OK - but it's just MEH.

I know you're waiting for this review BK. I mobile ordered a family bundle and ordered onion rings additionally. I ordered my cheeseburger with no ketchup. There was a 20 minute wait before we were given our order. I got home and all three burgers had ketchup. And missing an order of fries. I am allergic to tomatoes. I took a picture to show the manager. Did she even take the time to look? I was told that I had to bring the whole order back. The order the kids had been waiting for and started eating. I was made to feel like my complaint wasn't warranted. One even asked me if I wanted another burger. YES I BROUGHT IT BACK TO REPLACE! You're weren't doing me a favor by replacing the burger and giving me the fries I paid for. And was inconvenienced by having to come back. And placing hot food on top of cold drinks then sealing them makes no sense.

The  difference from when they first opened and now is a huge difference. The workers have just become lazier and lazier even when business is slow. Look at this sandwich. None of the topping that I wanted was placed on there. Smfh

This chain from NYC serves flavorful fast  food burgers,  but even better chicken sandwiches, both regular and spicy. I can find better burgers elsewhere but their chicken sandwhich is my favorite in the city.  The fries are good, the shakes average. 

So why only 2 stars for a location with the best chicken sandwhich in the city? Well... Unfortunately, this location got caught in a tv expose showing they have mice partying in the restaurant after hours. I hope the embarrassment has spurred them to take action and clean up their act.

Grub Hub driver shows up late apologizing, saying "That place is the worst! Your order is probably wrong too."
It was. Completely. And not the first time. This place is the worst.

Stopped in this location for a second time and both times haven't disappointed. The staff is friendly, my order has been right and the food is excellent. This is my favorite location to visit. I recommend getting the vegan cheesesteak if you're in the mood to try something besides a burger. The chili is excellent - i like the mix of quinoa and beans.
Like any other subway. Often come here for the foot long and the space is clean and well kept. Bathroom was okay.

I been in few other locations oh HipCityVeg. And unfortunately this one was the worst from my experience. Girl that was working at checkout looks and acting like she doesn't want work in this place. I don't expect all the time smile but being kind and polite would be nice especially when clients come with positive thinking. I'm foreign so some thing was confused and obviously I asked question but I fell bad attitude from this girl. Also food was much worst than I had in other places. I worked in restaurant and I don't expect magic. Just normal attitude

Great food, I loved their paneer and achari paneer kati rolls. 
The Mango lassi is very thick (more like a dessert). 
Overall, great value for money. Love their food

I got the chicken tacos and honestly they were disgusting. I threw them out. Barely any meat and your staff seems clueless. They couldn't even figure out my order that was pretty simple. I don't recommend at all. Stay away.
Legit prob the slowest WAWA I've ever been to. Even at 3am. So far it's been 17 mins since I printed my food order ticket. I mean I get that it's a college campus but DAMN smh

There should be a rewards program here because I'm a regular customer and this place is not cheap! So I took off one star for that. But other than that all of my friends and family know that I'm obsessed with this place and love their food to the point that I gifted myself their gift card for Christmas! I get their breakfast sandwich weekly, which is offered only in the center city location. It's sooo delicious along with their AM Philly && for the entree later during the day, I am a fan of the curry wrap and sweet potato fries with their yummy dips. I have made all 50+ of my classmates try this place out and they have all loved it! Highly recommend it to vegan and my non-vegan folks! I promise it is not anything you have imagined that vegan food would taste like
Didn't receive biscuits with bucket meal. And they shorted me 3 chocolate chip cookies.
Didn't get my 4 biscuits :( but the chicken and sides were okay. It's take out ya know?
too much green herbs gives it bad flavor and always hard shells in rice.dont bother.try another halal restaurant

i stepped into the corner bakery today for something quick since i had a meeting and was a little early. All i ordered was a croissant.  The girl at the register asked if i wanted it warmed up and i replied yes. After paying she handed me a little card to display at my table for someone to deliver my croissant to me.  I sat down around the corner and waited. and waited..... and then waited some more. surely it doesn't take almost 10 minutes just to warm up a croissant and then for someone to bring it to me. I got up and walked toward the kitchen and guess what... there's my croissant. Just sitting in its plate.. all sad and alone... for how long? who knows... waiting for someone to take him to his final destination. I asked "excuse me... i believe thats my croissant." The reply i got from the gentleman behind the counter was "oh it is? well then take it." um... ok. sure. 

how hard can it be to buy a croissant at the Corner Bakery? clearly for them its a difficult task.

This McDonald's is the absolute worst! There were a total of two cars in the drive thru and the young cat at the window stated they have to close due to employee shortage. Seriously???! Two employees that I could visibly see, not doing anything but hanging out. I remember when McDonald's drive thurs were packed and the employees would bust their butts to get it done. Young folk these days are lazy and entitled!

Have never gone thru the drive thru when they have actually gotten the order correct! 
The food is typical Taco Bell but trying to get what you ordered is a nightmare. Don't pull away without going through the bag!!

If you've had Shake Shack before, this is exactly what I'd expect from one. The service here is always pretty fast; during COVID they've been providing a pretty seamless pickup experience. I always order first on the app and walk over when it's ready (usually 15-20 minutes).

If you haven't had Shake Shack before, I'd easily rank it at the top of my fast food burger preferences. However, given that it's fairly expensive and often times double the price any other fast food joint, I have trouble comparing Shake Shack to something like McDonalds or Wendy's. With that said, I've never really been let down by Shake Shack before - their buns are always soft, their patties are always juicy, and overall it's a craving that other burger places can't always satisfy.

Literally THE WORST service strategy ever! I do doordash and I always seem to be held up at chipotle no matter where I go but this location has to be on to be top 3 never agains. I waited FOR OVER AN HOUR. Watched people come in after me and get served before me. Now my delivery ratings dropped because they couldn't get it together. NEVER AGAIN!

Very dissapoining experience of what I thought of the Philly cheesesteak. Save Yourself some $ because its also very pricey $13 dlls for a tiny sándwich with ugly cheese..omg.. 
They really got some nerve

Coming from socal, I'm prefacing this by saying no burger joint shall ever dethrone in n out! That said... I'm now a Philly transplant and I happen to live on the same corner as this shake shack. So I come here pretty much every week. 

Shake shack's burger is juicy and flavorful, with quality ingredients and a nice hint (just a hint!) of sweetness in the buns. At times their patties are a tad too salty, but overall balance well with their fresh greens. Fries, again, are too salty - - but WOW they are good! Perfect level of crispness, and I love the crinkle cut too. Not sure why this variety is so beloved... Is it the extra surface area? Something about the ridges just makes you appreciate each fry that much more.

Too bad it's so expensive though. At $10 for a burger and fries, I could get better quality from Five Guys and twice the portions from in n out. Drop the prices just a tad and I might just eat here everyday!

Absolutely pathetic. Placed a pick up order through the app. Wasn't ready until 10 mins after scheduled pick up time. When I got home I noticed the order was missing half the ingredients. They gave me a bowl with just rice, beans, salsa and sour cream. How does that happen?

Returned to shake shack recently and it was better than i remembered. Burger was good, a bit greasy. Shake was delicious. Pretty inexpensive and quick.
Super friendly staff.

Cool little spot - one of a few in the city. This place is tiny, so it can get very crowded and busy. You order at the bar, and the staff call out your order for pick-up. Main items (sandwiches, wraps, etc.) are $9-10, and don't come with sides - you can do side salads or fries for $4, which are generous portions. Everything was very delicious and satisfying. I'd definitely recommend the place.
Hamburger was ok. the construction was fine, but flavor was bland. the shake sauce was not detectable in most bites, and barely detectable in others.

PROS: Awesome mango lassi
CONS: Greasy, small portions

Overall, Spice End is decent. The paneer kati roll I ordered was fresh and flavory, but a tad small. It was approximately 1/3 the size of a Chipotle burrito for around $1 less. The mango lassi was good. Perhaps the platters are of better value.

I really didn't want to write a review of a food court place, but with so many other people dogging them with whiny reviews, I felt inclined to bring some balance.   
First and foremost, the food here is just as good as any other Chic Fil A.  If you like Chic Fil A, you will be happy with the quality here.  The main complaint other reviewers have is that its slow.  Like any other Chic Fil A, the line is always long here.  That means people like coming here.  Isn't it IRONIC that popularity brings about unpopular reviews?  
This place does move a little slower than other locations, but give them a break, they are new and probably have a mostly rookie staff.  The lines are long, but they usually have 3-4 registers going, and most people aren't making complicated orders.   You will have a little extra wait time for your food once its ordered, but that's the nature of a busy, popular place.
Bottom line its good food at a good price.  If you're in a big hurry, go to one of the other restaurants in the food court, they don't have lines.  You can conclude why.

A bit on the pricey side but very good sandwiches. I had the turkey & provolone. My sister had similar without provolone and my mother had Chicken cheesesteak.
All were fresh and yummy. Delivery was fast & correct. Will order again!

Five star rating today, five star rating forever! How have I lived in Philly my whole life and have never been to HipCityVeg?! I've been missing out all these years. I love it here! 

I placed my order directly through the HipCityVeg website which is linked to DoorDash. I received a text notification that my food would be ready in 20-25 minutes. I went and picked it up before the 20 minute mark and my food was ready. 

I can honestly say this was the BEST vegan Philly cheesesteak I have ever had and I've had my fair share of vegan cheesesteaks. It was cheesy and piled high with onions and the bread was soft. The sweet po fries were crispy, not oily. The sauces were complimentary at the condiment counter. I devoured this meal and I would get the same thing again in a heartbeat. 

The employees at this particular location were very nice and let me know they didn't have the boxed water I requested so they provided me with a Spindrift water instead. Really great service all around! 

HipCityVeg is walking distance from where I work so I will definitely be stopping in on future lunch breaks!

Another Taiwanese fried food. Why not try it right ? My first thought ? It's a big place compared to the other one. They accept cards (min of $10 purchase). The menu is different. They actually have Ramen! When I went here I went for the Squid on a stick. I will be honest, the squid was a little chewy. The breading was not consistent, some parts of the squid doesn't have breading at all, the breading has little to no taste but definitely crispy. You have to pay for sauce, why ? I think you should at least give one free sauce per order, the grapefruit yakult was pricey in my opinion. I don't know, I'm on the fence on this one. I'll try the ramen next time and see if I can update this review. Anyway for Boku no Hero Academia fans, they actually have a good sketch of Midoriya here that you might enjoy

Stopped by here for a meal and had a great experience. The guys working were really nice, and the food was tasty. Their rotis were great for a quick, not-too-heavy bite, and their lassi were tasty. Price was a little higher than what it could have been, but not so unreasonable as to be a deal-breaker. Their sauces were a little on the bland side- even after they warned me about how spicy the meats would be I found them still a little weak. All in all their food is good if you just want to get a quick bite, but it definitely isn't a restaurant experience or a great date place.

I've been here a couple times recently. The first two weren't bad, nothing to write home about.  

Tonight the girl rolling my burrito ripped it near in half, I watched her pretend not to notice the juices spilling out of it as she wrapped the foil around it.  

I ask for it to be re-rolled on another tortilla but they can't take food back so they want to do the whole thing again free of charge of course, very nice of them.  

A different employee rips it again, smaller rip but ended up just eating it with a fork. First girl who rolled the burrito looked at me like I'm an asshole while she passed the burrito to the cashier.  

I was as polite as I could be, it's not something that ruined my day and I got to keep the first one and I'm sure someone will want it on my walk home. Just a little frustrated with how often chipotle employees roll a burrito into a ball and act surprised when it tears.

We were so excited to see this location opening.... but every time we have driven by - we live two streets over and pass through frequently- none of the staff are wearing masks or gloves. My husband said he did see an employee wearing a mask once, but it was pulled down so her nose was uncovered. Perhaps if a manager is present the staff will practice proper precautions, but we've seen this too many times now to ever feel comfortable eating from there

I've eaten here many times and have yet to taste a bad burger.  Fries are never soggy or old, and the shakes overwhelm me with the good feels every time.  Only downside, it's pricey for a burger joint.  Maybe if they beefed up (haha) the patty size it'd be perfect.  Either way I'll be coming back for mo'

Passed by Shake Shake and my toddler had a yearning for their fries (it's been 3 months). I walked up to the counter, was the only one there on Saturday at 12.45pm, paid and waited patiently for the fries to be prepared. 

10 mins later, I see an employee put a box of fries in a bag and the counter person handed it to me. I presumed it was freshly made, after all took nearly a quarter hour to prepare right?

No, it was ice cold. I supposed the employees had other things to do at the time since there was literally no other order, not even another bag at the counter. 

My poor little guy; mommy could have made fresher fries from frozen thrown in my air fryer during that time.

This place has really gone downhill. Now that they have the "2 for 5.99" specials on certain days its been worse. They literally just slap the sandwiches together not even caring if they have enough on it, the paninis' are not cooked all the way through, barely toasted and always missing an ingredient. AND that's only if they actually get your order correct. Slow service and poor management. Skip it.

As soon as we heard this Chipotle finally opened  (but really, took forever to open and opened during a pandemic?), we decided to order delivery through their website. Maybe it's because they're brand new, but some of their items just didn't taste right. Their corn had large chunks of jalapenos so my husband couldn't really eat his because it was way too spicy. We also noticed the portions were smaller - normally one bowl would last me two meals but I killed mine in one sitting. Overall, a great location with parking, but they need to work on their recipe and portions!

I ordered online getting a lot of rice and toppings for my bowl. Rice, beans, tomato, corn and all that. When i got my bowl all it had was cold chicken, guac and tomatoes. Tasted like a prison meal I couldn't believe I paid money for this. I ordered tortillas too and of course i didnt get those either. I have never left a yelp review and I have had some pretty awful meals. Save yourself the time and never go here. I will get my money back for this, because this is just disrespectful.

The food was not as advertised didn't look nothing like the pictures and it didn't taste great either and took forever to delivery over an hour . I'm sure the other good reviews are from friends.always hard shelly stuff in rice

I received my order with not only one item messed up, but 3 of them. One Quesadia which specially I ordered with Tomatoes added as topping, was missing that topping which I have paid extra for. I thought that may have been a mistake so I thought of ignoring it, but then I found out not only one but two of the Chalupas I ordered were missing tomatoes too. It even got worst when I brought my order back to the store driving back there from my home, they dind't pay much attention or enthusiasm to resolve it. They only said rudely that only items I brought back (one chalupa and partial quesdila will be provided again). Then after 5 mins they said even Quesdila which was provided partially will not be provided. It's not acceptable because I have even paid extra for the tomatoes in Quesdila and still they were not accepting their mistake. They even didn't say sorry about ruining my order. It even got worst when I found out after reaching home that the chalupa that they made it again, was again missing the tomatoes, so I take this as intentional insult to the person coming back to expect getting the issue resolved. It was just useless to going back and expect a good service at this place.

Service was really quick. I went in at lunch time, ordered and got my food before I left the register. I did not have any issue with staff being rude or anything. It seemed fairly clean though I did not eat there so I can't  say anything about the tables. 

As for my food. I had a 5-8 min walk back to my office. My fries was cold.

Incredible burgers. Simple, but high quality.

Portobello mushroom burger also excellent.
It's a KFC... but with more bulletproof glass. Honestly sometimes it really does hit the spot though.

I am extremely concerned that when I went to thru the drive through in McDonald's that the cashier window no one was wearing gloves as well as where I picked up my food at the next window. There is a pandemic going on if you're not aware ? and prior to that all food service workers should be wearing gloves anyway. I am not sure why your employees awareness is not heighten during  this pandemic.gloves and mask should be a part of you uniform. I am not subjecting my health to this ignorance
This place is closed.  Out of business.  Not there any more.  Don't waste your time.  It is not "Open" as Yelp and their website says.
Decent place...except for the annoying droning pop music they have on, I think it's that local 102 station.

Ordered from Wendy's did not get the correct order the person who dropped off the delivery would not listen to us when he gave us the wrong order he was rude and drove away and did not listen to the customer will not order from this Wendy's ever again

This is more like a 3.5, but something tells me I should try some other menu items before I lay down the hammer. Disclaimer: Not a huge fan of fusion, so I tend to be lenient with these reviews. Coreanos is very divey with a unique Chinatown Square flair, serving food in cardboard boxes lined with a wax coating inside so the contents don't soak through. 

The carnitas tacos? Pretty much carnitas with kimchi on it, which was great! But not too fusion, so I feel like that's why it was a winner for me. 

Bulgogi tacos? Less of a winner, but still pretty good. I think it was missing kimchi because it had the ssam sauce and lettuce, which is very much Korean, but there was something missing. The bulgogi could have sat in the marinade for another 3 hours or so too.

The chicken appetizer was the least impressive to me since it was what I imagined the rice bowl to be, without the rice. Basically just crunchy chicken mixed with some corn salsa and lettuce with some gochujang sauce on the side.

I am curious about the other tacos, but maybe I'll come by during a special since it's a little too pricey to be messing around with food that might not live up to my expectations.

Late night early morning SPOT for coffee & FOOD!! Drive thru action can get very busy after clubs close. The staff really try to do their best to keep it moving even with delivery services coming thru. 

Tonight Sheba assisted me thru the drive thru. She has done so before & has always been pleasant over the mic & at the window. She also knows how to hook up a good cup of coffee that was well needed at 4am. Lol. 

My food was hot & DELISH. HOT cakes, hash browns & sausage were on point. My breakfast started off right today!!! Never had a problem with this location & this is why I frequent here & suggest it to others!!! I'll be back as usual!!!

We are so angry. If I could give it a 0 I would.
Ordered ahead during this virus. Menu said chicken bucket either regular, crispy or grilled. Put grilled and paid. Put email and phone for them to call if problem.
Went to pick up and the guy said" we don't have grilled during the virus". My husband said why didn't you call. Of course he just shook his hear.
Husband asked for the refund and he shook his shoulders and said " that's up to corporate".
Absolutely unacceptable.  
I never go  there but was in the mood. Emailed customer service, no response.
Maybe if I keep posting negative reviews, they will respond, but I doubt it
The worst. I never get my order if I order online. I don't have time to leave my office, such awful customer service.

No - it's not a five star establishment, but it's wayyy cleaner and organized than what used to be here. The managers maintain this store well and the employees are friendly.  Even if the line looks long, it will usually go fast. There is a value menu, not sure what other people are talking about. The breakfast is just what you would expect from a fast food joint, but sometimes a sausage, egg, and cheese on a biscuit hits the spot! The burgers are cooked well, and I really enjoy unsweetened strawberry tea in the afternoon as a nice pick me up or an occasional frosty. If you ever have an issue with your order, the managers are so friendly, accommodating, and easy to approach.  Minus one star for better line organization. When it's crowded the order line and pick up line collide :/ Not a fan. Overall a convenient and clean Wendy's location.

This has been the second night in a row that I come to panda and they closed 30 minutes before advertised. I walked up both times to all food gone, workers sitting in dinning area waiting for 9:30 so they can leave. I've worked in many restaurants to know that we don't stop cooking until customers stop walking through the front door. Culinary Arts and Customer Service go hand in hand. If you don't believe I have some pics to prove.

I may update this in the future because I think I need to give it another chance. 

My first experience was kind of a bust. I'm not sure if I just wasn't impressed with my spicy chicken roll. Everyone I came with ordered platters and seemed to enjoy those more than I enjoyed my plate. 

I'm hoping it was a fluke so I will go once more to try a platter. However, the one thing I found really strange was that their white yogurt sauce tasted like ranch. Not sure what that's about, but they should really try to fix that as I've seen other yelpers have mentioned the same thing. I must have missed the memo about when we decided ranch seasoning was acceptable in middle eastern foods...

Food: 4 out of 5
Cleanliness: 4 out of 5
Atmosphere: 4 out of 5
Service: 4 out of 5
Value: 3 out of 5

Great vegan spot by city hall. Location is very small so not a lot of space to sit down and have your mean so be ready to take it on the run. Good flavor but the portion size is a little small for the price. I would visit again.

KFC would be unstoppable if they had decent sides. Let me say that again... unstoppable!! Too bad they don't. The stores are pretty much always filthy too. But damn that Chicken tastes so good!! Original recipe thighs is where it's at. Now remember that! 

Stop it with the stupid shit already. The Cheeto sandwiches and all of that other crap. And would it kill you to put some legit wings on the menue?

Wendy's has a fountain soda machine that lets you choose from around fifty different varieties and flavors of sodas, drinks and flavored waters. My favorites are the Diet Dr. Pepper options. I chose Diet Cherry Dr. Pepper but I enjoy original diet or Diet Cherry Dr. Pepper. Since Wendy's shares a store with Jersey Mikes I managed to both buy the soda and then stand in line for the California Chicken cheese steak on a scooped whole wheat roll with...please check out the rest of my review on Jersey Mikes page...

HOW IS THIS PLANT BASED???????? I am thoroughly SHOOK by this plant based crispy chick'n. It was so satisfying. The bun was nice and toasty. The ranch was drippppinngggg all over, but I was so into it. Onions were sliced too thick, but I still love them. I'm not sure how'd I critique this. Service was very nice. They do waste a lot of bags though. Not very environmentally friendly. $9-$10 for this burger. I'd do it again! I wish they didn't sloppily slap on the ranch though. I wanted to lick every last bit. The one on Broad is less busy than the other location for sure. Go to that one!

I have a dirty little secret. I like to eat Taco Bell once a month. Sometimes twice. I've been to many TBs, but this one is consistently the best one I've ever been to. The food is always good, and the service is even better. If you're looking to go to a Taco Bell, make the trip if you have to and visit this one. Ariba!!! Bring back pintos and cheese!

If I can give minus star, i would... 1st.. Chinese restaurant but operate and cook by Jamaican... however,  i did not have a problem with that...until i tasted the food.....it was bad, very bad food.... i had orange chicken and fried rice to be safe..but it was not safe... orange chicken tasted weird and nasty..fried rice was so dry and tasteless... 

I would never come back.
Worst service and dirty store. 5 workers just standing around talking not one working

Tried the cart at 15th and spring garden. I ordered the General Tsos chicken stir fry. I talked to the guy about how spicy and he was like it's not that spicy but it definnnnitely has a kick (I'm also a wimp haha) but the flavor is great. The guy working was super nice and personable while helping me order. The veggies taste fresh and are crisp and I am very happy with the size of the portion for $10. I'll definitely have a bit for leftovers!
They have covid here and didn't quarantine. Won't be coming here again it's ridiculous because I did really love this restaurant growing up

This location should just close.  They can't seem to deliver the consumer an edible, consistent product.  Ordering delivery? add 60-90 mins to thr time they tell you and prepare for cold food and missing items - only to be met with indifference.  Picking up? watch them closely or double check the order as I've yet to get one home correct unless I micromanage them.  I'm done with it, and going forward will spend with Adobe Cafe or Taqueria Amor.

I'd been craving a burger for a while now and didn't even realize it till I walked in today! 

I had the regular Shack Burger - included a thick slice of cheddar cheese and shack sauce with the obligatory lettuce and tomato. The burger itself was a little greasy and made the roll a bit soggy, but it didn't last long enough on my plate for this to bother me: it was delicious. Also got the cheese fries.  Miss the crinkle-cut fries but they were still tasty. 

Looking forward to coming back this summer for the custard selection...
Is half an hour freaky fast? This is legit the worst location of all. So rude in there as well. Get new employees please.

This was the best Jersey Mike's I've had! They just made my Italian so great! The staff was just super nice too - I had a birthday coupon from last year that expired the next day, and they honored it  So note, this location doesn't accept regular Jersey Mike's coupons, I guess? But it was so so so nice that they still gave me my free sandwich and drink - thank you!!

Honestly it's the worst Wendy's I ever been too I haven't been in the place or ate there for 2 years the girl that was taking my Oder was rude to me and the lady behind me and not to point her out but her also was high ashell but the inside of Wendy's is nice they even have a bowl with chips but I would check your food before eating it cuz there might be a perk30 or sum else place has a big drug problem I say shut down

Rude people work here I wish I can give them a 0 
They are lazy and just don't want to work light skin heavy set girl with curly hair and glasses wish I didn't drive 30 min to come here

Two words...DRUNKEN NOODLES...they are truly awesome!  Perfectly spiced and come with chicken and shrimp.  Noodles are cooked to perfection too.  As you can tell, it is my favorite dish on the menu.  This is a weekly treat for myself at lunchtime, and its great that they are right outside my building!
This place is trash and needs to go. Ignorant employees that mouth off and make rude remarks while cursing at customers while they completely screw up their orders. Don't waste your time or money

I'm not a huge burger fan but I can appreciate a good fast food burger. Since I live in Texas and we don't have a shake shack- I had to compare to In and Out & 5 guys since that's what we have. I like that the bun isn't completely split so it's easier to keep everything contained. I did the regular shack burger. The shack sauce was really tasty. I also shared an order of crinkle cut fries with cheese and a strawberry shake. It's tasty- not too greasy and the fries and shake are great sides. I can't wait until the one in Dallas is open.

I ordered the chicken bowl with a warm tortilla on the side and extra mild salsa. Convenient location and the food is consistently fresh! I would suggest going during off peak hours to avoid a little bit of a wait.

I was leary about coming here because it only had 3 1/2 stars. We definitely had a 5 star experience. When we arrived we did have to wait to long in line. The workers were patient and friendly. My group ordered a mixture of burgers and chicken sandwiches. The ShackMiester is by far my favorite. I order the shack burger with fried shallots. The fries are always delicious and the cheese dipping sauce is the cherry on top. We left happy and full!

I ordered Sausage Egg McMuffin sandwiches from this location. I took a bite of my sandwich and when I went to sit it down I realized the other side of the muffin was completed molded. Covered in blue mold. Disgusting!!! I am sick to my stomach knowing I ate food from this place.
Following the news of late? They need to fumigate this jawn. Mice, roaches and feces.

Couldn't feel AC on a 90 plus day! Tables needed to be wiped off. Everyone is always angry. Here's the thing- you choose your job. It's not the customers fault if you have a problem with wages/mgr/franchise etc! Don't take your dissatisfaction out on us.

Terrible that this place would allow a customer to walk away with a frozen frosty!! Thought it was weird when they said they only had small size. Is it worth the $2 to disappoint a customer? Shame!! I would've rated a ZERO!
Worst store ever nasty store ans customer service no respect for the customer.worst experience ever 2 times been here and veru unpleasant vist.

I ordered ahead of time for pick up so I wouldn't have to wait. Once I arrived I waited an hour to pick up my food! The girl next to me said she was waiting an hour as well! This is beyond ridiculous and management does nothing when you tell them you've been waiting for a pick up order! People were walking in and getting their food before the 15+ people that have been waiting outside for their pick up orders. This location is a nothing short of a disgrace. They need to shut this location down or get a whole new staff because this is unacceptable

Beware of the flying roaches aka water bugs that  bite , fly , come up from the Philly sewers and also grab a bite at this local shake shack . I just ordered a shack stack and upon picking it up from the pick up window I noticed a giant roach making its way inside the restaurant . Upon telling the hostess , god bless her heart , she said it happens . Yikes !!!!!!!!!
Now I can't bring myself to eat the burger I ordered. I guess I just  wasted $11.  Customers beware. Management please keep the door closed and spray your restaurant with bug barrier .

Went to this location expecting a solid lunch. Menu and prices were on point. I ordered the "Pick Two" and got a Turkey Uptown and Chicken Caesar Salad. Order took 18 minutes to be brought to my table which was ridiculous. Sandwich was sloppy and lacking ingredients. Salad had barely any chicken which was a negative because I paid extra for it to be added. I was also not provided with the complimentary chips I ordered. Overall the food wasn't bad, but the service and prep were very poor.

Poor Customer Service and a ripoff. Manager refused to provide me with a refund for an item that was out of stock at the restaurant. Now McDonald's corporate is giving me the runaround about my missing refund.

I was specifically craving JMs Cali chicken cheesesteak hoagie with fried o light on the mayo on a scooped out whole-wheat roll with peppers and mushroom and man did they deliver. Seriously their best effort thus far. I forgot to ask them to cut it but managed to gobble it all up without a drip on my outfit and didn't even need a napkin even though it was very juicy and delicious. 

Service as always was a 6/5
California chicken cheesesteak hoagie with fried onions, mushrooms, peppers on whole wheat roll light on the m

I don't understand how it takes 60 minutes sitting in a drive through to get our order. 40 nuggets and 2 large fries, like did someone ahead of us order the entire menu four times? How is something that's supposed to be standardized take so long. This isn't a dry aged steak, it's Mcnuggets and fries. Like what??? This is the slowest McDonald's I've experienced ever, no hyperbole.

Bad service all around. This is a chain, but what separates this location is how utterly terrible their service is. Like, maybe the goal is to be shut down or run off customers. If that is the goal mission accomplished. They will cancel your order without communication or will take liberties to substitute items without your consent. I can understand a mistake, but the response to their mistakes is out of line. I'll drive a few extra miles if want chipotle that bad.

FOOD & HUMANITY AT ITS FINEST HipCityVeg Broad st Philly. 
This Saturday morning on my usual journey to pick up my favorite breakfast at HipCityVeg Broad street Philadelphia, I experienced an unexpected but virtuous act.  A fellow human being doing the Honorable and Decent thing.  I would like to say thank you to James & Josh and all at HipCityVeg Broad st for finding the $100 bill I dropped (A birthday gift from my Parents!)  and returning it to me.
 Not only Does HipCityVeg serve Some of the Best Vegan Food around, but they are truly good folk HonestyIntegrityPrincipled HIP!
I can't thank you enough!
Sincerely,  Lisa

I'll go basic on this review. You probably have a good idea what this place is about from the other 365 reviews. 

Time from ordering the burger to getting it was about 5 minutes at 1:20 pm on a Friday. Not bad. 

Single SmokeShack burger with large half and half tea was almost 10 bucks. A bit high, but I'm sure that is paying for the location. 

The burger was really good. Loved the flavor, but the flavor came mainly from the condiments on it. Nothing wrong with the half and half drink at all. 

4 stars is right. I've had better overall burger experiences.  But I like the taste here, the staff was very friendly, and you can't beat the location on a nice day.

But I do believe that you can get 5 star burgers at cheaper places.
Terrrible ordered through popeyes app. They gave me wrong food and i was missing food that i ordered. Wish i never ordered from them. If i dont get my money back im sueing them. Periodtttt
Pleasant and clean but a little pricey for the food. I would eat here again but not going out of my way.

My girlfriend loves this place, and we order delivery whenever she craves. They have an awesome lunch deal that is super worth it.  

I was so surprised the cheesesteak was so tasty with no meat! The sweet potato fries and sauce are bomb. The udon salad is great mix of flavors and textures. 

They are a staple in our takeout rotation.

I didn't like it the one time I had it before. The chicken & biscuts tasted like it was sitting under the heat lamp too too long. I don't trust the people who are serving it at all. I think  I saw two of them on "America's Most Wanted" before. I don't know what their doing to the food back behind the counter. My "gut" feeling tells me to stay far away.

The first restaurant opened on August 18, 1969, in Lexington, Kentucky.[3] The original location, on 301 Southland Drive just off Nicholasville Road, was previously a seafood carry out restaurant named the Cape Codder. The original Cape Codder concrete block building was redesigned by architect Druce Henn, who created the New England style of Long John Silver's early chain restaurants. That original location is now a styling salon.[4][5]
Earlier restaurants were known for their Cape Cod style buildings, blue roofs with square cupolas, wood benches/tables, lobster pots, and ship's wheels. Later, more nautically themed decorations were added such as seats made to look like nautical flags.

I've now ordered from Wokworks multiple times! It's delicious every. single. time. never disappoints! I quite literally cannot get enough of their brussel sprouts. Their locations are super convienenet too!

The Chicken could be tastier. The shakes are delicious! I always get the double shack stack with smoked applewood bacon!! It is my favorite! The staff is always courteous and helpful. The lines move quickly.

Take me back to rolling into Chipotle after chem lab. Take me back to hitting up this franchise for some group catering. Take me back to a burrito so big, you need two tortillas to wrap that monster. 

But please DO NOT take me back to this chipotle. This is just about the worst Chipotle I've ever had in my life. The rice was blatantly burnt beyond belief. Folks im not talking abt a few black rice pieces, Im talking spoons of brown overdone nonsense. Im talking crunching so loud youd think you were eating raw rice. The saddest part is that, it was so obviously burnt but they didnt have the decency to at least change it out.

Then came the sides/meats. Its a franchise, meaning there should be a straightforward recipe in place. For whatever reason that wasn't the case. Everything just seemed off and not reminiscent of the good ole Chipotle times.

Then the service. I was greeted quite rudely by a lady. No 'hi' or 'how are you doing' I wanted to ask for a tortilla to go but her attitude, suggested it might not go well.

Then icing on the cake, its more expensive then any other Chipotle Ive ever been to! You should not wat here so bang to buck is effectively 0.

Food-1/5
Bang:Buck Ratio-0/5

Seriously the Best Fast Food Breakfast!! The people who work here are awesome and they actually care about what they are serving you and it shows. The eggs are fresh not like McDonald's eggs log .. and the bacon was real. Completely satisfied !!

*****Update thanks to the wise words of Yelp friend Amy M, I'm no longer giving up carbs till Thanksgiving! Yelpers are the wisest people!!!!

Now back to my regularly scheduled review of last night's meal...

Service 10/5

Special thanks to JOSE B who patiently took my order and well, he made my night..

Have you ever had one of those weeks where one thing added a tinge of grey to your otherwise sunny outlook? I'd one of those weeks where a lot of great things happened but my mind chose to dwell on the one or two negative things that happened instead of my many awesome blessings. Maybe I'm not as thick skinned as I once thought, or maybe I'm re-connecting with my own humanity. Either way i was feeling blue and talking abt it didn't help. My solution to seeing the cup half empty was to make an unplanned stop at shake shack! Yeah a meal after a day of being stuck to and starved at my desk b/c i forgot my pass and work bestie and favorite lunch buddy took a day off and i didn't want to deal with the workplace temp pass security issues, so it was water for me till the the proverbial bell rang yabadabadoo! So I was very hungry by 6pm. 

Back to my Shake Shack experience...
So all it took was a little red wine and a very kind, smart counter gentleman named JOSE B. to set the stage to change my attitude and also the delicious burger helped!

Food 6/5
In my case? It was a delicious...

...double Shack burger no cheese with everything on it, but sauce on the side and no salt 6/5

People! Order it "well" with no salt and get the shake shack special sauce on the side! You will not be disappointed! Maybe it was the $8.99 glass of red wine (which was very good)  I had on an empty stomach while i waited but I gotta tell you, the burger was yumliciious! Yes that's the red wine talking, I never say yumilicious out loud or even to myself but who cares? I'm happily broadcasting it publicly this eve!

Fries 5/5
No salt and yes they listened and they are perfect. smaller serving than I remembered but I'm okay with that. I tend to finish everything on my plate so less is more. Also I saw someone leave some of their fries and thought hey, I'm kinda full I'm gonna leave some too. So sadly I'm going to not over fill my belly (I'm pretty full though tbh) and yes one of the floor servers politely offered to clear my tray and chucked the rest on my behalf, not sure i could have done it on my own.

I'm mourning the end of my meal now not my formerly negative affect. Thanks to Jose B. who patiently took my order and made me realize not all people suck when it's really only one person outside in my non shake shack real world life who kind of wasn't nice earlier in the week. Thanks Jose you give me hope, not all men are insensitive! :) 

Yes i let the behavior of one acquaintance whom I'll never see again ruin my mood for five days. 

Back to food...So now I'm in mourning  b/c i finished my delicious double burger no cheese cooked well. So my negative affect is gone thanks to shake shack and their kind customer service (standing ovation to Jose and team at shake shack)and delicious food (order no salt and well done and you'll be so happy). So here's the hard part...

I gave up on my plan to kick carbs to the side of the road till Thanksgiving. Life's too short and in the words of Yelp friend Amy M..,.carbs=happiness!

In summary JOSE B!!! Man you made my night!
JOSE B. at the counter took excellent care of me. Sometimes a guy in tune with humanity can see when a person is out of sorts and just that little bit of TLC changes a stranger's perspective! Thanks Jose, your kindness  and graciousness was  all it took!  What a great, kind humanitarian he was to this crazy chick!

Came in today to order fries and ice cream for my dog. As I was waiting for my order, I was rudely told dogs weren't allowed. It's assumed if there's a menu for dogs, dogs would be allowed. The woman basically gave me a dirty look, told me to wait outside and my order would be brought out. She could have came out and told me politely and I would have understood but she yelled from the kitchen, making a scene. I work in a customer/client based field, and that is definitely not how you handle a situation. Words can't explain how appalled I am. If dogs aren't welcomed, take it off the menu. How am I suppose to order something for my dog if she's not even allowed it. And no I refuse to keep her outside in an area where people are constantly walking by where she can get stolen. If my dog isn't welcomed, I'm not either. And I'll definitely be spreading the word.

Went here for a work week lunch. Line wasn't super long so that's nice.

I ordered the shroom burger and its the best thing I've ever had. It comes out of the kitchen piping hot so you gotta wait a bit before biting into it. The battered coating around the mushroom is so crispy and perfectly seasoned. And inside the battered coating was creamy and melty cheese. Oh boy was it so good! The fresh tomatoes and lettuce and warm bun just worked so well with the fried goodness. 

I'll definitely come back for the shroom burger - I love that they have this vegetarian option!

I keep coming back here hoping that it will get better. It hasn't. 

Seems like it always takes at least 15-20 minutes longer than the estimate even if you order it in advance. Hours seem to vary somewhat too from the posted ones. 

The kati rolls are usually tasty, but not very filling for the price. The sauces are just kind of gross. The white stuff tastes like ranch mixed with mayo and the hot sauce isn't really even that hot. The chicken and rice bowl is worse than what you'd find at most halal carts and costs a lot more to boot. 

It would be great to have a quick, cheap, and filling late-night Indian food place around the neighborhood, but Spice End isn't that place.

Unprofessional behavior by those taking and preparing orders. Handing people their orders without as much as looking at customers, let alone speaking to them. Wait was very long for "fast" food. Food was had unmelted cheese and uneven placement of sauce.

Seattle Teriyaki is such a hidden gem in Center City! Since "discovering" this adorable spot, I've stopped to get lunch here at least 5 times in a matter of 3 weeks, and I typically bring my lunch to work. 
I always get the #1, their teriyaki chicken thighs with rice topped with sesame seeds and green onion, and it's soooooo soooooo good!
What's also super important to mention is that the meal is only $9 with tax, customer service is phenomenal and employees call you by name and your food is ready in about 60 seconds.
I plan to come back many more times!

Delicious! I was in town to see the Celtics beat up on the Sixers. This meal was almost as satisfying as the Celtics win!  I had the crispy ranch sandwich with fries. The chick'n was terrific; juicy and very flavorful. I likely won't be back any time soon but will be sure to stop in next time I'm in town.

I ordered  my food at 1:14pm it was delivered at  1:52pm cold I literally live 2 1/2 blocks from the 52nd st location. No one wants to eat cold French fries and a chicken sandwich that was no longer crispy with a soggy bun due to the condensation in the bag they put it in. I would have been better off ordering and picking it up it would have still been hot and edible when I got home. Do not order  for delivery my total was 10.78 plus tax was 11.64 delivery charge was 1.99 plus tip which was Iess than $2 after all the other charges were added  I paid 20.19 for a cold meal I couldn't eat. This was my first and my last time ordering from Popeyes

Oh Popeyes, where do I begin? I wanna start off by saying I'm not mad, I'm just disappointed. It kills me to give this establishment the satisfaction of achieving one star as if they've actually earned it. For starters, they seem relatively incapable of reading English and properly executing their deliveries. Our side of fries were thrown in a paper bag and I'm not entirely sure that our post mates driver didn't eat a couple. But I'll save that review for my next post. We didn't get both sides of mashed potatoes and the mashed potatoes we did get look like something that came out of my ass earlier this morning.

If your looking for a Shake Shack and don't want to have to wait in a long line and fight for a table(NYC Shake Shack I'm talking about you)...this is the place to come. 

Ordered a Shackburger that was cooked to a perfection medium unless you tell them otherwise and a black and white shake which was mmmmm good. Even though it was lunch time there were plenty of open tables inside but since it was nice out we sat outside.

The place was very clean and staff was friendly. I like how the meat is free of any hormones or antibiotics. Hot dogs are 100% all natural. They also serve wine and beer.

I didn't forget about my dog at home and got a Bag O' Bones for him which had 5 Shackburger dog biscuits made by Bocce's Bakery...I hope he liked them (well he must of, he ate them fast) those bad boys cost $7.50 which was more then my burger!!

This rating is a compromise.. If I could give one rating for the food, it would be a five.... If I could give another rating for the service, it would be a debate between a one or a two - or it might be a roller coaster that runs from 1 to, at best, a peak of about 3.5 with all possibilities in-between.
-error Orders - when I get a Coke Zero that is actually a standard Coke, it does, actually, do a number on my blood sugar numbers - Type I diabetc ere....  Once - caught the challenge, was replaced.. the other time, they labeled it correctly on the receipt, gave me something that jacked my numbers through the roof. Solution?  just skip the beverage.
- Errors in handing over the order.  Having the clerk stand there looking at me while my buzzer is buzzing incessantly while she is contemplating whether the bag WITHOUT the receipt is an "interesting" experience... When I got frustrated and asked for some kind of resolution, was told I was "belligerent".  Other errors have included being handed the wrong bag - so, always check - both the receipt and the bag contents/tray contents to see if the receipt is your order and that the food matches the order
-Errors in taking the order. The acoustics in this place resemble a boiler plant, with the result that I may have to repeat my order multiple times before I can confirm that it is correct...(my voice projects enough to "work the conference rooms" that my profession requires of me, but does not, apparently, work for this location. Have been in others where the acoustics are almost serene......don't know why CC Philly lost out)

So, again, the food is great - can have a decent "no-prep" meal that is tasty and well worth the cost differential from a "standard chain Fast Food place.... but would suggest for first timer's, go in with a bucket of patience

I tend to avoid chain establishments in an effort to support local businesses, but when it's good - it's good. 

Shake Shack burgers are delicious. Everything is made to order, and the veggies were fresh and crisp. I'm a firm believer that a bun can make or break a burger (don't mess with my carbohydrates), but I was not disappointed. This is probably the best, albeit greasy, burger I've had since moving to Philly in October. 

I paired it with the Center City Pretzel concrete, a sweet, salty, marshmallow-y concoction. It was everything frozen custard should be. Additionally, 5% of proceeds from the purchase of this specific concrete goes to charity. Double win!

I'm a big fan of the location! The was no shortage of seating, both in and outside, but even if there is, you can do what I did and have yourself a picnic in Rittenhouse Square park. .

First time visiting this place and its very cute and clean. I was greeted promptly even though I had no idea what I wanted to eat. Everyone was friendly and warm and assisted us during meal time.
