I ended up getting the vegan chicken nuggets for my youngest son and the smokehouse beyond burger for my eldest. I ate the vegan chicken fajita wrap and had a the carrot ginger juice. The nuggets were so damn good and the dipping sauce!!! Omg I immediately regretted no ordering this one for myself. The juice was very good usually when I have a juice with ginger it's really overpowering. This place is a bit pricey spent close to $40 for the food, but it's an overall good place to try.

Yesterday was my last day patronizing  Chick fil la, and I will be encouraging others not to. I purchased 2 Breakfast sandwiches to start my mothers birthday off right and to my dismay when I reached the train and indulge in my own sandwich to my surprise I only found 1, even though the woman checked or at least she appeared that she did, I politely returned  and asked for the second sandwich, Two managers were present and I presented the issue without making a scene until The manager "David" took it upon himself to say " I know I put two sandwiches in the bag"  and other unnecessary banter directed to me,  this all happened in front of other customers and what appeared to be another manager, needless to say I didn't have time to come back for the sandwich that I paid for or to make a formal complaint on the spot ( not that it would make a difference)   The service I encountered there yesterday was totally uncalled for and spoke volumes, as to the type of company Chick Fil A really is, I feel bad for anyone that works there and I will be contacting there corporate offices.

Mostly posting this review to remind myself that fast food can be a treat, but too much exposure increases the likelihood for problems. I've ordered a few times since moving to the area, but it's never really gone smoothly. 
Just tried the spicy tenders for the first time, and somehow, they are so not flavorful at all, even compared to the regular ones. The soda machine was super watery, the tenders were bland, and I had one tender that was so big, tough and chewy all the way through, I couldn't really eat it. 
Service is usually quick, but long lines and a busy staff lead to delays with pick ups and waiting around. Not great, especially waiting indoors lately. I've found a lot of deals on the Popeye's app lately, but I think that was my last time.

on saturaday my housemate order 12 piece chicken meal from Popeyes at 52nd and woodland and we used uber eats . We recieved 8 pieces of chicken and we were told by management that there was nothing they could do for us ,so dont order from Popeyes .

Horrible service once again. Ordered ahead and my order was supposed to be ready at 2;20 pm.  So when it wasn't by 2:25 pm, I was understanding.  As I watched the worker finish up my order and bag it around 2:27 pm I was ready to say thank you and take my food.  The worker left the bag on the food prep table after watching me standing there and seeing the order was past due AND started the next order.  I had to ask her for my finished order three times before she even acknowledged me!  Then she told me "there is a process to each order".  I guess the process at Chipotle is to finish an order and withhold it while starting another one because you're a miserable worker who wants to belay your discontent onto others to find some amusement in your drole disappointing life.  STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE!!!

Also, look at the YELP reviews... pretty much all horrible and Jacob F. (The owner) only offers half- hearted non- meaningful apologies.

This place is amaze. 
I've had their achar paneer and paneer tikka roll and love both! I think I like the paneer tikka more though because it includes some vegetables. Their white sauce is delicious and their red sauce is SPICY. 

People rave about their biryani but I thought it was pretty so-so to be honest. Perhaps I'm not huge on biryani? Never had their platters.

The kati rolls are on the spicy end when you first get it and see that it's small (yooo I coulda gotten a Subway footlong for cheaper!) But these fill you up! Although I could probably eat 10. 

Definitely a place to try!

My experience at KQ Burger started off on the wrong foot but ultimately ended up working out well. I had a gift certificate from a promotion I worked on with University City Dining Days. My guest and I placed our orders on the kiosk and I mentioned the gift certificate to the employee, who told me that the certificate was no longer valid as it was part of a limited time promotion. There were no date restrictions or anything on the certificate, but there wasn't really anything I could do so I just paid for the order. Note to management: please put clear instructions on limited-time offers to avoid confusion! 

As it was a Saturday afternoon, the food hall wasn't very crowded and my order was cooked right away, resulting in a five minute or so wait. The burgers were hearty and delicious. My guest had the classic, with a few modifications, while I had the smokey. We shared an order of cheese fries, which were really good. At $34 for two burgers, the fries, and two waters, I thought this was a pretty reasonably priced lunch. I'd probably avoid during super busy times because I imagine the wait could get long. Otherwise, I'd gladly return!

I would give this place 0 stars if I could. I have never seen such gross incompetence. One - two time screw ups are ok. But every order is completely wrong. They take forever with pick up (be prepared to wait at least 30 minutes after your promised time). Whoever runs or manages this place should be ashamed of themselves.

Extremely disappointing visit today. I placed an order through the website at 12:15pm for pickup at 12:30pm. I ordered 3 burrito bowls. When I went to pick it up, I had to wait for 35 mins for my pick up order. It was not ready until 1:05pm. On top of waiting an absurd amount of time, all THREE bowls were made incorrectly with wrong and/or missing ingredients. A let down. Would not recommend this location at all. This is the second time I had an experience waiting over 30 mins for a pick up order.

Wow. They consistently mess up my order. I think it turned into a game for them. You know how at Starbucks they intentionally write your name wrong? At KFC they see how creative they can be in messing up your order. I keep trying to give them another chance but I gave up after seeing mold by the soda machine and under the rubber mats; I will bet anyone real money that they have never cleaned their lines because it smells like a fermenting loaf of bread near that soda machine.
I was thoroughly pleased when Jake reached out to me and addressed my concerns. This shows true dedication for his establishment. I will absolutely give this shop another try next time I am in town.

Rude manager Laina. She was condensending, reprimanded me for not saying hello before I started in In ordering. Wanted to tell me I didn't respond to her.   I was just starving and such. Wow. We walked out so rude.

I went Into chipotle a few days ago and the workers seemed very stressed, the line was very long and they only had two workers working the serving line so they were really slow at making the orders ! Really disorganized, my online pickup order wasn't done in time, way to many people in the restaurant definitely not following Covid social distancing rules. Don't think I'll be back .

I love mock meat - well, most times, that is. 

I love mock meat that doesn't market itself that way, you know? For instance, as a vegetarian, I really don't want a substitute that tastes like meat- that's not what I'm going for. I want something with texture, a unique flavor, and the potential to let me understand and taste a dish I otherwise would have been kept in thee dark about.

When I visited Philadelphia, I was pleasantly overwhelmed by their menu, mostly because the Midwest has almost nothing like it. (Actually, nothing like it). I was more overwhelmed by the fact that we, a rather non-adventurous Indian family, could all find things we enjoyed and would happily eat again.

The jerk caesar is exactly what you'd want and expect out of caesar salad. What thrilled me was the fact that THIS chicken caesar, I could actually eat! 

HipCityVeg is a great chain and conceptually, deserves a high level of praise. Perhaps American cuisine has omnivorous hope after all.

Stopped for a fountain soda ... I got my drink it was flat watered down and had 5 ice cubes in it. It looked like ice tea - didn't take more than one sip. GROSS. This was a waste of money and horrible customer service.
Super good chicken with very crispy fried combos! I highly recommend this restaurant for those who LOVE fried chicken but wanna still stay lean and healthy

This place is a staple when my husband and I are craving a quick but tasty quality meal. Clearly we're not the only ones who feel that way since every time we stop by, this place is hopping. If it's a nice day, it's great to take advantage of the outdoor seating and soak in the sun and people watch. You usually have to wait a decent amount of time for the order to be ready, but I figure it's worth the sacrifice for fresh, delicious, and made to order food. 

We usually go for the ShackBurger or Chick'n Shack. The chicken is always perfectly seasoned and pairs so well with the potato roll. I'm also a huge fan of the spicy chicken sandwich which was a limited edition special. The Shack-cago Dog was pretty good, loaded with lots of toppings. The dining experience is made complete with a side of their perfectly crisp crinkle cut fries and a milkshake. We opted for the cookies and cream shake which was heaven, so thick and creamy that we couldn't even suck it up through the straw. I've also tried some of their unique concrete combinations which have typically been winners.

Another great Lunch spent at Jersey Mike's with work bestie and California chicken cheesesteaks. I ordered the wheat option scooped, light on the mayo,  with fried onions, sweet peppers, tomatoes, lettuce and a side of "hots."  And this time I remembered to ask them to cut the hoagie in half!. We really enjoyed our hoagies. 5/5

Service 6/5
The folks here are really nice and they're fast too. The lines are long but they move for sure. The manager is the sweetest guy- he runs both Wendy's and Jersey Mike's He hires great people and both the Wendy's and Jersey Mikes staff members bend over backwards to make sure you've a great experience! Everyone at JM's from the person who takes your order and cooks it to the cashiers really care about their product and the customers - they're awesome! I remembered to request to have my hoagie cut in half for a much much easier and enjoyable eating experience. One thing Jersey Mike's - they're HOAGIES not subs!

Honestly the worst service I have ever had. The workers were so rude and trained very poorly or just didn't give a shit. My meat wasn't cut up at all and the worker made me cut a woman in line. Wasted my money the bowl tasted horrible.

I had never heard of a Kati roll until I walked by Spice End and decided to satisfy my curiosity.  Now I am hooked.  I had the Chicken Tikka roll with a side of Veggie Biryani rice (a combo offered in their lunchbox special from 11am-2pm).  Delicious!  The chicken roll was full of freshly cooked, tender chunks of chicken breast and accompanied by just the right amount of mint-coriander curry.  The wrap was not a fluffy naan or a thin pita as I expected, but a thin and tender wrap.  That made it easy to eat without making a mess, plus left room to enjoy the rice.  Very filling, tasty lunch at a reasonable price. I will be back!

Where do I start...the employees are constantly unfriendly and unhelpful. They are always out of multiple ingredients. Employees are often not wearing masks and conformational when asked to put on a mask. You are not allowed to get in the dining area, yet employees are always hanging out without masks on at these blocked off tables. If the manager is not around the employees simply don't care at all, and when the manager is around they give the bare minimum. This is by far my least favorite chipotle that I have ever been to.

I absolutely love HipCityVeg, and it warms my heart to see them expanding! I hope one day they'll consider bringing their vegan cheesesteaks to the west coast - we're in dire need of a tasty one in Los Angeles!

The past few years, I haven't had enough real estate in my stomach to grab a meal here, but I still stop by to grab the BEST HOT CHOCOLATE EVER and a cookie, usually right before walking over to the Christmas village. I am not kidding you when I say they have cracked the code for creamy, decadent, perfectly sweet but not cloying, perfectly rich but drinkable hot chocolate, complete with whipped cream. It's a good thing it's not so easy for me to get into the city, or I'd be here every day. I've never come close to replicating it at home.

Their cookies and brownies are always delicious, maybe not "best ever!" but a lovely accompaniment to my hot chocolate all the same. HipCityVeg makes walking around the city in winter so special to me, I love them so much!

My first Chinatown Square visit was a major success. 

My friend Bridget & I wandered through the first floor and landed at Coreanos, and I think we were both thrilled with our lunches.

I ordered a bowl, and built it with rice, bulgogi, veggies, gochujang, and guacamole. The bowl came out pretty quickly and I ate every grain of rice and every bit of kimchi. The steak was tender and flavorful, I loved the bright and tangy flavors of the kimchi & bulgogi. It was a very generous portion, and I would love to try it with one of the chicken options or carnitas.

My friend ordered a bowl as well, but got it loaded with extra veggies. She also really enjoyed her bowl. 

Service was pretty quick, considering it was on the verge of the lunch rush.

Really looking forward to coming back!

It was as good as expected with the exception of pink in what was suppose to be a WELL DONE burger.   If you don't have a microwave (at hotel) skip cheese on the fries. It was cold & hard.  Thank goodness the burger was somewhat warm.

I was so excited to have a Chipotle open up in the neighborhood. Unfortunately they opened during a pandemic. Even though they were new, they were clean, and setting precautions, which was good. However, the food itself was underwhelming; smaller portions than what we usually get with the same order from other Chipotles.

If I could give zero I would! I feel like it's purposely being done when you specifically say no ketchup!!! I know reading directions is maybe 98% of the job! But to do it after someone even saying their allergic really grinds my gears! Like people pay for a service and if you don't want to do it properly I think maybe I suggest you start looking for another job! Like y'all be on some petty BS

Fast, accurate, and friendly - I had a 15 minute "layover" on the Keystone line at Philadelphia's 30th St station.  Ran upstairs, asked if they could do a quick order - the cashier said "yessir" and they went to work.  Had my order in about 8 minutes - and it was right on!    Many thanks to the team there!!

A milkshake and fries from Shake Shack will brighten any day. Even the monthly specials don't disappoint. Throw in a burger to make it a meal. I've done pick up and delivery and the quality was maintained with both. Just don't bother with the cheese fries. Cheese comes on the side and doesn't reheat well.
This chipotle is just gross. We are pretty sure they reused tops for our burrito bowls because there was food smeared on them. And they forgot ingredients...

used to be my favorite spot but then they hired a new guy who screwed up my order. He forgot the rice and put veggies and sauce. When i went back and asked them add rice,instead of remaining it they dumped rice on the bowl and threw in the contents from old bowl and sent it back. Dint bother to mix it either. Also the guy was being very rude about the fact that he forgot the rice.

Today I visited this location and placed my order via the drive they, my prefer number is 22. The drive thru attendant was very nice and I agreed to wait the additional 5 min for my seafood order to be made fresh. A young lady came to my car with my order she was very pleasant and wished AME a nice day. I looked over my order and realized I was missing one of my shrimp and fish boxes, so I gathered all the food and went inside. I got the attention of the young lady that brought  my order out and told her what was wrong and she began to fix the problem. The manager (orangish button down) came from out of nowhere and began talking very aggressively to the young lady who was fixing my order (she had my entire order behind the counter) telling her to shut her mouth when she was trying to explain what was wrong with my order. Then he proceeded to open all my boxes and rummage thrum
Food no gloves nothing! I called to him and requested that he not touch my food with his bare hands he told me that he was the manager and he's doing his job and again I said "DO NOT touch my food with your bare hands! He continued to go back and forth with me and proceeded to repack my food and give it to me STILL missing my 2nd shrimp and fish basket. I then summoned the original young lady to come and actually fix my order and requested that he not touch it at all. I am the manager of a fast casual restaurant in university city Philadelphia and not only would I never talk down to my team members i also would NEVER argue with a guest who is the main reason why I have my job. His behavior was absolutely unacceptable and the Popeyes brand should be way more mindful of who you have leading your stores. I can't speak for any other guest that witnessed his behavior but many of them said that he always behaves that way and harasses his team. You do not create a good working culture/environment treating your people like trash! His position seriously needs re-evaluation. And I certainly offered that young lady the opportunity  to interview with my company because nobody deserves to be subject to that kind of harsh undeveloping work environment. In the end my food was good but the experience had me livid.

Popped in to buy a whole cake for a presentation. The girl that helped me had to ask her manager if I could have a dozen or so small plates...to which he/she said NO? I then asked for a cake cutter, serving utensil (plastic comes with every order in catering) to which she looked at me like I was crazy and said, NO. Job well done Corner Bakery...

I know, I know, it's kinda ridiculous that we JUST tried Shake Shack, but we never really felt the desire to go especially when I knew they didn't have a veggie burgers. Well, they don't, which in this day and age is absurd to me, but they do offer the most INSANE mushrooms as a non-meat option!! They're fried to golden perfection and have a layer of melty cheese baked into them! If you're a mushroom fan, I will tell you that these are worth a visit alone!! And if you're not a veg-head, you can add this to a regular burger and make it a double stack. Mom had it and loved it. My brother is obsessed with Shake Shake, and that's his go-to. Mushrooms are where it's at here!!

The fries were just ok. I'm glad we just got a few for our large party to taste. 

Milkshakes were rather basic but thoroughly enjoyed by the kiddos. 

We did enjoy their signature brew, which I a lighter lager. Think Yuengling. 

Honestly, the mushroom is what's making me crave a return visit and give it more than a 3 star. That bad boy is a solid 5! The kids have been begging to go back since we first visited. 

Our party of 6 pushed a few tables together outside and had a nice time on the street. 

Casual pay at the counter joint. 
Typical kiosk meter parking.

So, I work near Rittenhouse and have gotten into the budget friendly habit of packing my lunch because of the limited, reasonably priced, healthy options... and then I didn't have time to pack a lunch one day so popped into Snap Kitchen. Woah. I almost wish I hadn't discovered how AWESOME this place is.

I stood just looking at everything for a few minutes (not sure where to start because it all looked SO good!) before one of the employees who was stocking the shelves asked if I needed anything. She recommended the brisket with veggies and it was seriously good! I loved that they give you instructions on how long to heat things up for and that everything has a close "sell by" date. Real food. I'm sold.

i'll be honest. the best mcflurry i've had. the ratio of oreo and ice cream was perfect. i think they measured 
i can't comment on the service, though i would love to, but i was drunk and got uber eats. 
my driver seemed happy and my mcflurrys weren't melting at all. i tipped well. 
got one for my sister. she was sticky and my friend had to give her a bath but it was worth it.

Yum!  I was happy to run into this truck last night in Manayunk.  Portions and prices were fair, service was nice, and food came out soon after we ordered.

We tried:

-Dan Dan Cauliflower:  This was a special listed on a sign separate from the menu.  It was $5 for a good amount of cauliflower in a spicy sauce with a heavy flavor of sesame.  I was pleasantly surprised by the kick it had.  The sauce was a little too thin to coat the cauliflower fully, but this was no problem as there was an excess of sauce at the bottom of the container to dip into.

-Drunken Noodles: I get wary of noodles on food trucks sometimes but these were perfectly cooked.  There was a nice array of protein and veggies, including shrimp, chicken, broccoli, snap peas, carrots, scallions, and bell pepper.  The chicken was juicy and not dry at all.  Flavor and spice level were both great.  I also liked that the two types of protein came standard.

The truck had a nice selection of beverages for $1, including three types of LaCroix.  We grabbed a pamplemousse (grapefruit) flavor, and it was a refreshing addition to our meal.

Wokworks is definitely one of my favorite food trucks that have been in the area lately, and I really hope they return again soon!

A solid burger but nothing to write home about. Typical burger that can easily be replicated but obviously better than anything a "clown" or "king" or "girl with pigtails" could make.

The seating here during the weekend is abysmal and its highly recommended to just go for takeout if you're nearby or even just take it to the park for a nice meal on the benches.

The pastries are pretty good, but I find their food to be processed regardless of what the menu might claim.  Their soup taste like they poured salt in it, forgot they salted it & then salted it again and once again for good measure.   I'm learning to cook at home.
These place is trash got young people working there and they have no clue what they are doing
Never again! Ordered Uber eats and was eating my food and found a dead bug in it- almost gagged- suck in the stomach now. Done ordering Uber eats and done just getting food delivered. Nasty ass food

They finally serve ramen here so I came to check it out a couple weeks ago. I ordered the ramen with bbq chicken combo. By the time our food came out, my bbq chicken was cold and it wasn't that crispy, which was disappointing. The ramen was okay, nothing too special to rave about tbh. I wish they served it with soft boiled egg. One where the egg yolk oozes out, but they served it with hard boiled egg. 

I will come back again to order their popcorn chicken. It was really good besides the fact that it was served cold. Again. This place has a lot of potential, just needs a little tweaking. The service was lovely btw :)

Take a bus into the city, have a sit down lunch, and take a train back. I assure you it will be faster. 

Won't be back
Rude staff, over priced, filthy area where sandwiches are made. Spend your money elsewhere
i dont come here often but every time i do i have to end up pulling over and waiting for them to bring my food. THEY ARE NEVER READY. Whoever their manager is they need to  get their staff together

Amazing people who make amazing food!! The sweet potato fries is the best we've had (and we go to really highly rated places to eat). Food was ready before suggested pick up time and everything was so fresh and tasty. The people serving us were super friendly and extremely cautious of the Covid situation. They took all precautions to keep the place clean and food fresh. Ours was  probably the first take out order this morning...we got crispy hip city ranch and ziggy sandwiches. All sandwiches were amazing. Definitely be back next time we are in the city.

i wish i could give them more stars! i went through the drive thru a few days ago and my order wasn't going be ready right away, they ended up giving me a larger side and an extra drink that i hadn't ordered. everyone there was so kind and so accommodating. such an awesome team of people working here.

If you find yourself in the center city area of Philadelphia and need a quick healthy bite to eat I definitely recommend this place.

There are plenty of great choices for carnivorous types but for quasi-vegetarians like me there are also a number of really good vegan options here. 

The. Beyond Meat vegan burger. I had this two days in a row here. W hat I love about today's veggie burgers is they are nearly indistinguishable from meat patties. 

The curry tofu wrap is also an excellent healthy choice and it's a nice sized wrap with lots of taste. I recommend and aïoli sauce to pick it up even a step more.

The sweet potato fries dipped in their own hip city sauce make for a really nice side. 

The nuggets are also vegan and really good!  They combine well with the fries if that's all you're having. 

The folks working here are also great - very helpful, and can let you know exactly what's in the food as well as how it's prepared. 

In a world of toxic foods I've got a special place in my heart for quick and healthy options and they score high at this great little spot. 

I'll definitely be back when I'm in this part of town.

My go to is the chicken sandwich and never disappoints me.  This is a big sandwich and comes with lettuce, tomato, onion, and ranch sauce.  

The only complaint is that it's a pricey sandwich and you might still be hungry.  Probably want to add a side if you're here.

I got in line quarter of 11 AM on opening day and was pleasantly surprised at the size of the line. Every minute the line got longer and longer. I felt like all of the staff had taken ecstacy before beginning their shifts based on their wide-eyed enthusiasm and excitement. 

Doors opened and the line moved swiftly. I ordered the ShakeMeister Ale brewed specially for Shake Shack by Brooklyn Brewery. It was a refreshing pale ale that was perfect for washing down the delicious cheeseburger that I devoured within 60 seconds. The meat was juicy and flavorful and the bun was soft and buttery. I also had a side of perfectly crisp crinkle fries. Typing this review makes me want to get back in line and this time double the meat :). 

Next time I go back I will definitely try their shake of the day, the blackberry buttermilk sounded amazing.
Best Gyro in the city, maybe the best I've ever had. Staff is welcoming and takes great care of you!

This has turned into our go-to place for a fast bite when in Philadelphia, especially since we are always in 30th St Station. We especially like the breakfast menu (not offered in other locations). Pork roll and cheese! Showing our Jersey roots here. The other subs are also great. It makes a difference when the meats and cheeses are fresh sliced to order, instead of being stacked in a tray for who knows how long. We've been to several Jersey Mike's and haven't had a bad one yet. Recommended!

The best things that this Corner Bakery has going for it is that it is the only Corner Bakery in Center City, and it has the standard drink fountains that all Corner Bakery locations have.

And then there are a few notable problems with this location.

Breakfast is minimal. Do not come here expecting to have the full Corner Bakery breakfast menu, such as hot cakes. The limited menu aside, the food you get otherwise is standard decent Corner Bakery fare.

The staff give you minimal service. It just always feels like they could care less about anything besides taking your orders and getting your food out of their hair. 

The hours are very limited: it closes by 2pm on weekends and by 6pm on weekdays. You can't have a relaxing evening meal in this nice, cozy place.

It's great to have a Corner Bakery in Center City; it just misses its own opportunities.
Best chipotle around!! Don't usually even leave reviews but wanted to give a shout-out. The meat is always juicy and the portions have been perfect. Great job!!!

Been frequenting the pop up kitchen in Conshohocken, every few days I have to get Wokworks because I'm afraid they'll be gone before I know it! Hands down the BEST egg noodles I've ever had in my life. So fluffy and chewy. I haven't ordered anything with other noodles because I literally cannot pass up the perfectly cooked lo mein noodles in chili oil. If you're ordering from here, you must get the lo mein! Hope this pop up sticks around for a while.

Just walked out after attempting to place an order. We were told that they all had just started lunch and wouldn't be making any orders for at least another 20 minutes. What is going on in this place?? What restaurant shuts down and has ALL the staff go on break simultaneously? Where is management? Should have gone with our first impression and stayed away...

I love Chipotle and have been a loyal customer for years. I have the app, collect bonus points, and frequent Chipotle at least several times per month. However, this location (12th and Walnut in Philadelphia) is HORRIBLE. I have ordered from this location, unfortunately, more times than I can count through the app and in-person (pre-coronavirus - I know I'm writing this in the thick of a global pandemic) and they have botched our order EVERY SINGLE TIME. From missing ingredients to neglecting to include sides and failing to reimburse us after the fact. I've called and complained, and at one point they actually hung up on me. We ordered via mobile last night, picked up our order, asked at the door if it was complete and everything was included, and were ASSURED multiple times it was fine. We didn't open the bag due to the current health crisis. Upon getting home, sure enough, items were missing. The portion sizes were (and always are at this location) the smallest I've seen from any location. There are no other locations within reasonable walking distance, otherwise we would never return. In a broader sense, I love Chipotle and will continue to go to their other establishments, but this particular one is seriously the worst.

Anlmost none of the workers were wearing their face masks correctly or some at all. Lots below the nose- some just only on the chin and the person giving the orders out when they were ready was literally talking INTO the bags without a mask on, calling out the orders for people. I felt disgusted watching the whole scene considering the increase/influx in Covid cases lately. It's also a matter of their protection with so many folks literally traveling through 30th street station.

This place has really fell off ordered yesterday and the family meal smell applied and burnt from the firecracker chicken breast to rice and everything else Will never come back here I don't understand why you all will serve something like this to anyone if you want good food go somewhere else not here

The worker at the food counter (black girl, dreadlocks) was maskless as she created my food. I could forgive that, but the fact that her and another coworker were laughing hard and talking as she looked directly at my sandwich was too much. I asked as politely as I could if I could have one remade and this set off a whole ordeal with managers, the staff complaining about customers and discussing how rude I was to my face (I littered my request for a new sandwich with so many apologies I can't fathom how I came across as rude or 'yelling'. I even whispered the request to her when no other customers were around!) 

Then the workers began cackling about covid being a fake disease and how there's a "perfectly good sandwich" left on the counter.

The other one and two star reviews are a testament to how low quality this Wawa is. After nearly 10 minutes of waiting a night supervisor remade my order which I'm thankful for and apologized for. But as she did it her co workers were the rudest, most dismissive and disrespectful workers I've ever seen at any store in University City, let alone a Wawa. And all because one of them was not following their own rules others had to. The icing on the cake is that the same girl prepared another's meal with no gloves. 

I definitely won't be stopping by here ever again.

WARNING I REPEAT WARNING 
DON'T go to this location I went here and got food for everyone because we wanted Wendy's and that night was the worst night ever everyone got food poisoning it was horrible! I'm still dealing with the effects now. Do your bathroom a favor and go to another location

Been here twice so far, and have been happy with the popcorn chicken both times.  I've compared and contrasted the garlic flavoring versus the original, and honestly couldn't discern much of a difference.  I have yet to try the boxes or anything else, but for a quick snack or something to eat while driving, it's a good & cheap option.  Service can take a little while since they're frying to order though, so be prepared to wait especially if others have ordered before you.

Ok first off. The employees yea mask cops. Young man approach me before I could even land my two feet in the door about a mask. No hello thank you for coming or welcome to chipotle. Just immediately yelled out your mask . I didn't appreciate it at all as I had my autistic son with me and my mask in hand. He didn't even give me time to put my mask on. Very unprofessional the line was filthy the prep area was filthy .  But than has a nerve to have his nose sticking out of the top of his mask. So are we wearing mask or not . ??? Than the manager took 10mins to come from back you would of thought he was coming with mask in hand. Nope than when I ask for cooperate he said it wasn't one. I use to work for the company years ago so I know it needs to be ran better. I didn't even purchase from this location I just went to the next one. New GM ASAP.
Came for the BTS Meal (for a limited time only!) I personally preferred the Sweet Chili sauce. It really complements the McNuggets. Successful promotion/collab but it's definitely overhyped.
They do have the best fries and burgers. I really enjoy their quick service. Friendly and polite. Always a clean place.

I've never had Panda express pre-covid so I wasn't sure what to expect, but I was thoroughly happy with my first experience.  For our date night, we went for the family meal. This includes 2 sides with 3 entrees for $35. The entrees were just what you'd expect. The chow mein on the other hand, was chewier than it probably should have been/tasted of flour but I'm a sicko and loved it. Overall, I think it was a good value for the food you got, considering all the boxes were filled to the brim and the fact that they were even offering takeout at a time like this is a huge plus in my book. I'll be back for more.

Stopped by this location after doing a little shopping at the mall! Got home and was surprised to see the smallest hardest chicken strips I've ever gotten at KFC! I was not in the mood to drive all the way back 20 mins so I threw it in the trash! I know this is fast food but usually KFC is wayyyy better than this! Totally turned me off of going there or to any KFC ever again!

When I booked my trip to Philly one of the suggestions I received was to eat at Shake Shack. Coming from Orange County, CA I knew it would be tough to beat the infamous In-N-Out burger.

Simplicity can go a long way, one of the reasons why I like In-N-Out so much. Shake Shack does offer simple burger creations. I had the Shackburger - cheeseburger topped with lettuce, tomato, and shacksauce, shared the crinkle cut Yukon potato fries with the friends, and fresh brewed iced tea. 

I was pleasantly surprised at how good the Shackburger was. Since the burgers are all cooked medium, the patty wasn't overly cooked and dried. The burger definitely tasted fresh and not the run-of-the-mill fast food burgers like McDonalds or Burger King. The buns were extremely soft, I was told the buns are steamed therefore resulting in the softer texture. I prefer my buns a bit crispy, but the softer buns weren't too bad. I would say the burger is considered "small" to American standards, but it was a perfect size for me. For those who have a much bigger appetite, I would suggest ordering two burgers (or at least two Shackburgers). 
 
I can't remember the last time I had crinkle cut fries! I definitely indulged on the fries which were very crispy and perfectly cooked. 

There is plenty of table/booth/bar seating at this location. 

I definitely see myself paying Shake Shack another visit when I'm on the East, until then In-N-Out will hold me over!

I've had fine food here but often times it's surprisingly bad. Mcdonalds is so consistent usually, this is without a doubt the worst location I've found. Last time was the final nail in the coffin when both my cheeseburgers were totally hard and old with no condiments or anything on them. Waited 30 minutes for food that was clearly older. Bummer.
Horrible, messed up my order completely. Didn't get anything right, just a disgrace like fix your workers.

This place is awesome! The platter sizes are very generous and the food is fantastic. The food is priced right and you shouldn't drive by this place without stopping by because it's that tasty! The tzatziki is delicious and the inside of the restaurant is very clean. To top all of this off the employees are all very kind. Everyone should give this place a try!

I came here to get breakfast before my bus ride. The clerk working behind the counter was laconic and rude. When I got there at 10:02 to get a breakfast sandwich, he gruffly informed me that breakfast ended at 10 AM. I can't abide a food establishment that is unwilling to be flexible to the customer. I proceeded directly to Cosi and ate a very delicious breakfast sandwich, and the staff there couldn't have been nicer.

I go here twice a week, so obviously it isn't that bad. However, it is not one of my favorite chipotles, I only go here because it is very near one of my offices. I have to ask for extra chicken every time and end up with the same amount i get at others. I also have and to skip the lettuce for the past few weeks because it tastes pretty bad and made the whole burrito taste funky. 

They are fast and even at peak hours they can get me in and out in 15 minutes or so which is better than most chiptoles at noon.  They also have a clean restroom.

I was specifically craving JMs Cali chicken cheesesteak hoagie with fried o light on the mayo on a scooped out whole-wheat roll with peppers and mushroom and man did they deliver. Seriously their best effort thus far. I forgot to ask them to cut it but managed to gobble it all up without a drip on my outfit and didn't even need a napkin even though it was very juicy and delicious. 

Service as always was a 6/5
California chicken cheesesteak hoagie with fried onions, mushrooms, peppers on whole wheat roll light on the mayo 6/5

I only ever seem to end up here around closing time, so they are almost always out of at least one kind of chicken I want (either they don't have any more spicy, or any more white meat, or whatever). It's my favorite fast food, though, so I still go. The previous reviewer is right--the dining area is around 80F in both summer and winter, so it's not ideal for eating in. Not to mention they seem strangely barren of tables. Their sides are delicious, though, especially the beans, and they always make fries fresh to order. One last note: unlike KFC, their chicken is amazingly good eaten cold the next day--equally as good as when it's fresh, actually.

IN SUMMARY
Food freshness: usually good
Order accuracy: 60%, below average
Overall staff attitude: lackluster
Cleanliness of dining area: not dirty, but the floor is always slippery
Cleanliness of bathrooms: ?
Refills on drinks: no
Condiments, napkins, utensils: at the counter
Kid's play area: no
Drive-through: no

Stopped by this location in the morning to try their philly cheesesteak and see how it compared to others in the area. It was right around hwne they opened, and normally they wouldn't make the sandwich until lunchtime, but luckily it wasn't too busy, so they happily made it for me, which I really appreciated! 

Since this location also served breakfast, we also tried their hashbrown patties, which are a lot like what you'd get at McDonald's, and tasted even better! 

I also got some of their kale lemonade, because I think it's blasphemy to stop at HCV and not get the kale lemonade. It's just so good!

I have had Jersey Mike's Subs passing through 30th Street station before and stopped by on my way home from trip back home to Midwest. They give you a choice of white or wheat and you choose toppings. They do not skimp on cheese or meat. They prepare your sandwich after you order and slice the meat(in mt case I had the number 7 (turkey). It's tasty, hearty and delicious. A Good deal for anyone, weary traveler, commuter or someone just passing through. I will go back as they have great sub sandwiches.
Extremely disappointed with my purchase today. My husbands strips looked like chicken nuggets & my pot pie was burnt & extremely dry! Never again.. such a waste of time & money!
This Chipotle works so hard to deal with annoying college kids, the food is always great and the chips are so good

frightening experience in my life! ordered a peppermint mocha coffee (which was ice cold) but i decided to heat it up at my office but when i started to drink it i felt a hard object in my mouth. i thought maybe they had added an actual piece of candy! no it was a piece of hardware from the coffee machine! i really will never eat or drink here and dont suggest you do either!
You pay $9.25 for brown guac and super small portions that will leave you still hungry. I usually love chipotle but this isn't worth it.

Beloved Shake Shack. How I love you so. Even when I leave NYC, you seem to end up in places where I visit. I used to live near a Shake Shack in Manhattan, and oh boy, did that destroy my physique. I guess daily Shack Stacks and fries can do that to you. Now that Shake Shack has migrated to Philly, people in PA can have a taste of epic-ness.  This Shake Shack is located right in the heart of downtown Philadelphia, around Rittenhouse Square. It's not a large location, but when I went, it was pretty empty and there wasn't much of a line. 

Now if you haven't had Shake Shack before, you're really missing out on something great. Sure, there are great burger spots like In-N-Out, but Shake Shack really trumps them all. The selections here are pretty simple, giving you a choice between 4 types of burgers: Shack Burger, Shack Stack, Shroom Burger, and the Smoke Burger, hot dogs, milkshakes, and fries. Hands down, the best thing to get here is the Shack Stack. Having a nice fried portobello mushroom stuffed with munster cheese, right in the middle of a Shack burger is just a messy masterpiece. With every bite, you get a nice crunch, goo, and burger taste all at once. Just make sure you have a nice $8 to buy one of these bad boys. The fries here are pretty standard, not amazing but not horrible either. If you're a sweets guy, then you're in for a treat. Shake Shack has a bunch of custards to choose from, which are all equally amazing. If that's not your cup of tea, then there are tons of milkshakes too. 

Alcoholic rejoice too because Shake Shack serves wine and beer! What's better than a burger with alcohol? Not much really. 

Shake Shack. I love you so much but you're so damn bad for my diet. For you, I will make everyday a cheat day just to have a good ol Shack Stack and my Arnold Palmer.

Kathi Rolls are quick and convenient ways to enjoy the flavors of Middle Eastern/Indian food without having to sit down to a proper meal. I enjoyed the paneer roll, the chicken was fine- the staff was quite nice and the location seemed to be doing a brisk takeout business. I also enjoyed the rose lassi, even though it was a bit thick. We came here because we were in the area, would return if we were close by, but I wouldn't make the trip just for it. Four stars because of the staff, would give the food an a-ok.
When I want Subway, this is my go-to location. The sandwich artists are always pleasant and I love that the quality is consistent each time I visit.

This is my go to Chipotle when I am craving it, about once every couple of months. So far I've had a positive experience and food has been fresh and tasty. The person who made my bowl last night's was particularly effective - she had it ready in almost under a minute!

They didn't include my izze's, and didn't even tell me about it because they were out. So they were just gonna get an extra $5 for literally nothing. Also the burrito I got was small as f**k I can't believe I paid money for this

Terrible service, unorganized one register 
Manager and cashier, seem not to have a clue
Long time customer, Bala Cynwyd location 
Need an effective manager. 6:30 Friday night
Won't come back and will post this on Facebook

we had a mobile order last week .
the nicest young man was at the counter .it was evening,after 7 p.m. , a thrusday ,might actually have been the 12th ...
( it was a night that ran out of whopper rolls ,and he nicely explained that to every customer ).
he was a thin kid and I wished I got his name .
hard worker ,he straightened things ,replaced cups ,and even swept the front end floor.. .
I hope burger king sees the potential in this young man !
the food ,well it's burger king so ...there's that .
those jalapeño things are pretty good though, we ordered two ,with some other things .

Waited well over 10 mins for someone to acknowledge me to take my order in the drive thru - which never happened. So after watching 2 cars that were ahead of me pull up to the next window I thought maybe the speaker had broken. I inched up and waited in line for over 15 mins. Finally after getting up to the window to let the employee know that I didn't place an order because I thought the speaker was broken (which apparently it wasn't) I was told to circle around and go back in line to place my order even though all I wanted was a cheeseburger and fries. What a joke.

I just keep writing one star reviews and your automated manager guy offers me free something I never have once gotten.  Every single time I order from your store something is either missing or the order is wrong, cold, disgusting.  This time you sent me chicken nuggets without the BBQ sauce requested so I dry gross nuggets to choke down.

Sometimes meh. Sometimes great. The experience has always been hit or miss for me depending on who is working there, how agreeable and funny they are and how generous they are. (After 10-ish trips to this location.) Del's chicken is among the best I've ever eaten.

The milkshakes are good, but just that. Good nothing stellar. 

The beauty of Shake Shack is that the wait for village whiskey is a little shorter!
Today my boyfriend found a sharp piece of plastic in his usual custom salad order. We generally like going here but now I am disappointed.

This will be my last review. To be honest, I can't explain why I would review a glorified fast food joint on three separate occasions. I think the continued overrated hype of this place fuels the fire or maybe I'm trying to see if I'm clearly missing something. 

Let's get down to business. I came into try the Chicken Shack sandwich.. Before I came in, I kept hearing about the greatness of this sandwich, as well as how it's going to crush the soul of Chick fil a. 

Like in the past, I was not impressed. The chicken it's self was ok, To be honest, it was freaking Boring. Restaurants are all about be buttermilk ranch batter. What ranch? I didn't taste anything. Buttermilk ranch batter seasonings supposed to be zesty. There is absolutely no zest in existence.. It's a tired ass sandwich, plan and simple..

Between the flimsy bun, the shredded ice burg lettuce, the pickle and mayo, nothing stood out. On top of this, the damn thing was over 6 bucks. If you add in fries and a drink, you're paying over 12 bucks for a  mediocre meal. 

I truly have nothing personal against the Shake Shack establishment. I really dig the ambiance and the alcohol options but in my humble opinion, there are so many better burger and sandwich options in this city. I think people get caught up in the fact this this place is a product of NY, so it must be good and we need to submit. People, this isn't the case. 

In the end, in the world of " fast food" "fast casual", Chick fil a reins supreme. It's a fraction of the price and just can't be beat from their chicken sandwich options.

good food and fast friendly service. this place recently opened so I figured id give em a try. ordered the beef/lamb gyro platter with rice and a side salad. food was fresh and the portion was nice. I found the pitas to be exceptional. not sure if they make them or not (doubtful) they heated them on the grill and they were really good. the side salad was super fresh and flavorful as well. id def eat here again.

It's a pretty typical Jersey Mike's location. 

It's fine for what it but it's not tops for a sub shop 
But this true of all Jersey Mike's 

Average at best with messy sandwiches 
Lots of better spots available

I would give this place zero stars if I could. Tonight my app confirmed the scheduled order pickup for 645pm and I did not get my food until 815pm. They were so behind on pick up orders that they even closed down the walk in line - only online orders were allowed. How does that happen at a "fast food" restaurant? Some people even canceled their pickup order because the line was obviously a faster way to get their food. They were turned away and told to wait. Oh and the best part was, once they smartened up and used both serving lines, the manager started preparing food for the 730pm orders - so everyone from 6-730 (still waiting for their order) was stuck in a longer wait line than people that ordered their food after them! 

Management was no help. They complained they were under staffed. Not only can you not keep up with 30-50 patrons, you lost another 25 as they trickled in to the walk in line only to be turned away. How that place makes money is astonishing. 

Lastly - the portions are easily half what they are at other chipotles. Not an exaggeration - HALF. Do yourself a favor and go to another chipotle or eat somewhere else.

The one star regards the following only: We were disappointed to stop in Shake Shack to place an order only to discover that they weren't taking walk-in orders anymore. You have to now do it through the app, no cash transactions. Not too long ago I had no problem ordering in person, & paying with cash, and this was still during the pandemic with the 2 separate lines for paying & picking up.
Shake Shack has always been consistently good to us at this location. We have been frequent customers. Not everyone can go the digital route, or wants to put their bill on a credit card. I am hoping this will be temporary, as we are hoping to stop by frequently, & pay with cash. We want to be able to continue to patronize your business.

Shake Shack used to just be a place to get a decent burger.  Now, its gone ahead and introduced chicken!  Seriously, this Shake Shack location is clean and welcoming.  Seating can be a bit limited, especially colder days where you might not want to sit outside.  The have a few beers on tap and all the standard shack offerings in an easy to get to (if you live in the city) location. If you haven't had a shack burger, nothing I'd type would be able to describe it.  Better than 5 guys, not quite In-n-Out, check them out to judge for yourself.

This place is great! I tried every platter so far except the wraps and they are super good! The spicy is amazingly spicy so beware! However the food makes you come back for more because it great food and good service and now they're even on GrubHUB!

My no mayo chicken sandwich had tons of mayo and worst of all it was completely raw! I ate so much of it and have been puking for a while now. Also no one had there masks on, no one, not even the manager in his collared shirt , it seemed like they were closing, tons of people out of uniform,  gloveless, chilling, munching. I don't think I'll ever recover from this.

I've been here twice and my experiences were not good. The first time I ordered an iced tea.The tea tasted like coffee. Do they clean their machines? Ew gross! They fixed my order,but charged me to fix the problem. The second time was a little better, but I asked for no cheese on my sandwich. I got cheese on it. I wasn't impressed with this location. I'll go to other Wendy's

My fear of being late leads me to always being very early for everything. I had an interview nearby and it was snowing outside and I had time to kill. I saw the Corner Bakery and headed on in.  It's got the fast/casual set up where you order at the counter and can pick up some items immediately and others get brought to your table.

I usually don't eat breakfast, but I can do a light pastry or fruit. I ordered a croissant and a water. The cashier was very welcoming and polite. I got the croissant right away on a real plate (no paper/plastic) and a cup for my water. It was crowded, but the space was pretty big so finding a seat wasn't an issue. The dining area looked clean as well. 

The croissant had nice flakey layers on the outside and was moist inside. I honestly wasn't expecting much, but it was really good!  People's prepared food at nearby tables looked appetizing. If I hadn't been so nervous about my interview and it wasn't so early, I would have ordered more! 

I would like to go back and try some of the menu items. This seems like a nice breakfast/lunch spot.

I ordered KFC about a week ago and the food actually was hot when it was delivered. 

The food was really good too and the biscuits were incredible.
 
Everything that came tasted so good, no complaints here. 

I don't know why there are so many low ratings, but I really enjoyed this KFC.

Superbly fresh and tasty meals -- 4/5 times. Unfortunately, I was recently disappointed with the green curry during my last visit, which I ordered over rice noodles. The actual spice level of this sauce was inaccurately described on the menu board. I can attest to this because I've ordered items ranked with higher spice levels that have actually tasted far less spicy than the green curry I wound up getting. I do enjoy spicy food every now and then, but I wasn't expecting (or wanting) my dish to be that hot. Plus, the noodles are on the delicate side, so they were totally overpowered. I wound up not being able to finish my food and more than half went to waste.

I was a little put off by this, but I will be back because I've had so many amazing meals. I'm aware that they're a franchise, and they seem to be spreading rapidly, so I hope they maintain the same great quality I've come to know.

I always love Popeyes but this time when I went in to order there was a roach crawling on the counter. The girl working tried to act like she didn't notice it, but that's gross. Sadly, I left and went to another location near by on front street.

We asked a simple question about seating and we just got stared at for a few seconds then a shoulder shrug the girl only responded because I said damn we can't ask questions as a paying customer she then said idk I'm not the one who makes the decisions (duh you checking people out) with the rest of the city open every one was asking this question, so there's no meetings being had about this? train your employees to do better than a shoulder shrug when asked a question better yet call chic-fil-a and get their training video. my god!
I went there after work a month ago, the one at 30th street station. They greet you warmly, the meat is fresh, a little costly but worth the sacrifice if you don't want to cook.
During this time Covid they gave extremely too many workers an still slow with service they hair hanging down they shirts too small they stand so close to each other just a mess

Convenience. The main reason I stop at this Wawa is because it's along my travel route. If you've been in one, you've almost been in all of them. With the exception of employees and appearance. The location isn't bad. In the middle of University city there's all sorts of people that come through this Wawa. It's a clean store for the most part and I haven't come across an unpleasant employee yet.

Unfortunately, this location is hit or miss. Today's order for pick-up was all wrong - incorrect meats (and very skimpy on the meat), wrong toppings, and no guac on one (which I paid for).  Plus they put cheese on both orders and we didn't ask for any cheese (one of us is lactose intolerant).  
When we called to rectify the order, they didn't pick-up the phone. 

As bad as this order was, we ordered for delivery once and it was awesome (correct orders and standard meat portions). Seems they have a particular set of staff that does things right and another set that may not.

Shame on chipotle...I'm paying chipotle prices and getting Taco Bell quality and quantity.  Ordered the chicken quesadilla thinking it would look like the picture advertised and got this instead.  Super greasy , barely any cheese, or chicken, all tortilla, tiny sides.  What a joke.  The corn salsa was just corn, the rice was burnt.  Oh well won't be back.

Pretty good, pretty good food.

I have only have chicken and rice from those carts in New York and those samples are the benchmark to which I am comparing the food to.

The restaurant is pretty casual, reminds me almost of a fast food place.

I got the chicken and rice which was good. The sauces (I agree with all the other reviews), have a different flavor than what I was expecting. The white sauce was tasty, I could probably smoother my food in it, if I knew it was good for me. The red sauce was just hot, not flavorful, just added some heat to everything. 

I also got the mixed vegetable kati roll which was also pretty good. The filling consistency was that of retried beans, but tasty. I could probably eat 2-3 of these for a meal of I ordered it on its own. 

Lastly, there's a loyalty program that gets you free food. The food is a little pricey, but the thought of potential free food rounds my 3.5 up to a solid 4.

"Chinese restaurant" run by non-Chinese people with terrible customer service. My family and I walked and and we're not even greeted. The employee simply said "bowl or plate". Hell if I know! This is the first time I've been there. And when I asked for an explanation I was told to look at the board. Great answer right? Long story short: we left and went to the diner!

When I'm traveling corner bakery is a great spot to stop for a quick breakfast and coffee.  I like ordering online so it's ready when I get there. My favorite items are the bacon egg bowl and the cold brew coffee.  It's great because there is a corner bakery in most big cities.

Biggest fried jumbo squid I've seen!!! Definitely get it when you are in Chinatown! It's kind funny that you can find people posting "looking for girlfriend on their board" lol definitely come in and give a five star review! Open late till 1 am
They laughed at me for trying to order...rude and not helpful I don't have much to say it was the worst experience I have ever had at a fast food restaurant. Do not go there!

I became a more humane eater in March, the beginning of COVID and I was influenced and inspired by a vegan friend.  On the last day that we got to see each other while he was in town before moving, we decided we wanted to have a vegan meal because he inspired me to change my life in so many ways.  We were going to try some other place out but I really wanted to try out HipCity, so we did and I remember us grinning, enjoying our food, we were standing on the sidewalk on Broad St.  I ate the delicious sweet potato fries, he looked at me, and said- "it's good, right?" I nodded my head in approval and kept munching.  As he walked away, I realized that my vegan friend had helped to change my life for the better and I had never really had yummy vegan food... I was at home and I was eating the buttermilk ranch chick'n - I have to admit, that at first, I was skeptical, but then I texted him and said- "this tastes like chicken!!!"  I was really thrilled because one of the hardest parts of eating more humanely was missing the taste of some animal foods.  I had really been craving chicken and I was trying so hard to not cave, so I was delighted to have found a vegan sandwich that tastes like chicken.  

I kind of tend to like a few items rather than try the whole menu, but I do really like the Smokey and Sweet Chick'n wrap too.  I love the sweet potato fries!

The food is a delicious treat, it does taste a little greasy sometimes and I think that the price could be a little more reasonable, but I am really thrilled to have HipCity as a plant based alternative.  

I definitely want to explore other menu items also.  
Very glad that this an option in Philly!
They now accept Apple Pay!

Kind of didn't even want to eat our food after dealing with the pickup. Walked into SS to pick up an online order to find most employees not properly wearing their masks, either with their noses exposed or both noses and mouths exposed.

My order couldn't be located and when one of the employees was looking for it, had her exposed face looking into a bunch of pickup bags. Order number, my name, and general description of the items were not really helpful in finding it. Only way we did was realizing that one of my burgers had pickles.

Food-wise, Shake Shack doing its typical thing and good value, but had to nuke the food at home just to be safer.

While I understand places are distressed having to acclimate and cope with this C19 era, I can't recommend this location due to its poor hygiene procedures and lack of effort.
Horrible. Barely any chicken in quesadillas and asked for a sour cream which was 60 cents and there was barelyyyy any sour cream in the cup. Drive thru employees seem lazy or on drugs

I don't know what all the rave about on Yelp, but Chi-ken is mediocre at best. Looking through Grubhub and found Chi-ken, I'm in my adventurest bag so I got Ramen(Spicy shrimp base) with popcorn chicken combo, Oolong milk tea and Taiwanese sausage. 

Let's start with the ramen. I like everything about the ramen, from the broth to the vegetables. Only thing negative is, it was suppose to be spicy, but all I taste was a mild spice. And the famous popcorn chicken, one word: MEH. Some part was hard, some part was soggy, and it was luckwarm, this combination just didn't go together. 

Taiwanese sausage were overpriced. I order 2 orders priced at $2.50 each. All I got was 2 sticks of little sausage. I thought Vivi's was on the higher end, but Chi-ken is definitely on the highest end. 

I did enjoy the Oolong milk tea. It is not overly sweet, is just right. Overall experience is just ok.

Took a Regular Club Sub today with Vickie's Salt and Vinegar chips on my train ride home and it hit the spot. The roll could have been a little fresher but it was still tasty as always! It's a little pricey but I figure that's because of location in the City. Staff were friendly and quick!

I've been to the Shake Shack in King of Prussia 3 times, this was my first time at this location. Of course the food is good. I have no complaints. The staff is nice and friendly. They actually get your order right instead of a big mix up.

Won't be back to this place. Beautiful 'looking restaurant' but the girl who waited on customers reminded me of someone who being held hostage. Her dead pan rapid talk. 'What do you want' totally killed my appetite. I told her nevermind and just walked out. Went over to the old stand by, Country Buffet. Plus the prices seemed awful high for just standard old Chinese food recipes, nothing special. And the selection was limited. There was nothing there that would entice me to a return visit.

As soon as my friend and I walked in, we were not greeted but questioned - "Ladies, ladies are you using the restroom...?" My friend and I had intentions to eat there but first we wanted to drop off our backpacks in a booth. The vibe was off so, we didn't even end up eating there. One star for the vibe.

I literally watched the old fry guy scoop the burnt fries from the fryer using a strainer and slide them off in a full trash can using the edge of the trash can to get the tough ones. Then while the strainer was covered in old lettuce and crumbs from the trash he cleaned it off by dunking it back in the fryer. The manager told him not to do it in front of customers. It was super unsanitary and this place should be closed. Not to mention the manager and employees used the same gloves to count cash and use the computer as they did to build the burgers. Please if you have kids or people you care about do not go here!!!!!!!!

I tend to avoid reviewing franchises cause you know what you're getting, but city folk know they've got their favorite Dunkins and Wawas, etc. for a reason. I don't necessarily have a "favorite" Wendy's, but when I've got mad PMS and a hankering for salt and fat, I'm stopping here on my lunch break since there's virtually no other options near my office. It do be like that sometimes.

Truthfully, the staff here is awesome. They ALWAYS greet with a smile (even under the masks, I can tell!)  and damn they're fast. By the time I'm filling my drink at that DOPE liquid Wonka candy machine of soda concoctions, they're calling out my name in less than two minutes flat.

My fries today were still piping hot even ten minutes later when I finally sat down to eat them and the fresh crispy chicken sandwich and nuggets satiated my hangry cravings. There's always a *tad* too much mayo on the sandwich and that awkward hard corner of lettuce, but I still eat the whole damn thing.

Space needs to be rearranged tho for Covid. When people are both waiting for food and filling their drinks, it gets rather tight.

So good. A vegan (for strict health reasons) relative wanted to meet for lunch, so we went with the easiest choice. I'd been to the University City location years ago and remembered liking it. 

This location is more of a takeout place. There are a few stools at a counter and some small tables in the building lobby, which is where we ate. 

One relative loves the Philly cheesesteak and their sweet potato fries. The other likes the "chicken sandwich." 

I got a Mediterranean tofu salad, and it really hit the spot on a hot day. I don't usually like meat (not an issue here) or a lot of heavy toppings on my salad, so I worried I'd get lots of tofu and little actual salad. But I found lots of greens and tofu that was firm but not fried (which I prefer). Dressing was good. The salad was probably dressed more than I would have done myself, but it wasn't creamy so it didn't weigh the salad down and really added a lot of flavor. It was satisfying. I'd order it again. 

I enjoyed a kale lemonade with my lunch and felt good about my lunchtime choices as we left.

Popeyes prices are ridiculous. 2pc combo meal, $10.00. So, of course I'm doing the survey to get a two piece and a biscuit free if you purchase a large drink. THE LARGE DRINK IS $3.23. No more popeyes for me.

I walked in during lunch and it was surprisingly quiet and I'm not complaining. I was greeted by Mohammed aka MoMo and he was as sweet as you can get. I ordered the black truffle burger and it came out at a reasonable time.

The burger was moist and I can def taste the truffle oil/sauce. I was just hoping it would have more seasonings on the meat to make it more tasty. Other than that, I cant wait to try new creation from them!

I came here on the day of election night and I must say, this definitely hit the spot after a long day of work and a long night ahead full of the "fun" of the 2020 election results reporting. 

They had a 10 piece for $11.99 deal which I thought was well balanced, the chicken was better than the other popeyes locations in the city. It was well salted, juicy and kept me licking my fingers for more. 

They had signage for mask wearing and plexiglass, staff wore their masks up front and in the kitchen space.

Overall, gotta love that chicken from Popeyes. 

Tips/Takeaways:
-Can't go wrong here every once in a while, but with all good things in life, moderation would be advised.

KFC use to be my favorite spot for dinner... When I was in the mood for extra crispy chicken.. But this place has went down hill. I don't know if it's management or what. But I came in hear on a sat night. About dinner time. Ordered extra crispy chicken. To be told that. They had no extra crispy or crispy or original. They only had dark meat original... So I had no choice to take that. Then I'm told they only had 4 biscuits left. If I wanted more I have to wait 10 min. So I just took the 4 was not waiting... So after ordering. Chicken, potatoe wedges, Mac and cheese and 4 biscuits. I payed for my food. Got it. And ask for honey mustard... She told me that's going to cost 27 cents. I said for sauce... She said yes.....


I'll never eat at another KFC... so glad for Popeyes..

The long awaited food truck on my list. I finally got the chance to try Wokworks today. There was a long line but our order was ready within 15 minutes. The truck is really adorable and quirky. 

We tried the Drunken Noodles and the beef with rice. I'll start with the good. The beef was equally sliced, perfectly cooked and tender and filled with flavour. 10/10. The drunken noodles had a combination of chicken and shrimp. I think the noodles needed some seasoning and perhaps some chilli oil (or something along those lines) to make it perfect. Perfect food for a picnic. I will go back to try the other things on the menu.

I wanted something semi healthy and soup at the same time. I haven't had soup like this is years. It tasted soooooooooo good I'm mad I got it as a side and not a full order haha. The sandwich was nice and fresh and the turkey and avocado testing very good and soft!. No complaints over here that uptown ticket avocado sandwich was everything with the soup! You should try it! Definitely a good place to go to for a nice lunch!

This restaurant is delicious. I was visiting the area and was glad to have found a vegetarian-friendly restaurant. All their packaging is compostable and they have many organic drink options. I got the smokehouse burger-- which is an impossible burger with a BBQ sauce and little bits of fried potato on top. It was delicious! They are a little on the pricey side; my burger was $10-$12 but it was well worth it. Highly recommend!

UPDATE: Chick-Fil-A is now open until 10pm!!!

This place has the worst hours! Came here at 6:36pm on a weekday night hoping for a pick-me-up after a long day, and it was CLOSED. Why have such bad hours, especially when it's so close to Jefferson Station? Seriously missing out on a business opportunity with the deluge of commuters. This place also doesn't have Mac n Cheese, so don't get your hopes up. I did manage to eat here once though (long queue, be forewarned), and it's standard good Chick-fil-A fa

Fast casual vegan foods. Easy to access a vegan meal any time of day here. The hip city breakfast sandwich is yummy as are their sandwiches, fries, and salads. 

They have more seating at the location through the door on the right which is a shared space, it's the lobby of a apartment/office building...Kind of interesting, unique. The bathroom is also in this adjoining building and you can get the key from the building door person who sits at the desk.

Finally had the opportunity to try this place out. I heard about the chicken sandwich they were offering and was excited to try it, since I was in the mood for a chicken sandwich :-) I got to the counter, but didn't see the chicken sandwich on the menu, I was told the promotion was over, so only burgers to choose from. I went with their bacon burger and the regular fries. They gave me a buzzer which would let me know when my order was ready. I thought it was a bit strange that beverages weren't given as soon as you paid, instead I had to wait until my food came out to get it. 8 minutes later the buzzer went off, I picked up my food and beverage. The burger was cooked to done, not well done, not medium well, just done, which was fine with me. I took my first bite of the burger and the fries, they were good. The fries were nice and crispy, but after a couple of minutes the fries cooled and the texture changed drastically, I didn't finish them, they tasted like lard. The burger was good, but not filling enough. Long story short: limited topping selections, sub par fries,  ok small burgers. Maybe I should have just came here for a shake, I heard they're pretty good lol.

Went there on May 24 at 9:59 order my food gave them my card they gave me my food. Ask the lady for my card back she ga e it back. Look at my account later a hour later they charge me twice for my food. Went back the next morning about getting my money back for the over charge.  Claudia the shift supervisor said they can't refund my money  can not look in the computer to see that i was charged twice. And on top of that she didn't know the manager number or name. Then when i ask again for the manager she gave me his name. Really you lying about not knowing your manager name. People watch your card with them.

If I could give them zero stars I would!!!!!!
So my boyfriend and I went through the drive thru at the 52nd St McDonald's by the YMCA at around 1:53 pm on June 11th . We get our food get home and start eating my boyfriend is halfway done his double cheeseburger and a LONG BLACK PIECE OF CURLY HAIR WAS IN HIS BURGER!!!!!!!!!!!. So I tried to call and of course the line is busy. Now there is no reason why hair should be in my food! When working with food it is mandatory to have your hair up if it is not shoulder length!!!!!!! So I'm out of my money out of all of my food because now I don't want it and I can't speak with anyone  so what am I supposed to do. I'm beyond disgusted and pissed. Do better McDonald's.

Great COVID set up - grab and go when you order ahead! HipCityVeg is where I always go for great vegan fast food that's pretty healthy in Philly and DC. My omnivore significant other even loved the Disco chicken sandwich!

This was my first experience at Wokworks. I decided to get the drunken noodles. Oh my gosh was it delicious!!The chili garlic sauce was amazing. The veggies were fresh. I will definitely be making this my new lunch stop!
The first time I went to coreanos I LOVED it. It was literally amazing. I always go back around when I'm at Chinatown square. To anyone that wants to try it I advise you to try the rice bowls (:

BEWARE! As someone has travelled and tried a lot of chipotles around the country this is,BY FAR the dirtiest and worst chipotle in probably the entire country

Chips soggy, gauc old, and the people working here look like their life is sucked outta them and mess up your order.


This happened 3 times to me now- same location

Pleasantly surprised by this chain. As a vegan I was sure I gave up cheesesteaks for the rest of my life but that inclination changed after ordering from HCV. We obviously had to take our food to go (there's no seating inside and even if there were .. covid wouldn't allow it) and despite it being about 40° outside, we found a little park close by & quickly devoured our food. Highly recommend getting a side of nuggets. Pretty sure they're made with tofu (a huge plus for me) and they have the tastiest breading.
If you have bathroom and customer can't use it, how we gonna eat and drink , people life is matter for Mc donald, never go buy your food anymore, eat your self , pii your self?

I placed my order through the chipotle app around 7:48pm, and it said my order should be ready by 8pm. I arrived at chipotle at 8pm and there was about 50 people outside waiting for food in the rain. I didn't get my food until 9:40pm which is unacceptable. I go to this location all the time, and usually never have a problem. I've been once since the dining area shut down due to COVID-19, and still had no problem. I'm not sure what happened this time, but they were 1-2 hours behind on orders.

This chipotle brings shame to the company name. They routinely underfill bowls, get orders wrong, and overcharge. Just today, I asked for double meat, received half of what I ordered, and then was charged for THREE portions. When I asked the cashier, he said that they "had to do it." $20 for an under filled bowl- I would rather have no chipotle near me at all than deal with this sorry excuse of a restaurant.
ass, didn't give me the right order and then some of the fries soggy and then some are hard ashit. it's usually a good place but they made me mad today with this order so that's why i'm writing this.

Shake Shack serves my favorite guilty pleasure food.  I'll go out of my way for a meal at Shake Shack whenever I'm in a neighborhood that's lucky enough to have one.

I did just that when I was taking a morning stroll through Rittenhouse Square.  

There's one thing I order every time: shackburger with onions and pickles.  And it's glorious every single time.  This is literally the greatest fast-food burger in America.  It's packed with flavor, there's no added grease, and there's crazy-consistent quality control across locations.  Service is friendly and helpful too.

What I mix up is the flavor of concrete I have for dessert.  These vary across locations, and Philly's signature flavor is the Center City pretzel -- a heavenly swirl of vanilla custard and cinnamon-coated pretzel bits.  It doesn't get much better than that.

On top of all that, the prices are low and the vibe is always modern and comfortable.  Can't ever go wrong with Shake Shack, whether it's in Philly or elsewhere.

I'm in Philly for a couple days and I'm hitting myself on the head for not finding this place sooner that tonight!

The Kati rolls are just crazy delicious! I tried the achari paneer, aloo paneer, and the egg Kati rolls and man these are hands down the best Kati rolls I've had in my life!!! The aloo was seasoned to perfection, the achar (pickle flavor) came through every bite in the achari paneer Kati roll, and the eggs were cooked perfectly! All their Kati rolls are stuffed with mint chutney and onions, and if you want more accompaniments like me, they have crazy good hot sauce! I mean it's hot, but you just can't stop but reach more for it after one taste ;)

Overall the Kati rolls are pretty wholesome and I would say two should fill you up, and they are definitely worth the money!! Also, the service is pretty quick and the owner was very nice! I might end up going back once more before I leave Philly in two days ;) !!
