Fast and good asianish food.  Nice spice level to the spiced noodles and solid portions.  I liked the mix of veggies, cooked in front of you in 1 minute in their truck.  Not cheap for food truck food, my.dish was 12.95, but given available food truck options at Penn center today def the way to go.  They do have good looking choices overall w seafood, beef, veggie and chicken options, prices range $8-13/entree
Cold food; not what ordered. Allergic to guacamole. Called the store to talk to the manager--no response. Left voice message--no response. Will not be returning to the Andorra shopping Center store.

I LOVE this Chipotle! It's always clean, they move quickly, and they've actually helped me to incorporate beans into my diet, lol! I have never once been unhappy with my order and they don't skimp like some Chipotles are known for doing! I stay in there and for me, the best part is that it's DIRECTLY across the street from a Starbucks so I can get my favorite drink and burrito bowl then hop on my bus right on Walnut street to head home. This place is AWESOME! I'm not friends nor do I personally know anyone here, but I have never been dissatisfied with the service or the food.
Can you say mall food however I think mall food is better the food is so damm gross I would not recommend stick to regular Chinese food

As a vegetarian, I love coming to HipCityVeg for the innovative menu and friendly atmosphere. 

Pros: 
- the vegan cheesesteak is delicious. It is my go to every time and satiates my hunger. 
- Same great menu with plenty of options worth trying. Aside from the cheesesteak, I also really like the chipotle wrap. 
- more locations and awesome staff

Cons: 
- can't really think of any besides the lack of parking, but it is center city, so that is expected.

Shake shack looks like just another burger joint but it's in the city which always adds a little glamour to the chain and they serve beer. While I know a lot of people prefer to pair their burger with a milkshake I will always take the beer. 

I chose the chick'n shack- fried chicken, pickles, lettuce and buttermilk herb mayo. I LOVE herbs and mix them with mayo, I'm sure nothing could go wrong - except not being able to taste it. They should add a layer of the mayo on both buns. While the sandwich was on the smaller side, I enjoyed the crunch of the chicken and the fresh toppings. Now I'm looking forward to trying their SmokeShack burger. 

With a menu including burgers,fries,frozen custard, beer, and wine this is a good casual spot to hit up during the warmer months and enjoy the outdoor seating. FYI - There is a lot across the street promoting $15 weekend parking.

The boyfriend brought me here today because I have been craving chicken over rice for a bit now and he was told by a friend that this place was good. --- After eating here "I'm going to go yell at [him.]"

It was pretty empty in here but we don't mind that because that just means it's not nosey.

Summary:
- Chicken & Lamb was bland
- Mango Lassi is a no
- Their soft drinks and ice tea tastes extremely different
- Kind of over priced

I had the CHICKEN & LAMB platter $9 (platters comes with pita bread). The chicken and lamb were cut into little pieces, covering the rice and there were 4 small pieces of pita. First thing the boyfriend & I noticed was that the rice was not orange like at all the other places we've had it; we didn't mind that as long as it tastes good. My platter was very bland though. Even adding a lot of white and hot sauce, which they bring to you with your order if you are dining in.

The boyfriend ordered the SPICE END platter $9 (it's chicken). Because ordering, he asked what the difference with that special and the other one and so we were told there is more taste (which I agree on after eating mine).

We checked out the fridge and saw an orange cup of something.. We asked the guy what it was and he said it was like a mango yogurt; it's called the Mango Lassi $4; we got one to try and we really regretted it.
We also got a soft drink cause we've never seen them before; regretted that too.
So the boyfriend ended up getting a bottled ice tea but after trying it.. he said it tasted weird so he took a careful look at the label and it was in another language.

In the end, I was very disappointed because I can get much better chicken over rice with a whole pita bread nicely toasted and a drink at Temple's lunch trucks.

We're not coming back. It's just not our place.

There's only so much burgers one can eat, and I keep trying them all... or most. There's also a fine line between a fast food burger and a gourmet burger. At Shake Shack, my favorite is Shack-burger, Shroom burger, cheese fries, and of course the frozen custard. Those are the burgers that can be left for lazy, late night-- where they belong.
- Always crowded on weekend nights.
- Fairly priced fast food chain.
- Dog treats available on the menu.
 
Three Yelps.

This was my first visit to a shake shack and it was a disappointment. Other than the staff being Very friendly and welcoming and The cheese fries were delicious that's pretty much where it stops. The shake was okay not as spectacular as expected and my shack burger was horrendous. It had little to no flavor except for a slight hint of old grease. It's doubtful I'll give this particular establishment a second go, however I would probably try another.

Clean, fast and pretty decent food for what it is. Tried the $4 wicked chicken. Ugh.. The chicken had more breading than actual meat! My biscuit and red beans and rice tasted good though. Their regular meals are a little overpriced.. $8 for two pieces of chicken and a small side. We usually go for family deals when coming here.
It's amazing and the food was really good. The delivery was quick and had everything we ordered. Definitely would recommend if your in the area.
When you deny service to 3 Philly pd patrols 40-minutes before closing, you SUCK as a company, citizen, and should close up shop.

They put bacon on my vegetarian burger.. seriously?? Horrible surprise. Shame on me for not checking, but seriously how many people order a veggie burger and add bacon!?

Shameful. And despite looking good, the fries weren't actually good, so you suck shake shack. Typical overpriced wanna be fancy fast food.

was craving chicken and rice, so i decided to get some takeout from here. alas, after you've had halal guys in nyc, there just is nothing that comes close. 

but meals are decently sized and will definitely fill you up for the price. i'm pretty disappointed that the white sauce isn't spicy a la aforementioned halal guys, but the combo of red and white sauces works to hit the spot. a little sweet, a little spicy.

i also ordered a chicken biryani that i wasn't impressed with. the basmati rice tasted... tangy? the marinade on the chicken also could've been slathered on a bit more. overall it left a pretty sour taste in my mouth.

food comes out super fast here though, i'll give them that. great when you're starving and absolutely cannot wait any longer to eat something.

Never tried any of their meals but Snap Kitchen is the ONLY place in Philly that carries The Coconut Cult Probiotic Yogurt! If you ever want to try this product, be sure to head over to Snap Kitchen! Snap Kitchen also carries products typically found at Whole Foods but at a higher price, so I would recommend not buying those and going to Whole Foods, Trader Joes, MOM's or any other health store to purchase those products.

The cashiers are also super sweet and make you feel welcomed.
Poor service after taking 15 minutes for a milkshake. Friend next to me just ordered a small fry and that took 10 minutes as well. At least the food tasted semi decent.

I enjoy a good burger. I was underwhelmed unfortunately. The cheese that they put on the burger and fries was AMAZING. The rest.. well.. mediocre. The burger itself lacked flavor. I felt like I was just chewing on cardboard with cheese. I thought the prices were a bit much too.

I am pro-immigration and pro-service worker, but had serious problems with language + communication at this subway. Like, if I can tell someone is making a genuine effort to communicate, benefit of the doubt, immediately.

BUT...at this subway, there was some kind of massive problem with speaking and eliciting a response that coincided with the original request. very confusing. there was also a problem with determining whether the sandwich makers really cared if he heard you or not????

that sandwich was fine though???? it just took a long time to achieve. 

very weird subway.

Food is always good here.. the reason I am giving it 2 stars is because they don't know how to follow simple dietary instructions. Called in an order for work and has specific instructions which I made sure the person taking the order read each one back to me. I even asked for them to write on each one the difference in the order. My Mgr picked up the order came back with just the scramblers no fruit or toast that's supposed to come with the order. He went back to pick up the missing items. Gave the one with no bacon to the person and just as I guessed it had bacon in it although it was labeled with no bacon. So of course I called and went back to get it fixed.
An  amazing sandwich with friendly  staff that will guide you in the right direction of flavor and satisfying items
Place is a waste of money! Should be shut down. They literally gave me an old chicken sandwich that was laying around for a while. Cold and stale! Str8 bs! What a disgrace smh

The ppl that work at this place are so absolutely clueless, lazy, unprofessional & ignorant. Don't bother placing an order online bc when you get to the restaurant it's never ready. I will no longer be wasting my time or money here. I'll take my business elsewhere.

To satisfy our fatty, fast food cravings, my friend and I came here for lunch today. I ordered the single ShackBurger, and she ordered the Chicken Dog. We also split an order of the fries and a chocolate milkshake.

For what it was, everything was well-prepared and hit the spot. The servers were also friendly, and the space was clean, unlike most other fast food joints in the U.S. of A.

And we knew that the products were working their magic when we left with slightly heavy feelings, and shortly thereafter started to feel lightheaded- and as if the world had suddenly slowed down. After a brief walk through the farmer's market we headed home, where I promptly took a nap. 

Still coming down from our Shake Shack highs, we have been hydrating well, and have also had bowls of fresh strawberries to take the edge off. And once it all has completely passed, we will take to the streets again- and go for a run.

this location sucks. my husband went to pick up food for me. he had to literally wait in drive thru 45mins and my order was wrong.

new chicken sandwich wasn't good. i asked for no pickle...had pickles and no sauce. the commercial lied.  
stick to popeyes. 
was supposed to have 2 double cheese no pickles. they had pickles 
 fries were cold and limp.
The girl in the drive thru said "Heil Hitler" to me when she handed me the bag? Pretty racist.

I really enjoyed dining at Shake Shack! Son recommended it. The burger was fantastic.  I am normally a chicken tender person. The fries were very tasty, and just enough too. The shake was great for a custard blend. The staff was excellent. The waitress Karima was the absolute best. We chatted a little and she uplifted my spirits while eating. She turned a upsetting day into a great day. I was full and happy from the both the food and the service. I really liked the music. Very enjoyable to listen to. The place is very comfortable with big windows to look out of. The food is cooked fresh daily and shakes made fresh. Nice and thick! I like that they check to see how you are enjoying your food, or do you need anything and take your finished tray away. Very professional. The food didn't take long either.  The location for me is the best. Right on my way home from work. I will definitely return again and with friends. Thanks for a very enjoyable dining experience Shake Shack!

P.S. The location is 20th & Sansom St. between Chestnut and Walnut St.

my order has been wrong/messed up literally every time i've come to this chipotle. this location genuinely has to be losing chipotle profits with the number of refunds they have to give. you order online for delivery and you're lucky if it even shows up. if it does, it shows up 2 hours later with the wrong food. you order for pickup and you wait 45 minutes, usually to receive something you didn't even order. honestly have no idea how this place gets it wrong almost every single time.
The most dirtiest and slowest KFC in Philadelphia. Personal to slowly. Definitely not!

So first I'd like to say that half of my problems with this recent visit are due to this specific location, but the other half of the problems were with Caviar as well. So it may be wise to just go to the restaurant directly to order rather than get delivery.

I had been gassing this restaurant up to my boyfriend, who had never eaten here before too so this was his FIRST experience with this place...

So I ordered through Caviar and I ordered two bundles which included the following:

1st bundle (mine):
-HipCity chick'n ranch sandwich
-quinoa chili 
-The BFG
-a cookie

2nd bundle (boyfriend's):
-HipCity chick'n ranch sandwich 
-sweet potato fries with sriracha aioli 
-cane sodas

After placing my order, the restaurant called me to inform me that there were a few issues with my order. They were out of the quinoa chili and they stopped selling the cane soda "a while ago" (then why hadn't it been updated on caviar?). I asked them to replace my quinoa chili with their Caesar salad and to replace his soda with another BFG.

So the delivery person gets to the hotel we were staying at and the fries are missing, but the aioli is there. There were also no utensils or napkins, so I had no way to eat the salad. I called them back to let them know we were missing a side, and they told me they had no way of delivering it to me and that I should deal with Caviar. They kept misunderstanding me as well - when I told them the sweet potato fries were missing, they seemed under the impression that I THOUGHT I had placed two and that I was mistaken, when in reality we had zero fries and had only placed one.

So I got off the phone so I could deal with caviar and the manager, Mikayla (Michaela? Sorry for typos) called me back AGAIN (this is the third time now that we're dealing with this over the phone) and after some rudeness from her I finally got heated - our order was wrong from the beginning and it was ridiculously overpriced (a little over $50 for this) AND a rude manager? Nah. So SHE called Caviar (which is honestly what she probably should've done after the second phone call) and had them refund me for the whole meal.

I was upset that my boyfriend's first time with this chain was so unnecessarily frustrating. I also usually never go to this location (go to the one on 18th - it's definitely more organized and more polite). This got bumped up to two stars because their food honestly is just SO good.

Ugh. Never going back to this location again.

For some reason every time I order through DoorDash from this restaurant they always forget a part of my order. Today I ordered some spicy nuggets and two orange juice, just got the nuggets that's it. The workers there obviously can't get nothing right.

I'm surprised by all the negative reviews.  I love this Chipotle location.  the staff is very friendly - especially during Covid times.  I'm reviewing today because I just tried the new cauliflower rice in my burrito bowl and it was EXCELLENT - better than any cauliflower rice I've tried to make at home.  It's also great that a fast-casual place offers healthier options!

I just waited in chipotle and received this bowl. I requested like 6 toppings. Asked to speak with a manager--Brian come to the front with a full fledged attitude and told me to get a refund online. I will be calling corporate on him and the store. Every-time i go on there theres an issue with my order.

Brian is beyond rude and Didnt even offer to remake the bowl or offer an appology
I love shake shack. I never actually buy a shake, but obviously the burgers and fries are great. I always get a side of cheese with the fries.
This was my first experience at a Shake Shack.  My food was fresh and very tasty.  Only downsides are accessibility and price.  My lunch was $16.  Would I do it again?  Probably.

Non Stop Gyro has to be THE Best Gyro in PA. I have had them at all the places in town and this hands down is the best. Had the Pork Gyro; the seasoning, the actual meat (not fatty), tzatziki was fantastic. Spicy Feta. Amazing. The Galaktopouriko is homemade and authentically Greek as they come. Finally a great Greek Gyro that tastes just like Greece.  Can't wait to be back and try the other items on the menu!!!

OMG, KQ Burger was definitely impressive. The menu is great and the atmosphere is perfect. Every single menu item that we purchased was incredibly fresh and flavorful. Service was awesome and every one working here was very nice and helpful. I would certainly recommend KQ Burger to others and will definitely come back in the future.
I have no idea why this place has such a low score. It's literally Chipotle. Every time I go it is great

Shake Shack's burger is not life-changing, for those who were disappointed by high expectations.

I come to Shake Shack rather than other burger places for these reasons:
- alcohol served
- Shack Stack: crispy-fried portobello ontop your burger
- treats for your furkid
- decent outdoor seating

I never feel too gross after eating here, unless of course you get the Shack Stack, fries, and a milkshake...
Awful sandwiches. Why would anyone go here when there are so many great sandwich places mere blocks away?

And yet another review for the Burger King at 101 E. Olney. I ordered through Burger King App tonight. Once I received it I opened my bacon burger with no ketchup and lite lettuce. Of course it had ketchup. I also ordered a Lil Huddy meal. The mozzarella sticks were not given. I ordered a double cheeseburger, I didn't receive it. I called the store and spoke to a young man named Prince. He told me to return all the food or have Door Dash return. My husband returned the food and asked for Prince. The manager, informed him that she wasn't aware of the situation. And that it wasn't her problem. And how was she to know that we didn't remove the food trying to get free food. Then commented that that's why her inventory was so low. My son opened the burger to show the ketchup and she screamed "now I have to throw it away" My son told her that she would have to throw it away anyway. She then said and repeated "now I'm on bitch mode!" She also repeated to Prince that she is on "bitch mode" once again. How can your inventory be low if you aren't given people all their food? Do you think that you are intimidating enough for people not to return to get what they paid for?
Got the smallest burrito in my life today. Go to literally any other chipotle in the city unless you just want a little snack. The cup of guac is almost as big as the burrito

Absolutely horrible with online orders, never on time and always wrong. Portions are bad, guac is never good (been probably 20 times). Recently realized there is one on 15th and walnut which is 100x better.

The delivery for this location is awful. I don't know why I keep trying. Tonight was the second time my food just never showed up, after they sent me a text that  it was ready and waiting on the delivery driver to be picked up. That was 2 hours ago. They are either super late or just never show. I may have finally learned my lesson.

Got the salad bowl with bulgogi and was instantly disappointed. The Gochujang sour cream sauce  lacked flavor and the bulgogi tasted as though it was not even marinated. Not sure what the craze is about.

I spoke to Sandra, the person at the register, about the meat. After I insisted that she taste it, she agreed that it tasted unseasoned and offered to make me a new one, but I took a rain check for next time. I'll update this review then.

When we arrived we were told that the register was broken and everyone had to order from the website or app.  This was a lie since a woman walked in as we waited past our pickup time and was taken at the register.  Our order was wrong.  My wife got a salad but there was no salad.  We ordered $6 extra chips and queso and it wasn't there.  The end players were playing music fairly loudly, dancing, talking with each other, and taking their time (we didn't get our food until almost 10 minutes past our pickup time.  Very disappointed because We enjoy Chipotle but NOT THIS LOCATION!  Stay away and thank me later.

I ordered a ham and swiss sandwich and could not have been more disappointed. The bread was hard and mostly tasted like cardboard. I couldn't even finish it. 

The best part of my meal was the chips that I didn't even ordered.

Was so happy to come across this place while visiting independence park in Philly (although there are several locations in the area). I got the 10 piece nuggets and Smokehouse burger. The burger was amazing!!! Was a beyond meat patty, cooked perfectly with Gouda cheese, fried onions and bbq sauce. I am obsessed with fried onions and this was such an awesome touch. The golden nuggets were okay, they weren't fried and crispy the way I thought they were going to be. Would love to try this place again and get the chicken sandwich. Highly recommend.

Ordered hot dog w/mustard, onion & relish.  Received it 

w/a bit of mustard & relish, no packs of musta

rd or relish, but 7 packets of ketchup!  WTF wish they could've gotten everything right

This place is disgusting.. First of all no one is in the restaurant.  Never got acknowledged.  The food line was disgusting. There was food everywhere. No one tried to clean it up. Kept making plate for must have been online order. The girl was dropping food from one food container to another. Didn't try to clean it up. Non of the food was covered.  BIG UNSAT!!!

I've been trying to cut down my meat consumption for a while and have tried my fair share of fake meats and vegan junk food, but HipCityVeg probably gave vegan food everywhere a bad rap.
The food was pricey, flavors were pretty bland, presentation wasn't that appetizing, and portions were small. 
I got the Crispy Hip City Ranch Chick'n Sandwich and it tasted fine, but only because of the toppings and peppercorn ranch dressing. The chick'n itself was too soft and chewy, like tofu, and I would've just preferred a portobello burger that wasn't trying to masquerade as meat.
My friend got the Philly Steak and it was surprisingly tasty despite the monotonous appearance. The mushrooms' texture was pretty decent and tasted pretty much like a really Philly Cheese Steak, even though I typically hate mushrooms.
I had heard great things about the sweet potato fries but they weren't anything special. I wish fries were included with each sandwich order given the price of everything.
Seating was weird. There were only a few bar stools in the actual restaurant itself, and a sign pointing to an extra seating area just directed us to the neighboring hotel lobby which is where we ended up eating our food.

After visiting the former Gallery a few week weeks before, we decided to go by Chick-fil-a on a recent visit.  We came all the way here only to give up and go elsewhere.  The wait with less than 10 people exceeded 20 minutes!  Orders were not coming out of the the kitchen and folks seemed irritated they were not getting back to where they needed to go with their food in hand.  There were small children running around alone, doing all sort of unsavory things at the tables and I was not entertained at all.  Quite a few teens were there too, some eating, others simply loitering. The cleaning guy seemed complete numb at best to all the nonsense unfolding, so the one star is for the empathy I had for him.  No thank you.

The first time I went there when they opened my sub was so hard it was inedible but by the time I noticed I had already gotten home. This time I went and first checked the refrigerated section bc i'm in a rush but it was super under stocked so i went to the deli area and ordered a salad. cold side. after 25 min of waiting for my order and watching people bypass me i asked if it was up and they had cleared it without making it and now i'm late. the cashiers at the front are always nice but the deli side is the hottest of messes.

EDIT: switched my stars to 3 bc i just bit into my custom garden salad and the chicken is bomb af

I really like Shake Shack.  The service is quick, friendly, and precise.  This is true even when they are busy at lunch.  The food is always spot on and it is also hot when you get it.  The burgers haven't been sitting around for 20 minutes in a warming tray like other fast food restaurants.  
I love the beeper that you receive that tells you when your order is ready.  When I was there the other day, they had a food runner that was serving people on the terrace outside and he stopped by my table, asked me my name, and told me that my food would be right up.  Sure enough, my beeper went off almost immediately.  That was a really nice touch.  I really have nothing to suggest that would improve your experience at Shake Shack, it really is the place to go for a burger or a dog!

Wendy's located in the 30th Street Station, so super convenient for the travelers that get here early and need to wait and are hungry. One soda machine broken when I was there.

They have the 4 for $4.44 deal - you have to ask them about it. Also, the junior frosty is tiny - way smaller than other locations. Still, the fresh burger you want and good fries, although salty, and they have the pick-your-flavor soda machines.

oh shake shack, I love you way more than I should. I've tried all the "it" burger shops and they just aren't as good. I'm such a sucker for the double smoke stack, I could eat it every day. Matter of fact, pretty sure I'm getting takeout there tonight! Add the pleothera of hot dogs, shakes adn AWESOME fries and man I'm in love

Came on presidents day and it wasn't very busy for evening dinner. Ordered the regular hamburger with shack sauce. The burger and toppings were fresh, meat was super juicy and and service was quick.

My friend ordered the same thing but iwth a drink and fries. The crinkle fries were very crispy - which I love. 

Every now and then, an employee would come by and ask how everything was. They would also clear tables if we were finished and continuously clean. Usually a fast food service joint wouldn't be this on top of the tables so to me, this service was fantastic.

There are very few places that can properly make a Paneer Kati Roll and Spice End is one of them. So yummy! 

The paneer is cooked perfectly and there was enough chutney and onions in it. The white sauce is super tasty, but the hot sauce seemed a little watered down. It was still spicy but tasted watery. Service was super quick too. I would definitely recommend!

FIY: As of today (2/25/17), they're CASH ONLY

My boyfriend and I wandered into the food court that Coreanos is located in today cause initially, we were just thinking about getting Halal Guys. But after walking in and looking around at the MANY options they offered there, we decided on trying out Coreanos along with getting halal. Divide and conquer people.

WHAT WE GOT: Bulgogi tacos

PROS: They give you 3 tacos here instead of the usual 2 that they give you at other taco specialty restaurants. The flavors were well matched in the bulgogi one: sweetness of the meat paired with the spicy tang of the gochujang sauce they drizzled on top in just the right amount, adding the perfect kick, all balanced out with the neutral coolness of the lettuce. The wait time was pretty short too. I only really waited like 5 minutes before my name was called. Coreanos is located at the very back part of the food court, right next to the sitting area, so it has easy access to all the tables. 

CONS: The construction of the tacos were a bit messy. Everything was just kind of piled on the shells so the ingredients on the top were flowing out and onto the taco next to it or out into the box.

I had a two piece chicken dinner here.  I even take the skin off because it's so so greasy.  Today the chicken seemed extra greasy and not cooked all the way.  I love feed birds while I'm eating, like to share I guess.  Believe me the birds didn't even eat much of it.  Anyway I ate around 5:00 and by 9:00 that evening my stomach started cramping.  I knew it was a sign of food poisoning and soon as it started.  By 10:00 pm I was in such pain with dry heaves that I had to be rushed to the emergency room.  I usually can eliminate bad food but it wasn't moving.  I sat in the emergency room 2 hours before they took me in.  I'm still sick with a stomach virus from the bacteria.  It's been so horrible.  I was cramped up on the floor of the emergency room for hours from bad food from here.  I will NEVER eat at Kentucky Fried again.  This was my WORST food poisoning experience ever!  Josi

If I can give zero stars I would....... I just left this place, it was disgraceful. The girl behind the counter taken my order was very rude she seemed she didn't wanna be there working I ask a couple simple questions and she had nothing but attitude. Employees in the back cursing while talking to each other. NOT GOOD FOR YOUNG CHILDREN TO HEAR. My sons chicken tenders were dried out disgusting, my chicken bowl had no gravy the chicken in it was hard and dried out barely any cheese in it a few kernels of corn in it, oh and the biscuits forget it I couldn't even tell you how they tasted. My family and I couldn't even eat our dinner over 20$ down the drain for food then ended up in the trash. The soda machine was very sticky, the floor by the soda fountain was sticky and wet someone could fall and get hurt because they can't clean the store. The lids were all over the place not in order. I wish I just asked for my money back and walked out. I DO NOT RECOMMEND ANYONE TO GO TO THIS LOCATION VERY RUDE WORKERS AND DIRTY!!!!!!! ZERO STARS  THEY NEED TO WORK ON THEIR CUSTOMER SERVICE AND HOW TO TREAT OAYING CUSTOMERS

The Shake Shack is good.  A friend told me about it and said to come by this place.  There burgers and fries are great with a compliment of a shake, of course.  The line is short, its good customer service, and fast food.  They give you a sensor key and when your order is ready, it will beep.  I think myself had a Shackburger and it was very flavorful.  Depending on their hours its good to go right before a night on the town.  I think I even have a pic of the burger and drink I had one day.  I'd recommend going to Shake Shack if your into traditional burgers, fries, chili cheese dogs, and milkshakes.

The $7.50 lunch special is a great deal for getting Indian food (limited options for Indian food near my work) and is enough food to be filling but you won't be overly full that you're falling asleep at your desk in the afternoon. The lunch special is advertised in the store but not on their website. You have your choice of a Kati Roll (Chicken or Paneer) and a Biryani Rice (Chicken or Veggie). A Kati Roll is basically ingredients rolled in a flatbread, kind of like a burrito. I got the Paneer, which is made of cheese curds, and I thoroughly enjoyed it. For my rice option, I got the Chicken Biryani which is similar to a fried rice but light and fluffy. They don't skimp on the chicken meat, my rice came with good size chunks! Also grab a cup of hot sauce and white sauce, they balance each other out.

Been in lots of Popeye's and KFC places, since I love fried chicken, but the KFC place at Franklin Mills was the worst I have been in to date, so bad that I actually got my lazy butt to write a review.  Chicken they served was over-fried and burned, totally dried out and disgusting. The service was even worse. I asked for a honey mustard and found in the bag honey BBQ, so walked right back in, in pouring rain, to ask for a correct dressing and was just informed that I owe them a quater for a dressing, i was like WTF!? 
So out to the pouring rain I go again, to bring back the BBQ dressing I never asked for, so I don't have to leave another cent in that place, let alone a quater!?

I actually think this place *does* live up to the hype (I wouldn't stand in line for any significant length of time, but I think since the place has now been here since June and everyone's had a chance to try it out, I haven't had that experience, but I'd still recommend going on off-hours). The hamburgers are really good--it's immediately obvious that they're made to order: they're juicy, fresh, and flavorful. They are somewhat small for the price, but this isn't the place to go if you're looking to save money. Fries are quite decent as well, but to me the best part is the frozen custard, which reminds me of the frozen custard I used to get down the shore as a kid. Staff is very friendly and average wait time for me has been about 5-10 minutes. I've only ever done take-out; it's a little too loud for me to actually sit and eat here. Best times to go (if you can) are between 2-4, and around 8:30-close on a weeknight--lines are shortest then. I've been several times now and neither I nor my dining companion(s) have been disappointed.

The open at 10:45, however it's 1pm and we're standing outside watching 4 employees just hanging out inside with the door locked, eating pizza and McDonalds... just glaring at us almost saying "boo who" in our face. Nothing is stated in the door about why they are closed and when they will reopen... I understand if maybe they need a break... but some communication is honestly required to run a business.

1st time customer and it was worth it.  The place is a bit small but the wait wasn't long. The restaurant was crowded and busy. The staff was pleasant and quick. I ordered the Philly Steak and sweet potato fries with cilantro-black bean dip. I substituted the long roll for the whole wheat wrap.  The taste was exquisite; just like a cheesesteak.  I was very pleased with my food and will be back for more.

It's probably my fault for buying something so basic (i.e. Orange Chicken) but I wasn't really impressed by this truck outside my office. The chicken was predictably the fried nuggets one expects from this chameleon of a dish, but I wasn't expecting something freshly made to be tough! The sauce was pretty good, but the jasmine rice was a few minutes undercooked to the point it was mealy, which was 75% of the dish. I actually appreciated all the vegetables since I feel like there isn't enough in this dish traditionally. I don't know, maybe this is more of a noodle truck and I just bought the wrong thing? Can't say I'll ever come back, but maybe just don't get this.

I decided to order takeout based on a friend's recommendation. The delivery was super fast. I ordered the edamame dumplings and drunken noodles. The edamame dumplings were ok. I don't prefer the crispy skin of the dumplings. The drunken noodles flavor was delicious and on par. However the noddles were soggy and overcooked. There was no bounce to the noodle. It was also super oily dish. There was a sufficient amount of chicken and shrimp in the dish. I did not like the crunchy noodles on top of the dish. There are better options out there.

In Philly, craving a Philly Cheesteak, and decided to switch it up and go the vegan route. I was not all disappointed! The seitan was a perfect steak substitute and the mushrooms and onions mixed in were delightful. The bread was so soft and incredibly filling. The sanwich overall was so big I could barely finish it. 

It's pretty much a grab and go restaurant. Service is fast, I think I was in and out within ten minutes. The staff was incredibly friendly and willing to help customers with suggestions. I also love that their sauce bar is free. I grabbed a couple to try. The house sauce is eerily similar to Chick Fil A sauce, but the Siracha Aioli was my favorite. I dipped a bit of my sandwich in it and it gave it an extra kick. 

I don't have much more time left in the city, but I might pop by tomorrow to try a few other menu options. It really was that great!

So long as you come to Chipotle and/or similar fast Mexican joints during the busy lunch hour or so you should be provided with a fresh, tasty meal.  But if you happen to stroll into Chipotle around 3pm or so beware that you meal may not turn out so fresh.
Because the meats and such are prepared by the pan-full they tend to sit being continually heated during off-peak times and dry up like the Sahara.  Consider yourself warned so it is definitely worth waiting in a long line for a fresh burrito ;)

Very racist place. Especially towards asian female. And they don't follow social distancing. When you go there to pick up, they don't let u pick up from the side that has less people. You HAVE to be in some else's private bubble in order to get the food.   Very very very rude to delivery drivers too......

Not much to say here. I finally got around to trying Shake Shack and my pretty high expectations were totally met.

Friendly service, delicious and flavorful burger, tasty fries, and an out of this world milkshake. 

Can't wait to return.

I'm going with a solid 3 stars for Corner Bakery because their food is pretty decent, but their service can often be lacking. We get large catering orders from them every so often at work and they don't tend to always be on time. 

Luckily, when the food gets here, the sandwiches are fresh and tasty, the salads are crisp and delicious and the desserts are...well, they're something I should stay away from but today, I've already had two. Save room for baked goods. 

One not so fun thing is they don't allow you to purchase 2 liter bottles of soda- you have to get cans. And at a hefty $1.35 a piece, they don't come cheap. I don't think I'd every frequent Corner Bakery for lunch or breakfast, since there's so much else in Philly that's above the bar they set, but overall, a decent meal (and a decent catered lunch once it arrives) for a somewhat decent price.

I find it sad when establishments refuse to allow a pregnant woman and her child to use the bathroom. I won't be giving my business to this location ever again. 

Thank you to the establishment next door that didn't have a public restroom but saw the urgency and allowed me to use their bathroom.

SO DELICIOUS. This place is a great addition to the neighborhood, and is a hundred times better than Kati Roll Company (in Manhattan), which had been my only experience with kati rolls until now. The achari chicken roll, with a hint of tart pickle, is incredible. Great service, too.
The customer service was great but the food isn't the best. I went twice just to see if I was trippin. I wasn't. I am not going back there. Thanks but no thanks!

What a disgraceful place. Their hoagies stink. There is no meat on them, they were expensive and we didn't even get what we ordered. It's sad a chain would have service like that. We ordered while I was at a training. Everyone order was messed up and the next 2 days we ordered from somewhere else. Take your money elsewhere.

This McDonald's is garbage. Ordered through Uber and was missing my Double Quarter pounder meal, 40 nuggets + an additional 10 nuggets. They only gave me the drink from the quarter pounder meal like how the fuck do you give me the drink that's part of the meal but not the actual food?? And the sprite doesn't even taste normal!

Good, healthy food at decent prices.  What's not to love?  I ordered the Anaheim Scrambler -- scrambled eggs with bacon, tomatoes, green onions, cheese, and avocado with a side of breakfast potatoes and toast.  Delicious!  A full meal for under $10.

[Yelp collections: East Coast 2016]

Me and my mom recently drove to this location from south Philadelphia on Halloween night. We had been craving PE allllllll day. I googled the store hours and saw that it closed in 30 minutes so we had about 20 minutes to arrive after already being on the way. So we get there at about 9:20pm 10 minutes before closing. My mom walks in before I do because I had to get my chubby little baby out of his car seat. I walk in and my mom has this look on her face likes she's baffled I say "hey mom wats wrong" she said "there's no food" so I look and low and behold everything is gone! I asked the idiot behind the cash wrap "is anymore food coming out everything is gone" she replied "we close in ten minutes there's no more food left" I looked at her as if she wasn't serious. If the food is all gone then why is the establishment still open if it's a restaurant dumbo? You still have customers coming in wanting food! The doors are wide open yet no food? And you could tell they were glad to say it because they were so anxious to get off. If you're so anxious to get off work that you stop making food and turn away customers during working hours then maybe you shouldn't be working and stay your lazy ass at home. We had driven 35 minutes and this location was out of our way. They had some rice left that looked like it had been in there since the Vietnam nam war and a few other scraps that looked beaten down and assaulted. I told my mom let's go! We can spend our money else where. Then the managers comes out and says  "have a great nite" I'm like go sit down somewhere and do some training with your tired ass staff and step your game up as a manager and tell
these dummies that food should be ready for customers until the store actually is CLOSED! We Will never come here again plus they just opened a PE in cheltenhem near target and it's a lot cleaner and the staff have better attitudes.  We will never go here again. Despicable!

I am not a vegan! But I love hipCityVeg! They have really outdone with their menu. We have been ordering takeout/delivery and have never once been disappointed. Our usual to go is the udon noodle salad which comes with chik'n and the sweet potato fries. 
The salad is wholesome, fresh and downright delicious. I can personally never finish it in one sitting. 
In the past i have tried the chik'n nuggets and they pretty good!

This Chipotle is my favorite location in Center City! I live really close to the one on 15th and Walnut, but I always walk an extra 4 blocks to come to this one because the service and food quality is so much better at this one! 

I always get a bowl with extra white rice, half chicken/steak, fajitas, hot salsa, verde, cheese, and then a vinaigrette to mix in. In my humble opinion, this is perfection! I really like the staff here, they always seem to be in a good mood and laugh with one another. They are also generous with the portions! 

I wanted the regular size chips and guac, but they only had large bags of chips left for the day. So they gave me a large guac for the price of the regular. I was happy they made that swap for me! Love this Chipotle! Highly recommend walking a few extra blocks to go to this location!

Glad that my favorite fast casual burger spot from
New York City is also in Philadelphia. My go to is the 'Shroom burger (never has mushroom tasted so good) and fries but I've also tried the grilled cheese and veggie burger (no longer seems to be offered). 

Shake Shack is simply a step above the typical fast food spots and worth trying.

We ordered here for the first time tonight and the food was not good. Everything was cold. Mind you it's less than a 2 minute drive and I watched them make it. Chips were stale and they ran out of guacamole. Operationally, there were 2 people assembling meals during a dinner rush with about 6 other people waiting for their food so the staff didn't seem to be in a position to be successful. We want to support local business but there isn't an excuse for food to be that cold.

When I first went there to order two $5 meals that come with two drinks, two cookies and went home. I noticed two cookies were missing and I hardly see any chicken in my chicken pot pie ( What they do? Ate my chicken for themselves?) and all I see is the vegetable. We had problem before with the pot pit that has bone in it along with crunchy stuff that shouldn't be in the pie. My sister called the KFC and the guy answered, say his name is Joel but he lied and said, he would take care of it by writing it down by giving us three cookies. When I went back to pick up the cookies and went to Drive Thru. I spoke to the girl about the missing cookies and showed her the receipt with a name " Joel" and she came back and hand me ONE COOKIE? I was supposed to get two cookies that were part of the $5 meals ( 2) and the Black woman got real nasty and hand me two cookies and SLAMMED THE SIDE WINDOW. I said, BETTER GET YOUR ATTITUDE CHECKED. My sister called back and want to know why. It turned out this person gave a false name ( His name is Chris) and he's afraid he would get fired. Why lie? Why treat customers like us? I'm 63 years old and I feel everyone should be treated with respect. Kitchen worker should stop eating our food that were supposed to be in the pot pie. What a PIG!

Words do not explain how frustrating and disrespectful the experience i witnessed at this site. The cashier/manager (Denita) was rude when i asked for a side. She also refused to assist me when i told her the soda machine was off, i was told to wait until she feels like turning it on. I absolutely hate this location!
Not even trying.  Now online order only, this isn't the first time.  Absolute garrbage! And a huge inconvenience. This location is the worst I've been too.

I'm a little torn between giving Spice End three stars or four, but I'm coming down on three because I think the kati rolls could be served hotter. 

While the options and quality of the food is overall impressive (each dish is freshly made to order), the actual stand-out item for me was the vada pav. I had heard of this item before, a common street food snack in India, basically a small potato patty on small warm bun with a fried garlic chutney. Here at Spice End, the dish was served perfectly hot and was extremely flavorful, and even filling. While carbs on carbs like this could seem boring, the different flavors and textures made this dish a winner.

I only crave shake shack for burgers.The cashiers at this location have always been genuinely nice and patient.

The burgers here are slightly crispy on the outside and so juicy on the  inside. The meat is really good in terms of quality and fat ratio. I heard shake shack doesn't use oil when cooking their burgers since the meat has enough fat to cook in its own juices. This is probably why they taste amazing.

The hamburger with lettuce tomato and ketchup is my favorite. The cheeseburger is great too but this burger can stand on its own and is just as good without.

Skip the fries, even the cheese fries because they are terrible. Get a shake instead malted, with your burger and you wont even miss them.

Horrible. I thought I ordered delivery and when I finally figured it out (it was pick up and no where near my home) cancelled order they still charged me. 

Horrible!

This is a worthwhile vegan fast food place on Broad  St . We picked up two sandwiches- curry tofu and chickin( not chicken) with ranch dressing. Pretty good! Not a place you'd really want to eat in , although there  are three or four seats.They appear to have interesting drinks and smoothies.

Decided to try this lunch cart one day.  I ordered the general tso's chicken.  It comes with a medley of vegetables (snow peas, carrots, peppers, onions, and bok Choy).  The sauce is delicious, although a bit overpowering.  It's just a tad spicy and would add some sriracha to the meal to spice it further.  This is all served on a bed of white rice.

The portions left me still hungry for more, but flavors were there.

Portions size is far too small for it to be chipotle. You are paying literally $10 for a bowl so why make the only give a little rice and everything else. If you can go somewhere else, you should. Managers probably make them do this.

This location appears to be really struggling, twice we have placed orders only to have them cancelled when they were supposed to be delivered. Tried calling the restaurant and they never answer the phone. 
When we have placed pick up orders things have been missing and you won't find out until you arrive and picked up your packed yet incomplete order. 
It's a shame because the few times I have gone inside, I've met a friendly, young staff but, however this restaurant is being managed appears to overshadow whatever positives that have been experienced. 
Very disappointed.

I love me some Indian food, so I thought I'd give try this place all the good reviews. Got delivery of a Spice End platter (chicken and lamb), a chicken and rice platter, and an achari chicken roll.

-Chicken and rice platter: A big layer of ground chicken over yellow rice, topped with yogurt sauce and hot sauce. Similar to Halal cart style chicken and rice, if you've ever eaten that. Portion was big and satisfying but the rice and meat could've been more flavorful; I've definitely had better at food carts around the city.
-Spice End platter: Basically the same thing just with a mix of chicken and lamb. The meat is marinated with more spices so it's a little tastier but I wouldn't call it "taken to a whole new level" as the menu says
-Achari chicken roll: pretty good. Tender, marinated chicken with a hint of tartness from the pickle, wrapped in a warm paratha. A little dry by itself but great with some white sauce and hot sauce.

Don't expect the most amazing Indian food ever, but for the prices it's definitely worth it if you're looking for convenient, quick, and filling meal.

Snap Kitchen is my new go-to place for healthy goods. I love how everything is gluten-free and refined sugar-free but it's impossible to notice that the food is healthy because everything is SOOOO DELICIOUS!!!! I bought everything that looked and sounded good, which happened to be a lot. I spent a total of $159.19 on 2 Bison Quinoa Hash (small), 1 Beef Sweet Potato Scramble (small), 1 Chicken Butternut Macaroni (small), 1 Parmesan Chicken With Spiralized Butternut Squash (medium), 1 Turkey Sausage Breakfast Sandwich, 2 Coconut Cult- mango cream 16oz and 2 Coconut Cult-Original 16oz.   The prices are reasonable compared to eating out at a restaurant and the food is definitely better than a fancy meal. I love how all the ingredients and macronutrients are listed for each meal and there are different portion sizes for each meal. Snap Kitchen helps encourages people to live a healthy lifestyle by creating yummy meals. 

The Bison Quinoa Hash had a great combination of spices and had loads of bison meat! A hearty meal that I would definitely pick up again. Super delicious but since it is for the "sodium conscious," I had to add a lot of salt #guilty. The Turkey Sausage Breakfast Sandwich is hands down the BEST BREAKFAST SANDWICH EVER!!! The flavorful gluten-free bread tastes like regular bread, and the turkey sausage and egg white patties also were up my alley. I will be treating myself to another one of these breakfast sandwiches soon. 

I'll be having Snap Kitchen meals for the next few days since I bought so much!! I'll keep you all updated on what YOU HAVE TO TRY!!!! Also, the people are probably the NICEST people ever. I love coming here so much! 10/10 would recommend!

The first time I came here was because my mom was visiting and I knew she loved strawberry milkshakes. We decided to try the Shroom burger because she is a strict vegetarian. Let me say after eating that burger I can never eat a regular burger again. It was life changing delicious! And the milkshake....so thick...so creamy. 
So any ways a few months later I was craving that juicy mushroom burger so I walked over to Shake Shack. I placed my order and walked home to eat it. I was so excited as I bit down on my shroom burger! But then alas! I was like, Wait! This tastes like meat... So I took a 2nd bite to my dismay it was definitely beef! I used to eat meat but haven't for years, well at least definitely no beef. I spit it out. I was so bummed and called Shake Shack that very moment. To my surprise the manager  apologized and offered to accommodate me if I was willing to come back in. I was in my warm and cozy apartment but I decide to get dressed again and walk over and glad I did. The manager personally spoke to me sincerely apologizing and asked if I would give them another chance. (To be honest I was bummed out about not enjoy my mushroom burger but I was in no means angry about it, I mean I knew it was a mistake), but shake shack went above and beyond. They not only gave me a new mushroom burger, but also threw in fries& a 2nd milkshake! And let me tell you, you may think you've had a strawberry milkshake, but if it wasn't from Shake Shack, then you really didn't. I told them that didn't need to, all I was unhappy with was the Shroom Burger, but the manager insisted.
Any ways to sum this up, this was an epic experience with great customer service, which was both refreshing and delicious!

Honestly, for the price, quickness, and freshness, I absolutely can't complain! The concept is a little confusing (it's about as dark as a nightclub at 10pm, and some old @ramen branded bowls) but food is the real driver of a restaurant, right.

Okay, so you get this huge bowl that's like 2 parts rice to 1 part meat and veggies, which is expected. The teriyaki  chicken (boneless) is super moist and flavorful. The rice was slightly overcooked in some parts but I'd rather  it be a little mushy than hard. It also came with this coleslaw (definitely was told it'd be potato salad but I wasn't gonna eat it either way). And it came out to be like $8 after tax which is super great in center city. 

If you're confused, it's the dark ramen place, but with what I think is inherently better food!

My husband and I have given this location a chance several times. They regularly forget items in our orders and mess up dishes. This time, we ordered identical meals, but as you can see they were completely different - one bowl looks like it never made it past the first station (no salsa, cheese, lettuce, sour cream, etc). Cherry on top was the chunk of steak we found - we are both vegetarians, so it was gross to find red meat in the bowl and made us nervous to eat our meals. They also forgot our order of chips and guac. Thankfully used the app to receive a refund for the missing chips and a free meal for the botched order, but this will be the last time we order from this store.
Went there for lunch today and ordered the chicken with string beans.... Whu was there a hair in my food!!?? Never again will I ever eat from this place.
This place smells like the inside of  Indian guys ass garbage food garbage place do yourself a favor don't eat here don't even use the bedroom don't walk in

Omg. This is the worst Popeye's you'll ever go to. I've been there a total of three times. Their screw-up percentage is 100 percent, meaning they've screwed up all of my orders. Things as simple as the wrong drink, trying to serve me a sandwich without the bread (literally... there were chicken strips and pickles wrapped in paper), forgetting my biscuits, etc.

And the customer service is effing ridiculous. Like, why are you mad at me for coming back in and asking for my correct order? The lines are always insanely long, too.

Avoid if you can.

I was away for business, heading out of the 39th street station in Philly. Went to Jersey Mike's. I am a big fan of the brand . This was a smaller train station store. The service was so friendly and fast. They made me a huge turkey and provolone wrap.  It was just a great exuberance at something so simple yet so good.  Great job JERSEY MIKES PHILLY !!!
My go to fried chicken place. The manager listens to their customers. Good service. Love it.

Let's take two of the best food groups (yes, they're food groups now), put them together, and you get Coreanos. It's not the first time this has been done, and it won't be the last. What Coreanos does is fuse the two categories seamlessly, although the Korean side shine through more. I've had their rotisserie chicken (soy-lime marinated), rice bowl, and taco al pastor so far and have been impressed. It's the first time I've had rotisserie chicken with crispy skin. The rice bowl is YUGE and they don't skimp on the protein. Taco al pastor could compete with the best of them around Washington Ave. Great spot, and I can see this being THE spot for drunk food (other than Halal Guys, of course).

Meh.  I had the Cobb Salad here and substituted "roasted Shrimp" for turkey which proved to be a pricey and needless mistake.  The Shrimp were over cooked and rubbery.

The salad itself would have been just fine (Next time, IF there is a next time sticking to Turkey - I pray it is not dry.)

Avocado Ranch on the side was tasty.

$13 salad.  Blargh.

Oh - one bright spot - Service at the front counter from Natalie (sp?) was great and she ubbly, sassy, smiling personality.  They kind lady (Keysha?) who brought us our dine-in order was great, too.

They get packed during the lunch rush - location, location, location.
wow. 28$ for a bucket of dried out old chicken and 2 sides of slop... beagle approved.

Loved it! This was my first ever eating at Shake shake. I had high hopes going into it with my better half who talks it up all the time. It met my expectations and it was an awesome meal! Burger, chicken sandwich, fries, and chocolate shakes! Indoor and outdoor seating is available but limited. Food was prepared as we ordered and very tasty! Only downfall was we waited a bit to long for our food. It seems that our ticket may have been looked over but was corrected with no issues! Fun and awesome place. We will be back!

Go to buy lunch on Thursday, November 3rd...around 11:30 or so. Pull into the drive thru and order, only to be told that the registers weren't working and there wasn't a manager there to fix them, sorry...are you serious???
Ok, so I try again on Friday, the 4th. It's 11:10...I need to order for myself and a co-worker. 
Again, pull up to the Drive thru--one pot pie please and a 2 piece extra crispy meal. 
Sorry, there's a 20 minute wait for Pot Pies and we only have original chicken...wait!!!! You only sell chicken and you have NOTHING prepared??? How are you still in business???? On my way to Popeyes, you guys are ridiculous!!!!

My son and I waited in line to order. I stepped out to get a salad next door. Another worker stepped up so my son moved over. Then the workers left causing my son to be skipped over. Then when I pointed out he hadn't ordered, she told me he had to wait in line. I replied that he had. The worker placed both my son and I in an uncomfortable situation as she made seem like we were asking for special treatment when all we wanted was his food. Then to top it off, his nuggets were disgusting as they tasted like they had been cooked in months overdue for a change oil.

Ordered from them through DoorDash and I got the classic chicken sandwich with fries and a large coke, when my food came I got a large ice tea with fries and a Spicy chicken sandwich  I can't eat spicy food and this nasty ass sandwich had all this Buffalo sauce  TRASH
B****H!!!!! Tell me why theres no meat on this sandwich!?!?!   never going back. i ordered a turkey sub girl its not that hard

****Quick take-out review*****

While in dire need to fulfill an Indian food craving, I came upon this spot while yelping (of course). I went of the recommendation and got the Chicken Biryan. It was really good but not for 10 bucks. There wasn't much chicken in there.... lots of rice with about 8 pieces of chicken. I would try this place again since the flavor was there and its close to my job. Till next time Spice End.

Listen people. Go hear.

Its that simple. 

It was a nice day so I decided to take a little stroll down the block from my job and noticed a truck with pretty flowers on top of it so I was already intrigued. 

The menu is pretty straight forward, you have a choice between 5-6 wok made dishes with either rice or noodles as your base. You can also create your own dish instead of choosing one of the pre-thought of dishes. You have steak, chicken and shrimp to choose from (you can also get double vegetables if you do not eat meat)

I went with a shrimp & chicken rice bowl w chili garlic sauce cooked in Szechuan oil. 

Didn't take too long to receive my food maybe 5-7 minutes tops, it was nice out there was no need to look at the time. Pricing isn't real bad I paid extra to create my own meal.

The taste was BOMB. Very fresh, shrimp was not overcooked. Vegetables had a strong bite to them you can tell they were freshly cut. And a perfect portion size for lunch. The two people in the truck were very nice, chit chatted with regulars.

I grade 5s when they're needed and this was a 1 review 5, EASY. When you go, tell them CJ sent you.

This Wendy's is terrible. I pull up to the deuce thru and the worker says "what the f*** are you saying lady". I assume they didn't think the speaker was on but I heard him loud and clear. Should be ashamed or get another job that pays you better because you're clearly unhappy with life

THEY CAN DO NO WRONG! Ya, heard me? My meal is always hot, friendly service, the works. 

Considering I can't sink my hands in some In-and-Out, this will do. I hadn't been to this location in a minute but every time I passed by, I needed that fix. 

I'm an habitual orderer. If it's good, ya stick with it but dang nabbit, the cashier hooked me on an order of fries too. I'm questioning if I should have ordered another burger but is it too late to wonder this? Oh and yes, I always order without Shack Sauce. Things are just better this way. I will be back, plus visiting their other location. That's right. Philly is getting another Shack. Haha.
Open.  Nope. Online only.  Wow. Sent away when I walked in.   Either open or close!!!

Terrible service every time you go. They WILL mess up your order, whether you place it online, in-person, drive thru... Did I mention the awful service? Also I've never seen a single employee properly wearing a face mask, always down under the chin. Find somewhere better and safer to eat

Came here for dinner with some friends! Shake shack never fails ! We ordered 2 chicken sandwiches, a bacon cheese burger, shack stack and an order of regular fries! I had the shack stack and it was so good ! The shack stack is a cheeseburger, breaded portobello mushroom stuffed with cheese, and with lettuce/tomato. The cheese was oozing once you bite into the mushroom. Beware because it is hot, so let it cool down . This place has some solid fries. I have tried their cheese fries in the past and I must say, one of the best cheese fries I have had. They are crinkle cut fries with cheese whiz! 

In the past I have tried their spicy chicken sandwich. It contains spicy fried chicken patty, coleslaw, and pickles! It was so delicious and yummy! But i guess it was limited because I did not see it on the menu ! The service in this establishment is good. There is seating inside and outside. The total for this meal came up to about 41$

Boy, the burgers here are good. But...they are just as good elsewhere and for a lot cheaper (I'm lookin' at you, 99 cents Jr. Bacon Cheeseburger).

Shake Shack always boasts an eclectic bunch with everyone from medical students, high school kids, families and working professionals nomming on their burgers, dogs and fries. I prefer to come here for the ice cream, but they also have beer and wine, which would hit the spot in this ideal people-watching area. 

Hit up Shake Shack if you have a larger group of starving people, as the seating space is large.
Wow first time here but great service and loved how they bagged our food they separated it all out each meal in one bag and then put it all in a bigger carrier bag  that's awesome service

I feel like this is the best Shake Shack in the city considering my order is never wrong and the staff actually knows how to navigate lunch time. This particular review, though, is about the Chick'n Shack.

See, I have heard things about this elusive chicken sandwich. People had been asking me if I've had it, and my answer would always be "They have a chicken sandwich?" They do! And it's great.

The chicken itself is crispy on the outside, almost to a crunch, and the inside is cooked to temperature (because how easy is it to overcook?!). The lettuce is lettuce, but the herb mayo and pickles literally make this dish. Who needs Chick-Fil-A when you could have this majesty? I've had dreams about this sandwich, but magically I haven't been back out of fear that my experience was a fluke.

Definitely eat the Chick'n Shack.

Waited in line for 30 minutes just for two sandwiches wanted a large sprite after I ordered. Went to the window before even getting my food and asked if I could add a large sprite I had cash in my hand and they told me I had to go back around in the drive-through to place an order for one large sprite you're mad weird for that.

Spice End is my to go place whenever I want something quick, delicious and filling. This is Indian food but not the northern Indian food you're probably used to from other restaurants (e.g. don't expect chicken tikka and butter chicken). Spice End's Indian food is more dry like dry rub marinated grilled meat instead of stews. 

I love both the platters and kati rolls. My favorite roll is the chicken and egg roll. The fried egg is always cooked to perfection and the chicken super well marinated. It is so filling because of the ample amount of chicken they include plus the egg. I don't have a favorite platter because they all taste pretty similar although the Spice End platter is more spicy. 

Whatever you get, make sure you help yourself to plenty of their "white sauce". It reminds me of ranch dressing but doesn't have that super herby taste (I'm not a fan of ranch dressing, ick). Whatever the "white sauce" is, it's like crack! I can't get enough! The platters already come with the white sauce drizzled over it but I go over to the white sauce pump station and just smother my platter with the stuff.

The establishment itself is unassuming. Honestly I think they would get more business if they polished up the decor to make it look more hip because they do have some tacky artwork on their wall right now. The staff is always super efficient and friendly. They will bring you your food once your order is ready kind of like a sit in Chick Fil A.

The restaurant also sells Indian sodas and mango lassi for drinks. Spice End doesn't have the best mango lassi I've ever had (need more mango and more yogurt than milk I think) but it's not bad! I will have to try the masala chai next time when the weather gets colder!

The price could be a dollar or two cheaper for fast food because you can get similar chicken and rice platters (with the white and red sauce) at the halal carts in center city for $5 during lunch time. The Halal carts aren't around after lunch though and Spice End stays opens late (after 10pm) so it's great if you have the late night munchies! Portion size is also pretty big so a platter is definitely filling enough for dinner.  I always eat in or take out so can't comment on the delivery.

I've been meaning to come back here since I recently went to in and out on the west coast.  In the battle between east and west, I'd prefer shake shack over in and out.  

The bun is very soft and fluffy and the meat patty is properly seasoned and had a nice charred crust.  The fries are okay, but they come out consistently crispy.  The wait can get pretty long around lunchtime so recommend getting here before the noon rush.  

I can understand why people like in and out (animal style anything and the secret menu), but in terms of pure burger - shake shack wins!

Shake Shack is a cool place to hang out with friends in the neighborhood, especially if it's too cold to be outdoors in the Square. This Shake Shack is no better, and no worse, than any other locations of the chain, but one can always say that the staff are very friendly and accommodating. 

Especially notable is the Smokehouse burger, with it's Shack sauce, bacon, and peppers. The fries are basic, but they are delicious and a (un)healthy portion. The shakes are delicious and what you should expect from real ice cream.

I think Shake Shacks are overpriced for what you get, which is why I give 4/5 stars. I remember a few times having a sinking feeling in my tummy about the price, made worse by the cognizant (but tasty) ball of grease already in there. Haha

But at least the Shake Shack quality is dependable; and it's a gorgeous restaurant to spend a little time in!

Tonight was our very first time at a Shake Shake and I will tell you we will return! It was very crowded and not many seats and the manager couldn't have been more accommodating. Getting us seats together (there were 7 of us), to cleaning our table and bringing us samples of their ice cream! He went above and beyond!  Food was good too!

I survived off of this shit for years. 

I got obese as all hell and could hardly breathe ... years went on. I woke up. I still get occasional cravings. occasional meaning maybe once a year.

Not only do I feel horrible after eating food from here. I feel guilt and shame with every bite. There's no love in this "food" man. Low vibration food for the sleeping masses ..I'll pass. 

Love yourself. 

You deserve better.

Investigate how the beef is laden with antibiotics. How the beef is prepared... It's all bad stuff man. 

what's more? their food is now expensive. 

Hit up a legit Mexican joint or cook tacos at home. You'll stomach and health will thank you.

I SO look forward to Shake Shack when I visit America! This was no exception to the best burgers I have had. The service was good, fast and friendly and the food was delicious. I ordered the original shack burger and the crinkly fries. Delicious. Im drooling just writing this review...

There was an employee there who was VERY nice and helpful. He even offered to get our drink refills for us! I didn't get his name but he was very friendly!

Do you do the roll? As in KATI ROLL?! If so, you'll love Spice End. 

I can only speak for the Kati roll's here - but every one that I've had has been pretty darn on point.  The paneer, vegetable, and egg I've tried, and each time, they have been made, flavored, and cooked properly.  Additionally, they were always hot and tasted like they had some pretty darn fresh ingredients. It's priced well, the service has been fast in my experience, and they are super nice there. The thing I don't love - the sauces they give you. The white one tastes like buttermilk on most days, and it's apparently made of mayo. The red one is good, but nothing inventive. Honestly, it's Indian - they should have good chutney to go with it all!

Otherwise, a great place.

Popped in here for a late lunch and I walked out pretty disappointed. I had heard so much about 
Shake Shack so I was excited to try it out, but I can now say I really don't get the hype. 

I got the Shack Hamburger with all the fillings (lettuce, tomato, pickles, onions, and Shack Sauce) and it was just... meh. I was most excited to try the Shack Sauce since I had heard so much about it, but it was nothing special and underwhelming in flavor. Was it because there was barely any added to my burger? Who knows, but either way, nothing to rave about. 

It was also a pretty lengthy wait for lunch at 2:30 pm! All I ordered was a hamburger, no fries, no shake. Had I been more impressed with the food, it would have been worth the wait, but unfortunately I can't say I was. 

I'm glad I checked this place out after hearing so much about it, but in all honesty, this was no different to me than just any fast food, drive through burger joint (e.g. McDonalds). If I'm feeling a burger craving coming along in the future, I think I'll just dish out the dough and go to Village Whiskey.

Just opened KQ Burger @Franklin's Table Food Hall on University of Penn's Campus.

I tried the mushroom burger with American cheese and shroom sauce. No psychedelics here lol.

I opted for medium as opposed to my usual medium rare, 1st day opening so goes the reasoning.

At first glance, the burger looked to be on the small side but overall was quite filling. I would venture to guess that the pre-cooked weight was 16oz ÷ 3 = 1/3 yup. No Penn degree necessary.

Basically, the burger was duhlicious. Yes spelled that way. Duh of course it was delicious delicious. 

Cooked perfectly at medium, local mushrooms and that psychedelic sauce. Yum. Ok nothing illegal but definitely trippy :)

Local everything from the grass-fed beef, cheese, fresh house-baked brioche roll and local mushrooms. There were some onions in that sauce and what looked to be parsley.

Huge fan of the Kensington Quarters restaurant and the local love and responsible sourcing.  
#grassfed4life

A welcome edition to the 13th Street Kitchens lineup.

When is KQ Burger(Location 2) replacing Wahlburgers??? 
Or a Fishtown/Kensington location :)

Highly recommended and a definite return visit!

This place is tiny! I believe other locations may have more seating but this spot has three seats by the window and I happily claimed one to smash my food. I was in Philly for work and NEEDED to find a vegan cheesesteak. Especially after the previous night's shenanigans. 

After a little yelp and Instagram research (professional food stalker), I stumbled upon HipCityVeg which is 100% vegan/plant based. Their philly has great reviews but I was a little skeptical because they put ketchup on the sandwich... why doe? I was able to leave the ketchup off and add ranch because who doesn't love ranch?

Oh. My. God. This cheesesteak was the best I've ever had!! Even better than any real meat cheesesteak and I haven't been vegan that long to forget flavor! Vegan food that's amazing that satisfies old cravings, yum! The bread was perfectly soft and fresh filled with plenty of toppings: mushrooms, onions, seitan and vegan cheese. 

I can't wait to return to try their chicken sandwich which seems to be even more popular. They also have healthier whole food plant based items on their menu which I'm sure are delicious! I was tempted by their orange creamsicle milkshake but I'll have to try another time.

This place is new, modern and serves great burgers, hot dogs, shakes and yes beer and wine! The hot dogs are fried, something I haven't had since I was a kid. The burgers are juicy and tasty. They're located literally across from Village Whiskey, who make the best burgers in the world. However these are close in quality and taste but cost about 75% less.

Made my second visit here yesterday, arrived at 11:30am and the line was out the door already. They're pretty organized so the line moves quickly. They make everything fresh to order but it only takes a couple minutes. The inside sitting area turns frequently so even with the line, pretty easy to get a table. With the park only 2 blocks away, you can easily bring your food there as well. This place is a must if you want a burger or hot dog.

Never in a hundred years would I have thought Philly would be such an incredible city for vegetarian and vegan foods. Maybe because I don't know much about Philly and all I do know is cheesesteaks. Nevertheless, I was THOROUGHLY pleased and stumbled upon this spot. Great walking distance from The Bellevue for a quick lunch break.

The service was very friendly- much different compared to the people on the sidewalk. Don't get confused, I love the east coast attitude. Anyway- staff helped me decide on a burger and WOW! One of the best burgers (meat included) I've ever had! Thick, juicy, cheesy, & tasted fresh. I grabbed all of their sauces and can't remember which I liked the most, but I do remember liking all of them either way. I also got a side of fries but barely touched them because I was stuffed. That's how I knew it was an awesome burger...I didn't finish my fries first!

Yum.

THE INDO-CHINESE Y'ALL!

For starters, I love a good kati roll -- noone makes better than my mother-in-law, but the recipe tastes similar, so I suspended my disbelief and made my husband promise not to tell her. The achari chicken and chana options were spot on. I drowned my kati in both sauces like I usually do and I was so happy with the result; nearly licked the plate clean. But the real star, a new addition to the menu it seems, were the Indo-Chinese options! We tried the gobi/paneer chilli and WOWZERS I am craving it again already! 

If you live in the area and haven't stopped by, get to it! If you're traveling, this is a charming area of downtown Philly that has loads to offer in regards to eats and treats!

I decided to give Shake Shack Philly a second try before I wrote them off as an inferior SS.  

Well yes, my heart will always belong to the SS in Madison Square.  It's the environment, the atmosphere, and the people.  

I went to SS Philly on the day of the opening and there was a line wrapped outside the building.  It wasn't too long of a wait and the order came moderately quickly.  But the shack burger on that day was not the greatest.

The second time around, the shack burger was just like I remembered in SS NY but the fries were not that crispy.  But really, it's just another burger joint.

Ultimately, I rate SS Philly the same taste-wise but the experience is just not the same as in NY.

Loved somethings that Shake Shack had to offer, but hated some of the others. Overall its a 2.5, but I curve to three for the service being somewhat better than burger drones (see - http://www.yelp.com/biz/bobbys-burger-palace-philadelphia#hrid:MAsXlhEzbGoopwOkcjoWEA/src:self), and the Double Smoke Stack being a tasty burger. But beyond that it left much to be desired for me. 

When an area is as convoluted in Burger offerings as Rittenhouse Square is (See - http://www.yelp.com/biz/hipcityveg-philadelphia#hrid:JMJsT_w6XionQJXaakLJ9g/src:self) you have to compare it to what other spots within its surroundings have to offer; especially when its backed by the celebrity chef that's the equivalent of Danny Meyer. But despite both I couldn't help but feel that there were areas were the Shack was seriously lacking.

For lack of a better word the crinkle cut fries were a travesty. They were devoid of seasoning and completely lacking in flavor. Cooking a bag of McCain or ordering off a Wendy's Dollar Menu would have delivered better results. Normally that's a bad thing; but when one burger spot down the way offers varieties like Cajun and duck fat fries, the local vegetarian joint offers up freshly cut and seasoned sweet potato fries, and even the Five Guys a few blocks away offers fresh cut fries by the bag load; its a JOKE! The 50/50 blend of iced tea and lemonade i ordered was also bland in taste and completely failed to taste like either, thusly even giving a bottle of Nantucket Nectar's Half and Half more of an edge.

Both are indeed grave travesties of justice that could result in severe reprimand of a place.
